NAME: SSP_KPI_BR_BOD_REGISTRATION_DW_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SSP_KPI_BR_BOD_REGISTRATION_DW_V
 * Description  : SSP_KPI_BR_BOD_REGISTRATION 조회
                  소속 DIVISION_ID로 정보를 조회 하기 위해서
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2022.05.01   SSP Pjt.       Created
 * 2026.07.05   ZIONEX   [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
 S.YYYYMMDD
     , S.YYYYMM
     , S.WEEK_NAME
     , D.ATTRIBUTE3            AS DIVISION_ID
     , S.FROM_SITE
     , S.FROM_CITY
     , S.TO_SITE
     , S.TO_CITY
     , S.VMI_YN
     , S.INCOTERMS
     , S.TRANSPORT_MODE
     , S.ROUTE_CNT
     , S.CUSTOMER
     , S.CREATED_BY
     , S.CREATION_DATE
     , S.LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , S.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
     , S.ATTRIBUTE1
     , S.ATTRIBUTE2
     , S.ATTRIBUTE3
     , S.ATTRIBUTE4
     , S.ATTRIBUTE5
     , S.ATTRIBUTE6
     , S.ATTRIBUTE7
     , S.ATTRIBUTE8
     , S.ATTRIBUTE9
     , S.ATTRIBUTE10
     , S.DIVISION_ID           AS SCM_DIVISION_ID
  FROM SSP_KPI_BR_BOD_REGISTRATION S
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION D
 WHERE S.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID

NAME: SSP_KPI_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS_DW_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SSP_KPI_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS_DW_V
 * Description  : OWMS 출하실저, 반품실적 FOR DW
                  소속 DIVISION_ID로 정보를 조회 하기 위해서
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2022.04.01   SSP Pjt.       Created
 *
 * 2026.07.04   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
 FS.COMPANY_ID
	,      FS.PLANT_ID
	,      D.ATTRIBUTE3		AS DIVISION_ID
	,      FS.OPERATION_GROUP
	,      X.FROM_SITE
	,      NVL(X.TO_SITE, '-')          AS TO_SITE
	,      NVL(X.CUSTOMER_CODE, '-')    AS CUSTOMER_CODE
	,      X.ITEM_ID
	,      X.YYYYMMDD
	,      X.QTY
	,      NVL(B.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY, 1) * X.QTY AS QTY_TO_CELL
	,      X.DIVISION_ID	AS SCM_DIVISION_ID
	FROM (
			SELECT A.DIVISION_ID       AS DIVISION_ID
			,      A.FROM_SITE         AS FROM_SITE
			,      A.TO_SITE     AS TO_SITE
	/*		,      CASE WHEN A.TO_SITE ='-' THEN A.CUSTOMER_CODE ELSE  A.TO_SITE END          AS TO_SITE */
			,      A.CUSTOMER_CODE     AS CUSTOMER_CODE
			,      A.ITEM_ID           AS ITEM_ID
			,      A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE  AS YYYYMMDD
			,      SUM(A.LOT_QTY)       AS QTY
			FROM SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS A
			GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
			,        A.ITEM_ID
			,        A.FROM_SITE
			,        A.TO_SITE
			/* ,        CASE WHEN A.TO_SITE ='-' THEN A.CUSTOMER_CODE ELSE A.TO_SITE  END */
			,        A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
			,        A.CUSTOMER_CODE
			UNION ALL
			SELECT B.DIVISION_ID      AS DIVISION_ID
			,      B.FROM_SITE        AS FROM_SITE
			,      '-'                AS TO_SITE
			,      '-'                AS CUSTOMER_CODE
			,      B.ITEM_ID          AS ITEM_ID
			,      B.RECIEPT_DATE     AS YYYYMMDD
			,      SUM(B.RECIEPT_QTY) * -1      AS QTY
			FROM SSP_DNM_SHIP_RETURN_OWMS B
			GROUP BY B.DIVISION_ID
			,        B.ITEM_ID
			,        B.FROM_SITE
			,        B.RECIEPT_DATE
			) X
	 JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM V
	   ON V.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
	  AND V.ITEM_ID = X.ITEM_ID
	 JOIN SCM_MST_SITE FS
	   ON FS.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
	  AND FS.SCM_SITE_ID = X.FROM_SITE
	  AND FS.SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT'
	  AND FS.OSP_YN      = 'N'
	 JOIN SCM_MST_SITE TS
	   ON TS.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
	  AND TS.SCM_SITE_ID = X.TO_SITE
	  AND TS.SITE_TYPE   = 'SALES'
	 JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D
	   ON X.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
	 LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_MODEL_FINAL_ITEM_BOM_V B
	   ON B.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
	  AND B.MODEL_ID    = X.ITEM_ID
	  AND B.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'A'
	  AND B.PLANT_ID = FS.PLANT_ID
	  AND B.TCO_CELL_YN = 'N'

NAME: SSP_KPI_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/********************************************************************************************************************************
* VIEW NAME     : [SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS_V]
* DESCRIPTION   : OWMS 출하실저, 반품실적

* PROGRAM HISTORY
*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* 2020.01.20   juhlee     DW 제공을 위한 OWMS 실적 VIEW
* 2026.07.04   ZIONEX     [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
********************************************************************************************************************************/
 FS.COMPANY_ID
,      FS.PLANT_ID
,      X.DIVISION_ID
,      FS.OPERATION_GROUP
,      X.FROM_SITE
,      NVL(X.TO_SITE, '-')          AS TO_SITE
,      NVL(X.CUSTOMER_CODE, '-')    AS CUSTOMER_CODE
,      X.ITEM_ID
,      X.YYYYMMDD
,      X.QTY
,      NVL(B.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY, 1) * X.QTY AS QTY_TO_CELL
FROM (
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID       AS DIVISION_ID
        ,      A.FROM_SITE         AS FROM_SITE
        ,      A.TO_SITE           AS TO_SITE
--      ,      CASE WHEN A.TO_SITE ='-' THEN A.CUSTOMER_CODE ELSE  A.TO_SITE END          AS TO_SITE
        ,      A.CUSTOMER_CODE     AS CUSTOMER_CODE
        ,      A.ITEM_ID           AS ITEM_ID
        ,      A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE  AS YYYYMMDD
        ,      SUM(A.LOT_QTY)      AS QTY
        FROM SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS A
        GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
        ,        A.ITEM_ID
        ,        A.FROM_SITE
        ,        A.TO_SITE
--      ,        CASE WHEN A.TO_SITE ='-' THEN A.CUSTOMER_CODE ELSE A.TO_SITE  END
        ,        A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
        ,        A.CUSTOMER_CODE
        UNION ALL
        SELECT B.DIVISION_ID      AS DIVISION_ID
        ,      B.FROM_SITE        AS FROM_SITE
        ,      '-'                AS TO_SITE
        ,      '-'                AS CUSTOMER_CODE
        ,      B.ITEM_ID          AS ITEM_ID
        ,      B.RECIEPT_DATE     AS YYYYMMDD
        ,      SUM(B.RECIEPT_QTY) * -1      AS QTY
        FROM SSP_DNM_SHIP_RETURN_OWMS B
        GROUP BY B.DIVISION_ID
        ,        B.ITEM_ID
        ,        B.FROM_SITE
        ,        B.RECIEPT_DATE
        ) X
 JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM V
   ON V.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
  AND V.ITEM_ID = X.ITEM_ID
 JOIN SCM_MST_SITE FS
   ON FS.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
  AND FS.SCM_SITE_ID = X.FROM_SITE
  AND FS.SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT'
  AND FS.OSP_YN      = 'N'
 JOIN SCM_MST_SITE TS
   ON TS.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
  AND TS.SCM_SITE_ID = X.TO_SITE
  AND TS.SITE_TYPE   = 'SALES'
 LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_MODEL_FINAL_ITEM_BOM_V B
   ON B.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
  AND B.MODEL_ID    = X.ITEM_ID
  AND B.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = 'A'
  AND B.PLANT_ID = FS.PLANT_ID
  AND B.TCO_CELL_YN = 'N'

NAME: SSP_MAIL_SHIP_PLAN_INTER_COM_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/********************************************************************************************************************************
 * VIEW NAME     : [SSP_MAIL_SHIP_PLAN_INTER_COM_V]
 * DESCRIPTION   : 법인간 거래 대상 TO_SITE PO발행을 위한 공유 메일 대상자 및 대상 아이템 추출 (81,82 대상)

 * PROGRAM HISTORY
 *-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  DATE        IN CHARGE      DESCRIPTION
 *-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2018.10.17   juhlee         Initial Release [PJ20189106] 전지.GSCM 고도화 이행-
 * 2022.04.01   SSP Pjt.       JV DIVISION_ID 적용
******************************************************************************************************************************* */
 DISTINCT
       C.SEGMENT2 AS MAIL_RECEIVER
     , A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , A.FROM_SITE
     , A.ITEM_ID
     , A.TO_SITE
     , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'YYYYMMDD')  AS FROM_YYYYMMDD
     , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 14, 'YYYYMMDD') AS TO_YYYYMMDD
     , FN_GET_SSP_ANL_SHIP_FROZEN(A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE) AS SHIP_FROZEN
  FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_C          A
     , SCM_MST_SITE                 B
     , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL C
 WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
   AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.TO_SITE
   AND B.SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT'
   AND B.OSP_YN      = 'N'
   AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SHIP_PLAN_INTER_COM_MAIL_SEND'
   AND C.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
   AND C.SEGMENT3    = CASE WHEN C.SEGMENT3 = 'ALL' THEN 'ALL' ELSE A.TO_SITE END
   AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = (SELECT MAX(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
                                  FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_C
                                 WHERE COMPANY_ID = A.COMPANY_ID
                                   AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                                         FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION
                                                        WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                                          AND ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82')))
   AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'YYYYMMDD')
   AND A.YYYYMMDD <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + 14, 'YYYYMMDD')
   AND A.MEASURE = 'SHIP_PLAN'
   AND FN_GET_SSP_ANL_SHIP_FROZEN(A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE) > 0  /* 확정일자 0이상인것만 */
   AND A.QTY > 0
   AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                           FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION
                          WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                            AND ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82'))

NAME: SSP_MAIL_SHIP_REQ_DELETE_V
TEXT:
WITH MAIL_RECEIVER AS
(
    SELECT X.DIVISION_ID
         , X.COMPANY_ID
         , X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
         , X.MAIL_RECEIVER
         , X.FROM_SITE
         , X.ITEM_ID
         , X.TO_SITE
      FROM ( /* LOOKUP등록자 */
             SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                  , A.COMPANY_ID
                  , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                  , M.SEGMENT2 AS MAIL_RECEIVER
                  , A.FROM_SITE
                  , A.ITEM_ID
                  , A.TO_SITE
               FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_C          A
                  , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M
              WHERE M.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SHIP_REQ_DEL_MAIL_SEND'
                AND M.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                AND M.SEGMENT3    = CASE WHEN M.SEGMENT3 = 'ALL' THEN 'ALL' ELSE A.FROM_SITE END
                AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = (SELECT MAX(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
                                               FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_C
                                              WHERE COMPANY_ID = A.COMPANY_ID
                                                AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                                                      FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION
                                                                     WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                                                       AND ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82')))
                AND A.MEASURE      = 'SHIP_REQ'
                AND A.CONFIRM_FLAG = 'D'
                AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                        FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION
                                       WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                         AND ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82'))
             UNION ALL
             /* LOOKUP등록자 (TYPE : SCP 대상 : 법인간 거래 ) */
             SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                  , A.COMPANY_ID
                  , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                  , M.SEGMENT2 AS MAIL_RECEIVER
                  , A.FROM_SITE
                  , A.ITEM_ID
                  , A.TO_SITE
               FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_C          A
                  , SCM_MST_SITE                 S
                  , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M
              WHERE S.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                AND S.SCM_SITE_ID = A.TO_SITE
                AND S.SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT'
                AND S.OSP_YN      = 'N'
                AND M.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SHIP_REQ_DEL_MAIL_SEND'
                AND M.SEGMENT1    = 'SCP'
                AND M.SEGMENT3    = CASE WHEN M.SEGMENT3 = 'ALL' THEN 'ALL' ELSE A.FROM_SITE END
                AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = (SELECT MAX(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
                                               FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_C
                                              WHERE COMPANY_ID = A.COMPANY_ID
                                                AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                                                      FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION
                                                                     WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                                                       AND ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82')))
                AND A.MEASURE      = 'SHIP_REQ'
                AND A.CONFIRM_FLAG = 'D'
                AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                        FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION
                                       WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                         AND ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82'))
             UNION ALL
             /* 출하요청자 REQUESTOR */
             SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                  , A.COMPANY_ID
                  , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                  , A.REQUESTOR AS MAIL_RECEIVER
                  , A.FROM_SITE
                  , A.ITEM_ID
                  , A.TO_SITE
               FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_C A
              WHERE A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = (SELECT MAX(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
                                               FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_C
                                              WHERE COMPANY_ID = A.COMPANY_ID
                                                AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                                                      FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION
                                                                     WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                                                       AND ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82')))
                AND A.MEASURE      = 'SHIP_REQ'
                AND A.CONFIRM_FLAG = 'D'
                AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                        FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION
                                       WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                         AND ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82'))
             UNION ALL
             /* MKT_OWNER */
             SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                  , A.COMPANY_ID
                  , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                  , U.MKT_USER AS MAIL_RECEIVER
                  , A.FROM_SITE
                  , A.ITEM_ID
                  , A.TO_SITE
               FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_C A
                  , SSP_MKT_USER_V      U
              WHERE U.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                AND U.TO_SITE      = A.TO_SITE
                AND U.ITEM_ID      = A.ITEM_ID
                AND U.PROJECT_CODE = A.PROJECT_CODE
                AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = (SELECT MAX(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
                                               FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_C
                                              WHERE COMPANY_ID = A.COMPANY_ID
                                                AND DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                                                      FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION
                                                                     WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                                                       AND ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82')))
                AND A.MEASURE      = 'SHIP_REQ'
                AND A.CONFIRM_FLAG = 'D'
                AND A.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                        FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION
                                       WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                         AND ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82'))
           ) X
     GROUP BY X.DIVISION_ID
            , X.COMPANY_ID
            , X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            , X.MAIL_RECEIVER
            , X.FROM_SITE
            , X.ITEM_ID
            , X.TO_SITE
)
SELECT V.MAIL_RECEIVER
     , R.COMPANY_ID
     , R.DIVISION_ID
     , R.FROM_SITE
     , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(R.DIVISION_ID, R.FROM_SITE) AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
     , R.ITEM_ID
     , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(R.DIVISION_ID, R.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
     /* [2026-10-07] NULL 전파를 원본과 맞춘다 (사용자 결정 「가」).
      * 원본 MSSQL : U.USERNAME + '('+R.REQUESTOR +')'  — 보호가 없어 **NULL 을 전파**한다
      *              (운영 추출본 prod_20261006 의 뷰 정의로 확인).
      * 변환본은 `||` 라 NULL 이 빈값이 되어 이름 없이 '(ID)' 만 남았다 —
      * 사용자표에 없는 요청자(퇴사·삭제 계정)에서 갈린다. 2026-10-07 교차수행이 실측으로 잡았다
      *   MSSQL NULL  ↔  Oracle '(zzx16nouser)'
      * 행 12 PR_SCM_ADM_DEPT_CHANGED_MAIL 의 APPROVAL_NAME 과 **같은 결함 유형**이고
      * 그쪽과 같은 형태(CASE WHEN … IS NULL THEN NULL)로 맞춘다.
      * ★이 뷰의 소비자는 PR_SSP_MAIL_SEND_SHIP_REQ_DELETE 하나뿐이다(산출물 전수 grep).
      * ★같은 패턴이 SSP_MAIL_SHIP_REQ_MINUS_BALANCE_V 등 22곳에 더 있다 — 소급 범위는 별도 결정. */
     , CASE
           WHEN U.USERNAME  IS NULL
             OR R.REQUESTOR IS NULL
           THEN NULL
           ELSE U.USERNAME || '(' || R.REQUESTOR || ')'
       END AS REQUESTOR
     , R.TO_SITE
     , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(R.DIVISION_ID, R.TO_SITE) AS TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
     , TS.END_CUSTOMER AS END_CUSTOMER
     , R.FCST_TYPE
     , R.INCOTERMS
     , R.TRANSPORT_MODE
     , R.YYYYMMDD
     , R.QTY
  FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_C R
     , MAIL_RECEIVER        V
     , SCM_MST_SITE         TS
     , TB_FX_USER           U
 WHERE V.DIVISION_ID         = R.DIVISION_ID
   AND V.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = R.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
   AND V.COMPANY_ID          = R.COMPANY_ID
   AND V.FROM_SITE           = R.FROM_SITE
   AND V.ITEM_ID             = R.ITEM_ID
   AND R.MEASURE             = 'SHIP_REQ'
   AND R.CONFIRM_FLAG        = 'D'
   AND TS.DIVISION_ID        = R.DIVISION_ID
   AND TS.SCM_SITE_ID        = R.TO_SITE
   AND U.USERID(+)           = R.REQUESTOR
   AND R.MEASURE             = 'SHIP_REQ'
   AND R.CONFIRM_FLAG        = 'D'
   AND R.DIVISION_ID IN (SELECT DIVISION_ID
                           FROM SCM_MST_DIVISION
                          WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                            AND ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82'))

NAME: SSP_MAIL_SHIP_REQ_MINUS_BALANCE_V
TEXT:
WITH MAIL_RECEIVER
  AS (
      SELECT /********************************************************************************************************************************
* VIEW NAME     : [SSP_MAIL_SHIP_REQ_MINUS_BALANCE_V]
* DESCRIPTION   : 소형 출하요청내역중 차월 음수 Balance 대상 Mail 발송대상자 및 Item 추출

* PROGRAM HISTORY
*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* 2019.06.14   juhlee     nitial Release [CSR ID:4016810] [요청] SSP Planning Horizen 연장에 따른 Shipment Request Logic 변경
* 2026.07.06   ZIONEX     [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration

********************************************************************************************************************************/  X.DIVISION_ID
           , X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           , X.PLAN_TYPE
           , X.SEQ
           , X.MAIL_RECEIVER
           , X.FROM_SITE
           , X.ITEM_ID
        FROM (
              SELECT R.DIVISION_ID
                   , R.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                   , R.PLAN_TYPE
                   , R.SEQ
                   , R.CREATED_BY AS MAIL_RECEIVER
                   , R.FROM_SITE
                   , R.ITEM_ID
                FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_REQ R
                   , SSP_MST_SHIP_REQ  M
               WHERE M.DIVISION_ID         = R.DIVISION_ID
                 AND M.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = R.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                 AND M.PLAN_TYPE           = R.PLAN_TYPE
                 AND M.SEQ                 = R.SEQ
                 AND M.CUTOFF_FLAG         = 'Y'
                 AND M.CONFIRM_FLAG        = 'N'
                 AND R.DIVISION_ID         = '40'
                 AND R.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = (SELECT MAX(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
                                                FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_REQ A)
                 AND R.MEASURE IN ('SHIP_REQ')
                 AND R.QTY > 0
                 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                               FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_REQ B
                              WHERE R.DIVISION_ID         = B.DIVISION_ID
                                AND R.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                AND R.PLAN_TYPE           = B.PLAN_TYPE
                                AND R.SEQ                 = B.SEQ
                                AND R.ITEM_ID             = B.ITEM_ID
                                AND R.FROM_SITE           = B.FROM_SITE
                                AND B.MEASURE             = 'BALANCE'
                                AND B.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN M.CONFIRM_START_DATE AND M.CONFIRM_END_DATE
                                AND B.YYYYMMDD            = R.YYYYMMDD
                                AND B.QTY < 0)
                 AND R.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN M.CONFIRM_START_DATE AND M.CONFIRM_END_DATE
               GROUP BY R.DIVISION_ID, R.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, R.PLAN_TYPE, R.SEQ, R.CREATED_BY, R.FROM_SITE, R.ITEM_ID

              UNION ALL

              SELECT R.DIVISION_ID
                   , R.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                   , R.PLAN_TYPE
                   , R.SEQ
                   , L.SEGMENT2 AS MAIL_RECEIVER
                   , R.FROM_SITE
                   , R.ITEM_ID
                FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_REQ            R
                   , SSP_MST_SHIP_REQ            M
                   , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
               WHERE M.DIVISION_ID         = R.DIVISION_ID
                 AND M.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = R.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                 AND M.PLAN_TYPE           = R.PLAN_TYPE
                 AND M.SEQ                 = R.SEQ
                 AND M.CUTOFF_FLAG         = 'Y'
                 AND M.CONFIRM_FLAG        = 'N'
                 AND L.LOOKUP_TYPE         = 'NEGATIVE_MAIL_SEND'
                 AND L.VALID_YN            = 'Y'
                 AND L.SEGMENT3            = CASE WHEN L.SEGMENT3 = 'ALL' THEN 'ALL' ELSE R.FROM_SITE END
                 AND R.DIVISION_ID         = '40'
                 AND R.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = (SELECT MAX(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
                                                FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_REQ A)
                 AND R.MEASURE IN ('SHIP_REQ')  /*  , 'BALANCE' ) */
                 AND R.QTY > 0
                 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                               FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_REQ B
                              WHERE R.DIVISION_ID         = B.DIVISION_ID
                                AND R.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                                AND R.PLAN_TYPE           = B.PLAN_TYPE
                                AND R.SEQ                 = B.SEQ
                                AND R.ITEM_ID             = B.ITEM_ID
                                AND R.FROM_SITE           = B.FROM_SITE
                                AND B.MEASURE             = 'BALANCE'
                                AND B.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN M.CONFIRM_START_DATE AND M.CONFIRM_END_DATE
                                AND B.YYYYMMDD            = R.YYYYMMDD
                                AND B.QTY < 0)
                 AND R.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN M.CONFIRM_START_DATE AND M.CONFIRM_END_DATE
               GROUP BY R.DIVISION_ID, R.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, R.PLAN_TYPE, R.SEQ, L.SEGMENT2, R.FROM_SITE, R.ITEM_ID
             ) X
     )
SELECT V.MAIL_RECEIVER
     , R.DIVISION_ID
     , R.FROM_SITE
     , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(R.DIVISION_ID, R.FROM_SITE) AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
     , R.ITEM_ID
     , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(R.DIVISION_ID, R.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--     , U.USERNAME || '(' || R.CREATED_BY || ')' AS REQUESTOR
     , U.USER_NM || '(' || R.CREATED_BY || ')' AS REQUESTOR
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
     , R.TO_SITE
     , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_DESCRIPTION(R.DIVISION_ID, R.TO_SITE) AS TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
     , R.PROJECT_CODE AS END_CUSTOMER
     , R.FCST_TYPE
     , R.INCOTERMS
     , R.TRANSPORT_MODE
     , R.YYYYMMDD
     , R.QTY
  FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_REQ R
     , MAIL_RECEIVER     V
     , SSP_MST_SHIP_REQ  M
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--     , TB_FX_USER        U
     , SCM_ADM_USER_M    U
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
 WHERE V.DIVISION_ID         = R.DIVISION_ID
   AND V.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = R.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
   AND V.PLAN_TYPE           = R.PLAN_TYPE
   AND V.SEQ                 = R.SEQ
   AND V.FROM_SITE           = R.FROM_SITE
   AND V.ITEM_ID             = R.ITEM_ID
   AND M.DIVISION_ID         = R.DIVISION_ID
   AND M.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = R.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
   AND M.PLAN_TYPE           = R.PLAN_TYPE
   AND M.SEQ                 = R.SEQ
   AND M.CUTOFF_FLAG         = 'Y'
   AND M.CONFIRM_FLAG        = 'N'
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--   AND U.USERID              = R.CREATED_BY
   AND U.USER_ID             = R.CREATED_BY
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
   AND R.DIVISION_ID         = '40'
   AND R.MEASURE IN ('SHIP_REQ')
   AND R.QTY > 0
   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                 FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_REQ B
                WHERE R.DIVISION_ID         = B.DIVISION_ID
                  AND R.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                  AND R.PLAN_TYPE           = B.PLAN_TYPE
                  AND R.SEQ                 = B.SEQ
                  AND R.ITEM_ID             = B.ITEM_ID
                  AND R.FROM_SITE           = B.FROM_SITE
                  AND B.MEASURE             = 'BALANCE'
                  AND B.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN M.CONFIRM_START_DATE AND M.CONFIRM_END_DATE
                  AND B.QTY < 0)
   AND R.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN M.CONFIRM_START_DATE AND M.CONFIRM_END_DATE

NAME: SSP_MKT_USER_V
TEXT:
SELECT /********************************************************************************************************************************
* VIEW NAME     : [SSP_MKT_USER_V]
* DESCRIPTION   : MKT OWNER 조회 ( 동일 정보에 여러명 지정 된 경우 열로 분리하여 조회
*
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* 2018.11.07   juhlee     Initial Release [PJ20182279] 전지본부 출하계획 시스템 구축 프로젝트
******************************************************************************************************************************* */  MU.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
     , MU.ITEM_ID
     , MU.SCM_SITE_ID AS TO_SITE
     , MU.PROJECT_CODE
     , MU.MKT_USER
  FROM (
        SELECT S.DIVISION_ID
             , S.ITEM_ID
             , S.SCM_SITE_ID
             , S.PROJECT_CODE
             , FN_SCM_SPLIT(S.OWNER, 1, ',') AS MKT_USER1
             , FN_SCM_SPLIT(S.OWNER, 2, ',') AS MKT_USER2
             , FN_SCM_SPLIT(S.OWNER, 3, ',') AS MKT_USER3
             , FN_SCM_SPLIT(S.OWNER, 4, ',') AS MKT_USER4
             , FN_SCM_SPLIT(S.OWNER, 5, ',') AS MKT_USER5
          FROM (
                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                     , ITEM_ID
                     , SCM_SITE_ID
                     , PROJECT_CODE
                     , MAX(OWNER) AS OWNER
                  FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM
                 WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
                 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
                     , ITEM_ID
                     , SCM_SITE_ID
                     , PROJECT_CODE
               ) S
       ) T
 UNPIVOT ( MKT_USER FOR AA IN ( MKT_USER1, MKT_USER2, MKT_USER3, MKT_USER4, MKT_USER5 )
         ) MU

NAME: SSP_MST_SITE_ITEM_EE_V
TEXT:
SELECT X.DIVISION_ID
       , X.COMPANY_ID
       , X.PLANT_ID
       , X.SCM_SITE_ID
       , X.ITEM_ID
       , X.ITEM_ID_NICK_NAME
       , X.ITEM_UOM
       , X.ELECTRODE_TYPE
       , X.PACKAGE_TYPE
       , X.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE
       , X.DOM_EXP_TYPE
       , X.FACTORY_ID
       , X.FACTORY_NAME
       , X.ELECTRODE_POST_OPER_CODE
       , X.ELECTRODE_POST_OPER
       , X.ELECTRODE_POST_OPER_LT
       , X.PC_ROLL_LENGTH
       , X.BOX_PER_CUT
       , X.STEELCRATE_PER_CUT
       , X.STEELRACK_PER_CUT
       , X.MODEL_ID
       , X.MODEL_ID_NICK_NAME
       , X.CELL_TYPE_GROUP_CODE
       , X.CELL_TYPE
       , X.LANE
       , X.UOM_CONVERT_IN_TACT_TIME
       , X.UOM_CONVERT
       , X.CONVERT_QTY_CELL
       , 1 / (X.UOM_CONVERT * X.CONVERT_QTY_CELL)  AS METER_PER_CELL
       , X.UOM_CONVERT * X.CONVERT_QTY_CELL        AS CELL_PER_METER
       , 1 / X.UOM_CONVERT                         AS CONVERT_TO_PCM
       , 1 / X.UOM_CONVERT / X.LANE                AS CONVERT_TO_JRM
       , NVL(CASE WHEN X.ITEM_UOM = 'M' THEN X.UOM_CONVERT * X.CONVERT_QTY_CELL
                  ELSE 1 / X.CONVERT_QTY_CELL END, 1)  AS CONVERT_TO_CELL
       , NVL(CASE WHEN X.ITEM_UOM = 'M' THEN X.UOM_CONVERT * X.CONVERT_QTY_CELL / X.PC_ROLL_LENGTH * (1 / (X.UOM_CONVERT * X.CONVERT_QTY_CELL)) / X.LANE
                  ELSE 1 / (X.PC_ROLL_LENGTH * X.LANE) END, 1)  AS CONVERT_TO_PC_ROLL_LENGTH
       , X.ASSY_DIVISION_ID
       , X.ASSY_SCM_SITE_ID
    FROM (SELECT S.DIVISION_ID
               , S.SCM_SITE_ID
               , S.ITEM_ID
               , MAX(MS.COMPANY_ID)              AS COMPANY_ID
               , MAX(MS.PLANT_ID)                AS PLANT_ID
               , MAX(U.ITEM_UOM)                 AS ITEM_UOM
               , MAX(F.NICK_NAME)                AS ITEM_ID_NICK_NAME
               , MAX(F.ELECTRODE_TYPE)           AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
               , MAX(F.CELL_ITEM_ID)             AS MODEL_ID
               , MAX(CF.NICK_NAME)               AS MODEL_ID_NICK_NAME
               , MAX(CF.CELL_TYPE_GROUP_CODE)    AS CELL_TYPE_GROUP_CODE
               , MAX(LC.SEGMENT2)                AS CELL_TYPE
               , MIN(CASE WHEN T.ITEM_UOM = 'EA' THEN NVL(T.UOM_CONVERT_VALUE, 1.0) ELSE 1.0 END)  AS UOM_CONVERT
               , MIN(T.UOM_CONVERT_VALUE)        AS UOM_CONVERT_IN_TACT_TIME
               , CASE WHEN MIN(NVL(TO_NUMBER(T.ATTRIBUTE1), 1) / NVL(TO_NUMBER(L.ATTRIBUTE1), 1)) = 0 THEN 1
                      ELSE MIN(NVL(TO_NUMBER(T.ATTRIBUTE1), 1) / NVL(TO_NUMBER(L.ATTRIBUTE1), 1)) END  AS LANE
               , MIN(CASE WHEN F.CONVERT_QTY_CELL = 0 THEN 1 ELSE F.CONVERT_QTY_CELL END)  AS CONVERT_QTY_CELL
               , MIN(CASE WHEN NVL(M.PC_ROLL_LENGTH, 1) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE NVL(M.PC_ROLL_LENGTH, 1) END)  AS PC_ROLL_LENGTH
               , MIN(M.PC_ROLL_LENGTH)           AS PC_ROLL_LENGTH_ORG
               , MAX(M.DOM_EXP_TYPE_CODE)        AS DOM_EXP_TYPE
               , MAX(M.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE)        AS PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE
               , MAX(LP.SEGMENT2)                AS PACKAGE_TYPE
               , MAX(M.FACTORY_ID)               AS FACTORY_ID
               , MAX(B.FACTORY_NAME)             AS FACTORY_NAME
               , MAX(M.ELECTRODE_POST_OPER_CODE) AS ELECTRODE_POST_OPER_CODE
               , MAX(LO.SEGMENT4)                AS ELECTRODE_POST_OPER
               , MAX(LO.SEGMENT5)                AS ELECTRODE_POST_OPER_LT
               , MAX(M.BOX_PER_CUT)              AS BOX_PER_CUT
               , MAX(M.STEELCRATE_PER_CUT)       AS STEELCRATE_PER_CUT
               , MAX(M.STEELRACK_PER_CUT)        AS STEELRACK_PER_CUT
               , MAX(LS.DIVISION_ID)             AS ASSY_DIVISION_ID
               , MAX(LS.SCM_SITE_ID)             AS ASSY_SCM_SITE_ID
            FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM S
            JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
              ON F.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
             AND F.ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID
             AND F.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E'
            JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, ITEM_UOM FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN) U
              ON U.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID
             AND U.ITEM_ID     = F.ITEM_ID
            JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM CF
              ON 1 = 1
             AND CF.ITEM_ID = F.CELL_ITEM_ID
            JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MS
              ON MS.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
             AND MS.SCM_SITE_ID = S.SCM_SITE_ID
             AND MS.SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT'

            LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LC
              ON LC.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CELL_TYPE_GROUP_CODE'
             AND LC.SEGMENT1    = CF.CELL_TYPE_GROUP_CODE
            LEFT OUTER JOIN SCP_MST_TACT_TIME T
              ON T.DIVISION_ID   = S.DIVISION_ID
             AND T.PLANT_SITE_ID = S.SCM_SITE_ID
             AND T.ITEM_ID       = S.ITEM_ID
            LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
              ON L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ELECTRODE_LINE_WIDE_RATE'
             AND L.SEGMENT1    = T.PLANT_SITE_ID
             AND L.SEGMENT4    = T.LINE_ID
            LEFT OUTER JOIN SSP_MST_SHIP_MASTER_EE M
              ON M.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
             AND M.SCM_SITE_ID = S.SCM_SITE_ID
             AND M.ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID
            LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LP
              ON LP.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ELECTRODE_PACKAGE_TYPE'
             AND LP.SEGMENT1    = M.PACKAGE_TYPE_CODE
            LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN B
              ON B.COMPANY_ID  = MS.COMPANY_ID
             AND B.PLANT_ID    = MS.PLANT_ID
             AND B.DIVISION_ID = M.DIVISION_ID
             AND B.FACTORY_ID  = M.FACTORY_ID
            LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LO
              ON LO.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ELECTRODE_POST_OPER_CODE'
             AND LO.SEGMENT1    = M.DIVISION_ID
             AND LO.SEGMENT2    = M.ELECTRODE_POST_OPER_CODE
            LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LA
              ON LA.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ELECTRODE_ASSY_PLANT_MAPPING'
             AND LA.SEGMENT3    = MS.DIVISION_ID
             AND LA.SEGMENT4    = MS.PLANT_ID
             AND LA.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
            LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE LS
              ON LS.DIVISION_ID = LA.SEGMENT1
             AND LS.PLANT_ID    = LA.SEGMENT2
             AND LS.SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT'
             AND LS.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A'
           GROUP BY S.DIVISION_ID
                  , S.SCM_SITE_ID
                  , S.ITEM_ID) X

NAME: SSP_PLAN_VERSION_V
TEXT:
WITH SUB AS
(
SELECT D.DIVISION_ID,
       P.PLAN_NAME || '-' || D.PLAN_TYPE || '-' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(D.PLAN_SEQ), 2, '0')  AS PLAN_VERSION_ID,
       P.PLAN_NAME,
       D.PLAN_SEQ,
       D.PLAN_TYPE,
       D.CONFIRM_FLAG,
       D.CONFIRM_USER,
       D.CONFIRM_DATE,
       P.PLAN_ID,
       M.MODELING_ID,
       M.PLAN_CYCLE,
       P.PLAN_ID || '::' || D.PLAN_TYPE || '::' || TO_CHAR(D.PLAN_SEQ) AS ENG_PLAN_ID,
       D.UI_DISPLAY_YN,
       D.ACTIVE_FLAG,
       D.PLAN_STATUS
  FROM SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL D,
       SCM_MST_PLAN        P,
       SCM_MST_MODELING    M
 WHERE 1=1
   AND M.MODELING_ID   = D.MODELING_ID
   AND M.PLAN_CYCLE    = 'DAILY'
   AND M.DIVISION_ID   = D.DIVISION_ID
   AND M.MODELING_ID   = D.MODELING_ID
   AND P.DIVISION_ID   = D.DIVISION_ID
   AND P.PLAN_CYCLE    = M.PLAN_CYCLE
   AND P.PLAN_ID       = D.PLAN_ID
   AND D.PLAN_STATUS   = '1'
   AND D.UI_DISPLAY_YN = 'Y'
   AND D.CONFIRM_FLAG  = 'Y'

   UNION ALL
SELECT M.DIVISION_ID                                                                              AS DIVISION_ID
,      A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD || '-SP-' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(1), 2, '0')                                AS PLAN_VERSION_ID
,      A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD                                                                      AS PLAN_NAME
,      1                                                                                          AS PLAN_SEQ
,      'SP'                                                                                       AS PLAN_TYPE
,      A.CONFIRM_CREATE_YN                                                                        AS CONFIRM_FLAG
,      A.CREATED_BY                                                                               AS CONFIRM_USER
,      A.CONFIRM_CREATE_DATE                                                                      AS CONFIRM_DATE
,      'XX'                                                                                       AS PLAN_ID
,      'XX'                                                                                       AS MODELING_ID
,      'DAILY'                                                                                    AS PLAN_CYCLE
,      'XX'                                                                                       AS ENG_PLAN_ID
,      'Y'                                                                                        AS UI_DISPLAY_YN
,      'Y'                                                                                        AS ACTIVE_FLAG
,      '1'                                                                                        AS PLAN_STATUS
  FROM SSP_MST_SHIP_PLAN_SCHEDULE A
       LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION M
       ON M.DIVISION_ID <> '40'
 WHERE A.CONFIRM_CREATE_YN = 'Y'
   AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = ( SELECT MAX(B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
                                   FROM SSP_MST_SHIP_PLAN_SCHEDULE B
                                  WHERE B.CONFIRM_CREATE_YN = 'Y'
                               )
--AND    A.COMPANY_ID  = 'C100'
   AND A.COMPANY_ID = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SSP_PLAN_VERSION_V', 'ESOC')	--C100
)
SELECT DIVISION_ID,
       PLAN_VERSION_ID  AS PLAN_VERSION_ID,
       PLAN_NAME        AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD,
       PLAN_TYPE,
       PLAN_SEQ,
       CONFIRM_FLAG,
       CONFIRM_USER,
       CONFIRM_DATE,
       PLAN_ID,
       MODELING_ID,
       PLAN_CYCLE,
       ENG_PLAN_ID,
       UI_DISPLAY_YN,
       ACTIVE_FLAG,
       PLAN_STATUS
  FROM SUB
 WHERE 1=1
   AND PLAN_NAME >= FN_GET_BUCKET_YYYYMMDD(-5) --2주전

NAME: SSP_PLN_PEGGING_INFO_V
TEXT:
SELECT /****************************************************************************
  * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : SSP_PLN_PEGGING_INFO_V
  * DESCRIPTION   :
  *
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE         IN CHARGE       DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018.06.11   LTW         Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
  * 2018.07.16   LTW         전극 SSP 작업(ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID ,ELECTRODE_TYPE) 추가
  * 2018.09.07   LTW         TCO CELL 구분관련 로직 변경
  *                          SSP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V.FROM_TCO_CELL_YN
  *                          SSP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN.ATTRIBUTE7(FROM TCO_CELL_YN)
  * 2018.09.18   LTW         SSP_ANL_PROBLEM_REPORT_PEGGING.PLANNED_QTY 의 수량을 완료 기준 수량(FROM_SITE 기준) 으로 변경
  *
  *************************************************************************** */ /* 생산계획(ssp_pln_production_plan) */
     PI.PLAN_ID
    ,PI.MODELING_ID
    ,PI.SEQ                                   AS PLAN_SEQ
    ,PI.PLAN_NAME
    ,PI.MASTER_ID
    ,PI.OUT_VERSION_ID
    ,PI.PLAN_TYPE
    ,PI.DIVISION_ID
    ,PI.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */
    ,PI.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */

    ,PI.DEMAND_PRIORITY
    ,PI.DUE_DATE

    ,PI.SUPPLY_QTY AS PLANNED_QTY  /* ANL작업을위해 */

    ,NVL(TO_CHAR(PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID),' ')  AS DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
    ,NVL(TO_CHAR(PI.WORK_ORDER_ID)    ,' ')  AS WORK_ORDER_ID
    ,NULL                                                      AS TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
    ,NULL                                                      AS TO_WORK_ORDER_ID

    ,PI.START_DTTM
    ,PI.END_DTTM
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(SITE_ID,1,'~')          AS FROM_SITE_ID  /* work order는 from site=to site */
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(SITE_ID,1,'~')          AS TO_SITE_ID
    ,PI.ITEM_ID                               AS FROM_ITEM_ID

    /* ,fi.operation_group_id */
    /* ,fi.electrode_type */
    ,PI.OPERATION_GROUP
    ,PI.ELECTRODE_TYPE

    ,PI.START_DTTM                            AS PLAN_START_DATE  /* ANL작업을위해 */
    ,PI.END_DTTM                              AS PLAN_END_DATE  /* ANL작업을위해 */

    /* SSP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V
      FROM_OSP_YN
      FROM_TCO_CELL_YN
    */
    ,(CASE  WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' THEN (CASE WHEN PI.WORK_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ELEC' WHEN PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ESHIP' END)
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P' THEN (CASE WHEN PI.WORK_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'PACK' WHEN PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'PSHIP' END)
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' THEN (CASE WHEN PI.FROM_TCO_CELL_YN = 'Y'                                                      THEN 'TCELL'
                                                     WHEN SUBSTR(PI.SITE_ID,INSTR(PI.SITE_ID, '~')-1 ,6) IN ('A~001')             THEN 'FORM'
                                                     WHEN SUBSTR(PI.SITE_ID,INSTR(PI.SITE_ID, '~')-1 ,6) IN ('A~002')             THEN 'CHAR'
                                                     WHEN PI.WORK_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'CELL' WHEN PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'CSHIP' END)
            ELSE ''
      END)                                    AS PEGGING_OPERATION_CODE  /*  */

    ,PI.DEMAND_ID                             AS ENG_DEMAND_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,1,'##')    AS DEMAND_ID  /* ##제거한 FCST기준 DEMAND */

    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,1,'::')    AS DEMAND_ITEM_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,2,'::')    AS PROJECT_CODE
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,3,'::')    AS ENG_SITE_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,3,'::'),1,'~') AS SALES_SITE_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,3,'::'),2,'~') AS INCOTERMS
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,4,'::')    AS DOM_EXP
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,5,'::')    AS FCST_TYPE
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,6,'::')    AS DEMAND_TYPE
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,7,'::')    AS YYYYMMDD
    ,(CASE FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,8,'::'),1,'^'),1,'##')
              WHEN 'NOPLANT' THEN '-'
              ELSE FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,8,'::'),1,'^'),1,'##')
      END )                                   AS PLANT_SITE_ID
     ,'WO'                                    AS DESCR
     ,NULL                                    AS STOCK_PLAN_LOT_ID
     ,PI.LPST

/* SELECT * */
  FROM SSP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V PI
    /* INNER JOIN SCM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V AS fi */
    /* ON pi.division_id = fi.division_id */
    /* AND pi.item_id = fi.item_id */
 WHERE 1=1
   AND PI.DEMAND_ID <> 'UNPEGGING'
   AND PI.DEMAND_ID <> '-'

UNION ALL
/* 출하계획(ssp_pln_shipment_plan) */
SELECT
     PI.PLAN_ID
    ,PI.MODELING_ID
    ,PI.SEQ                                   AS PLAN_SEQ
    ,PI.PLAN_NAME
    ,PI.MASTER_ID
    ,PI.OUT_VERSION_ID
    ,PI.PLAN_TYPE
    ,PI.DIVISION_ID
    ,PI.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */
    ,PI.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */

    ,PI.DEMAND_PRIORITY
    ,PI.DUE_DATE

    ,CAST(PI.QTY AS NUMBER(20,10))          AS PLANNED_QTY

    ,NVL(TO_CHAR(PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID)    ,' ') AS DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
    ,NVL(TO_CHAR(PI.WORK_ORDER_ID)        ,' ') AS WORK_ORDER_ID
    ,NVL(TO_CHAR(PI.TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID) ,' ') AS TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
    ,NVL(TO_CHAR(PI.TO_WORK_ORDER_ID)     ,' ') AS TO_WORK_ORDER_ID

    ,PI.START_DTTM
    ,PI.END_DTTM
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.FROM_SITE_ID,1,'~')  AS FROM_SITE_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.TO_SITE_ID,1,'~')    AS TO_SITE_ID

    ,PI.FROM_ITEM_ID

    /* ,fi.operation_group_id */
    /* ,fi.electrode_type */
    ,PI.OPERATION_GROUP
    ,PI.ELECTRODE_TYPE

    ,PI.START_DTTM                            AS PLAN_START_DATE  /* ANL작업을위해 */
    ,PI.END_DTTM                              AS PLAN_END_DATE  /* ANL작업을위해 */

    /* ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN 속성정보
      ATTRIBUTE1 :   TO SITE_TYPE
      ATTRIBUTE2 :   TO OSP_YN
      ATTRIBUTE3 :   TO SITE_ID
      ATTRIBUTE4 : FROM SITE_ID
      ATTRIBUTE5 : FROM OSP_YN
      ATTRIBUTE6 :   TO OSP_YN
      ATTRIBUTE7 : FROM TCO_CELL_YN
      ATTRIBUTE8 :   TO TCO_CELL_YN
    */
    ,(CASE  WHEN PI.PEGGING_TYPE = 'ALLOCATION' THEN 'ALLOC'
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' THEN (CASE WHEN PI.TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ESHIP' END)
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P' THEN (CASE WHEN PI.TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'PSHIP' END)
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' THEN (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(PI.TO_SITE_ID,INSTR(PI.TO_SITE_ID, '~')-1 ,6) IN ('A~001') THEN 'FORM'
                                                     WHEN SUBSTR(PI.TO_SITE_ID,INSTR(PI.TO_SITE_ID, '~')-1 ,6) IN ('A~002') THEN 'CHAR'
                                                     WHEN PI.ATTRIBUTE7 = 'Y'                                                      THEN 'TCSHIP'
                                                     WHEN PI.TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL                                      THEN 'CSHIP'   END)
            ELSE ''
      END)                                    AS PEGGING_OPERATION_CODE  /*  */

    ,PI.DEMAND_ID                             AS ENG_DEMAND_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,1,'##')    AS DEMAND_ID  /* ##제거한 FCST기준 DEMAND */

    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,1,'::')    AS DEMAND_ITEM_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,2,'::')    AS PROJECT_CODE
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,3,'::')    AS ENG_SITE_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,3,'::'),1,'~') AS SALES_SITE_ID
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,3,'::'),2,'~') AS INCOTERMS
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,4,'::')    AS DOM_EXP
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,5,'::')    AS FCST_TYPE
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,6,'::')    AS DEMAND_TYPE
    ,FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,7,'::')    AS YYYYMMDD
    ,(CASE FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,8,'::'),1,'^'),1,'##')
              WHEN 'NOPLANT' THEN '-'
              ELSE FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID,8,'::'),1,'^'),1,'##')
         END )                                AS PLANT_SITE_ID
     ,'DO'                                    AS DESCR
     ,NVL(STOCK_PLAN_LOT_ID,' ')            AS STOCK_PLAN_LOT_ID
  /*  --속도이슈존재
      , ( SELECT TOP 1 d.LPST
           FROM SCP_PLN_SHIPMENT_PLAN_PEGGING D WITH (NOLOCK)
          WHERE D.DIVISION_ID =PI.DIVISION_ID
            AND D.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   = PI.PLAN_NAME
            AND D.PLAN_TYPE   = PI.PLAN_TYPE
            AND D.SEQ         = PI.SEQ
            AND D.ORDER_ID    = PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID )  AS LPST
            */
     ,NULL AS LPST

/* SELECT * */
  FROM SSP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN PI
 WHERE 1=1
	 AND (
	       ( PI.TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL 	AND PI.BOD_ID IS NOT NULL AND PI.FROM_SITE_ID <> PI.TO_SITE_ID )  /* DELIVERY ORDER */
	        OR
	       ( PI.PEGGING_TYPE = 'ALLOCATION' )  /* ALLOCATION */
	     )
   AND PI.FROM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL  /* 있으면 않되는 케이스 */
   AND PI.DEMAND_ID <> 'UNPEGGING'

NAME: SSP_PLN_PRODUCTION_PLAN_V
TEXT:
SELECT /****************************************************************************
  * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : SSP_PLN_WORK_ORDER_V
  * DESCRIPTION   : 생산계획(PLN-> ANL)
  *
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018.06.12   LTW         Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
  * 2018.06.29   LTW         전극 SSP 작업(ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID ,ELECTRODE_TYPE) 추가
  * 2018.06.29   LTW         SCM_MST_SITE.valid_yn = 'Y' 조건 추가
  * 2018.07.16   LTW         전극 SSP 작업(ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID ,ELECTRODE_TYPE) 추가
  * 2018.07.24   YYDOK        소형 특성후공정셀관련 공정코드추가(F6200,F7000,F7100,F7200,F7300)
  *                           left(WO.operation_id,1) <> 'F' --'F'로 시작하는 공정 제외=> left(WO.operation_id,5) NOT IN ( 'F1000','F6000') --활성화,특성제외
  * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX      [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
  ****************************************************************************/  WO.MASTER_ID
     , WO.OUT_VERSION_ID
     , WO.PLAN_ID
     , WO.PLAN_TYPE
     , WO.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , WO.SEQ
     , WO.DIVISION_ID
     , WO.OPERATION_GROUP
     , WO.SITE_ID
     , WO.ITEM_ID
     , WO.RESOURCE_ID
     , WO.OPERATION_ID
     , (CASE WO.PEGGING_TYPE WHEN 'WORK_ORDER' THEN TO_CHAR(WO.START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD')
                             ELSE TO_CHAR(WO.END_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD')
        END) AS YYYYMMDD  /* 생산계획:start_time ,출하계획:end_time */
     , (CASE WO.PEGGING_TYPE WHEN 'WORK_ORDER' THEN WO.COMPLETE_QTY
                             ELSE WO.OPERATION_QTY
        END) AS QTY  /* 생산계획:complete_qty ,출하계획:operation_qty */
     , WO.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */
     , WO.ELECTRODE_TYPE  /* 전극 작업 추가 */
  FROM SSP_PLN_PRODUCTION_PLAN WO
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND (SUBSTR(WO.OPERATION_ID, 1, 5) IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID
                                            FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                           WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION')  /* LOOKUP_TYPE 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION' 에 정의된 공정만 조회 */
         OR WO.OPERATION_ID IN (SELECT PLANT_ID AS OPERATION_ID
                                  FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                                 WHERE 1 = 1
                                   AND DIVISION_ID = (CASE WHEN WO.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN WO.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
                                                           ELSE WO.DIVISION_ID
                                                      END)
                                   AND SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT'
                                   AND OSP_YN      = 'Y'
                                   AND VALID_YN    = 'Y')  /* 외주PACKER의 업체코드 */
       )
   AND SUBSTR(WO.OPERATION_ID, 1, 5) NOT IN ('F1000', 'F6000')  /* 활성화,특성제외 */

NAME: SSP_PLN_SHIP_PLAN_TARGET_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/****************************************************************************
  * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : SSP_PLN_SHIP_PLAN_TARGET_V
  * DESCRIPTION   : FP용 SHIP TARGET VIEW(SSP)
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018-05-11   YYDOK        INITIAL
  * 2018-07-02   YYDOK        소형 packer에 대하여 item id 12번째자리를 packer site의 suffix정보로 변경처리로직반영
  *                           EE 사업부인 경우,셀계획 제외처리,ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
  * 2018-07-26   YYDOK        SHIP_TO_PARTY, RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD 추가반영
  * 2018-08-15   YYDOK        EE에 대해서,SHIP_ID,DEST_PLANT_ID,DESTINATION_SITE_TYPE,CUSTOMER누락조치(DIVISION_ID -> ORIGIN FROM/TO DIVISION ID)
  * 2018.8.20    YYDOK        SHIP TO CODE 추가
  * 2026.07.04   ZIONEX       [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
  ****************************************************************************/
  P.DIVISION_ID
        , P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
        , P.PLAN_TYPE
        , P.SEQ
        , P.DIVISION_ID || '^' || P.ITEM_ID || '^' || P.FROM_SITE || '^' || P.TO_SITE || '^' || P.YYYYMMDD || '^' || P.TRANSPORT_MODE
           || '^' || ( CASE PP.FCST_TYPE WHEN '-' THEN 'MPS' ELSE PP.FCST_TYPE END ) || '^' || ( CASE PP.DOM_EXP WHEN '-' THEN 'D' ELSE PP.DOM_EXP END )
                                             AS SHIP_ID
       /* , (CASE WHEN ( P.DIVISION_ID='40' AND P.OPERATION_GROUP ='P' ) THEN [dbo].[FN_GET_MOBILE_PACKER_ITEM_ID]( P.DIVISION_ID, P.FROM_SITE,P.ITEM_ID )
                  ELSE  P.ITEM_ID
            END )                              AS ITEM_ID */
        , P.ITEM_ID                          AS ITEM_ID
        , P.OPERATION_GROUP                  AS OPERATION_GROUP
        , P.FROM_SITE                        AS FROM_SITE
        , ( SELECT PLANT_ID
              FROM SCM_MST_SITE
             WHERE DIVISION_ID = P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
               AND SCM_SITE_ID = P.FROM_SITE
               AND ROWNUM = 1 )              AS PLANT_ID
        , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_CODE')
                                             AS CUSTOMER_CODE
        , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION')
                                             AS CUSTOMER_NAME
        , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_CODE')
                                             AS SHIP_TO_CODE
        , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION')
                                             AS SHIP_TO_PARTY
        , P.TO_SITE                          AS TO_SITE
        , ( SELECT PLANT_ID
              FROM SCM_MST_SITE
             WHERE DIVISION_ID = P.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
               AND SCM_SITE_ID = P.TO_SITE
               AND ROWNUM = 1 )              AS TO_PLANT_ID
        , ( SELECT SITE_TYPE
              FROM SCM_MST_SITE
             WHERE DIVISION_ID = P.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
               AND SCM_SITE_ID = P.TO_SITE
               AND ROWNUM = 1 )              AS TO_SITE_TYPE
        , ( SELECT BASIS_YYYYMMDD
              FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CM
             WHERE ISO_YYYYWW IN (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW
                                    FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                                   WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = P.YYYYMMDD )
               AND DAYOFWEEK = 'MON'
           )                                 AS SHIP_WEEK
        , P.YYYYMMDD                         AS SHIP_YYYYMMDD
        , MAX(TO_CHAR(P.END_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD'))    AS RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD
        , ROUND(SUM(PP.ALLOCATION_QTY), 0)   AS SHIP_QTY
       /*  , PP.FCST_TYPE                       AS FCST_TYPE */
        , ( CASE PP.FCST_TYPE WHEN '-' THEN 'MPS'
                ELSE PP.FCST_TYPE
            END )                            AS FCST_TYPE
        , P.TRANSPORT_MODE                   AS TRANSPORT_MODE
        , MAX(PP.ENG_DEMAND_PRIORITY)        AS PRIORITY
       /*  , PP.DOM_EXP                         AS DOM_EXP */
        , ( CASE PP.DOM_EXP WHEN '-' THEN 'D'
                ELSE PP.DOM_EXP
            END )                            AS DOM_EXP
        , P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID          AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
        , P.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID            AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
        , 'SCP'                              AS CREATE_USER_ID
        , SYSDATE                            AS CREATE_DATE
        , 'SCP'                              AS MODIFY_USER_ID
        , SYSDATE                            AS MODIFY_DATE
     FROM SSP_PLN_SHIPMENT_PLAN P
     LEFT JOIN SSP_PLN_SHIPMENT_PLAN_PEGGING PP
            ON P.DIVISION_ID           = PP.DIVISION_ID
           AND P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD   = PP.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND P.PLAN_TYPE             = PP.PLAN_TYPE
           AND P.SEQ                   = PP.SEQ
           AND P.ORDER_ID              = PP.ORDER_ID
    WHERE 1=1
      AND P.MEASURE                  = 'SHIP_PLAN'
       /*   AND P.DIVISION_ID              = '81'
            AND P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD      = '20180326'
            AND P.PLAN_TYPE                = 'PR'
            AND P.SEQ                      = 1    */
      AND ( ( P.DIVISION_ID <> 'EE' ) OR ( P.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' AND P.OPERATION_GROUP <> 'A' ))
    GROUP BY
          P.DIVISION_ID
        , P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
        , P.PLAN_TYPE
        , P.SEQ
        , P.ITEM_ID
        , P.OPERATION_GROUP
        , P.FROM_SITE
        , P.TO_SITE
        , P.YYYYMMDD
        , PP.FCST_TYPE
        , P.TRANSPORT_MODE
        , PP.DOM_EXP
        , P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
        , P.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
    HAVING ROUND(SUM(PP.ALLOCATION_QTY), 0) >= 1

NAME: SCM_AXIS_V
TEXT:
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_TYPE,
       A.SCM_SITE_ID              AS SITE_ID,
       A.SITE_DESCRIPTION         AS SITE_NAME,
       /* 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경 (START) 2026.09.29 AJS */
--       A.DEPT_ID,
       SD.DEPT_ID,
       /* 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경 (END) 2026.09.29 AJS */
       D.DEPT_NAME_KO             AS DEPT_NAME,
       CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID='40' THEN NULL ELSE A.END_CUSTOMER END AS EC_CODE,
       CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID='40' THEN NULL ELSE 'SITE'         END AS EC_SRC,
       CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID='40' THEN NULL
            ELSE NVL(EL.SEGMENT3, A.END_CUSTOMER) END              AS EC_NAME,
       NULL                       AS PROJECT_CODE,
       NVL(A.OPERATION_GROUP,' ') AS OPERATION_GROUP,
       A.VALID_YN,
       'SITE'                     AS SRC
  FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
  /* 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경 (START) 2026.09.29 AJS */
  LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_DEPT_REP_V SD ON SD.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID AND SD.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SCM_SITE_ID
--  LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D ON D.DEPT_ID = A.DEPT_ID
  LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D ON D.DEPT_ID = SD.DEPT_ID
  /* 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경 (END) 2026.09.29 AJS */
  LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL EL
         ON EL.LOOKUP_TYPE='END_CUSTOMER' AND EL.VALID_YN='Y'
        AND EL.SEGMENT1 = A.DIVISION_ID AND EL.SEGMENT2 = A.END_CUSTOMER
UNION ALL
/* ─ ② 40 owner 축 : SITE_ITEM.OWNER 첫 토큰 → SSO 부서, EC 자리 = PROJECT_CODE ─ */
SELECT B.DIVISION_ID, 'SALES', B.SCM_SITE_ID, B.SCM_SITE_ID,
       C.DEPT_ID, C.DEPT_NAME_KO, B.PROJECT_CODE, 'SITE_ITEM40',
       NVL(EL2.SEGMENT3, B.PROJECT_CODE), B.PROJECT_CODE,
       ' ', B.VALID_YN, 'SITE_ITEM40'
  FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM B
  JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO U ON U.USER_ID = TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(B.OWNER,'[^,]+',1,1))
  JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C ON C.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID
  LEFT JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL EL2
         ON EL2.LOOKUP_TYPE='END_CUSTOMER' AND EL2.VALID_YN='Y'
        AND EL2.SEGMENT1 = B.DIVISION_ID AND EL2.SEGMENT2 = B.PROJECT_CODE
 WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = '40'
UNION ALL
/* ─ ③ EC 마스터 축 : lookup END_CUSTOMER (사이트에 없는 고객코드) ─ */
SELECT L.SEGMENT1, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
       L.SEGMENT2, 'LOOKUP', L.SEGMENT3, NULL, ' ', L.VALID_YN, 'LOOKUP_EC'
  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
 WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE='END_CUSTOMER' AND L.VALID_YN='Y' AND L.SEGMENT2 <> '-'
UNION ALL
/* ─ ④ AS 사이트 축 : lookup AS_SITE_PLANT (Sales Site 목록 선두 노출분) ─ */
       /* 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경 (START) 2026.09.29 AJS */
--SELECT L.SEGMENT3, 'SALES', L.SEGMENT1, S.SITE_DESCRIPTION, S.DEPT_ID, D2.DEPT_NAME_KO,
SELECT L.SEGMENT3, 'SALES', L.SEGMENT1, S.SITE_DESCRIPTION, SD2.DEPT_ID, D2.DEPT_NAME_KO,
       /* 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경 (END) 2026.09.29 AJS */
       NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NVL(S.OPERATION_GROUP,' '), S.VALID_YN, 'LOOKUP_AS'
  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
  JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S ON L.SEGMENT3 = S.DIVISION_ID AND L.SEGMENT1 = S.SCM_SITE_ID
  /* 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경 (START) 2026.09.29 AJS */
  LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_DEPT_REP_V SD2 ON SD2.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID AND SD2.SCM_SITE_ID = S.SCM_SITE_ID
--  LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D2 ON D2.DEPT_ID = S.DEPT_ID
  LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO D2 ON D2.DEPT_ID = SD2.DEPT_ID
  /* 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경 (END) 2026.09.29 AJS */
 WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE='AS_SITE_PLANT' AND L.VALID_YN='Y' AND S.VALID_YN='Y'

NAME: DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V
TEXT:
SELECT /*+ LEADING(T2 T1) USE_HASH(T1) */
/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Program ID   : DM_MST_ITEM_SINGLE_V
 * Description  : SCM_MST_ITEM_SN 조회
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 *
 * 2021-04-28 SJHAN  [CSR ID:C20210323-000420] GSCM SCP 시스템의 소형 사업부의 업무 효율 증가를 위한 제품별 형태별 구분 추가
 * 2021-10-18	hwi1993		[PJ20209643] 속도개선 -  셀프조인 로직 변경
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX  [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 * --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 */
       T1.DIVISION_ID
     , T1.ITEM_ID
     , MAX(T1.ITEM_NAME)                     AS ITEM_NAME             /* 해당 컬럼이 NULL인 경우가 잇으므로 하나로 통일 */
     , MAX(T1.ITEM_CLASS)                    AS ITEM_CLASS            /* 해당 컬럼이 NULL인 경우가 잇으므로 하나로 통일 */
     , MAX(T1.ITEM_CLASS_NAME)               AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME       /* 해당 컬럼이 NULL인 경우가 잇으므로 하나로 통일 */
     , MAX(T1.NICK_NAME)                     AS NICK_NAME             /* 닉네임이 NULL인 경우가 있으므로 하나로 통일 */
     , CASE MIN(CASE WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE = 'P' THEN 1                   /* 타입이 사이트와 사업부, 법인에 따라 다양하게 존재 하므로 하나로 통일 */
                     WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE = 'H' THEN 2                   /* 또한 가장 완성된 상태의 자재 타입을 판매한다고 가정, 해당 자재타입을 사용함 */
                     WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE = 'Q' THEN 3
                     ELSE 4 END)
            WHEN 1 THEN 'P'
            WHEN 2 THEN 'H'
            WHEN 3 THEN 'Q'
            ELSE 'R' END                     AS ITEM_TYPE
     , MAX(T1.MATERIAL_CLASS_NAME)           AS MATERIAL_CLASS_NAME
     , MAX(T1.ITEM_UOM)                      AS ITEM_UOM
     , MAX(T1.SPEC)                          AS SPEC
     , MAX(T1.MDM_PROJECT_NAME)              AS MDM_PROJECT_NAME
     , MAX(T1.MIN_CAPACITY)                  AS MIN_CAPACITY
     , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE)        AS FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE
     , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP)   AS FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP
     , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL)      AS FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
     , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT) AS FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT
     , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_SPEC)            AS FORECAST_INFO_SPEC
     , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION)        AS FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION
     , MAX(T1.ACTIVE_FLAG)                   AS ACTIVE_FLAG           /* 20180720 ADD 'Y'대상중 1건 추출 */
     , MAX(T2.CELL_TYPE)                     AS CELL_TYPE             /* 20180911 ADD cell_type */
     , MAX(T1.ENERGE)                        AS ENERGE                /* 20200116 khsong ADD ENERGE */
     , MAX(T1.CELL_QUANTITY)                 AS CELL_QUANTITY         /* 20200116 khsong ADD CELL_QUANTITY */
     , MAX(T1.SCP_EXTRA_SPEC)                AS SCP_EXTRA_SPEC        /* [20210428 SJHAN / CSR ID:C20210323-000420] */
  FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T1
     , ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
              , SUBSTR(ITEM_ID, 1, 12)               AS ITEM_ID
              , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE)          AS FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE
              , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP)     AS FORECAST_INFO_PRODUCT_GROUP
              , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL)        AS FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
              , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT)   AS FORECAST_INFO_CELL_PACK_COUNT
              , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_SPEC)              AS FORECAST_INFO_SPEC
              , MAX(FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION)          AS FORECAST_INFOR_VERSION
              , MAX(CELL_TYPE)                       AS CELL_TYPE
           FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T2
          GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, SUBSTR(ITEM_ID, 1, 12)
       ) T2
 WHERE 1=1
   AND T1.DIVISION_ID              = T2.DIVISION_ID
   AND SUBSTR(T1.ITEM_ID, 1, 12)   = T2.ITEM_ID
   /* WHERE ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'  -- 20180720 ADD 'Y'대상만 */
 GROUP BY T1.DIVISION_ID, T1.ITEM_ID

NAME: SCM_ADM_USER_MNU_EDIT_AUTH_V
TEXT:
SELECT
    GRP.USER_ID
  , MNU.MNU_ID
  , MNU.UNIT_TP_CD
 	, AUTH.UNIT_ID
  , MAX(AUTH.EDIT_YN)  AS EDIT_YN   -- 여러 그룹/조직 중 편집권한 최대값
FROM
    SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M          GRP   -- 그룹-사용자 매핑
    INNER JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M  AUTH  -- 그룹-조직 권한
            ON AUTH.USER_GR_ID = GRP.USER_GR_ID
           AND AUTH.USER_ID    = GRP.USER_ID
    INNER JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_MNU_M                    MNU   -- 메뉴 마스터
            ON MNU.UNIT_TP_CD = AUTH.UNIT_TP_CD
WHERE
    GRP.USE_YN  = 'Y'
AND AUTH.USE_YN  = 'Y'
AND MNU.USE_YN   = 'Y'
GROUP BY
    GRP.USER_ID
  , MNU.MNU_ID
  , MNU.UNIT_TP_CD
  , AUTH.UNIT_ID

NAME: SCM_DNM_PRODUCT_RESULT_V
TEXT:
SELECT PR.SCM_SITE_ID
     , PR.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
     , PR.COMPANY_ID
     , PR.DIVISION_ID
     , PR.SITE_ID
     , PR.PLANT_ID
     , PR.FACTORY_ID
     , PR.TOP_ITEM_ID
     , NVL(FI.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID, PR.ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_ID  /* 2018.06.29 */
     , PR.ITEM_ID AS ORIGIN_ITEM_ID                        /* 2018.06.29 */
     , PR.OPERATION_ID
     , PR.LOCATION
     , PR.PRODUCTION_TYPE
     , PR.MARKET
     , PR.LINE_ID
     , FI.ELECTRODE_TYPE                                   /* 2018.07.12 */
     , PR.PLAN_DATE
     , PR.ACTUAL_QTY
     , PR.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY
     , PR.ACTUAL_SCRAP_QTY
     , PR.INSERT_ID
     , PR.INSERT_TIME
     , PR.UPDATE_ID
     , PR.UPDATE_TIME
     , PR.QTY
     , PR.QTY_LANE
     , PR.DFCT_QTY2
     , PR.LOSS_QTY2
     , PR.PRDT_REQ_QTY2
     , PR.TOP_COATING_QTY2
     , PR.YIELD_LOSS_QTY
     , PR.EQUIPMENT_ID
     , PR.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
     , PR.ROLL_IN_QTY
     , PR.ROLL_OUT_QTY
     , PR.JR_IN_QTY
     , PR.JR_OUT_QTY
     , PR.BATCH_IN_QTY
     , PR.BATCH_OUT_QTY
     , PR.CELL_IN_QTY
     , PR.CELL_OUT_QTY
  FROM (
        SELECT (SELECT NVL(I.SCM_SITE_ID, '/')
                  FROM SCM_MST_SITE I
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND I.PLANT_ID = A.PLANT_ID
                   AND I.OPERATION_GROUP = B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
                   AND I.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                   AND I.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1) AS SCM_SITE_ID
             , B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
             , A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.SITE_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.TOP_ITEM_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , A.LOCATION
             , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
             , A.MARKET
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , A.PLAN_DATE
             , A.ACTUAL_QTY
             , A.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY
             , A.ACTUAL_SCRAP_QTY
             , A.INSERT_ID
             , A.INSERT_TIME
             , A.UPDATE_ID
             , A.UPDATE_TIME
             , A.QTY
             , A.QTY_LANE
             , A.DFCT_QTY2
             , A.LOSS_QTY2
             , A.PRDT_REQ_QTY2
             , A.TOP_COATING_QTY2
             , A.YIELD_LOSS_QTY
             , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
             , A.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
             , A.ROLL_IN_QTY
             , A.ROLL_OUT_QTY
             , A.JR_IN_QTY
             , A.JR_OUT_QTY
             , A.BATCH_IN_QTY
             , A.BATCH_OUT_QTY
             , A.CELL_IN_QTY
             , A.CELL_OUT_QTY
          FROM SCM_DNM_DAILY_PRODUCT_RESULT_SN A
             , SCM_MST_ITEM_SN B
         WHERE A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID
           AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
           AND B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP IS NOT NULL
           AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE NOT IN ('REWORK', 'PILOT')  /* 20211006 C20210915-000381 외주 생산실적 테이블 변경 : ERP -> SCS */ /* Line 별 Plan 수행 대상 Site */
         UNION ALL
        SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
             , C.COMPANY_ID
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , C.SITE_ID
             , C.PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID
             , CAST('-' AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)) AS FACTORY_ID
             , CAST('-' AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)) AS TOP_ITEM_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , C.PLANT_ID AS OPERATION_ID
             , CAST('-' AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)) AS LOCATION
             , CAST('-' AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE
             , CAST('-' AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)) AS MARKET
             , A.LINE_ID
             , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50 CHAR)) AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , TO_DATE(A.PROD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS PLAN_DATE
             , CAST(A.PROD_QTY + A.DEFECT_QTY AS NUMBER(20, 4)) AS ACTUAL_QTY
             , CAST(A.PROD_QTY AS NUMBER(20, 4)) AS ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY
             , CAST(A.DEFECT_QTY AS NUMBER(20, 4)) AS ACTUAL_SCRAP_QTY
             , A.CREATED_BY AS INSERT_ID
             , A.CREATION_DATE AS INSERT_TIME
             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY AS UPDATE_ID
             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS UPDATE_TIME
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18, 5)) AS QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18, 5)) AS QTY_LANE
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18, 5)) AS DFCT_QTY2
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18, 5)) AS LOSS_QTY2
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18, 5)) AS PRDT_REQ_QTY2
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18, 5)) AS TOP_COATING_QTY2
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18, 5)) AS YIELD_LOSS_QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)) AS EQUIPMENT_ID
             , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)) AS FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS ROLL_IN_QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS ROLL_OUT_QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS JR_IN_QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS JR_OUT_QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS BATCH_IN_QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS BATCH_OUT_QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS CELL_IN_QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS CELL_OUT_QTY
          FROM SCM_DNM_SCS_PROD_RESULT A
             , SCM_MST_SITE C
             , SCM_MST_ITEM_SN B
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND C.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID
           AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
           AND B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP IS NOT NULL
           AND NVL(C.OSP_YN, 'N') = 'Y'  /* 외주 */
           AND NVL(C.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N') = 'Y'  /* Line 별 Plan 수행 대상 Site */ /* 20211006 C20210915-000381 외주 생산실적 테이블 변경 : ERP -> SCS */ /* Plant 별 Plan 수행 대상 : Line 구분 없음 */
         UNION ALL
        SELECT A.SCM_SITE_ID
             , B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
             , C.COMPANY_ID
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , C.SITE_ID
             , C.PLANT_ID AS PLANT_ID
             , CAST('-' AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)) AS FACTORY_ID
             , CAST('-' AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)) AS TOP_ITEM_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , C.PLANT_ID AS OPERATION_ID
             , CAST('-' AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)) AS LOCATION
             , CAST('-' AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)) AS PRODUCTION_TYPE
             , CAST('-' AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)) AS MARKET
             , CAST('-' AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)) AS LINE_ID
             , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50 CHAR)) AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
             , TO_DATE(A.PROD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS PLAN_DATE
             , CAST(A.PROD_QTY + A.DEFECT_QTY AS NUMBER(20, 4)) AS ACTUAL_QTY
             , CAST(A.PROD_QTY AS NUMBER(20, 4)) AS ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY
             , CAST(A.DEFECT_QTY AS NUMBER(20, 4)) AS ACTUAL_SCRAP_QTY
             , A.CREATED_BY AS INSERT_ID
             , A.CREATION_DATE AS INSERT_TIME
             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY AS UPDATE_ID
             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS UPDATE_TIME
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18, 5)) AS QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18, 5)) AS QTY_LANE
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18, 5)) AS DFCT_QTY2
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18, 5)) AS LOSS_QTY2
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18, 5)) AS PRDT_REQ_QTY2
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18, 5)) AS TOP_COATING_QTY2
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18, 5)) AS YIELD_LOSS_QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)) AS EQUIPMENT_ID
             , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(30 CHAR)) AS FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS ROLL_IN_QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS ROLL_OUT_QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS JR_IN_QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS JR_OUT_QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS BATCH_IN_QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS BATCH_OUT_QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS CELL_IN_QTY
             , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(20, 5)) AS CELL_OUT_QTY
          FROM SCM_DNM_SCS_PROD_RESULT A
             , SCM_MST_SITE C
             , SCM_MST_ITEM_SN B
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND C.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
           AND C.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID
           AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
           AND B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP IS NOT NULL
           AND NVL(C.OSP_YN, 'N') = 'Y'  /* 외주 */
           AND NVL(C.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N') = 'N'  /* Plant 별 Plan 수행 대상 : Line 구분 없음 */ /* -- 주석 START 20211006 C20210915-000381 외주 생산실적 테이블 변경 : ERP -> SCS
    UNION ALL --2018. 5. 28
    SELECT
         A.SCM_SITE_ID
        ,B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
        ,A.COMPANY_ID
        ,A.DIVISION_ID
        ,A.SITE_ID
        ,VENDOR_CODE AS PLANT_ID
        ,'-' AS FACTORY_ID
        ,'-' AS TOP_ITEM_ID
        ,A.ITEM_ID
        ,VENDOR_CODE AS OPERATION_ID
        ,'-' AS LOCATION
        ,'-' AS PRODUCTION_TYPE
        ,'-' AS MARKET
        ,'-' AS LINE_ID
        ,NULL AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
        ,PROD_DATE AS PLAN_DATE
        ,GOOD_QTY + DEFECT_QTY AS ACTUAL_QTY
        ,GOOD_QTY AS ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY
        ,DEFECT_QTY AS ACTUAL_SCRAP_QTY
        ,CREATED_BY AS INSERT_ID
        ,CREATION_DATE AS INSERT_TIME
        ,LAST_UPDATED_BY AS UPDATE_ID
        ,LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS UPDATE_TIME
        ,NULL AS QTY
        ,NULL AS QTY_LANE
        ,NULL AS DFCT_QTY2
        ,NULL AS LOSS_QTY2
        ,NULL AS PRDT_REQ_QTY2
        ,NULL AS TOP_COATING_QTY2
        ,NULL AS YIELD_LOSS_QTY
        ,NULL AS EQUIPMENT_ID
        ,NULL AS FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
        ,NULL AS ROLL_IN_QTY
        ,NULL AS ROLL_OUT_QTY
        ,NULL AS JR_IN_QTY
        ,NULL AS JR_OUT_QTY
        ,NULL AS BATCH_IN_QTY
        ,NULL AS BATCH_OUT_QTY
        ,NULL AS CELL_IN_QTY
        ,NULL AS CELL_OUT_QTY
    FROM   SCM_DNM_PACKER_PROD_RESULT A WITH(NOLOCK)
    JOIN   SCM_MST_ITEM_SN B WITH(NOLOCK)
    ON     A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
    AND    A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
    AND    A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID
    AND    A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
    WHERE  B.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP IS NOT NULL
    */ /* 주석 END */
       ) PR
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM FI  /* 2018.06.29 */
 WHERE PR.DIVISION_ID = FI.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND PR.ITEM_ID = FI.ITEM_ID(+)

NAME: SCM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_ORIGIN_DIV_V
TEXT:
SELECT DISTINCT
/****************************************************************************
* PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
* VIEW NAME     : SCM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_ORIGIN_DIV_V
* DESCRIPTION   : 전극,셀,팩공정그룹의 최종공정의 ITEM을 조회
*                 (ORIGIN DIVISION ONLY)
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* 2018-09-03   YYDOK        INITIAL
* 2019-03-18   YYDOK        전지재료 추가(DIVISION_ID=44) => 삭제
* 2020-10-14   KSG          PJ20202001 LG화학 전지. 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 SCM 관리 체계 개선 : RACK
* 2021-09-13   KSG          PJ20214907 LGES SCP 계획 수립 시간 단축 및 분석 기능 강화 : MEB(P5200) 추가
*                             --> 2021.12.13 PI 요청으로 원복함
* 2021-12-15   KSG          PJ20214907 LGES SCP 계획 수립 시간 단축 및 분석 기능 강화 : ESS EP Final Item 추가 : item_class = 'EM0308'
* 2022-01-08   KSG          PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : DC Item 구분 : item_class = 'EM0307'
* 2022-03-23   KSG          PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : GM JV 가상 Division
* 2022-06-02   KSG          PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : ISUZU Item 구분
* 2022-12-20   KSG          PJ20216894 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 Phase2 : Trust BCU Item 구분 : item_class = 'EM0306'
* 2023-04-03   HRK          PJ20230691 LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응
* 2023-06-01   KSG          PJ20230691 LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : 활성화 대응 Cell Prod/Assy 구분자 추가
*                                                                                  ==> 추가 정의 및 수정 필요
* 2024-04-05   KSG          E20240328-001468 CMA Biz의 Project route 등록을 위한 Plant site 내 PW 추가요청
*                              'EA' Item 중 EM0310 class 는 Cell 이 아니라 Pack 으로 판정
* 2025-08-01   HRK          PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산
*                             - OPERATION_GROUP_ID(1순위), CELL_TYPE, TCO_CELL_YN 컬럼 SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M 테이블 참조
* 2025-09-01   HRK          PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산
*                             - SCP Exclude Class 품목 제외
*                             - 2025.09.25 전극 ES0305 APCAS Anode(One Side)Panake class 추가
*************************************************************************** */
/* 1. 자동차 : 81 */
       I.DIVISION_ID
     , I.ITEM_ID
     , CASE WHEN CM.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP IS NOT NULL       THEN CM.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP  /* [PJ20257329] 2025.08.01 1순위로 class master 참조 */
            WHEN SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) IN ('AP', 'AM')  THEN 'P'
            WHEN SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) IN ('AC', 'EC')  THEN 'A'  /* Cell Product */
            WHEN SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) IN ('AA', 'EA')  THEN 'A'  /* Cell Assy */
            ELSE ''
       END AS OPERATION_GROUP_ID  /* E:ELECTRODE, A:CELL, P:PACK */
     , I.NICK_NAME
     , I.ITEM_CLASS
     , I.ITEM_CLASS_NAME
     , CASE I.ITEM_CLASS WHEN 'ES0301' THEN 'ANODE'
                         WHEN 'ES0302' THEN 'CATHODE'
                         WHEN 'ES0303' THEN 'ONESIDE'
                         WHEN 'ES0305' THEN 'ONESIDE'  /* PJ20257329 2025.09.25 전극 ES0305 APCAS Anode(One Side)Panake class 추가 */
                         ELSE ''
       END AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , NVL(CM.TCO_CELL_YN, 'N') AS TCO_CELL_YN  /* [PJ20257329] 2025.08.01 class master 참조 */
     , 'N' AS RACK_YN  /* 20201014 PJ20202001 RACK Item Flag 추가 */
     , 'N' AS DC_YN
     , 'N' AS IS_YN  /* 20220602 PJ20216891 ISUZU Item 구분 */
     , CM.CELL_TYPE  /* [PJ20257329] 2025.08.01 class master 참조 */
       /* 20230601 PJ20230691 활성화 대응 Cell Prod/Assy 구분자 추가 */
       /* [PJ20257329] 2025.08.01 변경전 CASE WHEN SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID,1,2) IN ('AC','EC') THEN 'CP'   Cell Product
                                             WHEN SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID,1,2) IN ('AA','EA') THEN 'CA1'  Cell Assy
                                             ELSE '' END AS CELL_TYPE */
  FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN        I
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION       D  /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
     , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M   CM
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND D.DIVISION_ID  = I.DIVISION_ID
   AND CM.CLASS_ID(+) = I.ITEM_CLASS
   AND D.ATTRIBUTE3   = '81'
   AND D.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
   AND NVL(I.ITEM_TYPE, '*') NOT IN ('Q', 'R')  /* 상품,원자재제외 */
   AND SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) IN ('AP', 'AM', 'AC', 'EC'  /* 'EC'자동차에서 ESS CELL생산하는 모델존재 */
                                  , 'AA', 'EA')             /* 20230601 PJ20230691 활성화 대응 Cell Assy 구분자 추가 */
   AND I.ITEM_CLASS NOT IN ('ES0301', 'ES0302', 'ES0303', 'ES0305')  /* PJ20257329 2025.09.25 전극 ES0305 (전극제외) */
   AND I.ITEM_CLASS IS NOT NULL
   AND (SUBSTR(I.ITEM_CLASS, 1, 2) = 'EM'
     OR SUBSTR(I.ITEM_CLASS, 1, 4) IN ('ES19', 'ES20'))  /* 20230601 활성화 대응 Cell Assy : ES19 / 후공정 Cell Assy : ES20 */
   AND NVL(CM.SCP_EXC_YN, 'N') != 'Y'  /* PJ20257329 2025.09.01 SCP Exclude Class 품목 제외 */

UNION

SELECT DISTINCT
       I.DIVISION_ID
     , I.ITEM_ID
     , NVL(CM.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP, 'E') AS OPERATION_GROUP_ID  /* E:ELECTRODE, A:CELL, P:PACK */  /* [PJ20257329] 2025.08.01 class master 참조 */
     , I.NICK_NAME
     , I.ITEM_CLASS
     , I.ITEM_CLASS_NAME
     , CASE I.ITEM_CLASS WHEN 'ES0301' THEN 'ANODE'
                         WHEN 'ES0302' THEN 'CATHODE'
                         WHEN 'ES0303' THEN 'ONESIDE'

                         ELSE ''
       END AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , NVL(CM.TCO_CELL_YN, 'N') AS TCO_CELL_YN  /* [PJ20257329] 2025.08.01 class master 참조 */
     , 'N' AS RACK_YN  /* 20201014 PJ20202001 RACK Item Flag 추가 */
     , 'N' AS DC_YN

  FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN        I

     , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M   CM
 WHERE 1 = 1

   AND CM.CLASS_ID(+) = I.ITEM_CLASS
   AND D.ATTRIBUTE3   = '81'
   AND D.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
