                            WHEN 'ES0303' THEN 'ONESIDE'
                            ELSE '' END AS ELECTRODE_TYPE,
          'N' AS TCO_CELL_YN,
          'N' AS RACK_YN,
          'N' AS DC_YN,
          'N' AS IS_YN,
          ''  AS CELL_TYPE
   FROM   SCM_MST_ITEM_SN I
   WHERE  1=1
   AND    I.DIVISION_ID IN ( '81', '81_UC')
   AND    ISNULL(I.FLOW_ID,'') = 'P5200'
   AND    ISNULL(I.ITEM_TYPE,'') NOT IN ('Q','R')
   UNION */

/* 2. 소형 : 40 */
SELECT DISTINCT
       I.DIVISION_ID
     , I.ITEM_ID
     , CASE WHEN CM.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP IS NOT NULL                 THEN CM.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP  /* [PJ20257329] 2025.08.01 1순위로 class master 참조 */
            WHEN SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) IN ('MP', 'MM')            THEN 'P'
            WHEN SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) IN ('MT', 'MI', 'MD', 'MC', 'EC') THEN 'A'  /* Cell Product */
            WHEN SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) IN ('MA', 'EA')            THEN 'A'  /* Cell Assy */
            WHEN SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) IN ('MU', 'MJ', 'ME', 'MF') THEN 'A'  /* TCO 용 Cell Assy2 */
            ELSE ''
       END AS OPERATION_GROUP_ID  /* E:ELECTRODE, A:CELL, P:PACK / MM-MODULE, MT-TCO CELL, MI-TAPED CELL, MD-DSF CELL */
     , I.NICK_NAME
     , I.ITEM_CLASS
     , I.ITEM_CLASS_NAME
     , CASE I.ITEM_CLASS WHEN 'ES0301' THEN 'ANODE'
                         WHEN 'ES0302' THEN 'CATHODE'
                         WHEN 'ES0303' THEN 'ONESIDE'
                         WHEN 'ES0305' THEN 'ONESIDE'  /* PJ20257329 2025.09.25 전극 ES0305 APCAS Anode(One Side)Panake class 추가 */
                         ELSE ''
       END AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , CASE WHEN CM.CLASS_ID IS NOT NULL              THEN NVL(CM.TCO_CELL_YN, 'N')  /* [PJ20257329] 2025.08.01 class master 참조 */
            WHEN SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) IN ('MT', 'MU') THEN 'Y'  /* TCO CELL */
            WHEN SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) IN ('MI', 'MJ') THEN 'Y'  /* TAPED CELL */
            WHEN SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) IN ('MD', 'ME') THEN 'Y'  /* DSF CELL */
            WHEN SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) IN ('MF')       THEN 'Y'  /* FT CELL : MC 중 일부는 TCO 로 MF와 연결됨 */
            WHEN (I.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP = 'A'
                 AND (CASE WHEN FLOW_ID IS NULL THEN SUBSTR(I.SCP_FLOW_ID, 1, 5)
                           ELSE SUBSTR(FLOW_ID, 1, 5)
                      END) IN ('F6200', 'F7000', 'F7100', 'F7200', 'F7300')
                 ) THEN 'Y'
            ELSE 'N'
       END AS TCO_CELL_YN
     , 'N' AS RACK_YN  /* 20201014 PJ20202001 RACK Item Flag 추가 */
     , 'N' AS DC_YN
     , CASE WHEN I.NICK_NAME LIKE '%ISUZU%' THEN 'Y'

       /* [PJ20257329] 2025.08.01 변경전 CASE WHEN SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID,1,2) IN ('MT','MI','MD','MC','EC') THEN 'CP'  Cell Product
                                             WHEN SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID,1,2) IN ('MA','EA') THEN 'CA1'  Cell Assy : MC -> MA/MF 존재
                                             WHEN SUBSTR(I.ITEM_ID,1,2) IN ('MU','MJ','ME','MF') THEN 'CA2'  TCO 용 Cell Assy2
                                             ELSE '' END AS CELL_TYPE */
  FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN        I
     , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M   CM
 WHERE 1 = 1

   AND I.DIVISION_ID  = '40'
   AND NVL(I.ITEM_TYPE, '*') NOT IN ('Q', 'R')  /* 상품,원자재제외 */

                                  , 'MC', 'EC'                 /* 20190703 'EC' 소형에서 ESS CELL생산하는 모델존재 */
                                  , 'MT', 'MI', 'MD'           /* TCO : MC 중 일부는 TCO */
                                  , 'MA', 'EA'                 /* 20230601 활성화 대응 Cell Assy */
                                  , 'MU', 'MJ', 'ME', 'MF')    /* 20230601 활성화 대응 Cell Assy2 : T/D/I/C -> U/E/J/F */
   AND I.ITEM_CLASS IS NOT NULL
   AND (SUBSTR(I.ITEM_CLASS, 1, 2) = 'EM'
     OR SUBSTR(I.ITEM_CLASS, 1, 4) IN ('ES19', 'ES20'))  /* 20230601 활성화 대응 Cell Assy : ES19 / 후공정 Cell Assy : ES20 */

     , I.NICK_NAME

NAME: SSP_SHIP_CONFIRM_HISTORY_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/********************************************************************************************************************************
* VIEW NAME     : [SSP_SHIP_CONFIRM_HISTORY_V]
* DESCRIPTION   : 출하확정 변경 히스토리
*
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* 2019.06.14   juhlee     Initial Release
* 2026.07.04   ZIONEX     [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
********************************************************************************************************************************/
 C.CONFIRM_ID
,      ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY H.CONFIRM_ID ORDER BY H.HISTORY_SEQ) AS SEQ
,      CASE WHEN H.HISTORY_SEQ =  (SELECT MAX(T.HISTORY_SEQ) FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_H T WHERE T.CONFIRM_ID = C.CONFIRM_ID ) THEN 'C' ELSE 'H' END AS HISTORY
,      C.DIVISION_ID
,      C.FROM_SITE
,      C.ITEM_ID
,      FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME((CASE WHEN C.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN C.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE C.DIVISION_ID END), C.ITEM_ID ) AS NICK_NAME
,      C.TO_SITE
,      C.PROJECT_CODE
,      C.FCST_TYPE
,      ''   AS END_CUSTOMER

/* ----------------------------------------------------------------- */
,      H.YYYYMMDD
,      H.QTY
,      H.TRANSPORT_MODE
,      H.INCOTERMS
,      H.CUSTOMER_LT
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
,      D.YYYYMMDD		AS BEFORE_YYYYMMDD
,      D.QTY			AS BEFORE_QTY
,      D.TRANSPORT_MODE AS BEFORE_TRANSPORT_MODE
,      D.INCOTERMS      AS BEFORE_INCOTERMS
/* --------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/*,      ISNULL(L2.SEGMENT2 ,'' )			AS CHANGE_TYPE */

,      CASE WHEN H.CHANGE_REQ_NO IS NULL THEN 'New'
            ELSE
			     CASE WHEN D.NEW_YN = 'Y' THEN 'New' ELSE 'Change' END
			END										AS TYPE

,      CASE WHEN NVL(M.CHANGE_TYPE,'System Create') = 'A' THEN 'Adjustment'
            WHEN NVL(M.CHANGE_TYPE,'System Create') IN( 'N','C') THEN 'Change Request'
	   ELSE 'System Create' END         AS CHANGE_TYPE
,      M.CHANGE_REASON_CODE
,      L.SEGMENT2         AS CHANGE_REASON_CODE_DESC_K
,      L.SEGMENT3         AS CHANGE_REASON_CODE_DESC_E
/*,      CASE WHEN M.CHANGE_REASON_CODE = 'C00' THEN '' ELSE L.SEGMENT2 END           AS CHANGE_REASON_CODE_DESC_K */
/*,      CASE WHEN M.CHANGE_REASON_CODE = 'C00' THEN 'Change without application' ELSE L.SEGMENT3 END         AS CHANGE_REASON_CODE_DESC_E */
,      M.REQUEST_TITLE
,      M.REQUEST_USER
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--,      U.USERNAME    AS REQUEST_USER_NAME
,      U.USER_NM     AS REQUEST_USER_NAME
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--,      U.USERNAME_E  AS REQUEST_USER_NAME_EN
,      U.USER_ENG_NM AS REQUEST_USER_NAME_EN
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
,      M.REQUEST_DEPT
,      DT.DEPT_NAME_KO   AS REQUEST_DEPT_NAME
,      DT.DEPT_NAME_EN   AS REQUEST_DEPT_NAME_EN
,      M.REQUEST_TIME
,      M.APPROVAL_USER
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--,      U2.USERNAME    AS APPROVAL_USER_NAME
,      U2.USER_NM     AS APPROVAL_USER_NAME
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--,      U2.USERNAME_E  AS APPROVAL_USER_NAME_EN
,      U2.USER_ENG_NM AS APPROVAL_USER_NAME_EN
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
,      M.APPROVAL_DEPT
,      DT2.DEPT_NAME_KO  AS APPROVAL_DEPT_NAME
,      DT2.DEPT_NAME_EN  AS APPROVAL_DEPT_NAME_EN
,      M.APPROVAL_TIME


,      ABS(NVL(D.QTY,0) - NVL(D.NEW_QTY,0) )   AS VARIABLE_QTY

,      H.CHANGE_REQ_NO
,      M.CHANGE_REASON_DETAIL
,      NVL(M.APPROVAL_TIME, C.CREATION_DATE ) AS UPDATED_DATE

/* ----------------------------------------------- */
,      H.REMARKS    AS REMARKS
,      H.REMARKS2   AS BULIDING
,      H.REMARKS3   AS CUSTORMER_REQUIREMENTS
/* ----------------------------------------------- */
,      CASE WHEN H.HISTORY_SEQ =  (SELECT MAX(T.HISTORY_SEQ) FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_H T WHERE T.CONFIRM_ID = C.CONFIRM_ID ) THEN C.ERP_SO_NO ELSE NULL END  AS ERP_SO_NO

,      C.ERP_STATUS
/*,      C.ERP_SO_NO */
,     S.USER_ID   AS MODEL_PIC

,     FN_GET_SSP_MKT_OWNER_NAME (SI.OWNER, ',', 'KO') AS MTK_OWNER_KR
,     FN_GET_SSP_MKT_OWNER_NAME (SI.OWNER, ',', 'EN') AS MTK_OWNER_EN


,     FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO((CASE WHEN C.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN C.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE C.DIVISION_ID END), C.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION' ) AS SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION
,     FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO((CASE WHEN C.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN C.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE C.DIVISION_ID END), C.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION' ) AS SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION

,      CASE WHEN NVL(D.YYYYMMDD,' ')       <> NVL(D.NEW_YYYYMMDD,' ')       THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END  AS DATE_CHANGE_YN
,      CASE WHEN NVL(D.QTY,0)             <> NVL(D.NEW_QTY,0)             THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END  AS QTY_CHANGE_YN
,      CASE WHEN NVL(D.TRANSPORT_MODE,' ') <> NVL(D.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE,' ') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END  AS TRANSPORT_CHANGE_YN
,      CASE WHEN  ( D.YYYYMMDD = D.NEW_YYYYMMDD  AND D.QTY = D.NEW_QTY  AND  D.TRANSPORT_MODE = D.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ONLY_REMARK_CHANGE_YN


,      M.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS
,      FN_GET_LOOKUP_CODE_DESC( 'CHANGE_REQ_STATUS', M.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS)  AS CHANGE_REQ_STATUS_DESC


,      C.REQUESTOR   AS SHIP_REQ_REQUESTOR
,      C.ATTRIBUTE10 AS REQ_DET_ID
FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM  C
           JOIN SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_H  H         ON H.CONFIRM_ID = C.CONFIRM_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ M    ON M.CHANGE_REQ_NO = H.CHANGE_REQ_NO AND M.CHANGE_REQ_STATUS ='A' AND M.VALID_YN = 'Y'
LEFT OUTER JOIN SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM_CHG_REQ_DE D ON D.CHANGE_REQ_NO = M.CHANGE_REQ_NO AND  C.CONFIRM_ID = D.CONFIRM_ID AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                                             /*     AND  ( D.YYYYMMDD <> D.NEW_YYYYMMDD  OR D.QTY <> D.NEW_QTY  OR D.TRANSPORT_MODE <> D.NEW_TRANSPORT_MODE ) */
LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L    ON M.CHANGE_REASON_CODE = L.SEGMENT1 AND L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CHANGE_REASON_CODE'
LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L2   ON M.CHANGE_TYPE = L2.SEGMENT1 AND L2.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CHANGE_REQ_TYPE'

/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_FX_USER U ON M.REQUEST_USER = U.USERID AND U.USEYN = 'Y'
LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_USER_M U ON M.REQUEST_USER = U.USER_ID AND U.USE_YN = 'Y'
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (START) */
--LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_FX_USER U2 ON M.APPROVAL_USER = U2.USERID AND U2.USEYN = 'Y'
LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_USER_M U2 ON M.APPROVAL_USER = U2.USER_ID AND U2.USE_YN = 'Y'
/* 2026.09.30 AJS 수정 (END) */

LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO DT ON M.REQUEST_DEPT = DT.DEPT_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO DT2 ON M.APPROVAL_DEPT = DT2.DEPT_ID

LEFT OUTER JOIN SSP_MST_MODEL_USER S ON S.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID AND S.FROM_SITE = C.FROM_SITE AND S.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID AND S.VALID_YN ='Y'

LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI ON SI.DIVISION_ID  = (CASE WHEN C.DIVISION_ID ='EE' THEN C.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID ELSE C.DIVISION_ID END)
												AND SI.SCM_SITE_ID  = C.TO_SITE
												AND SI.ITEM_ID  = C.ITEM_ID
												AND SI.PROJECT_CODE  = C.PROJECT_CODE



/* LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_PROJECT P WITH(NOLOCK) ON P.DIVISION_ID = (CASE WHEN C.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN C.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE C.DIVISION_ID END) */
/*                                                AND P.PROJECT_CODE = C.PROJECT_CODE */



WHERE   C.CHANGE_TYPE = 'C'

AND    C.CONFIRM_ID >= 'C20190419518861'

/*AND    C.DIVISION_ID = '40' */

/*AND  ISNULL(D.NEW_INCOTERMS,'') <> ISNULL(D.INCOTERMS,'') */

NAME: SCM_MST_MODEL_FINAL_ITEM_BOM_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/****************************************************************************
  * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : SCM_MST_MODEL_FINAL_ITEM_BOM_V
  * DESCRIPTION   : MODEL별 전극,셀,팩공정그룹의 최종공정의 ITEM으로 구성된 ONE LEVEL BOM
  *
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018-02-20   YYDOK        INITIAL
  * 2018-06-15   YYDOK        scm_mst_bom_sn -> SCM_MST_BOM_EFFECTIVE_SN 유효일자반영
  * 2018-10-09   YYDOK        MODEL의 CHILD ITEM의 PARENT도 모두 유효한 BOM인지 CHECK반영
  * 2018-10-15   YYDOK        ACTIVE_FLAG='N'인 CHILD_ITEM_ID 제외
  * 2018-11-26   YYDOK        TCO_CELL_YN 추가
  * 2018-12-06   YYDOK        C.ALT_PRIORITY='Y' 조건추가
  * 2018-12-26   yydok        X.CONCATENATE_ITEM LIKE C.CONCATENATE_ITEM + '^%'  ^추가
  * 2019-02-25   yydok        SCM_MST_BOM_EFFECTIVE_SN => scm_mst_bom_sn
  * 2021-02-19   ksg          C20210219-000229 SCP BOM Logic 변경 건 : Company 별로 유효한 Model만 적용
  * 2021-03-09   SEO          PJ20209642 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 : SCP 대치 BOM 적용
  * 2023-06-02   KSG          PJ20230691 LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : 활성화 대응 Cell Prod/Assy 구분자 추가
  *************************************************************************** */
       B.DIVISION_ID
     , B.PLANT_ID
     , B.MODEL_ID
     , B.CHILD_ITEM_ID
     , V.OPERATION_GROUP_ID
     , CASE V.OPERATION_GROUP_ID WHEN 'P' THEN 1  /* 전지 팩 */
                                 WHEN 'A' THEN 2  /* 전지 셀 */
                                 WHEN 'E' THEN 3  /* 전지 전극 */
                                 ELSE 9
       END AS OPERATION_SORT_NO
     , V.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , TO_DATE('20000101', 'YYYYMMDD') AS EFF_START_DATE
     , TO_DATE('99991231', 'YYYYMMDD') AS EFF_END_DATE
     , V.TCO_CELL_YN
     , SUM(B.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY)    AS ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
     , V.CELL_TYPE  /* 20230602 PJ20230691 활성화 대응 Cell Prod/Assy 구분자 추가 */
  FROM (SELECT X.*
          /* FROM scm_mst_bom_sn x */
          FROM SCM_MST_BOM_SN_V X  /* 2021-03-09 SCP 대치 BOM 적용 */
             , SCM_MST_ITEM_SN I
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND X.CHILD_DIVISION_ID = I.DIVISION_ID
           AND X.CHILD_ITEM_ID     = I.ITEM_ID
           AND X.CHILD_COMPANY_ID  = I.COMPANY_ID  /* A002 빈강 추가 따른 조건 추가 */
           AND X.CHILD_SITE_ID     = I.SITE_ID
           AND I.ACTIVE_FLAG       = 'Y'
       ) B
     , SCM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V V
     , SCM_MST_ITEM_SN       MI   /* 20210219 C20210219-000229  Company 별로 유효한 Model만 적용 */
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND B.DIVISION_ID   = V.DIVISION_ID
   AND B.CHILD_ITEM_ID = V.ITEM_ID
   AND B.ALT_PRIORITY  = 'Y'  /* => FP에서 MODEL별로 전개한 테이블에 적용. */
   /* AND ( b.alt_id IS NULL OR ISNULL(b.alt_priority,'') ='Y') */
   /* 20210219 C20210219-000229  Company 별로 유효한 Model만 적용 */
   AND B.DIVISION_ID   = MI.DIVISION_ID
   AND B.MODEL_ID      = MI.ITEM_ID
   AND B.COMPANY_ID    = MI.COMPANY_ID  /* A002 빈강 추가 따른 조건 추가 */
   AND B.SITE_ID       = MI.SITE_ID
   AND MI.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
 GROUP BY B.DIVISION_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.MODEL_ID, B.CHILD_ITEM_ID, V.OPERATION_GROUP_ID, V.ELECTRODE_TYPE, V.TCO_CELL_YN, V.CELL_TYPE

NAME: SCP_ANL_PSI_GLOBAL_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/****************************************************************************
  * PROJECT       : LG ENSOL SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : SCP_ANL_PSI_GLOBAL
  * DESCRIPTION   : WEEKLY SCP FINAL PLAN GLOBAL PSI
  *
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE        IN CHARGE    DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2022.06.22   KSG          INITIAL C20220620-000500 [SCM PI팀] MKT_FCST Waterfall 內 Safety Stock/Gap measure 추가를 위한 View 생성 요청 건 : DM 용
  *************************************************************************** */
       DIVISION_ID
     , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , PLAN_TYPE
     , SEQ
     , TO_SITE
     , ITEM_ID
     , YYYYMMDD
     , SUM(NVL(WH_IN_BALANCE, 0))                             AS WH_IN_BALANCE
     , SUM(NVL(SAFETY_STOCK, 0))                              AS SAFETY_STOCK
     , SUM(NVL(WH_IN_BALANCE, 0)) - SUM(NVL(SAFETY_STOCK, 0)) AS GAP
  FROM (
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , A.PLAN_TYPE
             , A.SEQ
             , A.TO_SITE
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.YYYYMMDD
             , CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'WH_IN_BALANCE' THEN A.QTY ELSE 0 END AS WH_IN_BALANCE
             , CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'SAFETY_STOCK'  THEN A.QTY ELSE 0 END AS SAFETY_STOCK
          FROM SCP_ANL_PSI_GLOBAL  A
             , SCM_MST_PLAN        P
             , SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL D
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND D.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID  /* EE 존재 */
           AND D.PLAN_ID      = P.PLAN_ID
           AND D.PLAN_TYPE    = A.PLAN_TYPE
           AND D.PLAN_SEQ     = A.SEQ
           AND A.PLAN_TYPE    = 'FN'
           AND D.CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND P.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID  /* EE 존재 */
           AND P.PLAN_NAME    = A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND P.PLAN_CYCLE   = 'WEEKLY'
           AND MEASURE        IN ('WH_IN_BALANCE', 'SAFETY_STOCK')
           AND QTY            <> 0
           /* Safety Stock 대상만 처리 */
           AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                         FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LD
                        WHERE LD.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DAYS_SAFETY_STOCK'
                          AND LD.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                          AND LD.SEGMENT2    = A.TO_SITE
                          AND LD.SEGMENT3    = A.ITEM_ID)
       ) A
 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
        , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
        , PLAN_TYPE
        , SEQ
        , TO_SITE
        , ITEM_ID
        , YYYYMMDD

NAME: SCM_DNM_STOCK_AGING_V
TEXT:
SELECT SA.COMPANY_ID

     , SA.DIVISION_ID

     , CASE WHEN FX.OPERATION_ID IS NULL THEN FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(SA.PLANT_ID, 'A')

            ELSE NULL

       END                                                  AS SCM_SITE_ID          /* [E20251028-000588] FCS 제외공정 반영 */

     , SA.SITE_ID

     , SA.PLANT_ID

     , SA.FACTORY_ID

     , SA.ROUTE_ID

     , SA.LINE_ID

     , SA.CUTOFF_DATE - 1                                   AS CUTOFF_DATE

     , SA.SEQ

     , CASE WHEN RTRIM(FI.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID) IS NULL THEN TRIM(NVL(EA.CELL_ASSY_ITEM_ID, SA.ITEM_ID))

            ELSE FI.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID

       END                                                  AS ITEM_ID              /* E20260331-000738 / 2025.09.15 CELL ASSY ITEM 우선 */

     , TRIM(SA.ITEM_ID)                                     AS ORIGIN_ITEM_ID       /* 2018.06.29 */

     , SA.PRODUCTION_TYPE

     , SA.FCS_INPUT_DATE

     , CASE WHEN NVL(SA.AGING_AVAILABLE_DATE, DATE '1999-01-01') >= NVL(SA.UNHOLD_EXP_DATE, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN SA.AGING_AVAILABLE_DATE

            ELSE SA.UNHOLD_EXP_DATE

       END                                                  AS AVAILABLE_DATE       /* 20200408 MAX(AVAILABLE_DATE, UNHOLD_EXP_DATE) */

     , SA.REMAIN_LEAD_TIME

     , SA.HOLDING_DATE

     , SA.INPUT_QTY

     , SA.QTY

     , SA.QTY_UOM

     , SA.STOCK_STATUS

     , SA.OPERATION_ID

     , SA.OPERATION_SEQ

     , SA.OP_START_TIME

     , SA.TRAY_OP_STATUS

     , SA.STOCK_TYPE

     , CASE WHEN RTRIM(SA.WIPHOLD_YN) IS NULL THEN 'N'

            ELSE SA.WIPHOLD_YN

       END                                                  AS WIPHOLD_YN           /* 2018. 5. 11 / E20260331-000738 */

     , SA.UNHOLD_EXP_DATE

     , SA.SPECIAL_YN

     , SA.LOT_ID

     , SA.OCV2_END_TIME

     , SA.SHIP_AVAILABLE_DATE

     , SA.BEFORE_DEGAS

     , SA.DEGAS_END_DATE

     , SA.INSERT_ID

     , SA.INSERT_TIME

     , SA.UPDATE_ID

     , SA.UPDATE_TIME

     , FI.OPERATION_GROUP                                                           /* 20190130 */

     , FI.NICK_NAME                                                                 /* 20190130 */

     , SA.AGING_AVAILABLE_DATE
     , SA.CUTOFF_DATE                                       AS ORG_CUTOFF_DATE      --  2026.10.07 AJS 원장 마감일(기간 조건 인덱스 사용)

  FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK_AGING_V_SN SA

     , (SELECT XA.COMPANY_ID

             , XA.DIVISION_ID

             , XA.SITE_ID

             , XA.PLANT_ID

             , XA.SCP_EXC_ITEM_ID

             , XA.CELL_ASSY_ITEM_ID

          FROM TABLE(FN_GET_SCP_EXC_ITEM_ASSY_MAP(NULL)) XA) EA                     /* 2025.09.15 SCP 제외 대상 품목 -> Cell Assy 전환 대상 */

     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM FI

     , (SELECT SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID

          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL

         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'FCS_INVENTORY_EXCEPTION_OPERATION'

           AND VALID_YN = 'Y'

         GROUP BY SEGMENT1) FX                                                      /* [E20251028-000588] FCS 제외공정 */

 WHERE EA.COMPANY_ID(+) = SA.COMPANY_ID

   AND EA.DIVISION_ID(+) = SA.DIVISION_ID

   AND EA.SITE_ID(+) = SA.SITE_ID

   AND EA.PLANT_ID(+) = SA.PLANT_ID

   AND EA.SCP_EXC_ITEM_ID(+) = TRIM(SA.ITEM_ID)

   AND FI.DIVISION_ID(+) = SA.DIVISION_ID

   AND FI.ITEM_ID(+) = TRIM(NVL(EA.CELL_ASSY_ITEM_ID, SA.ITEM_ID))

   AND FX.OPERATION_ID(+) = SA.OPERATION_ID

/* [PJ2025F254] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : ESS 가상 line 재고 정보 추가 */

 UNION ALL

SELECT MP.VL_COMPANY_ID                                     AS COMPANY_ID

     , MP.VL_DIVISION_ID                                    AS DIVISION_ID

     , CASE WHEN FX.OPERATION_ID IS NULL THEN FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(MP.VL_PLANT_ID, 'A')

            ELSE NULL

       END                                                  AS SCM_SITE_ID

     , MP.VL_SITE_ID                                        AS SITE_ID

     , MP.VL_PLANT_ID                                       AS PLANT_ID

     , MP.VL_FACTORY_ID                                     AS FACTORY_ID

     , SA.ROUTE_ID

     , MP.VL_LINE_ID                                        AS LINE_ID

     , SA.CUTOFF_DATE - 1                                   AS CUTOFF_DATE

     , SA.SEQ

     , CASE WHEN RTRIM(FI.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID) IS NULL THEN TRIM(NVL(EA.CELL_ASSY_ITEM_ID, SA.ITEM_ID))

            ELSE FI.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID

       END                                                  AS ITEM_ID

     , TRIM(SA.ITEM_ID)                                     AS ORIGIN_ITEM_ID

     , SA.PRODUCTION_TYPE

     , SA.FCS_INPUT_DATE

     , CASE WHEN NVL(SA.AGING_AVAILABLE_DATE, DATE '1999-01-01') >= NVL(SA.UNHOLD_EXP_DATE, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN SA.AGING_AVAILABLE_DATE

            ELSE SA.UNHOLD_EXP_DATE

       END                                                  AS AVAILABLE_DATE

     , SA.REMAIN_LEAD_TIME

     , SA.HOLDING_DATE

     , SA.INPUT_QTY

     , SA.QTY

     , SA.QTY_UOM

     , SA.STOCK_STATUS

     , SA.OPERATION_ID

     , SA.OPERATION_SEQ

     , SA.OP_START_TIME

     , SA.TRAY_OP_STATUS

     , SA.STOCK_TYPE

     , CASE WHEN RTRIM(SA.WIPHOLD_YN) IS NULL THEN 'N'

            ELSE SA.WIPHOLD_YN

       END                                                  AS WIPHOLD_YN

     , SA.UNHOLD_EXP_DATE

     , SA.SPECIAL_YN

     , SA.LOT_ID

     , SA.OCV2_END_TIME

     , SA.SHIP_AVAILABLE_DATE

     , SA.BEFORE_DEGAS

     , SA.DEGAS_END_DATE

     , SA.INSERT_ID

     , SA.INSERT_TIME

     , SA.UPDATE_ID

     , SA.UPDATE_TIME

     , FI.OPERATION_GROUP

     , FI.NICK_NAME

     , SA.AGING_AVAILABLE_DATE
     , SA.CUTOFF_DATE                                       AS ORG_CUTOFF_DATE      --  2026.10.07 AJS 원장 마감일(기간 조건 인덱스 사용)

  FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK_AGING_V_SN SA

     , TABLE(FN_GET_JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP()) MP                              /* JV Real Line / ESS Virtual Line 매핑 */

     , SCM_MST_ITEM_SN VI

     , (SELECT XA.COMPANY_ID

             , XA.DIVISION_ID

             , XA.SITE_ID

             , XA.PLANT_ID

             , XA.SCP_EXC_ITEM_ID

             , XA.CELL_ASSY_ITEM_ID

          FROM TABLE(FN_GET_SCP_EXC_ITEM_ASSY_MAP(NULL)) XA) EA

     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM FI

     , (SELECT SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID

          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL

         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'FCS_INVENTORY_EXCEPTION_OPERATION'

           AND VALID_YN = 'Y'

         GROUP BY SEGMENT1) FX

 WHERE MP.RL_COMPANY_ID = SA.COMPANY_ID

   AND MP.RL_DIVISION_ID = SA.DIVISION_ID

   AND MP.RL_SITE_ID = SA.SITE_ID

   AND MP.RL_PLANT_ID = SA.PLANT_ID

   AND MP.RL_FACTORY_ID = SA.FACTORY_ID

   AND MP.RL_LINE_ID = SA.LINE_ID

   AND VI.COMPANY_ID = MP.VL_COMPANY_ID

   AND VI.DIVISION_ID = MP.VL_DIVISION_ID

   AND VI.SITE_ID = MP.VL_SITE_ID

   AND VI.ITEM_ID = CASE WHEN RTRIM(FI.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID) IS NULL THEN TRIM(NVL(EA.CELL_ASSY_ITEM_ID, SA.ITEM_ID))

                         ELSE FI.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID

                    END

   AND EA.COMPANY_ID(+) = SA.COMPANY_ID

   AND EA.DIVISION_ID(+) = SA.DIVISION_ID

   AND EA.SITE_ID(+) = SA.SITE_ID

   AND EA.PLANT_ID(+) = SA.PLANT_ID

   AND EA.SCP_EXC_ITEM_ID(+) = TRIM(SA.ITEM_ID)

   AND FI.DIVISION_ID(+) = SA.DIVISION_ID

   AND FI.ITEM_ID(+) = TRIM(NVL(EA.CELL_ASSY_ITEM_ID, SA.ITEM_ID))

   AND FX.OPERATION_ID(+) = SA.OPERATION_ID

   AND VI.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP = 'A'                                                 /* Cell(조립) */

NAME: SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_DEPT_V
TEXT:
SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_DEPT_V
 * Description  : 사이트·아이템 단위 부서
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2026.09.29   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 *                             SCM_MST_SITE.DEPT_ID 삭제에 따라 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경
 */
       DIVISION_ID
     , SCM_SITE_ID
     , ITEM_ID
     , MAX(DEPT_ID)                                                        AS DEPT_ID
  FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM
 WHERE TRIM(DEPT_ID) IS NOT NULL
 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
        , SCM_SITE_ID
        , ITEM_ID

       DIVISION_ID

NAME: SCP_MST_FORMATION_V
TEXT:
SELECT DIVISION_ID
     , PLANT_SITE_ID
     , ITEM_ID
     , NVL(FORMATION_YIELD, 1.0)                            AS FORMATION_YIELD
     , NVL(CHAR_YIELD, 1.0)                                 AS CHAR_YIELD
     , NVL(FORMATION_YIELD, 1.0) * NVL(CHAR_YIELD, 1.0)     AS FORMATION_TOTAL_YIELD
     , LT_FORMATION
     , TO_NUMBER(NVL(ATTRIBUTE1, '0.0'))                    AS ADD_LT_FORMATION
     , LT_FORMATION + TO_NUMBER(NVL(ATTRIBUTE1, '0.0'))     AS TOTAL_LT_FORMATION
       /* 20240528 PJ20244573 : ssp 수율 처리 변경 - NULL 인 경우 0.0 으로 적용되던 것을 변경 */
     , NVL(SSP_MODIFY_YIELD
          ,NVL(FORMATION_YIELD, 1.0) * NVL(CHAR_YIELD, 1.0)) AS SSP_MODIFY_YIELD
  FROM SCP_MST_FORMATION

NAME: SSP_ANL_WH_STOCK_V
TEXT:
SELECT XA.DIVISION_ID
     , XA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , XA.PLAN_TYPE
     , XA.SEQ
     , XA.ITEM_ID
     , XA.FROM_SITE
     , SUM(XA.QTY) AS QTY
  FROM (
        /* OWMS 재고 */
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID            AS DIVISION_ID
             , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD    AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , A.PLAN_TYPE              AS PLAN_TYPE
             , A.SEQ                    AS SEQ
             , A.ITEM_ID                AS ITEM_ID
             , A.FROM_SITE              AS FROM_SITE
             , ROUND(SUM(A.AVAILABLE_QTY), 0) AS QTY
          FROM SSP_ANL_OWMS_STOCK_C A
         GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , A.PLAN_TYPE
             , A.SEQ
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.FROM_SITE
        UNION ALL
        /* STORAGE ID : B100(TCO Ass.BS D/F), R100(TCO Ass.SW D/F) */
        SELECT B.DIVISION_ID            AS DIVISION_ID
             , B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD    AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , B.PLAN_TYPE              AS PLAN_TYPE
             , B.SEQ                    AS SEQ
             , B.ITEM_ID                AS ITEM_ID
             , B.SCM_SITE_ID            AS FROM_SITE
             , ROUND(SUM(B.QTY), 0)     AS QTY
          FROM SSP_ANL_TCO_STOCK_C B
         GROUP BY B.DIVISION_ID
             , B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , B.PLAN_TYPE
             , B.SEQ
             , B.ITEM_ID
             , B.SCM_SITE_ID
       ) XA
 GROUP BY XA.DIVISION_ID
     , XA.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , XA.PLAN_TYPE
     , XA.SEQ
     , XA.ITEM_ID
     , XA.FROM_SITE

NAME: SCP_MST_BOD_N_V
TEXT:
SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SCP_MST_BOD_V
 * Description  : SCP BOD
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018.03.26   Kim SungGi     Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2018.06.08   KSG            Z01 / Z02 별도 로직 적용 제외
 * 2018.07.18   KSG            To Site가 Plant 인 경우는 DIV 조건 제거
 * 2019.02.13   YHW            [CSR ID:3907873] SSP Distribution route/BOD상 'L/T TYPE'컬럼 추가요청
 * 2020.04.17   juhlee         [PJ20199555] 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 자재재공 수급 점검 체계 개선
 *                               : lt_total_origin, ship_lt_total_origin 컬럼 추가 (incoterms와 관계없는 순수 물류 L/T)
 * 2020.09.01   KSG            PJ20202001  LG화학 전지. 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 SCM 관리 체계 개선 : 법인간 거래 Incoterms 동기화
 * 2021.05.03   SEO            PJ20209642 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 - Before/After LT 추가
 * 2021.06.07   SEO            PJ20209643 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2)
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
/* To Site : SALES */
       B.DIVISION_ID
     , B.BOD_ID
     , S.SITE_TYPE AS BOD_TYPE
     , B.FROM_SITE
     , R.D_COUNTRY
     , R.D_PORT_CODE
     , R.A_COUNTRY
     , R.A_PORT_CODE
     , R.TO_COUNTRY
     , R.TO_CITY
     , S.VMI_YN AS HUB_SLOC
     , B.TO_SITE
     , B.INCOTERMS
     , B.ATTRIBUTE1 AS SSP_INCOTERMS /* 20200901 PJ20202001R  법인간 거래 Incoterms 동기화 */
     , R.TRANSPORT_MODE
     , B.ROUTE_ID
     , B.PRIORITY
     , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(R.DAYS_MON, 'N') AS DAYS_MON
     , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(R.DAYS_TUE, 'N') AS DAYS_TUE
     , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(R.DAYS_WED, 'N') AS DAYS_WED
     , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(R.DAYS_THU, 'N') AS DAYS_THU
     , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(R.DAYS_FRI, 'N') AS DAYS_FRI
     , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(R.DAYS_SAT, 'N') AS DAYS_SAT
     , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(R.DAYS_SUN, 'N') AS DAYS_SUN
     , NVL(B.SAFETY_STOCK, 0)           AS SAFETY_STOCK
     , NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0)    AS LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND
     , NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0)       AS LT_WAIT_SHIPPING
     , NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0)              AS LT_VOYAGE
     , NVL(R.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0)   AS LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE
     , NVL(R.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, 0)      AS LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND
     , CASE WHEN RTRIM(L.SEGMENT3) IS NULL THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, 0) + NVL(B.LT_BEFORE, 0) + NVL(B.LT_AFTER, 0)
            /* 2018. 06. 08 Z01 / Z02 별도 로직 적용 제외 : 재적용시 적용 LT는 확인 후 반영할 것 */
            /* WHEN fs.site_id  = 'A001' AND l.segment1 = 'Z01' THEN 0                                -- 한국 Z01 */
            /* WHEN fs.site_id  = 'A001' AND l.segment1 = 'Z02' THEN ISNULL(r.lt_departure_inland, 0) -- 한국 Z02 */
            /* WHEN fs.site_id <> 'A001' AND l.segment1 = 'Z01' THEN ISNULL(r.lt_departure_inland, 0) -- 해외 Z01 */
            /* WHEN fs.site_id <> 'A001' AND l.segment1 = 'Z02' THEN 0                                -- 해외 Z02 */
            WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'A'            THEN 0
            WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'B'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(B.LT_BEFORE, 0)
            WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'C'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(B.LT_BEFORE, 0)
            WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'D'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(B.LT_BEFORE, 0) + NVL(B.LT_AFTER, 0)
            WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'E'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0) + NVL(B.LT_BEFORE, 0) + NVL(B.LT_AFTER, 0)
            WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'F'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, 0) + NVL(B.LT_BEFORE, 0) + NVL(B.LT_AFTER, 0)
            ELSE                                   NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, 0) + NVL(B.LT_BEFORE, 0) + NVL(B.LT_AFTER, 0)
       END AS LT_TOTAL	/* 2021.05.03 lt_before, lt_after 추가 */
     /* 20180402 추가 항차 LeadTime */
     , NVL(CASE WHEN RTRIM(L.SEGMENT3) IS NULL THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(B.LT_BEFORE, 0)
                   /* 2018. 06. 08 Z01 / Z02 별도 로직 적용 제외 */
                   /* WHEN fs.site_id  = 'A001' AND l.segment1 = 'Z01' THEN 0                                -- 한국 Z01 */
                   /* WHEN fs.site_id  = 'A001' AND l.segment1 = 'Z02' THEN ISNULL(r.lt_departure_inland, 0) -- 한국 Z02 */
                   /* WHEN fs.site_id <> 'A001' AND l.segment1 = 'Z01' THEN ISNULL(r.lt_departure_inland, 0) -- 해외 Z01 */
                   /* WHEN fs.site_id <> 'A001' AND l.segment1 = 'Z02' THEN 0                                -- 해외 Z02 */
                   WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'A'            THEN 0
                   WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'B'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(B.LT_BEFORE, 0)
                   ELSE                                   NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(B.LT_BEFORE, 0)
               END, 0) AS SHIP_LT_TOTAL		/* 2021.05.03 lt_before 추가 */
     , B.VALID_YN AS BOD_VALID_YN
     , R.VALID_YN AS ROUTE_VALID_YN
     , R.LT_TYPE
     , NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, 0)  AS LT_TOTAL_ORIGIN
     , NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) AS SHIP_LT_TOTAL_ORIGIN
     /* 20200901 PJ20202001R  법인간 거래 Incoterms 동기화 */
     , CASE WHEN RTRIM(SSP_L.SEGMENT3) IS NULL THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, 0) + NVL(B.LT_AFTER, 0)
            WHEN SSP_L.SEGMENT3  = 'A'            THEN 0
            WHEN SSP_L.SEGMENT3  = 'B'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0)
            WHEN SSP_L.SEGMENT3  = 'C'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0)
            WHEN SSP_L.SEGMENT3  = 'D'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0)  + NVL(B.LT_AFTER, 0)
            WHEN SSP_L.SEGMENT3  = 'E'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0)  + NVL(B.LT_AFTER, 0)
            WHEN SSP_L.SEGMENT3  = 'F'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, 0)  + NVL(B.LT_AFTER, 0)
            ELSE                                       NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, 0)  + NVL(B.LT_AFTER, 0)
       END AS LT_TOTAL_SSP		/* 2021.05.03 lt_after 추가 */
     /* 20200901 PJ20202001R  법인간 거래 Incoterms 동기화 */
     , NVL(CASE WHEN RTRIM(SSP_L.SEGMENT3) IS NULL THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0)
                   WHEN SSP_L.SEGMENT3  = 'A'            THEN 0
                   WHEN SSP_L.SEGMENT3  = 'B'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0)
                   ELSE                                       NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0)
               END, 0) AS SHIP_LT_TOTAL_SSP
     , B.LT_BEFORE AS BEFORE_LT		/* 2021.05.03 추가 */
     , B.LT_AFTER AS AFTER_LT		/* 2021.05.03 추가 */
     , CASE WHEN RTRIM(L.SEGMENT3) IS NULL THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, 0)
            /* 2018. 06. 08 Z01 / Z02 별도 로직 적용 제외 : 재적용시 적용 LT는 확인 후 반영할 것 */
            /* WHEN fs.site_id  = 'A001' AND l.segment1 = 'Z01' THEN 0                                -- 한국 Z01 */
            /* WHEN fs.site_id  = 'A001' AND l.segment1 = 'Z02' THEN ISNULL(r.lt_departure_inland, 0) -- 한국 Z02 */
            /* WHEN fs.site_id <> 'A001' AND l.segment1 = 'Z01' THEN ISNULL(r.lt_departure_inland, 0) -- 해외 Z01 */
            /* WHEN fs.site_id <> 'A001' AND l.segment1 = 'Z02' THEN 0                                -- 해외 Z02 */
            WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'A'            THEN 0
            WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'B'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0)
            WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'C'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0)
            WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'D'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0)
            WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'E'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0)
            WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'F'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, 0)

            WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'D'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(B.LT_AFTER, 0)
            WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'E'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0) + NVL(B.LT_AFTER, 0)
            WHEN L.SEGMENT3  = 'F'            THEN NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, 0) + NVL(B.LT_AFTER, 0)
            ELSE                                   NVL(R.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND, 0) + NVL(R.LT_WAIT_SHIPPING, 0) + NVL(R.LT_VOYAGE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_LAY_OFF_CLEARANCE, 0) + NVL(R.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND, 0) + NVL(B.LT_AFTER, 0)
       END AS ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL	/* 2021.05.03 추가 */
     , L.SEGMENT3						/* 2021.05.03 추가 */
     , SSP_L.SEGMENT3 AS SSP_SEGMENT3	/* 2021.05.03 추가 */
     , B.ATTRIBUTE2 AS FROM_YYYYMMDD	/* 2021.06.07 추가 */
     , B.ATTRIBUTE3 AS TO_YYYYMMDD		/* 2021.06.07 추가 */
  FROM (SELECT B.*
             , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(B.ATTRIBUTE4, '0'), '^[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(NVL(B.ATTRIBUTE4, '0')) ELSE 0 END AS LT_BEFORE	/* 2021.05.03 lt_before, 0:문자열, 1:순수한 숫자 */
             , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(B.ATTRIBUTE5, '0'), '^[0-9]+$') THEN TO_NUMBER(NVL(B.ATTRIBUTE5, '0')) ELSE 0 END AS LT_AFTER		/* 2021.05.03 lt_after, 0:문자열, 1:순수한 숫자 */
          FROM SCP_MST_BOD B ) B
       INNER JOIN SCP_MST_DISTRIBUTION_ROUTE R
       ON  B.ROUTE_ID = R.ROUTE_ID
       /* AND b.valid_yn = 'Y' */
       /* AND r.valid_yn = 'Y' */
       INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE FS
       ON  B.DIVISION_ID = FS.DIVISION_ID
       AND B.FROM_SITE   = FS.SCM_SITE_ID
       /* 2018.07.18 To Site가 Plant 인 경우는 DIV 조건 제거 */
       INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S
       ON  B.TO_SITE     = S.SCM_SITE_ID
       AND S.SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT'
       LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT *
                        FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                        WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'INCOTERMS'
                        AND    VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                       ) L
       ON  B.INCOTERMS = L.SEGMENT1
       /* 20200901 PJ20202001R  법인간 거래 Incoterms 동기화 */
       LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT *
                        FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                        WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'INCOTERMS'
                        AND    VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                       ) SSP_L
       ON  B.ATTRIBUTE1 = SSP_L.SEGMENT1

NAME: FP_INSTANCE_LINE_V
TEXT:
SELECT 'KR_FORM_FW' AS INSTANCE_ID
     , 'HQ00'       AS COMPANY_ID
     , 'A001'       AS SITE_ID
     , '81'         AS DIVISION_ID
     , 'HQ07'       AS PLANT_ID
     , 'A2'         AS FACTORY_ID
     , 'B1000'      AS OPERATION_ID
     , 'A2AP1'      AS LINE_ID
     , '-'          AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , 'Automotive' AS MODEL_TYPE
  FROM DUAL
 UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT NVL(IA.D_INSTANCE_ID, B.INSTANCE_ID) AS INSTANCE_ID
     , IA.COMPANY_ID
     , IA.SITE_ID
     , IA.DIVISION_ID
     , IA.PLANT_ID
     , IA.FACTORY_ID
     , IA.OPERATION_ID
     , IA.LINE_ID
     , IA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , IA.MODEL_TYPE
  FROM ( SELECT XA.COMPANY_ID
              , XA.SITE_ID
              , XA.DIVISION_ID
              , XA.PLANT_ID
              , XA.FACTORY_ID
              , XA.OPERATION_ID
              , XA.LINE_ID
              , XA.ELECTRODE_TYPE
              , XA.MODEL_TYPE
              , XB.INSTANCE_ID AS D_INSTANCE_ID
           FROM SCM_LINE_M XA
              , ( SELECT SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID
                       , SEGMENT3 AS LINE_ID
                    FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE
                   WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_SPLIT_LINE_DEFINITION'
                     AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' ) XB
          WHERE XA.LINE_ID = XB.LINE_ID(+)
            AND XA.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' ) IA
     , FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V_SN B
     , ( SELECT SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID
              , SEGMENT3 AS LINE_ID
           FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE
          WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_SPLIT_LINE_DEFINITION'
            AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' ) C
     , FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M E
 WHERE IA.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
   AND IA.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
   AND IA.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
   AND IA.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
   AND NVL(IA.MODEL_TYPE, '-') = NVL(B.MODEL_TYPE, '-')
   AND IA.FACTORY_ID   = E.FACTORY_ID
   AND ( B.INSTANCE_ID       = E.INSTANCE_ID
      OR C.INSTANCE_ID       = E.INSTANCE_ID
      OR IA.D_INSTANCE_ID    = E.INSTANCE_ID )
   AND ( ( B.INSTANCE_ID != C.INSTANCE_ID AND IA.D_INSTANCE_ID IS NULL )
      OR ( B.INSTANCE_ID  = C.INSTANCE_ID AND B.INSTANCE_ID = IA.D_INSTANCE_ID ) )
   AND E.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'

NAME: SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V
TEXT:
WITH SUB AS
(
SELECT
/***************************************************************************************
  * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V
  * DESCRIPTION   : SCP 엔진수행 버전조회용 뷰
  *
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018-02-09   YYDOK			INITIAL
  * 2018-04-03   YYDOK			CONFIRM_FLAG,UI_DISPLAN_YN ADD
  * 2018-04-03   YYDOK			PLAN_STATUS ADD (-2: STOP REQUEST)
  * 2018-10-30	 HWYOON			PLAN TYPE 정렬순서 수정(TE 추가)
  * 2021-04-07   khj79          [PJ20209642] LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 - CAPA SIMULATION VERSION_ID 정보를 위한 ATTRIBUTE1 컬럼 추가
**************************************************************************************** */
 D.DIVISION_ID
     , P.PLAN_NAME||'-'||D.PLAN_TYPE||'-'||FN_ZERO_LPAD(TO_CHAR(D.PLAN_SEQ), 2) AS PLAN_VERSION_ID
     , P.PLAN_NAME
     , D.PLAN_SEQ
     , D.PLAN_TYPE
     , D.CONFIRM_FLAG
     , D.CONFIRM_USER
     , D.CONFIRM_DATE
     , P.PLAN_ID
     , M.MODELING_ID
     , M.PLAN_CYCLE
     , D.PLAN_ID||'::'||D.PLAN_TYPE||'::'||TO_CHAR(D.PLAN_SEQ) AS ENG_PLAN_ID
     , D.UI_DISPLAY_YN
     , D.ACTIVE_FLAG
     , D.PLAN_STATUS
     , D.ATTRIBUTE1 AS VERSION_ID    /* 2021-04-07 : CAPA SIMULATION VERSION_ID 정보를 위한 컬럼 추가 */
  FROM SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL D
     , SCM_MST_PLAN P
     , SCM_MST_MODELING M
 WHERE 1=1
   AND M.MODELING_ID = D.MODELING_ID
   AND M.PLAN_CYCLE = 'WEEKLY'
   AND M.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
   AND M.MODELING_ID = D.MODELING_ID
   AND P.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
   AND P.PLAN_CYCLE = M.PLAN_CYCLE
   AND P.PLAN_ID = D.PLAN_ID
   AND D.PLAN_STATUS = '1'
   AND D.UI_DISPLAY_YN = 'Y'
)
SELECT S.DIVISION_ID
     , S.PLAN_VERSION_ID AS PLAN_VERSION_ID
     , S.PLAN_NAME AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , S.PLAN_TYPE
     , S.PLAN_SEQ
     , S.CONFIRM_FLAG
     , S.CONFIRM_USER
     , S.CONFIRM_DATE
     , S.PLAN_ID
     , S.MODELING_ID
     , S.PLAN_CYCLE
     , S.ENG_PLAN_ID
     , S.UI_DISPLAY_YN
     , S.ACTIVE_FLAG
     , S.PLAN_STATUS
     , S.VERSION_ID
     , CASE S.PLAN_TYPE
            WHEN 'PR' THEN 1
            WHEN 'MA' THEN 2
            WHEN 'SE' THEN 3
            WHEN 'FN' THEN 4
            ELSE 0
       END AS PLAN_TYPE_ORDER
  FROM SUB S
 WHERE 1=1
   AND S.PLAN_NAME >= FN_GET_BUCKET_YYYYMMDD(-24)    /* 24주전 : 20200619 허준성책임 요청으로 임시로 늘림 */

NAME: SCP_PLN_NET_DEMAND_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/****************************************************************************
  * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : SCP_PLN_NET_DEMAND_V
  * DESCRIPTION   :
  *
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018.02.21   YYDOK    Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
  * 2025.03.31   kimcd    PJ20249548R  LGES SCP역량 강화를 위한 기준정보PSI엔진 기능개선
  *                       E20250310-000135 셀 생산지별 공급계획 수립 엔진기능 개발
  * 2025.10.02   kimcd    NERP OPEN 3차 대응. 임시 VIEW 수정 - CELL 생산지 코드 신규 코드로 수정
  *************************************************************************** */
       A.MASTER_ID
     , A.PLAN_ID AS ENG_PLAN_ID
     , A.PLAN_ID AS OUT_VERSION_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.PLAN_ID, 1, '::') AS PLAN_ID
       /* ,( CASE FN_SCM_SPLIT(a.master_id,1,'::') WHEN '40' THEN '1' WHEN '81' THEN '2' WHEN '82' THEN '3' END ) AS modeling_id */
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.PLAN_ID, 3, '::') AS SEQ
     , FN_GET_PLAN_NAME(FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.MASTER_ID, 1, '::'), FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.PLAN_ID, 1, '::'), FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.MASTER_ID, 2, '::')) AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.PLAN_ID, 2, '::') AS PLAN_TYPE
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.MASTER_ID, 1, '::') AS DIVISION_ID
     , A.DEMAND_ID AS ENG_DEMAND_ID
     , A.SALES_MODEL_ID
     , TO_CHAR(A.SHIPPING_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS SHIPPING_DATE
     , TO_CHAR(A.DUE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS DUE_DATE
     , A.QTY
     , A.SPLIT_QTY
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.DEMAND_ID, 1, '::') AS ITEM_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.DEMAND_ID, 2, '::') AS PROJECT_CODE
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.DEMAND_ID, 3, '::') AS ENG_SITE_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.DEMAND_ID, 3, '::'), 1, '~') AS SALES_SITE_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.DEMAND_ID, 3, '::'), 2, '~') AS INCOTERMS
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.DEMAND_ID, 4, '::') AS DOM_EXP
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.DEMAND_ID, 5, '::') AS FCST_TYPE
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.DEMAND_ID, 6, '::') AS DEMAND_TYPE
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.DEMAND_ID, 7, '::') AS YYYYMMDD
     , (CASE FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.DEMAND_ID, 8, '::'), 1, '^'), 1, '##')
             WHEN 'NOPLANT' THEN '-'
             ELSE FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.DEMAND_ID, 8, '::'), 1, '^'), 1, '##')
        END) AS PLANT_SITE_ID
     , PRIORITY
       /* 2025.10.02 kimcd NERP OPEN 3차 대응. 임시 VIEW 수정 - CELL 생산지 코드 신규 코드로 수정 */
       /* 다음 주 SCP 계획 미수립으로 CELL 생산 SITE 넣기. 10월 12일 기존 VIEW로 원복할 것 */
     , NVL((SELECT CM.NEW_VALUE1
              FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER CM
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND CM.ATTRIBUTE5 = '3RD'
               AND CM.CODETYPE   = 'SCP_SITE_ID'
               AND CM.OLD_VALUE1 = A.PLANT_TYPE
               AND ROWNUM       <= 1), NVL(A.PLANT_TYPE, '-')) AS CELL_PLANT_SITE_ID  /* 2025.03.31 PJ20249548R E20250310-000135 */
  FROM TH_ENG_NET_DEMAND_SN A
 WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.PLAN_ID, 3, '::'), '^[0-9]+$')  /* 숫자 */

NAME: SCP_PLN_RTF_ALLOCATION_ALL_V
TEXT:
WITH DEMAND_VER AS (SELECT
/****************************************************************************
  * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : SCP_PLN_RTF_ALLOCATION_ALL_V
  * DESCRIPTION   : WEEKLY SCP FINAL PLAN CONFIRMED ALLOCATION
  *
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018-05-03   YYDOK        INITIAL
  * 2018-05-23   LTW          DUE_DATE DATA TYPE 수정
  * 2018-07-02   YYDOK        수량ROUND처리
  * 2018-09-03   YYDOK        40,EE 20181001이전에 BLOCKING
  * 2018-09-14   YYDOK        VMI인경우,계획반영시점의 CUTOFF FCST의 INCOTERMS반영
  * 2018-10-05   YYDOK        소형(40) 조회가능 division에 추가
  * 2020-08-11   KSG          C20200730-000482 전극(EE) 정보 추가
  * 2022-01-13   KSG          Plan 구간 내 정보만 조회
  * 2022-03-23   KSG          PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : GM JV 가상 Division
  * 2023-04-04   HRK		  PJ20230691R  LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응
  * 2024.05.28   KSG          PJ20244573 LGES SCM SCP 생산모델 기반 공급계획 수립체계 구성 : From Item 정보 추가
  * 2024.08.12   KSG          PJ20244573 LGES SCM SCP 생산모델 기반 공급계획 수립체계 구성
  *                               Final Plan 만 조회에서 전체 조회용으로 신규 생성 : 기존 Final Plan 조회용 SCP_PLN_RTF_ALLOCATION_V 에서는 SCP_PLN_RTF_ALLOCATION_ALL_V 사용하도록 수정
  * 2024.11.14   JJG          PJ20249346 LGES SCP 개선과제 이행 : From SITE ID 정보 추가
  * 2025.03.18   park.p.s     DM_PLN_NET_DEMAND KEY 생성에 따른 속도저하 개선
  * 2025.03.31   kimcd        PJ20249548R  LGES SCP역량 강화를 위한 기준정보PSI엔진 기능개선
  *************************************************************************** */
                           V.DIVISION_ID
                         , MAX(V.VERSION_NO)      AS VERSION_NO
                      FROM DM_MST_VERSION       V
                         , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M   CM
                     WHERE V.YYYYMMDD     = CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                       AND V.VERSION_TYPE = 'MF_W'
                     GROUP BY V.DIVISION_ID, CM.ISO_YYYYWW
                    )  /* 2025.03.18   park.p.s DM_PLN_NET_DEMAND KEY 생성에 따른 속도저하 개선 */
SELECT A.MASTER_ID
     , A.PLAN_ID
     , A.OUT_VERSION_ID
     , A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID                   AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID  /* 20200811 C20200730-000482 추가 */
     , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , A.PLAN_TYPE
     , A.SEQ
     , A.OPERATION_GROUP
     , A.ENG_DEMAND_ID
     , A.ITEM_ID
     , A.PROJECT_CODE
     , A.SALES_SITE_ID
     /*   , A.INCOTERMS */
     , CASE WHEN NVL(S.VMI_YN, 'N') = 'N' THEN A.INCOTERMS
            ELSE (SELECT DMD.INCOTERMS
                    FROM DM_PLN_NET_DEMAND DMD
                       , DEMAND_VER        VER
                   WHERE DMD.DIVISION_ID = VER.DIVISION_ID
                     AND DMD.VERSION_NO  = VER.VERSION_NO
                     /* 20200811 C20200730-000482 DIVISION_ID 에서 origin_to_division_id으로 변경, Net Demand 에 EE 없음 */
                     /* WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = DMD.DIVISION_ID */
                     AND A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID = DMD.DIVISION_ID
                     AND A.SALES_SITE_ID         = DMD.SCM_SITE_ID
                     AND A.PROJECT_CODE          = DMD.PROJECT_CODE
                     AND A.ITEM_ID               = DMD.ITEM_ID
                     AND A.FCST_TYPE             = DMD.FCST_TYPE
                     AND A.DOM_EXP               = DMD.DOM_EXP
                     AND ROWNUM = 1)
       END                                       AS INCOTERMS  /* 2025.03.18   park.p.s DM_PLN_NET_DEMAND KEY 생성에 따른 속도저하 개선 */
     , A.DOM_EXP
     , A.FCST_TYPE
     , A.DEMAND_TYPE
     , TO_CHAR(A.DUE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')           AS DUE_DATE
     , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
     , A.YYYYMMDD
     , ROUND(A.ALLOCATION_QTY, 0)                AS ALLOCATION_QTY
     , A.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
     , A.FROM_SITE
     , A.ATTRIBUTE1                              AS FROM_ITEM_ID  /* 20240528 PJ20244573 From Item / scp Incoterms 정보 추가 */
     , A.INCOTERMS                               AS SCP_INCOTERMS
     /* 2025.03.31 KJJ 오형선 책임님 요청에 의한 attribute2가 없는 경우 plant_site_id 를 FROM_SITE_ID로 구성 */
     , CASE WHEN NVL(LENGTH(A.ATTRIBUTE2), 0) < 6
            THEN A.PLANT_SITE_ID
            ELSE A.ATTRIBUTE2
       END                                       AS FROM_SITE_ID
     , D.CONFIRM_FLAG                            AS CONFIRM_FLAG
     , PND.CELL_PLANT_SITE_ID                    AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID  /* 2025.03.31 kimcd 수요에 존재하는 Cell 생산지 제약 정보 */
  FROM SCP_PLN_ALLOCATION   A
     , SCP_PLN_NET_DEMAND_V PND
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION     DM
     , SCM_MST_SITE         S
     , SCM_MST_PLAN         P
     , SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL  D
 WHERE PND.MASTER_ID              = A.MASTER_ID
   AND PND.OUT_VERSION_ID         = A.OUT_VERSION_ID
   AND PND.ENG_DEMAND_ID          = A.ENG_DEMAND_ID  /* 2025.03.31 kimcd 수요에 존재하는 Cell 생산지 제약 정보 */
   AND DM.DIVISION_ID             = A.DIVISION_ID     /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
   AND DM.VALID_YN                = 'Y'
   AND A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID    = S.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND A.SALES_SITE_ID            = S.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
   AND P.DIVISION_ID              = A.DIVISION_ID     /* EE 존재 */
   AND P.PLAN_NAME                = A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
   AND D.DIVISION_ID              = A.DIVISION_ID     /* EE 존재 */
   AND D.PLAN_ID                  = P.PLAN_ID
   AND D.PLAN_TYPE                = A.PLAN_TYPE
   AND D.PLAN_SEQ                 = A.SEQ
   /*  AND ( (a.division_id IN ('81','82') ) OR (( a.division_id IN ( 'EE','40' ) ) AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),112) > '20181001' ) )
       20200811 C20200730-000482 EE 포함
       전극인 경우 전극 Sales 만 대상, 가상 Cell Site는 제외해야 함
       HM JV 대응 AND (    a.division_id IN ('81','82','40','81_UC')                       20220323 PJ20216891 GM JV 추가
       HM JV 대응      OR (a.division_id IN ('EE','EE_UC') AND a.operation_group = 'E')    20220323 PJ20216891 GM JV 추가
       HM JV 대응     )
       AND (    a.division_id IN ('81','82','40')
            OR (a.division_id = 'EE' AND a.operation_group = 'E') )
       AND a.division_id IN ('81','82','40') */
   AND (DM.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE'                        /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
        OR
        (DM.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE' AND A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E'))  /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
   /* 20240812 PJ20244573 : Final Plan 만 조회에서 전체 조회용으로 신규 생성 : 기존 Final Plan 조회용 SCP_PLN_RTF_ALLOCATION_V 에서는 SCP_PLN_RTF_ALLOCATION_ALL_V 사용하도록 수정 */
   /*  AND A.PLAN_TYPE = 'FN' */
   AND P.PLAN_CYCLE               = 'WEEKLY'
   AND A.YYYYMMDD                <= P.HORIZON_END_DATE  /* 20220113 Plan 구간 내 정보만 조회 */
   AND D.PLAN_STATUS              = '1'
   /*  AND D.CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y' */

NAME: SCP_PLN_RTF_ALLOCATION_V
TEXT:
SELECT A.MASTER_ID
     , A.PLAN_ID
     , A.OUT_VERSION_ID
     , A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID  /* 20200811 C20200730-000482 추가 */
     , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , A.PLAN_TYPE
     , A.SEQ
     , A.OPERATION_GROUP
     , A.ENG_DEMAND_ID
     , A.ITEM_ID
     , A.PROJECT_CODE
     , A.SALES_SITE_ID
       /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          [E20250919-001699]_SSPM ATTRIBUTE6을 사용하도록 수정 원소스 주석처리 후 소스 수정(START)
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
     , NVL(A.INCOTERMS, A.SCP_INCOTERMS) AS INCOTERMS  /* [PJ2024-50611] 소형 매출 프로세스 개선의 건 - INCOTERMS가 NULL인 케이스를 SCP_INCOTERMS로 정의함. */
       /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          [E20251016-001378]_SCP RTF 반영로직 원복 후 NERP3차 INCOTERMS 관련 임시조치 내역 주석처리 (START)
          , CASE WHEN A.INCOTERMS IN ('A01', 'A02', 'DAT', 'DDU', 'FAC', 'S32', 'S33', 'Z01', 'Z02', 'Z03', 'Z04', 'ZS3') THEN NVL(NVL(C.ATTRIBUTE6, A.INCOTERMS), A.SCP_INCOTERMS)
                   ELSE NVL(A.INCOTERMS, A.SCP_INCOTERMS) END AS INCOTERMS  [PJ2024-50611] 소형 매출 프로세스 개선의 건 - INCOTERMS가 NULL인 케이스를 SCP_INCOTERMS로 정의함.
          [E20250919-001699]_SSPM ATTRIBUTE6을 사용하도록 수정 원소스 주석처리 후 소스 수정(END)
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          [E20251016-001378]_SCP RTF 반영로직 원복 후 NERP3차 INCOTERMS 관련 임시조치 내역 주석처리 (END)
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
     , A.DOM_EXP
     , A.FCST_TYPE
     , A.DEMAND_TYPE
     , A.DUE_DATE
     , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
     , A.YYYYMMDD
     , A.ALLOCATION_QTY
     , A.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
     , A.FROM_SITE
       /* 20240528 PJ20244573 From Item / scp Incoterms 정보 추가 */
     , A.FROM_ITEM_ID
     , A.SCP_INCOTERMS
     , A.FROM_SITE_ID
       /* A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID  2025.03.31 kimcd 수요에 존재하는 Cell 생산지 제약 정보 */
     , CASE WHEN A.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN A.CELL_PROD_SITE_ID
            ELSE A.FROM_SITE_ID
       END AS CELL_PROD_SITE_ID  /* 2025.04.16 P.C.I 40번 사업부를 제외하고는 FROM_SITE_ID 제공 */
  FROM SCP_PLN_RTF_ALLOCATION_ALL_V A
     , (SELECT *
          FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD ORDER BY PLAN_TYPE_ORDER DESC) AS ROW_NUM
                     , DIVISION_ID
                     , PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                     , PLAN_TYPE
                     , PLAN_SEQ
                     , PLAN_TYPE_ORDER
                     , CONFIRM_FLAG
                  FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND ((PLAN_TYPE = 'FN' AND CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y')
                     OR (PLAN_TYPE = 'SE' AND DIVISION_ID = '40')  /* 20251020 'SE' -> 'MA' */
                     OR (PLAN_TYPE = 'MA' AND DIVISION_ID IN ('81', 'EE')))  /* 2025.04.30 kimcd PJ20249548R 81, MA에서 조회 가능하도록 추가  20241210 PI 요청으로 보류 => 20250115 재반영 */
               ) SUB
         WHERE SUB.ROW_NUM = 1
       ) B
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
   AND A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = B.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
   AND A.PLAN_TYPE = B.PLAN_TYPE
   AND A.SEQ = B.PLAN_SEQ
       /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          [E20251016-001378]_NERP3차 INCOTERMS 관련 임시조치 내역 주석처리 (START)
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          [E20250919-001699]_SSPM의 ATTRIBUTE6으로 데이터를 사용하기 위해 해당 부분 추가.(START)
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM C
              ON A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
             AND A.SALES_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID
             AND A.PROJECT_CODE = C.PROJECT_CODE
             AND A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID
          [E20250919-001699]_SSPM의 ATTRIBUTE6으로 데이터를 사용하기 위해 해당 부분 추가.(END)
          -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
          [E20251016-001378]_NERP3차 INCOTERMS 관련 임시조치 내역 주석처리 (END)
          ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
       /* WHERE 1 = 1
            AND A.PLAN_TYPE = 'FN'
            AND A.CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y' */

NAME: SCM_MST_ALTER_BOM_V
TEXT:
SELECT
       /****************************************************************************
        * PROJECT       : PJ20209642 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선
        * VIEW NAME     : SCM_MST_ALTER_BOM_V
        * DESCRIPTION   : 대치 BOM
        *
        * PROGRAM HISTORY
        *--------------------------------------------------------------
        *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
        *--------------------------------------------------------------
        * 2021-03-08   SDS          PJ20209642 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선: 대치 BOM
        *                           - 대치 BOM에서 계획 수립 대상은 한 개로 제한
        * 2025.08.31   kimcd       PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산  :
        *                          Item 비활성의 경우 SCP 미반영으로 설정
        * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX  [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
        ****************************************************************************/
       B.DIVISION_ID
     , B.SITE_ID
     , B.PLANT_ID
     , B.PARENT_ITEM_ID
     , B.CHILD_ITEM_ID
     , B.ALT_ID
     , B.ALT_PRIORITY
     , B.BOM_VERSION_ID
     , B.KEY_DATE
     , B.EFF_START_DATE
     , B.EFF_END_DATE
     , B.PARENT_QTY
     , B.PARENT_UOM
     , B.CHILD_QTY
     , B.CHILD_UOM
     , B.VIEW_SCP_PLAN_YN AS SCP_PLAN_YN
     , B.COMMON_CELL_YN
     , B.CHILD_ITEM_TYPE
  FROM ( SELECT X.*
              , CASE
                     /* 2025.08.31 kimcd PJ20257329 : Item 비활성의 경우 SCP 미반영으로 설정 */
                     /* 대치 BOM일 경우 반드시 1개는 계획이 수립이 되도록 한다. 단일 대치BOM 또는 모두 SCP_PLAN_YN = 'N'일 경우 등... */
                     WHEN ATTRIBUTE13 = 'N' THEN 'N'
                     WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, PARENT_ITEM_ID, ALT_ID ORDER BY SCP_PLAN_YN DESC, ALT_PRIORITY, EFF_START_DATE, EFF_END_DATE) = 1 THEN 'Y'
                     ELSE 'N'
                END AS VIEW_SCP_PLAN_YN
           FROM SCM_MST_ALTER_BOM X
          WHERE 1=1
                /* AND   CHILD_ITEM_TYPE <> 'R'  --원자재 제외 */
       ) B
 WHERE 1=1
