NAME: DM_CUST_DEMAND_ANL_BY_ITEM_V
TEXT:
WITH TEMP_CELL_CF AS (
                        SELECT
/****************************************************************************************************************************************
* PROJECT       : LGES SCM
* VIEW NAME     : DM_CUST_DEMAND_ANL_BY_ITEM_V
* DESCRIPTION   : 고객수요분석 - ITEM별 SUMMARY 및 DETAIL 수량 조회
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE         IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* 2025.02.11    Philsu Park         Initial Release.
* 2025.03.04    Philsu Park         [E20250228-001385]_SCM View 테이블 관련 정보 추가 요청 건 [KWH_PER_CELL 추가(SSPM의 ATTRIBUTE8번 값 사용)]
* 2026.07.06    ZIONEX  [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
****************************************************************************************************************************************/
 CT.COMPANY_ID
                                , MAX(CT.DIVISION_ID) AS DIVISION_ID
                                , CT.SITE_ID
                                , CT.PLANT_ID
                                , CT.MODEL_ID
                                , CT.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                                , SUM(CT.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY) AS ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
                                , MAX(CT.CHILD_UOM) AS CHILD_UOM
                        FROM  ( SELECT    CT.COMPANY_ID
                                        , CT.DIVISION_ID
                                        , CT.SITE_ID
                                        , CT.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                                        , CT.MODEL_ID
                                        , CT.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                                        , CT.PLANT_ID
                                        , CT.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
                                        , CT.CHILD_UOM
                                        , CT.ALT_PRIORITY
                                FROM    (   SELECT    COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, MODEL_ID
                                                    , PARENT_ITEM_ID, CHILD_ITEM_ID, CHILD_QTY, CHILD_UOM
                                                    , ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY, ALT_PRIORITY
                                            FROM    SCM_MODEL_COMP_TEMP_SN
                                            WHERE   DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' --속도 이슈 감안해서 81사업부 한정 조건 적용.
                                            GROUP BY      COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, MODEL_ID
                                                        , PARENT_ITEM_ID, CHILD_ITEM_ID, CHILD_QTY, CHILD_UOM
                                                        , ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY, ALT_PRIORITY
                                        ) CT
                                    ,   (   SELECT  SIM.DIVISION_ID, SIM.COMPANY_ID, SIM.SITE_ID, SIM.ITEM_ID, SIM.FLOW_ID
                                            FROM    SCM_MST_ITEM_SN SIM
                                            INNER JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_SN ICM
                                                ON  ICM.CLASS_ID    = SIM.ITEM_CLASS
                                            INNER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                                                ON  B.LOOKUP_TYPE   = 'DM_CELL_ITEM_LEVEL_ID'
                                                AND ICM.LEVEL_1_ID  = B.SEGMENT1
                                            GROUP BY SIM.DIVISION_ID, SIM.COMPANY_ID, SIM.SITE_ID, SIM.ITEM_ID, SIM.FLOW_ID
                                        ) CL
                                WHERE   CT.COMPANY_ID       = CL.COMPANY_ID
                                AND     CT.DIVISION_ID      = CL.DIVISION_ID
                                AND     CT.SITE_ID          = CL.SITE_ID
                                AND     CT.CHILD_ITEM_ID    = CL.ITEM_ID
                                AND    ((CL.FLOW_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_CELL_FLOW_ID')/*('P5500', 'P9500')*/
                                            AND CT.PARENT_ITEM_ID <>  '*')
                                        OR CL.FLOW_ID NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_CELL_FLOW_ID'))
                                AND     CT.ALT_PRIORITY      = 'Y'
                            )  CT
                        GROUP BY CT.COMPANY_ID ,CT.SITE_ID ,CT.MODEL_ID ,CT.PLANT_ID ,CT.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                    )
, CELL_PER_BIZ AS   (
                    SELECT  C.DIVISION_ID, C.ITEM_ID
                            , CASE WHEN MAX(D.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY) IS NULL THEN MAX(E.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY) ELSE MAX(D.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY) END AS ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
                            , MAX(C.KWH_PER_CELL) AS KWH_PER_CELL --[E20250228-001385]_KWH_PER_CELL 추가
                    FROM (  SELECT  A.ITEM_ID, A.DIVISION_ID
                                  , MAX(ATTRIBUTE8) AS KWH_PER_CELL --[E20250228-001385]_KWH_PER_CELL 추가
                            FROM    SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A,
                                    (   SELECT  DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID
                                        FROM    SCM_MST_ITEM_SN
                                        GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID
                                    ) B
                            WHERE    1=1
                            AND      A.DIVISION_ID   LIKE '81%'  --속도 이슈 감안해서 81사업부 한정 조건 적용.
                            AND      A.VALID_YN         = 'Y'
                            AND      A.DIVISION_ID      = B.DIVISION_ID
                            AND      A.ITEM_ID          = B.ITEM_ID
                            GROUP BY A.ITEM_ID, A.DIVISION_ID
                    ) C
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN (   SELECT  MODEL_ID, MAX(ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY) AS ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
                                        FROM    TEMP_CELL_CF
                                        GROUP BY    MODEL_ID
                                        ) D
                                    ON D.MODEL_ID = C.ITEM_ID
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN (   SELECT  MODEL_ID, MAX(ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY) AS ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
                                        FROM    TEMP_CELL_CF
                                        GROUP BY    MODEL_ID
                                        ) E
                                    ON E.MODEL_ID LIKE SUBSTR(C.ITEM_ID, 1, 10) || '%'
                    GROUP BY C.DIVISION_ID, C.ITEM_ID
                    )
SELECT  TT.DIVISION_ID
        , TT.END_CUSTOMER
        , TT.PROJECT_CODE
        , TT.ITEM_ID
        , TT.MEASURE
        , TT.PLAN_YYYYMM
        , TT.REQ_RSN_CD
        , TT.DIF_ANLS_TP_CD
        , TT.ANLS_DIF_RSN_CD
        , TT.REQ_RSN_DTL_CTN
        , TT.QTY
        , TT.CFCST_QTY
        , TT.MFCST_QTY
        , TT.CELL_PER_BIZ
        , TT.CELL_QTY
        , TT.CFCST_CELL_QTY
        , TT.MFCST_CELL_QTY
        , CASE WHEN TT.ITEM_ID IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TT.KWH_PER_CELL END AS KWH_PER_CELL --[E20250228-001385]_KWH_PER_CELL 추가
FROM    (
        SELECT MM.DIVISION_ID, MM.END_CUSTOMER, MM.PROJECT_CODE, MM.ITEM_ID, MM.MEASURE, MM.PLAN_YYYYMM -- Summary
            , NULL                                                                  AS REQ_RSN_CD
            , NULL                                                                  AS DIF_ANLS_TP_CD
            , NULL                                                                  AS ANLS_DIF_RSN_CD
            , NULL                                                                  AS REQ_RSN_DTL_CTN             -- Detail
            , SUM(ROUND(MM.GAP_QTY, 0))                                             AS QTY
            , SUM(ROUND(MM.CUST_FCST_QTY, 0))                                       AS CFCST_QTY
            , SUM(ROUND(MM.MKT_FCST_QTY, 0))                                        AS MFCST_QTY
            , MAX(CL.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY)                                         AS CELL_PER_BIZ
            , SUM(ROUND(MM.GAP_QTY, 0) * NVL(CL.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY, 1))          AS CELL_QTY
            , SUM(ROUND(MM.CUST_FCST_QTY, 0) * NVL(CL.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY, 1))    AS CFCST_CELL_QTY
            , SUM(ROUND(MM.MKT_FCST_QTY, 0) * NVL(CL.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY, 1))     AS MFCST_CELL_QTY
            , MAX(CL.KWH_PER_CELL)                                                  AS KWH_PER_CELL --[E20250228-001385]_KWH_PER_CELL 추가
        FROM (
                SELECT  DIVISION_ID, END_CUSTOMER, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, MEASURE, PLAN_YYYYMM
                        , CUST_FCST_QTY AS CUST_FCST_QTY
                        , MKT_FCST_QTY AS MKT_FCST_QTY
                        , MKT_FCST_QTY - CUST_FCST_QTY AS GAP_QTY
                FROM    DM_CUST_DEMAND_BY_ITEM_SUMMARY A
                ) MM
        INNER JOIN CELL_PER_BIZ CL
            ON  CL.DIVISION_ID  = MM.DIVISION_ID
            AND CL.ITEM_ID      = MM.ITEM_ID
        WHERE  1=1
        AND    MM.PLAN_YYYYMM  >= '202401'  -- Item 단위 집계 이후 데이터만 반영.
        AND    (MM.CUST_FCST_QTY <> 0 OR MM.MKT_FCST_QTY <> 0)
        GROUP BY ROLLUP(MM.ITEM_ID), MM.DIVISION_ID, MM.END_CUSTOMER, MM.PROJECT_CODE, MM.MEASURE, MM.PLAN_YYYYMM
        UNION ALL
        SELECT MM.DIVISION_ID, MM.END_CUSTOMER, MM.PROJECT_CODE, MM.ITEM_ID, MM.MEASURE, MM.PLAN_YYYYMM -- Summary
            , DTL.REQ_RSN_CD, DTL.DIF_ANLS_TP_CD, DTL.ANLS_DIF_RSN_CD, DTL.REQ_RSN_DTL_CTN             -- Detail
            , ROUND(MM.GAP_QTY * DTL.DETAIL_RATIO, 0)                                                   AS QTY
            , ROUND(MM.CUST_FCST_QTY * DTL.DETAIL_RATIO, 0)                                             AS CFCST_QTY
            , ROUND(MM.MKT_FCST_QTY * DTL.DETAIL_RATIO, 0)                                              AS MFCST_QTY
            , CL.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY                                                                  AS CELL_PER_BIZ
            , ROUND(MM.GAP_QTY * DTL.DETAIL_RATIO, 0) * NVL(CL.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY, 1)                AS CELL_QTY
            , ROUND(MM.CUST_FCST_QTY * DTL.DETAIL_RATIO, 0) * NVL(CL.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY, 1)          AS CFCST_CELL_QTY
            , ROUND(MM.MKT_FCST_QTY * DTL.DETAIL_RATIO, 0) * NVL(CL.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY, 1)           AS MFCST_CELL_QTY
            , CL.KWH_PER_CELL                                                                           AS KWH_PER_CELL --[E20250228-001385]_KWH_PER_CELL 추가
        FROM (
                SELECT  DIVISION_ID, END_CUSTOMER, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, MEASURE, PLAN_YYYYMM
                        , CUST_FCST_QTY AS CUST_FCST_QTY
                        , MKT_FCST_QTY AS MKT_FCST_QTY
                        , MKT_FCST_QTY - CUST_FCST_QTY AS GAP_QTY
                FROM    DM_CUST_DEMAND_BY_ITEM_SUMMARY A
                ) MM
        INNER JOIN CELL_PER_BIZ CL
            ON  CL.DIVISION_ID  = MM.DIVISION_ID
            AND CL.ITEM_ID      = MM.ITEM_ID
        INNER JOIN (SELECT  SEQ_NO, DIVISION_ID, END_CUSTOMER, PROJECT_CODE, MEASURE, PLAN_YYYYMM, REQ_RSN_CD, DIF_ANLS_TP_CD, ANLS_DIF_RSN_CD, REQ_RSN_DTL_CTN, QTY
                            , CASE WHEN SUM(ABS(QTY))OVER(PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, END_CUSTOMER, PROJECT_CODE, MEASURE, PLAN_YYYYMM) = 0 THEN 0
                                    ELSE ABS(QTY)/SUM(ABS(QTY))OVER(PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, END_CUSTOMER, PROJECT_CODE, MEASURE, PLAN_YYYYMM)
                                END AS DETAIL_RATIO
                    FROM    DM_CUST_DEMAND_ANL_DETAIL T
                    ) DTL
            ON  DTL.DIVISION_ID     = MM.DIVISION_ID
            AND DTL.END_CUSTOMER    = MM.END_CUSTOMER
            AND DTL.PROJECT_CODE    = MM.PROJECT_CODE
            AND DTL.MEASURE         = MM.MEASURE
            AND DTL.PLAN_YYYYMM     = MM.PLAN_YYYYMM
        WHERE  1=1
        AND    MM.PLAN_YYYYMM  >= '202401' -- Item 단위 집계 이후 데이터만 반영.
        AND    (MM.CUST_FCST_QTY <> 0 OR MM.MKT_FCST_QTY <> 0)
        ) TT
ORDER BY DIVISION_ID, END_CUSTOMER, PROJECT_CODE, MEASURE DESC, PLAN_YYYYMM, ITEM_ID, (CASE WHEN REQ_RSN_CD IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)

NAME: DM_LATEST_CUTOFF_DEMAND_V
TEXT:
SELECT /*
 * PROJECT       : LGES SCM
 * VIEW NAME     : DM_LATEST_CUTOFF_DEMAND_V_20240418
 * DESCRIPTION   : 최신 확정 기준 Mkt Fcst 및 RTF 등 DM 계획정보를 조회
 * PROGRAM HISTORY
 *===================================================================================================
 *   DATE         IN CHARGE      DESCRIPTION
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2024.04.01   Philsu Park    Initial Release.
 * 2024.04.15   Philsu Park    KEEP Table 포함 View 확장.
 *                             [E20240405-002034]_DM 데이터 AWS 전송 기준 변경 건 주차별 최신CUTOFF정보 표출
 * 2024.05.17   Philsu Park    주차별 최신 버전 -> 주차 내 모든 버전 조회.
 * 2024.05.17   Philsu Park    [E20250114-000438]_View table 컬럼 추가 요청의 건(Project_code)
 * 2025.03.11   JSSBAE         [E20250305-000530]_View table 컬럼 추가 요청의 건(plant_site, sold_to_code 칼럼 추가)
 */
       IA.DIVISION_ID
     , IA.VERSION_NO
     , IA.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD                                    AS PLAN_DATE
     , IB.CALENDAR_YYYY                                      AS PLAN_YYYY
     , IB.CALENDAR_MONTH                                     AS PLAN_MM
     , IB.CALENDAR_DAY                                       AS PLAN_DD
     , IB.ISO_WEEK                                           AS PLAN_WEEK
     , IA.MODEL_CODE
     , IA.END_CUSTOMER
     , IA.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
     , IA.SCM_SITE_ID
     , IA.PRODUCT_LEVEL1
     , IA.ITEM_ID
     , IA.NICK_NAME
     , IA.FCST_TYPE
     , IA.INCOTERMS
     , IA.YYYYMM
     , IA.ISO_YYYYWW
     , IA.MKT_QTY
     , IA.RTF_QTY
     , CASE WHEN IA.YYYYMM >= '202301' THEN IA.CUST_FCST_QTY ELSE 0 END AS CUST_FCST_QTY
     , IA.PROJECT_CODE
     , IA.PLANT_SITE_ID
     , IA.SOLDTO_CODE                                        AS SOLD_TO_CODE
  FROM (SELECT XA.*
             , B.END_CUSTOMER
             , B.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
             , B.VMI_YN
             , C.BIZ_TYPE_NAME                               AS "BIZ.TYPE"
             , C.PROJECT_NAME
             , C.PROJECT_STATUS
             , C.PROJECT_OWNER                               AS PROJECT_OWNER
             , D.OWNER_NAME                                  AS OWNER
             , D.CELL_PER_CAR                                AS CELL_PER_CAR
             , D.CELL_PER_MODULE                             AS CELL_PER_MODULE
             , CASE WHEN D.CELL_PER_MODULE <> 0 THEN D.CELL_PER_CAR / D.CELL_PER_MODULE ELSE 0 END AS MODULE_PER_CAR
             , D.SALES_COMPANY
             , D.ATTRIBUTE8                                  AS KWH_CELL
             , CASE WHEN XA.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' AND D.CELL_PER_MODULE > 0 AND TRIM(D.ATTRIBUTE8) IS NOT NULL
                    THEN (D.CELL_PER_MODULE * TO_NUMBER(D.ATTRIBUTE8))
                    ELSE NULL
               END                                          AS KWH_MODULE
             , CASE WHEN XA.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' AND D.CELL_PER_CAR > 0 AND TRIM(D.ATTRIBUTE8) IS NOT NULL
                    THEN (D.CELL_PER_CAR * TO_NUMBER(D.ATTRIBUTE8))
                    ELSE NULL
               END                                          AS KWH_PACK
             , J.COUNTRY_NAME                                AS COUNTRY
             , H.CITY_NAME                                   AS CITY
             , L.SOLDTO_CODE                                 AS SOLDTO_CODE
             , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(XA.DIVISION_ID, 1, 2) = '81' OR XA.DIVISION_ID = '82' THEN F.GROUP_CODE6
                    ELSE F.CELL_TYPE_GROUP_NAME
               END                                          AS PRODUCT_LEVEL1
             , SUBSTR(XA.ITEM_ID, 1, 12)                     AS MODEL_CODE  /* SUFFIX 제거 */
             , G.NICK_NAME
          FROM (SELECT YA.DIVISION_ID
                     , YA.VERSION_NO
                     , YA.SCM_SITE_ID
                     , YA.PROJECT_CODE
                     , YA.ITEM_ID
                     , YA.INCOTERMS
                     , YA.DOM_EXP
                     , YA.FCST_TYPE
                     , SUBSTR(YA.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6)             AS YYYYMM
                     , YA.ISO_YYYYWW
                     , YA.WEEK_NAME
                     , YA.PLANT_SITE_ID
                     , SUM(YA.MKT_FCST_QTY)                  AS MKT_QTY
                     , SUM(YA.RTF_QTY)                       AS RTF_QTY
                     , SUM(YA.CUST_FCST_QTY)                 AS CUST_FCST_QTY
                     , MAX(YA.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD)               AS CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                  FROM (SELECT ZA.DIVISION_ID
                             , ZA.SCM_SITE_ID
                             , ZA.PROJECT_CODE
                             , ZA.ITEM_ID
                             , ZA.INCOTERMS
                             , ZA.DOM_EXP
                             , ZA.FCST_TYPE
                             , ZA.MEASURE
                             , ZA.YYYYMMDD
                             , ZA.QTY
                             , ZA.VERSION_NO
                             , ZA.PLANT_SITE_ID
                             , B.ISO_YYYYWW
                             , B.ISO_WEEK
                             , B.WEEK_NAME
                             , ZA.MKT_FCST_QTY
                             , ZA.RTF_QTY
                             , ZA.CUST_FCST_QTY
                             , ZA.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                          FROM (SELECT WA.DIVISION_ID
                                     , WA.VERSION_NO
                                     , WA.SCM_SITE_ID
                                     , WA.PROJECT_CODE
                                     , WA.ITEM_ID
                                     , WA.DOM_EXP
                                     , WA.FCST_TYPE
                                     , WA.INCOTERMS
                                     , WA.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                     , WA.YYYYMMDD
                                     , WA.MEASURE
                                     , SUM(WA.QTY)           AS QTY
                                     , SUM(CASE WHEN WA.MEASURE = 'MKT_FCST'   AND WA.GUBUN = 'P' THEN WA.QTY ELSE 0 END)
                                     + SUM(CASE WHEN WA.MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP' AND WA.GUBUN = 'R' THEN WA.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS MKT_FCST_QTY  /* (R+P) */
                                     , SUM(CASE WHEN WA.MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP'    THEN WA.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS RTF_QTY
                                     , SUM(CASE WHEN WA.MEASURE = 'CUST_FCST_EDI' THEN WA.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS CUST_FCST_QTY
                                     , MAX(WA.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD)                   AS CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                                  FROM (SELECT 'P'           AS GUBUN
                                             , A.DIVISION_ID
                                             , A.VERSION_NO
                                             , A.CUTOFF_TYPE
                                             , A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                                             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                                             , A.ITEM_ID
                                             , A.DOM_EXP
                                             , A.FCST_TYPE
                                             , A.INCOTERMS
                                             , A.MEASURE
                                             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                             , A.YYYYMMDD
                                             , A.QTY
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE1
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE2
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE3
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE4
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE5
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE6
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE7
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE8
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE9
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE10
                                             , A.CREATED_BY
                                             , A.CREATION_DATE
                                             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                          FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_C A
                                             , (SELECT VA.DIVISION_ID
                                                     , MAX(VA.YYYYMMDD)         AS YYYYMMDD
                                                     , VA.VERSION_NO
                                                     , VA.VERSION_TYPE
                                                     , MAX(CA.BASIS_START_DATE) AS START_YYYYMMDD
                                                     , MAX(TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(CA.BASIS_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + 52 * 7, 'MON') + (-7 - 1), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS END_YYYYMMDD
                                                     , MAX(TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(CA.BASIS_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MON') + (-7 * 52), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD
                                                     , MAX(TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(CA.BASIS_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MON') + (-7 - 1), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS RESULT_END_YYYYMMDD
                                                  FROM DM_MST_VERSION     VA
                                                     , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CA
                                                 WHERE VA.YYYYMMDD = CA.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                                                   AND VA.VERSION_TYPE = 'MF_W'
                                                 GROUP BY VA.DIVISION_ID, VA.VERSION_NO, CA.ISO_YYYYWW, VA.VERSION_TYPE) B
                                         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
                                           AND A.VERSION_NO      = B.VERSION_NO
                                           AND A.CUTOFF_TYPE     = B.VERSION_TYPE
                                           AND A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD = B.YYYYMMDD
                                           AND A.YYYYMMDD       >= B.START_YYYYMMDD
                                           AND A.YYYYMMDD       <= B.END_YYYYMMDD
                                           AND A.QTY            <> 0
                                           AND A.MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST', 'RTF_SYS_RP', 'CUST_FCST_EDI')
                                         UNION ALL
                                        SELECT 'P'            AS GUBUN
                                             , A.DIVISION_ID
                                             , A.VERSION_NO
                                             , A.CUTOFF_TYPE
                                             , A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                                             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                                             , A.ITEM_ID
                                             , A.DOM_EXP
                                             , A.FCST_TYPE
                                             , A.INCOTERMS
                                             , A.MEASURE
                                             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                             , A.YYYYMMDD
                                             , A.QTY
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE1
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE2
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE3
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE4
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE5
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE6
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE7
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE8
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE9
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE10
                                             , A.CREATED_BY
                                             , A.CREATION_DATE
                                             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                          FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_C_KEEP A
                                             , (SELECT VA.DIVISION_ID
                                                     , MAX(VA.YYYYMMDD)         AS YYYYMMDD
                                                     , VA.VERSION_NO
                                                     , VA.VERSION_TYPE
                                                     , MAX(CA.BASIS_START_DATE) AS START_YYYYMMDD
                                                     , MAX(TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(CA.BASIS_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + 52 * 7, 'MON') + (-7 - 1), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS END_YYYYMMDD
                                                     , MAX(TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(CA.BASIS_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MON') + (-7 * 52), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD
                                                     , MAX(TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(CA.BASIS_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MON') + (-7 - 1), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS RESULT_END_YYYYMMDD
                                                  FROM DM_MST_VERSION     VA
                                                     , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CA
                                                 WHERE VA.YYYYMMDD = CA.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                                                   AND VA.VERSION_TYPE = 'MF_W'
                                                 GROUP BY VA.DIVISION_ID, VA.VERSION_NO, CA.ISO_YYYYWW, VA.VERSION_TYPE) B
                                         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
                                           AND A.VERSION_NO      = B.VERSION_NO
                                           AND A.CUTOFF_TYPE     = B.VERSION_TYPE
                                           AND A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD = B.YYYYMMDD
                                           AND A.YYYYMMDD       >= B.START_YYYYMMDD
                                           AND A.YYYYMMDD       <= B.END_YYYYMMDD
                                           AND A.QTY            <> 0
                                           AND A.MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST', 'RTF_SYS_RP', 'CUST_FCST_EDI')
                                         UNION ALL
                                        SELECT 'R'            AS GUBUN
                                             , A.DIVISION_ID
                                             , A.VERSION_NO
                                             , A.CUTOFF_TYPE
                                             , A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                                             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                                             , A.ITEM_ID
                                             , A.DOM_EXP
                                             , A.FCST_TYPE
                                             , A.INCOTERMS
                                             , A.MEASURE
                                             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                             , A.YYYYMMDD
                                             , A.QTY
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE1
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE2
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE3
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE4
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE5
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE6
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE7
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE8
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE9
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE10
                                             , A.CREATED_BY
                                             , A.CREATION_DATE
                                             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                          FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT_C A
                                             , (SELECT VA.DIVISION_ID
                                                     , MAX(VA.YYYYMMDD)         AS YYYYMMDD
                                                     , VA.VERSION_NO
                                                     , VA.VERSION_TYPE
                                                     , MAX(CA.BASIS_START_DATE) AS START_YYYYMMDD
                                                     , MAX(TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(CA.BASIS_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + 52 * 7, 'MON') + (-7 - 1), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS END_YYYYMMDD
                                                     , MAX(TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(CA.BASIS_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MON') + (-7 * 52), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD
                                                     , MAX(TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(CA.BASIS_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MON') + (-7 - 1), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS RESULT_END_YYYYMMDD
                                                  FROM DM_MST_VERSION     VA
                                                     , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CA
                                                 WHERE VA.YYYYMMDD = CA.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                                                   AND VA.VERSION_TYPE = 'MF_W'
                                                 GROUP BY VA.DIVISION_ID, VA.VERSION_NO, CA.ISO_YYYYWW, VA.VERSION_TYPE) B
                                         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
                                           AND A.VERSION_NO      = B.VERSION_NO
                                           AND A.CUTOFF_TYPE     = B.VERSION_TYPE
                                           AND A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD = B.YYYYMMDD
                                           AND A.YYYYMMDD       >= B.RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD  /* 실적구간처리일자 */
                                           AND A.YYYYMMDD       <  B.START_YYYYMMDD         /* 계획 전날까지 */
                                           AND A.QTY            <> 0
                                           AND A.MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST', 'RTF_SYS_RP', 'CUST_FCST_EDI')
                                         UNION ALL
                                        SELECT 'R'            AS GUBUN
                                             , A.DIVISION_ID
                                             , A.VERSION_NO
                                             , A.CUTOFF_TYPE
                                             , A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
                                             , A.PROJECT_CODE
                                             , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                                             , A.ITEM_ID
                                             , A.DOM_EXP
                                             , A.FCST_TYPE
                                             , A.INCOTERMS
                                             , A.MEASURE
                                             , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                             , A.YYYYMMDD
                                             , A.QTY
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE1
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE2
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE3
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE4
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE5
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE6
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE7
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE8
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE9
                                             , A.ATTRIBUTE10
                                             , A.CREATED_BY
                                             , A.CREATION_DATE
                                             , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                                             , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
                                          FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT_C_KEEP A
                                             , (SELECT VA.DIVISION_ID
                                                     , MAX(VA.YYYYMMDD)         AS YYYYMMDD
                                                     , VA.VERSION_NO
                                                     , VA.VERSION_TYPE
                                                     , MAX(CA.BASIS_START_DATE) AS START_YYYYMMDD
                                                     , MAX(TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(CA.BASIS_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + 52 * 7, 'MON') + (-7 - 1), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS END_YYYYMMDD
                                                     , MAX(TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(CA.BASIS_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MON') + (-7 * 52), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD
                                                     , MAX(TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(CA.BASIS_START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MON') + (-7 - 1), 'YYYYMMDD')) AS RESULT_END_YYYYMMDD
                                                  FROM DM_MST_VERSION     VA
                                                     , SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CA
                                                 WHERE VA.YYYYMMDD = CA.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                                                   AND VA.VERSION_TYPE = 'MF_W'
                                                 GROUP BY VA.DIVISION_ID, VA.VERSION_NO, CA.ISO_YYYYWW, VA.VERSION_TYPE) B
                                         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID     = B.DIVISION_ID
                                           AND A.VERSION_NO      = B.VERSION_NO
                                           AND A.CUTOFF_TYPE     = B.VERSION_TYPE
                                           AND A.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD = B.YYYYMMDD
                                           AND A.YYYYMMDD       >= B.RESULT_START_YYYYMMDD  /* 실적구간처리일자 */
                                           AND A.YYYYMMDD       <  B.START_YYYYMMDD         /* 계획 전날까지 */
                                           AND A.QTY            <> 0
                                           AND A.MEASURE IN ('MKT_FCST', 'RTF_SYS_RP', 'CUST_FCST_EDI')) WA
                                 GROUP BY WA.DIVISION_ID
                                        , WA.VERSION_NO
                                        , WA.SCM_SITE_ID
                                        , WA.PROJECT_CODE
                                        , WA.ITEM_ID
                                        , WA.DOM_EXP
                                        , WA.FCST_TYPE
                                        , WA.INCOTERMS
                                        , WA.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                        , WA.YYYYMMDD
                                        , WA.MEASURE) ZA
                             , (SELECT A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
                                     , A.ISO_YYYYWW
                                     , A.ISO_WEEK
                                     , A.WEEK_NAME
                                     , A.BASIS_START_DATE
                                     , A.BASIS_END_DATE
                                     , A.MONTH_NAME
                                  FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                                 WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= '20190101') B  /* 디폴트 구간 설정해서 줄이기 */
                         WHERE B.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = ZA.YYYYMMDD) YA
                 GROUP BY YA.DIVISION_ID
                        , YA.SCM_SITE_ID
                        , YA.PROJECT_CODE
                        , YA.ITEM_ID
                        , YA.INCOTERMS
                        , YA.DOM_EXP
                        , YA.FCST_TYPE
                        , SUBSTR(YA.YYYYMMDD, 1, 6)
                        , YA.ISO_YYYYWW
                        , YA.WEEK_NAME
                        , YA.VERSION_NO
                        , YA.PLANT_SITE_ID) XA
             , (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                     , A.SITE_TYPE
--                   , A.DEPT_ID
                     , A.VALID_YN
                     , A.END_CUSTOMER
                     , A.COUNTRY
                     , A.CITY
                     , A.VMI_YN
                     , A.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                  FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
                 WHERE NVL(A.VALID_YN, ' ') = 'Y') B  /* SCM_MST_SITE : END_CUSTOMER, VMI_YN */
             , (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.PROJECT_CODE
                     , A.PROJECT_NAME
                     , A.BIZ_TYPE
                     , A.BIZ_TYPE_NAME
                     , A.PROJECT_STATUS
                     , A.PROJECT_OWNER
                  FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT A) C  /* 소형은 Pjt 단위 관리 안하므로 Outer */
             , (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.PROJECT_CODE
                     , A.SCM_SITE_ID
                     , A.ITEM_ID
                     , A.VALID_YN
                     , A.CUST_GROUP
                     , A.CUST_GROUP_DTL
                     , A.APPLICATION
                     , A.ROUTE
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE5
                     , A.CELL_PER_CAR
                     , A.CELL_PER_MODULE
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE7
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE1
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE2
                     , A.REPORT_GROUP6
                     , A.SALES_COMPANY
                     , A.ATTRIBUTE8
--                   , (SELECT SA.DEPT_ID
--                        FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO SA
--                       WHERE SA.USER_ID = (SELECT SB.COLUMN_VALUE
--                                             FROM TABLE(STRING_SPLIT(A.OWNER, ',')) SB
--                                            WHERE ROWNUM = 1)) AS DEPT_ID
                     , A.DEPT_ID                                                        -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                     , FN_GET_DM_MKT_OWNER_NAME(A.OWNER, ',', 'EN') AS OWNER_NAME
                     , FN_GET_DM_MKT_OWNER_NAME(A.OWNER, ',', 'KO') AS OWNER_NAME_KO
                  FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A) D
             , (SELECT SCP_P.DIVISION_ID
                     , SCP_P.ITEM_ID
                     , SCP_P.CELL_NICKNAME
                     , SCP_P.BASIC_NICKNAME_CELL40
                     , SCP_P.NICKNAME_40
                     , SCP_P.GROUP_CODE1
                     , SCP_P.GROUP_CODE4
                     , SCP_P.GROUP_CODE5
                     , SCP_P.GROUP_CODE6
                     , SCP_P.GROUP_CODE7
                     , CASE WHEN SCP_P.LEVEL_EXCEPT = 'EC' THEN 'POUCH'
                            WHEN SCP_P.LEVEL_EXCEPT = 'AM' THEN 'CYLINDRICAL'
                            WHEN SUBSTR(SCP_P.ITEM_ID, 3, 1) = 'M' AND SCP_P.OPERATION_ID = 'P9500' THEN 'POUCH'
                            ELSE SCP_G.CELL_TYPE_GROUP_NAME
                       END                                  AS CELL_TYPE_GROUP_NAME
                  FROM (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                             , A.FLOW_ID                     AS OPERATION_ID
                             , A.ITEM_ID
                             , SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 3, 1)       AS CELL_TYPE_CODE
                             , SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 2)       AS LEVEL_EXCEPT  /* 예외적용 */
                             , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(A.DIVISION_ID, 1, 2) = '81' THEN A.GROUP_CODE1
                                    WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '82'               THEN A.LEVEL2_CODE
                                    ELSE ''
                               END                          AS CELL_NICKNAME
                             , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) = 'EC' THEN 'ESS'
                                    WHEN SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) = 'AM' THEN 'M50L'
                                    ELSE CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P'
                                              THEN (SELECT SA.NICK_NAME
                                                      FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM SA
                                                     WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                       AND SA.ITEM_ID = (SELECT SB.DOE
                                                                           FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN SB
                                                                          WHERE SB.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                                            AND SB.ITEM_ID = A.ATTRIBUTE1
                                                                            AND SB.DOE IS NOT NULL
                                                                            AND ROWNUM = 1))
                                              ELSE (SELECT SA.NICK_NAME
                                                      FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM SA
                                                     WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                       AND SA.ITEM_ID = (SELECT SB.DOE
                                                                           FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN SB
                                                                          WHERE SB.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                                            AND SB.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                                                                            AND SB.DOE IS NOT NULL
                                                                            AND ROWNUM = 1))
                                         END
                               END                          AS BASIC_NICKNAME_CELL40
                             , A.NICK_NAME                   AS NICKNAME_40
                             , A.GROUP_CODE4
                             , A.GROUP_CODE5
                             , A.GROUP_CODE6
                             , A.GROUP_CODE7
                             , A.GROUP_CODE1
                             , CASE WHEN A.FLOW_ID IN ('A3000', 'A9000') THEN 'C' ELSE 'E' END AS FLOW_TYPE
                          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM A
                         WHERE (SUBSTR(A.ATTRIBUTE8, 1, 2) <> 'CA' OR A.ATTRIBUTE8 IS NULL)  /* 활성화코드 분리 */
                       ) SCP_P
                     , (SELECT A.CODE                        AS CELL_TYPE_CODE
                             , SUBSTR(A.NAME, 1, 1)          AS FLOW_TYPE
                             , A.GROUP_CODE                  AS CELL_TYPE_GROUP_CODE
                             , G.NAME                        AS CELL_TYPE_GROUP_NAME
                             , A.DISPLAY_SEQ
                          FROM (SELECT B.SEGMENT1            AS CODE
                                     , B.SEGMENT2            AS NAME
                                     , B.SEGMENT3            AS GROUP_CODE
                                     , B.DISPLAY_SEQ
                                  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER        A
                                     , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                                 WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE
                                   AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                   AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CELL_TYPE_ITEM_CODE'
                                   AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y') A
                             , (SELECT B.SEGMENT1            AS CODE
                                     , B.SEGMENT2            AS NAME
                                  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER        A
                                     , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                                 WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE
                                   AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                   AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CELL_TYPE_ITEM_GROUP'
                                   AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y') G
                         WHERE A.GROUP_CODE = G.CODE) SCP_G
                 WHERE SCP_G.FLOW_TYPE(+)      = SCP_P.FLOW_TYPE
                   AND SCP_G.CELL_TYPE_CODE(+) = SCP_P.CELL_TYPE_CODE) F
             , (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                     , A.ITEM_ID
                     , MAX(A.ITEM_NAME)                      AS ITEM_NAME
                     , CASE MIN(CASE WHEN A.ITEM_TYPE = 'P' THEN 1
                                     WHEN A.ITEM_TYPE = 'H' THEN 2
                                     WHEN A.ITEM_TYPE = 'Q' THEN 3
                                     ELSE 4
                                END)
                            WHEN 1 THEN 'P'
                            WHEN 2 THEN 'H'
                            WHEN 3 THEN 'Q'
                            ELSE 'R'
                       END                                  AS ITEM_TYPE
                     , MAX(A.ITEM_CLASS_NAME)                AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME
                     , MAX(A.NICK_NAME)                      AS NICK_NAME
                  FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN A
                 GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID) G  /* SSPM T_SINGLE 참고 */
             , SCM_MST_CITY          H
             , SCM_MST_COUNTRY       J
             , SCM_MST_SITE_CUSTOMER K
             , SCM_MST_CUSTOMER      L
         WHERE XA.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
           AND XA.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND XA.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
           AND XA.PROJECT_CODE = C.PROJECT_CODE(+)
           AND XA.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID(+)
           AND XA.PROJECT_CODE = D.PROJECT_CODE(+)
           AND XA.SCM_SITE_ID = D.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
           AND XA.ITEM_ID = D.ITEM_ID(+)
           AND H.CITY(+) = B.CITY
           AND J.COUNTRY(+) = B.COUNTRY
           AND B.DIVISION_ID = K.DIVISION_ID(+)
           AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = K.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
           AND K.REP_YN(+) = 'Y'
           AND K.DIVISION_ID = L.DIVISION_ID(+)
           AND K.SHIPTO_CODE = L.SHIPTO_CODE(+)
           AND K.SOLDTO_CODE = L.SOLDTO_CODE(+)
           AND F.DIVISION_ID(+) = XA.DIVISION_ID
           AND F.ITEM_ID(+) = XA.ITEM_ID
           AND XA.DIVISION_ID = G.DIVISION_ID(+)
           AND XA.ITEM_ID = G.ITEM_ID(+)) IA
     , (SELECT A.BASIS_START_DATE
             , A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
             , A.CALENDAR_YYYY
             , A.CALENDAR_MONTH
             , A.CALENDAR_DAY
             , A.ISO_WEEK
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
         WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= '20190101') IB
 WHERE IB.BASIS_YYYYMMDD(+) = IA.CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD

NAME: DM_LATEST_SALES_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : DM_LATEST_SALES_V
 * Description  : 매출실적 Query
 * Program History
 *==============================================================================================================================
 *  DATE        IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
 *==============================================================================================================================
 * 2024.05.03  Philsu Park         Initial Release. - SQL작성
 * 2024.05.03  HMIN                VIEW생성  [E20240422-000076]_데이터 AWS 전송 데이터 추가 건(DM 실적)
 * 2025.03.11  JSSBAE              [E20250305-000530]_View table 컬럼 추가 요청의 건(project_code, plant_site, sold_to_code 칼럼 추가)
 * 2026.07.06  ZIONEX              [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
       FINAL_DATA.DIVISION_ID    AS DIVISION_ID
     , FINAL_DATA.MODEL_CODE     AS MODEL_CODE
     , FINAL_DATA.END_CUSTOMER   AS END_CUSTOMER
     , FINAL_DATA.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER AS SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
     , FINAL_DATA.SCM_SITE_ID    AS SCM_SITE_ID    /* [E20240227-000623] */
     , FINAL_DATA.PRODUCT_LEVEL1 AS PRODUCT_LEVEL1
     , FINAL_DATA.ITEM_ID        AS ITEM_ID
     , FINAL_DATA.NICK_NAME      AS NICK_NAME      /* [E20240227-000623] */
     , FINAL_DATA.FCST_TYPE      AS FCST_TYPE      /* [E20240227-000623] */
     , FINAL_DATA.INCOTERMS      AS INCOTERMS      /* [E20240227-000623] */
     , FINAL_DATA.YYYYMM         AS YYYYMM
     , FINAL_DATA.ISO_YYYYWW     AS ISO_YYYYWW
     , FINAL_DATA.RESULT_QTY     AS RESULT_QTY
     , FINAL_DATA.PROJECT_CODE   AS PROJECT_CODE   /* [E20250305-000530]_project_code 추가 */
     , FINAL_DATA.SOLDTO_CODE    AS SOLDTO_CODE    /* [E20250305-000530]_sold_to_code 추가 */
     , FINAL_DATA.PLANT_SITE_ID  AS PLANT_SITE_ID  /* [E20250305-000530]_plant_site 추가 */
  FROM (
        SELECT ALL_DATA.*
             , TB.END_CUSTOMER
             , TB.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
             , TB.VMI_YN
             , TC.BIZ_TYPE_NAME   AS "BIZ.TYPE"
             , TC.PROJECT_NAME
             , TC.PROJECT_STATUS
             , TC.PROJECT_OWNER   AS PROJECT_OWNER
             , TD.OWNER_NAME      AS OWNER
             , TD.CELL_PER_CAR    AS CELL_PER_CAR
             , TD.CELL_PER_MODULE AS CELL_PER_MODULE
             , CASE WHEN TD.CELL_PER_MODULE <> 0 THEN TD.CELL_PER_CAR / TD.CELL_PER_MODULE ELSE 0 END AS MODULE_PER_CAR
             , TD.SALES_COMPANY
             , TD.ATTRIBUTE8      AS KWH_CELL
             , CASE WHEN ALL_DATA.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' AND TD.CELL_PER_MODULE > 0 AND TD.ATTRIBUTE8 IS NOT NULL
                    THEN CAST((TD.CELL_PER_MODULE * TD.ATTRIBUTE8) AS FLOAT)
                    ELSE NULL END AS KWH_MODULE
             , CASE WHEN ALL_DATA.DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' AND TD.CELL_PER_CAR > 0 AND TD.ATTRIBUTE8 IS NOT NULL
                    THEN CAST((TD.CELL_PER_CAR * TD.ATTRIBUTE8) AS FLOAT)
                    ELSE NULL END AS KWH_PACK
             , J.COUNTRY_NAME     AS COUNTRY
             , H.CITY_NAME        AS CITY
             , L.SOLDTO_CODE      AS SOLDTO_CODE
             , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ALL_DATA.DIVISION_ID, 1, 2) = '81' OR ALL_DATA.DIVISION_ID = '82' THEN SCP_INFO.GROUP_CODE6
                    ELSE SCP_INFO.CELL_TYPE_GROUP_NAME END AS PRODUCT_LEVEL1
             , SUBSTR(ALL_DATA.ITEM_ID, 1, 12) AS MODEL_CODE  /* SUFFIX 제거 */
             , MST_ITEM_SN.NICK_NAME  /* [E20240227-000623] */
          FROM (
                SELECT DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, SUBSTR(YYYYMMDD, 1, 6) AS YYYYMM, ISO_YYYYWW, WEEK_NAME
                     , SUM(RESULT_QTY)   AS RESULT_QTY
                     , PLANT_SITE_ID  /* [E20250305-000530]_plant_site 추가 */
                  FROM (
                        SELECT TA.DIVISION_ID, TA.SCM_SITE_ID, TA.PROJECT_CODE, TA.ITEM_ID, TA.INCOTERMS, TA.DOM_EXP, TA.FCST_TYPE, TA.MEASURE, TA.YYYYMMDD
                             , CALENDAR.ISO_YYYYWW
                             , CALENDAR.ISO_WEEK
                             , CALENDAR.WEEK_NAME
                             , RESULT_QTY
                             , TA.PLANT_SITE_ID  /* [E20250305-000530]_plant_site 추가 */
                          FROM (
                                SELECT TA.DIVISION_ID, TA.SCM_SITE_ID, TA.PROJECT_CODE, TA.ITEM_ID, TA.DOM_EXP, TA.FCST_TYPE, TA.INCOTERMS, TA.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                     , TA.YYYYMMDD
                                     , TA.MEASURE
                                     , SUM(QTY) AS RESULT_QTY
                                  FROM DM_PLN_MKT_FCST_RESULT TA
                                 WHERE MEASURE = 'RTF_SYS_RP'
                                   AND QTY <> 0
                                 GROUP BY TA.DIVISION_ID, TA.SCM_SITE_ID, TA.PROJECT_CODE, TA.ITEM_ID, TA.DOM_EXP, TA.FCST_TYPE, TA.INCOTERMS, TA.PLANT_SITE_ID
                                        , TA.YYYYMMDD
                                        , TA.MEASURE
                               ) TA
                             , (
                                SELECT A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD, A.ISO_YYYYWW, A.ISO_WEEK, A.WEEK_NAME, A.BASIS_START_DATE, A.BASIS_END_DATE, A.MONTH_NAME
                                  FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
                                 WHERE 1 = 1
                                   AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= '20190101'  /* 디폴트 구간 설정해서 줄이기! */
                               ) CALENDAR
                         WHERE 1 = 1
                           AND CALENDAR.BASIS_YYYYMMDD = TA.YYYYMMDD
                       ) T
                 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, INCOTERMS, DOM_EXP, FCST_TYPE, SUBSTR(YYYYMMDD, 1, 6), ISO_YYYYWW, WEEK_NAME
                        , PLANT_SITE_ID  /* [E20250305-000530]_plant_site 추가 */
               ) ALL_DATA
             , (   /* SCM_MST_SITE 정보 : END_CUSTOMER, VMI_YN */
--              SELECT B.DIVISION_ID, B.SCM_SITE_ID, B.SITE_TYPE, B.DEPT_ID, B.VALID_YN, B.END_CUSTOMER
                SELECT B.DIVISION_ID, B.SCM_SITE_ID, B.SITE_TYPE, B.VALID_YN, B.END_CUSTOMER            -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                     , B.COUNTRY, B.CITY, B.VMI_YN, B.SOLDTO_CUSTOMER
                  FROM SCM_MST_SITE B
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND NVL(B.VALID_YN, ' ') = 'Y'
               ) TB
             , (   /* SCM_MST_PROJECT 정보, 소형은 Pjt 단위 관리 안하기 때문에 Outer 처리. */
                SELECT C.DIVISION_ID, C.PROJECT_CODE, C.PROJECT_NAME, C.BIZ_TYPE, C.BIZ_TYPE_NAME, C.PROJECT_STATUS, C.PROJECT_OWNER
                  FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT C
                 WHERE 1 = 1
               ) TC
             , (
                SELECT D.DIVISION_ID, D.PROJECT_CODE, D.SCM_SITE_ID, D.ITEM_ID, D.VALID_YN
                     , D.CUST_GROUP
                     , D.CUST_GROUP_DTL
                     , D.APPLICATION
                     , D.ROUTE
                     , D.ATTRIBUTE5
                     , D.CELL_PER_CAR
                     , D.CELL_PER_MODULE
                     , D.ATTRIBUTE7
                     , D.ATTRIBUTE1
                     , D.ATTRIBUTE2
                     , D.REPORT_GROUP6
                     , D.SALES_COMPANY
                     , D.ATTRIBUTE8
--                   , (SELECT SU.DEPT_ID
--                        FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO SU
--                       WHERE SU.USER_ID = REGEXP_SUBSTR(D.OWNER, '[^,]+', 1, 1)) DEPT_ID
                     , D.DEPT_ID                                                        -- 2026.09.03 AJS
                     , FN_GET_DM_MKT_OWNER_NAME(D.OWNER, ',', 'EN')     AS OWNER_NAME
                     , FN_GET_DM_MKT_OWNER_NAME(D.OWNER, ',', 'KO')     AS OWNER_NAME_KO
                  FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM D
                 WHERE 1 = 1
               ) TD
             , SCM_MST_CITY H
             , SCM_MST_COUNTRY J
             , SCM_MST_SITE_CUSTOMER K
             , SCM_MST_CUSTOMER L
             , (
                SELECT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID
                     , CELL_NICKNAME
                     , BASIC_NICKNAME_CELL40
                     , NICKNAME_40
                     , GROUP_CODE1
                     , GROUP_CODE4
                     , GROUP_CODE5
                     , GROUP_CODE6
                     , GROUP_CODE7
                     , CELL_TYPE_GROUP_NAME
                  FROM (
                        SELECT SCP_P.DIVISION_ID
                             , SCP_P.ITEM_ID
                             , SCP_P.CELL_NICKNAME
                             , SCP_P.BASIC_NICKNAME_CELL40
                             , SCP_P.NICKNAME_40
                             , SCP_P.GROUP_CODE1
                             , SCP_P.GROUP_CODE4
                             , SCP_P.GROUP_CODE5
                             , SCP_P.GROUP_CODE6
                             , SCP_P.GROUP_CODE7
                             , CASE WHEN SCP_P.LEVEL_EXCEPT = 'EC' THEN 'POUCH'
                                    WHEN SCP_P.LEVEL_EXCEPT = 'AM' THEN 'CYLINDRICAL'
                                    WHEN SUBSTR(SCP_P.ITEM_ID, 3, 1) = 'M' AND SCP_P.OPERATION_ID = 'P9500' THEN 'POUCH'
                                    ELSE SCP_G.CELL_TYPE_GROUP_NAME END AS CELL_TYPE_GROUP_NAME
                          FROM (
                                SELECT DIVISION_ID
                                     , FLOW_ID                    AS OPERATION_ID
                                     , ITEM_ID
                                     , SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 3, 1)    AS CELL_TYPE_CODE
                                     , SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 2)    AS LEVEL_EXCEPT  /* 예외적용 */
                                     , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(A.DIVISION_ID, 1, 2) = '81' THEN GROUP_CODE1
                                            WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '82'              THEN LEVEL2_CODE
                                            ELSE '' END AS CELL_NICKNAME
                                     , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) = 'EC' THEN 'ESS'
                                            WHEN SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 2) = 'AM' THEN 'M50L'
                                            ELSE CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P'
                                                      THEN (SELECT NICK_NAME
                                                              FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM B
                                                             WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                               AND B.ITEM_ID = (SELECT DOE
                                                                                  FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN B
                                                                                 WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID AND B.ITEM_ID = A.ATTRIBUTE1 AND B.DOE IS NOT NULL AND ROWNUM = 1))
                                                      ELSE (SELECT NICK_NAME
                                                              FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM B
                                                             WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                               AND B.ITEM_ID = (SELECT DOE
                                                                                  FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN B
                                                                                 WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID AND B.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID AND B.DOE IS NOT NULL AND ROWNUM = 1))
                                                      END
                                            END  AS BASIC_NICKNAME_CELL40
                                     , A.NICK_NAME  AS NICKNAME_40
                                     , A.GROUP_CODE4
                                     , A.GROUP_CODE5
                                     , A.GROUP_CODE6
                                     , A.GROUP_CODE7
                                     , A.GROUP_CODE1
                                     , CASE WHEN A.FLOW_ID IN ('A3000', 'A9000') THEN 'C' ELSE 'E' END  AS FLOW_TYPE
                                  FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM A
                                 WHERE 1 = 1
                                   AND (SUBSTR(A.ATTRIBUTE8, 1, 2) <> 'CA' OR A.ATTRIBUTE8 IS NULL)  /* 활성화코드 분리 */
                               ) SCP_P
                             , (
                                SELECT A.CODE                  AS CELL_TYPE_CODE
                                     , SUBSTR(A.NAME, 1, 1)    AS FLOW_TYPE
                                     , A.GROUP_CODE            AS CELL_TYPE_GROUP_CODE
                                     , G.NAME                  AS CELL_TYPE_GROUP_NAME
                                     , A.DISPLAY_SEQ
                                  FROM (
                                        SELECT B.SEGMENT1 CODE
                                             , B.SEGMENT2 NAME
                                             , B.SEGMENT3 GROUP_CODE
                                             , B.DISPLAY_SEQ
                                          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A
                                             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                                         WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE
                                           AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                           AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CELL_TYPE_ITEM_CODE'
                                           AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                       ) A
                                     , (
                                        SELECT B.SEGMENT1 CODE
                                             , B.SEGMENT2 NAME
                                          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A
                                             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                                         WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE
                                           AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                           AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CELL_TYPE_ITEM_GROUP'
                                           AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                       ) G
                                 WHERE A.GROUP_CODE = G.CODE
                               ) SCP_G
                         WHERE SCP_G.FLOW_TYPE(+) = SCP_P.FLOW_TYPE
                           AND SCP_G.CELL_TYPE_CODE(+) = SCP_P.CELL_TYPE_CODE
                       )  T
               ) SCP_INFO
             , (   /* SSPM T_SINGLE 참고 */
                SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID
                     , T1.ITEM_ID
                     , MAX(T1.ITEM_NAME)                 AS ITEM_NAME
                     , CASE  MIN(CASE WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE = 'P' THEN 1
                                      WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE = 'H' THEN 2
                                      WHEN T1.ITEM_TYPE = 'Q' THEN 3
                                      ELSE 4 END)
                             WHEN 1 THEN 'P'
                             WHEN 2 THEN 'H'
                             WHEN 3 THEN 'Q'
                             ELSE 'R' END    AS ITEM_TYPE
                     , MAX(T1.ITEM_CLASS_NAME)           AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME
                     , MAX(T1.NICK_NAME)                 AS NICK_NAME
                  FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T1
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                 GROUP BY T1.DIVISION_ID, T1.ITEM_ID
               ) MST_ITEM_SN
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND ALL_DATA.DIVISION_ID = TB.DIVISION_ID
           AND ALL_DATA.SCM_SITE_ID = TB.SCM_SITE_ID    /* 18 */
           AND ALL_DATA.DIVISION_ID = TC.DIVISION_ID(+)
           AND ALL_DATA.PROJECT_CODE = TC.PROJECT_CODE(+)
           AND ALL_DATA.DIVISION_ID = TD.DIVISION_ID(+)
           AND ALL_DATA.PROJECT_CODE = TD.PROJECT_CODE(+)
           AND ALL_DATA.SCM_SITE_ID = TD.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
           AND ALL_DATA.ITEM_ID = TD.ITEM_ID(+)
           AND H.CITY(+) = TB.CITY
           AND J.COUNTRY(+) = TB.COUNTRY
           AND K.DIVISION_ID(+) = TB.DIVISION_ID
           AND K.SCM_SITE_ID(+) = TB.SCM_SITE_ID
           AND K.REP_YN(+) = 'Y'
           AND L.DIVISION_ID(+) = K.DIVISION_ID
           AND L.SHIPTO_CODE(+) = K.SHIPTO_CODE
           AND L.SOLDTO_CODE(+) = K.SOLDTO_CODE
           AND SCP_INFO.DIVISION_ID(+) = ALL_DATA.DIVISION_ID
           AND SCP_INFO.ITEM_ID(+) = ALL_DATA.ITEM_ID
           AND MST_ITEM_SN.DIVISION_ID(+) = ALL_DATA.DIVISION_ID
           AND MST_ITEM_SN.ITEM_ID(+) = ALL_DATA.ITEM_ID
       ) FINAL_DATA
 WHERE 1 = 1

NAME: DM_PLN_SHIPMENT_REQ_DW_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : DM_PLN_SHIPMENT_REQ_DW_V
 * Description  : DM_PLN_SHIPMENT_REQ 조회
                  소속 DIVISION_ID로 정보를 조회 하기 위해서
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2022.04.01   SSP Pjt.       Created

 */
 D.ATTRIBUTE3     AS DIVISION_ID
          ,S.PROJECT_CODE
          ,S.SCM_SITE_ID
          ,S.ITEM_ID
          ,S.FCST_TYPE
          ,S.INCOTERMS
          ,S.TRANSPORT_MODE
          ,S.BOD_ID
          ,S.MEASURE
          ,S.PLANT_SITE_ID
          ,S.SITE_TYPE
          ,S.YYYYMMDD
          ,S.QTY
          ,S.CREATED_BY
          ,S.CREATION_DATE
          ,S.LAST_UPDATED_BY
          ,S.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
          ,S.ATTRIBUTE1
          ,S.ATTRIBUTE2
          ,S.ATTRIBUTE3
          ,S.ATTRIBUTE4
          ,S.ATTRIBUTE5
          ,S.ATTRIBUTE6
          ,S.ATTRIBUTE7
          ,S.ATTRIBUTE8
          ,S.ATTRIBUTE9
          ,S.ATTRIBUTE10
          ,S.DIVISION_ID    AS SCM_DIVISION_ID
      FROM DM_PLN_SHIPMENT_REQ S
           JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D
        ON S.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID

NAME: IF_DM_ANL_KPI_RTF_SALES_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : IF_DM_ANL_KPI_RTF_SALES_V
 * Description  : KPI VIEW  : DW용
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2022.05.03   HWI1993 Initial Release : PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : GM JV
 *
 * 2026.07.05   ZIONEX   [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
 CASE WHEN DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN '81' ELSE DIVISION_ID END AS DIVISION_ID
     , ITEM_ID
     , FCST_TYPE
     , YYYYMM
     , MEASURE
     , QTY

     , DIVISION_ID AS SCM_DIVISION_ID

NAME: IF_DM_ANL_KPI_SALES_ACCURACY_V
TEXT:
SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : IF_DM_ANL_KPI_SALES_ACCURACY_V
 * Description  : KPI VIEW  : DW용
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2022.05.03   HWI1993 Initial Release : PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : GM JV
 *
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX   [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
       WORK_YYYYMMDD
     , CASE WHEN DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' THEN '81' ELSE DIVISION_ID END AS DIVISION_ID
     , DEPT_ID
     , DOE
     , BASIC_NICK_NAME
     , GROUP_TYPE
     , ITEM_CLASS_NAME
     , SCM_PIC
     , ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
     , RESULT_QTY_CELL
     , PLAN_QTY_CELL
     , CREATED_BY
     , KPI_RATE
     , ATTRIBUTE1
     , YYYYMM
     , ATTRIBUTE4
     , PROJECT_CODE
     , WEIGHT
     , SCM_SITE_ID
     , RESULT_QTY
     , ATTRIBUTE10
     , ITEM_ID
     , CREATION_DATE
     , ATTRIBUTE8
     , FCST_TYPE
     , MEASURE
     , ATTRIBUTE9
     , ATTRIBUTE3
     , LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , ATTRIBUTE6
     , LAST_UPDATE_DATE
     , ATTRIBUTE7
     , ATTRIBUTE5
     , END_CUSTOMER

    ON A.CELL_PROD_SITE = LK1.SEGMENT1
   AND LK1.LOOKUP_TYPE IN ('DM_CELL_PROD_SITE', 'SP_CELL_PROD_SITE')
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_CLASS, A.ITEM_NAME, A.ITEM_CLASS_NAME, A.NICK_NAME, A.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE, A.ENERGE
               FROM (SELECT T1.DIVISION_ID
                          , T1.ITEM_ID
                          , MAX(T1.ITEM_NAME)             AS ITEM_NAME
                          , MAX(T1.ITEM_CLASS)            AS ITEM_CLASS
                          , MAX(T1.ITEM_CLASS_NAME)       AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME
                          , MAX(T1.NICK_NAME)             AS NICK_NAME
                          , MAX(T2.FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE) AS FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE
                          , MAX(T1.ENERGE)                AS ENERGE
                       FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T1
                       INNER JOIN (SELECT DIVISION_ID, SUBSTR(ITEM_ID, 1, 12) AS ITEM_ID
                                        , MAX(FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE) AS FORECAST_INFO_BIZ_TYPE
                                     FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T2
                                    GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, SUBSTR(ITEM_ID, 1, 12)) T2
                          ON T1.DIVISION_ID = T2.DIVISION_ID
                         AND SUBSTR(T1.ITEM_ID, 1, 12) = T2.ITEM_ID
                      WHERE 1 = 1
                      GROUP BY T1.DIVISION_ID, T1.ITEM_ID) A) SINGLE
    ON A.DIVISION_ID = SINGLE.DIVISION_ID
   AND A.ITEM_ID = SINGLE.ITEM_ID

NAME: IF_DM_PROJECT_DEPT_V
TEXT:
SELECT /*=====================================================================================================
 * PROJECT       : LGES SCM Customer Demand Analysis
 * VIEW NAME     : DM_PROJECT_DEPT_V
 * DESCRIPTION   : Power BI 제공용: SSPM의 Division, Project 별 담당, 거래선 정보
 * PROGRAM HISTORY
 *=====================================================================================================
 *  DATE        IN CHARGE			DESCRIPTION
 *=====================================================================================================
 * 2025.01.22	Philsu Park         Initial Release.
 * 2025.02.17   Philsu Park         표준 Report 요청: DEPT_ID, PJT_NAME 추가.
===================================================================================================== */  MM.DIVISION_ID
     , MM.PROJECT_CODE
     , PJT.PROJECT_NAME AS PJT_NAME
     , DPT.DEPT_ID
     , MM.DEPARTMENT_NAME
     , MM.REPORT_CUSTOMER_NAME
  FROM (SELECT STM.DIVISION_ID       AS DIVISION_ID
             , STM.PROJECT_CODE      AS PROJECT_CODE
             , MAX(STM.CRGE_ORG_NM)  AS DEPARTMENT_NAME
             , MAX(STM.CUST_ENG_NM)  AS REPORT_CUSTOMER_NAME
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM STM
         WHERE TRIM(STM.CRGE_ORG_NM) IS NOT NULL
           AND STM.VALID_YN = 'Y'
         GROUP BY STM.DIVISION_ID
                , STM.PROJECT_CODE) MM
     , (SELECT DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, MAX(PROJECT_NAME) AS PROJECT_NAME
          FROM SCM_MST_PROJECT
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE) PJT
     , (SELECT SEGMENT1 AS DEPT_ID
             , SEGMENT2 AS DEPT_NAME
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DM_ORG_NAME_DEPT_LIST'
           AND VALID_YN    = 'Y') DPT
 WHERE MM.DIVISION_ID     = PJT.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND MM.PROJECT_CODE    = PJT.PROJECT_CODE(+)
   AND MM.DEPARTMENT_NAME = DPT.DEPT_NAME(+)
   AND 1=1

 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2025.05.07   김준규         Initial Release : NERP_CONV 대상중 DM 처리 항목별 테이블 이름
 * 2025.05.25   김준규         NERP) 컨버전 프로시저 컬럼 추가
 *
 * 2026.07.05   ZIONEX   [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
 DISTINCT 1 AS SORT_SEQ
       , 'LOOKUP'   AS RTYPE
       , 'SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL' AS TABLE_NAME
       , 'PR_TMP_NERP_LOOKUP_CONVERTER_UPDATE_DM' AS CONV_PR_NAME
    FROM DUAL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT 2 AS SORT_SEQ
       , 'CODE_LOOKUP'   AS RTYPE
       , 'SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE' AS TABLE_NAME
       , 'PR_TMP_NERP_LOOKUP_CODE_CONVERTER_UPDATE_DM' AS CONV_PR_NAME
    FROM DUAL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT 3 AS SORT_SEQ
       , 'TABLES'   AS RTYPE
       , TABLE_NAME AS TABLE_NAME
       , 'PR_TMP_NERP_COLUMN_CONVERTER_UPDATE_DM' AS CONV_PR_NAME
    FROM ZNERP_TARGET_INFO_DM
   WHERE CONVERSION_FLAG <> '-'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT 4 AS SORT_SEQ
       , 'CUTOFF_MASTER' AS RTYPE
       , M.TABLE_NAME AS TABLE_NAME
       , 'PR_TMP_NERP_COLUMN_CONVERTER_UPDATE_DM_BIG' AS CONV_PR_NAME
    FROM NERP_CONV_DM_CUTOFF_MASTER M
   WHERE M.MAPPING_USE = 'Y'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT 5 AS SORT_SEQ
       , 'LOOKUP_TYPE' AS RTYPE
       , LID.LOOKUP_TYPE AS TABLE_NAME
       , 'PR_TMP_NERP_LOOKUP_CONVERTER_UPDATE_DM' AS CONV_PR_NAME
    FROM ZNERP_LOOKUP_INFO_DM LID
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT 6 AS SORT_SEQ
       , 'CODE_LOOKUP_TYPE' AS RTYPE
       , LID.LOOKUP_TYPE AS TABLE_NAME
       , 'PR_TMP_NERP_LOOKUP_CODE_CONVERTER_UPDATE_DM' AS CONV_PR_NAME
    FROM ZNERP_LOOKUP_CODE_INFO_DM LID
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND LID.LOOKUP_VALID_YN = 'Y'

NAME: NERP_CONV_MASTER_MERGED_CFM_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : NERP_CONV_MASTER_MERGED_CFM_V
 * Description  : NERP_CONV ROLLIN별 MERGE되는 CODETYPE별 매핑확정 이름
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2025.04.14   김준규         Initial Release : NERP_CONV ROLLIN별 MERGE되는 CODETYPE별 매핑확정 이름
 *
 * 2026.07.05   ZIONEX   [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
 CODETYPE
     , LISTAGG(OLD_VALUE1, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY OLD_VALUE1) AS OLD_VALUE1
     , OLD_VALUE2
     , NEW_VALUE1
     , NEW_VALUE2
     , ATTRIBUTE5
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CODETYPE
                      , OLD_VALUE1
                      , OLD_VALUE2
                      , NEW_VALUE1
                      , NEW_VALUE2
                      , ATTRIBUTE5
          FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER_CFM_V
         WHERE CODETYPE <> 'STORAGE_ID') X
 GROUP BY CODETYPE
        , OLD_VALUE2
        , NEW_VALUE1
        , NEW_VALUE2
        , ATTRIBUTE5
 UNION ALL
SELECT CODETYPE
     , LISTAGG(OLD_VALUE1, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY OLD_VALUE1) AS OLD_VALUE1
     , LISTAGG(OLD_VALUE2, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY OLD_VALUE2) AS OLD_VALUE2
     , NEW_VALUE1
     , NEW_VALUE2

  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CODETYPE
                      , OLD_VALUE1
                      , OLD_VALUE2
                      , NEW_VALUE1
                      , NEW_VALUE2
                      , ATTRIBUTE5
          FROM NERP_CONV_MASTER_CFM_V
         WHERE CODETYPE = 'STORAGE_ID') X
 GROUP BY CODETYPE
        , NEW_VALUE1
        , NEW_VALUE2
        , ATTRIBUTE5

SELECT
/* ============================================================
 * Program ID   : NERP_CONV_OLD_NEW_REF_V

 * Program History
 *------------------------------------------------------------
 * Date          In Charge      Description
 *------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2025.03.31    김준규         Initial Release : NERP_CONV_MASTER 중 매핑확정 NEW_VALUE1 UNIQUE 기준 OLD_VALUE1 값 참조
 * 2025.06.05    김준규         'PLANT_ID,SCP_SITE_ID 강제 매핑확정
 * 2025.06.09    김준규         'PLANT_ID,SCP_SITE_ID 강제 매핑확정 제외처리(별도 테이블에 바로 UPDATE 처리:프로그램 로직에 들어가면 안됨)
 * 2025.07.21    김준규         PLANT_ID "공통"도 매핑확정 처리
 * 2025.10.20    김준규         ROLLIN 4차 25년12월과 ROLLIN 4차 26년1월을 1개로 ROLLIN차수로 합친 것을 4N5로 하고 매핑확정 만 나오도록 처리
 * 2025.10.31    김준규         DM ROLLIN 5차 4N5차에 SCM_DNM_STOCK_SALES 테이블 STORAGE_NAME 필요하여 컬럼 추가

 * 2026.07.06    ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 * ============================================================ */

     , NEW_VALUE2
     , LISTAGG(OLD_VALUE1, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY OLD_VALUE1) AS OLD_VALUE1
     , LISTAGG(OLD_VALUE2, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY OLD_VALUE2) AS OLD_VALUE2

                SELECT NCM.CODETYPE

                     , NCM.OLD_VALUE4
                     , NCM.NEW_VALUE1

NAME: SCM_ADM_DEPT_CHANGED_V
TEXT:
SELECT SU.USER_ID
	     , MAX(SU.USER_NAME) AS USER_NAME
	     , GRP.USER_GR_ID AS GROUP_ID
	     , AUTH.UNIT_ID   AS DIVISION_ID
	     , 'APPROVED'     AS APPROVAL_RESULT
	     , MAX(AUTH.LAST_UPDATED_BY) AS APPROVAL_ID
	     , MAX(SU2.USER_NAME)        AS APPROVAL_NAME
	     , TO_CHAR(MAX(AUTH.LAST_UPDATE_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS APPROVED_DATE
	     , TRUNC(MAX(TO_DATE(SU.ATTRIBUTE9, 'YYYYMMDD')) + 15) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS REMAIN_DAYS
	     , TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(MAX(TO_DATE(SU.ATTRIBUTE9, 'YYYYMMDD'))) AS ELAPSED_DAYS
	     , MAX(SU.ACTIVE_FLAG) AS ACTIVE_FLG
	  FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M U
	       JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO SU
	         ON U.USER_ID = SU.USER_ID
           JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_MPG_M          GRP   -- 그룹-사용자 매핑
             ON U.USER_ID = GRP.USER_ID
           JOIN SCM_MGR.SCM_ADM_USER_GR_UNIT_AUTH_MPG_M  AUTH  -- 그룹-조직 권한
             ON AUTH.USER_GR_ID = GRP.USER_GR_ID
            AND AUTH.USER_ID    = GRP.USER_ID
	       LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO SU2
	         ON AUTH.LAST_UPDATED_BY = SU2.USER_ID
	       JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
             ON GRP.USER_GR_ID = LK.SEGMENT1
            AND LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DEPT_CHANGED_AUTH_DELETE'
           --AND LK.SEGMENT2    = 'N'  --SCM, 조건 제거. SCM,FP 권한 체계 통합에 따른 조건 제거
            AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
	 WHERE 1 = 1
	   AND SU.DEPT_ID <> CASE WHEN NVL(SU.ATTRIBUTE10, '') = '' OR SU.ATTRIBUTE10 IS NULL THEN SU.DEPT_ID ELSE SU.ATTRIBUTE10 END
	   AND REGEXP_LIKE(SU.DEPT_ID, '^[0-9]+$')
	   AND AUTH.LAST_UPDATE_DATE < TO_DATE(SU.ATTRIBUTE9, 'YYYYMMDD')
	   AND SU.ACTIVE_FLAG != 'D'
	   AND U.USE_YN        = 'Y'
       AND GRP.USE_YN      = 'Y'
       AND AUTH.USE_YN     = 'Y'
       AND AUTH.UNIT_TP_CD = 'D'
	 GROUP BY SU.USER_ID, GRP.USER_GR_ID, AUTH.UNIT_ID
	 /* Next SCM 에서는 FP 권한 체계를 SCM과 통합하여 주석 처리함
     UNION ALL
	SELECT SU.USER_ID
	     , SU.USER_NAME
	     , UG.GROUPID AS GROUP_ID
	     , UGA.CODE AS DIVISION_ID
	     , 'APPROVED' AS APPROVAL_RESULT
	     , UGA.UPDATEUSERID AS APPROVAL_ID
	     , SU2.USER_NAME AS APPROVAL_NAME
	     , TO_CHAR(FP.UPDATEDATETIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS APPROVED_DATE
	     , TRUNC(SU.ATTRIBUTE9 + 15) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS REMAIN_DAYS
	     , TRUNC(SYSDATE) - TRUNC(SU.ATTRIBUTE9) AS ELAPSED_DAYS
	     , SU.ACTIVE_FLAG
	  FROM SCM_ADM_USER_M U
	       JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO SU
	    ON U.USER_ID = SU.USER_ID
	       JOIN SCM_ADM_USER_GR_M UG
	    ON U.USER_ID = UG.USERID
	       JOIN TB_FX_USERGROUPAUTHEXTENTION UGA
	    ON UG.USERID = UGA.USERID AND UG.GROUPID = UGA.GROUPID
	       LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO SU2
	    ON UGA.UPDATEUSERID = SU2.USER_ID
	       JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
	    ON UG.GROUPID = LK.SEGMENT1
	   AND LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'DEPT_CHANGED_AUTH_DELETE'
	   AND LK.SEGMENT2    = 'Y'  --FP
	   AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
	       JOIN (SELECT UIR.USER_ID AS USERID
	                  , CASE WHEN UIR.SAVE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'FP Planner' ELSE 'FP Viewer' END AS GroupID
	                  , RIR.DIVISION_ID AS Code
	                  , MAX(NVL(UIR.UPDATE_DTTM, UIR.INSERT_DTTM)) AS UPDATEDATETIME
	               FROM TH_UIS_USER_INSTANCE_RELATE_SN UIR
	                    JOIN TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE_SN RI
	                 ON UIR.ROLE_ID     = RI.ROLE_ID
	                    JOIN TH_UIS_ROLE_INSTANCE_RELATE_SN RIR
	                 ON RIR.ROLE_ID     = RI.ROLE_ID
	              WHERE 1 = 1
	                AND UIR.USE_AT_FLAG = 'Y'
	                AND RIR.USE_AT_FLAG = 'Y'
	                AND UIR.SAVE_FLAG   = 'Y' --FP Planner
	              GROUP BY
	                    UIR.USER_ID, UIR.SAVE_FLAG, RIR.DIVISION_ID
	            ) FP
	    ON UGA.USERID  = FP.USERID
	   AND UGA.GROUPID = FP.GROUPID
	   AND UGA.CODE    = FP.CODE
	 WHERE 1 = 1
	   AND SU.DEPT_ID <> CASE WHEN NVL(SU.ATTRIBUTE10, '') = '' OR SU.ATTRIBUTE10 IS NULL THEN SU.DEPT_ID ELSE SU.ATTRIBUTE10 END
	   AND REGEXP_LIKE(SU.DEPT_ID, '^[0-9]+$')
	   AND FP.UPDATEDATETIME < TO_DATE(SU.ATTRIBUTE9, 'YYYYMMDD')
	   AND SU.ACTIVE_FLAG != 'D'
	   AND U.USEYN         = 'Y'
	   AND UG.USEYN        = 'Y'*/
 --    ) AS V
