NAME: SCM_DNM_GTS_ETA_V
TEXT:
SELECT A.COMPANY_ID  /* 20181204 company_id 추가 */
     , A.SHIPMENT_NO
     , A.INCOTERMS
     , A.SHIPPING_DATE
     , A.POL
     , A.POL_ATD_DATE
     , A.POD
     , A.POD_ETA_DATE
     , A.POD_ATA_DATE
     , A.POD_ETD_DATE
     , A.POD_ATD_DATE
     , A.F_DEST_PORT_CODE
     , A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE
     , A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE
       /* SCM_DNM_GTS_ETA_V 사용하는 곳에서 해당 정보의 Incoterms 기준으로 아래와 같은 로직으로 추가 처리되고 있음 */
     , CASE WHEN B.SEGMENT3 IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE IS NULL THEN A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE ELSE A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE END
            WHEN B.SEGMENT3 = 'A'   THEN ''
            WHEN B.SEGMENT3 = 'B'   THEN A.SHIPPING_DATE
            /* 'C' : 1 순위 - pol_atd_date , 2순위 - shipping_date */
            WHEN B.SEGMENT3 = 'C'   THEN CASE WHEN A.POL_ATD_DATE IS NULL THEN A.SHIPPING_DATE ELSE A.POL_ATD_DATE END
            /* 'D/E/F' : 1 순위 - f_dest_ata_date , 2순위 - f_dest_eta_date */
            WHEN B.SEGMENT3 = 'D'   THEN CASE WHEN A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE IS NULL THEN A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE ELSE A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE END
            WHEN B.SEGMENT3 = 'E'   THEN CASE WHEN A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE IS NULL THEN A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE ELSE A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE END
            WHEN B.SEGMENT3 = 'F'   THEN CASE WHEN A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE IS NULL THEN A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE ELSE A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE END
            ELSE CASE WHEN A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE IS NULL THEN A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE ELSE A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE END
       END AS F_DEST_ETA_DATE_SALES
  FROM ( SELECT A.COMPANY_ID  /* 20181204 company_id 추가 */
              , A.SHIPMENT_NO
              , A.INCOTERMS
              , MAX(A.SHIPPING_DATE)     SHIPPING_DATE
              , MAX(A.POL)               POL
              , MAX(A.POL_ATD_DATE)      POL_ATD_DATE
              , MAX(A.POD)               POD
              , MAX(A.POD_ETA_DATE)      POD_ETA_DATE
              , MAX(A.POD_ATA_DATE)      POD_ATA_DATE
              , MAX(A.POD_ETD_DATE)      POD_ETD_DATE
              , MAX(A.POD_ATD_DATE)      POD_ATD_DATE
              , MAX(A.F_DEST_PORT_CODE)  F_DEST_PORT_CODE
              , MAX(A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE)   F_DEST_ETA_DATE
              , MAX(A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE)   F_DEST_ATA_DATE
           FROM SCM_DNM_DELIVERY_TRACKING A
              , ( SELECT COMPANY_ID
                       , SHIPMENT_NO
                       , MAX(INCOTERMS) AS INCOTERMS
                    FROM SCM_DNM_DELIVERY_TRACKING
                   GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, SHIPMENT_NO  /* 20181204 company_id 추가 */
                ) B
          WHERE A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID
            AND A.SHIPMENT_NO = B.SHIPMENT_NO
            AND A.INCOTERMS   = B.INCOTERMS
          /* WHERE  len(t.pol_atd_date) > 0 -- ERP 와 같은 조건 처리(SAP 화면에서도 해당 데이터는 보이지 않음) -- 20210122 Delete */
          GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.SHIPMENT_NO, A.INCOTERMS  /* 20181204 company_id 추가 */
       ) A
     , ( SELECT *
           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
          WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'INCOTERMS'
            AND VALID_YN    = 'Y'
       ) B
 WHERE A.INCOTERMS = B.SEGMENT1(+)

NAME: SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_FP_V
TEXT:
SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_FP_V
 * Description  : 해상재고 정보 : FP용
                  * 운송중 재고 정보 : ERP Intransit 전체 / 공장(PLANT) 도착 확인용

 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2020.07.21   KSG            Initial Release : C20200715-000034 [요청]운송중 재고 데이터 생성 요청의 건
 * 2020.10.06   KSG            PJ20202001 LG화학 전지. 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 SCM 관리 체계 개선 : ERP
 *                                추가 컬럼 정보 생성 FINAL_SOLDTO_CODE / FINAL_INCOTERMS
 * 2021.01.29   KSG            C20210128-000556 [SCM PI팀] SCP시스템의 운송중 재고 정합성을 위한 GTS Tracking정보 UPdate로직 변경의 건
 * 2021.05.03   SEO			   PJ20209642 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 - lt_total -> add_after_lt_total 변경
 * 2021.07.07   sclee          PJ20209643 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - 참조뷰 변경 및 조인조건 추가
 * 2022.01.25   KSG            PJ20216891 LGES Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 - f dest eta 재정의
 * 2024.02.21   vadabi3        NERP - Warranty Plant 제외, 특정 Plant 별도 처리 개선
                                   -- A002 -- Warranty Plant 제외
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT * FROM      SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_FP_V WHERE RESULT_DATE = '20240408' and company_id = 'HQ00' and PLANT_ID = 'HQ07'
 SELECT * FROM OLD_SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_FP_V WHERE RESULT_DATE = '20240408' and company_id = 'HQ00' and PLANT_ID = 'HQ07'

 */  INV.RESULT_DATE
       , INV.RESULT_TYPE
       , INV.COMPANY_ID
       , INV.DIVISION_ID
       , INV.PLANT_ID
       , INV.SHIPMENT_NO
       , INV.PROJECT_CODE
       , INV.ITEM_ID
       , INV.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
       , INV.INCOTERMS
       , INV.FCST_TYPE
       , INV.CUSTOMER_CODE
       , INV.SHIPTO_CODE
       , INV.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
       , INV.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
       , S.SITE_TYPE
       , INV.DELIVERY_QTY
       , INV.UOM
       , INV.TRANSPORT_MODE
       , INV.SHIPPING_DATE
       , INV.POL
       , INV.POL_ATD_DATE
       , INV.POD
       , INV.POD_ETA_DATE
       , INV.POD_ATA_DATE
       , INV.POD_ETD_DATE
       , INV.POD_ATD_DATE
       , INV.F_DEST_PORT_CODE
       , INV.F_DEST_ETA_DATE
       , INV.F_DEST_ATA_DATE
	   /* From/To/Tr Mode/Incoterms 가 맞는 BOD가 없는 경우 : From/To/Tr Mode 기준 MAX(LT) 적용 */
       /* BOD 없는 경우 당일 일자 적용 */
       /* , dbo.FN_SCM_SYS_NVL( inv.f_dest_eta_date */
       /* , IIF( bod.lt_total IS NULL */
       /* , IIF( bod2.lt_total IS NULL */
       /* , CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), DATEADD(d, 1, CONVERT(DATETIME, inv.result_date)), 112) */
       /* , CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), DATEADD(d, bod2.lt_total, inv.plant_issue_date), 112) */
       /* ) */
       /* , CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), DATEADD(d, bod.lt_total, inv.plant_issue_date), 112) */
       /* ) */
       /* ) AS eta_date */
       , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL( INV.F_DEST_ETA_DATE
                       , CASE WHEN BOD.ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL IS NULL
                              THEN CASE WHEN BOD2.ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL IS NULL
                                        THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(INV.RESULT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                        ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(INV.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + BOD2.ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                   END
                              ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(INV.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + BOD.ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL, 'YYYYMMDD')
                         END
                       ) AS ETA_DATE  /* 2021.05.03 lt_total -> add_after_lt_total */
       /* 20201006 PJ20202001 컬럼 추가 */
       , INV.FINAL_INCOTERMS
       , INV.FINAL_SOLDTO_CODE

  FROM
        (
         /* --------------------------------------------------------- */
		/* 1-1. Intransit(GTS) : [ERP Intransit + GTS Update] */
        /* 법인출발 - PLANT도착 : FOB 반영 */
        /* --------------------------------------------------------- */
		SELECT  B.RESULT_DATE
		       ,B.RESULT_TYPE
			   ,B.COMPANY_ID
			   ,B.DIVISION_ID
			   ,B.PLANT_ID
			   ,B.SHIPMENT_NO
			   ,B.PROJECT_CODE
			   ,B.ITEM_ID
			   ,B.INCOTERMS
			   ,B.FINAL_INCOTERMS  /* 20201006 PJ20202001 컬럼 추가 */

			   ,MAX(FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(FN_GET_LOOKUP_CODE_DESC('DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL', B.DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL), 'E')) AS DOM_EXP
			   ,MAX(B.CUSTOMER_CODE)     AS CUSTOMER_CODE
			   ,MAX(B.FINAL_SOLDTO_CODE) AS FINAL_SOLDTO_CODE  /* 20201006 PJ20202001 컬럼 추가 */
			   ,MAX(B.SHIPTO_CODE)       AS SHIPTO_CODE
			   ,MAX(B.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID)  AS FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
			   ,MAX(B.TO_SCM_SITE_ID)    AS TO_SCM_SITE_ID
			   ,SUM(B.DELIVERY_QTY)      AS DELIVERY_QTY
			   ,MAX(B.UOM)               AS UOM
			   ,MAX(B.TRANSPORT_MODE)    AS TRANSPORT_MODE
			   ,B.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
			   ,B.FCST_TYPE
			   ,MAX(B.SHIPPING_DATE)    AS SHIPPING_DATE
			   ,MAX(B.POL)              AS POL
			   ,MAX(B.POL_ATD_DATE)     AS POL_ATD_DATE
			   ,MAX(B.POD)              AS POD
			   ,MAX(B.POD_ETA_DATE)     AS POD_ETA_DATE
			   ,MAX(B.POD_ATA_DATE)     AS POD_ATA_DATE
			   ,MAX(B.POD_ETD_DATE)     AS POD_ETD_DATE
			   ,MAX(B.POD_ATD_DATE)     AS POD_ATD_DATE
			   ,MAX(B.F_DEST_PORT_CODE) AS F_DEST_PORT_CODE
			   ,MAX(B.F_DEST_ETA_DATE)  AS F_DEST_ETA_DATE
			   ,MAX(B.F_DEST_ATA_DATE)  AS F_DEST_ATA_DATE
			   ,MAX(B.STORAGE_ID)       AS STORAGE_ID  /* 20200218  Storage ID 추가 */
		FROM   ( SELECT  TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1, 'YYYYMMDD') AS RESULT_DATE
						,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-1-90, 'YYYYMMDD') AS CAL_DATE  /* 2018.09.20 */
						,'I' AS RESULT_TYPE
						,DI.COMPANY_ID
						,DI.DIVISION_ID
						,DI.PLANT_ID
						,DI.SHIPMENT_NO
						,DI.PROJECT_CODE
						,DI.ITEM_ID
						,DI.INCOTERMS
						,DI.DISTRIBUTION_CHANNEL
						,DI.CUSTOMER_CODE
						,DI.SHIPTO_CODE
						,DI.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
						,DI.FROM_SITE_ITEM_MAPPING_YN
						,DI.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
						,DI.TO_SITE_ITEM_MAPPING_YN
						,DI.DELIVERY_QTY
						,DI.UOM
						,DI.TRANSPORT_MODE
						,DI.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
						,FCST_TYPE
						,DT.SHIPPING_DATE
						,DT.POL
						,DT.POL_ATD_DATE
						,DT.POD
						,DT.POD_ETA_DATE
						,DT.POD_ATA_DATE
						,DT.POD_ETD_DATE
						,DT.POD_ATD_DATE
						,DT.F_DEST_PORT_CODE
						/* 20210129  C20210128-000556 */
						/* ,dt.f_dest_eta_date */
						/* ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.site_type, 'SALES') = 'SALES' THEN dt.f_dest_eta_date_sales */
						/* ELSE dt.f_dest_eta_date */
						/* END  f_dest_eta_date */
						/* 20220125 PJ20216891 : f dest eta 재정의 */
                       ,CASE WHEN RTRIM(L.SEGMENT3) IS NULL  THEN CASE WHEN RTRIM(DT.F_DEST_ATA_DATE) IS NULL THEN DT.F_DEST_ETA_DATE ELSE DT.F_DEST_ATA_DATE END

                             WHEN NVL(S.SITE_TYPE, 'SALES') = 'SALES' AND L.SEGMENT3  = 'A' THEN ''
                             WHEN NVL(S.SITE_TYPE, 'SALES') = 'SALES' AND L.SEGMENT3  = 'B' THEN DT.SHIPPING_DATE
                             /* 'C' : 1 순위 - pol_atd_date , 2순위 - shipping_date */
                             WHEN NVL(S.SITE_TYPE, 'SALES') = 'SALES' AND L.SEGMENT3  = 'C' THEN CASE WHEN RTRIM(DT.POL_ATD_DATE) IS NULL THEN DT.SHIPPING_DATE ELSE DT.POL_ATD_DATE END
                             /* 'D/E/F' : 1 순위 - f_dest_ata_date , 2순위 - f_dest_eta_date */
                             WHEN NVL(S.SITE_TYPE, 'SALES') = 'SALES' AND L.SEGMENT3  = 'D' THEN CASE WHEN RTRIM(DT.F_DEST_ATA_DATE) IS NULL THEN DT.F_DEST_ETA_DATE ELSE DT.F_DEST_ATA_DATE END
                             WHEN NVL(S.SITE_TYPE, 'SALES') = 'SALES' AND L.SEGMENT3  = 'E' THEN CASE WHEN RTRIM(DT.F_DEST_ATA_DATE) IS NULL THEN DT.F_DEST_ETA_DATE ELSE DT.F_DEST_ATA_DATE END
                             WHEN NVL(S.SITE_TYPE, 'SALES') = 'SALES' AND L.SEGMENT3  = 'F' THEN CASE WHEN RTRIM(DT.F_DEST_ATA_DATE) IS NULL THEN DT.F_DEST_ETA_DATE ELSE DT.F_DEST_ATA_DATE END

                             ELSE CASE WHEN RTRIM(DT.F_DEST_ATA_DATE) IS NULL THEN DT.F_DEST_ETA_DATE ELSE DT.F_DEST_ATA_DATE END
                        END AS F_DEST_ETA_DATE

						,DT.F_DEST_ATA_DATE
						,DI.ORDER_TYPE_CODE  /* 2018.09.20 */
						,DI.STORAGE_ID  /* 20200218  Storage ID 추가 */
                         /* 20201006 PJ20202001 컬럼 추가 */
                        ,FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(DI.FINAL_INCOTERMS, DI.INCOTERMS)       AS FINAL_INCOTERMS
                        ,FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(DI.FINAL_SOLDTO_CODE, DI.CUSTOMER_CODE) AS FINAL_SOLDTO_CODE
				FROM    SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT DI

				/* 20210129  C20210128-000556 */
				LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S
				ON  DI.DIVISION_ID    = S.DIVISION_ID
				AND DI.TO_SCM_SITE_ID = S.SCM_SITE_ID

				/* 20210129  C20210128-000556 f_dest_eta_date 로 사용할 컬럼 변경 */
				LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_DNM_GTS_ETA_V DT
                /*
					    (SELECT  t.company_id  -- 20181204 company_id 추가
						        ,t.shipment_no
						 	    ,max(t.shipping_date) shipping_date
							    ,max(t.pol) pol
							    ,max(t.pol_atd_date) pol_atd_date
							    ,max(t.pod) pod
							    ,max(t.pod_eta_date) pod_eta_date
							    ,max(t.pod_ata_date) pod_ata_date
							    ,max(t.pod_etd_date) pod_etd_date
							    ,max(t.pod_atd_date) pod_atd_date
							    ,max(t.f_dest_port_code) f_dest_port_code
							    ,max(t.f_dest_eta_date) f_dest_eta_date
							    ,max(t.f_dest_ata_date) f_dest_ata_date
						 FROM   scm_dnm_delivery_tracking t WITH(NOLOCK)
						 --WHERE  len(t.pol_atd_date) > 0 -- ERP 와 같은 조건 처리(SAP 화면에서도 해당 데이터는 보이지 않음)
						 GROUP BY t.company_id, t.shipment_no  -- 20181204 company_id 추가
						) dt
				*/
				ON     DI.COMPANY_ID  = DT.COMPANY_ID  /* 20181204 company_id 추가 */
				AND    DI.SHIPMENT_NO = DT.SHIPMENT_NO

				LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT *
                                 FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                 WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'INCOTERMS'
                                 AND    VALID_YN    = 'Y'
				                ) L
				ON  NVL(DI.FINAL_INCOTERMS, DI.INCOTERMS)  = L.SEGMENT1

				WHERE  RTRIM(DI.SALES_POSTING_DATE) IS NULL
				AND    DI.SHIPMENT_NO > CHR(0)
			   ) B

				WHERE  (B.ORDER_TYPE_CODE != 'ZEML'	OR  (RTRIM(B.F_DEST_ATA_DATE) IS NULL  /* 2018.09.20 */
				                                         AND B.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE >= CAL_DATE))

				GROUP BY	B.RESULT_DATE   ,B.RESULT_TYPE    ,B.COMPANY_ID    ,B.DIVISION_ID      ,B.PLANT_ID
						   ,B.SHIPMENT_NO   ,B.PROJECT_CODE	  ,B.ITEM_ID       ,B.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE ,B.INCOTERMS
						   ,B.FCST_TYPE     ,B.FINAL_INCOTERMS

       ) INV

               INNER JOIN ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, SITE_TYPE
                            FROM   SCM_MST_SITE
                            WHERE  SITE_TYPE  IN ('PLANT')  /* To가 PLANT 인 경우 반영 */
                            AND    VALID_YN    = 'Y') S
               ON   INV.DIVISION_ID             = S.DIVISION_ID
               AND  INV.TO_SCM_SITE_ID          = S.SCM_SITE_ID

               /* LEFT JOIN  scp_mst_bod_v bod WITH (NOLOCK) */
               LEFT JOIN  SCP_MST_BOD_N_V BOD  /* 20210707 PJ20209643 scp_mst_bod_v 에서 scp_mst_bod_n_v로 변경 */
               ON    BOD.DIVISION_ID    = INV.DIVISION_ID
               AND   BOD.FROM_SITE      = INV.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
               AND   BOD.TO_SITE        = INV.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
               AND   BOD.INCOTERMS      = INV.FINAL_INCOTERMS  /* inv.incoterms 20201006 PJ20202001 변경 */
               AND   BOD.TRANSPORT_MODE = INV.TRANSPORT_MODE
               AND   BOD.BOD_VALID_YN   = 'Y'
			   AND   BOD.FROM_YYYYMMDD  <= INV.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE  /* 20210707 PJ20209643 추가 */
			   AND   BOD.TO_YYYYMMDD  >= INV.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE  /* 20210707 PJ20209643 추가 */
			   /* From/To/Tr Mode 가 맞는 경우의 MAX(LT) */
               LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE, A.TO_SITE, A.TRANSPORT_MODE
							   /* , MAX(lt_total) lt_total */
							   , MAX(ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL) ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL  /* 2021.05.03 lt_total -> add_after_lt_total */
						  /* FROM   scp_mst_bod_v A WITH (NOLOCK) */
                          FROM   SCP_MST_BOD_N_V A  /* 20210707 PJ20209643 scp_mst_bod_v 에서 scp_mst_bod_n_v로 변경 */
						  WHERE  A.BOD_VALID_YN    = 'Y'
						  GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE,A.TO_SITE, A.TRANSPORT_MODE
						 ) BOD2
               ON    BOD2.DIVISION_ID    = INV.DIVISION_ID
               AND   BOD2.FROM_SITE      = INV.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
               AND   BOD2.TO_SITE        = INV.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
               AND   BOD2.TRANSPORT_MODE = INV.TRANSPORT_MODE

   WHERE INV.PLANT_ID <> (  /* A002 -- Warranty Plant 제외 */
							SELECT SEGMENT2
							 FROM SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE
							WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_FP_V'
							  AND SEGMENT1 = 'WarrantyPlant'
							  AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
							)

NAME: SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_V
 * Description  : 해상재고 정보
                  * 운송중 재고 정보 생성 : 해상재고( I : GTS 있는 해상정보, 'S' : GTS 없는 정보, 'C' 법인간 해상재고)

                     1-1. Intransit(GTS) : [ERP Intransit + GTS Update] : result_type = 'I'
					  - lookup_type = 'EXFACTORY_INTRANSIT_TARGET' 에 없는 Company 만 scm_dnm_intransit_c 에 정보 생성되어 있음
                        법인출발 - SALES도착 : FOB 반영
                        법인출발 - PLANT도착 : FOB 반영
						C20200401-000183 A040-A => LGE_US_HZP 이동인 경우 Incoterms 를 DDP 로 처리

                     1-2. Intransit(출하실적기반 : Non GTS) [ERP 출하실적 + BOD LT] : result_type = 'S'
					  - lookup_type = 'EXFACTORY_INTRANSIT_TARGET' 에 있는 Company 만 scm_dnm_intransit_c 에 정보 생성되어 있음
                        법인출발        - SALES도착        : FOB 제외
                        CNA/CNB법인출발 - HLGP_KR_CHU 도착 : FOB 만 반영 : exfactory_status(D20 : 공장출고) / incoterms를 'Z02'로 처리
                        CNA법인출발     - PLANT도착        : FOB 반영    : exfactory_status(D20 : 공장출고)

                     1-3. 법인간 운송중 재고 : [ERP 법인미착정보] : result_type = 'C'
                        C20200227-000175 : 오창/법인출발 - PLANT/SALES도착 : FOB 반영
						  OLD] 오창/법인출발 - PLANT도착 : FOB 반영
						C20200401-000183 A040-A => LGE_US_HZP 이동인 경우 Incoterms 를 DDP 로 처리

                     1-4. to site가 VMI 정보 생성 : SCM_MST_VMI_INT_SLOC Mapping 된 것
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2019.06.18   KSG            Initial Release
 * 2019.09.24   KSG            항목 추가 : CNA/CNB법인출발 - HLGP_KR_CHU 도착
 * 2019.10.16   KSG            1-2 CNA/CNB법인출발 - HLGP_KR_CHU 도착 : exfactory_status(D20 : 공장출고) 만 반영
 * 2020.03.04   KSG            C20200227-000175  CNA법인-고객사(HLGP) 간 운송중 재고 반영건
 * 2020.03.13   KSG            C20200312-000110 CNA-HLGP 운송중 재고 누락건
 *                                법인간 운송 재고에서 To Site가 'HLGP_KR_CHU' 이면 Incoterms를 'Z02'로 처리
 * 2020.03.23   KSG            [전지 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 RTF 적확도 개선] - Hold VMI 대기 재고 Visibility 강화
 *                                VMI 전진 검사 LT 추가 적용 : SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM 테이블의 SCP_VMI_LT 값 만큼 ETA에 더해 줌
 * 2020.04.07   KSG            C20200401-000183 자동차 SCP, ACEN4065I-A1모델 운송중 재고의 RTF 반영 요청
 * 2020.10.06   KSG            PJ20202001 LG화학 전지. 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 SCM 관리 체계 개선 : ERP
 *                                추가 컬럼 정보 생성 FINAL_SOLDTO_CODE / FINAL_INCOTERMS
 * 2021.05.03   SEO			   PJ20209642 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 - lt_total -> add_after_lt_total 변경
 * 2021.07.07   sclee          PJ20209643 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - 참조뷰 변경 및 조인조건 추가
 * 2022.01.21   KSG            PJ20216891 LGES Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : Stock_v -> Stock 테이블로 변경
 * 2022.02.17   KSG            PJ20216891 LGES Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선
 *                                : result_type = 'S' 제외
 *                                : From Site가 AS인 경우 제외
 * 2022.06.28   hrkim          PJ20216891 LGES Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : storage_id 추가
 *								  - 참조 컬럼 :  scm_dnm_intransit_c.attribute2
 * 2024.06.09   vadabi3        NERP - 특정 Company 별도 처리 개선
							   -- A040-A, A002
							   SELECT DBO.FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_V','SCM_SITE_ID')
							   SELECT DBO.FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_V','PLANT_ID')
 * 2025.03.20	kimcd		   [PJ20249548R] SCP역량 강화를 위한 기준정보PSI엔진 기능개선
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 SELECT *
 FROM SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_V
 where result_date = '20240221'
 and result_type = 'C'
 and company_id = 'G450'
 and division_id = '81'

 SELECT *
 FROM NERP_SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_V
 where result_date = '20240221'
 and result_type = 'C'
 and company_id = 'G450'
 and division_id = '81'

 */
       A.RESULT_DATE
     , A.RESULT_TYPE
     , A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.PLANT_ID
     , A.SHIPMENT_NO
     , A.PROJECT_CODE
     , A.ITEM_ID
     , A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
     , A.INCOTERMS
     , A.FINAL_INCOTERMS
     , A.FCST_TYPE
     , A.CUSTOMER_CODE
     , A.FINAL_SOLDTO_CODE
     , A.SHIPTO_CODE
     , A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
     , A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
     , A.SITE_TYPE
     , A.DELIVERY_QTY
     , A.UOM
     , A.TRANSPORT_MODE
     , A.SHIPPING_DATE
     , A.POL
     , A.POL_ATD_DATE
     , A.POD
     , A.POD_ETA_DATE
     , A.POD_ATA_DATE
     , A.POD_ETD_DATE
     , A.POD_ATD_DATE
     , A.F_DEST_PORT_CODE
     , A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE
     , A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE
     /* VMI 전진검사 LT(scp_vmi_lt)를 ETA에 더함 */
     , CASE WHEN VALIDATE_CONVERSION(A.ETA_DATE AS DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = 1
            THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.ETA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + NVL(B.LT_DAY, 0), 'YYYYMMDD')
            ELSE A.ETA_DATE
       END   AS ETA_DATE
     , A.ATTRIBUTE2   AS STORAGE_ID
  FROM ( /* 1-1. Intransit(GTS) : result_type = 'I' */
         SELECT A.RESULT_DATE
              , A.RESULT_TYPE
              , A.COMPANY_ID
              , A.DIVISION_ID
              , A.PLANT_ID
              , A.SHIPMENT_NO
              , A.PROJECT_CODE
              , A.ITEM_ID
              , A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
              , CASE WHEN A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_V', 'SCM_SITE_ID')
                      AND A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID = 'LGE_US_HZP' THEN 'DDP' ELSE A.INCOTERMS
                END   AS INCOTERMS
              , CASE WHEN A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_V', 'SCM_SITE_ID')
                      AND A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID = 'LGE_US_HZP' THEN 'DDP' ELSE A.FINAL_INCOTERMS
                END   AS FINAL_INCOTERMS
              , A.FCST_TYPE
              , A.CUSTOMER_CODE
              , A.FINAL_SOLDTO_CODE
              , A.SHIPTO_CODE
              , A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
              , A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
              , B.SITE_TYPE
              , A.DELIVERY_QTY
              , A.UOM
              , A.TRANSPORT_MODE
              , A.SHIPPING_DATE
              , A.POL
              , A.POL_ATD_DATE
              , A.POD
              , A.POD_ETA_DATE
              , A.POD_ATA_DATE
              , A.POD_ETD_DATE
              , A.POD_ATD_DATE
              , A.F_DEST_PORT_CODE
              , A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE
              , A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE
              , CASE WHEN A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE IS NULL THEN
                          CASE WHEN C.ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL IS NULL THEN
                                    CASE WHEN D.ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL IS NULL
                                         THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.RESULT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                         ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + D.ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                    END
                               ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + C.ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL, 'YYYYMMDD')
                          END
                     ELSE A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE
                END   AS ETA_DATE
              , A.ATTRIBUTE2
           FROM SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_C   A
              , ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
                       , SCM_SITE_ID
                       , SITE_TYPE
                    FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                   WHERE SITE_TYPE IN ('PLANT', 'SALES')
                     AND VALID_YN = 'Y' )   B
              , SCP_MST_BOD_N_V   C
              , ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                       , A.FROM_SITE
                       , A.TO_SITE
                       , A.TRANSPORT_MODE
                       , MAX(A.ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL)   AS ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL
                    FROM SCP_MST_BOD_N_V   A
                   WHERE A.BOD_VALID_YN = 'Y'
                   GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE, A.TO_SITE, A.TRANSPORT_MODE )   D
          WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
            AND C.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND C.FROM_SITE(+) = A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
            AND C.TO_SITE(+) = A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
            AND C.INCOTERMS(+) = A.FINAL_INCOTERMS
            AND C.TRANSPORT_MODE(+) = A.TRANSPORT_MODE
            AND C.BOD_VALID_YN(+) = 'Y'
            AND C.FROM_YYYYMMDD(+) <= A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
            AND C.TO_YYYYMMDD(+) >= A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
            AND D.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND D.FROM_SITE(+) = A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
            AND D.TO_SITE(+) = A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
            AND D.TRANSPORT_MODE(+) = A.TRANSPORT_MODE
            AND A.RESULT_TYPE = 'I'
            AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
         UNION
         /* 1-3. 법인간 운송중 재고 : result_type = 'C' */
         SELECT A.RESULT_DATE
              , A.RESULT_TYPE
              , A.COMPANY_ID
              , A.DIVISION_ID
              , A.PLANT_ID
              , A.SHIPMENT_NO
              , A.PROJECT_CODE
              , A.ITEM_ID
              , A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
              , CASE WHEN A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_V', 'SCM_SITE_ID')
                      AND A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID = 'LGE_US_HZP' THEN 'DDP' ELSE A.INCOTERMS
                END   AS INCOTERMS
              , CASE WHEN A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_V', 'SCM_SITE_ID')
                      AND A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID = 'LGE_US_HZP' THEN 'DDP' ELSE A.FINAL_INCOTERMS
                END   AS FINAL_INCOTERMS
              , A.FCST_TYPE
              , A.CUSTOMER_CODE
              , A.FINAL_SOLDTO_CODE
              , A.SHIPTO_CODE
              , A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
              , A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
              , B.SITE_TYPE
              , A.DELIVERY_QTY
              , A.UOM
              , A.TRANSPORT_MODE
              , A.SHIPPING_DATE
              , A.POL
              , A.POL_ATD_DATE
              , A.POD
              , A.POD_ETA_DATE
              , A.POD_ATA_DATE
              , A.POD_ETD_DATE
              , A.POD_ATD_DATE
              , A.F_DEST_PORT_CODE
              , A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE
              , A.F_DEST_ATA_DATE
              , CASE WHEN A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE IS NULL THEN
                          CASE WHEN C.ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL IS NULL THEN
                                    CASE WHEN D.ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL IS NULL
                                         THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.RESULT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                         ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + D.ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                    END
                               ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + C.ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL, 'YYYYMMDD')
                          END
                     ELSE A.F_DEST_ETA_DATE
                END   AS ETA_DATE
              , A.ATTRIBUTE2
           FROM SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_C   A
              , ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
                       , SCM_SITE_ID
                       , SITE_TYPE
                    FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                   WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y' )   B
              , SCP_MST_BOD_N_V   C
              , ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
                       , A.FROM_SITE
                       , A.TO_SITE
                       , A.TRANSPORT_MODE
                       , MAX(A.ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL)   AS ADD_AFTER_LT_TOTAL
                    FROM SCP_MST_BOD_N_V   A
                   WHERE A.BOD_VALID_YN = 'Y'
                   GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE, A.TO_SITE, A.TRANSPORT_MODE )   D
          WHERE B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND B.SCM_SITE_ID = A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
            AND C.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND C.FROM_SITE(+) = A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
            AND C.TO_SITE(+) = A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
            AND C.INCOTERMS(+) = A.FINAL_INCOTERMS
            AND C.TRANSPORT_MODE(+) = A.TRANSPORT_MODE
            AND C.BOD_VALID_YN(+) = 'Y'
            AND C.FROM_YYYYMMDD(+) <= A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
            AND C.TO_YYYYMMDD(+) >= A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
            AND D.DIVISION_ID(+) = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND D.FROM_SITE(+) = A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
            AND D.TO_SITE(+) = A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
            AND D.TRANSPORT_MODE(+) = A.TRANSPORT_MODE
            AND A.RESULT_TYPE = 'C'
            AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
         UNION
         /* 1-4. VMI 정보 (SCM_MST_VMI_INT_SLOC 매핑) */
         SELECT A.CUTOFF_DATE   AS RESULT_DATE
              , 'V'   AS RESULT_TYPE
              , A.COMPANY_ID
              , A.DIVISION_ID
              , A.PLANT_ID
--            , TO_CHAR(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.PLANT_ID, A.ITEM_ID))   AS SHIPMENT_NO                    --  2026.10.07 AJS
              , TO_CHAR(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY 'V' ORDER BY A.PLANT_ID, A.ITEM_ID))   AS SHIPMENT_NO   --  2026.10.07 AJS 번호 동일 · RESULT_TYPE 조건을 받아 VMI 갈래 생략
              , ''    AS PROJECT_CODE
              , A.ITEM_ID
              , ''    AS PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
              , 'DAP' AS INCOTERMS
              , 'DAP' AS FINAL_INCOTERMS
              , ''    AS FCST_TYPE
              , ''    AS CUSTOMER_CODE
              , ''    AS FINAL_SOLDTO_CODE
              , ''    AS SHIPTO_CODE
              , ( SELECT PLANT_SITE_ID
                    FROM ( SELECT SA.PLANT_SITE_ID
                             FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY   SA
                                , SCM_MST_SITE                 SB
                            WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = SB.DIVISION_ID
                              AND SA.PLANT_SITE_ID = SB.SCM_SITE_ID
                              AND SA.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                              AND SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                              AND SA.PRIORITY = 1
                              AND SB.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                              AND SB.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                              AND SA.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                              AND SB.OPERATION_GROUP <> 'W'
                              AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN SA.FROM_YYYYMMDD AND SA.TO_YYYYMMDD
                            ORDER BY SB.OSP_YN, SA.PRIORITY_SEQ DESC )
                   WHERE ROWNUM = 1 )   AS FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
              , B.SCM_SITE_ID   AS TO_SCM_SITE_ID
              , 'SALES'   AS SITE_TYPE
              , NVL(A.SCM_QTY, 0)   AS DELIVERY_QTY
              , A.QTY_UOM   AS UOM
              , 'TRK'   AS TRANSPORT_MODE
              , NULL  AS SHIPPING_DATE
              , NULL  AS POL
              , NULL  AS POL_ATD_DATE
              , NULL  AS POD
              , NULL  AS POD_ETA_DATE
              , NULL  AS POD_ATA_DATE
              , NULL  AS POD_ETD_DATE
              , NULL  AS POD_ATD_DATE
              , NULL  AS F_DEST_PORT_CODE
              , NULL  AS F_DEST_ETA_DATE
              , NULL  AS F_DEST_ATA_DATE
              , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.CUTOFF_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1, 'YYYYMMDD')   AS ETA_DATE
              , A.STORAGE_ID   AS ATTRIBUTE2
           FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK          A
              , SCM_MST_VMI_INT_SLOC   B
          WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
            AND A.PLANT_ID = B.PLANT_ID
            AND A.STORAGE_ID = B.STORAGE_ID
            AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y' )   A
     , ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
              , A.SCM_SITE_ID
              , A.ITEM_ID
              , MAX(NVL(A.SCP_VMI_LT, 0))   AS LT_DAY
           FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM             A
              , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL  B
          WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.SEGMENT1
            AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.SEGMENT2
            AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'VMI_LT_SITE'
            AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
            AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
          GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.SCM_SITE_ID, A.ITEM_ID )   B
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID = B.SCM_SITE_ID(+)
   AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID(+)
   AND A.PLANT_ID <> FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_V', 'WarrantyPlant')
   AND ( A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID IS NULL
      OR A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID IN (SELECT SCM_SITE_ID
                                  FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                                 WHERE NVL(OPERATION_GROUP, '*') <> 'W') )

NAME: SCM_DNM_MPP_DW_V
TEXT:
SELECT

NAME: SCM_DNM_PLAN_FROZEN_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCM_DNM_PLAN_FROZEN_V
 * Description  : FP 8 주 확정 계획 정보
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018.01.26   Kim Jaejung    Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2018.04.20   KSG            대상 테이블 변경
 * 2018.05.14   Kim Jihye      fp_production_type TEST, REWORK 제외
 * 2018.06.18   Kim Jihye      fp_production_type M/C(형교환) 제외
 * 2018. 06.29  Kim jaejung    소형 대표 ITEM_ID 로 실적 생성 로직 추가 (소형)
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX   [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
/*
SELECT FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(A.PLANT_ID
                               ) AS SCM_SITE_ID
*/
       FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(A.PLANT_ID
                              , (SELECT SA.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
                                   FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN SA
                                  WHERE 1 = 1
                                    AND SA.ITEM_ID = NVL(B.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID)
                                    AND SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                    AND ROWNUM = 1)) AS SCM_SITE_ID
     , A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.SITE_ID
     , A.PLANT_ID
     , A.FACTORY_ID
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.LOCATION
     , A.TOP_ITEM_ID
     , NVL(B.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_ID   /* 2018.06.29 */
     , A.ITEM_ID AS ORIGIN_ITEM_ID   /* 2018.06.29 */
     , A.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
     , A.MARKET
     , A.LINE_ID
     , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , A.PLAN_DATE
     , A.PLAN_QTY   /* OUT 수량 */
       /* IN 수량 */
     , CASE WHEN A.PLAN_IN_QTY <= 0 THEN A.PLAN_QTY
            ELSE A.PLAN_IN_QTY
       END AS PLAN_IN_QTY
     , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM SCM_DNM_FP_RELEASE_PLAN_V_SN A
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM B   /* 2018.06.29 */
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID(+)
   AND NVL(A.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE, '-') NOT IN ('TEST', 'REWORK', 'M/C')   /* 2018.05.14, 2018.06.18  Kim Jihye */
       /* TEST : 공장 내부 Test  'M/C' : 형교환계획 */

NAME: SCM_DNM_RELEASE_FULL_PLAN_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCM_DNM_RELEASE_FULL_PLAN_V
 * Description  : FP 확정 계획 정보
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018. 1. 26  Kim Jaejung    Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2018. 5. 14  Kim Jihye      fp_production_type TEST, REWORK 제외
 * 2018. 07.19  Kim jaejung    소형 대표 ITEM_ID 로 실적 생성 로직 추가 (소형)
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX  [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
       B.SCM_SITE_ID
     , B.SITE_ID
     , A.INSTANCE_ID
     , A.INSTANCE_DATE
     , A.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
     , A.AMEND_PLAN_ID
     , A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.FACTORY_ID
     , A.PLAN_GROUP_ID
     , A.WORK_ORDER_ID
     , NVL(FI.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_ID   /* 2018.07.19 */
     , A.ITEM_ID AS ORIGIN_ITEM_ID   /* 2018.07.19 */
     , A.LINE_ID
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
     , A.FIX_TYPE
     , A.PLAN_DATE
     , A.START_TIME
     , A.END_TIME
     , A.PLAN_QTY
     , A.PLAN_IN_QTY
     , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
     , A.MARKET
     , A.BATCH_ORDER_ID
     , A.LANE_QTY
     , A.ACTUAL_FLAG
     , A.CLOSE_FLAG
     , A.INSERT_ID
     , A.INSERT_TIME
     , A.MIN_ACTUAL_DATE
     , A.RESULT_QTY
     , A.RESULT_ERP_QTY
     , A.PEGGING_RESULT_QTY
     , A.ADJUST_PLAN_IN_QTY
     , A.ADJUST_START_TIME
     , A.IS_PREV_SCHEDULE
     , A.TARGET_PRODUCTION_TYPE
     , A.TARGET_CATEGORY
     , A.TOP_ITEM_ID
     , A.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
  FROM SCM_DNM_RELEASE_FULL_PLAN_H_SN A
     , (SELECT ZZ.PLAN_ID
             , ZZ.FACTORY_ID
             , ZZ.SITE_ID
             , ZZ.PLAN_GROUP_ID
             , ZZ.SCM_SITE_ID
             , ZZ.NUMS
          FROM (SELECT B.SITE_ID
                     , A.INSTANCE_ID
                     , INSTANCE_DATE
                     , DIVISION_ID
                     , B.FACTORY_ID
                       /* ,FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(B.PLANT_ID,FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(A.DIVISION_ID,A.ITEM_ID)) AS SCM_SITE_ID */
                     , FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(B.PLANT_ID
                                              , (SELECT I.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
                                                   FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN I
                                                  WHERE 1 = 1
                                                    AND I.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                                    AND I.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                                                    AND ROWNUM = 1)) AS SCM_SITE_ID
                     , A.PLAN_GROUP_ID
                     , A.RELEASE_PLAN_ID AS PLAN_ID
                     , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, INSTANCE_TYPE, B.FACTORY_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.PLAN_GROUP_ID ORDER BY INSERT_TIME DESC) AS NUMS   /* 마지막 RELEASE VERSION */
                  FROM SCM_DNM_RELEASE_FULL_PLAN_H_SN A
                     , (SELECT A.INSTANCE_ID
                             , INSTANCE_TYPE
                             , B.SITE_ID
                             , B.FACTORY_ID
                             , B.PLANT_ID
                             , CASE WHEN SLV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'PLAN GROUP' THEN '-' ELSE B.FACTORY_ID END AS LINK_FACTORY_ID
                             , NVL(MP.SEGMENT2, '-') AS PLAN_GROUP_ID
                          FROM SCM_MST_INSTANCE_FACTORY_SN A
                             , SCM_MST_FACTORY_SN B
                             , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_VALUE_FP_SN SLV

                          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_VALUE_FP_SN MP
                            ON MP.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_PLANNING_GROUP'
                           AND MP.SEGMENT1 = SLV.SEGMENT1
                           AND SLV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'PLAN GROUP'
                         WHERE A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
                           AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                           AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = B.ACTIVE_FLAG
                           AND A.INSTANCE_ID != 'KR_CELL_M_P'   /* 오창 소형 조립 테스트용 계획 SCM과 무관함 */
                           AND SLV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
                           AND SLV.SEGMENT1 = A.INSTANCE_ID) B
                 WHERE A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID
                   AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.LINK_FACTORY_ID
                   AND A.PLAN_GROUP_ID = B.PLAN_GROUP_ID) ZZ
         WHERE ZZ.NUMS = 1) B
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM FI   /* 2018.07.19 */
 WHERE A.RELEASE_PLAN_ID = B.PLAN_ID
   AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
   AND NVL(A.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE, '-') NOT IN ('TEST', 'REWORK')   /* 2018. 5. 14  Kim Jihye */
   AND A.DIVISION_ID = FI.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND A.ITEM_ID = FI.ITEM_ID(+)

NAME: SCM_DNM_SSP_PLAN_V
TEXT:
SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SCM_DNM_SSP_PLAN_V
 * Description  : 재고 : DW용
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2024.10.02   KSG            Initial Release : PJ20249346 LGES SCP 개선과제 이행 : SSP Confirm + SSP Request 정보 : SCP Plan Input용
 * 2025.03.26   kimcd          [PJ20249548R] SCP역량 강화를 위한 기준정보PSI엔진 기능개선 : 월요일 출하 실적으로 변경.
 *                             E20250217-000373 통합FP → SCP 출하계획 전송 시 월요일 출하실적 전송 요청
 * 2025.05.07   kimcd          [PJ2024A332] 독립적 Planning 체계 및 Master Validation UI 구축
 * 2026.07.06	ZIONEX		[PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
       'CFM'   AS SSP_TYPE
     , SC.DIVISION_ID
     , SC.CONFIRM_ID
     , SC.FROM_SITE
     , SC.BOD_ID   AS BOD_ID
     , SC.TO_SITE  AS TO_SITE
     , SC.INCOTERMS
     , SC.TRANSPORT_MODE
     , SC.CHANGE_TYPE
     , SC.BIZ_TYPE
     , SC.PROJECT_CODE
     , SC.FCST_TYPE
     , SC.ITEM_ID
     , SC.YYYYMMDD
     , CASE WHEN SC.ETA_DATE IS NULL THEN TO_DATE(SC.YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')
            ELSE TO_DATE(SC.ETA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
       END   AS ETA_DATE
     , SC.QTY
  FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM SC
 WHERE SC.DIVISION_ID = SC.DIVISION_ID
   AND SC.QTY > 0
   AND SC.YYYYMMDD >= CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') <> 'MON'
                                AND SC.DIVISION_ID = '81_UC'
                           THEN TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 6, 'YYYYMMDD')   /* 당주 화요일 */
                           ELSE TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')   /* 당주 월요일 */
                      END
   AND SC.CHANGE_TYPE = 'C'
UNION ALL
/* 2. SSP Request 정보 */
SELECT 'REQ'   AS SSP_TYPE
     , TT0.DIVISION_ID
     , '-'   AS CONFIRM_ID
     , TT0.PLANT_SITE_ID   AS FROM_SITE
     , TT0.BOD_ID
     , TT0.SCM_SITE_ID   AS TO_SITE
     , NVL(TT1.SSP_INCOTERMS, TT0.INCOTERMS)   AS INCOTERMS
     , TT0.TRANSPORT_MODE
     , '-'   AS CHANGE_TYPE
     , FI.OPERATION_GROUP   AS BIZ_TYPE
     , TT0.PROJECT_CODE
     , TT0.FCST_TYPE
     , TT0.ITEM_ID
     , TT0.YYYYMMDD
     , TO_DATE(FN_GET_SSP_ETA_DATE(TT0.DIVISION_ID, TT0.BOD_ID, TT0.YYYYMMDD), 'YYYYMMDD')   AS ETA_DATE
     , TT0.QTY
  FROM DM_PLN_SHIPMENT_REQ TT0
       /* H-3 ANSI 유지 : 외부조인 대상 E의 조인술어가 CASE식 내부 컬럼(E.DIVISION_ID/E.SCM_SITE_ID 등)이고
          FI.OPERATION_GROUP(FI도 외부조인)에 연쇄 종속 → Oracle (+)로 표현 불가(ORA-30563 등) → ANSI JOIN 유지 */
       INNER JOIN SCP_MST_BOD_N_V TT1
               ON TT0.DIVISION_ID = TT1.DIVISION_ID
              AND TT0.BOD_ID = TT1.BOD_ID
       INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE TT2
               ON TT0.DIVISION_ID = TT2.DIVISION_ID
              AND TT0.PLANT_SITE_ID = TT2.SCM_SITE_ID
              AND TT2.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
              AND TT2.VALID_YN = 'Y'
       LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE FS
               ON TT0.DIVISION_ID = FS.DIVISION_ID
              AND TT0.PLANT_SITE_ID = FS.SCM_SITE_ID
              AND FS.VALID_YN = 'Y'
       LEFT OUTER JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM FI
               ON FI.DIVISION_ID = TT0.DIVISION_ID
              AND FI.ITEM_ID = TT0.ITEM_ID
       LEFT OUTER JOIN SSP_MST_SITE_ITEM_EE_V E
               ON TT0.DIVISION_ID = (CASE WHEN FI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' THEN E.DIVISION_ID ELSE E.ASSY_DIVISION_ID END)
              AND TT0.PLANT_SITE_ID = (CASE WHEN FI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' THEN E.SCM_SITE_ID ELSE E.ASSY_SCM_SITE_ID END)
              AND TT0.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID
 WHERE TT0.DIVISION_ID = TT0.DIVISION_ID
   AND TT0.QTY > 0
   AND TT0.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7 * 2, 'YYYYMMDD')   /* 전주 월요일 */
UNION ALL
/* 3. ERP 출하실적 (SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT) */
SELECT 'CFM'   AS SSP_TYPE
     , E.DIVISION_ID   AS DIVISION_ID
     , E.CONFIRM_ID || '_ER'   AS CONFIRM_ID
     , E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID   AS FROM_SITE
     , B.BOD_ID   AS BOD_ID
     , E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID   AS TO_SITE
     , CASE WHEN MST.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' THEN 'DAP' ELSE NVL(E.INCOTERMS, '-') END   AS INCOTERMS
     , E.TRANSPORT_MODE   AS TRANSPORT_MODE
     , 'C'   AS CHANGE_TYPE
     , F.OPERATION_GROUP   AS BIZ_TYPE
     , CASE WHEN E.PROJECT_CODE IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE E.PROJECT_CODE END   AS PROJECT_CODE
     , '-'   AS FCST_TYPE
     , E.ITEM_ID   AS ITEM_ID
     , E.EXFACTORY_DATE   AS YYYYMMDD
     , MAX(CASE WHEN E.ETA_DATE IS NULL THEN TO_DATE(E.EXFACTORY_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + NVL(B.LT_TOTAL, 0)
                ELSE TO_DATE(E.ETA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') END)   AS ETA_DATE
     , SUM(E.EXFACTORY_QTY)   AS QTY
  FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT E
     , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
     , SCM_MST_SITE MS
     , SCM_MST_SITE MST
     , SCP_MST_BOD_N_V B
 WHERE L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_SSP_TYPE'
   AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
   AND L.SEGMENT1 = E.SSP_TYPE
   AND F.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID
   AND F.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
   AND E.DIVISION_ID = MS.DIVISION_ID
   AND E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID = MS.SCM_SITE_ID
   AND MS.OSP_YN = 'N'
   AND E.DIVISION_ID = MST.DIVISION_ID
   AND E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID = MST.SCM_SITE_ID
   AND B.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
   AND B.FROM_SITE = E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
   AND B.TO_SITE = E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID
   AND B.INCOTERMS = CASE WHEN MST.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' THEN 'DAP' ELSE E.INCOTERMS END
   AND B.TRANSPORT_MODE = E.TRANSPORT_MODE
   AND B.FROM_YYYYMMDD <= E.EXFACTORY_DATE
   AND B.TO_YYYYMMDD >= E.EXFACTORY_DATE
   AND B.BOD_VALID_YN = 'Y'
   AND NVL(E.EXFACTORY_STATUS, 'D90') NOT IN ('D90', 'D10')   /* D90:DO삭제 D10:DO생성 */
   AND E.CONFIRM_ID LIKE 'C%'
   AND E.EXFACTORY_DATE >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7 * 2, 'YYYYMMDD')   /* 전주 월요일 */
   AND E.EXFACTORY_DATE <  CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') <> 'MON'
                                     AND E.DIVISION_ID = '81_UC'
                                THEN TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 6, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                ELSE TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                           END
 GROUP BY E.DIVISION_ID, E.CONFIRM_ID, E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID, B.BOD_ID, E.EXFACTORY_DATE
        , E.TRANSPORT_MODE, F.OPERATION_GROUP, E.INCOTERMS, E.PROJECT_CODE, E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID, E.ITEM_ID, MST.SITE_TYPE
UNION ALL
/* 3b. SCS(외주) 출하실적 (SCM_DNM_SCS_SHIP_RESULT) */
SELECT 'CFM'   AS SSP_TYPE
     , E.DIVISION_ID   AS DIVISION_ID
     , NVL(E.ATTRIBUTE5, '-') || '_SR'   AS CONFIRM_ID
     , E.SCM_SITE_ID   AS FROM_SITE
     , NVL(C.BOD_ID, B.BOD_ID)   AS BOD_ID
     , E.TO_SITE   AS TO_SITE
     , CASE WHEN MST.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' THEN 'DAP' ELSE NVL(C.INCOTERMS, '-') END   AS INCOTERMS
     , NVL(C.TRANSPORT_MODE, '-')   AS TRANSPORT_MODE
     , 'C'   AS CHANGE_TYPE
     , F.OPERATION_GROUP   AS BIZ_TYPE
     , CASE WHEN C.PROJECT_CODE IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE C.PROJECT_CODE END   AS PROJECT_CODE
     , '-'   AS FCST_TYPE
     , E.ITEM_ID   AS ITEM_ID
     , E.SHIP_DATE   AS YYYYMMDD
     , MAX(CASE WHEN C.ETA_DATE IS NULL THEN TO_DATE(E.SHIP_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') + NVL(B.LT_TOTAL, 0)
                ELSE TO_DATE(C.ETA_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') END)   AS ETA_DATE
     , SUM(E.SHIP_QTY)   AS QTY
  FROM SCM_DNM_SCS_SHIP_RESULT E
       /* H-3 ANSI 유지 : LEFT JOIN C(외부)에 하위 INNER 테이블 B가 조인술어로 종속(B.TRANSPORT_MODE=C.TRANSPORT_MODE 등)
          → C가 두 테이블(E,B)에 아우터조인되어 Oracle (+)로 표현 불가(ORA-01417) → ANSI JOIN 유지 */
       JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
         ON F.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID
        AND F.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
       JOIN SCM_MST_SITE FS
         ON FS.SCM_SITE_ID = E.SCM_SITE_ID
        AND FS.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
        AND FS.OSP_YN = 'Y'
       LEFT JOIN SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM C
         ON E.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
        AND E.PACK_MODEL_CODE = C.ITEM_ID
        AND E.SCM_SITE_ID = C.FROM_SITE
        AND E.TO_SITE = C.TO_SITE
        AND E.ATTRIBUTE5 = C.CONFIRM_ID
       JOIN SCM_MST_SITE MST
         ON E.DIVISION_ID = MST.DIVISION_ID
        AND E.TO_SITE = MST.SCM_SITE_ID
       JOIN SCP_MST_BOD_N_V B
         ON B.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
        AND B.FROM_SITE = E.SCM_SITE_ID
        AND B.TO_SITE = E.TO_SITE
        AND B.INCOTERMS = CASE WHEN MST.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT' THEN 'DAP' ELSE C.INCOTERMS END
        AND B.TRANSPORT_MODE = C.TRANSPORT_MODE
        AND B.FROM_YYYYMMDD <= E.SHIP_DATE
        AND B.TO_YYYYMMDD >= E.SHIP_DATE
        AND B.BOD_VALID_YN = 'Y'
 WHERE E.ATTRIBUTE5 LIKE 'C%'
   AND E.SHIP_DATE >= TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7 * 2, 'YYYYMMDD')   /* 전주 월요일 */
   AND E.SHIP_DATE <  CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=ENGLISH') <> 'MON'
                                AND E.DIVISION_ID = '81_UC'
                           THEN TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 6, 'YYYYMMDD')
                           ELSE TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                      END
 GROUP BY E.DIVISION_ID, E.ATTRIBUTE5, E.SCM_SITE_ID, NVL(C.BOD_ID, B.BOD_ID), E.SHIP_DATE, E.TO_SITE
        , C.TRANSPORT_MODE, F.OPERATION_GROUP, C.INCOTERMS, C.PROJECT_CODE, E.ITEM_ID, MST.SITE_TYPE

NAME: SCM_DNM_STOCK_AGING_SN_V
TEXT:
SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SCM_DNM_STOCK_AGING_SN_V
 * Description  : 자동차 JV재고를 ESS 가상 plant 재고로 치환한 활성화 재고
 *				  사용될 프로시저 : PR_SCP_RPT_GLOBAL_PSI_MD_MM/WW
 *
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 *  2025.11.18	hrkim		   Initial Release [PJ2025F254] [LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선
 *								- FP 활성화 재고를 ESS MI 법인 가상 Plant 재고로 치환하여 정보 형성
 *								- 자동차 Global PSI New 데이터 생성 프로시저에서 참조하기 위한 뷰
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX  [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
       CASE WHEN VI.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN MP.VL_COMPANY_ID  ELSE SA.COMPANY_ID  END  AS COMPANY_ID
     , CASE WHEN VI.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN MP.VL_DIVISION_ID ELSE SA.DIVISION_ID END  AS DIVISION_ID
     , CASE WHEN VI.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN MP.VL_SITE_ID     ELSE SA.SITE_ID     END  AS SITE_ID
     , CASE WHEN VI.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN MP.VL_PLANT_ID    ELSE SA.PLANT_ID    END  AS PLANT_ID
     , CASE WHEN VI.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN MP.VL_FACTORY_ID  ELSE SA.FACTORY_ID  END  AS FACTORY_ID
     , SA.ROUTE_ID
     , CASE WHEN VI.ITEM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN MP.VL_LINE_ID     ELSE SA.LINE_ID     END  AS LINE_ID
     , SA.CUTOFF_DATE
     , SA.SEQ
     , SA.ITEM_ID
     , SA.PRODUCTION_TYPE
     , SA.FCS_INPUT_DATE
     , SA.AVAILABLE_DATE
     , SA.REMAIN_LEAD_TIME
     , SA.HOLDING_DATE
     , SA.INPUT_QTY
     , SA.QTY
     , SA.QTY_UOM
     , SA.STOCK_STATUS
     , SA.OPERATION_ID
     , SA.OPERATION_SEQ
     , SA.OP_START_TIME
     , SA.TRAY_OP_STATUS
     , SA.INSERT_ID
     , SA.INSERT_TIME
     , SA.UPDATE_ID
     , SA.UPDATE_TIME
     , SA.STOCK_TYPE
     , SA.WIPHOLD_YN
     , SA.UNHOLD_EXP_DATE
     , SA.SPECIAL_YN
     , SA.LOT_ID
     , SA.OCV2_END_TIME
     , SA.SHIP_AVAILABLE_DATE
     , SA.BEFORE_DEGAS
     , SA.DEGAS_END_DATE
     , SA.BASE_AVAILABLE_DATE
     , SA.ORIGINAL_QTY
  FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK_AGING_SN SA
       LEFT JOIN TABLE(FN_GET_JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP()) MP  /* JV Real Line / ESS Virtual Line 매핑 정보 반환 함수 */
              ON MP.RL_COMPANY_ID  = SA.COMPANY_ID
             AND MP.RL_DIVISION_ID = SA.DIVISION_ID
             AND MP.RL_SITE_ID     = SA.SITE_ID
             AND MP.RL_PLANT_ID    = SA.PLANT_ID
             AND MP.RL_FACTORY_ID  = SA.FACTORY_ID
             AND MP.RL_LINE_ID     = SA.LINE_ID
       LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_SN VI  /* ESS MI법인 Virtual 품목 */
              ON VI.ITEM_ID             = SA.ITEM_ID
             AND VI.COMPANY_ID          = MP.VL_COMPANY_ID
             AND VI.DIVISION_ID         = MP.VL_DIVISION_ID
             AND VI.SITE_ID             = MP.VL_SITE_ID
             AND VI.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP = 'A'  /* Cell(조립) */
 WHERE 1=1

NAME: SCM_DNM_STOCK_DW_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCM_DNM_STOCK_DW_V
 * Description  : 재고 : DW용
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2022.04.28   KSG            Initial Release : PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : GM JV
 * 2023.04.03	HRK			   PJ20230691R LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응
 * 
 * 2026.07.04   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
 V.SCM_SITE_ID
     , V.COMPANY_ID
       /* HM JV , CASE WHEN DIVISION_ID = '81_UC' THEN '81' ELSE DIVISION_ID END AS DIVISION_ID */
     , D.ATTRIBUTE3 AS DIVISION_ID   /* HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
     , V.SITE_ID
     , V.PLANT_ID
     , V.FACTORY_ID
     , V.STORAGE_ID
     , V.CUTOFF_DATE
     , V.SEQ
     , V.STOCK_TYPE
     , V.ITEM_ID
     , V.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
     , V.SCM_QTY
     , V.SSP_QTY
     , V.LANE
     , V.PRODUCTION_TYPE
     , V.AVAILABLE_DATE
     , V.REMAIN_LEAD_TIME
     , V.HOLDING_DATE
     , V.QTY
     , V.QTY_UOM
     , V.STOCK_STATUS
     , V.OPERATION_ID
     , V.LINE_ID
     , V.OUTSOURCING_FLAG
     , V.OUTSOURCING_FACTORY
     , V.DESCRIPTION
     , V.FP_APPLY_OPERATION_ID
     , V.FP_APPLY_ITEM_ID
     , V.FP_APPLY_WIPQTY
     , V.WIPHOLD_YN
     , V.QMS_HOLD_YN
     , V.WIP_TYPE_CODE
     , V.QTY2
     , V.MODIFY_FP_APPLY_WIPQTY
     , V.MODIFY_DESCRIPTION
     , V.CAL_QTY
     , V.FORMATION_REWORK_TYPE
     , V.INSERT_ID
     , V.INSERT_TIME
     , V.UPDATE_ID
     , V.UPDATE_TIME
     , V.LOCATION
     , V.MOVING_QTY
     , V.CAPA_GRD_CODE
     , V.VLTG_GRD_CODE
     , V.RSST_GRD_CODE
     , V.DEFECT_QTY
     , V.UNHOLD_EXP_DATE
     , V.MES_MAP_SLOC
     , V.MES_HOLD_YN
     , V.MES_UNHOLD_DATE
     , V.QMS_HOLD_DATE
     , V.QMS_UNHOLD_EXP_DATE
     , V.QMS_UNHOLD_DATE
     , V.OPERATION_ID_ORG
     , V.LOCATION_CODE
     , V.DIVISION_ID AS SCM_DIVISION_ID
