       INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D   /* HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
               ON D.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
              AND D.VALID_YN    = 'Y'

NAME: SCM_DNM_STOCK_KPI_V
TEXT:
SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SCM_DNM_STOCK_KPI_V
 * Description  : 재고 정보 (KPI 용) - 일요일 기준 재고 + 운송중 재고
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018.09.13   Kim Jihye      Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 *
 */   STOCK.DIVISION_ID
       ,STOCK.ITEM_ID
       ,CM.WEEK_NAME
       ,CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
       ,SUM(STOCK.STOCK_QTY) STOCK_QTY
FROM   (SELECT SV.DIVISION_ID
              ,ITEM_ID
              ,SV.SCM_QTY STOCK_QTY
              ,SV.CUTOFF_DATE
        FROM   SCM_DNM_STOCK_V SV
        WHERE  SV.SCM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL
        AND    SV.SCM_QTY > 0
        UNION
        SELECT IC.DIVISION_ID
              ,IC.ITEM_ID
              ,IC.DELIVERY_QTY STOCK_QTY
              ,TO_DATE(IC.RESULT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') CUTOFF_DATE
        FROM   SCM_DNM_INTRANSIT_C IC
        WHERE  IC.RESULT_TYPE IN ('I', 'S', 'C')
        AND    IC.TO_SCM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL) STOCK
JOIN    SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CM
ON      STOCK.CUTOFF_DATE = CM.BASIS_DATE - 1
WHERE   CM.DAYOFWEEK = 'MON'
GROUP BY STOCK.DIVISION_ID
        ,STOCK.ITEM_ID
        ,CM.WEEK_NAME
        ,CM.BASIS_YYYYMMDD

NAME: SCM_DNM_STOCK_V
TEXT:
WITH SCP_EXC_ITEM_ASSY_MAP AS (
    SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, SCP_EXC_ITEM_ID, CELL_ASSY_ITEM_ID
      FROM TABLE(FN_GET_SCP_EXC_ITEM_ASSY_MAP(NULL))
     WHERE 1 = 1
),
JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_SITE_MAP AS (
    SELECT MP.VP_COMPANY_ID, MP.VP_DIVISION_ID, MP.VP_SITE_ID, MP.VP_PLANT_ID, MP.VP_SCM_SITE_ID
         , MP.RP_COMPANY_ID, MP.RP_DIVISION_ID, MP.RP_SITE_ID, MP.RP_PLANT_ID, MP.RP_SCM_SITE_ID
      FROM TABLE(FN_GET_JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_SITE_MAP()) MP
),
JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP AS (
    SELECT MP.VL_COMPANY_ID, MP.VL_DIVISION_ID, MP.VL_SITE_ID, MP.VL_PLANT_ID, MP.VL_FACTORY_ID, MP.VL_LINE_ID
         , MP.RL_COMPANY_ID, MP.RL_DIVISION_ID, MP.RL_SITE_ID, MP.RL_PLANT_ID, MP.RL_FACTORY_ID, MP.RL_LINE_ID
      FROM TABLE(FN_GET_JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP()) MP
)
SELECT STOCK.scm_site_id                                                                 AS scm_site_id
     , CASE WHEN STOCK.company_id  IS NULL THEN '*' ELSE STOCK.company_id  END            AS company_id
     , STOCK.division_id
     , CASE WHEN STOCK.site_id     IS NULL THEN '*' ELSE STOCK.site_id     END            AS site_id
     , CASE WHEN STOCK.plant_id    IS NULL THEN '*' ELSE STOCK.plant_id    END            AS plant_id
     , CASE WHEN STOCK.factory_id  IS NULL THEN '*' ELSE STOCK.factory_id  END            AS factory_id
     , CASE WHEN STOCK.storage_id  IS NULL THEN '*' ELSE STOCK.storage_id  END            AS storage_id
     , STOCK.cutoff_date - 1                                                              AS cutoff_date
     , STOCK.seq
     , STOCK.stock_type
     , NVL(EX.CELL_ASSY_ITEM_ID, STOCK.item_id)                                           AS ITEM_ID
     , STOCK.origin_item_id
     , NVL(STOCK.scm_qty, 0) + NVL(STOCK.moving_qty, 0) + NVL(STOCK.defect_qty, 0)        AS scm_qty
     , NVL(STOCK.scm_qty, 0)                                                              AS ssp_qty
     , STOCK.lane
     , STOCK.production_type
     , CASE WHEN NVL(STOCK.wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND STOCK.available_date IS NULL AND STOCK.division_id = '40'
                 THEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(STOCK.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMM') || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 6)
            WHEN NVL(STOCK.wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND STOCK.available_date IS NULL AND DM.ATTRIBUTE3 IN ('81', '82')
                 THEN ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(STOCK.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMM') || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 24)
            ELSE STOCK.available_date
        END                                                                              AS available_date
     , STOCK.remain_lead_time
     , STOCK.holding_date
     , STOCK.qty
     , STOCK.qty_uom
     , STOCK.stock_status
     , STOCK.operation_id
     , STOCK.line_id
     , STOCK.outsourcing_flag
     , STOCK.outsourcing_factory
     , STOCK.description
     , STOCK.fp_apply_operation_id
     , STOCK.fp_apply_item_id
     , STOCK.fp_apply_wipqty
     , CASE WHEN STOCK.wiphold_yn IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE STOCK.wiphold_yn END              AS wiphold_yn
     , CASE WHEN STOCK.qms_hold_yn IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE STOCK.qms_hold_yn END            AS qms_hold_yn
     , STOCK.wip_type_code
     , STOCK.qty2
     , STOCK.modify_fp_apply_wipqty
     , STOCK.modify_description
     , STOCK.cal_qty
     , STOCK.formation_rework_type
     , STOCK.insert_id
     , STOCK.insert_time
     , STOCK.update_id
     , STOCK.update_time
     , STOCK.location
     , STOCK.moving_qty
     , STOCK.capa_grd_code
     , STOCK.vltg_grd_code
     , STOCK.rsst_grd_code
     , STOCK.defect_qty
     , STOCK.unhold_exp_date
     , STOCK.mes_map_sloc
     , STOCK.mes_hold_yn
     , STOCK.mes_unhold_date
     , STOCK.qms_hold_date
     , STOCK.qms_unhold_exp_date
     , STOCK.qms_unhold_date
     , STOCK.operation_id_org
     , STOCK.location_code
     , STOCK.mes_item_id
     , STOCK.mes_operation_id
     , STOCK.from_sloc_id
     , STOCK.customer_id
     , STOCK.special_stock_indicator
     , STOCK.cutoff_date                                                                AS org_cutoff_date   /* AJS 20261007 속도 : 원장 마감일 그대로(마감일 조건이 인덱스를 타도록) */
  FROM (
        --------------------------- 외주 Packer 재고 (SUPPLY)
        SELECT CASE WHEN dss.division_id = '82' THEN NULL
                    WHEN dss.division_id = '40' THEN NULL
                    ELSE FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(ip.scm_site_id, ms.scm_site_id)
               END                                              AS scm_site_id
             , qty2                                             AS scm_qty
             , dss.company_id, dss.division_id, dss.site_id, dss.plant_id, dss.factory_id, dss.storage_id
             , dss.cutoff_date, dss.seq, dss.stock_type
             , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) AS item_id
             , dss.item_id                                      AS origin_item_id
             , dss.lane, dss.production_type
             , CASE WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'N'                                                                            THEN NVL(dss.available_date, dss.cutoff_date - 1)
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND dss.unhold_exp_date IS NULL AND dss.qms_unhold_exp_date IS NULL         THEN NULL
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') >= NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.unhold_exp_date
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') <  NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.qms_unhold_exp_date
                    ELSE dss.available_date
               END                                              AS available_date
             , dss.remain_lead_time, dss.holding_date, dss.qty, dss.qty_uom, dss.stock_status
             , dss.operation_id
             , dss.operation_id                                 AS operation_id_org
             , dss.line_id, dss.outsourcing_flag, dss.outsourcing_factory, dss.description
             , dss.fp_apply_operation_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id, dss.fp_apply_wipqty
             , dss.wiphold_yn, dss.qms_hold_yn, dss.wip_type_code, dss.qty2
             , dss.modify_fp_apply_wipqty, dss.modify_description, dss.cal_qty, dss.formation_rework_type
             , dss.insert_id, dss.insert_time, dss.update_id, dss.update_time, dss.location, dss.moving_qty
             , dss.capa_grd_code, dss.vltg_grd_code, dss.rsst_grd_code
             , NVL(dss.defect_qty, 0) + NVL(dss.restrict_qty, 0) AS defect_qty
             , dss.unhold_exp_date, dss.mes_map_sloc, dss.mes_hold_yn, dss.mes_unhold_date
             , dss.qms_hold_date, dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, dss.qms_unhold_date
             , NULL                                             AS location_code
             , dss.mes_item_id, dss.mes_operation_id, dss.from_sloc_id, dss.customer_id, dss.special_stock_indicator
          FROM scm_dnm_stock_sn dss
          LEFT JOIN scp_mst_final_item fi
            ON dss.division_id = fi.division_id
           AND dss.item_id     = fi.item_id
          LEFT JOIN scm_mst_site ms
            ON dss.division_id = ms.division_id
           AND (dss.outsourcing_factory = ms.plant_id
             OR FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(ms.hq_vendor_code, '-') LIKE '%' || dss.outsourcing_factory || '%')
           AND ms.valid_yn = 'Y'
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT ms.company_id, ip.division_id, ms.plant_id, ms.site_id, ms.scm_site_id
                          , ip.item_id, ip.from_yyyymmdd, ip.to_yyyymmdd
                       FROM scm_mst_site ms
                       JOIN scm_mst_site_item_priority ip
                         ON ms.division_id = ip.division_id
                        AND ms.scm_site_id = ip.plant_site_id
                      WHERE ms.osp_yn = 'Y' AND ms.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ip.valid_yn = 'Y') ip
            ON dss.division_id = ip.division_id
           AND dss.site_id     = ip.site_id
           AND dss.outsourcing_factory = ip.plant_id
           AND FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) = ip.item_id
           AND (TO_CHAR(dss.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN ip.from_yyyymmdd AND ip.to_yyyymmdd)
         WHERE dss.stock_type = 'SUPPLY'

        --------------------------- Storage 별 일반 재고 (ERP) : AS Plant 제외
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CASE WHEN dss.company_id = 'WA00' AND dss.storage_id = 'Z799' THEN 'Ford_US_RDF'
                    WHEN dss.special_stock_indicator IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
                    WHEN dss.plant_id   = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'PLANT')
                     AND dss.storage_id = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'SLOC')
                     AND FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'MODEL')
                        THEN FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(site.SCM_SITE_ID, md.segment2), packer.scm_site_id)
                    WHEN dss.plant_id   = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'PLANT')
                     AND dss.storage_id = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'SLOC')
                     AND FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) <> FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'MODEL')
                        THEN NULL
                    ELSE FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(site.SCM_SITE_ID, md.segment2), packer.scm_site_id)
               END                                              AS scm_site_id
             , qty2                                             AS scm_qty
             , dss.company_id, dss.division_id, dss.site_id, dss.plant_id, dss.factory_id, dss.storage_id
             , dss.cutoff_date, dss.seq
             , CASE WHEN dss.special_stock_indicator IS NOT NULL THEN dss.stock_type || '_' || dss.special_stock_indicator
                    ELSE dss.stock_type END                     AS stock_type
             , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) AS item_id
             , dss.item_id                                      AS origin_item_id
             , dss.lane, dss.production_type
             , CASE WHEN NVL(site.location_code, ' ') = 'CELL_INV_HOLD'                                                        THEN dss.cutoff_date
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'N'                                                                            THEN NVL(dss.available_date, dss.cutoff_date - 1)
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND dss.unhold_exp_date IS NULL AND dss.qms_unhold_exp_date IS NULL         THEN NULL
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') >= NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.unhold_exp_date
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') <  NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.qms_unhold_exp_date
                    ELSE dss.available_date
               END                                              AS available_date
             , dss.remain_lead_time, dss.holding_date, dss.qty, dss.qty_uom, dss.stock_status
             , dss.operation_id
             , dss.operation_id                                 AS operation_id_org
             , dss.line_id, dss.outsourcing_flag, dss.outsourcing_factory, dss.description
             , dss.fp_apply_operation_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id, dss.fp_apply_wipqty
             , CASE WHEN NVL(site.location_code, ' ') = 'CELL_INV_HOLD' THEN 'Y' ELSE dss.wiphold_yn END AS wiphold_yn
             , dss.qms_hold_yn, dss.wip_type_code, dss.qty2
             , dss.modify_fp_apply_wipqty, dss.modify_description, dss.cal_qty, dss.formation_rework_type
             , dss.insert_id, dss.insert_time, dss.update_id, dss.update_time, dss.location, dss.moving_qty
             , dss.capa_grd_code, dss.vltg_grd_code, dss.rsst_grd_code
             , NVL(dss.defect_qty, 0) + NVL(dss.restrict_qty, 0) AS defect_qty
             , dss.unhold_exp_date, dss.mes_map_sloc, dss.mes_hold_yn, dss.mes_unhold_date
             , dss.qms_hold_date, dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, dss.qms_unhold_date
             , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(site.location_code, NULL)         AS location_code
             , dss.mes_item_id, dss.mes_operation_id, dss.from_sloc_id, dss.customer_id, dss.special_stock_indicator
          FROM scm_dnm_stock_sn dss
          LEFT JOIN scp_mst_final_item fi
            ON dss.division_id = fi.division_id
           AND dss.item_id     = fi.item_id
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ms.company_id, ms.division_id, ms.site_id, ml.factory_id
                          , CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MST_SLOC SLOC
                                                   WHERE SLOC.DIVISION_ID = ML.DIVISION_ID AND SLOC.STORAGE_ID = ML.STORAGE_ID AND SLOC.PLANT_ID = ML.PLANT_ID)
                                  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MST_SLOC SLOC
                                               WHERE SLOC.DIVISION_ID = ML.DIVISION_ID AND SLOC.STORAGE_ID = ML.STORAGE_ID
                                                 AND SLOC.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT3 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LOOK_REF
                                                                        WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND LOOK_REF.SEGMENT2 = ML.PLANT_ID))
                                 THEN (SELECT PLANT_ID FROM SCM_MST_SLOC SLOC
                                        WHERE SLOC.DIVISION_ID = ML.DIVISION_ID AND SLOC.STORAGE_ID = ML.STORAGE_ID
                                          AND SLOC.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT3 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LOOK_REF
                                                                 WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND LOOK_REF.SEGMENT2 = ML.PLANT_ID)
                                          AND ROWNUM = 1)
                                 ELSE ml.plant_id END           AS PLANT_ID
                          , ml.storage_id, ms.scm_site_id, ml.location_code
                          , CASE ml.location_code WHEN 'CELL_OWMS' THEN 'A' WHEN 'PACK_OWMS' THEN 'P' ELSE '%' END operation_group
                       FROM scm_mst_site ms
                       JOIN scm_mst_location ml
                         ON ms.division_id = ml.division_id
                        AND ms.scm_site_id = ml.scm_site_id
                      WHERE ms.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ml.valid_yn = 'Y'
                        AND ml.storage_id IS NOT NULL
                        AND (ml.location_code NOT IN ('CELL_OWMS', 'PACK_OWMS')
                          OR (ml.plant_id = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'PLANT') AND ml.storage_id = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'SLOC')))
                        AND ms.vmi_yn = CASE ms.division_id WHEN '40' THEN 'N' ELSE ms.vmi_yn END) site
            ON dss.division_id = site.division_id
           AND dss.site_id     = FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(site.site_id, dss.site_id)
           AND dss.plant_id    = site.plant_id
           AND dss.storage_id  = site.storage_id
           AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id)) LIKE site.operation_group
           AND 'Y' = CASE WHEN site.location_code = 'PANCAKE_INV' AND fi.operation_group = 'A' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END
          LEFT JOIN scm_adm_lookup_master_detail md
            ON dss.plant_id   = md.segment1
           AND dss.storage_id = md.segment3
           AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, dss.item_id) = 'E'
           AND md.lookup_type = 'ELECTRODE_SHIP_SITE'
           AND md.valid_yn    = 'Y'
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT ip.division_id, os.plant_id, os.scm_site_id, os.storage_id, ip.item_id, ip.from_yyyymmdd, ip.to_yyyymmdd
                       FROM scm_mst_osp_sloc os
                       JOIN scm_mst_site_item_priority ip
                         ON os.division_id = ip.division_id
                        AND os.scm_site_id = ip.plant_site_id
                      WHERE os.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ip.valid_yn = 'Y') packer
            ON dss.division_id = packer.division_id
           AND dss.plant_id    = packer.plant_id
           AND dss.storage_id  = packer.storage_id
           AND FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) = packer.item_id
           AND (TO_CHAR(dss.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN packer.from_yyyymmdd AND packer.to_yyyymmdd)
         WHERE dss.stock_type = 'INVENTORY'
           AND dss.plant_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT plant_id FROM scm_mst_plant_sn
                                     WHERE NVL(plant_type, 'Z') = 'SVC'
                                       AND plant_id NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT3 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail md
                                                             WHERE md.lookup_type = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND md.valid_yn = 'Y'))
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MST_PLANT_SN PL
                            WHERE NVL(PL.PLANT_TYPE, 'Z') = 'SVC'
                              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL MD
                                               WHERE MD.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND MD.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                                 AND PL.DIVISION_ID = MD.SEGMENT1 AND PL.PLANT_ID = MD.SEGMENT3)
                              AND PL.DIVISION_ID = dss.DIVISION_ID AND PL.PLANT_ID = dss.PLANT_ID)

        --------------------------- Storage 별 일반 재고 (ERP) : AS Plant
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CASE WHEN dss.special_stock_indicator IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE site.SCM_SITE_ID END AS scm_site_id
             , qty2                                             AS scm_qty
             , dss.company_id
             , NVL(foi.division_id, dss.division_id)            AS division_id
             , dss.site_id, dss.plant_id, dss.factory_id, dss.storage_id, dss.cutoff_date, dss.seq
             , CASE WHEN dss.special_stock_indicator IS NOT NULL THEN dss.stock_type || '_' || dss.special_stock_indicator
                    ELSE dss.stock_type END                     AS stock_type
             , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) AS item_id
             , dss.item_id                                      AS origin_item_id
             , dss.lane, dss.production_type
             , CASE WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'N'                                                                            THEN NVL(dss.available_date, dss.cutoff_date - 1)
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND dss.unhold_exp_date IS NULL AND dss.qms_unhold_exp_date IS NULL         THEN NULL
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') >= NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.unhold_exp_date
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') <  NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.qms_unhold_exp_date
                    ELSE dss.available_date
               END                                              AS available_date
             , dss.remain_lead_time, dss.holding_date, dss.qty, dss.qty_uom, dss.stock_status
             , dss.operation_id
             , dss.operation_id                                 AS operation_id_org
             , dss.line_id, dss.outsourcing_flag, dss.outsourcing_factory, dss.description
             , dss.fp_apply_operation_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id, dss.fp_apply_wipqty
             , dss.wiphold_yn, dss.qms_hold_yn, dss.wip_type_code, dss.qty2
             , dss.modify_fp_apply_wipqty, dss.modify_description, dss.cal_qty, dss.formation_rework_type
             , dss.insert_id, dss.insert_time, dss.update_id, dss.update_time, dss.location, dss.moving_qty
             , dss.capa_grd_code, dss.vltg_grd_code, dss.rsst_grd_code
             , NVL(dss.defect_qty, 0) + NVL(dss.restrict_qty, 0) AS defect_qty
             , dss.unhold_exp_date, dss.mes_map_sloc, dss.mes_hold_yn, dss.mes_unhold_date
             , dss.qms_hold_date, dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, dss.qms_unhold_date
             , NULL                                             AS location_code
             , dss.mes_item_id, dss.mes_operation_id, dss.from_sloc_id, dss.customer_id, dss.special_stock_indicator
          FROM scm_dnm_stock_sn dss
          LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_ORIGIN_DIV_V foi
            ON dss.item_id = foi.item_id
          LEFT JOIN scp_mst_final_item fi
            ON dss.division_id = fi.division_id
           AND dss.item_id     = fi.item_id
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT segment1 AS division_id, segment2 AS scm_site_id, segment3 AS plant_id, segment4 AS storage_id
                       FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail md
                      WHERE md.lookup_type = 'SSP_AS_DIV_SLOC' AND md.valid_yn = 'Y') site
            ON foi.division_id = site.division_id
           AND dss.plant_id    = site.plant_id
           AND dss.storage_id  = site.storage_id
         WHERE dss.stock_type = 'INVENTORY'
           AND dss.plant_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT plant_id FROM scm_mst_plant_sn WHERE NVL(plant_type, 'Z') = 'SVC')
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail md
                            WHERE md.lookup_type = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND md.valid_yn = 'Y'
                              AND NVL(foi.division_id, dss.division_id) = md.SEGMENT1 AND dss.plant_id = md.SEGMENT3)

        --------------------------- WIP 재고 (MES)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CASE WHEN dss.stock_status = 'MOVING' AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id)) = 'E'
                         THEN ms.scm_site_id
                    WHEN dss.division_id IN ('40') AND sl.scm_site_id IS NOT NULL AND sl.location_code = 'CELL_OWMS' THEN NULL
                    WHEN sl.scm_site_id IS NOT NULL THEN sl.scm_site_id
                    WHEN md2.segment2 IS NULL       THEN site.scm_site_id
                    WHEN md.segment2 IS NOT NULL    THEN site.scm_site_id
                    ELSE NULL
               END                                              AS scm_site_id
             , dss.fp_apply_wipqty                              AS scm_qty
             , dss.company_id, dss.division_id, dss.site_id, dss.plant_id, dss.factory_id, dss.storage_id
             , dss.cutoff_date, dss.seq, dss.stock_type
             , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id) AS item_id
             , dss.fp_apply_item_id                             AS origin_item_id
             , dss.lane, dss.production_type
             , CASE WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'N'                                                                            THEN NVL(dss.available_date, dss.cutoff_date - 1)
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND dss.unhold_exp_date IS NULL AND dss.qms_unhold_exp_date IS NULL         THEN NULL
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') >= NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.unhold_exp_date
                    WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') <  NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.qms_unhold_exp_date
                    ELSE dss.available_date
               END                                              AS available_date
             , dss.remain_lead_time, dss.holding_date, dss.qty, dss.qty_uom, dss.stock_status
             , dss.fp_apply_operation_id                        AS operation_id
             , dss.operation_id                                 AS operation_id_org
             , dss.line_id, dss.outsourcing_flag, dss.outsourcing_factory, dss.description
             , dss.fp_apply_operation_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id, dss.fp_apply_wipqty
             , dss.wiphold_yn, dss.qms_hold_yn, dss.wip_type_code, dss.qty2
             , dss.modify_fp_apply_wipqty, dss.modify_description, dss.cal_qty, dss.formation_rework_type
             , dss.insert_id, dss.insert_time, dss.update_id, dss.update_time, dss.location, dss.moving_qty
             , dss.capa_grd_code, dss.vltg_grd_code, dss.rsst_grd_code
             , NVL(dss.defect_qty, 0) + NVL(dss.restrict_qty, 0) AS defect_qty
             , dss.unhold_exp_date, dss.mes_map_sloc, dss.mes_hold_yn, dss.mes_unhold_date
             , dss.qms_hold_date, dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, dss.qms_unhold_date
             , CASE WHEN dss.stock_status = 'MOVING' AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id)) = 'E'
                         AND ms.operation_group = 'E' THEN 'SLITTING'
                    WHEN sl.scm_site_id IS NOT NULL THEN sl.location_code
                    WHEN md2.segment2 IS NULL       THEN site.location_code
                    WHEN md.segment2 IS NOT NULL    THEN site.location_code
                    ELSE NULL
               END                                              AS location_code
             , dss.mes_item_id, dss.mes_operation_id, dss.from_sloc_id, dss.customer_id, dss.special_stock_indicator
          FROM scm_dnm_stock_sn dss
          LEFT JOIN scp_mst_final_item fi
            ON dss.division_id      = fi.division_id
           AND dss.fp_apply_item_id = fi.item_id
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ms.company_id, ms.division_id, ms.site_id, ml.factory_id, ms.plant_id, ml.operation_id, ms.scm_site_id, ml.location_code
                       FROM scm_mst_site ms
                       JOIN scm_mst_location ml
                         ON ms.division_id = ml.division_id
                        AND ms.scm_site_id = ml.scm_site_id
                      WHERE ms.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ml.valid_yn = 'Y') site
            ON dss.company_id  = site.company_id
           AND dss.division_id = site.division_id
           AND dss.site_id     = site.site_id
           AND dss.plant_id    = site.plant_id
           AND dss.factory_id  = site.factory_id
           AND dss.fp_apply_operation_id = site.operation_id
          LEFT JOIN scm_mst_site ms
            ON dss.division_id = ms.division_id
           AND dss.plant_id    = ms.plant_id
           AND ms.site_type = 'PLANT'
           AND ms.valid_yn  = 'Y'
           AND ms.operation_group IN ('E')
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT segment2, segment3, segment4, segment5 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail
                      WHERE lookup_type = 'WIP_MES_MAP_SLOC' AND segment1 = 'WIP' AND valid_yn = 'Y') md
            ON dss.fp_apply_operation_id = md.segment2
           AND dss.mes_map_sloc = md.segment3
           AND dss.plant_id     = md.segment4
           AND dss.factory_id   = md.segment5
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT segment2, segment4, segment5 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail
                      WHERE lookup_type = 'WIP_MES_MAP_SLOC' AND segment1 = 'WIP' AND valid_yn = 'Y') md2
            ON dss.fp_apply_operation_id = md2.segment2
           AND dss.plant_id     = md2.segment4
           AND dss.factory_id   = md2.segment5
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ms.company_id, ms.division_id, ms.site_id, ml.factory_id, ml.plant_id, ml.storage_id, ms.scm_site_id, ml.location_code
                          , CASE ml.location_code WHEN 'CELL_OWMS' THEN 'A' WHEN 'PACK_OWMS' THEN 'P' ELSE '%' END operation_group
                       FROM scm_mst_site ms
                       JOIN scm_mst_location ml
                         ON ms.division_id = ml.division_id
                        AND ms.scm_site_id = ml.scm_site_id
                      WHERE ms.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ml.valid_yn = 'Y'
                        AND ml.location_code IN ('CELL_OWMS', 'PACK_OWMS')
                        AND ms.vmi_yn = CASE ms.division_id WHEN '40' THEN 'N' ELSE ms.vmi_yn END) sl
            ON dss.company_id  = FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(sl.company_id, dss.company_id)
           AND dss.division_id = sl.division_id
           AND dss.site_id     = FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(sl.site_id, dss.site_id)
           AND dss.plant_id    = sl.plant_id
           AND CASE WHEN dss.from_sloc_id IS NOT NULL THEN dss.from_sloc_id ELSE dss.mes_map_sloc END = sl.storage_id
           AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id)) LIKE sl.operation_group
         WHERE dss.stock_type = 'WIP'

        --------------------------- OWMS 재고
        UNION ALL
        SELECT CASE WHEN owm.plant_id   = (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'SCM_DNM_STOCK_V' AND SEGMENT1 = 'PLANT' AND ROWNUM = 1)
                     AND owm.storage_id = (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'SCM_DNM_STOCK_V' AND SEGMENT1 = 'SLOC' AND ROWNUM = 1)
                     AND owm.item_id    = (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'SCM_DNM_STOCK_V' AND SEGMENT1 = 'MODEL' AND ROWNUM = 1)
                        THEN NULL
                    WHEN as_site.scm_site_id IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
                    WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL              THEN NVL(sl.scm_site_id, site.scm_site_id)
                    ELSE NVL(sl.scm_site_id, site.scm_site_id)
               END                                              AS scm_site_id
             , CASE WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) <= 0 THEN owm.stock_qty
                    WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) >  0 THEN owm.BLOCK_QTY
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.stock_status IN ('20', '40', '50') THEN owm.block_qty
                    ELSE owm.stock_qty
               END                                              AS scm_qty
             , CASE WHEN sl.company_id IS NULL THEN NVL(site.company_id, '-') ELSE sl.company_id END AS company_id
             , owm.origin_from_division_id                     AS division_id
             , CASE WHEN sl.site_id IS NULL THEN NVL(site.site_id, '-') ELSE sl.site_id END AS site_id
             , owm.plant_id
             , CASE WHEN sl.factory_id IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE sl.factory_id END AS factory_id
             , owm.storage_id
             , TO_DATE(owm.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1         AS cutoff_date
             , NULL                                             AS seq
             , 'OWMS'                                           AS stock_type
             , owm.item_id                                      AS item_id
             , owm.item_id                                      AS origin_item_id
             , NULL                                             AS lane
             , NULL                                             AS production_type
             , CASE WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) <= 0 THEN TO_DATE(owm.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                    WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) >  0 THEN TO_DATE(owm.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') IN ('PASS') THEN TO_DATE(owm.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') IN ('FAIL') THEN TO_DATE(lt.horizon_end_date, 'YYYYMMDD')
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.stock_status = '70'                THEN TO_DATE(owm.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.stock_status IN ('20', '40', '50') THEN TO_DATE(lt.horizon_end_date, 'YYYYMMDD')
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.attribute4 IS NOT NULL             THEN TO_DATE(owm.attribute4, 'YYYYMMDD')
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.attribute4 IS NULL                 THEN TO_DATE(owm.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
                    ELSE TO_DATE(owm.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') + 1
               END                                              AS available_date
             , NULL AS remain_lead_time
             , NULL AS holding_date
             , NULL AS qty
             , 'EA' AS qty_uom
             , NULL AS stock_status
             , NULL AS operation_id
             , NULL AS operation_id_org
             , NULL AS line_id
             , 'N'  AS outsourcing_flag
             , NULL AS outsourcing_factory
             , NULL AS description
             , NULL AS fp_apply_operation_id
             , NULL AS fp_apply_item_id
             , NULL AS fp_apply_wipqty
             , CASE WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) <= 0 THEN 'N'
                    WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) >  0 THEN 'Y'
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') IN ('PASS') THEN 'N'
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') IN ('FAIL') THEN 'Y'
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.stock_status = '70'                THEN 'N'
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.stock_status IN ('20', '40', '50') THEN 'Y'
                    ELSE 'Y'
               END                                              AS wiphold_yn
             , 'N'  AS qms_hold_yn
             , CASE WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) <= 0 THEN 'INSP_COM'
                    WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) >  0 THEN 'INSP_COM'
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') IN ('PASS') THEN 'INSP_COM'
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') IN ('FAIL') THEN 'INSP_HOLD'
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.stock_status = '70'                THEN 'INSP_COM'
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.stock_status IN ('20', '40', '50') THEN 'INSP_HOLD'
                    ELSE 'INSP_PRE'
               END                                              AS wip_type_code
             , CASE WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) <= 0 THEN owm.stock_qty
                    WHEN lt.item_id IS NULL AND NVL(owm.BLOCK_QTY, 0) >  0 THEN owm.BLOCK_QTY
                    WHEN NVL(owm.attribute3, ' ') NOT IN ('PASS', 'FAIL') AND owm.stock_status IN ('20', '40', '50') THEN owm.block_qty
                    ELSE owm.stock_qty
               END                                              AS qty2
             , NULL AS modify_fp_apply_wipqty
             , NULL AS modify_description
             , NULL AS cal_qty
             , NULL AS formation_rework_type
             , owm.created_by, owm.creation_date, owm.last_updated_by, owm.last_update_date
             , NULL AS location
             , NULL AS moving_qty
             , NULL AS capa_grd_code
             , NULL AS vltg_grd_code
             , NULL AS rsst_grd_code
             , NULL AS defect_qty
             , NULL AS unhold_exp_date
             , NULL AS mes_map_sloc
             , 'N'  AS mes_hold_yn
             , NULL AS mes_unhold_date
             , NULL AS qms_hold_date
             , NULL AS qms_unhold_exp_date
             , NULL AS qms_unhold_date
             , NVL(sl.location_code, NULL)                      AS location_code
             , NULL AS mes_item_id
             , NULL AS mes_operation_id
             , NULL AS from_sloc_id
             , NULL AS customer_id
             , NULL AS special_stock_indicator
          FROM ssp_dnm_owms_stock owm
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ms.company_id, ms.division_id, ms.site_id, ml.factory_id, ml.plant_id, ml.storage_id, ms.scm_site_id, ml.location_code
                          , CASE ml.location_code WHEN 'CELL_OWMS' THEN 'A' WHEN 'PACK_OWMS' THEN 'P' ELSE '%' END operation_group
                       FROM scm_mst_site ms
                       JOIN scm_mst_location ml
                         ON ms.division_id = ml.division_id
                        AND ms.scm_site_id = ml.scm_site_id
                      WHERE ms.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ml.valid_yn = 'Y'
                        AND ml.location_code IN ('CELL_OWMS', 'PACK_OWMS')
                        AND ms.vmi_yn = CASE ms.division_id WHEN '40' THEN 'N' ELSE ms.vmi_yn END) sl
            ON owm.origin_from_division_id = sl.division_id
           AND owm.plant_id    = sl.plant_id
           AND owm.storage_id  = sl.storage_id
           AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(owm.origin_from_division_id, owm.item_id) LIKE sl.operation_group
          LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SITE SITE
            ON OWM.origin_from_division_id = SITE.DIVISION_ID
           AND OWM.PLANT_ID    = SITE.PLANT_ID
           AND SITE.OPERATION_GROUP = 'W'
           AND SITE.SITE_TYPE       = 'PLANT'
           AND SITE.VALID_YN        = 'Y'
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT ms.division_id, mo.scm_site_id, mo.item_id, mo.lt_operation, NVL(mo.attribute1, 'N') attribute1, mo.lt_day
                          , NVL(mp.horizon_end_date, TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')) horizon_end_date
                       FROM scp_mst_operation_lt mo
                       JOIN scm_mst_site ms
                         ON mo.division_id  = ms.division_id
                        AND mo.scm_site_id  = ms.scm_site_id
                        AND mo.lt_operation = 'PRE_INSP'
                        AND NVL(mo.attribute1, 'N') = 'Y'
                       LEFT JOIN scm_mst_plan mp
                         ON mo.division_id = mp.division_id
                        AND mp.plan_name   = TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(SYSDATE, 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
                        AND mp.plan_cycle  = 'WEEKLY') lt
            ON lt.division_id  = owm.origin_from_division_id
           AND lt.scm_site_id = NVL(sl.scm_site_id, site.scm_site_id)
           AND lt.item_id     = owm.item_id
           AND lt.lt_operation = 'PRE_INSP'
           AND lt.attribute1   = 'Y'
          LEFT JOIN (SELECT segment1 AS division_id, segment2 AS scm_site_id, segment3 AS plant_id, segment4 AS storage_id
                       FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail md
                      WHERE md.lookup_type = 'SSP_AS_DIV_SLOC' AND md.valid_yn = 'Y') as_site
            ON owm.origin_from_division_id = as_site.division_id
           AND owm.plant_id    = as_site.plant_id
           AND owm.storage_id  = as_site.storage_id

             , JV.modify_fp_apply_wipqty, JV.modify_description, JV.cal_qty, JV.formation_rework_type
             , JV.insert_id, JV.insert_time, JV.update_id, JV.update_time, JV.location, JV.moving_qty
             , JV.capa_grd_code, JV.vltg_grd_code, JV.rsst_grd_code, JV.defect_qty
             , JV.unhold_exp_date, JV.mes_map_sloc, JV.mes_hold_yn, JV.mes_unhold_date
             , JV.qms_hold_date, JV.qms_unhold_exp_date, JV.qms_unhold_date, JV.location_code
             , JV.mes_item_id, JV.mes_operation_id, JV.from_sloc_id, JV.customer_id, JV.special_stock_indicator
          FROM (
                -- ESS 가상 : Storage 별 일반 재고 (ERP)
                SELECT CASE WHEN dss.company_id = 'WA00' AND dss.storage_id = 'Z799' THEN 'Ford_US_RDF'
                            WHEN dss.special_stock_indicator IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
                            WHEN dss.plant_id   = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'PLANT')
                             AND dss.storage_id = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'SLOC')
                             AND FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'MODEL')
                                THEN FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(site.SCM_SITE_ID, md.segment2), packer.scm_site_id)
                            WHEN dss.plant_id   = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'PLANT')
                             AND dss.storage_id = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'SLOC')
                             AND FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) <> FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'MODEL')
                                THEN NULL
                            ELSE FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(site.SCM_SITE_ID, md.segment2), packer.scm_site_id)
                       END                                      AS scm_site_id
                     , qty2                                     AS scm_qty
                     , dss.company_id, dss.division_id, dss.site_id, dss.plant_id, dss.factory_id, dss.storage_id
                     , dss.cutoff_date, dss.seq
                     , CASE WHEN dss.special_stock_indicator IS NOT NULL THEN dss.stock_type || '_' || dss.special_stock_indicator ELSE dss.stock_type END AS stock_type
                     , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) AS item_id
                     , dss.item_id                              AS origin_item_id
                     , dss.lane, dss.production_type
                     , CASE WHEN NVL(site.location_code, ' ') = 'CELL_INV_HOLD'                                                        THEN dss.cutoff_date
                            WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'N'                                                                            THEN NVL(dss.available_date, dss.cutoff_date - 1)
                            WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND dss.unhold_exp_date IS NULL AND dss.qms_unhold_exp_date IS NULL         THEN NULL
                            WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') >= NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.unhold_exp_date
                            WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') <  NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.qms_unhold_exp_date
                            ELSE dss.available_date
                       END                                      AS available_date
                     , dss.remain_lead_time, dss.holding_date, dss.qty, dss.qty_uom, dss.stock_status
                     , dss.operation_id
                     , dss.operation_id                         AS operation_id_org
                     , dss.line_id, dss.outsourcing_flag, dss.outsourcing_factory, dss.description
                     , dss.fp_apply_operation_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id, dss.fp_apply_wipqty
                     , CASE WHEN NVL(site.location_code, ' ') = 'CELL_INV_HOLD' THEN 'Y' ELSE dss.wiphold_yn END AS wiphold_yn
                     , dss.qms_hold_yn, dss.wip_type_code, dss.qty2
                     , dss.modify_fp_apply_wipqty, dss.modify_description, dss.cal_qty, dss.formation_rework_type
                     , dss.insert_id, dss.insert_time, dss.update_id, dss.update_time, dss.location, dss.moving_qty
                     , dss.capa_grd_code, dss.vltg_grd_code, dss.rsst_grd_code
                     , NVL(dss.defect_qty, 0) + NVL(dss.restrict_qty, 0) AS defect_qty
                     , dss.unhold_exp_date, dss.mes_map_sloc, dss.mes_hold_yn, dss.mes_unhold_date
                     , dss.qms_hold_date, dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, dss.qms_unhold_date
                     , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(site.location_code, NULL) AS location_code
                     , dss.mes_item_id, dss.mes_operation_id, dss.from_sloc_id, dss.customer_id, dss.special_stock_indicator
                  FROM scm_dnm_stock_sn dss
                  LEFT JOIN scp_mst_final_item fi
                    ON dss.division_id = fi.division_id
                   AND dss.item_id     = fi.item_id
                  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ms.company_id, ms.division_id, ms.site_id, ml.factory_id
                                  , CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MST_SLOC SLOC
                                                           WHERE SLOC.DIVISION_ID = ML.DIVISION_ID AND SLOC.STORAGE_ID = ML.STORAGE_ID AND SLOC.PLANT_ID = ML.PLANT_ID)
                                          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MST_SLOC SLOC
                                                       WHERE SLOC.DIVISION_ID = ML.DIVISION_ID AND SLOC.STORAGE_ID = ML.STORAGE_ID
                                                         AND SLOC.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT3 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LOOK_REF
                                                                                WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND LOOK_REF.SEGMENT2 = ML.PLANT_ID))
                                         THEN (SELECT PLANT_ID FROM SCM_MST_SLOC SLOC
                                                WHERE SLOC.DIVISION_ID = ML.DIVISION_ID AND SLOC.STORAGE_ID = ML.STORAGE_ID
                                                  AND SLOC.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT3 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LOOK_REF
                                                                         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND LOOK_REF.SEGMENT2 = ML.PLANT_ID)
                                                  AND ROWNUM = 1)
                                         ELSE ml.plant_id END   AS PLANT_ID
                                  , ml.storage_id, ms.scm_site_id, ml.location_code
                                  , CASE ml.location_code WHEN 'CELL_OWMS' THEN 'A' WHEN 'PACK_OWMS' THEN 'P' ELSE '%' END operation_group
                               FROM scm_mst_site ms
                               JOIN scm_mst_location ml
                                 ON ms.division_id = ml.division_id
                                AND ms.scm_site_id = ml.scm_site_id
                              WHERE ms.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ml.valid_yn = 'Y'
                                AND ml.storage_id IS NOT NULL
                                AND (ml.location_code NOT IN ('CELL_OWMS', 'PACK_OWMS')
                                  OR (ml.plant_id = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'PLANT') AND ml.storage_id = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCM_DNM_STOCK_V', 'SLOC')))
                                AND ms.vmi_yn = CASE ms.division_id WHEN '40' THEN 'N' ELSE ms.vmi_yn END) site
                    ON dss.division_id = site.division_id
                   AND dss.site_id     = FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(site.site_id, dss.site_id)
                   AND dss.plant_id    = site.plant_id
                   AND dss.storage_id  = site.storage_id
                   AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id)) LIKE site.operation_group
                   AND 'Y' = CASE WHEN site.location_code = 'PANCAKE_INV' AND fi.operation_group = 'A' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END
                  LEFT JOIN scm_adm_lookup_master_detail md
                    ON dss.plant_id   = md.segment1
                   AND dss.storage_id = md.segment3
                   AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, dss.item_id) = 'E'
                   AND md.lookup_type = 'ELECTRODE_SHIP_SITE'
                   AND md.valid_yn    = 'Y'
                  LEFT JOIN (SELECT ip.division_id, os.plant_id, os.scm_site_id, os.storage_id, ip.item_id, ip.from_yyyymmdd, ip.to_yyyymmdd
                               FROM scm_mst_osp_sloc os
                               JOIN scm_mst_site_item_priority ip
                                 ON os.division_id = ip.division_id
                                AND os.scm_site_id = ip.plant_site_id
                              WHERE os.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ip.valid_yn = 'Y') packer
                    ON dss.division_id = packer.division_id
                   AND dss.plant_id    = packer.plant_id
                   AND dss.storage_id  = packer.storage_id
                   AND FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id) = packer.item_id
                   AND (TO_CHAR(dss.cutoff_date, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN packer.from_yyyymmdd AND packer.to_yyyymmdd)
                 WHERE dss.stock_type = 'INVENTORY'
                   AND dss.plant_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT plant_id FROM scm_mst_plant_sn
                                             WHERE NVL(plant_type, 'Z') = 'SVC'
                                               AND plant_id NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT3 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail md
                                                                     WHERE md.lookup_type = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND md.valid_yn = 'Y'))
                   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_MST_PLANT_SN PL
                                    WHERE NVL(PL.PLANT_TYPE, 'Z') = 'SVC'
                                      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL MD
                                                       WHERE MD.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'PLANT_SLOC_REF' AND MD.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                                         AND PL.DIVISION_ID = MD.SEGMENT1 AND PL.PLANT_ID = MD.SEGMENT3)
                                      AND PL.DIVISION_ID = dss.DIVISION_ID AND PL.PLANT_ID = dss.PLANT_ID)

                UNION ALL
                -- ESS 가상 : WIP 재고 (MES)
                SELECT CASE WHEN dss.stock_status = 'MOVING' AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id)) = 'E'
                                 THEN ms.scm_site_id
                            WHEN dss.division_id IN ('40') AND sl.scm_site_id IS NOT NULL AND sl.location_code = 'CELL_OWMS' THEN NULL
                            WHEN sl.scm_site_id IS NOT NULL THEN sl.scm_site_id
                            WHEN md2.segment2 IS NULL       THEN site.scm_site_id
                            WHEN md.segment2 IS NOT NULL    THEN site.scm_site_id
                            ELSE NULL
                       END                                      AS scm_site_id
                     , dss.fp_apply_wipqty                      AS scm_qty
                     , dss.company_id, dss.division_id, dss.site_id, dss.plant_id, dss.factory_id, dss.storage_id
                     , dss.cutoff_date, dss.seq, dss.stock_type
                     , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id) AS item_id
                     , dss.fp_apply_item_id                     AS origin_item_id
                     , dss.lane, dss.production_type
                     , CASE WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'N'                                                                            THEN NVL(dss.available_date, dss.cutoff_date - 1)
                            WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND dss.unhold_exp_date IS NULL AND dss.qms_unhold_exp_date IS NULL         THEN NULL
                            WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') >= NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.unhold_exp_date
                            WHEN NVL(wiphold_yn, 'N') = 'Y' AND NVL(dss.unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') <  NVL(dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, DATE '1999-01-01') THEN dss.qms_unhold_exp_date
                            ELSE dss.available_date
                       END                                      AS available_date
                     , dss.remain_lead_time, dss.holding_date, dss.qty, dss.qty_uom, dss.stock_status
                     , dss.fp_apply_operation_id                AS operation_id
                     , dss.operation_id                         AS operation_id_org
                     , dss.line_id, dss.outsourcing_flag, dss.outsourcing_factory, dss.description
                     , dss.fp_apply_operation_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id, dss.fp_apply_wipqty
                     , dss.wiphold_yn, dss.qms_hold_yn, dss.wip_type_code, dss.qty2
                     , dss.modify_fp_apply_wipqty, dss.modify_description, dss.cal_qty, dss.formation_rework_type
                     , dss.insert_id, dss.insert_time, dss.update_id, dss.update_time, dss.location, dss.moving_qty
                     , dss.capa_grd_code, dss.vltg_grd_code, dss.rsst_grd_code
                     , NVL(dss.defect_qty, 0) + NVL(dss.restrict_qty, 0) AS defect_qty
                     , dss.unhold_exp_date, dss.mes_map_sloc, dss.mes_hold_yn, dss.mes_unhold_date
                     , dss.qms_hold_date, dss.qms_unhold_exp_date, dss.qms_unhold_date
                     , CASE WHEN dss.stock_status = 'MOVING' AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.fp_apply_item_id)) = 'E'
                                 AND ms.operation_group = 'E' THEN 'SLITTING'
                            WHEN sl.scm_site_id IS NOT NULL THEN sl.location_code
                            WHEN md2.segment2 IS NULL       THEN site.location_code
                            WHEN md.segment2 IS NOT NULL    THEN site.location_code
                            ELSE NULL
                       END                                      AS location_code
                     , dss.mes_item_id, dss.mes_operation_id, dss.from_sloc_id, dss.customer_id, dss.special_stock_indicator
                  FROM scm_dnm_stock_sn dss
                  LEFT JOIN scp_mst_final_item fi
                    ON dss.division_id      = fi.division_id
                   AND dss.fp_apply_item_id = fi.item_id
                  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ms.company_id, ms.division_id, ms.site_id, ml.factory_id, ms.plant_id, ml.operation_id, ms.scm_site_id, ml.location_code
                               FROM scm_mst_site ms
                               JOIN scm_mst_location ml
                                 ON ms.division_id = ml.division_id
                                AND ms.scm_site_id = ml.scm_site_id
                              WHERE ms.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ml.valid_yn = 'Y') site
                    ON dss.company_id  = site.company_id
                   AND dss.division_id = site.division_id
                   AND dss.site_id     = site.site_id
                   AND dss.plant_id    = site.plant_id
                   AND dss.factory_id  = site.factory_id
                   AND dss.fp_apply_operation_id = site.operation_id
                  LEFT JOIN scm_mst_site ms
                    ON dss.division_id = ms.division_id
                   AND dss.plant_id    = ms.plant_id
                   AND ms.site_type = 'PLANT'
                   AND ms.valid_yn  = 'Y'
                   AND ms.operation_group IN ('E')
                  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT segment2, segment3, segment4, segment5 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail
                              WHERE lookup_type = 'WIP_MES_MAP_SLOC' AND segment1 = 'WIP' AND valid_yn = 'Y') md
                    ON dss.fp_apply_operation_id = md.segment2
                   AND dss.mes_map_sloc = md.segment3
                   AND dss.plant_id     = md.segment4
                   AND dss.factory_id   = md.segment5
                  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT segment2, segment4, segment5 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail
                              WHERE lookup_type = 'WIP_MES_MAP_SLOC' AND segment1 = 'WIP' AND valid_yn = 'Y') md2
                    ON dss.fp_apply_operation_id = md2.segment2
                   AND dss.plant_id     = md2.segment4
                   AND dss.factory_id   = md2.segment5
                  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ms.company_id, ms.division_id, ms.site_id, ml.factory_id, ml.plant_id, ml.storage_id, ms.scm_site_id, ml.location_code
                                  , CASE ml.location_code WHEN 'CELL_OWMS' THEN 'A' WHEN 'PACK_OWMS' THEN 'P' ELSE '%' END operation_group
                               FROM scm_mst_site ms
                               JOIN scm_mst_location ml
                                 ON ms.division_id = ml.division_id
                                AND ms.scm_site_id = ml.scm_site_id
                              WHERE ms.valid_yn = 'Y' AND ml.valid_yn = 'Y'
                                AND ml.location_code IN ('CELL_OWMS', 'PACK_OWMS')
                                AND ms.vmi_yn = CASE ms.division_id WHEN '40' THEN 'N' ELSE ms.vmi_yn END) sl
                    ON dss.company_id  = FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(sl.company_id, dss.company_id)
                   AND dss.division_id = sl.division_id
                   AND dss.site_id     = FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(sl.site_id, dss.site_id)
                   AND dss.plant_id    = sl.plant_id
                   AND CASE WHEN dss.from_sloc_id IS NOT NULL THEN dss.from_sloc_id ELSE dss.mes_map_sloc END = sl.storage_id
                   AND FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(dss.division_id, FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(fi.packer_plan_item_id, dss.item_id)) LIKE sl.operation_group
                 WHERE dss.stock_type = 'WIP'
               ) JV
          INNER JOIN JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_SITE_MAP SM
             ON SM.RP_COMPANY_ID  = JV.COMPANY_ID
            AND SM.RP_DIVISION_ID = JV.DIVISION_ID
            AND SM.RP_SITE_ID     = JV.SITE_ID
            AND SM.RP_PLANT_ID    = JV.PLANT_ID
            AND SM.RP_SCM_SITE_ID = JV.SCM_SITE_ID
          LEFT JOIN JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP LM
             ON LM.RL_COMPANY_ID  = JV.COMPANY_ID
            AND LM.RL_DIVISION_ID = JV.DIVISION_ID
            AND LM.RL_SITE_ID     = JV.SITE_ID
            AND LM.RL_PLANT_ID    = JV.PLANT_ID
            AND LM.RL_FACTORY_ID  = JV.FACTORY_ID
            AND LM.RL_LINE_ID     = JV.LINE_ID
         WHERE 1 = 1
       ) STOCK
  INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION DM
     ON DM.DIVISION_ID = STOCK.DIVISION_ID
    AND DM.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
  LEFT JOIN SCP_EXC_ITEM_ASSY_MAP EX
     ON EX.COMPANY_ID      = STOCK.COMPANY_ID
    AND EX.DIVISION_ID     = STOCK.DIVISION_ID
    AND EX.SITE_ID         = STOCK.SITE_ID
    AND EX.PLANT_ID        = STOCK.PLANT_ID
    AND EX.SCP_EXC_ITEM_ID = STOCK.ITEM_ID
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND (STOCK.stock_type = 'VMI_LT'
     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm_adm_lookup_master_detail md
                     WHERE md.lookup_type = 'VMI_LT_SITE' AND md.valid_yn = 'Y'
                       AND md.segment1 = STOCK.division_id
                       AND md.segment2 = NVL(STOCK.scm_site_id, ' ')))

NAME: SCM_DNM_STOCK_WIP_HOLD_V

NAME: SCM_DNM_WEEK_PLAN_FROZEN_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCM_DNM_WEEK_PLAN_FROZEN_V
 * Description  : FP 당주 확정 계획 정보 : 당주 월요일 기준으로 과거 일자는 실적임 : 당주는 전부 계획임
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2023.03.13   KSG            Initial Release : PJ20230691  SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
       FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(A.PLANT_ID
                              , (SELECT SA.SCP_OPERATION_GROUP
                                   FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN SA
                                  WHERE SA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                                    AND SA.ITEM_ID     = NVL(B.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID)
                                    AND ROWNUM         = 1)) AS SCM_SITE_ID
     , A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.SITE_ID
     , A.PLANT_ID
     , A.FACTORY_ID
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.LOCATION
     , A.TOP_ITEM_ID
     , NVL(B.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID, A.ITEM_ID)  AS ITEM_ID
     , A.ITEM_ID                              AS ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
     , A.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
     , A.MARKET
     , A.LINE_ID
     , A.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , A.PLAN_DATE
     , A.PLAN_QTY                                                          /* OUT 수량 */
     , CASE WHEN A.PLAN_IN_QTY <= 0 THEN A.PLAN_QTY ELSE A.PLAN_IN_QTY END AS PLAN_IN_QTY  /* IN 수량 */
     , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM SCM_DNM_FP_WEEK_RELEASE_PLAN_V_SN A
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM                  B
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID(+)
   AND NVL(A.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE, '-') NOT IN ('TEST', 'REWORK', 'M/C')
   /* TEST : 공장 내부 Test  'M/C' : 형교환계획 */

NAME: SCM_KPI_DIO_DW_V

SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCM_KPI_DIO_DW_V
 * Description  : KPI DIO : DW용
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2022.04.28   KSG            Initial Release : PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : GM JV
 * 2023.04.03	HRK			   PJ20230691R LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응
 * 2026.07.04   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 *
 */
 /* HM JV CASE WHEN DIVISION_ID = '81_UC' THEN '81' ELSE DIVISION_ID END AS DIVISION_ID */
         D.ATTRIBUTE3    AS DIVISION_ID    /* HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
       , K.ITEM_ID
       , K.YYYYMM

       , K.QTY
       , K.DIO_QTY

       , K.LAST_UPDATED_BY

       , K.ATTRIBUTE1
       , K.ATTRIBUTE2

       , K.ATTRIBUTE4
       , K.ATTRIBUTE5
       , K.ATTRIBUTE6
       , K.ATTRIBUTE7
       , K.ATTRIBUTE8

       , K.ATTRIBUTE10
       , K.DIVISION_ID AS SCM_DIVISION_ID
  FROM   SCM_KPI_DIO K

NAME: SCM_KPI_ITEM_DW_V

/*

 * 2022.04.28   KSG            Initial Release : PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : GM JV

 /* HM JV CASE WHEN DIVISION_ID = '81_UC' THEN '81' ELSE DIVISION_ID END AS DIVISION_ID */
