NAME: SCM_KPI_ITEM_V
TEXT:
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.ITEM_ID
     , MAX(A.ITEM_NAME) AS ITEM_NAME
     , MAX(A.NICK_NAME) AS NICK_NAME
     , CASE MIN(CASE WHEN A.ITEM_TYPE = 'P' THEN 1
                     WHEN A.ITEM_TYPE = 'H' THEN 2
                     WHEN A.ITEM_TYPE = 'Q' THEN 3
                     ELSE 4
                END)
            WHEN 1 THEN 'P'
            WHEN 2 THEN 'H'
            WHEN 3 THEN 'Q'
            ELSE 'R'
       END AS ITEM_TYPE
     , CASE MIN(CASE WHEN A.ITEM_TYPE = 'P' THEN 1
                     WHEN A.ITEM_TYPE = 'H' THEN 2
                     WHEN A.ITEM_TYPE = 'Q' THEN 3
                     ELSE 4
                END)
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Product'
            WHEN 2 THEN 'Semi-Product'
            WHEN 3 THEN 'Goods'
            ELSE 'Raw Material'
       END AS ITEM_TYPE_NAME
     , MAX(A.ITEM_UOM) AS ITEM_UOM
     , MAX(A.SPEC) AS SPEC
     , MAX(NVL(B.OPERATION_GROUP
     , CASE WHEN NVL(SUBSTR(B.FLOW_ID, 1, 1), SUBSTR(A.FLOW_ID, 1, 1)) = 'R' THEN 'P'
                    ELSE NVL(SUBSTR(B.FLOW_ID, 1, 1), SUBSTR(A.FLOW_ID, 1, 1))
               END)) AS OPERATION_GROUP
     , MAX(B.OPERATION_GROUP_ID) AS OPERATION_GROUP_ID
     , MAX(NVL(SUBSTR(B.FLOW_ID, 1, 5), A.FLOW_ID)) AS FLOW_ID
     , MAX(CASE WHEN (B.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' OR NVL(SUBSTR(B.FLOW_ID, 1, 1), SUBSTR(A.FLOW_ID, 1, 1)) = 'E') THEN 'ELECTRODE'
                WHEN (B.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' OR NVL(SUBSTR(B.FLOW_ID, 1, 1), SUBSTR(A.FLOW_ID, 1, 1)) = 'A') THEN 'CELL'
                WHEN (NVL(B.OPERATION_GROUP, NVL(SUBSTR(B.FLOW_ID, 1, 1), SUBSTR(A.FLOW_ID, 1, 1))) = 'P' AND NVL(SUBSTR(B.FLOW_ID, 1, 5), SUBSTR(A.FLOW_ID, 1, 5)) = 'P9500') THEN 'PACK'
                WHEN (NVL(B.OPERATION_GROUP, NVL(SUBSTR(B.FLOW_ID, 1, 1), SUBSTR(A.FLOW_ID, 1, 1))) = 'P' AND NVL(SUBSTR(B.FLOW_ID, 1, 5), SUBSTR(A.FLOW_ID, 1, 5)) = 'P5500') THEN 'MODULE'
                WHEN (NVL(SUBSTR(B.FLOW_ID, 1, 5), SUBSTR(A.FLOW_ID, 1, 5)) = 'P5000' OR SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 5) = 'AMDAU') THEN 'MODULE'
                WHEN NVL(SUBSTR(B.FLOW_ID, 1, 1), SUBSTR(A.FLOW_ID, 1, 1)) = 'R' THEN 'PACK'
                ELSE ''
           END) AS OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
  FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN A
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM B
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID(+)
   AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
 GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID

NAME: SCM_KPI_TIMELINE_DW_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCM_KPI_TIMELINE_DW_V
 * Description  : KPI Timeline : DW용
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2022.04.28   KSG            Initial Release : PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : GM JV
 * 2023.04.03	HRK			   PJ20230691R LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응
 * 2026.07.04   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 * 
 */
 /* HM JV CASE WHEN DIVISION_ID = '81_UC' THEN '81' */
         /* HM JV      WHEN DIVISION_ID = 'EE_UC' THEN 'EE'  */
         /* HM JV      ELSE DIVISION_ID                      */
         /* HM JV END AS DIVISION_ID                         */
         D.ATTRIBUTE3    AS DIVISION_ID    /* HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
       , K.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
       , K.PLAN_TYPE
       , K.PLAN_SEQ
       , K.PLAN_START_DATE
       , K.PLAN_START_WEEK_DAY
       , K.PLAN_WEEK_DAY
       , K.PLAN_START_TIME
       , K.PLAN_TIME
       , K.VALID_TYPE
       , K.CREATED_BY
       , K.CREATION_DATE
       , K.LAST_UPDATED_BY
       , K.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
       , K.ATTRIBUTE1
       , K.ATTRIBUTE2
       , K.ATTRIBUTE3
       , K.ATTRIBUTE4
       , K.ATTRIBUTE5
       , K.ATTRIBUTE6
       , K.ATTRIBUTE7
       , K.ATTRIBUTE8
       , K.ATTRIBUTE9
       , K.ATTRIBUTE10
       , K.DIVISION_ID AS SCM_DIVISION_ID
  FROM   SCM_KPI_TIMELINE K
         INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D    /* HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
                 ON D.DIVISION_ID = K.DIVISION_ID
                AND D.VALID_YN    = 'Y'

NAME: SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_RATIO_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/****************************************************************************
* PROJECT       : LGES SCM
* VIEW NAME     : SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_RATIO_V
* DESCRIPTION   : 월별 부실재고 비중 확인
*
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*   DATE        IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*   2024.04.01  Philsu Park         Initial Release.
*   2026.07.04  ZIONEX              [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
****************************************************************************/
  CASE WHEN G.PLAN_TP_CD = 'FERT' THEN '완제품'
                 WHEN G.PLAN_TP_CD = 'SPRD' THEN '반제품'
                 WHEN G.PLAN_TP_CD = 'RMTL' THEN '원재료'
            END                                             AS PLAN_TP_CD
        , G.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD                             AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
        ,(SELECT CALENDAR_YYYY||WEEK_NAME
          FROM   SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
          WHERE  BASIS_YYYYMMDD = G.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD )   AS PLAN_START_YYYYWW
        ,(SELECT  LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM    SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
          WHERE   1=1
          AND     LK.LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
          AND     LK.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
          AND     LK.SEGMENT1     = 'ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID'
          AND     LK.SEGMENT2     = G.DIVISION_ID )         AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
        ,(SELECT  LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM    SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
          WHERE   1=1
          AND     LK.LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
          AND     LK.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
          AND     LK.SEGMENT1     = 'DATA_TP_CD'
          AND     LK.SEGMENT2     = G.DATA_TP_CD)           AS DATA_TP_CD
        , G.PLAN_YYYYMM                                     AS PLAN_YYYYMM
        , G.LONG_TERM_TYPE                                  AS LONG_TERM_TYPE
        , G.SAMT                                            AS SAMT
        , G.TAMT                                            AS TAMT
        , ABS(ROUND(G.SAMT/ G.TAMT, 3))                     AS RATE
    FROM (
            /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            /* 완제품 */
            /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            SELECT SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                ,  SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                ,  SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                ,  SUM.DIVISION_ID
                ,  SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                ,  SUM.LONG_TERM_TYPE
                ,  SUM(SUM.AMT)              AS SAMT
                ,  (    SELECT SUM(AMT)
                        FROM    SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY
                        WHERE   1=1
                        AND     PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                        AND     PLAN_TP_CD          = SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                        AND     DATA_TP_CD          = SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                        AND     DIVISION_ID         = SUM.DIVISION_ID
                        AND     PLAN_YYYYMM         = SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                    )                        AS TAMT
            FROM   SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY SUM
            WHERE  DATA_TP_CD IN ( 'EOH' ,'RESULT' )
            GROUP BY  SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                    , SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                    , SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                    , SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                    , SUM.DIVISION_ID
                    , SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                    , SUM.LONG_TERM_TYPE
            /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            /* 반제품 */
            /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            UNION ALL
            SELECT SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                ,  SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                ,  SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                ,  SUM.DIVISION_ID
                ,  SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                ,  SUM.LONG_TERM_TYPE
                ,  SUM(SUM.AMT)              AS SAMT
                ,  (    SELECT SUM(AMT)
                        FROM    SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_SPRD
                        WHERE   1=1
                        AND     PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                        AND     PLAN_TP_CD          = SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                        AND     DATA_TP_CD          = SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                        AND     DIVISION_ID         = SUM.DIVISION_ID
                        AND     PLAN_YYYYMM         = SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                    )                        AS TAMT
            FROM   SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_SPRD SUM
            WHERE  DATA_TP_CD IN ( 'EOH' ,'RESULT' )
            GROUP BY  SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                    , SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                    , SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                    , SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                    , SUM.DIVISION_ID
                    , SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                    , SUM.LONG_TERM_TYPE
            /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            /* 원재료 */
            /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            UNION ALL
            SELECT SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                ,  SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                ,  SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                ,  SUM.DIVISION_ID
                ,  SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                ,  SUM.LONG_TERM_TYPE
                ,  SUM(SUM.AMT)              AS SAMT
                ,  (    SELECT SUM(AMT)
                        FROM    SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_RMTL
                        WHERE   1=1
                        AND     PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                        AND     PLAN_TP_CD          = SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                        AND     DATA_TP_CD          = SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                        AND     DIVISION_ID         = SUM.DIVISION_ID
                        AND     PLAN_YYYYMM         = SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                    )                        AS TAMT
            FROM   SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_RMTL SUM
            WHERE  DATA_TP_CD IN ( 'EOH' ,'RESULT' )
            GROUP BY  SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                    , SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                    , SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                    , SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                    , SUM.DIVISION_ID
                    , SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                    , SUM.LONG_TERM_TYPE
            /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            /* 완제품 All Div. */
            /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            UNION ALL
            SELECT SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                ,  SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                ,  SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                ,  'ALL'                    AS DIVISION_ID
                ,  SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                ,  SUM.LONG_TERM_TYPE
                ,  SUM(SUM.AMT)             AS SAMT
                ,  (    SELECT SUM(AMT)
                        FROM    SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY
                        WHERE   1=1
                        AND     PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                        AND     PLAN_TP_CD          = SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                        AND     DATA_TP_CD          = SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                        AND     PLAN_YYYYMM         = SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                    )                       AS TAMT
            FROM   SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY SUM
            WHERE  DATA_TP_CD IN ( 'EOH' ,'RESULT' )
            GROUP BY  SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                    , SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                    , SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                    , SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                    , SUM.LONG_TERM_TYPE
            /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            /* 반제품 All Div. */
            /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            UNION ALL
            SELECT SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                ,  SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                ,  SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                ,  'ALL'                    AS DIVISION_ID
                ,  SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                ,  SUM.LONG_TERM_TYPE
                ,  SUM(SUM.AMT)             AS SAMT
                ,  (    SELECT SUM(AMT)
                        FROM    SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_SPRD
                        WHERE   1=1
                        AND     PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                        AND     PLAN_TP_CD          = SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                        AND     DATA_TP_CD          = SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                        AND     PLAN_YYYYMM         = SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                    )                        AS TAMT
            FROM   SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_SPRD SUM
            WHERE  DATA_TP_CD IN ( 'EOH' ,'RESULT' )
            GROUP BY  SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                    , SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                    , SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                    , SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                    , SUM.LONG_TERM_TYPE
            /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            /* 원재료 */
            /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
            UNION ALL
            SELECT SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                ,  SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                ,  SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                ,  'ALL'                    AS DIVISION_ID
                ,  SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                ,  SUM.LONG_TERM_TYPE
                ,  SUM(SUM.AMT)             AS SAMT
                ,  (    SELECT SUM(AMT)
                        FROM    SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_RMTL
                        WHERE   1=1
                        AND     PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                        AND     PLAN_TP_CD          = SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                        AND     DATA_TP_CD          = SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                        AND     PLAN_YYYYMM         = SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                    )                       AS TAMT
            FROM   SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_RMTL SUM
            WHERE  DATA_TP_CD IN ( 'EOH' ,'RESULT' )
            GROUP BY  SUM.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                    , SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                    , SUM.PLAN_TP_CD
                    , SUM.DATA_TP_CD
                    , SUM.PLAN_YYYYMM
                    , SUM.LONG_TERM_TYPE

        ) G
    WHERE 1=1

NAME: SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_GODS_V
TEXT:
WITH GROUP_CD AS (SELECT /****************************************************************************
* PROJECT       : LGES SCM
* VIEW NAME     : SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_GODS_V
* DESCRIPTION   : 원재료 ITEM별 PSI
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE         IN CHARGE       DESCRIPTION
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* 2024.08.22    yangsh          Initial Release.
* 2024.10.18    Philsu Park     PLAN_TP_CD 구분을 위한 Lookup 처리 반영.
****************************************************************************/  I.DIVISION_ID
                       , I.ITEM_ID
                       , MAX(CASE WHEN RTRIM(F1.GROUP_CODE1) IS NOT NULL THEN F1.GROUP_CODE1
                                  WHEN RTRIM(F3.GROUP_CODE1) IS NOT NULL THEN F3.GROUP_CODE1
                                  WHEN RTRIM(F2.GROUP_CODE1) IS NOT NULL THEN F2.GROUP_CODE1
                                  WHEN RTRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL           THEN NVL(I3.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME)
                                  ELSE NVL(I2.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME) END) AS GROUP_CODE1
                       , MAX(CASE WHEN RTRIM(F1.GROUP_CODE9) IS NOT NULL THEN F1.GROUP_CODE9
                                  WHEN RTRIM(F3.GROUP_CODE9) IS NOT NULL THEN F3.GROUP_CODE9
                                  WHEN RTRIM(F2.GROUP_CODE9) IS NOT NULL THEN F2.GROUP_CODE9
                                  WHEN RTRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL           THEN NVL(I3.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME)
                                  ELSE NVL(I2.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME) END) AS GROUP_CODE9
                    FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN     I
                       , SCM_ITEM_M_SN     I2
                       , SCM_ITEM_M_SN     I3
                       , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F1
                       , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F2
                       , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F3
                   WHERE I2.ITEM_ID(+)     = CASE WHEN RTRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL THEN I.APPLIED_MODEL ELSE I.DOE END
                     AND I2.DIVISION_ID(+) = I.DIVISION_ID
                     AND I3.ITEM_ID(+)     = I2.DOE
                     AND I3.DIVISION_ID(+) = I2.DIVISION_ID
                     AND F1.ITEM_ID(+)     = I.ITEM_ID
                     AND F1.DIVISION_ID(+) = I.DIVISION_ID
                     AND F2.ITEM_ID(+)     = CASE WHEN RTRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL THEN I.APPLIED_MODEL ELSE I.DOE END
                     AND F2.DIVISION_ID(+) = I.DIVISION_ID
                     AND F3.ITEM_ID(+)     = I2.DOE
                     AND F3.DIVISION_ID(+) = I2.DIVISION_ID
                   GROUP BY I.DIVISION_ID
                          , I.ITEM_ID)
SELECT (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'PLAN_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.PLAN_TP_CD)                        AS PLAN_TP_CD
     , S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , (SELECT CALENDAR_YYYY||WEEK_NAME
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)               AS PLAN_START_YYYYWW
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DATA_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD)                        AS DATA_TP_CD
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD
           AND LK.SEGMENT3    = S.SRCE_TP_CD)                        AS SRCE_TP_CD
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DIVISION_ID'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DIVISION_ID)                       AS DIVISION_ID
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD.ATTRIBUTE3, S.DIVISION_ID))   AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
     , S.PROCESS_DETAIL                                              AS GROUP_CODE1
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN RTRIM(MAX(LV.SEGMENT4)) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(LV.ATTRIBUTE2) ELSE '' END
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
           AND LV.SEGMENT1    = S.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD.ATTRIBUTE3, S.DIVISION_ID)
           AND ((SELECT CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN GR2.GROUP_CODE9 ELSE GR2.GROUP_CODE1 END
                   FROM SCM_MST_BOM_EFFECTIVE_SN BOM2
                      , GROUP_CD                 GR2
                  WHERE GR2.ITEM_ID(+)     = BOM2.MODEL_ID
                    AND GR2.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
                    AND BOM2.DIVISION_ID   = S.DIVISION_ID
                    AND BOM2.CHILD_ITEM_ID = S.ITEM_ID
                  FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) = LV.SEGMENT4
                 OR S.ITEM_ID    = LV.SEGMENT4
                 OR S.SRCE_TP_CD = LV.SEGMENT4))                     AS EXCEPTION_MODEL
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1, ',')
                       WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1)
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
           AND LV.SEGMENT1    = S.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD.ATTRIBUTE3, S.DIVISION_ID)
           AND ((SELECT CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN GR2.GROUP_CODE9 ELSE GR2.GROUP_CODE1 END
                   FROM SCM_MST_BOM_EFFECTIVE_SN BOM2
                      , GROUP_CD                 GR2
                  WHERE GR2.ITEM_ID(+)     = BOM2.MODEL_ID
                    AND GR2.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
                    AND BOM2.DIVISION_ID   = S.DIVISION_ID
                    AND BOM2.CHILD_ITEM_ID = S.ITEM_ID
                  FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) = LV.SEGMENT4
                 OR S.ITEM_ID    = LV.SEGMENT4
                 OR S.SRCE_TP_CD = LV.SEGMENT4))                     AS EXCEPTION_DESC
     , S.ITEM_ID
     , SIM.ITEM_NAME
     , S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
     , '-'                                                          AS ITEM_CLASS
     , '-'                                                          AS CLASS_NAME
     , S.SRCE_YYYYMM
     , S.PLAN_YYYYMM
     , S.QTY
     , S.CURRENCY
     , S.STANDARD_COST
     , S.AMT
     , NVL(S.SCM_SITE_ID, '-')                                      AS SCM_SITE_ID
     , NVL(S.OPERATION_GROUP, '-')                                  AS OPERATION_GROUP
     , NVL(S.OPERATION_ID, '-')                                     AS OPERATION_ID
     , CASE WHEN S.DEVALUATION_AGE IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE REPLACE(S.DEVALUATION_AGE, 'GRM', '')||'개월' END  AS DEVALUATION_AGE
     , S.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
     , CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE = '비대상' THEN '정상' ELSE S.LONG_TERM_TYPE END AS LONG_TERM_TYPE
     , NVL(S.VERSION_NO, '-')                                       AS VERSION_NO
     , NVL(S.CST_CTN, '-')                                          AS CST_CTN
     , S.CREATED_BY
     , S.CREATION_DATE
     , S.LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , S.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ITEM_UOM, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ITEM_UOM)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS UOM
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT GROUP_CODE3, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GROUP_CODE3)
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS GROUP_CODE3
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT GROUP_CODE8, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GROUP_CODE8)
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS GROUP_CODE8
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT SITE_ID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SITE_ID)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS PLANT_CD
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT EVAL_CLASS, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EVAL_CLASS)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS EVAL_CLASS
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ITEM_CLASS, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ITEM_CLASS)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS ITEM_CLASS_BY_ITEM
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT D.CLASS_NAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY D.CLASS_NAME)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN        A
             , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M D
         WHERE A.ITEM_CLASS  = D.CLASS_ID(+)
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                           AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME_BY_ITEM
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN GR2.GROUP_CODE9 ELSE GR2.GROUP_CODE1 END
          FROM SCM_MST_BOM_EFFECTIVE_SN BOM2
             , GROUP_CD                 GR2
         WHERE GR2.ITEM_ID(+)     = BOM2.MODEL_ID
           AND GR2.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND BOM2.DIVISION_ID   = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND BOM2.CHILD_ITEM_ID = S.ITEM_ID
         FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)                                   AS END_CUSTOMER
     , S.PROCESS_GROUP                                              AS PROCESS_GROUP
     , S.PROCESS_DETAIL                                             AS PROCESS_DETAIL
     , S.COMPANY_ID
     , S.PLANT_ID
  FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_GODS S
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION              MD
     , (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID
                      , MAX(ITEM_CLASS) AS ITEM_CLASS
                      , MAX(ITEM_NAME)  AS ITEM_NAME
                   FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                  GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID) SIM
 WHERE MD.DIVISION_ID(+)  = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.ITEM_ID(+)     = S.ITEM_ID
   AND 1 = 1

NAME: SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_RMTL_V
TEXT:
WITH GROUP_CD AS (SELECT
/****************************************************************************
* PROJECT       : LGES SCM
* VIEW NAME     : SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_RMTL_V
* DESCRIPTION   : 원재료 Plant, ITEM별 PSI / 원재료 ITEM GR별 PSI 조회
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE         IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* 2024.09.24    Philsu Park         Initial Release.
* 2024.10.18    Philsu Park         PLAN_TP_CD 구분을 위한 Lookup 처리 적용.
* 2025.01.21    OIJ                 예외모델 표기 기준 변경
****************************************************************************/
 I.DIVISION_ID
                       , I.ITEM_ID
                       , MAX(CASE WHEN RTRIM(F1.GROUP_CODE1) IS NOT NULL THEN F1.GROUP_CODE1
                                  WHEN RTRIM(F3.GROUP_CODE1) IS NOT NULL THEN F3.GROUP_CODE1
                                  WHEN RTRIM(F2.GROUP_CODE1) IS NOT NULL THEN F2.GROUP_CODE1
                                  WHEN RTRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL           THEN NVL(I3.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME)
                                  ELSE NVL(I2.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME) END) AS GROUP_CODE1
                       , MAX(CASE WHEN RTRIM(F1.GROUP_CODE9) IS NOT NULL THEN F1.GROUP_CODE9
                                  WHEN RTRIM(F3.GROUP_CODE9) IS NOT NULL THEN F3.GROUP_CODE9
                                  WHEN RTRIM(F2.GROUP_CODE9) IS NOT NULL THEN F2.GROUP_CODE9
                                  WHEN RTRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL           THEN NVL(I3.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME)
                                  ELSE NVL(I2.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME) END) AS GROUP_CODE9
                    FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN      I
                       , SCM_ITEM_M_SN      I2
                       , SCM_ITEM_M_SN      I3
                       , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F1
                       , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F2
                       , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F3
                   WHERE I2.ITEM_ID(+)     = CASE WHEN RTRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL THEN I.APPLIED_MODEL ELSE I.DOE END
                     AND I2.DIVISION_ID(+) = I.DIVISION_ID
                     AND I3.ITEM_ID(+)     = I2.DOE
                     AND I3.DIVISION_ID(+) = I2.DIVISION_ID
                     AND F1.ITEM_ID(+)     = I.ITEM_ID
                     AND F1.DIVISION_ID(+) = I.DIVISION_ID
                     AND F2.ITEM_ID(+)     = CASE WHEN RTRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL THEN I.APPLIED_MODEL ELSE I.DOE END
                     AND F2.DIVISION_ID(+) = I.DIVISION_ID
                     AND F3.ITEM_ID(+)     = I2.DOE
                     AND F3.DIVISION_ID(+) = I2.DIVISION_ID
                   GROUP BY I.DIVISION_ID
                          , I.ITEM_ID)
SELECT RMTL.PLAN_TP_CD
     , RMTL.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , RMTL.PLAN_START_YYYYWW
     , RMTL.DATA_TP_CD
     , RMTL.SRCE_TP_CD
     , RMTL.DIVISION_ID
     , RMTL.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
     , RMTL.GROUP_CODE1
       /* 2025.01.21 OIJ 예외모델 표기 */
     , CASE WHEN (SELECT CASE WHEN RTRIM(MAX(LV.SEGMENT4)) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(LV.ATTRIBUTE2) ELSE '' END
                    FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
                   WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
                     AND LV.SEGMENT1    = RMTL.PLAN_TP_CD_CODE
                     AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(RMTL.MD_ATTR3, RMTL.DIVISION_ID)
                     AND (RMTL.END_CUSTOMER = LV.SEGMENT4
                       OR RMTL.ITEM_ID      = LV.SEGMENT4
                       OR RMTL.SRCE_TP_CD   = LV.SEGMENT4)) IS NULL
                 AND RMTL.EXHT_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Policy'
            ELSE (SELECT CASE WHEN RTRIM(MAX(LV.SEGMENT4)) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(LV.ATTRIBUTE2) ELSE '' END
                    FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
                   WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
                     AND LV.SEGMENT1    = RMTL.PLAN_TP_CD_CODE
                     AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(RMTL.MD_ATTR3, RMTL.DIVISION_ID)
                     AND (RMTL.END_CUSTOMER = LV.SEGMENT4
                       OR RMTL.ITEM_ID      = LV.SEGMENT4
                       OR RMTL.SRCE_TP_CD   = LV.SEGMENT4))
            END                                                        AS EXCEPTION_MODEL
       /* 2025.01.21 OIJ 예외모델 표기 */
     , CASE WHEN (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1, ',')
                                WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1)
                    FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
                   WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
                     AND LV.SEGMENT1    = RMTL.PLAN_TP_CD_CODE
                     AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(RMTL.MD_ATTR3, RMTL.DIVISION_ID)
                     AND (RMTL.END_CUSTOMER = LV.SEGMENT4
                       OR RMTL.ITEM_ID      = LV.SEGMENT4
                       OR RMTL.SRCE_TP_CD   = LV.SEGMENT4)) IS NULL
                 AND RMTL.EXHT_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Policy Inv Plan'
            ELSE (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1, ',')
                                WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1)
                    FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
                   WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
                     AND LV.SEGMENT1    = RMTL.PLAN_TP_CD_CODE
                     AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(RMTL.MD_ATTR3, RMTL.DIVISION_ID)
                     AND (RMTL.END_CUSTOMER = LV.SEGMENT4
                       OR RMTL.ITEM_ID      = LV.SEGMENT4
                       OR RMTL.SRCE_TP_CD   = LV.SEGMENT4))
            END                                                        AS EXCEPTION_DESC
     , RMTL.PLANT_ID
     , RMTL.ITEM_ID
     , RMTL.ITEM_NAME
     , RMTL.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
     , RMTL.ITEM_CLASS
     , RMTL.CLASS_NAME
     , RMTL.SRCE_YYYYMM
     , RMTL.PLAN_YYYYMM
     , RMTL.QTY
     , RMTL.CURRENCY
     , RMTL.STANDARD_COST
     , RMTL.AMT
     , RMTL.SCM_SITE_ID
     , RMTL.OPERATION_GROUP
     , RMTL.OPERATION_ID
     , RMTL.DEVALUATION_AGE
     , RMTL.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
     , RMTL.LONG_TERM_TYPE
     , RMTL.VERSION_NO
     , RMTL.CST_CTN
     , RMTL.CREATED_BY
     , RMTL.CREATION_DATE
     , RMTL.LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , RMTL.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
     , RMTL.UOM
     , RMTL.GROUP_CODE3
     , RMTL.GROUP_CODE8
     , RMTL.PLANT_CD
     , RMTL.EVAL_CLASS
     , RMTL.ITEM_CLASS_BY_ITEM
     , RMTL.ITEM_CLASS_NAME_BY_ITEM
     , RMTL.END_CUSTOMER
     , RMTL.PROCESS_GROUP
     , RMTL.PROCESS_DETAIL
     , RMTL.EXHT_FLAG
     , RMTL.COMPANY_ID
  FROM (SELECT (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
                  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
                 WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
                   AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'PLAN_TP_CD'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.PLAN_TP_CD)                   AS PLAN_TP_CD
             , S.PLAN_TP_CD                                            AS PLAN_TP_CD_CODE
             , S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , (SELECT CALENDAR_YYYY||WEEK_NAME
                  FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                 WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)         AS PLAN_START_YYYYWW
             , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
                  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
                 WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
                   AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DATA_TP_CD'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD)                   AS DATA_TP_CD
             , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
                  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
                 WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
                   AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD
                   AND LK.SEGMENT3    = S.SRCE_TP_CD)                   AS SRCE_TP_CD
             , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
                  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
                 WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
                   AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DIVISION_ID'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DIVISION_ID)                  AS DIVISION_ID
             , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
                  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
                 WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
                   AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID'
                   AND LK.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD.ATTRIBUTE3, S.DIVISION_ID)) AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
             , S.PROCESS_DETAIL                                        AS GROUP_CODE1
             , ''                                                      AS EXCEPTION_MODEL
             , ''                                                      AS EXCEPTION_DESC
             , S.PLANT_ID
             , S.ITEM_ID
             , SIM.ITEM_NAME
             , S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
             , '-'                                                     AS ITEM_CLASS
             , '-'                                                     AS CLASS_NAME
             , S.SRCE_YYYYMM
             , S.PLAN_YYYYMM
             , S.QTY
             , S.CURRENCY
             , S.STANDARD_COST
             , S.AMT
             , NVL(S.SCM_SITE_ID, '-')                                 AS SCM_SITE_ID
             , NVL(S.OPERATION_GROUP, '-')                             AS OPERATION_GROUP
             , NVL(S.OPERATION_ID, '-')                                AS OPERATION_ID
             , CASE WHEN S.DEVALUATION_AGE IS NULL THEN NULL
                    ELSE REPLACE(S.DEVALUATION_AGE, 'GRM', '')||'개월' END AS DEVALUATION_AGE
             , S.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
             , CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE = '비대상' THEN '정상' ELSE S.LONG_TERM_TYPE END AS LONG_TERM_TYPE
             , NVL(S.VERSION_NO, '-')                                  AS VERSION_NO
             , NVL(S.CST_CTN, '-')                                     AS CST_CTN
             , S.CREATED_BY
             , S.CREATION_DATE
             , S.LAST_UPDATED_BY
             , S.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
             , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ITEM_UOM, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ITEM_UOM)
                  FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                        AS UOM
             , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT GROUP_CODE3, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GROUP_CODE3)
                  FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                        AS GROUP_CODE3
             , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT GROUP_CODE8, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GROUP_CODE8)
                  FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                        AS GROUP_CODE8
             , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT SITE_ID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SITE_ID)
                  FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                        AS PLANT_CD
             , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT EVAL_CLASS, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EVAL_CLASS)
                  FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                        AS EVAL_CLASS
             , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ITEM_CLASS, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ITEM_CLASS)
                  FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                 WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                        AS ITEM_CLASS_BY_ITEM
             , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT D.CLASS_NAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY D.CLASS_NAME)
                  FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN        A
                     , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M D
                 WHERE D.CLASS_ID(+) = A.ITEM_CLASS
                   AND A.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND A.ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                      AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME_BY_ITEM
             , (SELECT CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN GR2.GROUP_CODE9 ELSE GR2.GROUP_CODE1 END
                  FROM SCM_MST_BOM_EFFECTIVE_SN BOM2
                     , GROUP_CD                 GR2
                 WHERE GR2.ITEM_ID(+)     = BOM2.MODEL_ID
                   AND GR2.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND BOM2.DIVISION_ID   = S.DIVISION_ID
                   AND BOM2.CHILD_ITEM_ID = S.ITEM_ID
                 FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)                              AS END_CUSTOMER
             , S.PROCESS_GROUP                                         AS PROCESS_GROUP
             , S.PROCESS_DETAIL                                        AS PROCESS_DETAIL
             , MD.ATTRIBUTE3                                           AS MD_ATTR3
               /* 2025.01.21 OIJ EXHT 여부 */
             , CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN S.SRCE_TP_CD = 'S_EXHT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                              OVER (PARTITION BY S.DIVISION_ID, S.PLANT_ID, S.ITEM_ID)) > 0
                    THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END                             AS EXHT_FLAG
             , S.COMPANY_ID
          FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_RMTL S
             , SCM_MST_DIVISION              MD
             , (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID
                              , MAX(ITEM_CLASS) AS ITEM_CLASS
                              , MAX(ITEM_NAME)  AS ITEM_NAME
                           FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                          GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID) SIM
         WHERE MD.DIVISION_ID(+)  = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND SIM.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND SIM.ITEM_ID(+)     = S.ITEM_ID
           AND 1 = 1) RMTL

NAME: SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_SPRD_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/****************************************************************************
* PROJECT       : LGES SCM
* VIEW NAME     : SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_V
* DESCRIPTION   : 완제품 ITEM별 PSI / 완제품 ITEM GR별 PSI 조회
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE         IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* 2024.07.31    yangsh              Initial Release.
* 2024.10.18    Philsu Park         PLAN_TP_CD 룩업 적용.
****************************************************************************/
 (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'PLAN_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.PLAN_TP_CD)                        AS PLAN_TP_CD
     , S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , (SELECT CALENDAR_YYYY||WEEK_NAME
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)               AS PLAN_START_YYYYWW
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DATA_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD)                        AS DATA_TP_CD
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN S.SRCE_TP_CD = 'BOH_SPRD' AND CLS.PROCESS_GROUP = '전극' THEN '수요<재고(전극)'
                    WHEN S.SRCE_TP_CD = 'BOH_SPRD' AND CLS.PROCESS_GROUP = '조립' THEN '수요<재고(조립)'
                    ELSE LK.ATTRIBUTE1 END
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD
           AND LK.SEGMENT3    = S.SRCE_TP_CD)                        AS SRCE_TP_CD
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DIVISION_ID'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DIVISION_ID)                       AS DIVISION_ID
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD.ATTRIBUTE3, S.DIVISION_ID))   AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
     , S.GROUP_CODE1
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN RTRIM(MAX(LV.SEGMENT4)) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(LV.ATTRIBUTE2) ELSE '' END
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
           AND LV.SEGMENT1    = S.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD.ATTRIBUTE3, S.DIVISION_ID)
           AND ( S.GROUP_CODE1 = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S.ITEM_ID     = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S.SRCE_TP_CD  = LV.SEGMENT4))                       AS EXCEPTION_MODEL
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1, ',')
                       WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1)
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
           AND LV.SEGMENT1    = S.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD.ATTRIBUTE3, S.DIVISION_ID)
           AND ( S.GROUP_CODE1 = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S.ITEM_ID     = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S.SRCE_TP_CD  = LV.SEGMENT4))                       AS EXCEPTION_DESC
     , S.ITEM_ID
     , SIM.ITEM_NAME
     , S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
     , '-'                                                          AS ITEM_CLASS
     , '-'                                                          AS CLASS_NAME
     , S.SRCE_YYYYMM
     , S.PLAN_YYYYMM
     , S.QTY
     , S.CURRENCY
     , S.STANDARD_COST
     , S.AMT
     , NVL(S.SCM_SITE_ID, '-')                                      AS SCM_SITE_ID
     , NVL(S.OPERATION_GROUP, '-')                                  AS OPERATION_GROUP
     , NVL(S.OPERATION_ID, '-')                                     AS OPERATION_ID
     , CASE WHEN S.DEVALUATION_AGE IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE REPLACE(S.DEVALUATION_AGE, 'GRM', '')||'개월' END  AS DEVALUATION_AGE
     , S.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
     , CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE = '비대상' THEN '정상' ELSE S.LONG_TERM_TYPE END AS LONG_TERM_TYPE
     , NVL(S.VERSION_NO, '-')                                       AS VERSION_NO
     , NVL(S.CST_CTN, '-')                                          AS CST_CTN
     , S.CREATED_BY
     , S.CREATION_DATE
     , S.LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , S.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ITEM_UOM, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ITEM_UOM)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS UOM
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT GROUP_CODE3, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GROUP_CODE3)
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS GROUP_CODE3
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT GROUP_CODE8, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GROUP_CODE8)
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS GROUP_CODE8
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT SITE_ID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SITE_ID)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS PLANT_CD
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT EVAL_CLASS, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EVAL_CLASS)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS EVAL_CLASS
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ITEM_CLASS, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ITEM_CLASS)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS ITEM_CLASS_BY_ITEM
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT D.CLASS_NAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY D.CLASS_NAME)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN        A
             , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M D
         WHERE A.ITEM_CLASS  = D.CLASS_ID(+)
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                           AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME_BY_ITEM
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT A.END_CUSTOMER, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY A.END_CUSTOMER)
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM A
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                           AS END_CUSTOMER
     , CLS.PROCESS_GROUP                                            AS PROCESS_GROUP
     , CLS.PROCESS_DETAIL                                           AS PROCESS_DETAIL
     , CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN S.SRCE_TP_CD = 'S_EXHT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                      OVER (PARTITION BY S.DIVISION_ID)) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS EXHT_FLAG
     , S.COMPANY_ID
     , S.PLANT_ID
  FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_SPRD S
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION              MD
     , (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID
                      , MAX(ITEM_CLASS) AS ITEM_CLASS
                      , MAX(ITEM_NAME)  AS ITEM_NAME
                   FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                  GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID) SIM
     , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M          CLS
 WHERE MD.DIVISION_ID(+)  = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.ITEM_ID(+)     = S.ITEM_ID
   AND SIM.ITEM_CLASS     = CLS.CLASS_ID(+)
   AND 1 = 1
/* ---------------------------------------------------------- */
UNION ALL
/* ---------------------------------------------------------- */
SELECT (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'PLAN_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S2.PLAN_TP_CD)                      AS PLAN_TP_CD
     , S2.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , (SELECT CALENDAR_YYYY||WEEK_NAME
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = S2.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)             AS PLAN_START_YYYYWW
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DATA_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S2.DATA_TP_CD)                      AS DATA_TP_CD
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN S2.SRCE_TP_CD = 'BOH_SPRD' AND S2.ITEM_CLASS = 'ELTR' THEN '수요<재고(전극)'
                    WHEN S2.SRCE_TP_CD = 'BOH_SPRD' AND S2.ITEM_CLASS = '*'    THEN '수요<재고(조립)'
                    ELSE LK.ATTRIBUTE1 END
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S2.DATA_TP_CD
           AND LK.SEGMENT3    = S2.SRCE_TP_CD)                      AS SRCE_TP_CD
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DIVISION_ID'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S2.DIVISION_ID)                     AS DIVISION_ID
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD2.ATTRIBUTE3, S2.DIVISION_ID)) AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
     , S2.GROUP_CODE1
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN RTRIM(MAX(LV.SEGMENT4)) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(LV.ATTRIBUTE2) ELSE '' END
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
           AND LV.SEGMENT1    = S2.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD2.ATTRIBUTE3, S2.DIVISION_ID)
           AND ( S2.GROUP_CODE1 = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S2.SRCE_TP_CD  = LV.SEGMENT4))                     AS EXCEPTION_MODEL
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1, ',')
                       WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1)
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
           AND LV.SEGMENT1    = S2.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND LV.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD2.ATTRIBUTE3, S2.DIVISION_ID)
           AND ( S2.GROUP_CODE1 = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S2.SRCE_TP_CD  = LV.SEGMENT4))                     AS EXCEPTION_DESC
     , ''                                                          AS ITEM_ID
     , ''                                                          AS ITEM_NAME
     , ''                                                          AS ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
     , S2.ITEM_CLASS
     , CASE WHEN S2.CLASS_NAME = 'ELTR' THEN '전극' ELSE S2.CLASS_NAME END AS CLASS_NAME
     , S2.SRCE_YYYYMM
     , S2.PLAN_YYYYMM
     , S2.QTY
     , S2.CURRENCY
     , S2.STANDARD_COST
     , S2.AMT
     , '-'                                                         AS SCM_SITE_ID
     , '-'                                                         AS OPERATION_GROUP
     , '-'                                                         AS OPERATION_ID
     , CASE WHEN S2.DEVALUATION_AGE IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE REPLACE(S2.DEVALUATION_AGE, 'GRM', '')||'개월' END AS DEVALUATION_AGE
     , S2.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
     , CASE WHEN S2.LONG_TERM_TYPE = '비대상' THEN '정상' ELSE S2.LONG_TERM_TYPE END AS LONG_TERM_TYPE
     , '-'                                                         AS VERSION_NO
     , '-'                                                         AS CST_CTN
     , S2.CREATED_BY
     , S2.CREATION_DATE
     , S2.LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , S2.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
     , '-'                                                         AS UOM
     , '-'                                                         AS GROUP_CODE3
     , '-'                                                         AS GROUP_CODE8
     , '-'                                                         AS PLANT_CD
     , '-'                                                         AS EVAL_CLASS
     , '-'                                                         AS ITEM_CLASS_BY_ITEM
     , '-'                                                         AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME_BY_ITEM
     , '-'                                                         AS END_CUSTOMER
     , CLS.PROCESS_GROUP                                           AS PROCESS_GROUP
     , CLS.PROCESS_DETAIL                                          AS PROCESS_DETAIL
     , CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN S2.SRCE_TP_CD = 'S_EXHT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                      OVER (PARTITION BY S2.DIVISION_ID)) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS EXHT_FLAG
     , S2.COMPANY_ID
     , S2.PLANT_ID
  FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_SPRD_IGR S2
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION                 MD2
     , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M             CLS
 WHERE MD2.DIVISION_ID(+) = S2.DIVISION_ID
   AND S2.ITEM_CLASS      = CLS.CLASS_ID(+)
   AND 1 = 1

NAME: SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/****************************************************************************
* PROJECT       : LGES SCM
* VIEW NAME     : SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_V
* DESCRIPTION   : 완제품 ITEM별 PSI / 완제품 ITEM GR별 PSI 조회
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE         IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* 2024.07.31    yangsh              Initial Release.
* 2024.09.26    Philsu.Park         활성화 공정 반제품 표기 추가
* 2024.10.18    Philsu Park         PLAN_TP_CD 룩업 적용.
****************************************************************************/
 (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'PLAN_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.PLAN_TP_CD)                        AS PLAN_TP_CD
     , CASE WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD IN ('BOH', 'EOH')
             AND SIM2.ITEM_CLASS IN ('ES1901', 'ES2004', 'ES2003', 'ES2002', 'ES2001')
            THEN '반제품' ELSE '-' END                              AS ORIGIN_PLAN_TP_CD
     , S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , (SELECT CALENDAR_YYYY||WEEK_NAME
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)               AS PLAN_START_YYYYWW
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DATA_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD)                        AS DATA_TP_CD
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD
           AND LK.SEGMENT3    = S.SRCE_TP_CD)                        AS SRCE_TP_CD
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DIVISION_ID'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DIVISION_ID)                       AS DIVISION_ID
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID)                AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
     , S.GROUP_CODE1
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(MAX(LV.SEGMENT4)) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(LV.ATTRIBUTE2) ELSE '' END
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
           AND LV.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LV.SEGMENT1    = S.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND LV.SEGMENT2    = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ( S.GROUP_CODE1 = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S.ITEM_ID     = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S.SRCE_TP_CD  = LV.SEGMENT4))                       AS EXCEPTION_MODEL
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1, ',')
                       WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1)
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
           AND LV.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LV.SEGMENT1    = S.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND LV.SEGMENT2    = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ( S.GROUP_CODE1 = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S.ITEM_ID     = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S.SRCE_TP_CD  = LV.SEGMENT4))                       AS EXCEPTION_DESC
     , S.ITEM_ID
     , SIM.ITEM_NAME
     , S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
     , '-'                                                          AS ITEM_CLASS
     , '-'                                                          AS CLASS_NAME
     , S.SRCE_YYYYMM
     , S.PLAN_YYYYMM
     , S.QTY
     , S.CURRENCY
     , S.STANDARD_COST
     , S.AMT
     , NVL(S.SCM_SITE_ID, '-')                                      AS SCM_SITE_ID
     , NVL(S.OPERATION_GROUP, '-')                                  AS OPERATION_GROUP
     , NVL(S.OPERATION_ID, '-')                                     AS OPERATION_ID
     , CASE WHEN S.DEVALUATION_AGE IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE REPLACE(S.DEVALUATION_AGE, 'GRM', '')||'개월' END  AS DEVALUATION_AGE
     , S.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
     , CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE = '비대상' THEN '정상' ELSE S.LONG_TERM_TYPE END AS LONG_TERM_TYPE
     , NVL(S.VERSION_NO, '-')                                       AS VERSION_NO
     , NVL(S.CST_CTN, '-')                                          AS CST_CTN
     , S.CREATED_BY
     , S.CREATION_DATE
     , S.LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , S.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ITEM_UOM, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ITEM_UOM)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS UOM
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT GROUP_CODE3, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GROUP_CODE3)
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS GROUP_CODE3
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT GROUP_CODE8, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY GROUP_CODE8)
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS GROUP_CODE8
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT SITE_ID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SITE_ID)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS PLANT_CD
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT EVAL_CLASS, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EVAL_CLASS)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS EVAL_CLASS
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT ITEM_CLASS, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ITEM_CLASS)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                             AS ITEM_CLASS_BY_ITEM
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT D.CLASS_NAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY D.CLASS_NAME)
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN        A
             , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M D
         WHERE A.ITEM_CLASS  = D.CLASS_ID(+)
           AND A.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                           AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME_BY_ITEM
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT A.END_CUSTOMER, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY A.END_CUSTOMER)
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM A
         WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND A.ITEM_ID     = S.ITEM_ID)                           AS END_CUSTOMER
     , NVL(CLS.PROCESS_GROUP, '-')                                  AS PROCESS_GROUP
     , NVL(CLS.PROCESS_DETAIL, '-')                                 AS PROCESS_DETAIL
     , CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN S.SRCE_TP_CD = 'S_EXHT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                      OVER (PARTITION BY S.DIVISION_ID)) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS EXHT_FLAG
     , S.COMPANY_ID
     , S.PLANT_ID
  FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY S
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION          MD
     , (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID
                      , MAX(ITEM_CLASS) AS ITEM_CLASS
                      , MAX(ITEM_NAME)  AS ITEM_NAME
                   FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                  GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID) SIM
     , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M      CLS
     , (SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID
                      , MAX(ITEM_CLASS) AS ITEM_CLASS
                      , MAX(ITEM_NAME)  AS ITEM_NAME
                   FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
                  GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID) SIM2
 WHERE MD.DIVISION_ID(+)   = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.DIVISION_ID(+)  = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.ITEM_ID(+)      = S.ITEM_ID
   AND SIM.ITEM_CLASS      = CLS.CLASS_ID(+)
   AND SIM2.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM2.ITEM_ID(+)     = S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
   AND 1 = 1
/* ---------------------------------------------------------- */
UNION ALL
/* ---------------------------------------------------------- */
SELECT (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'PLAN_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S2.PLAN_TP_CD)                      AS PLAN_TP_CD
     , '-'                                                          AS ORIGIN_PLAN_TP_CD
     , S2.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , (SELECT CALENDAR_YYYY||WEEK_NAME
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = S2.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)             AS PLAN_START_YYYYWW
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DATA_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S2.DATA_TP_CD)                      AS DATA_TP_CD
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S2.DATA_TP_CD
           AND LK.SEGMENT3    = S2.SRCE_TP_CD)                      AS SRCE_TP_CD
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DIVISION_ID'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S2.DIVISION_ID)                     AS DIVISION_ID
     , (SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
         WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_REPORT'
           AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID'
           AND LK.SEGMENT2    = NVL(MD2.ATTRIBUTE3, S2.DIVISION_ID)) AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
     , S2.GROUP_CODE1
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(MAX(LV.SEGMENT4)) IS NOT NULL THEN MAX(LV.ATTRIBUTE2) ELSE '' END
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
           AND LV.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LV.SEGMENT1    = S2.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND LV.SEGMENT2    = S2.DIVISION_ID
           AND ( S2.GROUP_CODE1 = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S2.SRCE_TP_CD  = LV.SEGMENT4))                     AS EXCEPTION_MODEL
     , (SELECT LISTAGG(DISTINCT '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1, ',')
                       WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY '('||LV.SEGMENT3||')'||LV.ATTRIBUTE1)
          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LV
         WHERE LV.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_EXCEPTION_GROUP_CODE_ALL'
           AND LV.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
           AND LV.SEGMENT1    = S2.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND LV.SEGMENT2    = S2.DIVISION_ID
           AND ( S2.GROUP_CODE1 = LV.SEGMENT4
              OR S2.SRCE_TP_CD  = LV.SEGMENT4))                     AS EXCEPTION_DESC
     , '-'                                                          AS ITEM_ID
     , ''                                                           AS ITEM_NAME
     , '-'                                                          AS ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
     , S2.ITEM_CLASS
     , S2.CLASS_NAME
     , S2.SRCE_YYYYMM
     , S2.PLAN_YYYYMM
     , S2.QTY
     , S2.CURRENCY
     , S2.STANDARD_COST
     , S2.AMT
     , '-'                                                          AS SCM_SITE_ID
     , '-'                                                          AS OPERATION_GROUP
     , '-'                                                          AS OPERATION_ID
     , CASE WHEN S2.DEVALUATION_AGE IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE REPLACE(S2.DEVALUATION_AGE, 'GRM', '')||'개월' END AS DEVALUATION_AGE
     , S2.LONG_TERM_TYPE_CODE
     , CASE WHEN S2.LONG_TERM_TYPE = '비대상' THEN '정상' ELSE S2.LONG_TERM_TYPE END AS LONG_TERM_TYPE
     , '-'                                                          AS VERSION_NO
     , '-'                                                          AS CST_CTN
     , S2.CREATED_BY
     , S2.CREATION_DATE
     , S2.LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , S2.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
     , '-'                                                          AS UOM
     , '-'                                                          AS GROUP_CODE3
     , '-'                                                          AS GROUP_CODE8
     , '-'                                                          AS PLANT_CD
     , '-'                                                          AS EVAL_CLASS
     , '-'                                                          AS ITEM_CLASS_BY_ITEM
     , '-'                                                          AS ITEM_CLASS_NAME_BY_ITEM
     , '-'                                                          AS END_CUSTOMER
     , CLS.PROCESS_GROUP                                            AS PROCESS_GROUP
     , CLS.PROCESS_DETAIL                                           AS PROCESS_DETAIL
     , CASE WHEN (SUM(CASE WHEN S2.SRCE_TP_CD = 'S_EXHT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                      OVER (PARTITION BY S2.DIVISION_ID)) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS EXHT_FLAG
     , S2.COMPANY_ID
     , S2.PLANT_ID
  FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_IGR S2
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION              MD2
     , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M          CLS
 WHERE MD2.DIVISION_ID(+) = S2.DIVISION_ID
   AND S2.ITEM_CLASS      = CLS.CLASS_ID(+)
   AND 1 = 1

NAME: SCM_LGTM_MGMT_DETAIL2_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/****************************************************************************
* PROJECT       : LGES SCM
* VIEW NAME     : SCM_LGTM_MGMT_DETAIL2_V
* DESCRIPTION   : SCPF0113 Long Term Stock Mgmt
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE        IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* 2024.09.10   yangsh         Initial Release.
* 2025.01.21   OIJ            srce_tp_cd, item_name, origin_item_name, version_no add
* 2026.07.06   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
****************************************************************************/
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* 완제품 */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
       S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD                       AS PLAN_DATE
     , S.COMPANY_ID                                AS COMPANY_ID
     , S.PLANT_ID                                  AS PLANT_ID
     , S.DIVISION_ID                               AS DIV
     , '완제품'                                    AS PLAN_TYPE
     , S.GROUP_CODE1                               AS GROUP_CODE
     , S.ITEM_ID                                   AS MATERIAL
     , SIM.ITEM_NAME                               AS MATERIAL_DESC
     , S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID                            AS ORIGIN_MATERIAL
     , CASE WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'BOH' THEN 1
            WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'P'   THEN 2
            WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'S'   THEN 3
            WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'EOH' THEN 4 END   AS SORT
     , ( SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
          WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_LGTM'
            AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
            AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DATA_TP_CD'
            AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD )    AS DATA_TP_CD
     , ( SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE1
           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
          WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_LGTM'
            AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
            AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
            AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD
            AND LK.SEGMENT3    = S.SRCE_TP_CD )    AS SRCE_TP_CD
     , CASE WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD IN ( 'BOH', 'EOH' ) THEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE ELSE '-' END  AS LONG_TERM_TYPE
     , S.PLAN_YYYYMM
     , SUM(S.QTY)                                  AS QTY
     , MAX(CASE WHEN S.VERSION_NO IN ( 'Y', 'N', '81_ESS' ) THEN NULL ELSE S.VERSION_NO END)  AS VERSION_NO
  FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY S
     , ( SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, MAX(ITEM_CLASS) AS ITEM_CLASS, MAX(ITEM_NAME) AS ITEM_NAME
           FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
          GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID ) SIM
 WHERE SIM.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.ITEM_ID(+)     = S.ITEM_ID
   AND S.DATA_TP_CD <> 'RESULT'
   AND S.PLAN_TP_CD  = 'FERT_INIT'
 GROUP BY S.COMPANY_ID, S.PLANT_ID, S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, S.DIVISION_ID, S.GROUP_CODE1, S.ITEM_ID, SIM.ITEM_NAME
        , S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID, S.DATA_TP_CD, S.SRCE_TP_CD, S.LONG_TERM_TYPE, S.PLAN_YYYYMM
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
UNION ALL
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* 반제품 */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
SELECT S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD                       AS PLAN_DATE
     , S.COMPANY_ID                                AS COMPANY_ID
     , S.PLANT_ID                                  AS PLANT_ID
     , S.DIVISION_ID                               AS DIV
     , '반제품'                                    AS PLAN_TYPE
     , S.GROUP_CODE1                               AS GROUP_CODE
     , S.ITEM_ID                                   AS MATERIAL
     , SIM.ITEM_NAME                               AS MATERIAL_DESC
     , S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID                            AS ORIGIN_MATERIAL
     , CASE WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'BOH' THEN 1
            WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'P'   THEN 2
            WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'S'   THEN 3
            WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'EOH' THEN 4 END   AS SORT
     , ( SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE2
           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
          WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_LGTM'
            AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
            AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DATA_TP_CD'
            AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD )    AS DATA_TP_CD
     , ( SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE2
           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
          WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_LGTM'
            AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
            AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
            AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD
            AND LK.SEGMENT3    = S.SRCE_TP_CD )    AS SRCE_TP_CD
     , CASE WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD IN ( 'BOH', 'EOH' ) THEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE ELSE '-' END  AS LONG_TERM_TYPE
     , S.PLAN_YYYYMM
     , SUM(S.QTY)                                  AS QTY
     , MAX(CASE WHEN S.VERSION_NO IN ( 'Y', 'N', '81_ESS' ) THEN NULL ELSE S.VERSION_NO END)  AS VERSION_NO
  FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_SPRD S
     , ( SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, MAX(ITEM_CLASS) AS ITEM_CLASS, MAX(ITEM_NAME) AS ITEM_NAME
           FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
          GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID ) SIM
 WHERE SIM.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.ITEM_ID(+)     = S.ITEM_ID
   AND S.DATA_TP_CD <> 'RESULT'
   AND S.PLAN_TP_CD  = 'SPRD_INIT'
 GROUP BY S.COMPANY_ID, S.PLANT_ID, S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, S.DIVISION_ID, S.GROUP_CODE1, S.ITEM_ID, SIM.ITEM_NAME
        , S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID, S.DATA_TP_CD, S.SRCE_TP_CD, S.LONG_TERM_TYPE, S.PLAN_YYYYMM
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
UNION ALL
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* 원재료 */
/* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
SELECT S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD                       AS PLAN_DATE
     , S.COMPANY_ID                                AS COMPANY_ID
     , S.PLANT_ID                                  AS PLANT_ID
     , S.DIVISION_ID                               AS DIV
     , '원재료'                                    AS PLAN_TYPE
     , S.GROUP_CODE1                               AS GROUP_CODE
     , S.ITEM_ID                                   AS MATERIAL
     , SIM.ITEM_NAME                               AS MATERIAL_DESC
     , S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID                            AS ORIGIN_MATERIAL
     , CASE WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'BOH' THEN 1
            WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'P'   THEN 2
            WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'S'   THEN 3
            WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'EOH' THEN 4 END   AS SORT
     , ( SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE3
           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
          WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_LGTM'
            AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
            AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'DATA_TP_CD'
            AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD )    AS DATA_TP_CD
     , ( SELECT LK.ATTRIBUTE3
           FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
          WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_LGTM'
            AND LK.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
            AND LK.SEGMENT1    = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
            AND LK.SEGMENT2    = S.DATA_TP_CD
            AND LK.SEGMENT3    = S.SRCE_TP_CD )    AS SRCE_TP_CD

  FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_RMTL S

            WHEN S.DATA_TP_CD = 'EOH' THEN 4 END   AS SORT

          WHERE LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_LGTM'

NAME: SCM_LGTM_MGMT_V
TEXT:
WITH GROUP_CD AS (SELECT
/****************************************************************************
* PROJECT       : LGES SCM
* VIEW NAME     : SCM_LGTM_MGMT_V
* DESCRIPTION   : SCPF0113 Long Term Stock Mgmt
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*--------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE        IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*--------------------------------------------------------------
* 2024.09.09   yangsh         Initial Release.
****************************************************************************/
 I.DIVISION_ID
                       , I.ITEM_ID
                       , MAX(CASE WHEN TRIM(F1.GROUP_CODE1) IS NOT NULL THEN F1.GROUP_CODE1
                                  WHEN TRIM(F3.GROUP_CODE1) IS NOT NULL THEN F3.GROUP_CODE1
                                  WHEN TRIM(F2.GROUP_CODE1) IS NOT NULL THEN F2.GROUP_CODE1
                                  WHEN TRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL           THEN NVL(I3.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME)
                                  ELSE NVL(I2.NICK_NAME, I.NICK_NAME) END) AS GROUP_CODE1
                    FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN      I
                       , SCM_ITEM_M_SN      I2
                       , SCM_ITEM_M_SN      I3
                       , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F1
                       , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F2
                       , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F3
                   WHERE I2.ITEM_ID(+)     = CASE WHEN TRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL THEN I.APPLIED_MODEL ELSE I.DOE END
                     AND I2.DIVISION_ID(+) = I.DIVISION_ID
                     AND I3.ITEM_ID(+)     = I2.DOE
                     AND I3.DIVISION_ID(+) = I2.DIVISION_ID
                     AND F1.ITEM_ID(+)     = I.ITEM_ID
                     AND F1.DIVISION_ID(+) = I.DIVISION_ID
                     AND F2.ITEM_ID(+)     = CASE WHEN TRIM(I.DOE) IS NULL THEN I.APPLIED_MODEL ELSE I.DOE END
                     AND F2.DIVISION_ID(+) = I.DIVISION_ID
                     AND F3.ITEM_ID(+)     = I2.DOE
                     AND F3.DIVISION_ID(+) = I2.DIVISION_ID
                   GROUP BY I.DIVISION_ID
                          , I.ITEM_ID)
   , BASE     AS (SELECT PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                       , TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(MIN(PLAN_YYYYMM) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), -1), 'YYYYMM') AS BASE_YYYYMM
                       , MAX(PLAN_YYYYMM)                                                                 AS LAST_YYYYMM
                    FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY
                   WHERE DATA_TP_CD = 'BOH'
                   GROUP BY PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 완제품 */
SELECT S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD                                              AS PLAN_DATE
     , S.PLAN_YYYYMM                                                      AS END_MONTH
     , S.DIVISION_ID                                                      AS DIV
     , S.COMPANY_ID                                                       AS COMPANY_ID
     , '*'                                                                AS PLANT_ID
     , SUBSTR(S.PLAN_TP_CD, 1, 4)                                         AS PLAN_TP_CD
     , S.DATA_TP_CD                                                       AS DATA_TP_CD
     , S.SRCE_TP_CD                                                       AS SRCE_TP_CD
     , '완제품'                                                           AS ITEM_TYPE
     , LK.ATTRIBUTE1                                                      AS CREATION_TYPE
     , S.GROUP_CODE1                                                      AS GROUP_CODE
     , FI.MKT_DEPT                                                        AS MKT_DEPT
     , FI.END_CUSTOMER                                                    AS END_CUSTOMER
     , S.ITEM_ID                                                          AS ITEM_ID
     , SIM.ITEM_NAME                                                      AS ITEM_NAME
     , SIM.UOM                                                            AS UOM
     , (SELECT SUM(QTY)
          FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY
         WHERE PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND PLAN_TP_CD          = S.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND DIVISION_ID         = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID             = S.ITEM_ID
           AND DATA_TP_CD          = 'S'
           AND PLAN_YYYYMM        <= S.PLAN_YYYYMM)                       AS RTF
     , MAX(S.STANDARD_COST)                                              AS PRICE
     , SUM(S.AMT)                                                        AS AMT
     , ROUND(SUM(S.QTY), 2)                                             AS TOTAL
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '부실'      THEN S.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS LONG_TERM_QTY
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '부실 징후' THEN S.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.DEVALUATION_AGE = 'GRM03'     THEN S.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS NEW_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.DEVALUATION_AGE = 'GRM03'     THEN S.AMT ELSE 0 END) AS NEW_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_AMT
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '비대상'    THEN S.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS NORMAL_QTY
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_PRICE)                                            AS RESULT_PRICE
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_NORMAL_QTY)                                       AS RESULT_NORMAL_QTY
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY)                             AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_LONG_TERM_QTY)                                    AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_QTY
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_LONG_TERM_AMT)                                    AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_AMT
     , (SELECT BASE_YYYYMM FROM BASE WHERE PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD) AS BASE_YYYYMM
     , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR))                                     AS PIC
     , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(4000 CHAR))                                     AS MIN_EXHT_YYYYMM
  FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY      S
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM            FI
     , (SELECT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, MAX(ITEM_UOM) AS UOM, MAX(ITEM_NAME) AS ITEM_NAME
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID) SIM
     , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL  LK
     , (SELECT PLAN_TP_CD, PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, SRCE_TP_CD, DIVISION_ID, ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID, GROUP_CODE1, ITEM_ID, ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
             , MAX(STANDARD_COST)                                        AS RESULT_PRICE
