             , SUM(CASE WHEN LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '비대상'    THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS RESULT_NORMAL_QTY
             , SUM(CASE WHEN LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '부실 징후' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY
             , SUM(CASE WHEN LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '부실'      THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_QTY
             , SUM(CASE WHEN LONG_TERM_TYPE <> '비대상'    THEN AMT ELSE 0 END) AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_AMT
          FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY S2
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND PLAN_YYYYMM = (SELECT BASE_YYYYMM FROM BASE WHERE PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = S2.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
           AND DATA_TP_CD  = 'RESULT'
         GROUP BY PLAN_TP_CD, PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, SRCE_TP_CD, DIVISION_ID, ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID, GROUP_CODE1, ITEM_ID, ORIGIN_ITEM_ID) RLT
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND FI.DIVISION_ID(+)          = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND FI.ITEM_ID(+)              = S.ITEM_ID
   AND SIM.DIVISION_ID(+)         = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.ITEM_ID(+)             = S.ITEM_ID
   AND LK.SEGMENT2(+)             = S.DATA_TP_CD
   AND LK.SEGMENT3(+)             = S.SRCE_TP_CD
   AND LK.LOOKUP_TYPE(+)          = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_LGTM'
   AND LK.VALID_YN(+)             = 'Y'
   AND LK.SEGMENT1(+)             = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
   AND RLT.PLAN_TP_CD(+)          = S.PLAN_TP_CD
   AND RLT.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD(+) = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
   AND RLT.SRCE_TP_CD(+)          = S.SRCE_TP_CD
   AND RLT.DIVISION_ID(+)         = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND RLT.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID(+)  = S.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
   AND RLT.ITEM_ID(+)             = S.ITEM_ID
   AND RLT.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID(+)      = S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
   AND S.DATA_TP_CD     = 'EOH'
   AND S.LONG_TERM_TYPE IN ('부실', '부실 징후')
   AND S.PLAN_TP_CD     = 'FERT_INIT'
   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                 FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_IGR IGR
                WHERE IGR.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD ELSE IGR.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD END
                  AND IGR.PLAN_TP_CD          = 'FERT_INIT_GC'
                  AND IGR.PLAN_YYYYMM         = CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN S.PLAN_YYYYMM ELSE IGR.PLAN_YYYYMM END
                  AND IGR.LONG_TERM_TYPE      IN ('부실', '부실 징후')
                  AND IGR.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD ELSE IGR.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD END
                  AND IGR.DIVISION_ID         = CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN S.DIVISION_ID ELSE IGR.DIVISION_ID END
                  AND IGR.GROUP_CODE1         = CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN S.GROUP_CODE1 ELSE IGR.GROUP_CODE1 END)
 GROUP BY S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
        , S.PLAN_YYYYMM
        , S.DIVISION_ID
        , S.COMPANY_ID
        , S.PLAN_TP_CD
        , S.DATA_TP_CD
        , S.SRCE_TP_CD
        , LK.ATTRIBUTE1
        , S.GROUP_CODE1
        , FI.MKT_DEPT
        , FI.END_CUSTOMER
        , S.ITEM_ID
        , SIM.ITEM_NAME
        , SIM.UOM
UNION ALL
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 반제품 */
SELECT S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD                                              AS PLAN_DATE
     , S.PLAN_YYYYMM                                                      AS END_MONTH
     , S.DIVISION_ID                                                      AS DIV
     , S.COMPANY_ID                                                       AS COMPANY_ID
     , '*'                                                                AS PLANT_ID
     , SUBSTR(S.PLAN_TP_CD, 1, 4)                                         AS PLAN_TP_CD
     , S.DATA_TP_CD                                                       AS DATA_TP_CD
     , S.SRCE_TP_CD                                                       AS SRCE_TP_CD
     , '반제품'                                                           AS ITEM_TYPE
     , LK.ATTRIBUTE2                                                      AS CREATION_TYPE
     , S.GROUP_CODE1                                                      AS GROUP_CODE
     , FI.MKT_DEPT                                                        AS MKT_DEPT
     , FI.END_CUSTOMER                                                    AS END_CUSTOMER
     , S.ITEM_ID                                                          AS ITEM_ID
     , SIM.ITEM_NAME                                                      AS ITEM_NAME
     , SIM.UOM                                                            AS UOM
     , (SELECT SUM(QTY)
          FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_SPRD
         WHERE PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND PLAN_TP_CD          = S.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND DIVISION_ID         = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID             = S.ITEM_ID
           AND DATA_TP_CD          = 'S'
           AND PLAN_YYYYMM        <= S.PLAN_YYYYMM)                       AS RTF
     , MAX(S.STANDARD_COST)                                              AS PRICE
     , SUM(S.AMT)                                                        AS AMT
     , ROUND(SUM(S.QTY), 2)                                             AS TOTAL
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '부실'      THEN S.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS LONG_TERM_QTY
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '부실 징후' THEN S.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.DEVALUATION_AGE = 'GRM03'     THEN S.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS NEW_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.DEVALUATION_AGE = 'GRM03'     THEN S.AMT ELSE 0 END) AS NEW_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_AMT
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '비대상'    THEN S.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS NORMAL_QTY
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_PRICE)                                            AS RESULT_PRICE
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_NORMAL_QTY)                                       AS RESULT_NORMAL_QTY
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY)                             AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_LONG_TERM_QTY)                                    AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_QTY
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_LONG_TERM_AMT)                                    AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_AMT
     , (SELECT BASE_YYYYMM FROM BASE WHERE PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD) AS BASE_YYYYMM
     , NULL                                                             AS PIC
     , NULL                                                             AS MIN_EXHT_YYYYMM
  FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_SPRD S
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM            FI
     , (SELECT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, MAX(ITEM_UOM) AS UOM, MAX(ITEM_NAME) AS ITEM_NAME
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID) SIM
     , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL  LK
     , (SELECT PLAN_TP_CD, PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, SRCE_TP_CD, DIVISION_ID, GROUP_CODE1, ITEM_ID, ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
             , MAX(STANDARD_COST)                                        AS RESULT_PRICE
             , SUM(CASE WHEN LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '비대상'    THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS RESULT_NORMAL_QTY
             , SUM(CASE WHEN LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '부실 징후' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY
             , SUM(CASE WHEN LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '부실'      THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_QTY
             , SUM(CASE WHEN LONG_TERM_TYPE <> '비대상'    THEN AMT ELSE 0 END) AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_AMT
          FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_SPRD S2
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND PLAN_YYYYMM = (SELECT BASE_YYYYMM FROM BASE WHERE PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = S2.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
           AND DATA_TP_CD  = 'RESULT'
         GROUP BY PLAN_TP_CD, PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, SRCE_TP_CD, DIVISION_ID, GROUP_CODE1, ITEM_ID, ORIGIN_ITEM_ID) RLT
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND FI.DIVISION_ID(+)          = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND FI.ITEM_ID(+)              = S.ITEM_ID
   AND SIM.DIVISION_ID(+)         = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.ITEM_ID(+)             = S.ITEM_ID
   AND LK.SEGMENT2(+)             = S.DATA_TP_CD
   AND LK.SEGMENT3(+)             = S.SRCE_TP_CD
   AND LK.LOOKUP_TYPE(+)          = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_LGTM'
   AND LK.VALID_YN(+)             = 'Y'
   AND LK.SEGMENT1(+)             = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
   AND RLT.PLAN_TP_CD(+)          = S.PLAN_TP_CD
   AND RLT.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD(+) = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
   AND RLT.SRCE_TP_CD(+)          = S.SRCE_TP_CD
   AND RLT.DIVISION_ID(+)         = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND RLT.ITEM_ID(+)             = S.ITEM_ID
   AND RLT.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID(+)      = S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
   AND S.DATA_TP_CD     = 'EOH'
   AND S.LONG_TERM_TYPE IN ('부실', '부실 징후')
   AND S.PLAN_TP_CD     = 'SPRD_INIT'
   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                 FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_SPRD_IGR IGR
                WHERE IGR.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD ELSE IGR.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD END
                  AND IGR.PLAN_TP_CD          = 'SPRD_INIT_GC'
                  AND IGR.PLAN_YYYYMM         = CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN S.PLAN_YYYYMM ELSE IGR.PLAN_YYYYMM END
                  AND IGR.LONG_TERM_TYPE      IN ('부실', '부실 징후')
                  AND IGR.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD ELSE IGR.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD END
                  AND IGR.DIVISION_ID         = CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN S.DIVISION_ID ELSE IGR.DIVISION_ID END
                  AND IGR.GROUP_CODE1         = CASE WHEN S.DIVISION_ID = '81' THEN S.GROUP_CODE1 ELSE IGR.GROUP_CODE1 END)
 GROUP BY S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
        , S.PLAN_YYYYMM
        , S.DIVISION_ID
        , S.COMPANY_ID
        , S.PLAN_TP_CD
        , S.DATA_TP_CD
        , S.SRCE_TP_CD
        , LK.ATTRIBUTE2
        , S.GROUP_CODE1
        , FI.MKT_DEPT
        , FI.END_CUSTOMER
        , S.ITEM_ID
        , SIM.ITEM_NAME
        , SIM.UOM
UNION ALL
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 원재료 */
SELECT S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD                                              AS PLAN_DATE
     , S.PLAN_YYYYMM                                                      AS END_MONTH
     , S.DIVISION_ID                                                      AS DIV
     , '*'                                                                AS COMPANY_ID
     , S.PLANT_ID                                                         AS PLANT_ID
     , SUBSTR(S.PLAN_TP_CD, 1, 4)                                         AS PLAN_TP_CD
     , S.DATA_TP_CD                                                       AS DATA_TP_CD
     , S.SRCE_TP_CD                                                       AS SRCE_TP_CD
     , '원재료'                                                           AS ITEM_TYPE
     , LK.ATTRIBUTE3                                                      AS CREATION_TYPE
     , S.PROCESS_DETAIL                                                   AS GROUP_CODE
     , FI.MKT_DEPT                                                        AS MKT_DEPT
     , (SELECT GR2.GROUP_CODE1
          FROM SCM_MST_BOM_EFFECTIVE_SN BOM2
             , GROUP_CD                 GR2
         WHERE GR2.ITEM_ID(+)     = BOM2.MODEL_ID
           AND GR2.DIVISION_ID(+) = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND BOM2.EFF_START_DATE >= SYSDATE
           AND BOM2.DIVISION_ID    = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND BOM2.CHILD_ITEM_ID  = S.ITEM_ID
         FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)                                         AS END_CUSTOMER
     , S.ITEM_ID                                                          AS ITEM_ID
     , SIM.ITEM_NAME                                                      AS ITEM_NAME
     , SIM.UOM                                                            AS UOM
     , (SELECT SUM(QTY)
          FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_RMTL
         WHERE PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND PLAN_TP_CD          = S.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND DIVISION_ID         = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND PLANT_ID            = S.PLANT_ID
           AND ITEM_ID             = S.ITEM_ID
           AND DATA_TP_CD          = 'S'
           AND PLAN_YYYYMM        <= S.PLAN_YYYYMM)                       AS RTF
     , MAX(S.STANDARD_COST)                                              AS PRICE
     , SUM(S.AMT)                                                        AS AMT
     , ROUND(SUM(S.QTY), 2)                                             AS TOTAL
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '부실'      THEN S.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS LONG_TERM_QTY
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '부실 징후' THEN S.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.DEVALUATION_AGE = 'GRM03'     THEN S.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS NEW_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.DEVALUATION_AGE = 'GRM03'     THEN S.AMT ELSE 0 END) AS NEW_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_AMT
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '비대상'    THEN S.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS NORMAL_QTY
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_PRICE)                                            AS RESULT_PRICE
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_NORMAL_QTY)                                       AS RESULT_NORMAL_QTY
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY)                             AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_LONG_TERM_QTY)                                    AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_QTY
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_LONG_TERM_AMT)                                    AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_AMT
     , (SELECT BASE_YYYYMM FROM BASE WHERE PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD) AS BASE_YYYYMM
     , PIC.PIC_NM                                                       AS PIC
     , NULL                                                             AS MIN_EXHT_YYYYMM
  FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_RMTL S
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM            FI
     , (SELECT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, MAX(ITEM_UOM) AS UOM, MAX(ITEM_NAME) AS ITEM_NAME
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID) SIM
     , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL  LK
     , SCP_MST_PIC_INFO              PIC
     , (SELECT PLAN_TP_CD, PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, SRCE_TP_CD, DIVISION_ID, GROUP_CODE1, ITEM_ID, ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
             , MAX(STANDARD_COST)                                        AS RESULT_PRICE
             , SUM(CASE WHEN LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '비대상'    THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS RESULT_NORMAL_QTY
             , SUM(CASE WHEN LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '부실 징후' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY
             , SUM(CASE WHEN LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '부실'      THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_QTY
             , SUM(CASE WHEN LONG_TERM_TYPE <> '비대상'    THEN AMT ELSE 0 END) AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_AMT
          FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_RMTL S2
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND PLAN_YYYYMM = (SELECT BASE_YYYYMM FROM BASE WHERE PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = S2.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
           AND DATA_TP_CD  = 'RESULT'
         GROUP BY PLAN_TP_CD, PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, SRCE_TP_CD, DIVISION_ID, GROUP_CODE1, ITEM_ID, ORIGIN_ITEM_ID) RLT
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND FI.DIVISION_ID(+)          = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND FI.ITEM_ID(+)              = S.ITEM_ID
   AND SIM.DIVISION_ID(+)         = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.ITEM_ID(+)             = S.ITEM_ID
   AND LK.SEGMENT2(+)             = S.DATA_TP_CD
   AND LK.SEGMENT3(+)             = S.SRCE_TP_CD
   AND LK.LOOKUP_TYPE(+)          = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_LGTM'
   AND LK.VALID_YN(+)             = 'Y'
   AND LK.SEGMENT1(+)             = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
   AND PIC.PLANT_ID(+)            = S.PLANT_ID
   AND PIC.ITEM_ID(+)             = S.ITEM_ID
   AND RLT.PLAN_TP_CD(+)          = S.PLAN_TP_CD
   AND RLT.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD(+) = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
   AND RLT.SRCE_TP_CD(+)          = S.SRCE_TP_CD
   AND RLT.DIVISION_ID(+)         = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND RLT.ITEM_ID(+)             = S.ITEM_ID
   AND RLT.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID(+)      = S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
   AND S.DATA_TP_CD     = 'EOH'
   AND S.LONG_TERM_TYPE IN ('부실', '부실 징후')
   AND S.PLAN_TP_CD     = 'RMTL_INIT'
 GROUP BY S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
        , S.PLAN_YYYYMM
        , S.DIVISION_ID
        , S.PLANT_ID
        , S.PLAN_TP_CD
        , S.DATA_TP_CD
        , S.SRCE_TP_CD
        , LK.ATTRIBUTE3
        , S.PROCESS_DETAIL
        , S.GROUP_CODE1
        , FI.MKT_DEPT
        , FI.END_CUSTOMER
        , S.ITEM_ID
        , SIM.ITEM_NAME
        , SIM.UOM
        , PIC.PIC_NM
UNION ALL
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ 상품 */
SELECT S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD                                              AS PLAN_DATE
     , S.PLAN_YYYYMM                                                      AS END_MONTH
     , S.DIVISION_ID                                                      AS DIV
     , '*'                                                                AS COMPANY_ID
     , '*'                                                                AS PLANT_ID
     , SUBSTR(S.PLAN_TP_CD, 1, 4)                                         AS PLAN_TP_CD
     , S.DATA_TP_CD                                                       AS DATA_TP_CD
     , S.SRCE_TP_CD                                                       AS SRCE_TP_CD
     , '상품'                                                             AS ITEM_TYPE
     , LK.ATTRIBUTE4                                                      AS CREATION_TYPE
     , S.PROCESS_DETAIL                                                   AS GROUP_CODE
     , FI.MKT_DEPT                                                        AS MKT_DEPT
     , FI.END_CUSTOMER                                                    AS END_CUSTOMER
     , S.ITEM_ID                                                          AS ITEM_ID
     , SIM.ITEM_NAME                                                      AS ITEM_NAME
     , SIM.UOM                                                            AS UOM
     , (SELECT SUM(QTY)
          FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_GODS
         WHERE PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND PLAN_TP_CD          = S.PLAN_TP_CD
           AND DIVISION_ID         = S.DIVISION_ID
           AND ITEM_ID             = S.ITEM_ID
           AND DATA_TP_CD          = 'S'
           AND PLAN_YYYYMM        <= S.PLAN_YYYYMM)                       AS RTF
     , MAX(S.STANDARD_COST)                                              AS PRICE
     , SUM(S.AMT)                                                        AS AMT
     , ROUND(SUM(S.QTY), 2)                                             AS TOTAL
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '부실'      THEN S.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS LONG_TERM_QTY
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '부실 징후' THEN S.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.DEVALUATION_AGE = 'GRM03'     THEN S.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS NEW_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.DEVALUATION_AGE = 'GRM03'     THEN S.AMT ELSE 0 END) AS NEW_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_AMT
     , SUM(CASE WHEN S.LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '비대상'    THEN S.QTY ELSE 0 END) AS NORMAL_QTY
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_PRICE)                                            AS RESULT_PRICE
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_NORMAL_QTY)                                       AS RESULT_NORMAL_QTY
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY)                             AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_LONG_TERM_QTY)                                    AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_QTY
     , MAX(RLT.RESULT_LONG_TERM_AMT)                                    AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_AMT
     , (SELECT BASE_YYYYMM FROM BASE WHERE PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD) AS BASE_YYYYMM
     , NULL                                                             AS PIC
     , NULL                                                             AS MIN_EXHT_YYYYMM
  FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_GODS S
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM            FI
     , (SELECT DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, MAX(ITEM_UOM) AS UOM, MAX(ITEM_NAME) AS ITEM_NAME
          FROM SCM_ITEM_M_SN
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID) SIM
     , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL  LK
     , (SELECT PLAN_TP_CD, PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, SRCE_TP_CD, DIVISION_ID, GROUP_CODE1, ITEM_ID, ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
             , MAX(STANDARD_COST)                                        AS RESULT_PRICE
             , SUM(CASE WHEN LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '비대상'    THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS RESULT_NORMAL_QTY
             , SUM(CASE WHEN LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '부실 징후' THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_EXPECT_QTY
             , SUM(CASE WHEN LONG_TERM_TYPE  = '부실'      THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_QTY
             , SUM(CASE WHEN LONG_TERM_TYPE <> '비대상'    THEN AMT ELSE 0 END) AS RESULT_LONG_TERM_AMT
          FROM SCM_LGTM_INV_PSI_SUMMARY_GODS S2
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND PLAN_YYYYMM = (SELECT BASE_YYYYMM FROM BASE WHERE PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = S2.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
           AND DATA_TP_CD  = 'RESULT'
         GROUP BY PLAN_TP_CD, PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, SRCE_TP_CD, DIVISION_ID, GROUP_CODE1, ITEM_ID, ORIGIN_ITEM_ID) RLT
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND FI.DIVISION_ID(+)          = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND FI.ITEM_ID(+)              = S.ITEM_ID
   AND SIM.DIVISION_ID(+)         = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND SIM.ITEM_ID(+)             = S.ITEM_ID
   AND LK.SEGMENT2(+)             = S.DATA_TP_CD
   AND LK.SEGMENT3(+)             = S.SRCE_TP_CD
   AND LK.LOOKUP_TYPE(+)          = 'SCM_LGTM_CODE_NAME_FOR_LGTM'
   AND LK.VALID_YN(+)             = 'Y'
   AND LK.SEGMENT1(+)             = 'SRCE_TP_CD'
   AND RLT.PLAN_TP_CD(+)          = S.PLAN_TP_CD
   AND RLT.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD(+) = S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
   AND RLT.SRCE_TP_CD(+)          = S.SRCE_TP_CD
   AND RLT.DIVISION_ID(+)         = S.DIVISION_ID
   AND RLT.ITEM_ID(+)             = S.ITEM_ID
   AND RLT.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID(+)      = S.ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
   AND S.DATA_TP_CD     = 'EOH'
   AND S.LONG_TERM_TYPE IN ('부실', '부실 징후')
   AND S.PLAN_TP_CD     = 'GODS_INIT'
 GROUP BY S.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
        , S.PLAN_YYYYMM
        , S.DIVISION_ID
        , S.PLAN_TP_CD
        , S.DATA_TP_CD
        , S.SRCE_TP_CD
        , LK.ATTRIBUTE4
        , S.PROCESS_DETAIL
        , FI.MKT_DEPT
        , FI.END_CUSTOMER
        , S.ITEM_ID
        , SIM.ITEM_NAME
        , SIM.UOM

NAME: SCM_MST_LINE_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCM_MST_LINE_V
 * Description  : SCM_MST_LINE_SN 정보와 SCM_MST_LINE_OSP 정보를 UNION하여 보여줌
                  LINE_NAME 정보를 조회 하기 위해서
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2020.02.07  KTH      Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX   [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
       COMPANY_ID
     , DIVISION_ID
     , SITE_ID
     , PLANT_ID
     , FACTORY_ID
     , OPERATION_ID
     , LINE_ID
     , ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , LINE_NAME
     , 'Y' AS VALID_YN
/*   , 'N' AS OSP_YN */
  FROM SCM_MST_LINE_SN
 UNION ALL
SELECT
       NULL         AS COMPANY_ID
     , DIVISION_ID
     , SCM_SITE_ID  AS SITE_ID
     , OPERATION_ID AS PLANT_ID
     , NULL         AS FACTORY_ID
     , OPERATION_ID
     , LINE_ID
     , NULL         AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , LINE_NAME
     , VALID_YN
/*   , 'Y' AS OSP_YN */
  FROM SCM_MST_LINE_OSP

NAME: SCM_MST_MODEL_FINAL_ITEM_BOM_V1
TEXT:
SELECT B.DIVISION_ID
     , B.PLANT_ID
     , B.MODEL_ID
     , B.CHILD_ITEM_ID
     , V.OPERATION_GROUP_ID
     , CASE V.OPERATION_GROUP_ID WHEN 'P' THEN 1   -- 전지 팩
                                 WHEN 'A' THEN 2   -- 전지 셀
                                 WHEN 'E' THEN 3   -- 전지 전극
                                 ELSE 9
       END AS OPERATION_SORT_NO
     , V.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , V.TCO_CELL_YN
     , SUM(B.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY) AS ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
     , V.CELL_TYPE   -- 20230602 PJ20230691 활성화 대응 Cell Prod/Assy 구분자
  FROM ( SELECT X.*
           FROM SCM_MST_BOM_SN_V X       -- 2021-03-09 SCP 대치 BOM 적용
                INNER JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_SN I
                        ON X.CHILD_DIVISION_ID = I.DIVISION_ID
                       AND X.CHILD_ITEM_ID     = I.ITEM_ID
                       AND X.CHILD_COMPANY_ID  = I.COMPANY_ID
                       AND X.CHILD_SITE_ID     = I.SITE_ID
                       AND I.ACTIVE_FLAG       = 'Y'
          WHERE 1 = 1
            AND X.NLEVEL = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT C.CONCATENATE_ITEM)
                              FROM SCM_MST_BOM_SN_V C
                             WHERE 1 = 1
                               AND X.COMPANY_ID        = C.COMPANY_ID
                               AND X.DIVISION_ID       = C.DIVISION_ID
                               AND X.SITE_ID           = C.SITE_ID
                               AND X.PLANT_ID          = C.PLANT_ID
                               AND X.MODEL_ID          = C.MODEL_ID
                               AND X.CONCATENATE_ITEM != C.CONCATENATE_ITEM
                               AND X.CONCATENATE_ITEM LIKE C.CONCATENATE_ITEM || '^%'
                               AND C.ALT_PRIORITY      = 'Y'
                           )
        ) B
     , SCM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V V
     , SCM_MST_ITEM_SN MI    -- 20210219 C20210219-000229 Company 별 유효 Model
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND B.DIVISION_ID   = V.DIVISION_ID
   AND B.CHILD_ITEM_ID = V.ITEM_ID
   AND B.ALT_PRIORITY  = 'Y'
   AND B.DIVISION_ID   = MI.DIVISION_ID
   AND B.MODEL_ID      = MI.ITEM_ID
   AND B.COMPANY_ID    = MI.COMPANY_ID
   AND B.SITE_ID       = MI.SITE_ID
   AND MI.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
 GROUP BY B.DIVISION_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.MODEL_ID, B.CHILD_ITEM_ID, V.OPERATION_GROUP_ID, V.ELECTRODE_TYPE, V.TCO_CELL_YN, V.CELL_TYPE

NAME: SCM_MST_MODEL_ONE_LEVEL_BOM_V
TEXT:
SELECT B.DIVISION_ID
     , B.PLANT_ID
     , B.MODEL_ID
     , B.CHILD_ITEM_ID
     , MAX(I.ITEM_TYPE) AS ITEM_TYPE
     , MAX(I.ITEM_NAME) AS ITEM_NAME
     , MAX(I.ITEM_UOM)  AS ITEM_UOM
     , FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(B.DIVISION_ID, B.CHILD_ITEM_ID)    AS OPERATION_GROUP
     , FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP_ID(B.DIVISION_ID, B.CHILD_ITEM_ID) AS OPERATION_GROUP_ID
     , SUM(B.ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY)                                   AS ACCUMULATED_CHILD_QTY
  FROM (SELECT X.*
           /* FROM scm_mst_bom_sn x */
           FROM SCM_MST_BOM_SN_V X  /* 2021-03-09 SCP 대치 BOM 적용 */
                INNER JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_SN I
                ON  X.CHILD_DIVISION_ID = I.DIVISION_ID
                AND X.CHILD_ITEM_ID     = I.ITEM_ID
                AND X.CHILD_COMPANY_ID  = I.COMPANY_ID /* A002 빈강 추가 따른 조건 추가 */
                AND X.CHILD_SITE_ID     = I.SITE_ID
                AND I.ACTIVE_FLAG       = 'Y'
          WHERE 1 = 1
         ) B
     , SCM_MST_ITEM_SN I
     , SCM_MST_ITEM_SN MI   /* 20210219 C20210219-000229  Company 별로 유효한 Model만 적용 */
 WHERE 1 = 1
   /* and ( b.alt_id IS NULL OR ( b.alt_id IS NOT NULL AND b.alt_priority = 1 ) --=> BOM 원본테이블에 적용. */
   AND B.ALT_PRIORITY  = 'Y'  /* => FP에서 MODEL별로 전개한 테이블에 적용. */
   AND B.DIVISION_ID   = I.DIVISION_ID
   AND B.CHILD_ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID
   AND B.COMPANY_ID    = I.COMPANY_ID  /* A002 빈강 추가 따른 조건 추가 */
   AND B.SITE_ID       = I.SITE_ID
   AND I.ITEM_TYPE    IN ('P', 'H')
   AND I.ACTIVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
   /* 20210219 C20210219-000229  Company 별로 유효한 Model만 적용 */
   AND B.DIVISION_ID   = MI.DIVISION_ID
   AND B.MODEL_ID      = MI.ITEM_ID
   AND B.COMPANY_ID    = MI.COMPANY_ID  /* A002 빈강 추가 따른 조건 추가 */
   AND B.SITE_ID       = MI.SITE_ID
   AND MI.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
GROUP BY B.DIVISION_ID, B.PLANT_ID, B.MODEL_ID, B.CHILD_ITEM_ID

NAME: SCM_MST_OFF_CALENDAR_V
TEXT:
WITH A AS
(
    SELECT C.COMPANY_ID
         , C.DIVISION_ID
         , C.SITE_ID
         , C.PLANT_ID
         , C.FACTORY_ID
         , C.OPERATION_ID
         , C.LINE_ID
         , C.EQUIPMENT_ID
         , C.OFF_START_TIME AS OFF_TIME
         , (C.OFF_END_TIME - C.OFF_START_TIME) * 24 * 60 OFF_TIME_MINUTE
      FROM (SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
                 , A.DIVISION_ID
                 , A.SITE_ID
                 , A.PLANT_ID
                 , A.FACTORY_ID
                 , A.OPERATION_ID
                 , A.LINE_ID
                 , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                 , A.OFF_START_TIME + (REPLACE(B.SEGMENT2, '0', '') * -1) / 24 OFF_START_TIME
                 , A.OFF_END_TIME   + (REPLACE(B.SEGMENT2, '0', '') * -1) / 24 OFF_END_TIME
              FROM SCM_MST_OFF_CALENDAR_SN A
              JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_VALUE_FP_SN B
                ON A.PLANT_ID = B.SEGMENT1
               AND B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'BASIS_START_TIME_PLANT') C
)
SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.SITE_ID
     , A.PLANT_ID
     , A.FACTORY_ID
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.LINE_ID
     , TO_CHAR(A.OFF_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD') OFF_DAY
     , SUM(A.OFF_TIME_MINUTE) OFF_TIME_MINUTE
  FROM A
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X'
                     FROM SCM_MST_EQUIPMENT_EXCEPT_SN B
                    WHERE B.COMPANY_ID   = A.COMPANY_ID
                      AND B.DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                      AND B.SITE_ID      = A.SITE_ID
                      AND B.PLANT_ID     = A.PLANT_ID
                      AND B.FACTORY_ID   = A.FACTORY_ID
                      AND B.EQUIPMENT_ID = A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                      AND B.START_TIME  <= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(A.OFF_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYYMMDD')
                      AND B.END_TIME    >= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(A.OFF_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYYMMDD')
                      AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y')
 GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID
        , A.DIVISION_ID
        , A.SITE_ID
        , A.PLANT_ID
        , A.FACTORY_ID
        , A.OPERATION_ID
        , A.LINE_ID
        , TO_CHAR(A.OFF_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD')

NAME: SCM_MST_OPERATION_FLOW_V
TEXT:
SELECT T."COMPANY_ID",T."DIVISION_ID",T."SITE_ID",T."FLOW_ID",T."OPERATION_ID",T."OPERATION_SEQ",T."ACTIVE_FLAG",T."DESCRIPTION",T."INSERT_ID",T."INSERT_TIME",T."UPDATE_ID",T."UPDATE_TIME"
     , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) = 'F' THEN 'A'          /* 활성화 => CELL */
            WHEN SUBSTR(T.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) = 'S' THEN 'E'          /* SRS => 전극 */
            ELSE SUBSTR(T.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1)
       END    AS OPERATION_GROUP
     , CASE WHEN T.DIVISION_ID = '40'
                 AND T.OPERATION_ID IN ('F6200', 'F7000', 'F7100', 'F7200', 'F7300') THEN 'Y'   /* 2018-07-20 소형 조정 */
            WHEN SUBSTR(T.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) = 'F' THEN 'N'
            WHEN SUBSTR(T.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) = 'S' THEN 'N'
            ELSE 'Y'
       END    AS VALID_YN
  FROM SCM_MST_OPERATION_FLOW_SN    T
       INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION    D                               /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상사업부 */
         ON  D.DIVISION_ID = T.DIVISION_ID
         AND D.ATTRIBUTE3  <> 'EE'
         AND D.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
 WHERE 1 = 1

NAME: SCM_MST_SITE_DEPT_V
TEXT:
SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SCM_MST_SITE_DEPT_V
 * Description  : Site 대표 부서
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018.09.03   Kim Jihye      Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2018.09.11   Kim Jihye      소형의 경우 여러 Owner 인 경우 첫번째 Owner 의 부서 정보 적용
 * 2026.09.29   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304] MSSQL -> Oracle 전환
 *                             SCM_MST_SITE.DEPT_ID 삭제에 따라 부서 축을 아이템 원장으로 변경
 */
 DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
              , C.DEPT_ID
              , C.UPPER_DEPT_ID
              , A.SCM_SITE_ID
              , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100))                                AS ITEM_ID
              , CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100))                                AS PROJECT_CODE
  FROM SCM_MST_SITE A
     , SCM_MST_SITE_DEPT_REP_V B
     , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
   AND A.SCM_SITE_ID  = B.SCM_SITE_ID
   AND B.DEPT_ID      = C.DEPT_ID
   AND A.SITE_TYPE    = 'SALES'
   AND A.DIVISION_ID <> '40'
 UNION
SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID
              , C.DEPT_ID
              , C.UPPER_DEPT_ID
              , A.SCM_SITE_ID
              , A.ITEM_ID
              , A.PROJECT_CODE
  FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM A
     , SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO B
     , SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO C
 WHERE TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(A.OWNER, '[^,]+', 1, 1)) = B.USER_ID
   AND B.DEPT_ID            = C.DEPT_ID
   AND A.DIVISION_ID        = '40'
   AND TRIM(A.ITEM_ID)      IS NOT NULL
   AND TRIM(A.PROJECT_CODE) IS NOT NULL

NAME: SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY_V
TEXT:
SELECT /****************************************************************************
  * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY_V
  * DESCRIPTION   : 선호 사이트 정보를 조회 ( valid_yn = 'Y'이면서 priority가 가장 작은값이 조회됨 )
  *
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE        IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018.03.23   KSW                 INITIAL
  * 2020.03.24   KSG                 Warranty Plant Site 제외
  *************************************************************************** */  A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.PROJECT_CODE
     , A.PLANT_SITE_ID
     , A.SALES_SITE_ID
     , A.ITEM_ID
     , A.FROM_YYYYMMDD
     , A.TO_YYYYMMDD
  FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY A
     , (SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , PROJECT_CODE
             , SALES_SITE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , FROM_YYYYMMDD
             , TO_YYYYMMDD
             , MIN(PRIORITY) AS MIN_PRIORITY
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY
         WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
         GROUP BY DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SALES_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID, FROM_YYYYMMDD, TO_YYYYMMDD
       ) B
     , (SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , SCM_SITE_ID
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE
         WHERE VALID_YN  = 'Y'
           AND SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
           AND OPERATION_GROUP <> 'W'  /* 20200324 AS Site 제외 */
       ) C
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
   AND A.PROJECT_CODE  = B.PROJECT_CODE
   AND A.SALES_SITE_ID = B.SALES_SITE_ID
   AND A.ITEM_ID       = B.ITEM_ID
   AND A.FROM_YYYYMMDD = B.FROM_YYYYMMDD
   AND A.TO_YYYYMMDD   = B.TO_YYYYMMDD
   AND A.PRIORITY      = B.MIN_PRIORITY
   AND A.DIVISION_ID   = C.DIVISION_ID
   AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = C.SCM_SITE_ID
   AND A.VALID_YN      = 'Y'

NAME: SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_EXCT_VER_V
TEXT:
WITH MASTER_VERSION AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT division_id, operation_id, version_id
      FROM (SELECT v.division_id, r.operation_id, MAX(v.version_id) AS version_id
              FROM scm_master_version_info_h_sn v
              JOIN scm_mst_division d
                ON d.division_id = v.division_id
               AND d.attribute3 != 'EE'
               AND d.valid_yn    = 'Y'
                 , scm_mst_operation_sn r
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND v.scp_use_flag = 'Y'
               AND SUBSTR(r.operation_id, 1, 1) NOT IN ('E', 'S')
             GROUP BY v.division_id, r.operation_id
            UNION
            SELECT d.division_id, r.operation_id, MAX(v.version_id) AS version_id
              FROM scm_master_version_info_h_sn v
              JOIN scm_mst_division dm
                ON dm.division_id = v.division_id
               AND dm.valid_yn    = 'Y'
              JOIN scm_mst_division d
                ON d.attribute4  = dm.attribute4
               AND d.attribute3 != 'EE'
               AND d.valid_yn    = 'Y'
                 , scm_mst_operation_sn r
             WHERE 1 = 1
               AND dm.attribute3   = 'EE'
               AND v.scp_use_flag  = 'Y'
               AND SUBSTR(r.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('E', 'S')
             GROUP BY d.division_id, r.operation_id) a
)
SELECT tt.version_id, tt.division_id, tt.company_id, tt.site_id, tt.plant_id, tt.factory_id, tt.plant_site_id
     , tt.item_id, tt.operation_id, tt.line_id, tt.start_time, tt.end_time
     , (CASE WHEN tt.operation_group_id <> 'E' THEN MAX(NVL(tt.tact_time, 0))
             WHEN MAX(NVL(A.lane_qty, 0)) = 0 THEN MAX(NVL(tt.tact_time, 0))
             ELSE MAX(NVL(tt.tact_time, 0)) / MAX(NVL(A.lane_qty, 0))
        END)  AS tact_time
     , (CASE WHEN tt.operation_group_id <> 'E' THEN MAX(NVL(tt.daily_capa, 0))
             WHEN MAX(NVL(A.lane_qty, 0)) = 0 THEN MAX(NVL(tt.daily_capa, 0))
             ELSE MAX(NVL(tt.daily_capa, 0)) * MAX(NVL(A.lane_qty, 0))
        END)  AS daily_capa
  FROM (SELECT t.version_id, t.division_id, t.company_id, t.site_id, t.plant_id, t.factory_id
             , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(t.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('E', 'S')      THEN 'E'
                    WHEN SUBSTR(t.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('A', 'B', 'F') THEN 'A'
                    WHEN SUBSTR(t.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('P')           THEN 'P'
                    ELSE 'A' END AS operation_group_id
             , t.plant_id || '-' ||
               CASE WHEN SUBSTR(t.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('E', 'S')      THEN 'E'
                    WHEN SUBSTR(t.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('A', 'B', 'F') THEN 'A'
                    WHEN SUBSTR(t.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('P')           THEN 'P'
                    ELSE 'A' END AS plant_site_id
             , t.item_id, t.operation_id, t.line_id
             , TO_CHAR(t.start_time, 'YYYYMMDD') AS start_time
             , TO_CHAR(t.end_time, 'YYYYMMDD')   AS end_time
             , TO_CHAR(t.end_time, 'YYYYMM')     AS month
             , CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(t.daily_capa, 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((60 * 60 * 24) / MAX(NVL(t.daily_capa, 0)), 3) END AS tact_time
             , MAX(NVL(t.daily_capa, 0)) AS daily_capa
          FROM scm_tact_time_exct_ver_h_sn t
          JOIN MASTER_VERSION v
            ON t.division_id  = v.division_id
           AND t.operation_id = v.operation_id
           AND t.version_id   = v.version_id
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND t.end_time   >= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -2), 'YYYYMM') || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')
           AND t.active_flag  = 'Y'
         GROUP BY t.version_id, t.division_id, t.company_id, t.site_id, t.plant_id, t.factory_id
                , t.item_id, t.operation_id, t.line_id
                , TO_CHAR(t.start_time, 'YYYYMMDD')
                , TO_CHAR(t.end_time, 'YYYYMMDD')
                , TO_CHAR(t.end_time, 'YYYYMM')
        HAVING CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(t.daily_capa, 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((60 * 60 * 24) / MAX(NVL(t.daily_capa, 0)), 3) END > 0) tt
     , scm_mst_item_line_assign_sn a
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND tt.division_id  = a.division_id
   AND tt.company_id   = a.company_id
   AND tt.site_id      = a.site_id
   AND tt.plant_id     = a.plant_id
   AND tt.factory_id   = a.factory_id
   AND tt.operation_id = a.operation_id
   AND tt.item_id      = a.item_id
   AND tt.line_id      = a.line_id
   AND tt.month        = a.month
   AND a.active_flag   = 'Y'
   AND a.priority      NOT IN (0, 9)
 GROUP BY tt.version_id, tt.division_id, tt.company_id, tt.site_id, tt.plant_id, tt.factory_id, tt.plant_site_id, tt.operation_group_id
        , tt.item_id, tt.operation_id, tt.line_id, tt.start_time, tt.end_time

NAME: SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_VER_H_V
TEXT:
WITH MASTER_VERSION AS
(
       SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SCM_MST_TACT_TIME_VER_H_V
 * Description  : SCP Tact Time 용 View : FP 최신 Version 정보 사용
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2021.03.12   KSG            Initial Release PJ20209642 Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선
 * 2022.03.29   KSG            PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : GM JV 가상 Division
 * 2023-04-03   HRK            PJ20230691R LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX  [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
              DISTINCT DIVISION_ID
                     , OPERATION_ID
                     , VERSION_ID
         FROM ( SELECT V.DIVISION_ID
                     , R.OPERATION_ID
                     , MAX(V.VERSION_ID) AS VERSION_ID
                  FROM SCM_MASTER_VERSION_INFO_H_SN V
                     , SCM_MST_DIVISION             D    /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
                     , SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN         R
                 WHERE D.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
                   AND D.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE'
                   AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                   /* PJ20230691R HM JV 대응 AND V.DIVISION_ID IN ('40', '81', '82', '81_UC') -- 전극 별도 버전 존재함  -- 20220329 PJ20216891 GM JV 가상 Division 추가 */
                   AND V.SCP_USE_FLAG = 'Y'
                   AND SUBSTR(R.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) NOT IN ('E', 'S')
                 GROUP BY V.DIVISION_ID
                        , R.OPERATION_ID

                UNION
                /* 전극은 하나의 version으로 존재하나 실제 Data는 사업부별로 존재함  PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
                SELECT D.DIVISION_ID
                     , R.OPERATION_ID
                     , MAX(V.VERSION_ID) AS VERSION_ID
                  FROM SCM_MASTER_VERSION_INFO_H_SN V
                     , SCM_MST_DIVISION             DM
                     , SCM_MST_DIVISION             D
                     , SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN         R
                 WHERE DM.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
                   AND D.ATTRIBUTE4 = DM.ATTRIBUTE4
                   AND DM.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                   AND D.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE'
                   AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                   AND DM.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE'
                   AND V.SCP_USE_FLAG = 'Y'
                   AND SUBSTR(R.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) IN ('E', 'S')
                 GROUP BY D.DIVISION_ID
                        , R.OPERATION_ID

                /*  PJ20230691R HM JV 2023.04.03 주석처리 (EE와 JV EE 쿼리 하나로 통합)
              SELECT d.division_id, r.operation_id, MAX(v.version_id) AS version_id
              FROM   scm_master_version_info_h_sn v , scm_mst_operation_sn r , scm_mst_division d
              WHERE  1=1 AND v.division_id = 'EE' AND d.division_id IN ('40','81','82')
              AND    v.scp_use_flag = 'Y' AND SUBSTRING(r.operation_id,1,1) IN ('E','S')
              GROUP BY d.division_id, r.operation_id
              UNION
              SELECT d.division_id, r.operation_id, MAX(v.version_id) AS version_id
              FROM   scm_master_version_info_h_sn v , scm_mst_operation_sn r , scm_mst_division d
              WHERE  1=1 AND v.division_id = 'EE_UC' AND d.division_id = '81_UC'
              AND    v.scp_use_flag = 'Y' AND SUBSTRING(r.operation_id,1,1) IN ('E','S')
              GROUP BY d.division_id, r.operation_id
                */
              ) A
)
SELECT B.VERSION_ID
     , B.DIVISION_ID
     , B.COMPANY_ID
     , B.SITE_ID
     , B.PLANT_ID
     , B.FACTORY_ID
     , B.PLANT_SITE_ID
     , B.ITEM_ID
     , B.OPERATION_ID
     , B.LINE_ID
     , B.MONTH
     , B.TACT_TIME
     , B.DAILY_CAPA
     , B.LANE_QTY
  FROM ( SELECT T.VERSION_ID
              , T.DIVISION_ID
              , T.COMPANY_ID
              , T.SITE_ID
              , T.PLANT_ID
              , T.FACTORY_ID
              , T.PLANT_ID || '-' || T.OPERATION_GROUP_ID AS PLANT_SITE_ID
              , T.ITEM_ID
              , T.OPERATION_ID
              , T.LINE_ID
              , T.MONTH
                /* SCP에서 사용할 Tact Time : daily_capa 기준으로 처리 */
              , (CASE /* 셀, 팩일때 */
                      WHEN T.OPERATION_GROUP_ID <> 'E' THEN
                           CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((60 * 60 * 24) / MAX(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)), 3) END
                      /* 전극일때 */
                      WHEN MAX(NVL(A.LANE_QTY, 0)) = 0 THEN CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((60 * 60 * 24) / MAX(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)), 3) END
                      ELSE CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((60 * 60 * 24) / MAX(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)), 3) END
                          / MAX(NVL(A.LANE_QTY, 1))
                 END) AS TACT_TIME
              , MAX(NVL(A.LANE_QTY, 1)) AS LANE_QTY
              , (CASE /* 셀, 팩일때 */
                      WHEN T.OPERATION_GROUP_ID <> 'E' THEN
                           CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE MAX(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) END
                      /* 전극일때 */
                      WHEN MAX(NVL(A.LANE_QTY, 0)) = 0 THEN CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE MAX(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) END
                      ELSE CASE WHEN SUM(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE MAX(NVL(T.DAILY_CAPA, 0)) END
                          * MAX(NVL(A.LANE_QTY, 1))
                 END) AS DAILY_CAPA
           FROM ( SELECT T.*
                       , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) IN ('E', 'S')      THEN 'E'
                              WHEN SUBSTR(T.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) IN ('A', 'B', 'F') THEN 'A'
                              WHEN SUBSTR(T.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) IN ('P')           THEN 'P'
                              ELSE 'A'
                         END AS OPERATION_GROUP_ID
                    FROM SCM_TACT_TIME_VER_H_SN T
                       , MASTER_VERSION         V
                   WHERE T.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
                     AND T.OPERATION_ID = V.OPERATION_ID
                     AND T.VERSION_ID = V.VERSION_ID
                     AND T.MONTH > SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -2), 'YYYYMMDD'), 1, 6)  /* 전전월 */
                ) T
              , SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN A
          WHERE T.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND T.COMPANY_ID = A.COMPANY_ID
            AND T.SITE_ID = A.SITE_ID
            AND T.PLANT_ID = A.PLANT_ID
            AND T.FACTORY_ID = A.FACTORY_ID
            AND T.OPERATION_ID = A.OPERATION_ID
            AND T.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
            AND T.LINE_ID = A.LINE_ID
            AND T.MONTH = A.MONTH
            AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
            AND A.PRIORITY NOT IN (0, 9)  /* FP에서 0 / 9 는 생산 대상 아님 */
          GROUP BY T.VERSION_ID
                 , T.DIVISION_ID
                 , T.COMPANY_ID
                 , T.SITE_ID
                 , T.PLANT_ID
                 , T.FACTORY_ID
                 , T.OPERATION_GROUP_ID
                 , T.ITEM_ID
                 , T.OPERATION_ID
                 , T.LINE_ID
                 , T.MONTH
       ) B
 WHERE B.TACT_TIME > 0

NAME: SCM_MST_YIELD_EXCT_VER_H_V
TEXT:
WITH MASTER_VERSION AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT division_id, operation_id, version_id
      FROM ( SELECT v.division_id, r.operation_id, MAX(v.version_id) AS version_id
               FROM SCM_MASTER_VERSION_INFO_H_SN v
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION d
                            ON d.division_id = v.division_id
                           AND d.attribute3 != 'EE'
                           AND d.valid_yn   = 'Y'
                  , SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN r
              WHERE v.scp_use_flag = 'Y'
                AND SUBSTR(r.operation_id, 1, 1) NOT IN ('E', 'S')
              GROUP BY v.division_id, r.operation_id
             UNION
             -- 전극(EE)은 하나의 version이나 Data는 사업부별 (HM JV 통합)
             SELECT d.division_id, r.operation_id, MAX(v.version_id) AS version_id
               FROM SCM_MASTER_VERSION_INFO_H_SN v
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION dm
                            ON dm.division_id = v.division_id
                           AND dm.valid_yn   = 'Y'
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION d
                            ON d.attribute4 = dm.attribute4
                           AND d.attribute3 != 'EE'
                           AND d.valid_yn   = 'Y'
                  , SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN r
              WHERE dm.attribute3 = 'EE'
                AND v.scp_use_flag = 'Y'
                AND SUBSTR(r.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('E', 'S')
              GROUP BY d.division_id, r.operation_id ) a
)
SELECT tt.version_id, tt.division_id, tt.company_id, tt.site_id, tt.plant_id, tt.factory_id
     , tt.plant_id || '-' || tt.operation_group_id  AS plant_site_id
     , tt.item_id, tt.operation_id, tt.line_id, tt.start_time, tt.end_time
     , MAX(NVL(tt.yield, 0))  AS yield
  FROM ( SELECT t.version_id, t.division_id, t.company_id, t.site_id, t.plant_id, t.factory_id
              , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(t.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('E', 'S')      THEN 'E'
                     WHEN SUBSTR(t.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('A', 'B', 'F') THEN 'A'
                     WHEN SUBSTR(t.operation_id, 1, 1) IN ('P')           THEN 'P'
                     ELSE 'A'
                END  AS operation_group_id
              , t.item_id, t.operation_id, t.line_id
              , TO_CHAR(t.start_time, 'YYYYMMDD')  AS start_time
              , TO_CHAR(t.end_time, 'YYYYMMDD')    AS end_time
              , TO_CHAR(t.end_time, 'YYYYMM')      AS month   -- FP Except 는 일별
              , MAX(NVL(t.yield, 1))  AS yield
           FROM SCM_YIELD_EXCT_VER_H_SN t
                INNER JOIN MASTER_VERSION v
                        ON t.division_id  = v.division_id
                       AND t.operation_id = v.operation_id
                       AND t.version_id   = v.version_id
          WHERE t.end_time   >= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -2), 'YYYYMM') || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')   -- 전전월
            AND t.yield       > 0
            AND t.yield      <= 1
            AND t.active_flag = 'Y'
          GROUP BY t.version_id, t.division_id, t.company_id, t.site_id, t.plant_id, t.factory_id
                 , t.item_id, t.operation_id, t.line_id
                 , TO_CHAR(t.start_time, 'YYYYMMDD')
                 , TO_CHAR(t.end_time, 'YYYYMMDD')
                 , TO_CHAR(t.end_time, 'YYYYMM') ) tt
     , SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN a
 WHERE tt.division_id  = a.division_id
   AND tt.company_id   = a.company_id
   AND tt.site_id      = a.site_id
   AND tt.plant_id     = a.plant_id
   AND tt.factory_id   = a.factory_id
   AND tt.operation_id = a.operation_id
   AND tt.item_id      = a.item_id
   AND tt.line_id      = a.line_id
   AND tt.month        = a.month
   AND a.active_flag   = 'Y'
   AND a.priority NOT IN (0, 9)   -- FP에서 0/9 는 생산 대상 아님
 GROUP BY tt.version_id, tt.division_id, tt.company_id, tt.site_id, tt.plant_id, tt.factory_id, tt.operation_group_id
        , tt.item_id, tt.operation_id, tt.line_id, tt.start_time, tt.end_time

NAME: SCM_MST_YIELD_VER_H_V
TEXT:
WITH MASTER_VERSION AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, OPERATION_ID, VERSION_ID
    FROM (
          SELECT V.DIVISION_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, MAX(V.VERSION_ID) AS VERSION_ID
          FROM   SCM_MASTER_VERSION_INFO_H_SN V
                 INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D
                         ON D.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
                        AND D.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE'
                        AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
               , SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN R
          WHERE  1 = 1
          AND    V.SCP_USE_FLAG = 'Y'
          AND    SUBSTR(R.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) NOT IN ('E', 'S')
          GROUP BY V.DIVISION_ID, R.OPERATION_ID
          UNION
          /* 전극은 하나의 version으로 존재하나 실제 Data는 사업부별로 존재 */
          SELECT D.DIVISION_ID, R.OPERATION_ID, MAX(V.VERSION_ID) AS VERSION_ID
          FROM   SCM_MASTER_VERSION_INFO_H_SN V
                 INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION DM
                         ON DM.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
                        AND DM.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                 INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D
                         ON D.ATTRIBUTE4 = DM.ATTRIBUTE4
                        AND D.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE'
                        AND D.VALID_YN = 'Y'
               , SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN R
          WHERE  1 = 1
          AND    DM.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE'
          AND    V.SCP_USE_FLAG = 'Y'
          AND    SUBSTR(R.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) IN ('E', 'S')
          GROUP BY D.DIVISION_ID, R.OPERATION_ID
         ) A
)
SELECT T.VERSION_ID, T.DIVISION_ID, T.COMPANY_ID, T.SITE_ID, T.PLANT_ID, T.FACTORY_ID
     , T.PLANT_ID||'-' ||
       CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) IN ('E', 'S')      THEN 'E'
            WHEN SUBSTR(T.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) IN ('A', 'B', 'F') THEN 'A'
            WHEN SUBSTR(T.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1) IN ('P')           THEN 'P'
            ELSE 'A'
       END AS PLANT_SITE_ID
     , T.ITEM_ID, T.OPERATION_ID, T.LINE_ID, T.MONTH
     , MAX(NVL(YIELD, 1)) AS YIELD
FROM   SCM_YIELD_VER_H_SN T
       INNER JOIN MASTER_VERSION V
          ON  T.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
          AND T.OPERATION_ID = V.OPERATION_ID
          AND T.VERSION_ID = V.VERSION_ID
     , SCM_MST_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_SN A
WHERE  1 = 1
AND    T.MONTH > SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -2), 'YYYYMMDD'), 1, 6)
AND    T.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
AND    T.COMPANY_ID = A.COMPANY_ID
AND    T.SITE_ID = A.SITE_ID
AND    T.PLANT_ID = A.PLANT_ID
AND    T.FACTORY_ID = A.FACTORY_ID
AND    T.OPERATION_ID = A.OPERATION_ID
AND    T.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
AND    T.LINE_ID = A.LINE_ID
AND    T.MONTH = A.MONTH
AND    A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND    A.PRIORITY NOT IN (0, 9)
GROUP BY T.VERSION_ID, T.DIVISION_ID, T.COMPANY_ID, T.SITE_ID, T.PLANT_ID, T.FACTORY_ID
       , T.ITEM_ID, T.OPERATION_ID, T.LINE_ID, T.MONTH
HAVING MAX(NVL(YIELD, 1)) > 0 AND MAX(NVL(YIELD, 1)) <= 1

NAME: SCM_PLN_PLANNING_LEADTIME_V
TEXT:
SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SCM_PLN_PLANNING_LEADTIME_V
 * Description  : DM CUTOFF ~ SCP FINAL PLAN CONFIRM LEADTIME 지표추출
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018.12.03  YYDOK         Initial Release 전지본부 GSCM 구축 프로젝트
 * 2026.07.06  ZIONEX  [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */  DM.DIVISION_ID,
       CAL.WEEK_NAME
     , CAL.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
     , DM.CUTOFF_DATE
     , DM.VERSION_NO
     , SCP.CONFIRM_DATE
     , (SELECT DAYOFWEEK
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = TO_CHAR(SCP.CONFIRM_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS SCP_CONFIRM_DAYOFWEEK
     , ROUND(((TRUNC(SCP.CONFIRM_DATE,'HH24') - TRUNC(DM.CUTOFF_DATE,'HH24')) * 24)/24.0,2) AS PLANNING_LEADTIME
FROM
      (SELECT
               DIVISION_ID
              ,VERSION_TYPE
              ,TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(YYYYMMDD,'YYYYMMDD'), 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD') AS WEEK_DAY
              ,MAX(VERSION_NO) AS VERSION_NO
              ,MAX(CREATION_DATE) AS CUTOFF_DATE
         FROM DM_MST_VERSION
        WHERE VERSION_TYPE = 'MF_W'
          AND DIVISION_ID IN ('81','40')
        GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
              ,VERSION_TYPE
              ,TO_CHAR(FN_NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE(YYYYMMDD,'YYYYMMDD'), 'MON') - 7, 'YYYYMMDD')
      ) DM
    , (
        SELECT B.DIVISION_ID
             , A.PLAN_NAME
             , B.CONFIRM_DATE
          FROM SCM_MST_PLAN  A
             , SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL B
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID IN ('81','40')
           AND B.PLAN_TYPE='FN'
           AND B.CONFIRM_FLAG='Y'
           AND B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND B.PLAN_ID = A.PLAN_ID
        /* ORDER BY PLAN_ID */
      ) SCP
    , (
        SELECT '81' AS DIVISION_ID
             , BASIS_YYYYMMDD
             , WEEK_NAME
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE DAYOFWEEK='MON'
           AND BASIS_YYYYMMDD >='20180601'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT '40' AS DIVISION_ID
             , BASIS_YYYYMMDD
             , WEEK_NAME
          FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
         WHERE DAYOFWEEK='MON'
           AND BASIS_YYYYMMDD >='20181001'
      ) CAL
WHERE DM.DIVISION_ID = SCP.DIVISION_ID
  AND DM.WEEK_DAY    = SCP.PLAN_NAME
  AND DM.DIVISION_ID = CAL.DIVISION_ID
  AND DM.WEEK_DAY    = CAL.BASIS_YYYYMMDD

NAME: SCP_ANL_ENDING_INVENTORY_D_V
TEXT:
WITH W_CELL_CF AS
(
    SELECT TARGET_CELL
         , ITEM_ID
         , CELL_CF
         , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ITEM_ID ORDER BY BOM_MODIFY_DATE DESC, ATTRIBUTE5 DESC) AS RANKNO
    FROM SCP_MST_ITEM_CELL_CF
)
SELECT
           YYYYMM_DATA
         , YYYYMM
         , YYYYMMDD
         , DIVISION_ID
         , COMPANY_ID
         , PLANT_ID
         , PLANT_NAME
         , DATA.ITEM_ID
         , ITEM_DESCRIPTION
         , ITEM_UOM
         , STORAGE_LOCATION
         , STORAGE_DESC
         , QUANTITY
         , AMOUNT
         , CURRENCY
         , AMOUNT_KRW
         , UNIT_PRICE
         , UNIT_PRICE_KRW
         , VALUATION_CLASS
         , PURCHASE_PO
         , SUPPLIER_CODE
         , SUPPLIER_NAME
         , ITEM_TYPE
         , PROCESS_GROUP
         , MATERIAL_GROUP
         , GPLM_CELL_MODEL
         , MDM_PROJECT_NICK_NAME
         , EXTRA_SPEC
         , ( CASE
             WHEN PROCESS_GROUP = 'CELL' THEN '1.000000'
             WHEN ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품','제품') THEN WCF.CELL_CF
             ELSE NULL
             END
           ) AS CELL_CONVER_FACTOR
         , (
            CASE
            WHEN PROCESS_GROUP = 'CELL' THEN NVL(QUANTITY,0)
            WHEN ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품','제품') THEN NVL(WCF.CELL_CF ,1) * NVL(QUANTITY,0)
            ELSE NVL(QUANTITY,0)
            END
           ) AS CELL_CONVER_QUANTITY
         , LEVEL_1_NAME
         , LEVEL_2_NAME
         , LEVEL_3_NAME
         , LEVEL_4_NAME
         , CELL_GROUP
         , PACK_GROUP
         , PROFIT_CENTER_ID
         , PROFIT_CENTER_NAME
FROM
(
    SELECT ('‘' || SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 3, 2) || '.' || SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, -2, 2)) AS YYYYMM
         , A.YYYYMM AS YYYYMM_DATA
         , A.CUTOFF_DATE AS YYYYMMDD
         , A.DIVISION_ID
         , A.COMPANY_ID
         , A.PLANT_ID
         , ( SELECT X1.PLANT_NAME
              FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT PLANT_ID , PLANT_NAME
                       FROM SCM_PLANT_M_SN
                    ) X1
             WHERE X1.PLANT_ID = A.PLANT_ID
             ) AS PLANT_NAME
         , A.ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID
         , A.ITEM_DESCRIPTION
         , A.ITEM_UOM
         , A.STORAGE_LOCATION
         , A.STORAGE_DESC
         , A.QUANTITY
         , A.AMOUNT
         , A.CURRENCY
         , A.AMOUNT_KRW
         , A.UNIT_PRICE
         , A.UNIT_PRICE_KRW
         , A.VALUATION_CLASS
         , A.PURCHASE_PO
         , A.SUPPLIER_CODE
         , A.SUPPLIER_NAME
         , (
            CASE
            WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020','3030','3040') THEN '저장품'
            WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3100','3109') AND S1.ITEM_TYPE = '원부자재'  THEN '상품'
            ELSE S1.ITEM_TYPE
            END
           ) AS ITEM_TYPE
         , (CASE WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020','3030','3040') THEN '저장품' ELSE S1.PROCESS_GROUP  END) AS PROCESS_GROUP
         , (CASE WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020','3030','3040') THEN '저장품' ELSE S1.PROCESS_DETAIL END) AS MATERIAL_GROUP
         , (CASE WHEN S1.ITEM_TYPE = '반제품' AND MI.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL IS NULL THEN
                                                  (SELECT X2.APPLIED_MODEL
                                                     FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN X2
                                                    WHERE X2.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                                                      AND X2.APPLIED_MODEL IS NOT NULL
                                                      AND ROWNUM = 1
                                                   )
             ELSE MI.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
            END)                            AS GPLM_CELL_MODEL
         , MI.NICK_NAME                     AS MDM_PROJECT_NICK_NAME
         , MI.SCP_EXTRA_SPEC                AS EXTRA_SPEC
         , S1.LEVEL_1_NAME
         , S1.LEVEL_2_NAME
         , S1.LEVEL_3_NAME
         , S1.LEVEL_4_NAME
         , FI.GROUP_CODE1           AS CELL_GROUP
         , FI.GROUP_CODE2           AS PACK_GROUP
         , A.ATTRIBUTE3             AS PROFIT_CENTER_ID
         , A.ATTRIBUTE4             AS PROFIT_CENTER_NAME
      FROM SCP_ANL_MONTH_END_STOCK_R_D A
      LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_SN MI
        ON A.COMPANY_ID     = MI.COMPANY_ID
       AND A.DIVISION_ID    = MI.DIVISION_ID
       AND A.ITEM_ID        = MI.ITEM_ID
      LEFT JOIN (
                      SELECT  T.ITEM_ID
                            , T.ITEM_TYPE
                            , T.PROCESS_GROUP
                            , T.PROCESS_DETAIL
                            , T.LEVEL_1_NAME
                            , T.LEVEL_2_NAME
                            , T.LEVEL_3_NAME
                            , T.LEVEL_4_NAME
                        FROM
                        (
                       SELECT DISTINCT A.ITEM_ID
                            , B.ITEM_TYPE
                            , B.PROCESS_GROUP
                            , B.PROCESS_DETAIL
                            , B.LEVEL_1_NAME
                            , B.LEVEL_2_NAME
                            , B.LEVEL_3_NAME
                            , B.LEVEL_4_NAME
                            , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.ITEM_ID ORDER BY A.ITEM_CLASS DESC) AS RANKNO
                      FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN A
                         , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M B
                     WHERE A.ITEM_CLASS = B.CLASS_ID
                        ) T
                        WHERE RANKNO = 1
                    ) S1
           ON A.ITEM_ID = S1.ITEM_ID
      LEFT JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM FI
        ON A.DIVISION_ID    = FI.DIVISION_ID
       AND A.ITEM_ID        = FI.ITEM_ID
) DATA
LEFT JOIN W_CELL_CF WCF
  ON DATA.ITEM_ID       = WCF.ITEM_ID
 AND WCF.RANKNO = 1

NAME: SCP_ANL_ENDING_INVENTORY_V
TEXT:
WITH W_CELL_CF AS
   ( SELECT TARGET_CELL
          , ITEM_ID
          , CELL_CF
          , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ITEM_ID ORDER BY BOM_MODIFY_DATE DESC, ATTRIBUTE5 DESC)   AS RANKNO
       FROM SCP_MST_ITEM_CELL_CF )
SELECT YYYYMM_DATA
     , YYYYMM
     , DIVISION_ID
     , COMPANY_ID
     , PLANT_ID
     , PLANT_NAME
     , A.ITEM_ID
     , ITEM_DESCRIPTION
     , ITEM_UOM
     , STORAGE_LOCATION
     , STORAGE_DESC
     , QUANTITY
     , AMOUNT
     , CURRENCY
     , AMOUNT_KRW
     , UNIT_PRICE
     , UNIT_PRICE_KRW
     , VALUATION_CLASS
     , PURCHASE_PO
     , SUPPLIER_CODE
     , SUPPLIER_NAME
     , ITEM_TYPE
     , PROCESS_GROUP
     , MATERIAL_GROUP
     , GPLM_CELL_MODEL
     , MDM_PROJECT_NICK_NAME
     , EXTRA_SPEC
     , CASE WHEN PROCESS_GROUP = 'CELL' THEN '1.000000'
            WHEN ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품') THEN B.CELL_CF
            ELSE NULL
       END   AS CELL_CONVER_FACTOR
     , CASE WHEN PROCESS_GROUP = 'CELL' THEN NVL(QUANTITY, 0)
            WHEN ITEM_TYPE IN ('반제품', '제품') THEN NVL(B.CELL_CF, 1) * NVL(QUANTITY, 0)
            ELSE NVL(QUANTITY, 0)
       END   AS CELL_CONVER_QUANTITY
     , LEVEL_1_NAME
     , LEVEL_2_NAME
     , LEVEL_3_NAME
     , LEVEL_4_NAME
     , CELL_GROUP
     , PACK_GROUP
     , PROFIT_CENTER_ID     /* 2026.03.27 E20260316-000305 재고 데이터에 컬럼 추가 요청 */
     , PROFIT_CENTER_NAME   /* 2026.03.27 E20260316-000305 재고 데이터에 컬럼 추가 요청 */
  FROM ( SELECT ('‘' || SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 3, 2) || '.' || SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 5, 2))   AS YYYYMM
              , A.YYYYMM   AS YYYYMM_DATA
              , A.DIVISION_ID
              , A.COMPANY_ID
              , A.PLANT_ID
              , ( SELECT X1.PLANT_NAME
                    FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT PLANT_ID
                                , PLANT_NAME
                             FROM SCM_PLANT_M_SN ) X1
                   WHERE X1.PLANT_ID = A.PLANT_ID )   AS PLANT_NAME
              , A.ITEM_ID   AS ITEM_ID
              , A.ITEM_DESCRIPTION
              , A.ITEM_UOM
              , A.STORAGE_LOCATION
              , A.STORAGE_DESC
              , A.QUANTITY
              , A.AMOUNT
              , A.CURRENCY
              , A.AMOUNT_KRW
              , A.UNIT_PRICE
              , A.UNIT_PRICE_KRW
              , A.VALUATION_CLASS
              , A.PURCHASE_PO
              , A.SUPPLIER_CODE
              , A.SUPPLIER_NAME
              , CASE WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020', '3030', '3040') THEN '저장품'
                     WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3100', '3109') AND C.ITEM_TYPE = '원부자재' THEN '상품'
                     ELSE C.ITEM_TYPE
                END   AS ITEM_TYPE   /* 원반제구분 */
              , CASE WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020', '3030', '3040') THEN '저장품' ELSE C.PROCESS_GROUP END    AS PROCESS_GROUP
              , CASE WHEN A.VALUATION_CLASS IN ('3020', '3030', '3040') THEN '저장품' ELSE C.PROCESS_DETAIL END   AS MATERIAL_GROUP
              , CASE WHEN C.ITEM_TYPE = '반제품' AND B.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL IS NULL
                     THEN ( SELECT X2.APPLIED_MODEL
                              FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN X2
                             WHERE X2.ITEM_ID       = A.ITEM_ID
                               AND X2.APPLIED_MODEL IS NOT NULL
                             FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY )
                     ELSE B.FORECAST_INFO_CELL_MODEL
                END   AS GPLM_CELL_MODEL
              , B.NICK_NAME        AS MDM_PROJECT_NICK_NAME
              , B.SCP_EXTRA_SPEC   AS EXTRA_SPEC
              , C.LEVEL_1_NAME
              , C.LEVEL_2_NAME
              , C.LEVEL_3_NAME
              , C.LEVEL_4_NAME
              , D.GROUP_CODE1   AS CELL_GROUP
              , D.GROUP_CODE2   AS PACK_GROUP
              , A.ATTRIBUTE3    AS PROFIT_CENTER_ID     /* 2026.03.27 E20260316-000305 재고 데이터에 컬럼 추가 요청 */
              , A.ATTRIBUTE4    AS PROFIT_CENTER_NAME   /* 2026.03.27 E20260316-000305 재고 데이터에 컬럼 추가 요청 */
           FROM SCP_ANL_MONTH_END_STOCK_R A
              , SCM_MST_ITEM_SN            B
              , ( SELECT T.ITEM_ID
                       , T.ITEM_TYPE
                       , T.PROCESS_GROUP
                       , T.PROCESS_DETAIL
                       , T.LEVEL_1_NAME
                       , T.LEVEL_2_NAME
                       , T.LEVEL_3_NAME
                       , T.LEVEL_4_NAME
                    FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT A.ITEM_ID
                                , B.ITEM_TYPE
                                , B.PROCESS_GROUP
                                , B.PROCESS_DETAIL
                                , B.LEVEL_1_NAME
                                , B.LEVEL_2_NAME
                                , B.LEVEL_3_NAME
                                , B.LEVEL_4_NAME
                                , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.ITEM_ID ORDER BY A.ITEM_CLASS DESC)   AS RANKNO
                             FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN       A
                                , SCM_MST_ITEM_CLASS_M  B
                            WHERE A.ITEM_CLASS = B.CLASS_ID ) T
                   WHERE RANKNO = 1 ) C
              , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM         D
          WHERE A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID(+)
            AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
            AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID(+)
            AND A.ITEM_ID     = C.ITEM_ID(+)
            AND A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID(+)
            AND A.ITEM_ID     = D.ITEM_ID(+) ) A
     , W_CELL_CF B
 WHERE A.ITEM_ID   = B.ITEM_ID(+)
   AND B.RANKNO(+) = 1

NAME: SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_DW_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN_DW_V
 * Description  : SCP Production Plan : DW용
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2022.04.28   KSG            Initial Release : PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : GM JV
 * 2023-04-03   HRK			   PJ20230691R LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응
 * 2026.07.04   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 *
 */
 /* HM JV 대응 CASE WHEN DIVISION_ID = '81_UC' THEN '81' */
         /* HM JV 대응      WHEN DIVISION_ID = 'EE_UC' THEN 'EE' */
         /* HM JV 대응      ELSE DIVISION_ID */
		 /* HM JV 대응 END AS DIVISION_ID */
		 D.ATTRIBUTE3	AS DIVISION_ID
       , P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
       , P.PLAN_TYPE
       , P.SEQ
       , P.OPERATION_GROUP
       , P.SCM_SITE_ID
       , P.ITEM_ID
       , P.LINE_ID
       , P.OPERATION_ID
       , P.MEASURE
       , P.YYYYMMDD
       , P.QTY
       /* HM JV 대응 , CASE WHEN ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID = '81_UC' THEN '81' ELSE ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID END AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID */
	   , O.ATTRIBUTE3	AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID	/* HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
       , P.ELECTRODE_TYPE
       , P.CREATED_BY
       , P.CREATION_DATE
       , P.LAST_UPDATED_BY
       , P.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
       , P.ATTRIBUTE1
       , P.ATTRIBUTE2
       , P.ATTRIBUTE3
       , P.ATTRIBUTE4
       , P.ATTRIBUTE5
       , P.ATTRIBUTE6
       , P.ATTRIBUTE7
       , P.ATTRIBUTE8
       , P.ATTRIBUTE9
       , P.ATTRIBUTE10
       , P.CELL_QTY
	   , P.DIVISION_ID AS SCM_DIVISION_ID
	   , P.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID AS SCM_ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
  FROM   SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN P
		 INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D  /* HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
				 ON D.DIVISION_ID = P.DIVISION_ID
				AND D.VALID_YN	  = 'Y'
		 LEFT  JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION O  /* HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
				 ON O.DIVISION_ID = P.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
				AND O.VALID_YN	  = 'Y'

NAME: SCP_AWS_DNM_STOCK_V
TEXT:
WITH TARGET_OPERATION AS (
    SELECT SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID
      FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
     WHERE 1 = 1
       AND LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION'
       AND LK.ATTRIBUTE2  = 'Y'
)
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.CUTOFF_DATE                    AS CUTOFF_DATE
     , BUC.YYYY                         AS PLAN_YYYY
     , SUBSTR(BUC.YYYYMM, 5, 2)         AS PLAN_MM
     , SUBSTR(BUC.YYYYMMDD, 7, 2)       AS PLAN_DD
     , SUBSTR(BUC.YYYYWW, 5, 2)         AS PLAN_WEEK
     , A.SCM_SITE_ID
     , A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.PLANT_ID
     , A.STORAGE_ID
     , F.OPERATION_GROUP
     , F.FLOW_ID
     , FN_GET_ITEM_PROD_OP(A.DIVISION_ID, F.OPERATION_GROUP, A.ITEM_ID) AS ITEM_ID_CELL
     , A.ITEM_ID                        AS ITEM_ID
     , SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 12)         AS MODEL_CODE
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN X.NICK_NAME IS NULL OR X.NICK_NAME = '' THEN '-' ELSE X.NICK_NAME END
          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN X
         WHERE X.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
         FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)       AS NICK_NAME
     , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN (SELECT B.SEGMENT2
                                              FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A
                                              JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                                                ON A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE
                                               AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                             WHERE 1 = 1
                                               AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CELL_TYPE_ITEM_GROUP'
                                               AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                               AND B.SEGMENT1 = F.CELL_TYPE_GROUP_CODE
                                             FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)
            ELSE F.GROUP_CODE6 END      AS PRODUCT_LEVEL1
     , A.SCM_QTY
     , F.CONVERT_QTY_CELL               AS CELL_CONVERSION
     , A.SCM_QTY * NVL(F.CONVERT_QTY_CELL, 0) AS SCM_QTY_CELL
  FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK A
  JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
    ON A.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID
   AND A.ITEM_ID     = F.ITEM_ID
   AND F.FLOW_ID IN (SELECT TG.OPERATION_ID FROM TARGET_OPERATION TG)
  JOIN SCM_MST_BUCKET BUC
    ON A.CUTOFF_DATE = BUC.YYYYMMDD
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND A.STOCK_TYPE = 'INVENTORY'
   AND F.OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A', 'P')
   AND NVL(A.SCM_SITE_ID, ' ') = CASE WHEN A.STORAGE_ID = '5552' AND NVL(A.SCM_SITE_ID, ' ') <> ' ' THEN 'NO' ELSE NVL(A.SCM_SITE_ID, ' ') END

NAME: SCP_AWS_PROD_PLAN_V
TEXT:
WITH TARGET_OPERATION AS (
       SELECT SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID
         FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
        WHERE 1 = 1
          AND LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION'
          AND LK.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'   /* [PJ20257329] 2025.08.01  기준 AWS향 대상 공정 A3000/A9000/P5200/P5500/P9500 (SCP_PLAN_OPERATION lookup 참조) */
  )
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCP_AWS_PROD_PLAN_V
 * Description  : AWS 향 생산계획 정보
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2024.03.08   KSG            Initial Release E20240307-001294 생산계획/실적/재고 View 생성 요청
 * 2025.08.01   hrkim          PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 : AWS향 대상 공정 하드 코딩 변경
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX  [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
       /* DIVISION_ID, PLAN_DATE 조건으로 조회 */
       A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD          AS PLAN_DATE
     , BUC.YYYY                       AS PLAN_YYYY
     , SUBSTR(BUC.YYYYMM, 5, 2)       AS PLAN_MM
     , SUBSTR(BUC.YYYYMMDD, 7, 2)     AS PLAN_DD
     , SUBSTR(BUC.YYYYWW, 5, 2)       AS PLAN_WEEK
     , A.OPERATION_GROUP
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.LINE_ID
     , A.SCM_SITE_ID
     , CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_GROUP != 'A' THEN A.ITEM_ID
            ELSE (SELECT NVL(ITEM_ID_PROD, A.ITEM_ID)
                    FROM SCP_MST_CELL_PROD_ASSY_MAP
                   WHERE 1 = 1
                     AND DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
                     AND ITEM_ID_ASSY = A.ITEM_ID
                   FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)
       END                            AS ITEM_ID_CELL
     , A.ITEM_ID                      AS ITEM_ID
     , SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 12)       AS MODEL_CODE
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN X.NICK_NAME IS NULL OR RTRIM(X.NICK_NAME) IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE X.NICK_NAME END
          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN X
         WHERE X.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
         FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)     AS NICK_NAME
     , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN (SELECT B.SEGMENT2
                                              FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER A
                                                 , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                                             WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE
                                               AND B.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                               AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CELL_TYPE_ITEM_GROUP'
                                               AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
                                               AND B.SEGMENT1 = F.CELL_TYPE_GROUP_CODE)
            ELSE F.GROUP_CODE6 END     AS PRODUCT_LEVEL1
     , A.YYYYMMDD
     , CAL.BASIS_YYYYMM               AS YYYYMM
     , CAL.ISO_YYYYWW
     , A.QTY
  FROM HIST_SCP_ANL_PRODUCTION_PLAN A
  JOIN (SELECT D.DIVISION_ID
             , P.PLAN_NAME
             , D.PLAN_TYPE
             , MAX(D.PLAN_SEQ) AS PLAN_SEQ
          FROM SCM_MST_PLAN        P
             , SCM_MST_PLAN_DETAIL D
         WHERE P.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
           AND P.PLAN_ID     = D.PLAN_ID
           AND D.PLAN_STATUS  = '1'
           AND D.CONFIRM_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND D.PLAN_TYPE    = 'FN'
         GROUP BY D.DIVISION_ID, P.PLAN_NAME, D.PLAN_ID, D.PLAN_TYPE) B
    ON B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
   AND B.PLAN_NAME   = A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
   AND B.PLAN_TYPE   = A.PLAN_TYPE
  LEFT JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
    ON A.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID
   AND A.ITEM_ID     = F.ITEM_ID
   /* [PJ20257329] 2025.08.01  변경전 AND A.OPERATION_ID IN ('A3000', 'A9000', 'P5500', 'P9500', 'P5200') → AWS향 대상 공정 하드 코딩 변경 */
   AND A.OPERATION_ID IN (SELECT TG.OPERATION_ID FROM TARGET_OPERATION TG)
  JOIN SCM_MST_BUCKET BUC
    ON A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = BUC.YYYYMMDD
  JOIN SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CAL
    ON A.YYYYMMDD = CAL.BASIS_YYYYMMDD
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND A.SEQ = B.PLAN_SEQ
   AND A.OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A', 'P')
   AND A.MEASURE = 'PROD_PLAN_ENGINE'
   AND A.QTY <> 0

NAME: SCP_AWS_PROD_RESULT_V
TEXT:
WITH TARGET_OPERATION AS (
   SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCP_AWS_PROD_RESULT_V
 * Description  : AWS 향 생산실적 정보
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2024.03.08   KSG            Initial Release E20240307-001294 생산계획/실적/재고 View 생성 요청
 * 2025.08.01   hrkim          PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 : AWS향 대상 공정 하드 코딩 변경
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 *
 */
          SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID
     FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL LK
    WHERE 1 = 1
      AND LK.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION'
      AND LK.ATTRIBUTE2  = 'Y'
)
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.PLAN_DATE                    AS PLAN_DATE
     , BUC.YYYY                       AS PLAN_YYYY
     , SUBSTR(BUC.YYYYMM, 5, 2)       AS PLAN_MM
     , SUBSTR(BUC.YYYYMMDD, 7, 2)     AS PLAN_DD
     , SUBSTR(BUC.YYYYWW, 5, 2)       AS PLAN_WEEK
     , A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.PLANT_ID
     , A.LINE_ID
     , F.OPERATION_GROUP
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , CASE WHEN F.OPERATION_GROUP != 'A' THEN A.ITEM_ID
            ELSE (SELECT NVL(ITEM_ID_PROD, A.ITEM_ID)
                    FROM SCP_MST_CELL_PROD_ASSY_MAP
                   WHERE DIVISION_ID  = A.DIVISION_ID
                     AND ITEM_ID_ASSY = A.ITEM_ID
                   FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)
            END                       AS ITEM_ID_CELL
     , A.ITEM_ID                      AS ITEM_ID
     , SUBSTR(A.ITEM_ID, 1, 12)       AS MODEL_CODE
     , (SELECT CASE WHEN X.NICK_NAME IS NULL OR X.NICK_NAME = '' THEN '-' ELSE X.NICK_NAME END
          FROM SCM_MST_ITEM_SN X
         WHERE X.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
         FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)     AS NICK_NAME
     , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN (SELECT B.SEGMENT2
                                              FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER        A
                                                 , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL B
                                             WHERE A.LOOKUP_TYPE = B.LOOKUP_TYPE
                                               AND B.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                               AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'CELL_TYPE_ITEM_GROUP'
                                               AND A.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                               AND B.SEGMENT1    = F.CELL_TYPE_GROUP_CODE
                                             FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)
            ELSE F.GROUP_CODE6 END    AS PRODUCT_LEVEL1
     , A.ACTUAL_QTY
     , A.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY
     , A.ACTUAL_SCRAP_QTY
  FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM           F
     , SCM_DNM_DAILY_PRODUCT_RESULT_SN A
     , SCM_MST_BUCKET               BUC
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = F.DIVISION_ID
   AND A.ITEM_ID     = F.ITEM_ID
   AND A.PLAN_DATE   = TO_DATE(BUC.YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD')
   AND A.OPERATION_ID IN (SELECT TG.OPERATION_ID
                            FROM TARGET_OPERATION TG)
   AND F.OPERATION_GROUP IN ('A', 'P')
   AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE NOT IN ('REWORK', 'PILOT')

NAME: SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/****************************************************************************
  * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V
  * DESCRIPTION   : WORK ORDER DEMAND ID별 SUPPLY QTY 조회용
  *
  *
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018-03-23   YYDOK        INITIAL
  * 2018-04-04   YYDOK        ENGINE OUTPUT변경에 따라 FROM ITEM기준으로
  *                           WO의 DEMAND FEEDING수량이 PEGGING INFO에 나오는 것으로 변경됨
  * 2018-04-17   LTW          ENGINE OUTPUT변경에 따라 scp_eng_unpegging_info_o_sn 추가 처리
  * 2018-05-01   yydok        LPST add
  * 2018-05-16   LTW          엔진 DEMAND ID 추가
  * 2018.06.08   LTW          PEGGING 성능개선을 위한 수정
  *                           scp_eng_pegging_info_o_sn->scp_eng_pegging_info_o_temp_sn
  *                           scp_eng_unpegging_info_o_sn->scp_eng_unpegging_info_o_temp_sn
  *                           scp_eng_work_order_o_sn->scp_eng_work_order_o_temp_sn
  * 2018.07.09   LTW          전극 SCP 작업(ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID ,OPERATION_GROUP ,ELECTRODE_TYPE) 추가
  * 2018.09.06   LTW          소형 SCP 작업(FROM_OSP_YN ,TO_OSP_YN ,FROM_TCO_CELL_YN ,TO_TCO_CELL_YN) 추가
  * 2020.10.28   KSW          PJ20202001 LG화학 전지. 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 SCM 관리 체계 개선 : RACK biz. 대응
  * 2022-03-23   KSG          PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : GM JV 가상 Division
  * 2022.07.01   sclee.lee    PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 - isuzu관련 조회구문 변경
  * 2023.04.04   HRK          PJ20230691R LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응
 *************************************************************************** */
       SUB.PLAN_ID
     , SUB.MODELING_ID
     , SUB.SEQ
     , SUB.PLAN_NAME
     , SUB.MASTER_ID
     , SUB.OUT_VERSION_ID
     , SUB.PLAN_TYPE
     , SUB.DIVISION_ID
     , SUB.DEMAND_PRIORITY
     , SUB.DUE_DATE
     , SUB.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
     , SUB.WORK_ORDER_ID
     , SUB.START_DTTM
     , SUB.END_DTTM
     , SUB.SITE_ID
     , SUB.ITEM_ID
