     , SUB.DEMAND_ID                                        /* ORG DEMAND ID */
     , SUB.ENG_DEMAND_ID                                    /* 엔진 DEMAND ID */
     , SUB.SUPPLY_QTY
     , SUB.LPST
     , SUB.OPERATION_GROUP                                  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
     , SUB.ELECTRODE_TYPE                                   /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
     , SUB.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID    AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
     , SUB.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID                            /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
     , SUB.FROM_OSP_YN                                      /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
     , SUB.TO_OSP_YN                                        /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
     , SUB.FROM_TCO_CELL_YN                                 /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
     , SUB.TO_TCO_CELL_YN                                   /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
  FROM (
        SELECT A.PLAN_ID
             , A.MODELING_ID
             , A.SEQ
             , A.PLAN_NAME
             , A.MASTER_ID
             , A.OUT_VERSION_ID
             , A.PLAN_TYPE
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID                          /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
             , MAX(A.DEMAND_PRIORITY)   AS DEMAND_PRIORITY
             , MAX(A.DUE_DATE)          AS DUE_DATE
             , NULL                     AS DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
             , A.WORK_ORDER_ID
             , MIN(A.START_TIME)        AS START_DTTM
             , MAX(A.END_TIME)          AS END_DTTM
             , A.SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.ORG_DEMAND_ID          AS DEMAND_ID
             , A.DEMAND_ID              AS ENG_DEMAND_ID
             , SUM(A.QTY)               AS SUPPLY_QTY
             , MIN(A.LPST)              AS LPST
             , MAX(A.OPERATION_GROUP)   AS OPERATION_GROUP    /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
             , MAX(A.ELECTRODE_TYPE)    AS ELECTRODE_TYPE     /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
             , A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID                        /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
             , A.FROM_OSP_YN                                  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
             , A.TO_OSP_YN                                    /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
             , A.FROM_TCO_CELL_YN                             /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
             , A.TO_TCO_CELL_YN                               /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
          FROM (
                /* SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN */
                SELECT PI.PLAN_ID
                     , PI.MODELING_ID
                     , PI.SEQ
                     , PI.PLAN_NAME
                     , PI.MASTER_ID
                     , PI.OUT_VERSION_ID
                     , PI.PLAN_TYPE
                     , PI.DIVISION_ID
                     , PI.DEMAND_PRIORITY
                     , PI.DUE_DATE
                     , PI.WORK_ORDER_ID
                     , WO.START_TIME
                     , WO.END_TIME
                     , WO.SITE_ID
                     , WO.ITEM_ID
                     , PI.ORG_DEMAND_ID
                     , PI.DEMAND_ID
                     , PI.QTY
                     , WO.LPST
                     , WO.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID                  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                     , WO.OPERATION_GROUP                     /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                     , WO.ELECTRODE_TYPE                      /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                     , PI.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID             /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                     , PI.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID               /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                     , PI.ATTRIBUTE5 AS FROM_OSP_YN           /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 (MSSQL ISNULL(x,'') 제거: Oracle ''=NULL) */
                     , PI.ATTRIBUTE6 AS TO_OSP_YN             /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                     , PI.ATTRIBUTE7 AS FROM_TCO_CELL_YN      /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                     , PI.ATTRIBUTE8 AS TO_TCO_CELL_YN        /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                  /* FROM SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_SN     AS pi WITH(NOLOCK) */
                  /* INNER JOIN SCP_ENG_WORK_ORDER_O_SN AS wo WITH(NOLOCK) */
                  FROM SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN     PI
                 INNER JOIN SCP_ENG_WORK_ORDER_O_TEMP_SN  WO
                    ON 1 = 1
                   AND PI.MODELING_ID    = WO.MODELING_ID
                   AND PI.MASTER_ID      = WO.MASTER_ID
                   AND PI.PLAN_ID        = WO.PLAN_ID
                   AND PI.PLAN_TYPE      = WO.PLAN_TYPE
                   AND PI.PLAN_NAME      = WO.PLAN_NAME
                   AND PI.SEQ            = WO.SEQ
                   AND PI.OUT_VERSION_ID = WO.OUT_VERSION_ID
                   AND PI.DIVISION_ID    = WO.DIVISION_ID
                   AND PI.WORK_ORDER_ID  = WO.WORK_ORDER_ID
                   AND PI.FROM_ITEM_ID   = WO.ITEM_ID
                 INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION DM                /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
                    ON 1 = 1
                   AND DM.DIVISION_ID    = WO.DIVISION_ID
                   AND DM.VALID_YN       = 'Y'
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND PI.WORK_ORDER_ID       IS NOT NULL
                   AND PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID   IS NULL
                   AND PI.STOCK_PLAN_LOT_ID   IS NULL
                   AND TO_NUMBER(WO.OPERATION_QTY) > 0.0
                   AND ( SUBSTR(WO.OPERATION_ID, 1, 5) IN (/* LOOKUP_TYPE 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION' 에 정의된 공정만 조회 */
                                                           SELECT SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID
                                                             FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                                            WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION' )
                         /* PJ20216891 (sclee.lee) ISUZU item */
                         OR (
                             WO.OPERATION_ID = 'P5000'
                             AND EXISTS (
                                         SELECT 1
                                         FROM   SCM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V A
                                         INNER JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V B ON A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
                                         WHERE  A.ITEM_ID = WO.ITEM_ID
                                           AND A.IS_YN = 'Y'
                                        )
                            )
                         OR
                         /* 2020.10.28 KSW PJ20202001 RACK biz. 대응 - end / wo.operation_id IN (외주PACKER의 업체코드) */
                         (CASE WHEN INSTR(WO.OPERATION_ID, '_') > 0 THEN (SUBSTR(WO.OPERATION_ID, 1, FN_CHARINDEX_REV(WO.OPERATION_ID, '_', 0)-1)) ELSE WO.OPERATION_ID END)
                                                      IN (/* 외주PACKER의 업체코드 */
                                                          SELECT S.PLANT_ID  AS OPERATION_ID
                                                            FROM SCM_MST_SITE S
                                                           WHERE 1 = 1
                                                             /* HM JV 대응 (구) division_id = CASE wo.division_id EE/EE_UC->origin_division_id ELSE division_id END : dm.attribute3 기반으로 변경 */
                                                             AND S.DIVISION_ID = CASE WHEN DM.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE'  /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
                                                                                      THEN WO.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
                                                                                      ELSE WO.DIVISION_ID
                                                                                 END
                                                             AND S.SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT'
                                                             AND S.OSP_YN      = 'Y'
                                                             AND S.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                                         )
                       )
                UNION ALL
                /* SCP_ENG_UNPEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN */
                SELECT PI.PLAN_ID
                     , PI.MODELING_ID
                     , PI.SEQ
                     , PI.PLAN_NAME
                     , PI.MASTER_ID
                     , PI.OUT_VERSION_ID
                     , PI.PLAN_TYPE
                     , PI.DIVISION_ID
                     , NULL                   AS DEMAND_PRIORITY         /* demand_priority 없음 */
                     , NULL                   AS DUE_DATE                /* due_date 없음 */
                     , PI.WORK_ORDER_ID
                     , WO.START_TIME
                     , WO.END_TIME
                     , WO.SITE_ID
                     , WO.ITEM_ID
                     , 'UNPEGGING'            AS ORG_DEMAND_ID           /* org_demand_id 없음 */
                     , 'UNPEGGING'            AS DEMAND_ID               /* demand_id 없음 */
                     , PI.COMPLETE_QTY        AS QTY
                     , NULL                   AS LPST
                     , WO.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID                              /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                     , WO.OPERATION_GROUP                                 /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                     , WO.ELECTRODE_TYPE                                  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                     , WO.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID  AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                     , WO.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID  AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID    /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                     , WO.ATTRIBUTE5 AS FROM_OSP_YN                       /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 (MSSQL ISNULL(x,'') 제거: Oracle ''=NULL) */
                     , PI.ATTRIBUTE6 AS TO_OSP_YN                         /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                     , WO.ATTRIBUTE7 AS FROM_TCO_CELL_YN                  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                     , PI.ATTRIBUTE8 AS TO_TCO_CELL_YN                    /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                  /* FROM SCP_ENG_UNPEGGING_INFO_O_SN  AS pi WITH(NOLOCK) */
                  /* INNER JOIN SCP_ENG_WORK_ORDER_O_SN AS wo WITH(NOLOCK) */
                  FROM SCP_ENG_UNPEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN  PI
                 INNER JOIN SCP_ENG_WORK_ORDER_O_TEMP_SN WO
                    ON 1 = 1
                   AND PI.MODELING_ID    = WO.MODELING_ID
                   AND PI.MASTER_ID      = WO.MASTER_ID
                   AND PI.PLAN_ID        = WO.PLAN_ID
                   AND PI.PLAN_TYPE      = WO.PLAN_TYPE
                   AND PI.PLAN_NAME      = WO.PLAN_NAME
                   AND PI.SEQ            = WO.SEQ
                   AND PI.OUT_VERSION_ID = WO.OUT_VERSION_ID
                   AND PI.DIVISION_ID    = WO.DIVISION_ID
                   AND PI.WORK_ORDER_ID  = WO.WORK_ORDER_ID
                   AND PI.ITEM_ID        = WO.ITEM_ID          /* UNPEGGING_INFO.from_item 없음 */
                 INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION DM                /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
                    ON 1 = 1
                   AND DM.DIVISION_ID    = WO.DIVISION_ID
                   AND DM.VALID_YN       = 'Y'
                 WHERE 1 = 1
                   AND PI.WORK_ORDER_ID       IS NOT NULL
                   AND RTRIM(PI.WORK_ORDER_ID)     IS NOT NULL
                   AND RTRIM(PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID) IS NULL      /* MSSQL delivery_order_id = '' : Oracle 데이터컬럼 빈문자판정 = RTRIM() IS NULL */
                   /* AND pi.stock_plan_lot_id IS NULL : stock_plan_lot_id 없음 */
                   AND TO_NUMBER(WO.OPERATION_QTY) > 0.0
                   AND ( SUBSTR(WO.OPERATION_ID, 1, 5) IN (/* LOOKUP_TYPE 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION' 에 정의된 공정만 조회 */
                                                           SELECT SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID
                                                             FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                                            WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION' )
                         /* PJ20216891 (sclee.lee) ISUZU item */
                         OR (
                             WO.OPERATION_ID = 'P5000'
                             AND EXISTS (
                                         SELECT 1
                                         FROM   SCM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V A
                                         INNER JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V B ON A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
                                         WHERE  A.ITEM_ID = WO.ITEM_ID
                                           AND A.IS_YN = 'Y'
                                        )
                            )
                         OR
                         /* 2020.10.28 KSW PJ20202001 RACK biz. 대응 - end / wo.operation_id IN (외주PACKER의 업체코드) */
                         (CASE WHEN INSTR(WO.OPERATION_ID, '_') > 0 THEN (SUBSTR(WO.OPERATION_ID, 1, FN_CHARINDEX_REV(WO.OPERATION_ID, '_', 0)-1)) ELSE WO.OPERATION_ID END)
                                                      IN (/* 외주PACKER의 업체코드 */
                                                          SELECT S.PLANT_ID  AS OPERATION_ID
                                                            FROM SCM_MST_SITE  S
                                                           WHERE 1 = 1
                                                             /* HM JV 대응 (구) division_id = CASE wo.division_id EE/EE_UC->origin_division_id ELSE division_id END : dm.attribute3 기반으로 변경 */
                                                             AND S.DIVISION_ID = CASE WHEN DM.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE'  /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
                                                                                      THEN WO.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
                                                                                      ELSE WO.DIVISION_ID
                                                                                 END
                                                             AND S.SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT'
                                                             AND S.OSP_YN      = 'Y'
                                                             AND S.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                                         )
                       )
               ) A
         GROUP BY
               A.PLAN_ID
             , A.MODELING_ID
             , A.SEQ
             , A.PLAN_NAME
             , A.MASTER_ID
             , A.OUT_VERSION_ID
             , A.PLAN_TYPE
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID       /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
             , A.WORK_ORDER_ID
             , A.SITE_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.ORG_DEMAND_ID
             , A.DEMAND_ID
             , A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID    /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
             , A.FROM_OSP_YN              /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
             , A.TO_OSP_YN               /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
             , A.FROM_TCO_CELL_YN         /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
             , A.TO_TCO_CELL_YN           /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
       ) SUB

NAME: SCP_MST_BOD_DW_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*

 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2022.04.28   KSG            Initial Release : PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : GM JV
 * 2023.04.04   HRK			   PJ20230691R LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응

 */
 -- PJ20230691R HM JV 대응  CASE WHEN DIVISION_ID = '81_UC' THEN '81' ELSE DIVISION_ID END AS DIVISION_ID

       , B.PRIORITY

       , B.DAYS_TUE
       , B.DAYS_WED
       , B.DAYS_THU
       , B.DAYS_FRI
       , B.DAYS_SAT
       , B.DAYS_SUN
       , B.SAFETY_STOCK
       , B.LT_DEPARTURE_INLAND

       , B.LT_ARRIVAL_INLAND

				AND D.VALID_YN	  = 'Y'

NAME: SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_MDL_V
TEXT:
WITH TBLVERSION AS
   ( SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_MDL_V
 * Description  :
 * Program History
 *================================================================================================================================================
 * Date         In Charge                          Description
 *================================================================================================================================================
 * 2024/08/03   chaan        V1.1.0                PJ20230692  SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 Phase2     - Initial Release
 * 2024/08/29   chaan        V1.1.8                PJ20230692  SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 Phase2     - DAY_CNT 로직 수정 - SOP 적용
 * 2025/02/10   mrchois      V1.1.10               PJ20249346  LGES SCP 개선과제 이행     - Improvement Rate 입력 영역을 제거하고 Operation Plan 에 Goal 직접 입력 형태로 수정
 * 2025/05/09   kimcd        V1.1.11               PJ2024A332  독립적 Planning 체계 및 Master Validation UI 구축 - CPS Version 한 개만 조회되도록 수정
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */  DIVISION_ID
          , MAX(VER_ID)    AS VER_ID
          , MAX(VER_SEQ)   AS VER_SEQ
          , TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(MAX(VER_ID) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), -1), 'YYYYMM')   AS RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_VERSION
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND PROG_STAT IN ('-', '0')   /* Pre, Current */
      GROUP BY DIVISION_ID )
   , TBL_DAY_CNT AS
   ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , SOP_DT
          , SOP_YM    AS YYYYMM
          , SOP_DDN   AS DAY_CNT
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_SOP
      WHERE 1 = 1 )
   , TBL_DAY_CNT_YEAR AS
   ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , SOP_DT
          , SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4)   AS YYYY
          , CASE
                WHEN YYYYMM IS NOT NULL THEN (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SOP_DT, 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1   /* SOP 적용 일수 */
                /* 2026.09.28 원본은 MSSQL 문자 결합이라 월이 비면 NULL 이 되어 날짜로 바꾸지 않는다.
                   Oracle 은 NULL || '1231' 이 '1231' 이 되어 깨지므로 월이 빈 행을 먼저 가른다 — 값은 그대로 */
                WHEN SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) IS NULL THEN NULL
                ELSE                         (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1   /* 연간총일수 */
            END   AS DAY_CNT
       FROM TBL_DAY_CNT
      WHERE 1 = 1 )
   , TBLSCP0106_MEASURE_ALL AS
   ( SELECT ATTRIBUTE3     AS LOSS_GR_CD
          , SEGMENT1       AS LOSS_CD
          , ATTRIBUTE6     AS LOSS_GR_NM_KO
          , ATTRIBUTE7     AS LOSS_GR_NM_EN
          , ATTRIBUTE4     AS LOSS_NM_KO
          , ATTRIBUTE5     AS LOSS_NM_EN
          , ATTRIBUTE13    AS TARGET_YN   /* @p_sheet_name = 'CURRENT_TARGET_YN' */
          , DISPLAY_SEQ
       FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_MEASURE'
        AND VALID_YN    = 'Y' )
   , TBLSCP0106_MEASURE_VISIBLE AS
   ( SELECT COLUMN_NAME   AS MEASURE
       FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND PROGRAM_ID = 'SCP0106'
        AND SHEET_NAME = 'CURRENT_ELTR'
        AND VALID_YN   = 'Y' )
   , TBLSCP0106_SPEED_PLAN_PPM AS
   ( SELECT VER_ID
          , VER_SEQ
          , DIVISION_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , ITEM_ID
          , MSR_TP_CD
          , YYYYMM
          , BASE_QTY
          , QTY
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_SPEED_PLAN_V
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND MSR_TP_CD = 'EQP_SPED' )
   , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN AS
   ( SELECT V.VER_ID
          , V.VER_SEQ
          , A.DIVISION_ID
          , A.COMPANY_ID
          , A.SITE_ID
          , A.PLANT_ID
          , A.FACTORY_ID
          , A.LINE_ID
          , A.OPERATION_ID
          , A.ITEM_ID
          , A.NICK_NAME
          , A.YYYYMM
          , A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN A
          , TBLVERSION                    V
      WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND NVL(A.VALID_YN, '-') <> 'N' )   /* Oracle ''=NULL: sentinel 로 NULL 행 보존(원본 ISNULL(VALID_YN,'')<>'N') */
   , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN_NICK_NAME AS
   ( SELECT VER_ID
          , VER_SEQ
          , DIVISION_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , ITEM_ID
          , YYYYMM
          , MAX(ASSIGN_PRIORITY)   AS ASSIGN_PRIORITY
       FROM TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN
      GROUP BY VER_ID
             , VER_SEQ
             , DIVISION_ID
             , COMPANY_ID
             , SITE_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , FACTORY_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , YYYYMM )
   , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN_LN AS
   ( SELECT VER_ID
          , VER_SEQ
          , DIVISION_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , '-'   AS ITEM_ID
          , YYYYMM
          , SUM(ASSIGN_PRIORITY)   AS ASSIGN_PRIORITY_CNT
       FROM TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN_NICK_NAME
      GROUP BY VER_ID
             , VER_SEQ
             , DIVISION_ID
             , COMPANY_ID
             , SITE_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , FACTORY_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , YYYYMM )
   , TBLSCP0106_RAW_TEMP AS
   ( SELECT V.VER_ID
          , V.VER_SEQ
          , A.DIVISION_ID
          , A.MDL_NM
          , A.PLANT_ID
          , A.LINE_ID
          , A.OPERATION_ID
          , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , A.COMPANY_ID
          , A.SITE_ID
          , A.FACTORY_ID
          , A.MSR_TP_CD
          , A.YYYYMM
          , A.PFRSLT_NVL
          , A.BASE_NVL
          , A.MSR_GR_CD
          , A.MSR_NVL
          , CASE WHEN A.MDL_NM = '-' THEN C.ASSIGN_PRIORITY_CNT ELSE B.ASSIGN_PRIORITY END   AS ASSIGN_PRIORITY
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LOSS_PLAN_MDL                    A
          , TBLVERSION                                         V
          , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN_NICK_NAME B
          , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN_LN        C
      WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND A.COMPANY_ID  = B.COMPANY_ID(+)
        AND A.SITE_ID     = B.SITE_ID(+)
        AND A.PLANT_ID    = B.PLANT_ID(+)
        AND A.FACTORY_ID  = B.FACTORY_ID(+)
        AND A.LINE_ID     = B.LINE_ID(+)
        AND A.MDL_NM      = B.ITEM_ID(+)
        AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND A.COMPANY_ID  = C.COMPANY_ID(+)
        AND A.SITE_ID     = C.SITE_ID(+)
        AND A.PLANT_ID    = C.PLANT_ID(+)
        AND A.FACTORY_ID  = C.FACTORY_ID(+)
        AND A.LINE_ID     = C.LINE_ID(+)
        AND A.MDL_NM      = C.ITEM_ID(+)
        AND A.YYYYMM      = C.YYYYMM(+)
        AND (B.DIVISION_ID IS NOT NULL OR C.DIVISION_ID IS NOT NULL) )
   , TBLSCP0106_RAW_ALL AS
   ( SELECT A.VER_ID
          , A.VER_SEQ
          , A.DIVISION_ID
          , A.MDL_NM
          , A.PLANT_ID
          , A.LINE_ID
          , A.OPERATION_ID
          , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , A.COMPANY_ID
          , A.SITE_ID
          , A.FACTORY_ID
          , A.MSR_TP_CD
          , A.YYYYMM
          , A.PFRSLT_NVL
          , A.BASE_NVL
          , A.MSR_GR_CD
          , A.MSR_NVL
          , A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
          , M.LOSS_NM_EN
          , M.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
          , M.DISPLAY_SEQ   AS SORT_ORDER_NO
          , CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(A.YYYYMM) = 4
                THEN CASE
                         WHEN DY.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1   /* 연도별 & SOP 없을때 */
                         ELSE DY.DAY_CNT   /* 연도별 & SOP 존재 */
                     END
                ELSE CASE
                         WHEN DC.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RTRIM(A.YYYYMM)) = 6 THEN A.YYYYMM || '01' END, 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD'))   /* 2026.09.28 연 단위 행에서 실행계획에 따라 먼저 셈해져 깨지는 것을 막는다 — 값은 그대로 */   /* 월별 & SOP 없을때 (EOMONTH→LAST_DAY, DAY→'DD') */
                         ELSE DC.DAY_CNT   /* 월별 & SOP 존재 */
                     END
            END   AS DAY_CNT
          , CASE
                WHEN A.VER_ID IS NULL THEN NULL   /* VER_ID NULL(버전 미매칭): MSSQL NULL+'01'=NULL → Oracle NULL||'01'='01' 방지(원본 동치) */
                ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(A.VER_ID || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD')) - TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.VER_ID || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD')) + 1
            END   AS DAY_CNT_BASE
          , PP.QTY        AS SPEED_PPM
          , PP.BASE_QTY   AS SPEED_BASE_PPM
          , CASE WHEN V.MEASURE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END   AS MEASURE_VISIBLE
       FROM TBLSCP0106_RAW_TEMP        A
          , TBLSCP0106_MEASURE_ALL     M
          , TBLSCP0106_MEASURE_VISIBLE V
          , TBLSCP0106_SPEED_PLAN_PPM  PP
          , TBL_DAY_CNT                DC
          , TBL_DAY_CNT_YEAR           DY
      WHERE A.MSR_TP_CD    = M.LOSS_CD(+)
        AND A.MSR_TP_CD    = V.MEASURE(+)
        AND A.VER_ID       = PP.VER_ID(+)
        AND A.VER_SEQ      = PP.VER_SEQ(+)
        AND A.DIVISION_ID  = PP.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND A.COMPANY_ID   = PP.COMPANY_ID(+)
        AND A.SITE_ID      = PP.SITE_ID(+)
        AND A.PLANT_ID     = PP.PLANT_ID(+)
        AND A.FACTORY_ID   = PP.FACTORY_ID(+)
        AND A.LINE_ID      = PP.LINE_ID(+)
        AND A.OPERATION_ID = PP.OPERATION_ID(+)
        AND A.MDL_NM       = PP.ITEM_ID(+)
        AND A.YYYYMM       = PP.YYYYMM(+)
        AND A.DIVISION_ID  = DC.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND A.COMPANY_ID   = DC.COMPANY_ID(+)
        AND A.SITE_ID      = DC.SITE_ID(+)
        AND A.PLANT_ID     = DC.PLANT_ID(+)
        AND A.FACTORY_ID   = DC.FACTORY_ID(+)
        AND A.LINE_ID      = DC.LINE_ID(+)
        AND A.OPERATION_ID = DC.OPERATION_ID(+)
        AND A.YYYYMM       = DC.YYYYMM(+)
        AND A.DIVISION_ID  = DY.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND A.COMPANY_ID   = DY.COMPANY_ID(+)
        AND A.SITE_ID      = DY.SITE_ID(+)
        AND A.PLANT_ID     = DY.PLANT_ID(+)
        AND A.FACTORY_ID   = DY.FACTORY_ID(+)
        AND A.LINE_ID      = DY.LINE_ID(+)
        AND A.OPERATION_ID = DY.OPERATION_ID(+)
        AND A.YYYYMM       = DY.YYYY(+) )
   , TBLSCP0106_RAW3 AS
   ( SELECT VER_ID
          , VER_SEQ
          , DIVISION_ID
          , MDL_NM
          , PLANT_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , MSR_TP_CD
          , YYYYMM
          , CASE
                WHEN MSR_TP_CD IN ('PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'THRY_CAPA_D') THEN NULL   /* 실적에서 CAPA 제외 */
                WHEN MSR_TP_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT') THEN PFRSLT_NVL   /* 일수 or EA */
                ELSE PFRSLT_NVL * 100.0   /* 비율로 표시 */
            END   AS PFRSLT_NVL
          , CASE
                WHEN MSR_TP_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN', 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT') THEN BASE_NVL   /* 일수 or EA */
                ELSE BASE_NVL * 100.0   /* 비율로 표시 */
            END   AS BASE_NVL
          , MSR_GR_CD
          , CASE
                WHEN MSR_TP_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN', 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT') THEN MSR_NVL   /* 일수 or EA */
                ELSE MSR_NVL * 100.0   /* 비율로 표시 */
            END   AS MSR_NVL
          , ASSIGN_PRIORITY
          , LOSS_NM_EN
          , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
          , SORT_ORDER_NO
          , DAY_CNT
          , DAY_CNT_BASE
          , SPEED_PPM
          , SPEED_BASE_PPM
          , MEASURE_VISIBLE
       FROM TBLSCP0106_RAW_ALL )
SELECT VER_ID
     , VER_SEQ
     , DIVISION_ID
     , MDL_NM
     , PLANT_ID
     , LINE_ID
     , OPERATION_ID
     , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , COMPANY_ID
     , SITE_ID
     , FACTORY_ID
     , MSR_TP_CD
     , YYYYMM
     , PFRSLT_NVL
     , BASE_NVL
     , MSR_GR_CD
     , CASE WHEN NVL(ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE MSR_NVL END   AS MSR_NVL   /* 우선순위가 없으면 클리어 */
     , ASSIGN_PRIORITY
     , LOSS_NM_EN
     , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
     , SORT_ORDER_NO
     , DAY_CNT
     , DAY_CNT_BASE
     , SPEED_PPM
     , SPEED_BASE_PPM
     , MEASURE_VISIBLE
  FROM TBLSCP0106_RAW3
 WHERE 1 = 1

NAME: SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_SPEED_PLAN_V
TEXT:
WITH tblVersion AS
        (
            SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                    , MAX(VER_ID)          AS VER_ID
                    , MAX(VER_SEQ)         AS VER_SEQ
                    , TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(MAX(VER_ID) || '01','YYYYMMDD'), -1), 'YYYYMM') AS RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
            FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_VERSION A
            WHERE   1=1
                AND PROG_STAT IN ('-',  '0')
            GROUP BY  DIVISION_ID
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_SPEED_UNIT_ALL AS
        (
            SELECT    A.SEGMENT1        AS UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.SEGMENT2        AS OPERATION_ID
                    , A.SEGMENT3        AS MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.SEGMENT4        AS LINE_TYPE
                    , A.SEGMENT5        AS UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
                    , A.DISPLAY_SEQ
            FROM    SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
            WHERE   1=1
                AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE  = 'OPERATION_SPEED_ELTR_UNIT'
                AND A.VALID_YN  = 'Y'
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_SPEED_UNIT_GROUP AS
        (
            SELECT    A.UNIT_GROUP
                    , MIN(A.DISPLAY_SEQ)    AS DISPLAY_SEQ
                    , MAX(UNIT_GROUP_SEQ)   AS UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
            FROM    tblSCP0105_SPEED_UNIT_ALL A
            GROUP BY A.UNIT_GROUP
        )
        ,
        tbl_DAY_CNT AS
        (
            SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , SOP_DT
                    , SOP_YM            AS YYYYMM
                    , SOP_DDN           AS DAY_CNT
            FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_SOP
            WHERE   1=1
                AND VALID_YN        = 'Y'
        )
        ,
        tbl_DAY_CNT_YEAR AS
        (
            SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , SOP_DT
                    , SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4)          AS YYYY
                    , CASE
                        WHEN YYYYMM IS NOT NULL THEN (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231','YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SOP_DT,'YYYYMMDD')) + 1
                        ELSE                         (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231','YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101','YYYYMMDD')) + 1
                      END               AS DAY_CNT
            FROM    tbl_DAY_CNT
            WHERE   1=1
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_CHECK_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_ELTR_BY_ASSIGN_RESULT AS
        (
            SELECT    A.DIVISION_ID                 AS DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID                  AS COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID                     AS SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID                    AS PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID                  AS FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID                     AS LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID                AS OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD               AS ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.MDL_NM                      AS ITEM_ID
                    , '-'                           AS NICK_NAME
                    , B.UNIT_GROUP                  AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , UPPER(A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD)     AS EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD
                    , AVG(A.EQP_NBU)                AS EQP_NBU
                    , AVG(A.EQP_SPED)               AS EQP_SPED
            FROM    SCM_DNM_ELTR_EQP_SPED_MMLY A
                    LEFT JOIN (
                                    SELECT    UNIT_GROUP
                                            , MSR_TP_CD
                                    FROM    tblSCP0105_SPEED_UNIT_ALL
                                    WHERE   1=1
                                    GROUP BY UNIT_GROUP
                                            , MSR_TP_CD
                                ) B ON
                            A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD  = B.MSR_TP_CD
                    INNER JOIN (
                                    SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                                            , RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
                                    FROM    tblVersion
                               ) V ON
                    A.DIVISION_ID       = V.DIVISION_ID
                AND A.PFRSLT_YM         = V.RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
            WHERE   1=1
                AND A.PERD_DIVS_CD      = '3'
            GROUP BY  A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.MDL_NM
                    , B.UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0104_EQPUIPMENT_TEMP AS
        (
            SELECT    A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , B.BOM_ITEM_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_NAME
                    , A.WIDE_ROLL_ENABLE_FLAG
                    , CASE WHEN A.WIDE_ROLL_ENABLE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'W' ELSE 'S' END      AS ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , B.EQP_SPED
                    , B.UPDATE_TIME             AS SPEED_UPDATE_TIME
                    , A.UPDATE_TIME             AS EQPT_UPDATE_TIME
                    , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY
                                                    A.DIVISION_ID
                                                , A.SITE_ID
                                                , A.COMPANY_ID
                                                , A.PLANT_ID
                                                , A.LINE_ID
                                                , A.OPERATION_ID
                                                , B.BOM_ITEM_ID
                                            ORDER BY
                                                    B.UPDATE_TIME DESC
                                                , A.UPDATE_TIME DESC) AS RN
            FROM    SCM_MST_EQUIPMENT_SN A
                    INNER JOIN SCM_MMD_EQPT_PRDT_SPEED_SN B ON
                            B.EQP_ID = A.EQUIPMENT_ID
            WHERE   1=1
                AND A.OPERATION_ID LIKE 'E2000%'
                AND A.EQUIPMENT_TYPE   = 'M'
                AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0104_EQPUIPMENT AS
        (
            SELECT    A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_NAME
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.BOM_ITEM_ID                     AS ITEM_ID
                    , CAST(NULL AS NUMBER)              AS EQP_NBU
                    , AVG(A.EQP_SPED)                   AS EQP_SPED
            FROM    tblSCP0104_EQPUIPMENT_TEMP A
            WHERE   1=1
                AND A.RN = 1
            GROUP BY  A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_NAME
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.BOM_ITEM_ID
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0104_EQPUIPMENT_LINE AS
        (
            SELECT    A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_NAME
            FROM    tblSCP0104_EQPUIPMENT A
            WHERE   1=1
            GROUP BY  A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_ID
                    , A.EQUIPMENT_NAME
        )
        ,
        tblDummyLine AS
        (
            SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , MAX(ATTRIBUTE2)   AS DUMMY_YN
            FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
            WHERE   1=1
                AND LINE_ID <> '-'
            GROUP BY  DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_CHECK_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_ELTR_BY_ASSIGN_BASE AS
        (
            SELECT    A.DIVISION_ID                 AS DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID                  AS COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID                     AS SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID                    AS PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID                  AS FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID                     AS LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID                AS OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ITEM_ID                     AS ITEM_ID
                    , '-'                           AS NICK_NAME
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD               AS ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , 'EQP_SPED'                    AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , 'EQP_SPED'                    AS MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.EQP_SPED                    AS EQP_SPED
                    , 'N'                           AS UI_UPD_YN
            FROM    tblSCP0104_EQPUIPMENT A
            WHERE   1=1
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_CHECK_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_ELTR_BY_ASSIGN_BASE_UI_UPD_YN AS
        (
            SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , ITEM_ID
                    , '-'                           AS NICK_NAME
                    , MAX(UI_UPD_YN)                AS UI_UPD_YN
            FROM    tblSCP0105_CHECK_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_ELTR_BY_ASSIGN_BASE
            WHERE   1=1
            GROUP BY  DIVISION_ID
                    , COMPANY_ID
                    , SITE_ID
                    , PLANT_ID
                    , FACTORY_ID
                    , LINE_ID
                    , OPERATION_ID
                    , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , ITEM_ID
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN AS
        (
            SELECT    V.VER_ID
                    , V.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.YYYYMM
                    , A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
            FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN A
                    LEFT JOIN tblVersion V ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
            WHERE   1=1
                AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_RAW_ALL_TEMP AS
        (
            SELECT    V.VER_ID
                    , V.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.YYYYMM
                    , A.BASE_QTY                                AS PFRSLT_QTY
                    , A.BASE_QTY
                    , A.QTY
                    , B.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                    , A.REMARK
                    , A.CREATED_BY
                    , A.CREATION_DATE
                    , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                    , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
            FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_SPEED_PLAN A
                    JOIN tblSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN B ON
                                A.DIVISION_ID       = B.DIVISION_ID
                            AND A.COMPANY_ID        = B.COMPANY_ID
                            AND A.SITE_ID           = B.SITE_ID
                            AND A.PLANT_ID          = B.PLANT_ID
                            AND A.FACTORY_ID        = B.FACTORY_ID
                            AND A.LINE_ID           = B.LINE_ID
                            AND A.OPERATION_ID      = B.OPERATION_ID
                            AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD     = B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                            AND A.ITEM_ID           = B.ITEM_ID
                            AND A.NICK_NAME         = B.NICK_NAME
                            AND A.YYYYMM            = B.YYYYMM
                    LEFT JOIN tblVersion V ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
            WHERE   1=1
                AND NVL(B.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0) <> 0
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_RAW_ALL AS
        (
            SELECT    A.VER_ID
                    , A.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , G.UNIT_GROUP                              AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.YYYYMM
                    , A.PFRSLT_QTY                              AS PFRSLT_QTY
                    , A.BASE_QTY
                    , A.QTY
                    , A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                    , A.REMARK
                    , A.CREATED_BY
                    , A.CREATION_DATE
                    , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                    , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
            FROM    tblSCP0105_RAW_ALL_TEMP A
                    JOIN tblSCP0105_SPEED_UNIT_GROUP G ON
                            1=1
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_RAW_KEYS AS
        (
            SELECT    A.VER_ID
                    , A.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.YYYYMM
            FROM    tblSCP0105_RAW_ALL A
            WHERE   1=1
                    AND A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP  = 'EQP_SPED'   AND A.MSR_TP_CD = 'EQP_SPED'
            GROUP BY  A.VER_ID
                    , A.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.YYYYMM
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_RAW_TEMP AS
        (
            SELECT    A.VER_ID
                    , A.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.YYYYMM
                    , R.EQP_SPED                                            AS PFRSLT_QTY
                    , CASE WHEN X.BASE_QTY IS NULL THEN B.EQP_SPED ELSE X.BASE_QTY END  AS BASE_QTY
                    , X.QTY                                                 AS QTY
                    , NVL(BU.UI_UPD_YN, 'Y')                                AS UI_UPD_YN
                    , X.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                    , X.REMARK
                    , X.CREATED_BY
                    , X.CREATION_DATE
                    , X.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                    , X.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
            FROM    tblSCP0105_RAW_KEYS A
                    LEFT JOIN tblSCP0105_RAW_ALL_TEMP X ON
                            A.VER_ID                = X.VER_ID
                        AND A.VER_SEQ               = X.VER_SEQ
                        AND A.DIVISION_ID           = X.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID            = X.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID               = X.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID              = X.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID            = X.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID               = X.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID          = X.OPERATION_ID
                        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD         = X.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        AND A.ITEM_ID               = X.ITEM_ID
                        AND A.NICK_NAME             = X.NICK_NAME
                        AND A.MSR_TP_CD             = X.MSR_TP_CD
                        AND A.YYYYMM                = X.YYYYMM
                    LEFT JOIN tblSCP0105_CHECK_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_ELTR_BY_ASSIGN_RESULT R ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID                                   = R.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID                                    = R.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID                                       = R.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID                                      = R.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID                                    = R.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID                                       = R.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID                                  = R.OPERATION_ID
                        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD                                 = R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    LEFT JOIN tblSCP0105_CHECK_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_ELTR_BY_ASSIGN_BASE B ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID                                   = B.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID                                    = B.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID                                       = B.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID                                      = B.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID                                    = B.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID                                       = B.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID                                  = B.OPERATION_ID
                        AND A.ITEM_ID                                       = B.ITEM_ID
                        AND A.NICK_NAME                                     = B.NICK_NAME
                        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD                                 = B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    LEFT JOIN tblSCP0105_CHECK_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_ELTR_BY_ASSIGN_BASE_UI_UPD_YN BU ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID                                   = BU.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID                                    = BU.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID                                       = BU.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID                                      = BU.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID                                    = BU.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID                                       = BU.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID                                  = BU.OPERATION_ID
                        AND A.ITEM_ID                                       = BU.ITEM_ID
                        AND A.NICK_NAME                                     = BU.NICK_NAME
                        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD                                 = BU.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
        )
        ,
        tblSCP0105_RAW_TEMP2 AS
        (
            SELECT    A.VER_ID
                    , A.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.YYYYMM
                    , MAX(A.UI_UPD_YN)                  AS UI_UPD_YN
                    , MAX(A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY)            AS ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                    , AVG(NVL(A.PFRSLT_QTY, 0.0))       AS PFRSLT_QTY
                    , AVG(NVL(A.BASE_QTY, 0.0))         AS BASE_QTY
                    , AVG(NVL(A.QTY, 0.0))              AS QTY
                    , MAX(A.REMARK)                     AS REMARK
                    , MAX(A.CREATED_BY)                 AS CREATED_BY
                    , MAX(A.CREATION_DATE)              AS CREATION_DATE
                    , MAX(A.LAST_UPDATED_BY)            AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                    , MAX(A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)           AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
            FROM    tblSCP0105_RAW_TEMP A
            GROUP BY  A.VER_ID
                    , A.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.YYYYMM
        )
            SELECT    A.VER_ID
                    , A.VER_SEQ
                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                    , A.SITE_ID
                    , A.PLANT_ID
                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                    , A.LINE_ID
                    , A.OPERATION_ID
                    , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    , A.ITEM_ID
                    , A.NICK_NAME
                    , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    , A.MSR_TP_CD
                    , A.YYYYMM
                    , A.PFRSLT_QTY
                    , A.BASE_QTY
                    , A.QTY
                    , L.DUMMY_YN                        AS UI_UPD_YN
                    , CASE
                        WHEN LENGTH(A.YYYYMM) = 4 THEN
                            CASE
                                WHEN DY.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231','YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101','YYYYMMDD')) + 1
                                ELSE DY.DAY_CNT
                            END
                        ELSE
                            CASE
                                WHEN DC.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(A.YYYYMM || '01','YYYYMMDD')))
                                ELSE DC.DAY_CNT
                            END
                      END                                                                                           AS DAY_CNT
                    , '0'                                           AS PROG_STAT
                    , NVL(C.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0)                     AS ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                    , Z.EQUIPMENT_ID
                    , NVL(Z.EQUIPMENT_NAME, '-')                    AS EQUIPMENT_NAME
                    , A.REMARK
                    , A.CREATED_BY
                    , A.CREATION_DATE
                    , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                    , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
            FROM    tblSCP0105_RAW_TEMP2 A
                    LEFT JOIN tblSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_ASSIGN C ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID       = C.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID        = C.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID           = C.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID          = C.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID        = C.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID           = C.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID      = C.OPERATION_ID
                        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD     = C.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        AND A.ITEM_ID           = C.ITEM_ID
                        AND A.NICK_NAME         = C.NICK_NAME
                        AND A.YYYYMM            = C.YYYYMM
                    LEFT JOIN tblSCP0104_EQPUIPMENT_LINE Z ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID       = Z.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID        = Z.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID           = Z.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID          = Z.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID        = Z.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID           = Z.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID      = Z.OPERATION_ID
                    LEFT JOIN tbl_DAY_CNT DC ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID       = DC.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID        = DC.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID           = DC.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID          = DC.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID        = DC.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID           = DC.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID      = DC.OPERATION_ID
                        AND A.YYYYMM            = DC.YYYYMM
                    LEFT JOIN tbl_DAY_CNT_YEAR DY ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID       = DY.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID        = DY.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID           = DY.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID          = DY.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID        = DY.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID           = DY.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID      = DY.OPERATION_ID
                        AND A.YYYYMM            = DY.YYYY
                    LEFT JOIN tblDummyLine L ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID       = L.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID        = L.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID           = L.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID          = L.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID        = L.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID           = L.LINE_ID
            WHERE   1=1

NAME: SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_MDL_V
TEXT:
WITH TBL_CODE_ALL AS
   ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , SHOP_GROUP_ID
          , MAX(SITE_NAME)      AS SITE_NAME
          , MAX(COMPANY_NAME)   AS COMPANY_NAME
          , MAX(PLANT_NAME)     AS PLANT_NAME
          , MAX(FACTORY_NAME)   AS FACTORY_NAME
          , MAX(LINE_NAME)      AS LINE_NAME
          , MAX(DUMMY_YN)       AS DUMMY_YN
          , MAX(VALID_YN)       AS VALID_YN
       FROM ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
                   , SITE_ID
                   , COMPANY_ID
                   , PLANT_ID
                   , FACTORY_ID
                   , LINE_ID
                   , SITE_NAME
                   , COMPANY_NAME
                   , PLANT_NAME
                   , FACTORY_NAME
                   , LINE_NAME
                   , ATTRIBUTE1   AS SHOP_GROUP_ID
                   , ATTRIBUTE2   AS DUMMY_YN
                   , VALID_YN
                FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
               WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y'
              UNION ALL
              SELECT DIVISION_ID
                   , SITE_ID
                   , COMPANY_ID
                   , PLANT_ID
                   , FACTORY_ID
                   , LINE_ID
                   , SITE_NAME
                   , COMPANY_NAME
                   , PLANT_NAME
                   , FACTORY_NAME
                   , LINE_NAME
                   , VALID_YN
                   , ATTRIBUTE1   AS SHOP_GROUP_ID
                   , ATTRIBUTE2   AS DUMMY_YN
                FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE
               WHERE VALID_YN = 'Y' ) A
      GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
             , SITE_ID
             , COMPANY_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , FACTORY_ID
             , LINE_ID
             , SHOP_GROUP_ID )
   , TBL_SITE AS
   ( SELECT SITE_ID
          , SITE_NAME
       FROM TBL_CODE_ALL
      GROUP BY SITE_ID
             , SITE_NAME )
   , TBL_COMPANY AS
   ( SELECT COMPANY_ID
          , COMPANY_NAME
       FROM TBL_CODE_ALL
      GROUP BY COMPANY_ID
             , COMPANY_NAME )
   , TBL_PLANT AS
   ( SELECT PLANT_ID
          , PLANT_NAME
       FROM TBL_CODE_ALL
      GROUP BY PLANT_ID
             , PLANT_NAME )
   , TBL_FACTORY AS
   ( SELECT FACTORY_ID
          , FACTORY_NAME
       FROM TBL_CODE_ALL
      GROUP BY FACTORY_ID
             , FACTORY_NAME )
   , TBL_LINE AS
   ( SELECT LINE_ID
          , LINE_NAME
       FROM TBL_CODE_ALL
      GROUP BY LINE_ID
             , LINE_NAME )
   , SHOP_GROUP AS
   ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , SHOP_GROUP_ID
          , OPERATION_GROUP   AS SHOP_GROUP_NAME
       FROM SCM_SITE_HIERARCHY_V_SN
      WHERE 1 = 1
      GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
             , SITE_ID
             , PLANT_ID
             , SHOP_GROUP_ID
             , OPERATION_GROUP )
   , OPERATION AS
   ( SELECT OPERATION_ID
          , OPERATION_NAME
       FROM SCM_MST_OPERATION_SN
      GROUP BY OPERATION_ID
             , OPERATION_NAME )
   , ASSIGN_ALL AS
   ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
          , A.COMPANY_ID
          , A.SITE_ID
          , A.PLANT_ID
          , A.FACTORY_ID
          , A.LINE_ID
          , A.OPERATION_ID
          , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , A.ITEM_ID
          , A.NICK_NAME
          , A.DUMMY_YN
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_MDL A
      UNION ALL
     SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
          , A.COMPANY_ID
          , A.SITE_ID
          , A.PLANT_ID
          , A.FACTORY_ID
          , A.LINE_ID
          , A.OPERATION_ID
          , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , A.ITEM_ID
          , A.NICK_NAME
          , A.DUMMY_YN
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_ELTR_LINE_MDL A )
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.SITE_ID
     , A.PLANT_ID
     , A.FACTORY_ID
     , A.LINE_ID
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , A.ITEM_ID
     , A.NICK_NAME
     , A.DUMMY_YN
     , FN_GET_DIVISION_NAME(A.DIVISION_ID)                  AS DIVISION_NAME
     , S.SITE_NAME
     , C.COMPANY_NAME
     , P.PLANT_NAME
     , F.FACTORY_NAME
     , L.LINE_NAME
     , NVL(H.SHOP_GROUP_ID, SUBSTR(A.OPERATION_ID, 1, 1))   AS SHOP_GROUP_ID
     , H.SHOP_GROUP_NAME
     , O.OPERATION_NAME
     , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD                                      AS ELTR_LN_TP_NM
  FROM ASSIGN_ALL   A
     , TBL_SITE     S
     , TBL_COMPANY  C
     , TBL_PLANT    P
     , TBL_FACTORY  F
     , TBL_LINE     L
     , SHOP_GROUP   H
     , OPERATION    O
 WHERE A.SITE_ID      = S.SITE_ID(+)
   AND A.COMPANY_ID   = C.COMPANY_ID(+)
   AND A.PLANT_ID     = P.PLANT_ID(+)
   AND A.FACTORY_ID   = F.FACTORY_ID(+)
   AND A.LINE_ID      = L.LINE_ID(+)
   AND A.DIVISION_ID  = H.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND A.SITE_ID      = H.SITE_ID(+)
   AND A.PLANT_ID     = H.PLANT_ID(+)
   AND A.OPERATION_ID = O.OPERATION_ID(+)

NAME: SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_MDL_V
TEXT:
WITH TBLVERSION AS
   ( SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_MDL_V
 * Description  :
 * Program History
 *================================================================================================================================================
 * Date         In Charge                          Description
 *================================================================================================================================================
 * 2024/08/03   chaan        V1.1.0                PJ20230692  SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 Phase2     - Initial Release
 * 2024/08/29   chaan        V1.1.8                PJ20230692  SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 Phase2     - DAY_CNT 로직 수정 - SOP 적용
 * 2024/12/09   chaan        V1.1.9                PJ20230692  SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 Phase2     - Pre Version 누락 추가
 * 2025/02/10   mrchois      V1.1.10               PJ20249346  LGES SCP 개선과제 이행     - Improvement Rate 입력 영역을 제거하고 Operation Plan 에 Goal 직접 입력 형태로 수정
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */
 DIVISION_ID
          , VER_ID
          , VER_SEQ
          , TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(VER_ID || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), -1), 'YYYYMM')   AS RESULT_TO_YYYYMM   /* 원본 CONVERT(NVARCHAR(6),DATEADD(MM,-1,CONVERT(DATETIME,VER_ID+'01')),112): 전월 YYYYMM */
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_VERSION
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND PROG_STAT IN ('-', '0')   /* Pre, Current */
      GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
             , VER_ID
             , VER_SEQ )
   , TBL_DAY_CNT AS
   ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , SOP_DT
          , SOP_YM    AS YYYYMM
          , SOP_DDN   AS DAY_CNT
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_SOP
      WHERE 1 = 1 )
   , TBL_DAY_CNT_YEAR AS
   ( SELECT DIVISION_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , SOP_DT
          , SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4)   AS YYYY
          , CASE
                WHEN YYYYMM IS NOT NULL THEN (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SOP_DT, 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1   /* SOP 적용 일수 (원본 DATEDIFF(DAY,SOP_DT,YYYY+'1231')+1) */
                /* 2026.09.28 원본은 MSSQL 문자 결합이라 월이 비면 NULL 이 되어 날짜로 바꾸지 않는다.
                   Oracle 은 NULL || '1231' 이 '1231' 이 되어 깨지므로 월이 빈 행을 먼저 가른다 — 값은 그대로 */
                WHEN SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) IS NULL THEN NULL
                ELSE                         (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1   /* 연간총일수 */
            END   AS DAY_CNT
       FROM TBL_DAY_CNT
      WHERE 1 = 1 )
   , TBLSCP0106_MEASURE_ALL AS
   ( SELECT ATTRIBUTE3     AS LOSS_GR_CD
          , SEGMENT1       AS LOSS_CD
          , ATTRIBUTE6     AS LOSS_GR_NM_KO
          , ATTRIBUTE7     AS LOSS_GR_NM_EN
          , ATTRIBUTE4     AS LOSS_NM_KO
          , ATTRIBUTE5     AS LOSS_NM_EN
          , ATTRIBUTE13    AS TARGET_YN   /* @p_sheet_name = 'CURRENT_TARGET_YN' */
          , DISPLAY_SEQ
       FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_CAPA_LOSS_MEASURE'
        AND VALID_YN    = 'Y' )
   , TBLSCP0106_MEASURE_VISIBLE AS
   ( SELECT COLUMN_NAME   AS MEASURE
       FROM SCM_MST_SHEET_MEASURE
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND PROGRAM_ID = 'SCP0106'
        AND SHEET_NAME = 'CURRENT_ASSEMBLY'
        AND VALID_YN   = 'Y' )
   , TBLSCP0106_SPEED_PLAN_PPM AS
   ( SELECT VER_ID
          , VER_SEQ
          , DIVISION_ID
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , PLANT_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , ITEM_ID
          , NICK_NAME
          , MSR_TP_CD
          , YYYYMM
          , BASE_QTY
          , QTY
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_V
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND MSR_TP_CD = 'PPM' )
   , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_NICK_NAME AS
   ( SELECT V.VER_ID
          , V.VER_SEQ
          , A.DIVISION_ID
          , A.COMPANY_ID
          , A.SITE_ID
          , A.PLANT_ID
          , A.FACTORY_ID
          , A.LINE_ID
          , A.OPERATION_ID
          , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , A.ITEM_ID
          , A.NICK_NAME
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN   A
          , TBLVERSION                 V
      WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND NVL(A.VALID_YN, '-') <> 'N'   /* Oracle ''=NULL: sentinel 로 NULL 행 보존(원본 ISNULL(VALID_YN,'')<>'N') */
      GROUP BY V.VER_ID
             , V.VER_SEQ
             , A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.COMPANY_ID
             , A.SITE_ID
             , A.PLANT_ID
             , A.FACTORY_ID
             , A.LINE_ID
             , A.OPERATION_ID
             , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.NICK_NAME )
   , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN AS
   ( SELECT V.VER_ID
          , V.VER_SEQ
          , A.DIVISION_ID
          , A.COMPANY_ID
          , A.SITE_ID
          , A.PLANT_ID
          , A.FACTORY_ID
          , A.LINE_ID
          , A.OPERATION_ID
          , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , A.ITEM_ID
          , A.NICK_NAME
          , A.YYYYMM
          , A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN   A
          , TBLVERSION                 V
      WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND NVL(A.VALID_YN, '-') <> 'N' )   /* Oracle ''=NULL: sentinel 로 NULL 행 보존(원본 ISNULL(VALID_YN,'')<>'N') */
   , TBLSCP0106_RAW_TEMP AS
   ( SELECT B.VER_ID
          , B.VER_SEQ
          , A.DIVISION_ID
          , A.MDL_NM
          , A.PLANT_ID
          , A.LINE_ID
          , A.OPERATION_ID
          , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , A.COMPANY_ID
          , A.SITE_ID
          , A.FACTORY_ID
          , A.MSR_TP_CD
          , A.YYYYMM
          , A.PFRSLT_NVL
          , A.BASE_NVL
          , A.MSR_GR_CD
          , A.MSR_NVL
       FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LOSS_PLAN_MDL                      A
          , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN_NICK_NAME   B
      WHERE A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
        AND A.COMPANY_ID    = B.COMPANY_ID
        AND A.SITE_ID       = B.SITE_ID
        AND A.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID
        AND A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID
        AND A.LINE_ID       = B.LINE_ID
        AND A.OPERATION_ID  = B.OPERATION_ID
        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
        AND A.MDL_NM        = B.NICK_NAME )
   , TBLSCP0106_RAW_ALL AS
   ( SELECT A.VER_ID
          , A.VER_SEQ
          , A.DIVISION_ID
          , A.MDL_NM
          , A.PLANT_ID
          , A.LINE_ID
          , A.OPERATION_ID
          , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , A.COMPANY_ID
          , A.SITE_ID
          , A.FACTORY_ID
          , A.MSR_TP_CD
          , A.YYYYMM
          , A.PFRSLT_NVL
          , A.BASE_NVL
          , A.MSR_GR_CD
          , A.MSR_NVL
          , M.LOSS_NM_EN
          , M.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
          , M.DISPLAY_SEQ   AS SORT_ORDER_NO
          , CASE
                WHEN LENGTH(A.YYYYMM) = 4
                THEN CASE
                         WHEN DY.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1   /* 연도별 & SOP 없을때 */
                         ELSE DY.DAY_CNT   /* 연도별 & SOP 존재 */
                     END
                ELSE CASE
                         WHEN DC.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(CASE WHEN LENGTH(RTRIM(A.YYYYMM)) = 6 THEN A.YYYYMM || '01' END, 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD'))   /* 2026.09.28 연 단위 행에서 실행계획에 따라 먼저 셈해져 깨지는 것을 막는다 — 값은 그대로 */   /* 월별 & SOP 없을때 (EOMONTH→LAST_DAY, DAY→'DD') */
                         ELSE DC.DAY_CNT   /* 월별 & SOP 존재 */
                     END
            END   AS DAY_CNT
          , CASE
                WHEN A.VER_ID IS NULL THEN NULL   /* VER_ID NULL(버전 미매칭): MSSQL NULL+'01'=NULL → Oracle NULL||'01'='01' TO_DATE ORA-01840 방지(원본 동치) */
                ELSE TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(A.VER_ID || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')), 'DD')) - TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.VER_ID || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD')) + 1
            END   AS DAY_CNT_BASE
          , PP.QTY        AS SPEED_PPM
          , PP.BASE_QTY   AS SPEED_BASE_PPM
          , CASE WHEN V.MEASURE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END   AS MEASURE_VISIBLE   /* 원본 IIF(V.MEASURE IS NOT NULL,'Y','N') */
       FROM TBLSCP0106_RAW_TEMP        A
          , TBLSCP0106_MEASURE_ALL     M
          , TBLSCP0106_MEASURE_VISIBLE V
          , TBLSCP0106_SPEED_PLAN_PPM  PP
          , TBL_DAY_CNT                DC
          , TBL_DAY_CNT_YEAR           DY
      WHERE A.MSR_TP_CD    = M.LOSS_CD(+)
        AND A.MSR_TP_CD    = V.MEASURE(+)
        AND A.VER_ID       = PP.VER_ID(+)
        AND A.VER_SEQ      = PP.VER_SEQ(+)
        AND A.DIVISION_ID  = PP.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND A.COMPANY_ID   = PP.COMPANY_ID(+)
        AND A.SITE_ID      = PP.SITE_ID(+)
        AND A.PLANT_ID     = PP.PLANT_ID(+)
        AND A.FACTORY_ID   = PP.FACTORY_ID(+)
        AND A.LINE_ID      = PP.LINE_ID(+)
        AND A.OPERATION_ID = PP.OPERATION_ID(+)
        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = PP.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)
        AND A.MDL_NM       = PP.NICK_NAME(+)
        AND A.YYYYMM       = PP.YYYYMM(+)
        AND A.DIVISION_ID  = DC.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND A.COMPANY_ID   = DC.COMPANY_ID(+)
        AND A.SITE_ID      = DC.SITE_ID(+)
        AND A.PLANT_ID     = DC.PLANT_ID(+)
        AND A.FACTORY_ID   = DC.FACTORY_ID(+)
        AND A.LINE_ID      = DC.LINE_ID(+)
        AND A.OPERATION_ID = DC.OPERATION_ID(+)
        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = DC.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)
        AND A.YYYYMM       = DC.YYYYMM(+)
        AND A.DIVISION_ID  = DY.DIVISION_ID(+)
        AND A.COMPANY_ID   = DY.COMPANY_ID(+)
        AND A.SITE_ID      = DY.SITE_ID(+)
        AND A.PLANT_ID     = DY.PLANT_ID(+)
        AND A.FACTORY_ID   = DY.FACTORY_ID(+)
        AND A.LINE_ID      = DY.LINE_ID(+)
        AND A.OPERATION_ID = DY.OPERATION_ID(+)
        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = DY.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)
        AND A.YYYYMM       = DY.YYYY(+) )
   , TBLSCP0106_RAW3 AS
   ( SELECT VER_ID
          , VER_SEQ
          , DIVISION_ID
          , MDL_NM
          , PLANT_ID
          , LINE_ID
          , OPERATION_ID
          , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
          , COMPANY_ID
          , SITE_ID
          , FACTORY_ID
          , MSR_TP_CD
          , YYYYMM
          , CASE
                WHEN MSR_TP_CD IN ('PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'THRY_CAPA_D') THEN NULL   /* 실적에서 CAPA 제외 */
                WHEN MSR_TP_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT') THEN PFRSLT_NVL   /* 일수 or EA */
                ELSE PFRSLT_NVL * 100.0   /* 비율로 표시 */
            END   AS PFRSLT_NVL
          , CASE
                WHEN MSR_TP_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN', 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT') THEN BASE_NVL   /* 일수 or EA */
                ELSE BASE_NVL * 100.0   /* 비율로 표시 */
            END   AS BASE_NVL
          , MSR_GR_CD
          , CASE
                WHEN MSR_TP_CD IN ('SCP_PROD_PLAN', 'PROD_CAPA_M', 'PROD_CAPA_D', 'SCP_PROD_PLAN_DDN', 'THRY_CAPA_D', 'SD_RT', 'WT_RT', 'TD_RT', 'MC_RT') THEN MSR_NVL   /* 일수 or EA */
                ELSE MSR_NVL * 100.0   /* 비율로 표시 */
            END   AS MSR_NVL
          , LOSS_NM_EN
          , LOSS_GR_NM_EN
          , SORT_ORDER_NO
          , DAY_CNT
          , DAY_CNT_BASE
          , SPEED_PPM
          , SPEED_BASE_PPM
          , MEASURE_VISIBLE
       FROM TBLSCP0106_RAW_ALL )
SELECT A.VER_ID
     , A.VER_SEQ
     , A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.MDL_NM
     , A.PLANT_ID
     , A.LINE_ID
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.SITE_ID
     , A.FACTORY_ID
     , A.MSR_TP_CD
     , A.YYYYMM
     , A.PFRSLT_NVL
     , A.BASE_NVL
     , A.MSR_GR_CD
     , CASE WHEN NVL(B.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE A.MSR_NVL END   AS MSR_NVL   /* 우선순위가 없으면 클리어 (원본 ISNULL(B.ASSIGN_PRIORITY,0)=0) */
     , A.LOSS_NM_EN
     , A.LOSS_GR_NM_EN
     , A.SORT_ORDER_NO
     , A.DAY_CNT
     , A.DAY_CNT_BASE
     , A.SPEED_PPM
     , A.SPEED_BASE_PPM
     , B.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
     , A.MEASURE_VISIBLE
  FROM TBLSCP0106_RAW3                    A
     , TBLSCP0105_SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN B
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND A.COMPANY_ID    = B.COMPANY_ID(+)
   AND A.SITE_ID       = B.SITE_ID(+)
   AND A.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID(+)
   AND A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID(+)
   AND A.LINE_ID       = B.LINE_ID(+)
   AND A.OPERATION_ID  = B.OPERATION_ID(+)
   AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)
   AND A.MDL_NM        = B.NICK_NAME(+)
   AND A.YYYYMM        = B.YYYYMM(+)
   AND 1 = 1

NAME: SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_NEW_V
TEXT:
WITH tblVersion AS
    (
        SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                , MAX(VER_ID)          AS VER_ID
                , MAX(VER_SEQ)         AS VER_SEQ
                , TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(MAX(VER_ID) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), -1), 'YYYYMM') AS RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
        FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_VERSION A
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND PROG_STAT = '0'
            AND VER_ID    <> '-'
        GROUP BY  DIVISION_ID
    )
    ,
    tbl_OPERATION_ELECTRODE_TYPE AS
    (
        SELECT    A.SEGMENT1    AS DIVISION_ID
                , A.SEGMENT2    AS OPERATION_ID
                , A.SEGMENT3    AS ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ATTRIBUTE1  AS EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD
        FROM    SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPERATION_ELECTRODE_TYPE'
            AND A.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
    )
    ,
    tbl_SPEED_UNIT_ALL AS
    (
        SELECT    A.SEGMENT1    AS UNIT_GROUP
                , A.SEGMENT2    AS OPERATION_ID
                , A.SEGMENT3    AS MSR_TP_CD
                , A.SEGMENT4    AS LINE_TYPE
                , A.SEGMENT5    AS UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
                , A.DISPLAY_SEQ
        FROM    SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPERATION_SPEED_UNIT'
            AND A.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
    ),
    tbl_SPEED_UNIT_GROUP_MSR AS
    (
        SELECT    A.UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , MIN(A.DISPLAY_SEQ)      AS DISPLAY_SEQ
                , MAX(A.UNIT_GROUP_SEQ)   AS UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
        FROM    tbl_SPEED_UNIT_ALL A
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND MSR_TP_CD <> 'M'
        GROUP BY  A.UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
    )
    ,
    tbl_SPEED_UNIT_GROUP AS
    (
        SELECT    A.UNIT_GROUP
                , MAX(A.UNIT_GROUP_SEQ)   AS UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
        FROM    tbl_SPEED_UNIT_ALL A
        GROUP BY  A.UNIT_GROUP
    )
    ,
    tblSCP0104_CODE_ALL AS
    (
        SELECT  *
        FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE
        WHERE   VALID_YN = 'Y'
    )
    ,
    tblSCP0104_SITE AS
    (
        SELECT    SITE_ID
                , SITE_NAME
        FROM    tblSCP0104_CODE_ALL
        GROUP BY  SITE_ID
                , SITE_NAME
    )
    ,
    tblSCP0104_COMPANY AS
    (
        SELECT    COMPANY_ID
                , COMPANY_NAME
        FROM    tblSCP0104_CODE_ALL
        GROUP BY  COMPANY_ID
                , COMPANY_NAME
    )
    ,
    tblSCP0104_PLANT AS
    (
        SELECT    PLANT_ID
                , PLANT_NAME
        FROM    tblSCP0104_CODE_ALL
        GROUP BY  PLANT_ID
                , PLANT_NAME
    )
    ,
    tblSCP0104_FACTORY AS
    (
        SELECT    FACTORY_ID
                , FACTORY_NAME
        FROM    tblSCP0104_CODE_ALL
        GROUP BY  FACTORY_ID
                , FACTORY_NAME
    )
    ,
    tblSCP0104_LINE AS
    (
        SELECT    LINE_ID
                , LINE_NAME
        FROM    tblSCP0104_CODE_ALL
        GROUP BY  LINE_ID
                , LINE_NAME
    )
    ,
    -- tbl_DUMMY_CODE_NICK_NAME: 원본은 FN_SCM0002_GET_CAPA_ITEM_POPUP TVF(WHERE 1<>1 항상0행) 참조하나
    -- 뷰 내 어디서도 미참조(데드 CTE)이므로 변환 시 제거(테이블함수 의존 제거)
    tbl_DAY_CNT AS
    (
        SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , SOP_DT
                , SOP_YM    AS YYYYMM
                , SOP_DDN   AS DAY_CNT
        FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_SOP
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
    ),
    -- 실적
    tbl_RESULT AS
    (
        SELECT    A.DIVISION_ID                 AS DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID                  AS COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID                     AS SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID                    AS PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID                  AS FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID                     AS LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID                AS OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD               AS ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.MDL_NM                       AS NICK_NAME
                , B.UNIT_GROUP                  AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , UPPER(A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD)     AS EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD
                , A.EQP_NBU                     AS EQP_NBU
                , A.EQP_SPED                    AS EQP_SPED
                , CAST(A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS NUMBER)  AS PPM
        FROM    SCM_DNM_EQP_SPED_MMLY A
                LEFT JOIN (
                            SELECT    UNIT_GROUP
                                    , MSR_TP_CD
                            FROM    tbl_SPEED_UNIT_ALL
                            WHERE   1 = 1
                            GROUP BY UNIT_GROUP
                                    , MSR_TP_CD
                          ) B ON A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD = B.MSR_TP_CD
                INNER JOIN (
                            SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                                    , RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
                            FROM    tblVersion
                          ) V ON A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
                             AND A.PFRSLT_YM   = V.RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND A.PERD_DIVS_CD = '3'
    ),
    -- BASE
    tbl_BASE AS
    (
        SELECT    A.DIVISION_ID             AS DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID              AS COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID                 AS SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID                AS PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID              AS FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID                 AS LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID            AS OPERATION_ID
                , A.MDL_NM                  AS NICK_NAME
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD           AS ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , B.UNIT_GROUP              AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , UPPER(A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD) AS MSR_TP_CD
                , A.EQP_NBU
                , A.EQP_SPED
                , A.UI_UPD_YN
