        FROM    SCP_MST_MDL_EQP_SPED A
                LEFT JOIN (
                            SELECT    UNIT_GROUP
                                    , MSR_TP_CD
                            FROM    tbl_SPEED_UNIT_ALL
                            WHERE   1 = 1
                            GROUP BY UNIT_GROUP
                                    , MSR_TP_CD
                          ) B ON A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD = B.MSR_TP_CD
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
    ),
    -- UI_UPD_YN
    tbl_BASE_UI_UPD_YN AS
    (
        SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , NICK_NAME
                , MAX(UI_UPD_YN)    AS UI_UPD_YN
        FROM    tbl_BASE
        WHERE   1 = 1
        GROUP BY  DIVISION_ID
                , COMPANY_ID
                , SITE_ID
                , PLANT_ID
                , FACTORY_ID
                , LINE_ID
                , OPERATION_ID
                , ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , NICK_NAME
    ),
    -- CF
    tbl_CF AS
    (
        SELECT    A.NICK_NM                     AS NICK_NAME
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , CAST(A.ELTR_QTY AS NUMBER)     AS ELTR_QTY
                , CAST(A.ELTR_PCH_LEN AS NUMBER) AS ELTR_PCH_LEN
        FROM    SCP_MST_MDL_ELTR_QTY A
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND USE_YN = 'Y'
    ),
    -- ASSIGN
    tbl_LINE_ASSIGN AS
    (
        SELECT    V.VER_ID
                , V.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.YYYYMM
                , A.DUMMY_YN
                , A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
        FROM    SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN A
                LEFT JOIN tblVersion V ON A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND A.VALID_YN = 'Y'
            AND NVL(A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0) <> 0
    )
    ,
    tbl_RAW_ALL_TEMP AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , NVL(B.MSR_TP_CD, 'EQP_NBU')   AS MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , NULL                          AS PFRSLT_QTY
                , B.BASE_QTY
                , B.QTY
                , B.REMARK
                , B.CREATED_BY
                , B.CREATION_DATE
                , B.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        FROM    tbl_LINE_ASSIGN A
                LEFT JOIN SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN B ON
                            A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
                        AND A.COMPANY_ID    = B.COMPANY_ID
                        AND A.SITE_ID       = B.SITE_ID
                        AND A.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID
                        AND A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID
                        AND A.LINE_ID       = B.LINE_ID
                        AND A.OPERATION_ID  = B.OPERATION_ID
                        AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                        AND A.NICK_NAME     = B.NICK_NAME
                        AND A.YYYYMM        = B.YYYYMM
        WHERE   1 = 1
    )
    ,
    tbl_RAW_ALL AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , G.UNIT_GROUP      AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , G.UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
                , CASE
                    WHEN G.UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_SPED' THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A5000')                                              THEN 'MMS'
                            WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A7000') OR (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A7400')                 THEN 'CPM'
                            WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A8000' AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = 'Folding') OR (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A8400') THEN 'PPM_AVG'
                            ELSE 'TTT'
                        END
                    WHEN G.UNIT_GROUP = 'PPM' THEN 'PPM'
                    ELSE A.MSR_TP_CD
                  END AS MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , A.PFRSLT_QTY      AS PFRSLT_QTY
                , A.BASE_QTY
                , A.QTY
                , A.REMARK
                , A.CREATED_BY
                , A.CREATION_DATE
                , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        FROM    tbl_RAW_ALL_TEMP A
                INNER JOIN tbl_SPEED_UNIT_GROUP_MSR G ON 1 = 1
                LEFT JOIN tbl_OPERATION_ELECTRODE_TYPE U ON
                        A.DIVISION_ID   = U.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = U.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = U.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
        WHERE   1 = 1
    )
    ,
    -- RAW KEYS
    tbl_RAW_KEYS AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
        FROM    tbl_RAW_ALL A
        WHERE   1 = 1
        GROUP BY  A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
    )
    ,
    -- RAW TEMP
    tbl_RAW_TEMP AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , X.BASE_QTY
                , R.EQP_NBU                                 AS R_PFRSLT_QTY
                , B.EQP_NBU                                 AS B_BASE_QTY
                , R.EQP_SPED                                AS R_PFRSLT_SPEED
                , R.PPM                                     AS R_PPM
                , B.EQP_SPED                                AS B_BASE_SPEED
                , CAST(Q.ELTR_QTY AS NUMBER)                AS ELTR_QTY
                , CAST(Q.ELTR_PCH_LEN AS NUMBER)            AS ELTR_PCH_LEN
                , CAST(Q.ELTR_QTY * Q.ELTR_PCH_LEN AS NUMBER) AS MMS_CF
                , X.QTY
                , NVL(BU.UI_UPD_YN, 'Y')                    AS UI_UPD_YN
                , X.REMARK
                , X.CREATED_BY
                , X.CREATION_DATE
                , X.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , X.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        FROM    tbl_RAW_KEYS A
                LEFT JOIN tbl_RAW_ALL X ON
                        A.VER_ID            = X.VER_ID
                    AND A.VER_SEQ           = X.VER_SEQ
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID       = X.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.COMPANY_ID        = X.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID           = X.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID          = X.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID        = X.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID           = X.LINE_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID      = X.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD     = X.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    AND A.ITEM_ID           = X.ITEM_ID
                    AND A.NICK_NAME         = X.NICK_NAME
                    AND A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP  = X.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                    AND A.MSR_TP_CD         = X.MSR_TP_CD
                    AND A.YYYYMM            = X.YYYYMM
                LEFT JOIN tbl_RESULT R ON
                        A.DIVISION_ID   = R.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.COMPANY_ID    = R.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID       = R.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID      = R.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID    = R.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID       = R.LINE_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = R.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                LEFT JOIN tbl_BASE B ON
                        A.DIVISION_ID   = B.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.COMPANY_ID    = B.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID       = B.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID      = B.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID       = B.LINE_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = B.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.NICK_NAME     = B.NICK_NAME
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                LEFT JOIN tbl_CF Q ON
                        A.NICK_NAME     = Q.NICK_NAME
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = Q.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                LEFT JOIN tbl_BASE_UI_UPD_YN BU ON
                        A.DIVISION_ID   = BU.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.COMPANY_ID    = BU.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID       = BU.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID      = BU.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID    = BU.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID       = BU.LINE_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = BU.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.NICK_NAME     = BU.NICK_NAME
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = BU.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
        WHERE   1 = 1
    )
    ,
    -- 서브 쿼리 - QTY
    tbl_RAW_TEMP_QTY AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , A.R_PFRSLT_QTY
                , A.B_BASE_QTY
                , A.R_PFRSLT_SPEED
                , A.B_BASE_SPEED
                , A.ELTR_QTY
                , A.ELTR_PCH_LEN
                , A.MMS_CF
                , A.QTY
                , A.UI_UPD_YN
        FROM    tbl_RAW_TEMP A
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_NBU'
    )
    ,
    -- 서브 쿼리 - SPEED
    tbl_RAW_TEMP_SPEED AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , A.R_PFRSLT_QTY
                , A.B_BASE_QTY
                , A.R_PFRSLT_SPEED
                , A.R_PPM
                , A.B_BASE_SPEED
                , A.ELTR_QTY
                , A.ELTR_PCH_LEN
                , A.MMS_CF
                , CASE WHEN A.UI_UPD_YN = 'Y' THEN A.QTY ELSE A.B_BASE_SPEED END  AS SPEED
                , A.UI_UPD_YN
        FROM    tbl_RAW_TEMP A
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_SPED'
    )
    ,
    -- 실적 PPM (Line별)
    tbl_SPEED_RESULT_PPM AS
    (
        SELECT    A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , CAST(A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS NUMBER)  AS PPM
        FROM    SCM_DNM_EQP_SPED_MMLY A
                LEFT JOIN (
                            SELECT    DIVISION_ID
                                    , RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
                            FROM    tblVersion
                          ) V ON A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID
                             AND A.PFRSLT_YM   = V.RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND A.PERD_DIVS_CD = '3'
    )
    ,
    tbl_RAW_TEMP1 AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , CASE
                    WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_SPED' THEN CAST(A.R_PFRSLT_SPEED AS NUMBER)
                    WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_NBU'  THEN CAST(A.R_PFRSLT_QTY AS NUMBER)
                    ELSE A.R_PPM
                  END AS PFRSLT_QTY
                , CASE
                    WHEN A.UI_UPD_YN = 'Y' THEN A.BASE_QTY
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_SPED' THEN CAST(A.B_BASE_SPEED AS NUMBER)
                            WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_NBU'  THEN CAST(A.B_BASE_QTY AS NUMBER)
                            ELSE
                                CASE
                                    WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A5000') THEN
                                        CAST(CASE WHEN A.MMS_CF * A.B_BASE_QTY = 0 THEN 0 ELSE A.B_BASE_SPEED * 60.0 / A.MMS_CF * A.B_BASE_QTY END AS NUMBER)
                                    WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A7000') OR (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A7400') THEN
                                        CAST(CASE WHEN A.ELTR_QTY * A.B_BASE_QTY = 0 THEN 0 ELSE A.B_BASE_SPEED / A.ELTR_QTY * A.B_BASE_QTY END AS NUMBER)
                                    WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A8000' AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = 'Folding') OR (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A8400') THEN
                                        CAST(A.B_BASE_SPEED * A.B_BASE_QTY AS NUMBER)
                                    ELSE
                                        CAST(CASE WHEN A.B_BASE_SPEED * A.B_BASE_QTY = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 60.0 / A.B_BASE_SPEED * A.B_BASE_QTY END AS NUMBER)
                                END
                        END
                  END AS BASE_QTY
                , CASE
                    WHEN A.UI_UPD_YN = 'Y' THEN A.QTY
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_SPED' THEN CAST(S.SPEED AS NUMBER)
                            WHEN A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_NBU'  THEN CAST(Q.QTY AS NUMBER)
                            ELSE
                                CASE
                                    WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A5000') THEN
                                        CAST(CASE WHEN A.MMS_CF * Q.QTY = 0 THEN 0 ELSE S.SPEED * 60.0 / A.MMS_CF * Q.QTY END AS NUMBER)
                                    WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A7000') OR (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A7400') THEN
                                        CAST(CASE WHEN A.ELTR_QTY * Q.QTY = 0 THEN 0 ELSE S.SPEED / A.ELTR_QTY * Q.QTY END AS NUMBER)
                                    WHEN (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A8000' AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = 'Folding') OR (A.OPERATION_ID = 'A8400') THEN
                                        S.SPEED * Q.QTY
                                    ELSE
                                        CAST(CASE WHEN S.SPEED * Q.QTY = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 60.0 / S.SPEED * Q.QTY END AS NUMBER)
                                END
                        END
                  END AS QTY
                , A.ELTR_QTY
                , A.MMS_CF
                , Q.QTY         AS EQP_NBU
                , A.UI_UPD_YN
                , A.REMARK
                , A.CREATED_BY
                , A.CREATION_DATE
                , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        FROM    tbl_RAW_TEMP A
                LEFT JOIN tbl_RAW_TEMP_QTY Q ON
                        A.VER_ID        = Q.VER_ID
                    AND A.VER_SEQ       = Q.VER_SEQ
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID   = Q.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.COMPANY_ID    = Q.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID       = Q.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID      = Q.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID    = Q.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID       = Q.LINE_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = Q.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = Q.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    AND A.NICK_NAME     = Q.NICK_NAME
                    AND A.MSR_TP_CD     = Q.MSR_TP_CD
                    AND A.YYYYMM        = Q.YYYYMM
                LEFT JOIN tbl_RAW_TEMP_SPEED S ON
                        A.VER_ID        = S.VER_ID
                    AND A.VER_SEQ       = S.VER_SEQ
                    AND A.DIVISION_ID   = S.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.COMPANY_ID    = S.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID       = S.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID      = S.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID    = S.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID       = S.LINE_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = S.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = S.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    AND A.NICK_NAME     = S.NICK_NAME
                    AND A.MSR_TP_CD     = S.MSR_TP_CD
                    AND A.YYYYMM        = S.YYYYMM
        WHERE   1 = 1
    )
    ,
    tbl_RAW_TEMP2 AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , A.UI_UPD_YN
                , NVL(A.PFRSLT_QTY, 0.0)        AS PFRSLT_QTY
                , NVL(A.BASE_QTY, 0.0)          AS BASE_QTY
                , CASE WHEN NVL(A.QTY, 0.0) = 0.0 THEN A.BASE_QTY ELSE A.QTY END  AS QTY
                , NVL(A.ELTR_QTY, 0.0)          AS ELTR_QTY
                , NVL(A.MMS_CF, 0.0)            AS MMS_CF
                , A.REMARK
                , A.CREATED_BY
                , A.CREATION_DATE
                , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        FROM    tbl_RAW_TEMP1 A
        WHERE   1 = 1
            AND (   (A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_NBU'  AND A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('EQP_NBU')) OR
                    (A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'EQP_SPED' AND A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('MMS', 'CPM', 'PPM_AVG', 'TTT')) OR
                    (A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP = 'PPM'      AND A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('PPM')))
    )
    ,
    tbl_RAW AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , A.PFRSLT_QTY
                , A.BASE_QTY
                , A.QTY
                , A.ELTR_QTY
                , A.MMS_CF
                , A.UI_UPD_YN
                , NVL(C.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0)     AS ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                , C.DUMMY_YN
                , CASE
                    WHEN LENGTH(A.YYYYMM) = 4 THEN (TO_DATE(A.YYYYMM || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(A.YYYYMM || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1   -- 연도별
                    ELSE
                        CASE
                            WHEN NVL(DC.DAY_CNT, 0) = 0 THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(A.YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')))               -- 월별 & SOP 없을때
                            ELSE DC.DAY_CNT                                                                                                  -- 월별 & SOP 존재
                        END
                  END AS DAY_CNT
                , '0'   AS PROG_STAT   -- CURRENT 고정
                , A.REMARK
                , A.CREATED_BY
                , A.CREATION_DATE
                , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        FROM    tbl_RAW_TEMP2 A
                LEFT JOIN tbl_LINE_ASSIGN C ON
                        A.DIVISION_ID   = C.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.COMPANY_ID    = C.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID       = C.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID      = C.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID    = C.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID       = C.LINE_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = C.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = C.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    AND A.NICK_NAME     = C.NICK_NAME
                    AND A.YYYYMM        = C.YYYYMM
                LEFT JOIN tbl_DAY_CNT DC ON
                        A.DIVISION_ID   = DC.DIVISION_ID
                    AND A.COMPANY_ID    = DC.COMPANY_ID
                    AND A.SITE_ID       = DC.SITE_ID
                    AND A.PLANT_ID      = DC.PLANT_ID
                    AND A.FACTORY_ID    = DC.FACTORY_ID
                    AND A.LINE_ID       = DC.LINE_ID
                    AND A.OPERATION_ID  = DC.OPERATION_ID
                    AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD = DC.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                    AND A.YYYYMM        = DC.YYYYMM
        WHERE   1 = 1
    )
    ,
    tbl_RAW_Final AS
    (
        SELECT    A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
                , MAX(A.PFRSLT_QTY)         AS PFRSLT_QTY
                , MAX(A.BASE_QTY)           AS BASE_QTY
                , MAX(A.QTY)                AS QTY
                , MAX(A.ELTR_QTY)           AS ELTR_QTY
                , MAX(A.MMS_CF)             AS MMS_CF
                , MAX(A.UI_UPD_YN)          AS UI_UPD_YN
                , MAX(A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY)    AS ASSIGN_PRIORITY
                , MAX(A.DUMMY_YN)           AS DUMMY_YN
                , MAX(A.DAY_CNT)            AS DAY_CNT
                , MAX(A.PROG_STAT)          AS PROG_STAT
                , MAX(A.REMARK)             AS REMARK
                , MAX(A.CREATED_BY)         AS CREATED_BY
                , MAX(A.CREATION_DATE)      AS CREATION_DATE
                , MAX(A.LAST_UPDATED_BY)    AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
                , MAX(A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE)   AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
        FROM    tbl_RAW A
        WHERE   1 = 1
        GROUP BY  A.VER_ID
                , A.VER_SEQ
                , A.DIVISION_ID
                , A.COMPANY_ID
                , A.SITE_ID
                , A.PLANT_ID
                , A.FACTORY_ID
                , A.LINE_ID
                , A.OPERATION_ID
                , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
                , A.ITEM_ID
                , A.NICK_NAME
                , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
                , A.MSR_TP_CD
                , A.YYYYMM
    )
    SELECT  "VER_ID","VER_SEQ","DIVISION_ID","COMPANY_ID","SITE_ID","PLANT_ID","FACTORY_ID","LINE_ID","OPERATION_ID","ELTR_LN_TP_CD","ITEM_ID","NICK_NAME","SPEED_UNIT_GROUP","MSR_TP_CD","YYYYMM","PFRSLT_QTY","BASE_QTY","QTY","ELTR_QTY","MMS_CF","UI_UPD_YN","ASSIGN_PRIORITY","DUMMY_YN","DAY_CNT","PROG_STAT","REMARK","CREATED_BY","CREATION_DATE","LAST_UPDATED_BY","LAST_UPDATE_DATE"
    FROM    tbl_RAW_Final A

NAME: SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN_V
TEXT:
WITH TBLVERSION AS
(
SELECT DIVISION_ID
     , MAX(VER_ID)    AS VER_ID
     , MAX(VER_SEQ)   AS VER_SEQ
     , TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(MAX(VER_ID) || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), -1), 'YYYYMM')    AS RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
  FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_VERSION A
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND PROG_STAT IN ('-', '0')          /* Pre, Current */
 GROUP BY DIVISION_ID
)
, TBL_SPEED_UNIT_ALL AS
(
SELECT A.SEGMENT1    AS UNIT_GROUP
     , A.SEGMENT2    AS OPERATION_ID
     , A.SEGMENT3    AS MSR_TP_CD
     , A.SEGMENT4    AS LINE_TYPE
     , A.SEGMENT5    AS UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
     , A.DISPLAY_SEQ
  FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL A
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND A.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'OPERATION_SPEED_UNIT'
   AND A.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
)
, TBL_SPEED_UNIT_GROUP_MSR AS
(
SELECT A.UNIT_GROUP
     , A.MSR_TP_CD
     , MIN(A.DISPLAY_SEQ)      AS DISPLAY_SEQ
     , MAX(A.UNIT_GROUP_SEQ)   AS UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
  FROM TBL_SPEED_UNIT_ALL A
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND MSR_TP_CD <> 'M'
 GROUP BY A.UNIT_GROUP, A.MSR_TP_CD
)
, TBL_DAY_CNT AS
(
SELECT DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID, OPERATION_ID, ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , SOP_DT
     , SOP_YM     AS YYYYMM
     , SOP_DDN    AS DAY_CNT
  FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_SOP
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
)
, TBL_DAY_CNT_YEAR AS
(
SELECT DIVISION_ID, COMPANY_ID, SITE_ID, PLANT_ID, FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID, OPERATION_ID, ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , SOP_DT
     , SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4)    AS YYYY
     , CASE
         WHEN YYYYMM IS NOT NULL THEN (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SOP_DT, 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1                        /* SOP 적용 일수 (SOP_DT=VARCHAR YYYYMMDD) */
         ELSE (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1                       /* 연간 총일수 */
       END    AS DAY_CNT
  FROM TBL_DAY_CNT
 WHERE 1 = 1
)
, TBL_RESULT AS
(
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , A.MDL_NM                       AS NICK_NAME
     , B.UNIT_GROUP                   AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
     , UPPER(A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD)      AS EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD
     , A.EQP_NBU
     , A.EQP_SPED
     , TO_NUMBER(A.ATTRIBUTE1)        AS PPM
  FROM SCM_DNM_EQP_SPED_MMLY A
     , ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, RESULT_TO_YYYYMM FROM TBLVERSION ) V
     , ( SELECT UNIT_GROUP, MSR_TP_CD FROM TBL_SPEED_UNIT_ALL WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY UNIT_GROUP, MSR_TP_CD ) B
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID                     /* INNER JOIN TBLVERSION */
   AND A.PFRSLT_YM   = V.RESULT_TO_YYYYMM
   AND A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD = B.MSR_TP_CD(+)               /* OUTER JOIN 단위그룹(인라인뷰) */
   AND A.PERD_DIVS_CD = '3'
)
, TBL_BASE AS
(
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.MDL_NM                       AS NICK_NAME
     , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , B.UNIT_GROUP                   AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
     , UPPER(A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD)      AS MSR_TP_CD
     , A.EQP_NBU
     , A.EQP_SPED
     , A.UI_UPD_YN
  FROM SCP_MST_MDL_EQP_SPED A
     , ( SELECT UNIT_GROUP, MSR_TP_CD FROM TBL_SPEED_UNIT_ALL WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY UNIT_GROUP, MSR_TP_CD ) B
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND A.EQP_SPED_UNIT_CD = B.MSR_TP_CD(+)               /* OUTER JOIN 단위그룹(인라인뷰) */
   AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
)
, TBL_CF AS
(
SELECT A.NICK_NM                       AS NICK_NAME
     , A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , TO_NUMBER(A.ELTR_QTY)           AS ELTR_QTY
     , TO_NUMBER(A.ELTR_PCH_LEN)       AS ELTR_PCH_LEN
  FROM SCP_MST_MDL_ELTR_QTY A
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND USE_YN = 'Y'
)
, TBL_LINE_ASSIGN AS
(
SELECT V.VER_ID, V.VER_SEQ
     , A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , A.ITEM_ID, A.NICK_NAME, A.YYYYMM, A.DUMMY_YN, A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
  FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_LINE_ASSIGN A
     , TBLVERSION V
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND A.DIVISION_ID = V.DIVISION_ID(+)                  /* OUTER JOIN TBLVERSION */
   AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
)
, TBL_RAW AS
(
SELECT V.VER_ID, V.VER_SEQ
     , A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
     , A.ITEM_ID, A.NICK_NAME
     , G.UNIT_GROUP            AS SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
     , G.UNIT_GROUP_SEQ
     , A.MSR_TP_CD
     , A.YYYYMM
     , CASE
         WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('MMS', 'CPM', 'PPM_AVG', 'TTT') THEN R.EQP_SPED
         WHEN A.MSR_TP_CD IN ('PPM') THEN R.PPM
         ELSE R.EQP_NBU
       END                                                AS PFRSLT_QTY
     , A.BASE_QTY
     , TO_NUMBER(Q.ELTR_QTY)                              AS ELTR_QTY
     , TO_NUMBER(Q.ELTR_PCH_LEN)                          AS ELTR_PCH_LEN
     , Q.ELTR_QTY * Q.ELTR_PCH_LEN                        AS MMS_CF
     , A.QTY
     , A.UI_UPD_YN
     , S.ASSIGN_PRIORITY
     , S.DUMMY_YN
     , CASE
         WHEN LENGTH(A.YYYYMM) = 4 THEN
             CASE
                 WHEN DY.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.YYYYMM, 1, 4) || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD')) + 1   /* 연도별 & SOP 없을때 */
                 ELSE DY.DAY_CNT                                                                                                                                          /* 연도별 & SOP 존재 */
             END
         ELSE
             CASE
                 WHEN DC.DIVISION_ID IS NULL THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(A.YYYYMM || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')))                                                       /* 월별 & SOP 없을때 */
                 ELSE DC.DAY_CNT                                                                                                                                          /* 월별 & SOP 존재 */
             END
       END                                                AS DAY_CNT
     , '0'    AS PROG_STAT                                 /* CURRENT 고정 (CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2),0)) */
     , A.REMARK
     , A.CREATED_BY
     , A.CREATION_DATE
     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
  FROM SCP_MST_CAPA_SPEED_PLAN A
     , TBL_LINE_ASSIGN S
     , TBLVERSION V
     , TBL_SPEED_UNIT_GROUP_MSR G
     , TBL_RESULT R
     , TBL_BASE B
     , TBL_CF Q
     , TBL_DAY_CNT DC
     , TBL_DAY_CNT_YEAR DY
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND A.DIVISION_ID    = S.DIVISION_ID          /* INNER JOIN TBL_LINE_ASSIGN */
   AND A.COMPANY_ID     = S.COMPANY_ID
   AND A.SITE_ID        = S.SITE_ID
   AND A.PLANT_ID       = S.PLANT_ID
   AND A.FACTORY_ID     = S.FACTORY_ID
   AND A.LINE_ID        = S.LINE_ID
   AND A.OPERATION_ID   = S.OPERATION_ID
   AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD  = S.ELTR_LN_TP_CD
   AND A.NICK_NAME      = S.NICK_NAME
   AND A.YYYYMM         = S.YYYYMM
   AND A.DIVISION_ID    = V.DIVISION_ID(+)        /* OUTER JOIN TBLVERSION */
   AND A.MSR_TP_CD      = G.MSR_TP_CD(+)          /* OUTER JOIN TBL_SPEED_UNIT_GROUP_MSR */
   AND A.DIVISION_ID    = R.DIVISION_ID(+)        /* OUTER JOIN TBL_RESULT */
   AND A.COMPANY_ID     = R.COMPANY_ID(+)
   AND A.SITE_ID        = R.SITE_ID(+)
   AND A.PLANT_ID       = R.PLANT_ID(+)
   AND A.FACTORY_ID     = R.FACTORY_ID(+)
   AND A.LINE_ID        = R.LINE_ID(+)
   AND A.OPERATION_ID   = R.OPERATION_ID(+)
   AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD  = R.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)
   AND A.DIVISION_ID    = B.DIVISION_ID(+)        /* OUTER JOIN TBL_BASE */
   AND A.COMPANY_ID     = B.COMPANY_ID(+)
   AND A.SITE_ID        = B.SITE_ID(+)
   AND A.PLANT_ID       = B.PLANT_ID(+)
   AND A.FACTORY_ID     = B.FACTORY_ID(+)
   AND A.LINE_ID        = B.LINE_ID(+)
   AND A.OPERATION_ID   = B.OPERATION_ID(+)
   AND A.NICK_NAME      = B.NICK_NAME(+)
   AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD  = B.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)
   AND A.NICK_NAME      = Q.NICK_NAME(+)          /* OUTER JOIN TBL_CF */
   AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD  = Q.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)
   AND A.DIVISION_ID    = DC.DIVISION_ID(+)       /* OUTER JOIN TBL_DAY_CNT */
   AND A.COMPANY_ID     = DC.COMPANY_ID(+)
   AND A.SITE_ID        = DC.SITE_ID(+)
   AND A.PLANT_ID       = DC.PLANT_ID(+)
   AND A.FACTORY_ID     = DC.FACTORY_ID(+)
   AND A.LINE_ID        = DC.LINE_ID(+)
   AND A.OPERATION_ID   = DC.OPERATION_ID(+)
   AND A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD  = DC.ELTR_LN_TP_CD(+)
   AND A.YYYYMM         = DC.YYYYMM(+)
   AND A.DIVISION_ID    = DY.DIVISION_ID(+)       /* OUTER JOIN TBL_DAY_CNT_YEAR */
   AND A.COMPANY_ID     = DY.COMPANY_ID(+)
   AND A.SITE_ID        = DY.SITE_ID(+)
   AND A.PLANT_ID       = DY.PLANT_ID(+)
   AND A.FACTORY_ID     = DY.FACTORY_ID(+)
   AND A.LINE_ID        = DY.LINE_ID(+)
   AND A.OPERATION_ID   = DY.OPERATION_ID(+)
   AND A.YYYYMM         = DY.YYYY(+)
   AND NVL(S.ASSIGN_PRIORITY, 0) <> 0
)
SELECT A.VER_ID, A.VER_SEQ, A.DIVISION_ID, A.COMPANY_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID
     , A.OPERATION_ID, A.ELTR_LN_TP_CD, A.ITEM_ID, A.NICK_NAME
     , A.SPEED_UNIT_GROUP
     , A.MSR_TP_CD
     , A.YYYYMM
     , A.PFRSLT_QTY       AS PFRSLT_QTY
     , A.BASE_QTY         AS BASE_QTY
     , A.QTY              AS QTY
     , A.ELTR_QTY         AS ELTR_QTY
     , A.MMS_CF           AS MMS_CF
     , A.UI_UPD_YN        AS UI_UPD_YN
     , A.ASSIGN_PRIORITY  AS ASSIGN_PRIORITY
     , A.DUMMY_YN         AS DUMMY_YN
     , A.DAY_CNT          AS DAY_CNT
     , A.PROG_STAT        AS PROG_STAT
     , A.REMARK           AS REMARK
     , A.CREATED_BY       AS CREATED_BY
     , A.CREATION_DATE    AS CREATION_DATE
     , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY  AS LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE
  FROM TBL_RAW A
 WHERE 1 = 1

NAME: SCP_MST_CELL_TCO_RELATION_V
TEXT:
WITH SUB AS
(
SELECT A.ITEM_ID          AS CELL_ITEM_ID
     , C.PLANT_SITE_ID    AS CELL_PLANT_SITE_ID
     , B.ITEM_ID          AS TCO_CELL_ITEM_ID
     , (SELECT PLANT_SITE_ID
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY_V V
         WHERE V.DIVISION_ID = '40'
           AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN V.FROM_YYYYMMDD AND V.TO_YYYYMMDD
           AND V.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
           AND V.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
           AND ROWNUM        = 1) AS TCO_PLANT_SITE_ID
  FROM (SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , ITEM_ID
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
         WHERE DIVISION_ID     = '40'
           AND OPERATION_GROUP = 'A'
           AND TCO_CELL_YN     = 'N'
       ) A
     , (SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
         WHERE DIVISION_ID     = '40'
           AND OPERATION_GROUP = 'A'
           AND TCO_CELL_YN     = 'Y'
       ) B
     , (SELECT DIVISION_ID
             , ITEM_ID
             , PLANT_SITE_ID
          FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM_PRIORITY_V
         WHERE DIVISION_ID = '40'
           AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN FROM_YYYYMMDD AND TO_YYYYMMDD
       ) C
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND A.ITEM_ID     = B.ATTRIBUTE1(+)
   AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND A.ITEM_ID     = C.ITEM_ID(+)
)
SELECT CELL_ITEM_ID
     , CELL_PLANT_SITE_ID
     , TCO_CELL_ITEM_ID
     , TCO_PLANT_SITE_ID
     , (SELECT NVL(MAX(NVL(LT_TOTAL, 0)), 0)
          FROM SCP_MST_BOD_N_V B
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID    = '40'
           AND B.TO_SITE        = SUB.TCO_PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND B.BOD_VALID_YN   = 'Y'
           AND B.ROUTE_VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND B.FROM_SITE      = SUB.CELL_PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.FROM_YYYYMMDD AND B.TO_YYYYMMDD
       ) AS CELL_TO_TCO_BOD_LT
     , (SELECT NVL(MAX(NVL(LT_TOTAL, 0)), 0)
          FROM SCP_MST_BOD_N_V B
         WHERE B.DIVISION_ID    = '40'
           AND B.TO_SITE        = SUB.CELL_PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND B.BOD_VALID_YN   = 'Y'
           AND B.ROUTE_VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND B.FROM_SITE      = SUB.TCO_PLANT_SITE_ID
           AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.FROM_YYYYMMDD AND B.TO_YYYYMMDD
       ) AS TCO_TO_CELL_BOD_LT
     , (
        (SELECT NVL(MAX(NVL(LT_TOTAL, 0)), 0)
           FROM SCP_MST_BOD_N_V B
          WHERE B.DIVISION_ID    = '40'
            AND B.TO_SITE        = SUB.TCO_PLANT_SITE_ID
            AND B.BOD_VALID_YN   = 'Y'
            AND B.ROUTE_VALID_YN = 'Y'
            AND B.FROM_SITE      = SUB.CELL_PLANT_SITE_ID
            AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.FROM_YYYYMMDD AND B.TO_YYYYMMDD
        ) +
        (SELECT NVL(MAX(NVL(LT_TOTAL, 0)), 0)
           FROM SCP_MST_BOD_N_V B
          WHERE B.DIVISION_ID    = '40'
            AND B.TO_SITE        = SUB.CELL_PLANT_SITE_ID
            AND B.BOD_VALID_YN   = 'Y'
            AND B.ROUTE_VALID_YN = 'Y'
            AND B.FROM_SITE      = SUB.TCO_PLANT_SITE_ID
            AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.FROM_YYYYMMDD AND B.TO_YYYYMMDD
        )
       ) AS CELL_TO_TCO_TOTAL_BOD_LT
  FROM SUB

NAME: SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_DW_V

NAME: SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V
TEXT:
SELECT /****************************************************************************
 * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
 * VIEW NAME     : SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V
 * DESCRIPTION   : 전극,셀,팩공정그룹의 최종공정의 ITEM을 조회
 *                 ITEM ID에 대하여 하나의 정보만 조회되어야 함
 * PROGRAM HISTORY
 *--------------------------------------------------------------
 *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
 *--------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2018-07-04   KTH          INITIAL
 * 2018-08-15   YYDOK        TCO_CELL_YN ADD
 * 2018-11-27   YYDOK        CELL_LIST(ATTRIBUTE1) ADD
 * 2019-11-20   KSG          BOM 이슈로 GROUP BY 처리
 * 2020-10-14   KSG          PJ20202001 LG화학 전지. 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 SCM 관리 체계 개선 : RACK
 * 2022-01-08   KSG          PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : DC Item 구분 : item_class = 'EM0307'
 * 2022-06-02   KSG          PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : ISUZU Item 구분
 * 2023-06-02   KSG          PJ20230691 LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : 활성화 대응 Cell Prod/Assy 구분자 추가
 *************************************************************************** */  /* DISTINCT */
       ITEM_ID
     , MIN(OPERATION_GROUP)      AS OPERATION_GROUP
     , MIN(ELECTRODE_TYPE)       AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , MIN(TCO_CELL_YN)          AS TCO_CELL_YN
     , MIN(ATTRIBUTE1)           AS CELL_LIST
     , MIN(NVL(ATTRIBUTE3, 'N')) AS RACK_YN    /* 20201014 PJ20202001 RACK Item Flag 추가 */
     , MIN(NVL(ATTRIBUTE4, 'N')) AS DC_YN      /* 20220107 DC Item 구분 */
     , MIN(NVL(ATTRIBUTE5, 'N')) AS IS_YN      /* 20220602 PJ20216891 ISUZU Item 구분 */
     , MIN(NVL(ATTRIBUTE8, 'N')) AS CELL_TYPE  /* 20230601 PJ20230691 활성화 대응 Cell Prod/Assy 구분자 추가 */
  FROM SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM
 GROUP BY ITEM_ID
/* GROUP BY ITEM_ID, OPERATION_GROUP, ELECTRODE_TYPE, TCO_CELL_YN, NVL(ATTRIBUTE3, 'N') */

NAME: SCP_PLAN_PARAMETER_V
TEXT:
with sub as
(
select d.DIVISION_ID,
       p.plan_name || '-' || d.plan_type || '-' || FN_ZERO_LPAD(TO_CHAR(d.plan_seq),2)  as plan_version_id,
       p.plan_name,
       d.plan_seq,
       d.plan_type,
       d.CONFIRM_FLAG,
       D.CONFIRM_USER,
       D.CONFIRM_DATE,
       P.PLAN_ID,
       M.MODELING_ID,
       M.PLAN_CYCLE,
       P.PLAN_ID || '::' || d.plan_TYPE || '::' || TO_CHAR(d.plan_seq) AS ENG_PLAN_ID,
       d.DIVISION_ID || '::' || M.PLAN_CYCLE AS master_id,
       D.UI_DISPLAY_YN,
       D.ACTIVE_FLAG,
       D.PLAN_STATUS,
       D.CREATION_DATE
  from scm_mst_plan_detail d,
       scm_mst_plan        p,
       scm_mst_modeling    m
 where 1=1
   and m.MODELING_ID   = d.MODELING_ID
   and m.DIVISION_ID   = d.DIVISION_ID
   and m.MODELING_ID   = d.MODELING_ID
   and p.DIVISION_ID   = d.DIVISION_ID
   and p.PLAN_CYCLE    = m.PLAN_CYCLE
   and p.PLAN_ID       = d.PLAN_ID
 )
   SELECT "MASTER_ID","ENG_PLAN_ID","PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD","FOR_PROCEDURE","FOR_QUERY","FOR_WHERE_CLAUSE","FOR_UI_PROCEDURE","PLAN_CYCLE","PLAN_ID","MODELING_ID","PLAN_SEQ","PLAN_TYPE","DIVISION_ID","PLAN_VERSION_ID","CONFIRM_FLAG","CONFIRM_USER","CONFIRM_DATE","UI_DISPLAY_YN","ACTIVE_FLAG","PLAN_STATUS","CREATION_DATE","PLAN_TYPE_ORDER" FROM (
   select
          master_id,
          ENG_PLAN_ID,
          plan_name        as plan_start_yyyymmdd,
           CHR(13) || '-- DELETE FROM SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH where CREATED_BY = ''<@p_user_id,NVARCHAR(100),>'' '
         || CHR(13) || '--EXEC <sp,명,PR_SCP_> --'
         || ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '   @p_plan_cycle          = '''|| PLAN_CYCLE|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_plan_start_yyyymmdd = '''|| plan_name|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_plan_id             = '''|| PLAN_ID|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_modeling_id         = '''|| MODELING_ID || ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_seq                 = '''|| TO_CHAR(plan_seq)      || ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_plan_type           = '''|| plan_type|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_master_id           = '''|| master_id|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_division_id         = '''|| DIVISION_ID|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_engine_plan_id      = '''|| ENG_PLAN_ID|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_user_id             = ''<@p_user_id,NVARCHAR(100),>'
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' '
         || '' || CHR(13) || ' SELECT * FROM SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH    WITH (NOLOCK)  WHERE CREATED_BY =''<@p_user_id,NVARCHAR(100),>'' order by CREATION_DATE desc '
       AS FOR_PROCEDURE ,
                          ' -- Ctrl+Shift+M 으로 @p_user_id명 입력하세요 '
                || ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' DECLARE   @p_plan_cycle          NVARCHAR(100) = '''|| PLAN_CYCLE|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '         , @p_plan_start_yyyymmdd NVARCHAR(100) = '''|| plan_name|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '         , @p_plan_id             NVARCHAR(100) = '''|| PLAN_ID|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '         , @p_modeling_id         NVARCHAR(100) = '''|| MODELING_ID || ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '         , @p_seq                 NVARCHAR(100) = '''|| TO_CHAR(plan_seq)      || ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '         , @p_plan_type           NVARCHAR(100) = '''|| plan_type|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '         , @p_master_id           NVARCHAR(100) = '''|| master_id|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '         , @p_division_id         NVARCHAR(100) = '''|| DIVISION_ID|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '         , @p_engine_plan_id      NVARCHAR(100) = '''|| ENG_PLAN_ID|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '         , @p_item_id             NVARCHAR(100) = '''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '         , @p_user_id             NVARCHAR(100) = ''<@p_user_id,NVARCHAR(100),>'
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '         , @p_program_id          NVARCHAR(030) = ''XLSPSI03'
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '         , @p_to_yyyymmdd         NVARCHAR(008) =  CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(day, 364, '''|| plan_name || '''), 112)'
       AS FOR_QUERY,
                          '      WHERE 0 = 0
       ' || 'AND division_id         = '''|| DIVISION_ID|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '       AND plan_start_yyyymmdd = '''|| plan_name|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '       AND plan_type           = '''|| plan_type|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '       AND seq                 = '''|| TO_CHAR(plan_seq)      || ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '    -- AND item_id             = '''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '    -- AND plan_cycle          = '''|| PLAN_CYCLE|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '    -- AND plan_id             = '''|| PLAN_ID|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '    -- AND modeling_id         = '''|| MODELING_ID || ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '    -- AND master_id           = '''|| master_id|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '    -- AND engine_plan_id      = '''|| ENG_PLAN_ID|| ''
       AS FOR_WHERE_CLAUSE,
          ' /* Ctrl+Shift+M 으로 프로시저명, @p_user_id명 입력하세요 '
         || '*/'
         || CHR(13) || 'EXEC <sp,명,SCP00> --'
         || ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || '   @p_from_yyyymmdd       = '''|| plan_name||''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_to_yyyymmdd         = '''|| TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(plan_name,'YYYYMMDD')+30,'YYYYMMDD')||''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_division_id         = '''|| DIVISION_ID|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_item_id             = '''|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_nick_name           = '''|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_from_site           = '''|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_to_site             = '''|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_plan_start_yyyymmdd = '''|| plan_name|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_plan_type           = '''|| plan_type|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_seq                 = '''|| TO_CHAR(plan_seq)      || ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_program_id          = '''|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_sheet_name          = '''|| ''
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @p_user_id             = ''<@p_user_id,NVARCHAR(100),>'
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' , @debug_mode             = ''T'
         || '''' || CHR(13) || ' '
       AS FOR_UI_PROCEDURE ,
          PLAN_CYCLE,
          PLAN_ID,
          MODELING_ID,
          plan_seq,
          plan_type,
          DIVISION_ID,
          plan_version_id  as plan_version_id,
          CONFIRM_FLAG,
          CONFIRM_USER,
          CONFIRM_DATE,
          UI_DISPLAY_YN,
          ACTIVE_FLAG,
          PLAN_STATUS,
          CREATION_DATE,
       case plan_type when 'PR' then 0 when 'MA' then 1 when 'SE' then 3 when 'FN' then 4 else 9 end as plan_type_order
     from sub
    where 1=1
     and plan_name >= FN_GET_BUCKET_YYYYMMDD(-3)
  order by plan_name desc, PLAN_CYCLE desc, ENG_PLAN_ID Desc
   ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 200

NAME: SCP_PLN_DELIVERY_V
TEXT:
SELECT A.MASTER_ID
       , A.PLAN_ID
       , A.OUT_VERSION_ID
       , A.PLAN_NAME
       , A.DEMAND_ID
       , A.ORG_DEMAND_ID
       , A.DIVISION_ID
       , A.PLAN_TYPE
       , A.SEQ
       , A.FROM_SITE_ID  AS FROM_SITE_ID
       , A.TO_SITE_ID    AS TO_SITE_ID
       , CASE WHEN A.FROM_SITE_ID LIKE '%-S%' THEN SUBSTR(A.FROM_SITE_ID, 1, INSTR(A.FROM_SITE_ID, '~') - 1) ELSE A.FROM_SITE_ID END  AS SCM_FROM_SITE_ID
       , CASE WHEN A.TO_SITE_ID   LIKE '%-S%' THEN SUBSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, 1, INSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, '~') - 1)   ELSE A.TO_SITE_ID   END  AS SCM_TO_SITE_ID
       , SUBSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, INSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, '~') - 1, 6)  AS P_FLAG
       , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, INSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, '~') + 1, 3) NOT IN ('001', '002', '003') THEN 'S'
              WHEN SUBSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, INSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, '~') - 1, 6) IN ('A~001', 'A~002')        THEN 'P'
              ELSE '-' END  AS SP_FLAG
       , A.ITEM_ID
       , A.START_TIME
       , A.ORDER_ID
       , A.COMPLETE_QTY
       , A.ALLOCATION_QTY
       , A.OPERATION_QTY
       , A.END_TIME
       , CASE WHEN FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.BOD_ID, 2, '::') = 'x' THEN NULL ELSE FN_SCM_SPLIT(A.BOD_ID, 2, '::') END  AS BOD_ID
       , A.BOD_ID  AS BOD_ID2
       , A.FIX_TYPE
       , A.LPST
       , A.EPST
       , Y.DIVISION_ID  AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
       , Z.DIVISION_ID  AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
       , C.ELECTRODE_TYPE
       , C.OPERATION_GROUP
       , A.CREATION_DATE
       , A.CREATED_BY
       , A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
       , A.LAST_UPDATED_BY
    FROM SCP_ENG_DELIVERY_O_SN A
    JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V C
      ON A.ITEM_ID = C.ITEM_ID

    LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE Y
      ON 0 = 0
     AND Y.SCM_SITE_ID = REPLACE(SUBSTR(A.FROM_SITE_ID, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(A.FROM_SITE_ID, '~') = 0 THEN LENGTH(A.FROM_SITE_ID) ELSE INSTR(A.FROM_SITE_ID, '~') - 1 END), '-S', '')
     AND Y.VALID_YN = 'Y'
    LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE Z
      ON 0 = 0
     AND Z.SCM_SITE_ID = REPLACE(SUBSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, '~') = 0 THEN LENGTH(A.TO_SITE_ID) ELSE INSTR(A.TO_SITE_ID, '~') - 1 END), '-S', '')
     AND Z.VALID_YN = 'Y'
     AND Y.DIVISION_ID = Z.DIVISION_ID
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND A.TO_SITE_ID NOT LIKE '%-003'
     AND A.TO_SITE_ID NOT LIKE 'E-002'

NAME: SCP_PLN_ESS_ELEC_REQ_V
TEXT:
SELECT /****************************************************************************
  * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : SCP_PLN_ESS_ELEC_REQ_V
  * DESCRIPTION   : ESS사업부의 자동차전지사업부로의 전극소요량을
  *                 DM MKT FCST에 반영하기위한 뷰
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018-04-25   YYDOK        INITIAL
  * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX   [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
  ****************************************************************************/  M.DIVISION_ID
     , M.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , M.PLAN_TYPE
     , M.SEQ
     , M.ITEM_ID
     , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME(M.DIVISION_ID, M.ITEM_ID) AS NICK_NAME
     , M.YYYYMMDD
     , M.TO_SITE
     , ROUND((NVL(M.REQ_QTY, 0) - NVL(M.STOCK_QTY, 0)), 0) AS DM_FCST_QTY
  FROM SCP_PLN_MATERIAL_PLAN M
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND M.DIVISION_ID = '82'
   AND SUBSTR(M.ITEM_ID, 1, 5) IN ('APCAN', 'APCCA', 'APCCS')
   AND M.PLAN_TYPE = 'FN'
   AND (NVL(M.REQ_QTY, 0) - NVL(M.STOCK_QTY, 0)) > 0
   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                 FROM SCP_PLAN_VERSION_V V
                WHERE V.DIVISION_ID         = M.DIVISION_ID
                  AND V.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = M.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                  AND V.PLAN_TYPE           = M.PLAN_TYPE
                  AND V.PLAN_SEQ            = M.SEQ
                  AND V.CONFIRM_FLAG        = 'Y')

NAME: SCP_PLN_PEGGING_INFO_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * PROJECT      : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
 * VIEW NAME    : SCP_PLN_PEGGING_INFO_V
 * DESCRIPTION  : 생산계획(WO)/출하계획(DO) 페깅 정보 통합 (SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V + SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN)
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date        In Charge   Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018.02.02   LTW      Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 *                       (PLAN_ID,MODELING_ID,SEQ,PLAN_NAME,MASTER_ID,OUT_VERSION_ID)
 * 2018.03.23   YYDOK    PEGGING INFO에는 동일 WORK ORDER에 대해서 여러건의 자재투입수량이되어있어서
 *                       별도의 뷰를 구성하여 WORK ORDER별 DEMAND ID별 SUPPLY QTY를 조회할수있도록 변경
 *                       ( SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V 신규적용)
 * 2018.04.05   YYDOK    통합테스트 오류수정(PEGGING 출하정보누락..PEGGING_TYPE조건제거)
 * 2018-04-06   LTW      scp_eng_pegging_info_wo_v.demand_id 값이 '-'인항목 제거 조건 추가
 * 2018-06-08   YYDOK    scp_eng_pegging_info_o_temp_sn 적용
 * 2018.07.09   LTW      전극 SCP 작업(ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID ,ELECTRODE_TYPE) 추가
 * 2018.09.07   LTW      TCO CELL 구분관련 로직 변경 (SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V.FROM_TCO_CELL_YN /
 *                       SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN.ATTRIBUTE7(FROM TCO_CELL_YN))
 * 2018.09.18   LTW      SCP_ANL_PROBLEM_REPORT_PEGGING.PLANNED_QTY 의 수량을 완료 기준 수량(FROM_SITE 기준) 으로 변경
 * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX   [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 *
 *   SUBSTRING->SUBSTR / CHARINDEX(sub,str)->INSTR(str,sub) / UNION ALL 유지 / WITH(NOLOCK) 제거 / 끝 세미콜론 제거
 * --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 */
       /* 생산계획(scp_pln_production_plan) */
       PI.PLAN_ID, PI.MODELING_ID
     , PI.SEQ                                 AS PLAN_SEQ
     , PI.PLAN_NAME, PI.MASTER_ID, PI.OUT_VERSION_ID, PI.PLAN_TYPE, PI.DIVISION_ID
     , PI.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, PI.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
     , PI.DEMAND_PRIORITY, PI.DUE_DATE
     , PI.SUPPLY_QTY                          AS PLANNED_QTY
     , PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID                   AS DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
     , PI.WORK_ORDER_ID                       AS WORK_ORDER_ID
     , NULL                                   AS TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
     , NULL                                   AS TO_WORK_ORDER_ID
     , PI.START_DTTM, PI.END_DTTM
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.SITE_ID, 1, '~')       AS FROM_SITE_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.SITE_ID, 1, '~')       AS TO_SITE_ID
     , PI.ITEM_ID                             AS FROM_ITEM_ID
     , PI.OPERATION_GROUP, PI.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , PI.START_DTTM                          AS PLAN_START_DATE
     , PI.END_DTTM                            AS PLAN_END_DATE
     , CASE WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' THEN CASE WHEN PI.WORK_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ELEC' WHEN PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ESHIP' END
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P' THEN CASE WHEN PI.WORK_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'PACK' WHEN PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'PSHIP' END
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' THEN CASE WHEN PI.FROM_TCO_CELL_YN = 'Y'                                                THEN 'TCELL'
                                                    WHEN SUBSTR(PI.SITE_ID, INSTR(PI.SITE_ID, '~') - 1, 6) IN ('A~001')          THEN 'FORM'
                                                    WHEN SUBSTR(PI.SITE_ID, INSTR(PI.SITE_ID, '~') - 1, 6) IN ('A~002')          THEN 'CHAR'
                                                    WHEN PI.WORK_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'CELL' WHEN PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'CSHIP' END
            ELSE '' END                       AS PEGGING_OPERATION_CODE
     , PI.DEMAND_ID                           AS ENG_DEMAND_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 1, '##')    AS DEMAND_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 1, '::')    AS DEMAND_ITEM_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 2, '::')    AS PROJECT_CODE
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 3, '::')    AS ENG_SITE_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 3, '::'), 1, '~') AS SALES_SITE_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 3, '::'), 2, '~') AS INCOTERMS
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 4, '::')    AS DOM_EXP
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 5, '::')    AS FCST_TYPE
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 6, '::')    AS DEMAND_TYPE
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 7, '::')    AS YYYYMMDD
     , CASE FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 8, '::'), 1, '^'), 1, '##')
            WHEN 'NOPLANT' THEN '-'
            ELSE FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 8, '::'), 1, '^'), 1, '##') END AS PLANT_SITE_ID
     , 'WO'                                   AS DESCR
     , NULL                                   AS STOCK_PLAN_LOT_ID
     , PI.LPST
  FROM SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V PI
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND PI.DEMAND_ID <> 'UNPEGGING'
   AND PI.DEMAND_ID <> '-'
UNION ALL
/* 출하계획(scp_pln_shipment_plan) */
SELECT PI.PLAN_ID, PI.MODELING_ID
     , PI.SEQ                                 AS PLAN_SEQ
     , PI.PLAN_NAME, PI.MASTER_ID, PI.OUT_VERSION_ID, PI.PLAN_TYPE, PI.DIVISION_ID
     , PI.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, PI.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
     , PI.DEMAND_PRIORITY, PI.DUE_DATE
     , TO_NUMBER(PI.QTY)                      AS PLANNED_QTY
     , PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID                   AS DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
     , PI.WORK_ORDER_ID                       AS WORK_ORDER_ID
     , PI.TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID                AS TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
     , PI.TO_WORK_ORDER_ID                    AS TO_WORK_ORDER_ID
     , PI.START_DTTM, PI.END_DTTM
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.FROM_SITE_ID, 1, '~')  AS FROM_SITE_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.TO_SITE_ID, 1, '~')    AS TO_SITE_ID
     , PI.FROM_ITEM_ID
     , PI.OPERATION_GROUP, PI.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , PI.START_DTTM                          AS PLAN_START_DATE
     , PI.END_DTTM                            AS PLAN_END_DATE
     , CASE WHEN PI.PEGGING_TYPE = 'ALLOCATION' THEN 'ALLOC'
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' THEN CASE WHEN PI.TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'ESHIP' END
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P' THEN CASE WHEN PI.TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'PSHIP' END
            WHEN PI.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' THEN CASE WHEN SUBSTR(PI.TO_SITE_ID, INSTR(PI.TO_SITE_ID, '~') - 1, 6) IN ('A~001') THEN 'FORM'
                                                    WHEN SUBSTR(PI.TO_SITE_ID, INSTR(PI.TO_SITE_ID, '~') - 1, 6) IN ('A~002') THEN 'CHAR'
                                                    WHEN PI.ATTRIBUTE7 = 'Y'                                                  THEN 'TCSHIP'
                                                    WHEN PI.TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL                                  THEN 'CSHIP' END
            ELSE '' END                       AS PEGGING_OPERATION_CODE
     , PI.DEMAND_ID                           AS ENG_DEMAND_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 1, '##')    AS DEMAND_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 1, '::')    AS DEMAND_ITEM_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 2, '::')    AS PROJECT_CODE
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 3, '::')    AS ENG_SITE_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 3, '::'), 1, '~') AS SALES_SITE_ID
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 3, '::'), 2, '~') AS INCOTERMS
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 4, '::')    AS DOM_EXP
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 5, '::')    AS FCST_TYPE
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 6, '::')    AS DEMAND_TYPE
     , FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 7, '::')    AS YYYYMMDD
     , CASE FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 8, '::'), 1, '^'), 1, '##')
            WHEN 'NOPLANT' THEN '-'
            ELSE FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(FN_SCM_SPLIT(PI.DEMAND_ID, 8, '::'), 1, '^'), 1, '##') END AS PLANT_SITE_ID
     , 'DO'                                   AS DESCR
     , PI.STOCK_PLAN_LOT_ID                   AS STOCK_PLAN_LOT_ID
     , NULL                                   AS LPST
  FROM SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN PI
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND ((PI.TO_DELIVERY_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL AND PI.BOD_ID IS NOT NULL AND PI.FROM_SITE_ID <> PI.TO_SITE_ID)
     OR (PI.PEGGING_TYPE = 'ALLOCATION'))
   AND PI.FROM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL
   AND PI.DEMAND_ID <> 'UNPEGGING'

NAME: SCP_PLN_PRODUCTION_PLAN_V
TEXT:
SELECT WO.MASTER_ID
     , WO.OUT_VERSION_ID
     , WO.PLAN_ID
     , WO.PLAN_TYPE
     , WO.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , WO.SEQ
     , WO.DIVISION_ID
     , WO.OPERATION_GROUP
     , WO.SITE_ID
     , WO.ITEM_ID
     , WO.RESOURCE_ID
     , WO.OPERATION_ID
     , (CASE WO.PEGGING_TYPE WHEN 'WORK_ORDER' THEN TO_CHAR(WO.START_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD')
                             ELSE TO_CHAR(WO.END_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD')
        END) AS YYYYMMDD, /* 생산계획:start_time / 출하계획:end_time */
       (CASE WO.PEGGING_TYPE WHEN 'WORK_ORDER' THEN WO.COMPLETE_QTY
                             ELSE WO.OPERATION_QTY
        END) AS QTY, /* 생산계획:complete_qty / 출하계획:operation_qty */
       WO.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
     , WO.ELECTRODE_TYPE
FROM   SCP_PLN_PRODUCTION_PLAN WO
       INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION DM
          ON  1 = 1
          AND DM.DIVISION_ID = WO.DIVISION_ID
          AND DM.VALID_YN = 'Y'
WHERE  1 = 1
   AND (SUBSTR(WO.OPERATION_ID, 1, 5) IN (SELECT SEGMENT1
                                          FROM   SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                          WHERE  LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION')
        OR (WO.OPERATION_ID = 'P5000'
            AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                        FROM   SCM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V A
                        INNER JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V B ON A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
                        WHERE  A.ITEM_ID = WO.ITEM_ID
                        AND    A.IS_YN = 'Y'))
        OR (CASE WHEN INSTR(WO.OPERATION_ID, '_') > 0
                 THEN SUBSTR(WO.OPERATION_ID, 1, FN_CHARINDEX_REV(WO.OPERATION_ID, '_', 0) - 1)
                 ELSE WO.OPERATION_ID
            END) IN (SELECT S.PLANT_ID
                     FROM   SCM_MST_SITE S
                     WHERE  1 = 1
                     AND    S.DIVISION_ID = CASE WHEN DM.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE'
                                                 THEN WO.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
                                                 ELSE WO.DIVISION_ID
                                            END
                     AND    S.SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                     AND    S.OSP_YN = 'Y'
                     AND    S.VALID_YN = 'Y')
       )
   AND SUBSTR(WO.OPERATION_ID, 1, 5) NOT IN ('F1000', 'F6000')

NAME: SCP_PLN_PROD_PLAN_TARGET_V
TEXT:
SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , A.PLAN_TYPE
     , A.SEQ
     , A.DIVISION_ID || '^' || A.SITE_ID || '^' || TO_CHAR(A.END_TIME,'YYYYMMDD') || '^' || A.ITEM_ID || '^' || A.RESOURCE_ID || '^' || A.OPERATION_ID || '^' || C.FCST_TYPE || '^'
       || (CASE WHEN D.SITE_ID = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCP_PLN_PROD_PLAN_TARGET_V','WarrantyPlant') THEN C.DOM_EXP ELSE 'D' END ) || '^'
       || (CASE WHEN ENG_DEMAND_ID = 'UNPEGGING' THEN '-'
                ELSE SUBSTR(ENG_DEMAND_ID, 1, INSTR(ENG_DEMAND_ID, '::')-1)
           END)                    AS TARGET_ID
     , A.ITEM_ID
     , FN_GET_ITEM_NICKNAME( A.DIVISION_ID, A.ITEM_ID )
                                    AS NICK_NAME
     , A.OPERATION_GROUP
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.SITE_ID
     , ( SELECT ( CASE OSP_YN  WHEN 'Y' THEN SA.LOGISTIC_PLANT_ID
                               ELSE SA.PLANT_ID
                  END )
           FROM SCM_MST_SITE SA
          WHERE 1 = 1
            AND SA.SCM_SITE_ID = A.SITE_ID
            AND ROWNUM = 1
       )                           AS PLANT_ID
     , ( SELECT BASIS_YYYYMMDD
           FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M SB
          WHERE ISO_YYYYWW IN (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW
                                 FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                                WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = TO_CHAR(A.END_TIME,'YYYYMMDD')
                              )
            AND DAYOFWEEK = 'MON'
       )                           AS PROD_WEEK
     , ( SELECT BASIS_START_DATE
           FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CM
          WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = TO_CHAR(A.END_TIME,'YYYYMMDD')
       )                           AS PROD_PARTIAL_WEEK
     , TO_CHAR(A.END_TIME,'YYYYMMDD')
                                    AS YYYYMMDD
     , ROUND(SUM(NVL(C.ALLOCATION_QTY,0) * (A.OPERATION_QTY / A.COMPLETE_QTY )),4)
                                    AS PROD_IN_QTY
     , ROUND(SUM(NVL(C.ALLOCATION_QTY,0)),0)
                                    AS PROD_QTY
     , ROUND(SUM(NVL(C.ALLOCATION_QTY,0)),4)
                                    AS PROD_QTY_MRP
     , C.FCST_TYPE                  AS FCST_TYPE
     , A.RESOURCE_ID                AS PRODUCTION_LINE
     , MAX(C.ENG_DEMAND_PRIORITY)
                                    AS PRIORITY
     , ( CASE WHEN D.SITE_ID = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCP_PLN_PROD_PLAN_TARGET_V','WarrantyPlant') THEN C.DOM_EXP
              ELSE 'D'
         END )                     AS DOM_EXP
     , A.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID         AS ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
     , 'SCP'                        AS CREATE_USER_ID
     , SYSDATE                      AS CREATE_DATE
     , 'SCP'                        AS MODIFY_USER_ID
     , SYSDATE                      AS MODIFY_DATE
     , CASE WHEN ENG_DEMAND_ID = 'UNPEGGING' THEN '-'
            ELSE SUBSTR(ENG_DEMAND_ID, 1, INSTR(ENG_DEMAND_ID, '::')-1)
       END                          AS DEMAND_ITEM
  FROM SCP_PLN_PRODUCTION_PLAN           A
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION                  B
     , SCP_PLN_PRODUCTION_PLAN_PEGGING   C
     , SCM_MST_SITE                      D
 WHERE B.DIVISION_ID              = A.DIVISION_ID
   AND C.DIVISION_ID(+)           = A.DIVISION_ID
   AND C.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD(+)   = A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
   AND C.PLAN_TYPE(+)             = A.PLAN_TYPE
   AND C.SEQ(+)                   = A.SEQ
   AND C.WORK_ORDER_ID(+)         = A.WORK_ORDER_ID
   AND D.DIVISION_ID(+)           = A.DIVISION_ID
   AND D.SCM_SITE_ID(+)           = A.SITE_ID
   AND B.VALID_YN                 = 'Y'
   AND ( SUBSTR(A.OPERATION_ID,1,5) IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID
                                          FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                         WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION' )
         OR (
             A.OPERATION_ID = 'P5000'
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1
                           FROM SCM_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V   EA
                              , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM_V   EB
                          WHERE EA.ITEM_ID = EB.ITEM_ID
                            AND EA.ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
                            AND EA.IS_YN = 'Y'
                        )
            )
         OR (CASE WHEN INSTR(A.OPERATION_ID, '_') > 0 THEN (SUBSTR(A.OPERATION_ID, 1, FN_CHARINDEX_REV(A.OPERATION_ID, '_', 0)-1)) ELSE A.OPERATION_ID END) IN (SELECT PLANT_ID AS OPERATION_ID
                                          FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                                         WHERE 1 = 1
                                           AND SITE_TYPE = 'PLANT'
                                           AND OSP_YN = 'Y'
                                       )
       )
   AND SUBSTR(A.OPERATION_ID,1,5) NOT IN ( 'F1000','F6000' )
   AND A.COMPLETE_QTY >= 1.0
   AND (B.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE'
        OR
        (B.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE' AND A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E'))
 GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
        , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
        , A.PLAN_TYPE
        , A.SEQ
        , A.ITEM_ID
        , A.OPERATION_GROUP
        , A.OPERATION_ID
        , A.SITE_ID
        , TO_CHAR(A.END_TIME,'YYYYMMDD')
        , C.FCST_TYPE
        , A.RESOURCE_ID
        , A.DIVISION_ID
        , ( CASE WHEN D.SITE_ID = FN_GET_LOOKUP_VALUE('SCP_PLN_PROD_PLAN_TARGET_V','WarrantyPlant') THEN C.DOM_EXP ELSE 'D' END )
        , A.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
        , CASE WHEN ENG_DEMAND_ID = 'UNPEGGING' THEN '-'
               ELSE SUBSTR(ENG_DEMAND_ID, 1, INSTR(ENG_DEMAND_ID, '::')-1)
          END
HAVING ROUND(SUM(NVL(C.ALLOCATION_QTY,0)),0) >= 1

NAME: SCP_PLN_SHIP_PLAN_TARGET_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/****************************************************************************
  * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : SCP_PLN_SHIP_PLAN_TARGET_V
  * DESCRIPTION   : FP용 SHIP TARGET VIEW
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018-03-28   YYDOK        INITIAL
  * 2018-05-02   YYDOK        주초월요일 날짜 가져오는 부분을 수정
  * 2018-07-02   YYDOK        소형 packer에 대하여 item id 12번째자리를 packer site의 suffix정보로 변경처리로직반영
  *                           EE 사업부인 경우,셀계획 제외처리,ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
  * 2018-07-26   YYDOK        SHIP_TO_PARTY, RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD 추가반영
  * 2018-08-15   YYDOK        EE에 대해서,SHIP_ID,DEST_PLANT_ID,DESTINATION_SITE_TYPE,CUSTOMER누락조치(DIVISION_ID -> ORIGIN FROM/TO DIVISION ID)
  * 2018.8.20    YYDOK        SHIP TO CODE 추가
  * 2020.09.14   KSG          C20200911-000156 법인간 거래 Incoterms에 의한 SCP_PLN_SHIP_PLAN_TARGET_V 변경 건
  *                              RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD_SSP 추가
  * 2021.04.23   KSG          C20210422-000470 개별 이동 계획 Project Code 추가를 위한, Veiw 수정 요청건
  * 2021.07.09   sclee        [PJ20209643] LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) : SCP_MST_BOD_V에서 SCP_MST_BOD_N_V로 변경
  * 2022-03-23   KSG          PJ20216891 Digital SCM 3 Level 가속화를 위한 개선 : GM JV 가상 Division
  * 2023-04-04   HRK          PJ20230691R  LGES SCM 역량 강화 위한 SCP 개선과제 이행 : HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응
  * 2026.07.06   ZIONEX      [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
  ****************************************************************************/
       P.DIVISION_ID
     , P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , P.PLAN_TYPE
     , P.SEQ
     , P.DIVISION_ID || '^' || P.ITEM_ID || '^' || P.FROM_SITE || '^' || P.TO_SITE || '^' || P.YYYYMMDD || '^' || P.TRANSPORT_MODE
         || '^' || ( CASE PP.FCST_TYPE WHEN '-' THEN 'MPS' ELSE PP.FCST_TYPE END )
         || '^' || ( CASE PP.DOM_EXP WHEN '-' THEN 'D' ELSE PP.DOM_EXP END )
         || '^' || NVL(PP.PROJECT_CODE, '-')   /* 20210423 C20210422-000470 추가 */
                                              AS SHIP_ID
     /*   , (CASE WHEN ( P.DIVISION_ID='40' AND P.OPERATION_GROUP ='P' ) THEN FN_GET_MOBILE_PACKER_ITEM_ID( P.DIVISION_ID, P.FROM_SITE, P.ITEM_ID )
                 ELSE  P.ITEM_ID
           END )                              AS ITEM_ID */
     , P.ITEM_ID                              AS ITEM_ID
     , P.OPERATION_GROUP                      AS OPERATION_GROUP
     , P.FROM_SITE                            AS FROM_SITE
     , ( SELECT PLANT_ID
           FROM SCM_MST_SITE
          WHERE DIVISION_ID = P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
            AND SCM_SITE_ID = P.FROM_SITE
            AND ROWNUM = 1 )                  AS PLANT_ID
     , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_CODE')        AS CUSTOMER_CODE
     , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION') AS CUSTOMER_NAME
     , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_CODE')        AS SHIP_TO_CODE
     , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION')  AS SHIP_TO_PARTY
     , P.TO_SITE                              AS TO_SITE
     , ( SELECT PLANT_ID
           FROM SCM_MST_SITE
          WHERE DIVISION_ID = P.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
            AND SCM_SITE_ID = P.TO_SITE
            AND ROWNUM = 1 )                  AS TO_PLANT_ID
     , ( SELECT SITE_TYPE
           FROM SCM_MST_SITE
          WHERE DIVISION_ID = P.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
            AND SCM_SITE_ID = P.TO_SITE
            AND ROWNUM = 1 )                  AS TO_SITE_TYPE
     , ( SELECT BASIS_YYYYMMDD
           FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M CM
          WHERE ISO_YYYYWW IN (SELECT ISO_YYYYWW
                                 FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M
                                WHERE BASIS_YYYYMMDD = P.YYYYMMDD )
            AND DAYOFWEEK = 'MON'
         )                                    AS SHIP_WEEK
     , P.YYYYMMDD                             AS SHIP_YYYYMMDD
     , MAX(TO_CHAR(P.END_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD'))   AS RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD
     /* 20200914 C20200911-000156 RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD_SSP 추가 */
     , CASE WHEN BOD.LT_TOTAL_SSP IS NULL THEN MAX(TO_CHAR(P.END_TIME, 'YYYYMMDD'))
            ELSE MAX(TO_CHAR(P.START_TIME + BOD.LT_TOTAL_SSP, 'YYYYMMDD'))
       END                                    AS RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD_SSP
     , ROUND(SUM(PP.ALLOCATION_QTY), 0)       AS SHIP_QTY
     /*  , PP.FCST_TYPE                       AS FCST_TYPE */
     , ( CASE PP.FCST_TYPE WHEN '-' THEN 'MPS'
              ELSE PP.FCST_TYPE
         END )                                AS FCST_TYPE
     , P.TRANSPORT_MODE                       AS TRANSPORT_MODE
     , MAX(PP.ENG_DEMAND_PRIORITY)            AS PRIORITY
     /*  , PP.DOM_EXP                         AS DOM_EXP */
     , ( CASE PP.DOM_EXP WHEN '-' THEN 'D'
              ELSE PP.DOM_EXP
         END )                                AS DOM_EXP
     , P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID              AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
     , P.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID                AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
     , 'SCP'                                  AS CREATE_USER_ID
     , SYSDATE                                AS CREATE_DATE
     , 'SCP'                                  AS MODIFY_USER_ID
     , SYSDATE                                AS MODIFY_DATE
     , NVL(PP.PROJECT_CODE, '-')              AS PROJECT_CODE   /* 20210423 C20210422-000470 추가 */
  FROM SCP_PLN_SHIPMENT_PLAN P
       INNER JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D   /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
          ON D.DIVISION_ID = P.DIVISION_ID
         AND D.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
       LEFT JOIN SCP_PLN_SHIPMENT_PLAN_PEGGING PP
          ON P.DIVISION_ID         = PP.DIVISION_ID
         AND P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = PP.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
         AND P.PLAN_TYPE           = PP.PLAN_TYPE
         AND P.SEQ                 = PP.SEQ
         AND P.ORDER_ID            = PP.ORDER_ID
       /* 20200914 C20200911-000156 RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD_SSP 추가 */
       LEFT JOIN SCP_MST_BOD_N_V BOD   /* 20210709 PJ20209643 SCP_MST_BOD_V 에서 SCP_MST_BOD_N_V로 변경 */
          ON P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID = BOD.DIVISION_ID
         AND P.BOD_ID                 = BOD.BOD_ID
         AND BOD.BOD_VALID_YN         = 'Y'
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND (D.ATTRIBUTE3 != 'EE'   /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
        OR
        (D.ATTRIBUTE3 = 'EE' AND P.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E')   /* PJ20230691R HM JV 가상 사업부 추가 대응 */
       )
   AND P.MEASURE   = 'SHIP_PLAN'
   AND P.FROM_SITE <> P.TO_SITE
     /*AND ( ( P.DIVISION_ID <> 'EE' ) OR ( P.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' AND P.OPERATION_GROUP <> 'A' )) */
     /* HM JV 대응 AND ( ( P.DIVISION_ID IN ('81','82','40','81_UC') )                     20220323 PJ20216891 GM JV 추가
        HM JV 대응    OR ( P.DIVISION_ID IN ('EE', 'EE_UC') AND P.OPERATION_GROUP = 'E' )  20220323 PJ20216891 GM JV 추가
        HM JV 대응     ) */
 GROUP BY
       P.DIVISION_ID
     , P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , P.PLAN_TYPE
     , P.SEQ
     , P.ITEM_ID
     , P.OPERATION_GROUP
     , P.FROM_SITE
     , P.TO_SITE
     , P.YYYYMMDD
     , PP.FCST_TYPE
     , P.TRANSPORT_MODE
     , PP.DOM_EXP
     , P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID
     , P.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID
     , BOD.LT_TOTAL_SSP   /* 20200914 C20200911-000156 RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD_SSP 추가 */
     , NVL(PP.PROJECT_CODE, '-')   /* 20210423 C20210422-000470 추가 */
 HAVING ROUND(SUM(PP.ALLOCATION_QTY), 0) >= 1

NAME: SCP_XLS_CELL_PROD_LINE_V
TEXT:
WITH CELL_ITEM_LIST AS
   ( SELECT DISTINCT
/*
 * Program ID   : SCP_XLS_CELL_PROD_Line_V
 * Description  : SCP_ANL_TACT_TIME 정보와 SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_SMALL_CELL를 ITEM_ID별로 비교하여 Line 정보를 보여줌
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2019. 03. 19  KTH            Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2019.04.08    KTH            LINE LOAD율 수정
 * 2025.08.01    hrkim          PJ20257329 최적화 Planning Input Constraint UI 개발 및 Master Validation 확산 : Cell 완성 공정 하드코딩 변경
 * 2026.07.06    ZIONEX         [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
            CELL_ITEM_ID
       FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_SMALL_CELL
      WHERE 0 = 0
        AND DIVISION_ID = '40'
        AND MEASURE     = 'PROD' )
   , OPERATION_LIST AS
   ( SELECT DISTINCT SEGMENT1   AS OPERATION_ID
       FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
      WHERE 1 = 1
        AND LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION'
        AND SEGMENT3    = 'A'      /* 공정그룹(Cell) */
        AND ATTRIBUTE1  = 'Y' )    /* A3000/A9000 Cell Assembly/Packaging 공정 (SCP가 생산계획을 수립하는 Cell Final공정) */
SELECT DISTINCT A.DIVISION_ID, A.PLANT_SITE_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ITEM_ID
  FROM SCP_MST_TACT_TIME A
     , CELL_ITEM_LIST     B
     , OPERATION_LIST     C
 WHERE 0 = 0
   AND B.CELL_ITEM_ID = A.ITEM_ID
   AND C.OPERATION_ID = A.OPERATION_ID
   AND A.DIVISION_ID  = '40'
MINUS
SELECT DISTINCT DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, PROD_LINE, CELL_ITEM_ID
  FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_SMALL_CELL
 WHERE 0 = 0
   AND DIVISION_ID = '40'
   AND MEASURE     = 'PROD'

 * Program ID   : SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_Cell_V
 * Description  : ESS 시물레이션 가동율 계산을 위한 VIEW
 * EXEC  :
           SELECT *
            FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_Cell_V WITH (NOLOCK)
            ORDER BY OPERATION_GROUP DESC,FROM_SITE,OPERATION_ID,PROD_LINE, SORT_ORDER_NO, XLS_KEY1
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2019.09.04  KTH      Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2019.12.03  KTH      TACT_TIME 조건변경(TACT_TIME값이 NULL이 아닌 가장 최근일자 값)
 * 2020.02.06  KTH      ESS 외주 Line별 생산 Target 관련 OSP_YN로직 수정
 * 2020.02.25  KTH      시물레이션 CELL,PACK 분리로 VIEW 이름 변경( SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_V --> SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_Cell_V)
 * 2021.05.20  KSW      PJ20209642 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선' - 중장기 대응
 * 2026.07.06  ZIONEX   [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */  'P'   AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'PACK_TOTAL_TIME'   AS MEASURE, 'Total Time'      AS MEASURE_LABEL, '165'   AS SORT_ORDER_NO   FROM DUAL
     UNION ALL
     SELECT 'P'   AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'PACK_PROD_LOAD'    AS MEASURE, 'Load Ratio(%)'   AS MEASURE_LABEL, '170'   AS SORT_ORDER_NO   FROM DUAL
     UNION ALL
     SELECT 'A'   AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'CELL_TOTAL_TIME'   AS MEASURE, 'Total Time'      AS MEASURE_LABEL, '495'   AS SORT_ORDER_NO   FROM DUAL
     UNION ALL
     SELECT 'A'   AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'CELL_PROD_LOAD'    AS MEASURE, 'Load Ratio(%)'   AS MEASURE_LABEL, '500'   AS SORT_ORDER_NO   FROM DUAL )
       /* OSP가 아닌거나, OSP 이면서 Line Capa 비대상 */
       SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
            , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            , A.PLAN_TYPE
            , A.SEQ
            , A.OPERATION_GROUP
            , A.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
            , A.FROM_SITE
            , NVL((SELECT SA.SITE_DESCRIPTION
                            FROM SCM_MST_SITE SA
                           WHERE SA.SCM_SITE_ID = A.FROM_SITE
                             AND ROWNUM = 1), '/')   AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
            , A.ATTRIBUTE9   AS OPERATION_ID
            , A.ITEM_ID
            , A.NICK_NAME
            , A.PROD_LINE
            , (CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' THEN 0 ELSE B.DAILY_CAPA_QTY END)   AS DAILY_CAPA_QTY
            , (CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'P' THEN (1440*60.0) / NVL(B.DAILY_CAPA_QTY, 1)
                    WHEN A.OPERATION_GROUP = 'A' THEN (SELECT TACT_TIME
                                                         FROM (SELECT E.TACT_TIME
                                                                    , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID, OPERATION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, LINE_ID, ITEM_ID ORDER BY YYYYMMDD DESC)   AS RN
                                                                    , DIVISION_ID, OPERATION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, LINE_ID, ITEM_ID
                                                                 FROM SCP_ANL_TACT_TIME E
                                                                WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
                                                                  AND A.ATTRIBUTE9  = E.OPERATION_ID
                                                                  AND A.FROM_SITE   = E.SCM_SITE_ID
                                                                  AND A.PROD_LINE   = E.LINE_ID
                                                                  AND A.ITEM_ID     = E.ITEM_ID
                                                                  AND E.TACT_TIME   IS NOT NULL) Z
                                                        WHERE Z.RN = 1
                                                          AND ROWNUM = 1)
                    ELSE B.DAILY_CAPA_QTY END)   AS TACT_TIME
            , A.MEASURE
            , A.MEASURE_LABEL
            , A.SORT_ORDER_NO
            , A.XLS_KEY1
