            , X.NICK_NAME
            , X.FROM_BOH_QTY
            , X.YIELD
            , X.CELL_QTY_PACK
            , X.TO_SITE
            , X.MEASURE
            , X.MEASURE_LABEL
            , X.SORT_ORDER_NO

              /* 2021.04.07  KSW      C20210323-000513 - GSCM 시뮬레이터의 라인 가동율 정확도 향상을 위한 로직 변경 건 - start */
              /* 원래 키값으로 복원 : 저장 안되는 문제해결 */
            , X.XLS_KEY1
              /* 2021.04.07  KSW      C20210323-000513 - GSCM 시뮬레이터의 라인 가동율 정확도 향상을 위한 로직 변경 건 - end */
            , X.ATTRIBUTE3   /* PJ20209643 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - BOD L/T 2단계 */
            , X.BOD_ID   /* PJ20209643 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - BOD L/T 2단계 */
            , X.ATTRIBUTE6   /* DC LINK 적용 */

            , X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            , X.PLAN_TYPE
            , X.SEQ
            , X.OPERATION_GROUP
            , X.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
            , Y.FROM_SITE
            , NVL((SELECT SA.SITE_DESCRIPTION FROM SCM_MST_SITE SA WHERE SA.SCM_SITE_ID = Y.FROM_SITE AND ROWNUM = 1) , '/') AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
            , X.ATTRIBUTE9 AS OPERATION_ID
            , X.CELL_ITEM_ID
            , X.ITEM_ID
            , X.NICK_NAME
            , X.PROD_LINE
            , NULL AS DAILY_CAPA_QTY
            , NULL AS TACT_TIME
            , X.FROM_BOH_QTY
            , X.YIELD
            , X.LT_DAY
            , X.CELL_QTY_PACK
            , NULL AS TO_SITE
            , NULL AS TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
            , X.BOD_ID   /* PJ20209643 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - BOD L/T 2단계 */
            , X.MEASURE
            , X.MEASURE_LABEL
            , X.SORT_ORDER_NO
            , 9999999 AS XLS_KEY1
            , WQTY01,WQTY02,WQTY03,WQTY04,WQTY05,WQTY06,WQTY07,WQTY08,WQTY09,WQTY10
            , WQTY11,WQTY12,WQTY13,WQTY14,WQTY15,WQTY16,WQTY17,WQTY18,WQTY19,WQTY20
            , WQTY21,WQTY22,WQTY23,WQTY24,WQTY25,WQTY26,WQTY27,WQTY28,WQTY29,WQTY30
            , WQTY31,WQTY32,WQTY33,WQTY34,WQTY35,WQTY36,WQTY37,WQTY38,WQTY39,WQTY40
            , WQTY41,WQTY42,WQTY43,WQTY44,WQTY45,WQTY46,WQTY47,WQTY48,WQTY49,WQTY50
            , WQTY51,WQTY52
            , X.ATTRIBUTE3   /* PJ20209643 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - BOD L/T 2단계 */
            , X.ATTRIBUTE6   /* DC LINK 적용 */
              /* PJ20209642 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 - 중장기 플랜 대응 */
         FROM (SELECT Y1.DIVISION_ID
                    , Y1.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
                    , Y1.PLAN_TYPE
                    , Y1.SEQ
                    , Y1.OPERATION_GROUP
                    , Y1.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
                    , Y1.FROM_SITE
                    , Y1.ATTRIBUTE9 AS OPERATION_ID
                    , Y1.CELL_ITEM_ID
                    , Y1.ITEM_ID
                    , Y1.NICK_NAME
                    , Y1.PROD_LINE
                    , Y1.FROM_BOH_QTY
                    , Y1.YIELD
                    , Y1.LT_DAY
                    , Y1.CELL_QTY_PACK
                    , Y1.TO_SITE
                    , Y1.MEASURE
                    , Y1.MEASURE_LABEL
                    , Y1.SORT_ORDER_NO
                    , Y1.XLS_KEY1
                    , Y1.ATTRIBUTE9
                    , Y1.ATTRIBUTE3   /* PJ20209643 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - BOD L/T 2단계 */
                    , Y1.BOD_ID   /* PJ20209643 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - BOD L/T 2단계 */
                    , Y1.ATTRIBUTE6

                    , Y1.WQTY01,Y1.WQTY02,Y1.WQTY03,Y1.WQTY04,Y1.WQTY05,Y1.WQTY06,Y1.WQTY07,Y1.WQTY08,Y1.WQTY09,Y1.WQTY10
                    , Y1.WQTY11,Y1.WQTY12,Y1.WQTY13,Y1.WQTY14,Y1.WQTY15,Y1.WQTY16,Y1.WQTY17,Y1.WQTY18,Y1.WQTY19,Y1.WQTY20
                    , Y1.WQTY21,Y1.WQTY22,Y1.WQTY23,Y1.WQTY24,Y1.WQTY25,Y1.WQTY26,Y1.WQTY27,Y1.WQTY28,Y1.WQTY29,Y1.WQTY30
                    , Y1.WQTY31,Y1.WQTY32,Y1.WQTY33,Y1.WQTY34,Y1.WQTY35,Y1.WQTY36,Y1.WQTY37,Y1.WQTY38,Y1.WQTY39,Y1.WQTY40
                    , Y1.WQTY41,Y1.WQTY42,Y1.WQTY43,Y1.WQTY44,Y1.WQTY45,Y1.WQTY46,Y1.WQTY47,Y1.WQTY48,Y1.WQTY49,Y1.WQTY50
                    , Y1.WQTY51,Y1.WQTY52
                 FROM (SELECT *
                         FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS AA
                        WHERE CREATE_FROM_YYYYMMDD = (SELECT PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD FROM PLAN_NAME)   /* (SELECT TOP 1 PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS WITH (NOLOCK)) */
                      ) Y1
              ) X
            , (SELECT DISTINCT FROM_SITE, CELL_ITEM_ID
                 FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS A1
                    , (SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID
                         FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS
                        WHERE 0 = 0
                          AND CREATE_FROM_YYYYMMDD = (SELECT PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD FROM PLAN_NAME)   /* (SELECT TOP 1 PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS WITH (NOLOCK)) */
                          AND MEASURE ='SEMI_PACK_PROD_CELL'
                      ) A2
                WHERE A1.CELL_ITEM_ID = A2.ITEM_ID
                  AND CREATE_FROM_YYYYMMDD =  (SELECT PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD FROM PLAN_NAME)   /* (SELECT TOP 1 PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS WITH (NOLOCK)) */
                  AND OPERATION_GROUP ='P'
                  /* ★아래 옛 MSSQL 죽은코드 블록(원문 verbatim 보존)
            --             AND CELL_ITEM_ID IN (
												--SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID
												--FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS WITH (NOLOCK)
												--WHERE 0 = 0
												-- AND CREATE_FROM_YYYYMMDD =  (SELECT TOP 1 PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS WITH (NOLOCK))
												-- AND MEASURE ='SEMI_PACK_PROD_CELL'
            --                                 )
                  */
                  AND FROM_SITE <> '-'
              ) Y
        WHERE 0 = 0
          AND X.ITEM_ID = Y.CELL_ITEM_ID
          AND X.MEASURE ='SEMI_PACK_PROD_CELL'

NAME: SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_PACK_V2
TEXT:
WITH SUB AS
(
  SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_PACK_V2
 * Description  : ESS 시물레이션 가동율 계산을 위한 VIEW
 * EXEC  :
           SELECT *
            FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_PACK_V2 WITH (NOLOCK)
            ORDER BY OPERATION_GROUP DESC,FROM_SITE,OPERATION_ID,PROD_LINE, SORT_ORDER_NO, XLS_KEY1
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2019.09.04  KTH      Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2019.12.03  KTH      TACT_TIME 조건변경(TACT_TIME값이 NULL이 아닌 가장 최근일자 값)
 * 2020.02.06  KTH      ESS 외주 Line별 생산 Target 관련 OSP_YN로직 수정
 * 2020.02.21  KTH      PACK/CELL 분리 작업 반영으로 전체 로직 변경함.
 * 2020.02.25  KTH      시물레이션 CELL,PACK 분리로 VIEW 이름 변경( SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_V --> SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_PACK_V)
 * 2020.03.03  KTH      CELL_ITEM_ID 추가
 * 2020.03.04  KTH      SEMI_PACK_PROD_CELL FROM_SITE로직 반영
 * 2020.03.11  KTH      [C20200311-000042] ESS Pack Simulator 관련 개선 요청의 건 (SEMI_SHIP_PLAN에 TO_SITE 추가, 중복제거)
 * 2020.04.23  KTH      SEMI_SHIP_PLAN. SUM(X.LT_DAY) --> MAX(X.LT_DAY) 변경
 * 2020.06.24  KTH      [전지 공급 대응력 향상을 위한 RTF 적확도 개선] : GSCM 시스템의 보류재고 감안한 계획 수립을 위한 시뮬레이션 변경 요청(자동차, ESS)
 * 2021.03.26  KSW      C20210323-000513 - GSCM 시뮬레이터의 라인 가동율 정확도 향상을 위한 로직 변경 건 - Model Change Measure 추가
 * 2021.04.07  KSW      C20210323-000513 - GSCM 시뮬레이터의 라인 가동율 정확도 향상을 위한 로직 변경 건 - 원래 키값으로 복원 : 저장 안되는 문제해결
 * 2021.06.07  KSW      PJ20209642 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 - 중장기 플랜 대응 (단기버전)
 * 2021.12.20  KSW      ESS 운송중 재고 반영
 * 2021.12.27  KSW      DC LINK 적용
 * 2021.04.01  KSW      DC LINK 공용모델 적용
 * 2022.05.19  KSW      PACK_CELL_EOH_TOTAL_SUM  Cell Total measure 추가
 * 2022.10.27  KSW     dc link 복수건 적용
 * 2022.11.16  KSW      쿼리튜닝(속도개선)
 * 2024.03.21  KSK       최초생성( [SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_PACK_V2]
								   ( SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_PACK_V와
								     SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_PACK_BP_V의 통폐합본)
 * 2024.04.04  KSK	   E20240402-000726(ESS 사업부 시뮬레이터 팩재고 불일치 수정)
 * 2026.07.06  ZIONEX   [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */  'P' AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'PACK_TOTAL_TIME'    AS MEASURE, 'Total Time'    AS MEASURE_LABEL , 166 SORT_ORDER_NO FROM DUAL UNION ALL
  SELECT 'P' AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'PACK_PROD_LOAD'     AS MEASURE, 'Load Ratio(%)' AS MEASURE_LABEL , 170 SORT_ORDER_NO FROM DUAL UNION ALL
  SELECT 'A' AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'CELL_TOTAL_TIME'    AS MEASURE, 'Total Time'    AS MEASURE_LABEL , 496 SORT_ORDER_NO FROM DUAL UNION ALL
  SELECT 'A' AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'CELL_MODEL_CHANGE'  AS MEASURE, 'Model Change'  AS MEASURE_LABEL , 497 SORT_ORDER_NO FROM DUAL UNION ALL  /* 2021.03.26  KSW      C20210323-000513 - GSCM 시뮬레이터의 라인 가동율 정확도 향상을 위한 로직 변경 건 - Model Change Measure 추가 */
  SELECT 'A' AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'CELL_PROD_LOAD'     AS MEASURE, 'Load Ratio(%)' AS MEASURE_LABEL , 500 SORT_ORDER_NO FROM DUAL
)
, PLAN_NAME AS
(SELECT PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD,  TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD,'YYYYMMDD') + 364, 'YYYYMMDD')
		AS PLAN2_START_YYYYMMDD  FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS WHERE ROWNUM = 1
)
      /* OSP가 아닌거나, OSP 이면서 Line Capa 비대상 */
      SELECT X.DIVISION_ID
            ,X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            ,X.PLAN_TYPE
            ,X.SEQ
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
            ,X.FROM_SITE
            ,NVL((SELECT M.SITE_DESCRIPTION FROM SCM_MST_SITE M WHERE M.SCM_SITE_ID = X.FROM_SITE AND ROWNUM = 1) , '/') AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
            ,X.ATTRIBUTE9 AS OPERATION_ID
            ,X.CELL_ITEM_ID
            ,X.ITEM_ID
            ,X.NICK_NAME
            ,X.PROD_LINE
            ,(CASE WHEN X.OPERATION_GROUP ='A' THEN 0 ELSE Y.DAILY_CAPA_QTY END) AS DAILY_CAPA_QTY
            ,(CASE WHEN X.OPERATION_GROUP ='P' THEN (1440*60.0) / NVL(Y.DAILY_CAPA_QTY,1)
                   WHEN X.OPERATION_GROUP ='A' THEN (SELECT TACT_TIME
                                                      FROM (
                                                            SELECT E.TACT_TIME
                                                                  , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID,OPERATION_ID,SCM_SITE_ID,LINE_ID,ITEM_ID ORDER BY YYYYMMDD DESC) AS RN
                                                                  ,DIVISION_ID,OPERATION_ID,SCM_SITE_ID,LINE_ID,ITEM_ID
                                                              FROM SCP_ANL_TACT_TIME E
                                                             WHERE X.DIVISION_ID  = E.DIVISION_ID
                                                               AND X.ATTRIBUTE9   = E.OPERATION_ID
				                                               AND X.FROM_SITE    = E.SCM_SITE_ID
                                                               AND X.PROD_LINE    = E.LINE_ID
                                                               AND X.ITEM_ID      = E.ITEM_ID
                                                               AND E.TACT_TIME    IS NOT NULL
                                              ) Z
                                                      WHERE Z.RN = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1
                                                      )
                  ELSE Y.DAILY_CAPA_QTY END) AS TACT_TIME
            ,X.FROM_BOH_QTY
            ,X.YIELD
            ,X.LT_DAY
            ,X.CELL_QTY_PACK
            ,NULL AS TO_SITE
            ,NULL AS TO_SITE_DESCRIPTION
			,X.BOD_ID  /* PJ20209643 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - BOD L/T 2단계 */
            ,X.MEASURE
            ,X.MEASURE_LABEL
            ,X.SORT_ORDER_NO
            ,X.XLS_KEY1

            ,WQTY01,WQTY02,WQTY03,WQTY04,WQTY05,WQTY06,WQTY07,WQTY08,WQTY09,WQTY10
            ,WQTY11,WQTY12,WQTY13,WQTY14,WQTY15,WQTY16,WQTY17,WQTY18,WQTY19,WQTY20
            ,WQTY21,WQTY22,WQTY23,WQTY24,WQTY25,WQTY26,WQTY27,WQTY28,WQTY29,WQTY30
            ,WQTY31,WQTY32,WQTY33,WQTY34,WQTY35,WQTY36,WQTY37,WQTY38,WQTY39,WQTY40
            ,WQTY41,WQTY42,WQTY43,WQTY44,WQTY45,WQTY46,WQTY47,WQTY48,WQTY49,WQTY50
            ,WQTY51,WQTY52

			/* PJ20209642 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 - 중장기 플랜 대응 */
			,WQTY53, WQTY54, WQTY55, WQTY56, WQTY57, WQTY58, WQTY59, WQTY60, WQTY61, WQTY62
			,WQTY63, WQTY64, WQTY65, WQTY66, WQTY67, WQTY68, WQTY69, WQTY70, WQTY71, WQTY72
			,WQTY73, WQTY74, WQTY75, WQTY76, WQTY77, WQTY78, WQTY79, WQTY80, WQTY81, WQTY82
			,WQTY83, WQTY84, WQTY85, WQTY86, WQTY87, WQTY88, WQTY89, WQTY90, WQTY91, WQTY92  /* 중장기 +1 Year 변경처리 :: 2022.08.11 컬럼활성화 */
			,WQTY93, WQTY94, WQTY95, WQTY96, WQTY97, WQTY98, WQTY99, WQTY100,WQTY101,WQTY102
			,WQTY103,WQTY104

			,X.ATTRIBUTE3  /* PJ20209643 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - BOD L/T 2단계 */
			,X.ATTRIBUTE6  /* DC LINK 적용 */
        FROM (
		      /* PJ20209642 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 - 중장기 플랜 대응 */
		      SELECT Y1.DIVISION_ID
					,Y1.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
					,Y1.PLAN_TYPE
					,Y1.SEQ
					,Y1.OPERATION_GROUP
					,Y1.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
					,Y1.FROM_SITE
					,Y1.ATTRIBUTE9 AS OPERATION_ID
					,Y1.CELL_ITEM_ID
					,Y1.ITEM_ID
					,Y1.NICK_NAME
					,Y1.PROD_LINE
					,Y1.FROM_BOH_QTY
					,Y1.YIELD
					,Y1.LT_DAY
					,Y1.CELL_QTY_PACK
					,Y1.MEASURE
					,Y1.MEASURE_LABEL
					,Y1.SORT_ORDER_NO
					,Y1.XLS_KEY1
					,Y1.ATTRIBUTE9
					,Y1.ATTRIBUTE3  /* PJ20209643 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - BOD L/T 2단계 */
					,Y1.BOD_ID  /* PJ20209643 LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 (Phase.2) - BOD L/T 2단계 */
					,Y1.ATTRIBUTE6

					,Y1.WQTY01,Y1.WQTY02,Y1.WQTY03,Y1.WQTY04,Y1.WQTY05,Y1.WQTY06,Y1.WQTY07,Y1.WQTY08,Y1.WQTY09,Y1.WQTY10
					,Y1.WQTY11,Y1.WQTY12,Y1.WQTY13,Y1.WQTY14,Y1.WQTY15,Y1.WQTY16,Y1.WQTY17,Y1.WQTY18,Y1.WQTY19,Y1.WQTY20
					,Y1.WQTY21,Y1.WQTY22,Y1.WQTY23,Y1.WQTY24,Y1.WQTY25,Y1.WQTY26,Y1.WQTY27,Y1.WQTY28,Y1.WQTY29,Y1.WQTY30
					,Y1.WQTY31,Y1.WQTY32,Y1.WQTY33,Y1.WQTY34,Y1.WQTY35,Y1.WQTY36,Y1.WQTY37,Y1.WQTY38,Y1.WQTY39,Y1.WQTY40
					,Y1.WQTY41,Y1.WQTY42,Y1.WQTY43,Y1.WQTY44,Y1.WQTY45,Y1.WQTY46,Y1.WQTY47,Y1.WQTY48,Y1.WQTY49,Y1.WQTY50
					,Y1.WQTY51,Y1.WQTY52

					,Y2.WQTY01 AS WQTY53, Y2.WQTY02 AS WQTY54, Y2.WQTY03 AS WQTY55, Y2.WQTY04 AS WQTY56, Y2.WQTY05 AS WQTY57
					,Y2.WQTY06 AS WQTY58, Y2.WQTY07 AS WQTY59, Y2.WQTY08 AS WQTY60, Y2.WQTY09 AS WQTY61, Y2.WQTY10 AS WQTY62
					,Y2.WQTY11 AS WQTY63, Y2.WQTY12 AS WQTY64, Y2.WQTY13 AS WQTY65, Y2.WQTY14 AS WQTY66, Y2.WQTY15 AS WQTY67
					,Y2.WQTY16 AS WQTY68, Y2.WQTY17 AS WQTY69, Y2.WQTY18 AS WQTY70, Y2.WQTY19 AS WQTY71, Y2.WQTY20 AS WQTY72
					,Y2.WQTY21 AS WQTY73, Y2.WQTY22 AS WQTY74, Y2.WQTY23 AS WQTY75, Y2.WQTY24 AS WQTY76, Y2.WQTY25 AS WQTY77
					,Y2.WQTY26 AS WQTY78, Y2.WQTY27 AS WQTY79, Y2.WQTY28 AS WQTY80, Y2.WQTY29 AS WQTY81, Y2.WQTY30 AS WQTY82

					/* 중장기 +1 Year 변경처리 :: 2022.08.11 컬럼활성화 */
					,Y2.WQTY31 AS WQTY83, Y2.WQTY32 AS WQTY84, Y2.WQTY33 AS WQTY85, Y2.WQTY34 AS WQTY86, Y2.WQTY35 AS WQTY87
					,Y2.WQTY36 AS WQTY88, Y2.WQTY37 AS WQTY89, Y2.WQTY38 AS WQTY90, Y2.WQTY39 AS WQTY91, Y2.WQTY40 AS WQTY92
					,Y2.WQTY41 AS WQTY93, Y2.WQTY42 AS WQTY94, Y2.WQTY43 AS WQTY95, Y2.WQTY44 AS WQTY96, Y2.WQTY45 AS WQTY97
					,Y2.WQTY46 AS WQTY98, Y2.WQTY47 AS WQTY99, Y2.WQTY48 AS WQTY100,Y2.WQTY49 AS WQTY101,Y2.WQTY50 AS WQTY102
					,Y2.WQTY51 AS WQTY103,Y2.WQTY52 AS WQTY104
					, Y1.CREATE_FROM_YYYYMMDD
		        FROM  SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS Y1
				CROSS JOIN PLAN_NAME PN
				LEFT JOIN SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS Y2
					ON Y1.XLS_KEY1 = Y2.XLS_KEY1
					AND  Y1.CREATE_FROM_YYYYMMDD = PN.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
					AND  Y2.CREATE_FROM_YYYYMMDD = PN.PLAN2_START_YYYYMMDD
			 ) X
       LEFT OUTER  JOIN SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA Y
          ON X.DIVISION_ID = Y.DIVISION_ID
         AND X.ITEM_ID    = Y.ITEM_ID
         AND X.FROM_SITE  = Y.PLANT_SITE_ID
/* AND X.PROD_LINE  = Y.LINE_ID */

						,Y1.WQTY01,Y1.WQTY02,Y1.WQTY03,Y1.WQTY04,Y1.WQTY05,Y1.WQTY06,Y1.WQTY07,Y1.WQTY08,Y1.WQTY09,Y1.WQTY10
						,Y1.WQTY11,Y1.WQTY12,Y1.WQTY13,Y1.WQTY14,Y1.WQTY15,Y1.WQTY16,Y1.WQTY17,Y1.WQTY18,Y1.WQTY19,Y1.WQTY20
						,Y1.WQTY21,Y1.WQTY22,Y1.WQTY23,Y1.WQTY24,Y1.WQTY25,Y1.WQTY26,Y1.WQTY27,Y1.WQTY28,Y1.WQTY29,Y1.WQTY30
						,Y1.WQTY31,Y1.WQTY32,Y1.WQTY33,Y1.WQTY34,Y1.WQTY35,Y1.WQTY36,Y1.WQTY37,Y1.WQTY38,Y1.WQTY39,Y1.WQTY40
						,Y1.WQTY41,Y1.WQTY42,Y1.WQTY43,Y1.WQTY44,Y1.WQTY45,Y1.WQTY46,Y1.WQTY47,Y1.WQTY48,Y1.WQTY49,Y1.WQTY50
						,Y1.WQTY51,Y1.WQTY52

						,Y2.WQTY01 AS WQTY53, Y2.WQTY02 AS WQTY54, Y2.WQTY03 AS WQTY55, Y2.WQTY04 AS WQTY56, Y2.WQTY05 AS WQTY57
						,Y2.WQTY06 AS WQTY58, Y2.WQTY07 AS WQTY59, Y2.WQTY08 AS WQTY60, Y2.WQTY09 AS WQTY61, Y2.WQTY10 AS WQTY62
						,Y2.WQTY11 AS WQTY63, Y2.WQTY12 AS WQTY64, Y2.WQTY13 AS WQTY65, Y2.WQTY14 AS WQTY66, Y2.WQTY15 AS WQTY67
						,Y2.WQTY16 AS WQTY68, Y2.WQTY17 AS WQTY69, Y2.WQTY18 AS WQTY70, Y2.WQTY19 AS WQTY71, Y2.WQTY20 AS WQTY72
						,Y2.WQTY21 AS WQTY73, Y2.WQTY22 AS WQTY74, Y2.WQTY23 AS WQTY75, Y2.WQTY24 AS WQTY76, Y2.WQTY25 AS WQTY77
						,Y2.WQTY26 AS WQTY78, Y2.WQTY27 AS WQTY79, Y2.WQTY28 AS WQTY80, Y2.WQTY29 AS WQTY81, Y2.WQTY30 AS WQTY82

						/* 중장기 +1 Year 변경처리 :: 2022.08.11 컬럼활성화 */
						,Y2.WQTY31 AS WQTY83, Y2.WQTY32 AS WQTY84, Y2.WQTY33 AS WQTY85, Y2.WQTY34 AS WQTY86, Y2.WQTY35 AS WQTY87
						,Y2.WQTY36 AS WQTY88, Y2.WQTY37 AS WQTY89, Y2.WQTY38 AS WQTY90, Y2.WQTY39 AS WQTY91, Y2.WQTY40 AS WQTY92
						,Y2.WQTY41 AS WQTY93, Y2.WQTY42 AS WQTY94, Y2.WQTY43 AS WQTY95, Y2.WQTY44 AS WQTY96, Y2.WQTY45 AS WQTY97
						,Y2.WQTY46 AS WQTY98, Y2.WQTY47 AS WQTY99, Y2.WQTY48 AS WQTY100,Y2.WQTY49 AS WQTY101,Y2.WQTY50 AS WQTY102
						,Y2.WQTY51 AS WQTY103,Y2.WQTY52 AS WQTY104
					 FROM  SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS Y1
				CROSS JOIN PLAN_NAME PN
				LEFT JOIN SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS Y2
					ON Y1.XLS_KEY1 = Y2.XLS_KEY1
					AND  Y1.CREATE_FROM_YYYYMMDD = PN.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
					AND  Y2.CREATE_FROM_YYYYMMDD = PN.PLAN2_START_YYYYMMDD
					) X
				INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT FROM_SITE,CELL_ITEM_ID
		                FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS
                       WHERE CREATE_FROM_YYYYMMDD = (SELECT PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS WHERE ROWNUM = 1)
					     AND OPERATION_GROUP ='P'
                         AND CELL_ITEM_ID IN (
												SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID
												FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS
												WHERE 0 = 0
												 AND CREATE_FROM_YYYYMMDD = (SELECT PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS WHERE ROWNUM = 1)
												 AND MEASURE ='SEMI_PACK_PROD_CELL'
                                             )
                      AND FROM_SITE <> '-'
                      ) Y
          ON 0 = 0
          AND X.ITEM_ID = Y.CELL_ITEM_ID
          AND X.MEASURE ='SEMI_PACK_PROD_CELL'

NAME: SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_V
TEXT:
WITH SUB AS
(
  
  SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_V
 * Description  : ESS 시물레이션 가동율 계산을 위한 VIEW
 * EXEC  :
           SELECT *
            FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS_LOAD_RATIO_V WITH (NOLOCK)
            ORDER BY OPERATION_GROUP DESC,FROM_SITE,OPERATION_ID,PROD_LINE, SORT_ORDER_NO, XLS_KEY1
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2019.09.04  KTH      Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2019.12.03  KTH      TACT_TIME 조건변경(TACT_TIME값이 NULL이 아닌 가장 최근일자 값)
 * 2020.02.06  KTH      ESS 외주 Line별 생산 Target 관련 OSP_YN로직 수정
 * 2020.02.21  KTH      PACK/CELL 분리 작업 반영으로 전체 로직 변경함.
 * 2026.07.06  ZIONEX   [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */ /* SELECT 'P' AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'PACK_WORKING_TIME'  AS MEASURE, 'Working Time'  AS MEASURE_LABEL , '165' SORT_ORDER_NO UNION ALL */  'P' AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'PACK_TOTAL_TIME'    AS MEASURE, 'Total Time'    AS MEASURE_LABEL , 166 SORT_ORDER_NO FROM DUAL UNION ALL
  SELECT 'P' AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'PACK_PROD_LOAD'     AS MEASURE, 'Load Ratio(%)' AS MEASURE_LABEL , 170 SORT_ORDER_NO FROM DUAL UNION ALL
  SELECT 'A' AS OPERATION_GROUP, 'CELL_PROD_LOAD'       AS MEASURE, 'Load Ratio(%)'         AS MEASURE_LABEL , 500 SORT_ORDER_NO FROM DUAL
)
      /* OSP가 아닌거나, OSP 이면서 Line Capa 비대상 */
      SELECT X.DIVISION_ID
            ,X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            ,X.PLAN_TYPE
            ,X.SEQ
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
            ,X.FROM_SITE
            ,NVL((SELECT M.SITE_DESCRIPTION FROM SCM_MST_SITE M   WHERE M.SCM_SITE_ID = X.FROM_SITE AND ROWNUM = 1) , '/') AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
            ,X.ATTRIBUTE9 AS OPERATION_ID
            ,X.ITEM_ID
            ,X.NICK_NAME
            ,X.PROD_LINE
            ,(CASE WHEN X.OPERATION_GROUP ='A' THEN 0 ELSE Y.DAILY_CAPA_QTY END) AS DAILY_CAPA_QTY
            ,(CASE WHEN X.OPERATION_GROUP ='P' THEN (1440*60.0) / NVL(Y.DAILY_CAPA_QTY,1)
                   WHEN X.OPERATION_GROUP ='A' THEN (SELECT TACT_TIME
                                                      FROM (
                                                            SELECT E.TACT_TIME
                                                                  , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DIVISION_ID,OPERATION_ID,SCM_SITE_ID,LINE_ID,ITEM_ID ORDER BY YYYYMMDD DESC) AS RN
                                                                  ,DIVISION_ID,OPERATION_ID,SCM_SITE_ID,LINE_ID,ITEM_ID
                                                              FROM SCP_ANL_TACT_TIME E
                                                             WHERE X.DIVISION_ID  = E.DIVISION_ID
                                                               AND X.ATTRIBUTE9   = E.OPERATION_ID
				                                               AND X.FROM_SITE    = E.SCM_SITE_ID
                                                               AND X.PROD_LINE    = E.LINE_ID
                                                               AND X.ITEM_ID      = E.ITEM_ID
                                                               AND E.TACT_TIME    IS NOT NULL
                                                            ) Z
                                                      WHERE Z.RN = 1 AND ROWNUM = 1
                                                      )
                  ELSE Y.DAILY_CAPA_QTY END) AS TACT_TIME
            ,X.FROM_BOH_QTY
            ,X.YIELD
            ,X.LT_DAY
            ,X.CELL_QTY_PACK
            ,X.MEASURE
            ,X.MEASURE_LABEL
            ,X.SORT_ORDER_NO
            ,X.XLS_KEY1

            ,WQTY01,WQTY02,WQTY03,WQTY04,WQTY05,WQTY06,WQTY07,WQTY08,WQTY09,WQTY10
            ,WQTY11,WQTY12,WQTY13,WQTY14,WQTY15,WQTY16,WQTY17,WQTY18,WQTY19,WQTY20
            ,WQTY21,WQTY22,WQTY23,WQTY24,WQTY25,WQTY26,WQTY27,WQTY28,WQTY29,WQTY30
            ,WQTY31,WQTY32,WQTY33,WQTY34,WQTY35,WQTY36,WQTY37,WQTY38,WQTY39,WQTY40
            ,WQTY41,WQTY42,WQTY43,WQTY44,WQTY45,WQTY46,WQTY47,WQTY48,WQTY49,WQTY50
            ,WQTY51,WQTY52

        FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS X
       LEFT OUTER  JOIN SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA Y
          ON X.DIVISION_ID = Y.DIVISION_ID
         AND X.ITEM_ID    = Y.ITEM_ID
         AND X.FROM_SITE  = Y.PLANT_SITE_ID
/* AND X.PROD_LINE  = Y.LINE_ID */
        INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S  /* ESS 외주 Line별 생산 Target 관련 OSP_YN로직 수정 */
                ON S.DIVISION_ID              = X.DIVISION_ID
               AND S.SCM_SITE_ID              = X.FROM_SITE
               AND (S.OSP_YN = 'N'
			        OR (S.OSP_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(S.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N') IN ('N',''))
				   )
       WHERE 0 = 0
         AND X.MEASURE IN ('PACK_PROD','CELL_PROD'
                          ,'SEMI_PACK_PROD_CELL'
                          /* ,'PACK_CELL_BOH' */
                          /* ,'PACK_CELL_EOH_TOTAL' */
                          /* ,'PACK_CELL_EOH' */

                          /* ,'SEMI_SHIP_PLAN' */
                          ,'CELL_BOH'
                          ,'CELL_EOH'
                          ,'CELL_SHIP_PLAN_TOTAL'
                          ,'CELL_CHAR_PLAN'
                          ,'CELL_CHAR_AVAILABLE'
                          ,'CELL_FORM_PROGRESS'
                          ,'CELL_FORM_HOLD'
                          ,'CELL_FOR_FORM_END'
                          ,'CELL_PROD_FORM_END'

                          )


      /* ESS 외주 Line별 생산 Target 관련 OSP_YN로직 수정 : OSP 이면서 Line Capa 대상 */
      UNION
         SELECT  X.DIVISION_ID
            ,X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            ,X.PLAN_TYPE
            ,X.SEQ
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
            ,X.FROM_SITE
            ,NVL((SELECT M.SITE_DESCRIPTION FROM SCM_MST_SITE M   WHERE M.SCM_SITE_ID = X.FROM_SITE AND ROWNUM = 1) , '/') AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
            ,X.ATTRIBUTE9 AS OPERATION_ID
            ,X.ITEM_ID
            ,X.NICK_NAME
            ,X.PROD_LINE
            ,(CASE WHEN X.OPERATION_GROUP ='A' THEN 0 ELSE Y.DAILY_CAPACITY END) AS DAILY_CAPA_QTY
            ,(CASE WHEN X.OPERATION_GROUP ='P' THEN Y.TACT_TIME
                   WHEN X.OPERATION_GROUP ='A' THEN Y.TACT_TIME
                  ELSE Y.DAILY_CAPACITY END) AS TACT_TIME
            ,X.FROM_BOH_QTY
            ,X.YIELD
            ,X.LT_DAY
            ,X.CELL_QTY_PACK
            ,X.MEASURE
            ,X.MEASURE_LABEL
            ,X.SORT_ORDER_NO
            ,X.XLS_KEY1

            ,WQTY01,WQTY02,WQTY03,WQTY04,WQTY05,WQTY06,WQTY07,WQTY08,WQTY09,WQTY10
            ,WQTY11,WQTY12,WQTY13,WQTY14,WQTY15,WQTY16,WQTY17,WQTY18,WQTY19,WQTY20
            ,WQTY21,WQTY22,WQTY23,WQTY24,WQTY25,WQTY26,WQTY27,WQTY28,WQTY29,WQTY30
            ,WQTY31,WQTY32,WQTY33,WQTY34,WQTY35,WQTY36,WQTY37,WQTY38,WQTY39,WQTY40
            ,WQTY41,WQTY42,WQTY43,WQTY44,WQTY45,WQTY46,WQTY47,WQTY48,WQTY49,WQTY50
            ,WQTY51,WQTY52
        FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS X
        INNER JOIN SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP Y  /* ESS 외주 Line별 생산 Target 관련 OSP_YN로직 수정 */
                ON X.DIVISION_ID = Y.DIVISION_ID
               AND X.ITEM_ID    = Y.ITEM_ID
               AND X.FROM_SITE  = Y.PLANT_SITE_ID
               AND X.PROD_LINE  = Y.LINE_ID
        INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S
                ON S.DIVISION_ID              = X.DIVISION_ID
               AND S.SCM_SITE_ID              = X.FROM_SITE
               AND S.OSP_YN                   = 'Y'
               AND NVL(S.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N')  = 'Y'
       WHERE 0 = 0
         AND X.MEASURE IN ('PACK_PROD','CELL_PROD'
                          ,'PACK_TACT_TIME'  /* ,'CELL_TACT_TIME' */
                          )
UNION
/* CELL_TACT_TIME */
SELECT  X.DIVISION_ID
            ,X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            ,X.PLAN_TYPE
            ,X.SEQ
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
            ,X.FROM_SITE
            ,NVL((SELECT M.SITE_DESCRIPTION FROM SCM_MST_SITE M   WHERE M.SCM_SITE_ID = X.FROM_SITE AND ROWNUM = 1) , '/') AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
            ,X.ATTRIBUTE9 AS OPERATION_ID
            ,X.ITEM_ID
            ,X.NICK_NAME
            ,X.PROD_LINE
            , 0 AS DAILY_CAPA_QTY
            , 0 AS TACT_TIME
            ,X.FROM_BOH_QTY
            ,X.YIELD
            ,X.LT_DAY
            ,X.CELL_QTY_PACK
            ,X.MEASURE
            ,X.MEASURE_LABEL
            ,X.SORT_ORDER_NO
            ,X.XLS_KEY1

            ,WQTY01,WQTY02,WQTY03,WQTY04,WQTY05,WQTY06,WQTY07,WQTY08,WQTY09,WQTY10
            ,WQTY11,WQTY12,WQTY13,WQTY14,WQTY15,WQTY16,WQTY17,WQTY18,WQTY19,WQTY20
            ,WQTY21,WQTY22,WQTY23,WQTY24,WQTY25,WQTY26,WQTY27,WQTY28,WQTY29,WQTY30
            ,WQTY31,WQTY32,WQTY33,WQTY34,WQTY35,WQTY36,WQTY37,WQTY38,WQTY39,WQTY40
            ,WQTY41,WQTY42,WQTY43,WQTY44,WQTY45,WQTY46,WQTY47,WQTY48,WQTY49,WQTY50
            ,WQTY51,WQTY52
        FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS X
        WHERE 0 = 0
         AND X.MEASURE IN ('CELL_TACT_TIME')
    UNION
/* WORKING TIME */
    SELECT  DISTINCT X.DIVISION_ID
            ,X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            ,X.PLAN_TYPE
            ,X.SEQ
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
            ,X.FROM_SITE
            ,NVL((SELECT M.SITE_DESCRIPTION FROM SCM_MST_SITE M   WHERE M.SCM_SITE_ID = X.FROM_SITE AND ROWNUM = 1) , '/') AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
            ,X.ATTRIBUTE9 AS OPERATION_ID
            ,'-' AS ITEM_ID
            ,'-' AS NICK_NAME
            ,X.PROD_LINE
            ,NULL AS DAILY_CAPA_QTY
            ,NULL AS TACT_TIME
            ,X.FROM_BOH_QTY
            ,X.YIELD
            ,X.LT_DAY
            , 0 AS CELL_QTY_PACK
            ,X.MEASURE
            ,X.MEASURE_LABEL
            ,MAX(X.SORT_ORDER_NO)
            ,88888 AS XLS_KEY1

            ,MAX(WQTY01),MAX(WQTY02),MAX(WQTY03),MAX(WQTY04),MAX(WQTY05),MAX(WQTY06),MAX(WQTY07),MAX(WQTY08),MAX(WQTY09),MAX(WQTY10)
            ,MAX(WQTY11),MAX(WQTY12),MAX(WQTY13),MAX(WQTY14),MAX(WQTY15),MAX(WQTY16),MAX(WQTY17),MAX(WQTY18),MAX(WQTY19),MAX(WQTY20)
            ,MAX(WQTY21),MAX(WQTY22),MAX(WQTY23),MAX(WQTY24),MAX(WQTY25),MAX(WQTY26),MAX(WQTY27),MAX(WQTY28),MAX(WQTY29),MAX(WQTY30)
            ,MAX(WQTY31),MAX(WQTY32),MAX(WQTY33),MAX(WQTY34),MAX(WQTY35),MAX(WQTY36),MAX(WQTY37),MAX(WQTY38),MAX(WQTY39),MAX(WQTY40)
            ,MAX(WQTY41),MAX(WQTY42),MAX(WQTY43),MAX(WQTY44),MAX(WQTY45),MAX(WQTY46),MAX(WQTY47),MAX(WQTY48),MAX(WQTY49),MAX(WQTY50)
            ,MAX(WQTY51),MAX(WQTY52)
        FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS X
        /* INNER JOIN SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP Y WITH (NOLOCK)  -- ESS 외주 Line별 생산 Target 관련 OSP_YN로직 수정 */
        /* ON X.DIVISION_ID = Y.DIVISION_ID */
        /* AND X.ITEM_ID    = Y.ITEM_ID */
        /* AND X.FROM_SITE  = Y.PLANT_SITE_ID */
        /* AND X.PROD_LINE  = Y.LINE_ID */
        /* INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S WITH (NOLOCK) */
        /* ON S.DIVISION_ID              = X.DIVISION_ID */
        /* AND S.SCM_SITE_ID              = X.FROM_SITE */
        /* AND S.OSP_YN                   = 'Y' */
        /* AND ISNULL(S.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N')  = 'Y' */
       WHERE 0 = 0
         AND X.MEASURE IN ('PACK_WORKING_TIME','CELL_WORKING_TIME')
          GROUP BY X.DIVISION_ID
            ,X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            ,X.PLAN_TYPE
            ,X.SEQ
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
            ,X.FROM_SITE
           /* ,ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 M.SITE_DESCRIPTION FROM SCM_MST_SITE M  WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE M.SCM_SITE_ID = X.FROM_SITE) , '-') */
            ,X.ATTRIBUTE9
            /* ,'-' AS ITEM_ID */
            /* ,'-' AS NICK_NAME */
            ,X.PROD_LINE
            /* ,NULL AS DAILY_CAPA_QTY */
            /* ,NULL AS TACT_TIME */
            ,X.FROM_BOH_QTY
            ,X.YIELD
            ,X.LT_DAY
            ,X.CELL_QTY_PACK
            ,X.MEASURE
            ,X.MEASURE_LABEL
            /* ,X.SORT_ORDER_NO */
            /* ,X.XLS_KEY1 */
 UNION
        /* PACK_PROD_TOTAL */
         SELECT  X.DIVISION_ID
            ,X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            ,X.PLAN_TYPE
            ,X.SEQ
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
            ,X.FROM_SITE
            ,NVL((SELECT M.SITE_DESCRIPTION FROM SCM_MST_SITE M   WHERE M.SCM_SITE_ID = X.FROM_SITE AND ROWNUM = 1) , '/') AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
            ,X.ATTRIBUTE9 AS OPERATION_ID
            ,X.ITEM_ID
            ,X.NICK_NAME
            ,'Total' AS PROD_LINE
             ,NULL AS DAILY_CAPA_QTY
            ,NULL AS TACT_TIME
            ,X.FROM_BOH_QTY
            ,X.YIELD
            ,X.LT_DAY
            ,X.CELL_QTY_PACK
            ,X.MEASURE
            ,X.MEASURE_LABEL
            ,MAX(X.SORT_ORDER_NO)
            ,MAX(X.XLS_KEY1)
            ,SUM(WQTY01),SUM(WQTY02),SUM(WQTY03),SUM(WQTY04),SUM(WQTY05),SUM(WQTY06),SUM(WQTY07),SUM(WQTY08),SUM(WQTY09),SUM(WQTY10)
            ,SUM(WQTY11),SUM(WQTY12),SUM(WQTY13),SUM(WQTY14),SUM(WQTY15),SUM(WQTY16),SUM(WQTY17),SUM(WQTY18),SUM(WQTY19),SUM(WQTY20)
            ,SUM(WQTY21),SUM(WQTY22),SUM(WQTY23),SUM(WQTY24),SUM(WQTY25),SUM(WQTY26),SUM(WQTY27),SUM(WQTY28),SUM(WQTY29),SUM(WQTY30)
            ,SUM(WQTY31),SUM(WQTY32),SUM(WQTY33),SUM(WQTY34),SUM(WQTY35),SUM(WQTY36),SUM(WQTY37),SUM(WQTY38),SUM(WQTY39),SUM(WQTY40)
            ,SUM(WQTY41),SUM(WQTY42),SUM(WQTY43),SUM(WQTY44),SUM(WQTY45),SUM(WQTY46),SUM(WQTY47),SUM(WQTY48),SUM(WQTY49),SUM(WQTY50)
            ,SUM(WQTY51),SUM(WQTY52)
        FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS X
        INNER JOIN SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP Y  /* ESS 외주 Line별 생산 Target 관련 OSP_YN로직 수정 */
                ON X.DIVISION_ID = Y.DIVISION_ID
               AND X.ITEM_ID    = Y.ITEM_ID
               AND X.FROM_SITE  = Y.PLANT_SITE_ID
               AND X.PROD_LINE  = Y.LINE_ID
        INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S
                ON S.DIVISION_ID              = X.DIVISION_ID
               AND S.SCM_SITE_ID              = X.FROM_SITE
               AND S.OSP_YN                   = 'Y'
               AND NVL(S.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N')  = 'Y'
       WHERE 0 = 0
         AND X.MEASURE IN ('PACK_PROD_TOTAL')
          GROUP BY X.DIVISION_ID
            ,X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            ,X.PLAN_TYPE
            ,X.SEQ
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
            ,X.FROM_SITE
            ,X.ATTRIBUTE9
            ,X.ITEM_ID
            ,X.NICK_NAME
            ,X.FROM_BOH_QTY
            ,X.YIELD
            ,X.LT_DAY
            ,X.CELL_QTY_PACK
            ,X.MEASURE
            ,X.MEASURE_LABEL

UNION
        /* PACK_PROD_LOAD_TOTAL */
         SELECT  DISTINCT X.DIVISION_ID
            ,X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            ,X.PLAN_TYPE
            ,X.SEQ
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
            ,X.FROM_SITE
            ,NVL((SELECT M.SITE_DESCRIPTION FROM SCM_MST_SITE M   WHERE M.SCM_SITE_ID = X.FROM_SITE AND ROWNUM = 1) , '/') AS FROM_SITE_DESCRIPTION
            ,X.ATTRIBUTE9 AS OPERATION_ID
            ,'-' AS ITEM_ID
            ,'-' AS NICK_NAME
            ,'Total' AS PROD_LINE
            ,NULL AS DAILY_CAPA_QTY
            ,NULL AS TACT_TIME
            ,X.FROM_BOH_QTY
            ,X.YIELD

            ,SUM(WQTY21),SUM(WQTY22),SUM(WQTY23),SUM(WQTY24),SUM(WQTY25),SUM(WQTY26),SUM(WQTY27),SUM(WQTY28),SUM(WQTY29),SUM(WQTY30)
            ,SUM(WQTY31),SUM(WQTY32),SUM(WQTY33),SUM(WQTY34),SUM(WQTY35),SUM(WQTY36),SUM(WQTY37),SUM(WQTY38),SUM(WQTY39),SUM(WQTY40)

            ,SUM(WQTY51),SUM(WQTY52)

                ON X.DIVISION_ID = Y.DIVISION_ID

               AND X.FROM_SITE  = Y.PLANT_SITE_ID

        INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S

               AND S.SCM_SITE_ID              = X.FROM_SITE

          GROUP BY X.DIVISION_ID
            ,X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            ,X.PLAN_TYPE

            ,X.FROM_SITE

            ,X.YIELD
            ,X.LT_DAY
            ,X.CELL_QTY_PACK
            ,X.MEASURE
            ,X.MEASURE_LABEL
            ,X.ATTRIBUTE9

UNION

            ,X.PLAN_TYPE
            ,X.SEQ
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
            ,X.FROM_SITE

            ,NULL AS TACT_TIME
            ,X.FROM_BOH_QTY
            ,X.YIELD
            ,X.LT_DAY
            ,X.CELL_QTY_PACK
            ,X.MEASURE
            ,X.MEASURE_LABEL
            ,MAX(X.SORT_ORDER_NO)
            ,MAX(XLS_KEY1)
            ,SUM(WQTY01),SUM(WQTY02),SUM(WQTY03),SUM(WQTY04),SUM(WQTY05),SUM(WQTY06),SUM(WQTY07),SUM(WQTY08),SUM(WQTY09),SUM(WQTY10)
            ,SUM(WQTY11),SUM(WQTY12),SUM(WQTY13),SUM(WQTY14),SUM(WQTY15),SUM(WQTY16),SUM(WQTY17),SUM(WQTY18),SUM(WQTY19),SUM(WQTY20)
            ,SUM(WQTY21),SUM(WQTY22),SUM(WQTY23),SUM(WQTY24),SUM(WQTY25),SUM(WQTY26),SUM(WQTY27),SUM(WQTY28),SUM(WQTY29),SUM(WQTY30)
            ,SUM(WQTY31),SUM(WQTY32),SUM(WQTY33),SUM(WQTY34),SUM(WQTY35),SUM(WQTY36),SUM(WQTY37),SUM(WQTY38),SUM(WQTY39),SUM(WQTY40)
            ,SUM(WQTY41),SUM(WQTY42),SUM(WQTY43),SUM(WQTY44),SUM(WQTY45),SUM(WQTY46),SUM(WQTY47),SUM(WQTY48),SUM(WQTY49),SUM(WQTY50)
            ,SUM(WQTY51),SUM(WQTY52)
        FROM SCP_XLS_PSI_GLOBAL_ESS X
        /* INNER JOIN SCP_MST_TACT_TIME_OSP Y WITH (NOLOCK)  -- ESS 외주 Line별 생산 Target 관련 OSP_YN로직 수정 */
        /* ON X.DIVISION_ID = Y.DIVISION_ID */
        /* AND X.ITEM_ID    = Y.ITEM_ID */
        /* AND X.FROM_SITE  = Y.PLANT_SITE_ID */
        /* AND X.PROD_LINE  = Y.LINE_ID */
        INNER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S
                ON S.DIVISION_ID              = X.DIVISION_ID
               AND S.SCM_SITE_ID              = X.FROM_SITE
               AND S.OSP_YN                   = 'Y'
               AND NVL(S.ATTRIBUTE1, 'N')  = 'Y'
       WHERE 0 = 0
         AND X.MEASURE IN ('PACK_BOH','PACK_EOH','PACK_DIO')
          GROUP BY X.DIVISION_ID
            ,X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            ,X.PLAN_TYPE
            ,X.SEQ
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
            ,X.FROM_SITE
            ,X.ATTRIBUTE9
            ,X.ITEM_ID
            ,X.FROM_BOH_QTY
            ,X.YIELD
            ,X.LT_DAY
            ,X.CELL_QTY_PACK
            ,X.NICK_NAME
            ,X.MEASURE
            ,X.MEASURE_LABEL
    UNION

      SELECT DISTINCT
             X.DIVISION_ID
            ,X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
            ,X.PLAN_TYPE
            ,X.SEQ
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP
            ,X.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME
            ,X.FROM_SITE

            ,X.ATTRIBUTE9 AS OPERATION_ID

            ,X.YIELD

            ,0 AS CELL_QTY_PACK

            ,99999 AS XLS_KEY1

            ,0 AS WQTY01,0 AS WQTY02,0 AS WQTY03,0 AS WQTY04,0 AS WQTY05,0 AS WQTY06,0 AS WQTY07,0 AS WQTY08,0 AS WQTY09,0 AS WQTY10
            ,0 AS WQTY11,0 AS WQTY12,0 AS WQTY13,0 AS WQTY14,0 AS WQTY15,0 AS WQTY16,0 AS WQTY17,0 AS WQTY18,0 AS WQTY19,0 AS WQTY20
            ,0 AS WQTY21,0 AS WQTY22,0 AS WQTY23,0 AS WQTY24,0 AS WQTY25,0 AS WQTY26,0 AS WQTY27,0 AS WQTY28,0 AS WQTY29,0 AS WQTY30
            ,0 AS WQTY31,0 AS WQTY32,0 AS WQTY33,0 AS WQTY34,0 AS WQTY35,0 AS WQTY36,0 AS WQTY37,0 AS WQTY38,0 AS WQTY39,0 AS WQTY40
            ,0 AS WQTY41,0 AS WQTY42,0 AS WQTY43,0 AS WQTY44,0 AS WQTY45,0 AS WQTY46,0 AS WQTY47,0 AS WQTY48,0 AS WQTY49,0 AS WQTY50
            ,0 AS WQTY51,0 AS WQTY52

        /* LEFT OUTER  JOIN SCP_MST_OUTSOURCING_CAPA Y WITH (NOLOCK) */

NAME: SSP_ANL_DAILY_MAIL_SEND_N_V
TEXT:
WITH ITEM AS (
SELECT /********************************************************************************************************************************
* VIEW NAME     : [SSP_ANL_DAILY_MAIL_SEND_N_V]
* DESCRIPTION   : D-4일 BALANCE 음수 경우 메일 대상자 및 대상 아이템 추출

* PROGRAM HISTORY
*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* 2018.10.07   juhlee     Initial Release [PJ20189106] 전지.GSCM 고도화 이행-
******************************************************************************************************************************* */  A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , A.FROM_SITE
     , A.ITEM_ID
     , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + FN_GET_SSP_ANL_SHIP_FROZEN(A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE) + 1, 'YYYYMMDD') AS FROM_YYYYMMDD
     , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + FN_GET_SSP_ANL_SHIP_FROZEN(A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE) + 4, 'YYYYMMDD') AS TO_YYYYMMDD
  FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_C A
 WHERE A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = (SELECT MAX(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD)
                                  FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_C
                                 WHERE COMPANY_ID = A.COMPANY_ID)
   AND A.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + FN_GET_SSP_ANL_SHIP_FROZEN(A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE) + 1, 'YYYYMMDD')
   AND A.YYYYMMDD <= TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + FN_GET_SSP_ANL_SHIP_FROZEN(A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE) + 4, 'YYYYMMDD')
   AND A.MEASURE IN ('BALANCE', 'SHIP_PLAN', 'SHIP_REQ')
   AND FN_GET_SSP_ANL_SHIP_FROZEN(A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE) > 0  /* 확정일자 0이상인것만 */
 GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , A.FROM_SITE
     , A.ITEM_ID
     , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + FN_GET_SSP_ANL_SHIP_FROZEN(A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE) + 1, 'YYYYMMDD')
     , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, 'YYYYMMDD') + FN_GET_SSP_ANL_SHIP_FROZEN(A.DIVISION_ID, A.FROM_SITE) + 4, 'YYYYMMDD')
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'BALANCE' THEN A.QTY ELSE 0 END) < 0
   AND (SUM(CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'SHIP_PLAN' THEN A.QTY ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'SHIP_REQ' THEN A.QTY ELSE 0 END) > 0)
)
SELECT MAX(TYPE) AS TYPE
     , T.MAIL_RECEIVER
     , T.DIVISION_ID
     , T.COMPANY_ID
     , T.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , T.FROM_SITE
     , T.ITEM_ID
     , T.YYYYMMDD
  FROM (
        /* LOOK UP에 등록된 수신자 */
        SELECT M.SEGMENT1 AS TYPE
             , M.SEGMENT2 AS MAIL_RECEIVER
             , X.DIVISION_ID
             , X.COMPANY_ID
             , X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , X.FROM_SITE
             , X.ITEM_ID
             , X.FROM_YYYYMMDD AS YYYYMMDD
          FROM ITEM X
          JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M
            ON M.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'WARNING_MAIL_SEND'
           AND M.VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND M.SEGMENT3 = CASE WHEN M.SEGMENT3 = 'ALL' THEN 'ALL' ELSE X.FROM_SITE END
        UNION ALL
        /* MKT OWNER (DIVISION_ID, ITEM_ID, TO_SITE) */
        SELECT 'MKT' AS TYPE
             , U.MKT_USER AS MAIL_RECEIVER
             , X.DIVISION_ID
             , X.COMPANY_ID
             , X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , X.FROM_SITE
             , X.ITEM_ID
             , X.FROM_YYYYMMDD AS YYYYMMDD
          FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_C P
          JOIN ITEM X
            ON P.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
           AND P.COMPANY_ID = X.COMPANY_ID
           AND P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND P.FROM_SITE = X.FROM_SITE
           AND P.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN X.FROM_YYYYMMDD AND X.TO_YYYYMMDD
           AND P.MEASURE IN ('SHIP_REQ', 'SHIP_PLAN')
           AND P.QTY > 0
          JOIN SSP_MKT_USER_V U
            ON U.DIVISION_ID = P.DIVISION_ID
           AND U.TO_SITE = P.TO_SITE
           AND U.ITEM_ID = P.ITEM_ID
           AND U.PROJECT_CODE = P.PROJECT_CODE
         GROUP BY U.MKT_USER
             , X.DIVISION_ID
             , X.COMPANY_ID
             , X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , X.FROM_SITE
             , X.ITEM_ID
             , X.FROM_YYYYMMDD
        UNION ALL
        /* REQUESTOR */
        SELECT 'REQ' AS TYPE
             , P.REQUESTOR AS MAIL_RECEIVER
             , X.DIVISION_ID
             , X.COMPANY_ID
             , X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , X.FROM_SITE
             , X.ITEM_ID
             , X.FROM_YYYYMMDD AS YYYYMMDD
          FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_C P
          JOIN ITEM X
            ON P.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
           AND P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
           AND P.FROM_SITE = X.FROM_SITE
           AND P.YYYYMMDD BETWEEN X.FROM_YYYYMMDD AND X.TO_YYYYMMDD
           AND P.MEASURE IN ('SHIP_REQ', 'SHIP_PLAN')
           AND P.REQUESTOR IS NOT NULL
           AND P.QTY > 0
         GROUP BY P.REQUESTOR
             , X.DIVISION_ID
             , X.COMPANY_ID
             , X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
             , X.FROM_SITE
             , X.ITEM_ID
             , X.FROM_YYYYMMDD
       ) T
 WHERE T.MAIL_RECEIVER = 'juhlee'
 GROUP BY T.MAIL_RECEIVER
     , T.DIVISION_ID
     , T.COMPANY_ID
     , T.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
     , T.FROM_SITE
     , T.ITEM_ID
     , T.YYYYMMDD

NAME: SSP_ANL_DAILY_MAIL_SEND_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/********************************************************************************************************************************
* VIEW NAME     : [SSP_ANL_DAILY_MAIL_SEND_V]
* DESCRIPTION   : D-4일 BALANCE 음수 경우 메일 대상자 및 대상 아이템 추출
   -  대상 : 오창 자동차 공장출하분 ( division 81 , from site : A040-P, A040-A )
             현재일 기준 D+4 (PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD +4 ) 출하 Confirm 수량이 있으면서 BALANCE가 음수인 경우
     ex)  현재일 : 2018-07-24일 경우 2018-07-27의의 출하 확정수량 이 0보다 크고 BALANCE가 음수인 ITEM 대상
   -  메일링 일시 : Daily 08시
   -  메일수신자 :
      . MKT 담당자  : ITEM/Project 의 오너 (SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM.OWNER)
      . 생산 담당자 : Pack  황현규 선임( hwanghg)  --> from site가 A040-P
                      Cell  이재범 책임(laebumlee) --> from site가 A040-A
      . 물류 담당자 : 최예린 사원(chldpfls) , 한유미(ymhan) , 유정아(dhwmak)
	  . PI담당자    : 지준혁 선임(bondi)
* PROGRAM HISTORY
*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* 2018.09.19   juhlee     Initial Release [PJ20182279] 전지본부 출하계획 시스템 구축 프로젝트
*                         최초 OPEN시에는 PI 및 프로젝트 담당자에게만 메일 발송
* 2018.10.04   juhlee	  물류담당자 추가 - 최예린 사원(chldpfls) , 한유미(ymhan) , 유정아(dhwmak)
* 2019.01.28   juhlee     [C20190123_05453]메일수신자를 LOOKUP정도 등록하여 발송하게 변경( LOOKUP_TYPE ='WARNING_MAIL_SEND')
* 2019.04.09   juhlee	  [PJ20189106] 전지.GSCM 고도화 이행- 소형 추가
* 2026.07.04   ZIONEX     [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
********************************************************************************************************************************/
 M.SEGMENT1             AS TYPE
,      M.SEGMENT2             AS MAIL_RECEIVER
,      A.DIVISION_ID          AS DIVISION_ID
,      A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD  AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
,      A.FROM_SITE            AS FROM_SITE
,      A.ITEM_ID              AS ITEM_ID
,      A.YYYYMMDD             AS YYYYMMDD
FROM  SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN A
      JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL M
        ON  M.LOOKUP_TYPE ='WARNING_MAIL_SEND'
       AND  M.VALID_YN    ='Y'
       AND  M.SEGMENT3    = CASE WHEN M.SEGMENT3 = 'ALL' THEN 'ALL' ELSE A.FROM_SITE END
WHERE A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD =  ( SELECT MAX(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD) FROM SSP_PLAN_VERSION_V WHERE DIVISION_ID = '81' )
AND   A.DIVISION_ID = '81'
AND   A.PLAN_TYPE = 'SP'
AND   A.YYYYMMDD = FN_DATE_TO_CHAR ( FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD) + 4 )
/* AND   A.FROM_SITE IN ( 'A040-P' ,'A040-A') */
AND   A.MEASURE IN ( 'SHIP_CONFIRM' ,'BALANCE')
GROUP BY M.SEGMENT1, M.SEGMENT2, A.DIVISION_ID, A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, A.FROM_SITE, A.ITEM_ID, A.YYYYMMDD
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'BALANCE'      THEN A.QTY ELSE 0 END ) < 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'SHIP_CONFIRM' THEN A.QTY ELSE 0 END ) > 0


/*
UNION ALL
-- 소형의 경우 해당 모델 담당자에게 메일 발송 (Shipment Model PIC 화면에서 등록)
SELECT 'MODEL_PIC'            AS TYPE
,      U.USER_ID              AS MAIL_RECEIVER
,      A.DIVISION_ID          AS DIVISION_ID
,      A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD  AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
,      A.FROM_SITE            AS FROM_SITE
,      A.ITEM_ID              AS ITEM_ID
,      A.YYYYMMDD             AS YYYYMMDD
FROM  SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_40 A WITH(NOLOCK) -- 소형
      JOIN SSP_MST_MODEL_USER U WITH(NOLOCK)
        ON U.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
	   AND U.FROM_SITE   = A.FROM_SITE
	   AND U.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID
WHERE A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD =  ( SELECT MAX(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD) FROM SSP_PLAN_VERSION_V WHERE DIVISION_ID = '40' )
AND   A.DIVISION_ID = '40'
AND   A.PLAN_TYPE   = 'SP'
AND   A.YYYYMMDD = DBO.FN_DATE_TO_CHAR ( DBO.FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD) + 4 )
AND   A.MEASURE IN ( 'SHIP_CONFIRM' ,'BALANCE')
GROUP BY U.FROM_SITE, U.USER_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD, A.FROM_SITE, A.ITEM_ID, A.YYYYMMDD
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'BALANCE'      THEN A.QTY ELSE 0 END ) < 0
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'SHIP_CONFIRM' THEN A.QTY ELSE 0 END ) > 0


-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


UNION ALL
-- 대상 ITEM 추출 MKT -- mkt 담당자는 ITEM별로 정해져 있어 LOOKUP 사용 안됨
SELECT 'MKT'                  AS TYPE
,      X.MAIL_RECEIVER        AS MAIL_RECEIVER
,      X.DIVISION_ID          AS DIVISION_ID
,      X.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD  AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
,      X.FROM_SITE            AS FROM_SITE
,      X.ITEM_ID              AS ITEM_ID
,      X.YYYYMMDD             AS YYYYMMDD
FROM (
		SELECT
			   U.MKT_USER             AS MAIL_RECEIVER
		,      P.DIVISION_ID          AS DIVISION_ID
		,      P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD  AS PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD
		,      P.FROM_SITE            AS FROM_SITE
		,      P.ITEM_ID              AS ITEM_ID
		,      P.YYYYMMDD             AS YYYYMMDD
		FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN P  WITH(NOLOCK)
		JOIN (
				SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
				,      A.FROM_SITE
				,      A.ITEM_ID
				,      A.YYYYMMDD
				,      MAX(A.PROJECT_CODE) PROJECT_CODE
				FROM  SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN A WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = ( SELECT MAX(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD) FROM SSP_PLAN_VERSION_V WHERE DIVISION_ID = '81' )
				AND   A.DIVISION_ID = '81'
				AND   A.PLAN_TYPE   = 'SP'
				AND   A.YYYYMMDD = DBO.FN_DATE_TO_CHAR ( DBO.FN_CHAR_TO_DATE(A.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD) + 4 )  -- D+4
				AND   A.FROM_SITE IN ( 'A040-P' ,'A040-A')
				AND   A.MEASURE IN ( 'SHIP_CONFIRM' ,'BALANCE')
				GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID , A.FROM_SITE , A.ITEM_ID , A.YYYYMMDD
				HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'BALANCE'      THEN A.QTY ELSE 0 END ) < 0
				   AND SUM(CASE WHEN A.MEASURE = 'SHIP_CONFIRM' THEN A.QTY ELSE 0 END ) > 0
			) B
			ON P.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID AND  P.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
		JOIN SSP_MKT_USER_V U
		  ON U.DIVISION_ID   = CASE WHEN P.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN P.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ELSE P.DIVISION_ID END
		 AND U.TO_SITE       = P.TO_SITE
		 AND U.ITEM_ID       = P.ITEM_ID
		 AND U.PROJECT_CODE  = P.PROJECT_CODE
		WHERE P.DIVISION_ID = '81'
		AND   P.PLAN_TYPE   ='SP'
		AND   P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD = ( SELECT MAX(PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD) FROM SSP_PLAN_VERSION_V WHERE DIVISION_ID = '81' )
		AND   P.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
		AND   P.FROM_SITE   = B.FROM_SITE
		AND   P.ITEM_ID     = B.ITEM_ID
		AND   P.YYYYMMDD    = B.YYYYMMDD
		AND   P.MEASURE     = 'SHIP_CONFIRM'
		AND   P.QTY > 0
		GROUP BY U.MKT_USER, P.DIVISION_ID ,P.PLAN_START_YYYYMMDD ,P.FROM_SITE , P.ITEM_ID , P.YYYYMMDD
		) X
*/

NAME: SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_FP_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SSP_ANL_SHIP_PLAN_FP_V
 * Description  : FP 제공용 SHIP PLAN (Cell, Pack)
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2022.09.01   SSP Pjt.       Created.
 * 2026.07.04   ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 *
 */
 P.PLAN_TYPE
       , P.DIVISION_ID
       , FS.COMPANY_ID
       , P.ITEM_ID
       , FS.OPERATION_GROUP
       , P.FROM_SITE AS SITE_CODE
       , FS.PLANT_ID
       , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_CODE')        AS CUSTOMER_CODE
       , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SOLDTO_DESCRIPTION') AS CUSTOMER_NAME
       , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_CODE')        AS SHIP_TO_CODE
       , FN_GET_SITE_CUSTOMER_INFO(P.DIVISION_ID, P.TO_SITE, 'SHIPTO_DESCRIPTION') AS SHIP_TO_PARTY
       , P.TO_SITE AS DEST_SITE_CODE
       , TS.PLANT_ID AS DEST_PLANT_ID
       , TS.SITE_TYPE AS DESTINATION_SITE_TYPE
       , P.YYYYMMDD AS EXFACTORY_YYYYMMDD
       , P.QTY AS EXFACTORY_QTY
       , CASE WHEN P.FCST_TYPE = '-' THEN 'MPS' ELSE P.FCST_TYPE END AS ORDER_TYPE
       , P.INCOTERMS
       , P.TRANSPORT_MODE
       , P.PROJECT_CODE
       , P.ETD_DATE
       , P.ETA_DATE
       , FN_GET_SSP_DOM_EXP(P.DIVISION_ID, P.FROM_SITE, P.TO_SITE) AS MARKET
       , P.ETA_DATE AS RECEIVE_YYYYMMDD
    FROM ( SELECT C.DIVISION_ID
                , C.ITEM_ID
                , C.FROM_SITE
                , C.TO_SITE
                , C.YYYYMMDD
                , C.BOD_ID
                , C.ROUTE_ID
                , C.QTY
                , C.INCOTERMS
                , C.TRANSPORT_MODE
                , C.PROJECT_CODE
                , C.FCST_TYPE
                , C.ETD_DATE
                , C.ETA_DATE
                , C.CONFIRM_ID
                , C.REQUESTOR
                , 'Confirm' AS PLAN_TYPE
             FROM SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM C
            WHERE C.YYYYMMDD >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE - 1, 'YYYYMMDD')
              AND C.YYYYMMDD <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE + 56, 'YYYYMMDD')
              AND C.CHANGE_TYPE = 'C'  /* 확정 */
              AND C.BIZ_TYPE <> 'E'

            UNION ALL

           /* 확정기간 이후 출하요청 */

           SELECT R.DIVISION_ID
                , R.ITEM_ID
                , R.PLANT_SITE_ID AS FROM_SITE
                , R.SCM_SITE_ID AS TO_SITE
                , R.YYYYMMDD
                , R.BOD_ID
                , B.ROUTE_ID
                , R.QTY
                , NVL(B.SSP_INCOTERMS, R.INCOTERMS) AS INCOTERMS
                , R.TRANSPORT_MODE
                , R.PROJECT_CODE
                , R.FCST_TYPE
                , R.YYYYMMDD AS ETD_DATE
                , FN_GET_SSP_ETA_DATE(R.DIVISION_ID, R.BOD_ID, R.YYYYMMDD) AS ETA_DATE
                , '-' AS CONFIRM_ID
                , R.LAST_UPDATED_BY AS REQUESTOR
                , 'Plan' AS PLAN_TYPE
             FROM DM_PLN_SHIPMENT_REQ R
                  JOIN SCP_MST_BOD_N_V B
                    ON B.DIVISION_ID = R.DIVISION_ID
                   AND B.BOD_ID = R.BOD_ID
            WHERE R.MEASURE = 'SHIP_REQ'
              AND R.YYYYMMDD >= CASE WHEN FN_GET_SSP_ANL_SHIP_FROZEN(R.DIVISION_ID, R.PLANT_SITE_ID) <= 0 THEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
                                     ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYYMMDD') + FN_GET_SSP_ANL_SHIP_FROZEN(R.DIVISION_ID, R.PLANT_SITE_ID), 'YYYYMMDD')
                                END
              AND R.YYYYMMDD <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE + 56, 'YYYYMMDD')
              AND TO_DATE(R.YYYYMMDD DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR, 'YYYYMMDD') IS NOT NULL
         ) P
    JOIN SCM_MST_SITE FS
      ON P.DIVISION_ID = FS.DIVISION_ID
     AND P.FROM_SITE = FS.SCM_SITE_ID
     AND FS.VALID_YN = 'Y'
    JOIN SCM_MST_SITE TS
      ON P.DIVISION_ID = TS.DIVISION_ID
     AND P.TO_SITE = TS.SCM_SITE_ID
     AND TS.VALID_YN = 'Y'
   WHERE 1 = 1
     AND P.QTY > 0

NAME: SSP_DNM_ESS_PACKER_STOCK_V
TEXT:
SELECT IA.SCM_SITE_ID
     , NVL(A.COMPANY_ID, '*')                                       AS COMPANY_ID
     , A.DIVISION_ID
     , NVL(A.SITE_ID, '*')                                          AS SITE_ID
     , NVL(A.PLANT_ID, '*')                                         AS PLANT_ID
     , NVL(A.FACTORY_ID, '*')                                       AS FACTORY_ID
     , NVL(A.STORAGE_ID, '*')                                       AS STORAGE_ID
     , A.CUTOFF_DATE - 1                                            AS CUTOFF_DATE   /* STOCK은 BOH 일자 기준 처리되어 EOH 기준일자로 변경 */
     , A.SEQ
     , A.STOCK_TYPE
     , A.ITEM_ID
     , A.ITEM_ID                                                    AS ORIGIN_ITEM_ID
     , NVL(A.QTY2, 0) + NVL(A.MOVING_QTY, 0) + NVL(A.DEFECT_QTY, 0) AS SCM_QTY       /* 출하가능재고에서 MOVING_QTY 제외 */
     , NVL(A.QTY2, 0)                                               AS SSP_QTY
     , A.LANE
     , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
     , A.AVAILABLE_DATE
     , A.REMAIN_LEAD_TIME
     , A.HOLDING_DATE
     , A.QTY
     , A.QTY_UOM
     , A.STOCK_STATUS
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.LINE_ID
     , A.OUTSOURCING_FLAG
     , A.OUTSOURCING_FACTORY
     , A.DESCRIPTION
     , A.FP_APPLY_OPERATION_ID
     , A.FP_APPLY_ITEM_ID
     , A.FP_APPLY_WIPQTY
     , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(A.WIPHOLD_YN, 'N')                            AS WIPHOLD_YN
     , FN_SCM_SYS_NVL(A.QMS_HOLD_YN, 'N')                           AS QMS_HOLD_YN
     , A.WIP_TYPE_CODE
     , A.QTY2
     , A.MODIFY_FP_APPLY_WIPQTY
     , A.MODIFY_DESCRIPTION
     , A.CAL_QTY
     , A.FORMATION_REWORK_TYPE
     , A.INSERT_ID
     , A.INSERT_TIME
     , A.UPDATE_ID
     , A.UPDATE_TIME
     , A.LOCATION
     , A.MOVING_QTY
     , A.CAPA_GRD_CODE
     , A.VLTG_GRD_CODE
     , A.RSST_GRD_CODE
     , A.DEFECT_QTY
     , A.UNHOLD_EXP_DATE
     , A.MES_MAP_SLOC
  FROM SCM_DNM_STOCK_SN A
     , ( SELECT D.DIVISION_ID
              , D.PLANT_ID
              , D.SITE_ID
              , D.COMPANY_ID
              , D.SCM_SITE_ID
              , C.ITEM_ID
           FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM C
              , SCM_MST_SITE       D
          WHERE C.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
            AND C.SCM_SITE_ID = D.SCM_SITE_ID
            AND D.SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT'
            AND D.OSP_YN      = 'Y'
            AND D.VALID_YN    = 'Y' ) IA
     , SCM_MST_ITEM_SN B
 WHERE IA.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
   AND IA.SITE_ID     = A.SITE_ID
   AND IA.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID
   AND A.COMPANY_ID   = B.COMPANY_ID
   AND A.DIVISION_ID  = B.DIVISION_ID
   AND A.SITE_ID      = B.SITE_ID
   AND A.ITEM_ID      = B.ITEM_ID
   AND A.STORAGE_ID  IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                           FROM TABLE(FN_LIST_LOOKUP_VALUE('SSP_DNM_ESS_PACKER_STOCK_V', 'PEOPLEWORK_STORAGE')))
   AND B.ITEM_TYPE    = 'P'
   AND A.DIVISION_ID  = '82'
   AND A.CUTOFF_DATE  > TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 3
   AND A.CUTOFF_DATE <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)

NAME: SSP_DNM_PLAN_FROZEN_V
TEXT:
SELECT FN_GET_SCM_SITE_ID_PLANT(R.PLANT_ID
                              , FN_GET_ITEM_OPERATION_GROUP(R.DIVISION_ID, R.ITEM_ID)
                               ) AS SCM_SITE_ID
     , R.COMPANY_ID
     , R.DIVISION_ID
     , R.SITE_ID
     , R.PLANT_ID
     , R.FACTORY_ID
     , R.OPERATION_ID
     , R.LOCATION
     , R.TOP_ITEM_ID
     , NVL(FI.PACKER_PLAN_ITEM_ID, R.ITEM_ID) ITEM_ID  /* 2018.06.29 */
     , R.ITEM_ID ORIGIN_ITEM_ID  /* 2018.06.29 */
     , R.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
     , R.MARKET
     , R.LINE_ID
     , R.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , R.PLAN_DATE
     , R.PLAN_QTY  /* OUT 수량 */
       /* IN 수량 */
     , CASE WHEN R.PLAN_IN_QTY <= 0 THEN R.PLAN_QTY
            ELSE R.PLAN_IN_QTY
       END PLAN_IN_QTY
     , R.EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM SSP_DNM_FP_RELEASE_PLAN_V_SN R
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM FI  /* 2018.06.29 */
 WHERE R.DIVISION_ID = FI.DIVISION_ID(+)
   AND R.ITEM_ID = FI.ITEM_ID(+)
   AND NVL(R.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE, '-') NOT IN ('TEST', 'REWORK', 'M/C')  /* 2018.05.14, 2018.06.18  Kim Jihye */
       /* TEST : 공장 내부 Test  'M/C' : 형교환계획 */

NAME: SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_ERP_COMMON_SCM_V
SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_ERP_COMMON_SCM_WORK_V
TEXT:
WITH RESULT_SCS_EXIST AS
	(
		
		SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_ERP_COMMON_SCM_V
 * Description  : ERP 출하실적을 전사 SCM 에 제공한다
                  소속 DIVISION_ID 정보를 조회 하기 위해서
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2025.05.14 _ERP_DW_V에서 복사하여 전사SCM용으로 신규 생성 (심재만 책임 요청)
 * 2025.06.19 ssp 출하실적 view 기준으로 수정
 * 2026.07.06  ZIONEX   [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
*/ /* 패커 실적 */ /* SCS 출하실적에서 CONFIRM_ID 존재 */   E.DIVISION_ID             AS DIVISION_ID
		,       E.ATTRIBUTE5              AS CONFIRM_ID
		,       C.ERP_SO_NO				  AS ERP_SO_NO
		,       E.SHIP_DATE		          AS YYYYMMDD
		,       C.TRANSPORT_MODE		  AS TRANSPORT_MODE
		,       C.INCOTERMS				  AS INCOTERMS
		,		C.ETA_DATE				  AS ETA_DATE
		,		C.ETD_DATE				  AS ETD_DATE
		,       E.SCM_SITE_ID			  AS FROM_SITE
		,		E.TO_SITE				  AS TO_SITE
		,		E.ITEM_ID				  AS ITEM_ID
		/* 20211126  SMS  추가  Ship to */
		,		E.ATTRIBUTE4			  AS SHIP_TO
		/* ====================================================== */
		,       SUM(E.SHIP_QTY )		  AS RESULT_QTY
		FROM SCM_DNM_SCS_SHIP_RESULT E
		LEFT OUTER JOIN SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM C
			ON E.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
			AND E.ATTRIBUTE5 = C.CONFIRM_ID
		WHERE 1=1
		/* AND   E.ATTRIBUTE5 LIKE 'R%' */
		/* AND   E.SHIP_DATE BETWEEN @p_from_yyyymmdd  AND @p_to_yyyymmdd */

		GROUP BY E.DIVISION_ID
		,        E.ATTRIBUTE5
		,        C.ERP_SO_NO
		,        E.SHIP_DATE
		,		 C.TRANSPORT_MODE
		,        C.INCOTERMS
		,		 C.ETA_DATE
		,        C.ETD_DATE
		,        E.SCM_SITE_ID
		,		 E.TO_SITE
		,		 E.ITEM_ID
		/* 20211126  SMS  추가 */
		,		 E.ATTRIBUTE4
		/* ================================ */
		)
SELECT
	   D.ATTRIBUTE3		AS DIVISION_ID
	  ,X.COMPANY_ID
	  ,X.PLANT_ID
	  ,X.ORDER_NO
	  ,X.DELIVERY_NO
	  ,X.DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
	  ,X.ITEM_ID
	  ,X.PROJET_CODE
	  ,X.FROM_SITE
	  ,X.TO_SITE
	  ,X.YYYYMMDD
	  ,X.RESULT_QTY
	  ,X.SHIPTO_CODE
	  ,X.TRANSPORT_MODE
	  ,X.INCOTERMS
	  ,X.CONFIRM_ID
	  ,X.FCST_TYPE
	  ,X.CURRENCY_CODE
	  ,X.NET_PRICE
	  ,X.SALES_AMOUNT
	  ,X.KRW_XRATE
	  ,X.SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
	  ,X.DIVISION_ID	AS SCM_DIVISION_ID
	  ,X.ORDER_TYPE_CODE
  FROM (
		SELECT  E.DIVISION_ID             AS DIVISION_ID
		,       E.COMPANY_ID              AS COMPANY_ID
		,       E.PLANT_ID                AS PLANT_ID
		,       E.ORDER_NO                AS ORDER_NO
		,       E.DELIVERY_NO             AS DELIVERY_NO
		,       E.DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ       AS DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
        ,       C.ITEM_ID                 AS ITEM_ID
		,       CASE WHEN E.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN '-'
		             ELSE NVL(E.PROJECT_CODE,'-') END     AS PROJET_CODE
        ,       C.FROM_SITE               AS FROM_SITE
        ,       C.TO_SITE                 AS TO_SITE
		,       E.EXFACTORY_DATE          AS YYYYMMDD
		,       E.EXFACTORY_QTY           AS RESULT_QTY
		,       E.SHIPTO_CODE             AS SHIPTO_CODE
		,       C.TRANSPORT_MODE          AS TRANSPORT_MODE
		,       C.INCOTERMS               AS INCOTERMS
		,       E.CONFIRM_ID              AS CONFIRM_ID
		,       C.FCST_TYPE               AS FCST_TYPE
		,       E.CURRENCY_CODE
		,       E.NET_PRICE
		,       E.SALES_AMOUNT
		,       E.KRW_XRATE
		,       E.SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
		, E.ORDER_TYPE_CODE AS ORDER_TYPE_CODE
		FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT E
		    JOIN SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM C
			  ON C.CONFIRM_ID = E.CONFIRM_ID
			JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
				ON L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_SSP_TYPE'  /* LOOKUP에 등록된 공정만 */
			AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
			AND L.SEGMENT1    = E.SSP_TYPE
		JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S
			ON E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID	= S.SCM_SITE_ID
		   AND E.DIVISION_ID	= S.DIVISION_ID
		   AND S.SITE_TYPE		= 'PLANT'
		JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T
			ON E.ITEM_ID		= T.ITEM_ID
		   AND E.DIVISION_ID	= T.DIVISION_ID
		   AND S.COMPANY_ID		= T.COMPANY_ID
		   AND T.ITEM_TYPE		NOT IN ('Q','R')
		WHERE 1=1
		AND   NVL(E.EXFACTORY_STATUS,'D90') NOT IN ('D90' ,'D10')  /* D90: DO삭제 , D10:DO생성 */
		AND   E.CONFIRM_ID LIKE 'C%'
		/* AND   E.EXFACTORY_DATE BETWEEN @p_from_yyyymmdd  AND @p_to_yyyymmdd */

		UNION ALL

		SELECT S.DIVISION_ID     AS DIVISION_ID
		,NULL AS COMPANY_ID
		,NULL AS PLANT_ID
		,      S.ERP_SO_NO       AS ORDER_NO
		, NULL AS DELIVERY_NO
		, '0'       AS DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
		,      S.ITEM_ID         AS ITEM_ID
		, NULL          AS PROJECT_CODE
		,      S.FROM_SITE       AS FROM_SITE
		,      S.TO_SITE         AS TO_SITE
		,      S.YYYYMMDD        AS YYYYMMDD
		,      SUM(S.RESULT_QTY) AS RESULT_QTY
		,      S.SHIP_TO         AS SHIPTO_CODE
		,      S.TRANSPORT_MODE  AS TRANSPORT_MODE
		,      S.INCOTERMS       AS INCOTERMS
	, CONFIRM_ID AS CONFIRM_ID
	, '' AS FCST_TYPE
	, '0' AS CURRENCY_CODE
	,NULL AS NET_PRICE
	,NULL AS SALES_AMOUNT
	,NULL AS KRW_XRATE
	,NULL AS SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
	,'' AS ORDER_TYPE_CODE
		/* ,      NULL              AS END_CUSTOMER */
		/* ,      SUM(S.RESULT_QTY) AS QTY */
		/* ,      S.YYYYMMDD        AS YYYYMMDD */
		/* ,      S.TRANSPORT_MODE  AS TRANSPORT_MODE */
		/* ,      S.INCOTERMS       AS INCOTERMS */
		/* ,      S.ETD_DATE        AS ETD_DATE */
		/* ,      S.ETA_DATE        AS ETA_DATE */
		/* ,      NULL				 AS SHIP_TYPE */
		/* 20211126  SMS  추가 Ship to */
		/* ,      S.SHIP_TO         AS SHIP_TO */
		/* ============================================= */
		FROM  RESULT_SCS_EXIST S
		/* LEFT OUTER JOIN PLAN_SSP P */
		/* ON S.CONFIRM_ID = P.CONFIRM_ID */
		GROUP BY S.DIVISION_ID
		,		 S.ERP_SO_NO
		,        S.FROM_SITE
		,        S.TO_SITE
		,        S.ITEM_ID
		,		 S.TRANSPORT_MODE
		,		 S.INCOTERMS
		,		 S.ETD_DATE
		,		 S.ETA_DATE
		,        S.YYYYMMDD
		,        S.CONFIRM_ID
		/* 20211126  SMS  추가 Ship to */
		,        S.SHIP_TO

		UNION ALL

		SELECT  E.DIVISION_ID             AS DIVISION_ID
		,       E.COMPANY_ID              AS COMPANY_ID
		,       E.PLANT_ID                AS PLANT_ID
		,       E.ORDER_NO                AS ORDER_NO
		,       E.DELIVERY_NO             AS DELIVERY_NO
		,       E.DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ       AS DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
        ,       E.ITEM_ID                 AS ITEM_ID
		,       CASE WHEN E.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN '-'
		             ELSE NVL(E.PROJECT_CODE,'-') END     AS PROJET_CODE
		,       E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID        AS FROM_SITE
		,       E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID          AS TO_SITE
		,       E.EXFACTORY_DATE          AS YYYYMMDD
		,       E.EXFACTORY_QTY           AS RESULT_QTY
		,       E.SHIPTO_CODE             AS SHIPTO_CODE
		,       E.TRANSPORT_MODE          AS TRANSPORT_MODE
		,       E.INCOTERMS               AS INCOTERMS
		,       E.CONFIRM_ID              AS CONFIRM_ID
		,       '-'                       AS FCST_TYPE
		,       E.CURRENCY_CODE
		,       E.NET_PRICE
		,       E.SALES_AMOUNT
		,       E.KRW_XRATE
		,       E.SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
		,       E.ORDER_TYPE_CODE AS ORDER_TYPE_CODE
		FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT E
		JOIN SCM_MST_SITE S
			ON E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID	= S.SCM_SITE_ID
		   AND E.DIVISION_ID	= S.DIVISION_ID
		   AND S.SITE_TYPE		= 'PLANT'

		JOIN SCM_MST_ITEM_SN T
			ON E.ITEM_ID		= T.ITEM_ID
		   AND E.DIVISION_ID	= T.DIVISION_ID
		   AND S.COMPANY_ID		= T.COMPANY_ID
		   AND T.ITEM_TYPE		NOT IN ('Q','R')
		JOIN  SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F  /* SCP 대상 ITEM만 */
			ON F.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID
			AND F.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
		JOIN   SCM_MST_SITE FS
			ON FS.SCM_SITE_ID = E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
			AND FS.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
			AND NVL(FS.OSP_YN,'N') <> 'Y'  /* - [C20200121-000352]-2 : FROM_SITE PACKER포함(OSP_YN <> 'Y' 조건제외) */
		/* 2020.09.18 김광희 책임 요청으로 주석처리 */
		/* 2021.04.15 김광희 책임 요청으로 주석해제 */
		JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
			ON L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_ORDER_TYPE'  /* LOOKUP에 등록된 ORDER_TYPE만 대상으로 함 */
		AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
		AND L.SEGMENT1    = E.ORDER_TYPE_CODE
		LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L3
				ON L3.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SHIP_RESULT_TO_SITE_MAPPING'  /* SOLDTO, SHIPTO 과 MAPPING되는 TO_SITE */
			AND L3.SEGMENT1    = E.DIVISION_ID
			AND L3.SEGMENT2    = E.SOLDTO_CODE
			AND L3.SEGMENT3    = E.SHIPTO_CODE
		WHERE 1=1
		AND   NVL(E.EXFACTORY_STATUS,'D90') NOT IN ('D90' ,'D10')  /* D90: DO삭제 , D10:DO생성 */
		AND   NVL(E.CONFIRM_ID,' ') NOT LIKE  'C%'
		/* AND   E.EXFACTORY_DATE BETWEEN  @p_from_yyyymmdd  AND @p_to_yyyymmdd */
		/* [C20210330-000402] */
		/* AND   E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL */
		/* AND   E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL */
		AND   E.STORAGE_ID NOT IN ('6000' ,'799A')  /* 상품창고제외 */
		/* [C20200403-000062] */
		AND   E.STORAGE_ID NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT1
								FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
								WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_SHIP_RESULT_EXCEPT_STORAGE'
									AND VALID_YN = 'Y'
								)  /* 사외 창고 제외 LOOKUP 관리 */
       ) X
       JOIN SCM_MST_DIVISION D
    ON X.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID

NAME: SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_ERP_DW_V
TEXT:
SELECT /*
 * Program ID   : SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_ERP_DW_V
 * Description  : ERP 출하실적 FOR DW
                  소속 DIVISION_ID 정보를 조회 하기 위해서
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2022.04.01   SSP Pjt.       Created
 * 2024.10.01   KHJ            NERP_SSP
 * 2026.07.06  ZIONEX  [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 */  B.ATTRIBUTE3   AS DIVISION_ID
     , A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.PLANT_ID
     , A.ORDER_NO
     , A.DELIVERY_NO
     , A.DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
     , A.ITEM_ID
     , A.PROJET_CODE
     , A.FROM_SITE
     , A.TO_SITE
     , A.YYYYMMDD
     , A.RESULT_QTY
     , A.SHIPTO_CODE
     , A.TRANSPORT_MODE
     , A.INCOTERMS
     , A.CONFIRM_ID
     , A.FCST_TYPE
     , A.CURRENCY_CODE
     , A.NET_PRICE
     , A.SALES_AMOUNT
     , A.KRW_XRATE
     , A.SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
     , A.DIVISION_ID   AS SCM_DIVISION_ID
  FROM ( SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
              , A.COMPANY_ID
              , A.PLANT_ID
              , A.ORDER_NO
              , A.DELIVERY_NO
              , A.DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
              , B.ITEM_ID
              , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN '-'
                     ELSE NVL(A.PROJECT_CODE, '-')
                END   AS PROJET_CODE
              , B.FROM_SITE
              , B.TO_SITE
              , A.EXFACTORY_DATE   AS YYYYMMDD
              , A.EXFACTORY_QTY    AS RESULT_QTY
              , A.SHIPTO_CODE
              , B.TRANSPORT_MODE
              , B.INCOTERMS
              , A.CONFIRM_ID
              , B.FCST_TYPE
              , A.CURRENCY_CODE
              , A.NET_PRICE
              , A.SALES_AMOUNT
              , A.KRW_XRATE
              , A.SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
           FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT     A
              , SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM         B
              , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL C
          WHERE B.CONFIRM_ID = A.CONFIRM_ID
            AND C.SEGMENT1   = A.SSP_TYPE
            AND C.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_SSP_TYPE'   /* LOOKUP에 등록된 공정만 */
            AND C.VALID_YN    = 'Y'
            AND NVL(A.EXFACTORY_STATUS, 'D90') NOT IN ('D90', 'D10')   /* D90: DO삭제 , D10:DO생성 */
            AND A.CONFIRM_ID LIKE 'C%'
         UNION ALL
         SELECT A.DIVISION_ID
              , A.COMPANY_ID
              , A.PLANT_ID
              , A.ORDER_NO
              , A.DELIVERY_NO
              , A.DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
              , A.ITEM_ID
              , CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN '-'
                     ELSE NVL(A.PROJECT_CODE, '-')
                END   AS PROJET_CODE
              , A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID   AS FROM_SITE
              , A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID     AS TO_SITE
              , A.EXFACTORY_DATE     AS YYYYMMDD
              , A.EXFACTORY_QTY      AS RESULT_QTY
              , A.SHIPTO_CODE
              , A.TRANSPORT_MODE
              , A.INCOTERMS
              , A.CONFIRM_ID
              , '-'   AS FCST_TYPE
              , A.CURRENCY_CODE
              , A.NET_PRICE
              , A.SALES_AMOUNT
              , A.KRW_XRATE
              , A.SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
           FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT     A
              , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM           B
              , SCM_MST_SITE                 C
              , SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL D
          WHERE B.ITEM_ID     = A.ITEM_ID
            AND B.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND C.SCM_SITE_ID = A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
            AND C.DIVISION_ID = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND D.SEGMENT1(+)    = A.DIVISION_ID
            AND D.SEGMENT2(+)    = A.SOLDTO_CODE
            AND D.SEGMENT3(+)    = A.SHIPTO_CODE
            AND D.LOOKUP_TYPE(+) = 'SHIP_RESULT_TO_SITE_MAPPING'   /* SOLDTO, SHIPTO 과 MAPPING되는 TO_SITE */
            AND A.STORAGE_ID NOT IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE
                                       FROM TABLE(FN_LIST_LOOKUP_VALUE('SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_ERP_DW_V', 'PRODUCT_STORAGE')))   /* 상품창고제외 */
            AND A.STORAGE_ID NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT1
                                       FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                      WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_SHIP_RESULT_EXCEPT_STORAGE'
                                        AND VALID_YN = 'Y')   /* 사외 창고 제외 LOOKUP 관리 */
            AND NVL(C.OSP_YN, 'N') <> 'Y'   /* FROM_SITE가 PACKER제외 */
            AND NVL(A.EXFACTORY_STATUS, 'D90') NOT IN ('D90', 'D10')   /* D90: DO삭제 , D10:DO생성 */
            AND NVL(A.CONFIRM_ID, ' ') NOT LIKE 'C%'
            AND A.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL
            AND A.TO_SCM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL ) A
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION B
 WHERE A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID

NAME: SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_ERP_V
TEXT:
SELECT X."DIVISION_ID",X."COMPANY_ID",X."PLANT_ID",X."ORDER_NO",X."DELIVERY_NO",X."DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ",X."ITEM_ID",X."PROJET_CODE",X."FROM_SITE",X."TO_SITE",X."YYYYMMDD",X."RESULT_QTY",X."SHIPTO_CODE",X."TRANSPORT_MODE",X."INCOTERMS",X."CONFIRM_ID",X."FCST_TYPE",X."CURRENCY_CODE",X."NET_PRICE",X."SALES_AMOUNT",X."KRW_XRATE",X."SALES_KRW_AMOUNT"
  FROM (SELECT E.DIVISION_ID, E.COMPANY_ID, E.PLANT_ID, E.ORDER_NO, E.DELIVERY_NO, E.DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
             , C.ITEM_ID
             , CASE WHEN E.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN '-' ELSE NVL(E.PROJECT_CODE, '-') END AS PROJET_CODE
             , C.FROM_SITE, C.TO_SITE
             , E.EXFACTORY_DATE AS YYYYMMDD
             , E.EXFACTORY_QTY  AS RESULT_QTY
             , E.SHIPTO_CODE
             , C.TRANSPORT_MODE, C.INCOTERMS
             , E.CONFIRM_ID
             , C.FCST_TYPE
             , E.CURRENCY_CODE, E.NET_PRICE, E.SALES_AMOUNT, E.KRW_XRATE, E.SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
          FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT E
          JOIN SSP_ANL_SHIP_CONFIRM C
            ON C.CONFIRM_ID = E.CONFIRM_ID
          JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L
            ON L.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'ERP_SSP_TYPE'
           AND L.VALID_YN = 'Y'
           AND L.SEGMENT1 = E.SSP_TYPE
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND NVL(E.EXFACTORY_STATUS, 'D90') NOT IN ('D90', 'D10')
           AND E.CONFIRM_ID LIKE 'C%'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT E.DIVISION_ID, E.COMPANY_ID, E.PLANT_ID, E.ORDER_NO, E.DELIVERY_NO, E.DELIVERY_ITEM_SEQ
             , E.ITEM_ID
             , CASE WHEN E.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN '-' ELSE NVL(E.PROJECT_CODE, '-') END AS PROJET_CODE
             , E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID AS FROM_SITE
             , E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID   AS TO_SITE
             , E.EXFACTORY_DATE AS YYYYMMDD
             , E.EXFACTORY_QTY  AS RESULT_QTY
             , E.SHIPTO_CODE
             , E.TRANSPORT_MODE, E.INCOTERMS
             , E.CONFIRM_ID
             , '-' AS FCST_TYPE
             , E.CURRENCY_CODE, E.NET_PRICE, E.SALES_AMOUNT, E.KRW_XRATE, E.SALES_KRW_AMOUNT
          FROM SCM_DNM_EXFACTORY_RESULT E
          JOIN SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM F
            ON F.ITEM_ID = E.ITEM_ID
           AND F.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
          JOIN SCM_MST_SITE FS
            ON FS.SCM_SITE_ID = E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID
           AND FS.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
           AND NVL(FS.OSP_YN, 'N') <> 'Y'
          LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL L3
            ON L3.LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SHIP_RESULT_TO_SITE_MAPPING'
           AND L3.SEGMENT1 = E.DIVISION_ID
           AND L3.SEGMENT2 = E.SOLDTO_CODE
           AND L3.SEGMENT3 = E.SHIPTO_CODE
         WHERE 1 = 1
           AND NVL(E.EXFACTORY_STATUS, 'D90') NOT IN ('D90', 'D10')
           AND NVL(E.CONFIRM_ID, ' ') NOT LIKE 'C%'
           AND E.FROM_SCM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL
           AND E.TO_SCM_SITE_ID IS NOT NULL
           AND E.STORAGE_ID NOT IN (SELECT COLUMN_VALUE FROM TABLE(FN_LIST_LOOKUP_VALUE('SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_ERP_V', 'PRODUCT_STORAGE')))
           AND E.STORAGE_ID NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT1 FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                     WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SSP_SHIP_RESULT_EXCEPT_STORAGE' AND VALID_YN = 'Y')) X

NAME: SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS_DW_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * Program ID   : SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS_DW_V
 * Description  : SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS 조회
                  소속 DIVISION_ID로 정보를 조회 하기 위해서
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2022.04.01   SSP Pjt.       Created
 * 2026.07.05   ZIONEX   [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
 */
 D.ATTRIBUTE3 AS DIVISION_ID
     , S.FROM_SITE
     , S.ITEM_ID
     , S.TO_SITE
     , S.CUSTOMER_CODE
     , S.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
     , S.DELIVERY_NO
     , S.PALLET_ID
     , S.LOT_ID
     , S.GRADE
     , S.STORAGE_ID
     , S.LOT_QTY
     , S.SHIP_TYPE
     , S.SHIP_STATUS
     , S.CAPACITY_GRADE
     , S.CREATION_DATE
     , S.CREATED_BY
     , S.LAST_UPDATE_DATE
     , S.LAST_UPDATED_BY
     , S.ATTRIBUTE1
     , S.ATTRIBUTE2
     , S.ATTRIBUTE3
     , S.ATTRIBUTE4
     , S.ATTRIBUTE5
     , S.ATTRIBUTE6
     , S.ATTRIBUTE7
