  FROM SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS S
     , SCM_MST_DIVISION D
 WHERE S.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID

NAME: SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/********************************************************************************************************************************
* VIEW NAME     : [SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS_V]
* DESCRIPTION   : OWMS 출하실저, 반품실적

* PROGRAM HISTORY
*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
*-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* 2019.12.04   juhlee     [C20191205-000132] OWMS 출하실적, 반품실적
* 2020.02.11   KIMYONGHO  [C20200218-000135] SHIP_TYPE 컬럼 추가
* 2026.07.05   ZIONEX   [PJ202650304] NextSCM Migration
********************************************************************************************************************************/
 X.DIVISION_ID
     , X.ITEM_ID
     , X.FROM_SITE
     , X.TO_SITE
     , X.QTY
     , X.YYYYMMDD
     , X.SHIP_TYPE
  FROM (
        SELECT A.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID
             , A.FROM_SITE AS FROM_SITE
             , CASE WHEN A.TO_SITE = '-' THEN A.CUSTOMER_CODE ELSE A.TO_SITE END AS TO_SITE
             , SUM(A.LOT_QTY) AS QTY
             , A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE AS YYYYMMDD
             , A.SHIP_TYPE AS SHIP_TYPE
          FROM SSP_DNM_SHIP_RESULT_OWMS A
         GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID
             , A.ITEM_ID
             , A.FROM_SITE
             , CASE WHEN A.TO_SITE = '-' THEN A.CUSTOMER_CODE ELSE A.TO_SITE END
             , A.PLANT_ISSUE_DATE
             , A.SHIP_TYPE
         UNION ALL
        SELECT B.DIVISION_ID AS DIVISION_ID
             , B.ITEM_ID AS ITEM_ID
             , B.FROM_SITE AS FROM_SITE
             , '*' AS TO_SITE
             , SUM(B.RECIEPT_QTY) * -1 AS QTY
             , B.RECIEPT_DATE AS YYYYMMDD
             , NULL AS SHIP_TYPE
          FROM SSP_DNM_SHIP_RETURN_OWMS B
         GROUP BY B.DIVISION_ID
             , B.ITEM_ID
             , B.FROM_SITE
             , B.RECIEPT_DATE
       ) X
     , SCP_MST_FINAL_ITEM V
 WHERE V.DIVISION_ID = X.DIVISION_ID
   AND V.ITEM_ID = X.ITEM_ID

NAME: SSP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V
TEXT:
SELECT /****************************************************************************
  * PROJECT       : LG CHEM SCP PRJ.
  * VIEW NAME     : SCM_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_WO_V
  * DESCRIPTION   : WORK ORDER DEMAND ID별 SUPPLY QTY 조회용
  *
  *
  * PROGRAM HISTORY
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
  *--------------------------------------------------------------
  * 2018-06-11   LTW         INITIAL
  * 2018.07.16   LTW         전극 SSP 작업(ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID ,ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID ,OPERATION_GROUP ,ELECTRODE_TYPE) 추가
  * 2018.09.06   LTW         소형 SSP 작업(FROM_OSP_YN ,TO_OSP_YN ,FROM_TCO_CELL_YN ,TO_TCO_CELL_YN) 추가
  *
 *************************************************************************** */  SUB.PLAN_ID
      ,SUB.MODELING_ID
      ,SUB.SEQ
      ,SUB.PLAN_NAME
      ,SUB.MASTER_ID
      ,SUB.OUT_VERSION_ID
      ,SUB.PLAN_TYPE
      ,SUB.DIVISION_ID

      ,SUB.DEMAND_PRIORITY
      ,SUB.DUE_DATE
      ,SUB.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
      ,SUB.WORK_ORDER_ID
      ,SUB.START_DTTM
      ,SUB.END_DTTM
      ,SUB.SITE_ID
      ,SUB.ITEM_ID
      ,SUB.DEMAND_ID  /* ORG DEMAND ID */
      ,SUB.ENG_DEMAND_ID  /* 엔진 DEMAND ID */
      ,SUB.SUPPLY_QTY
      ,SUB.LPST

      ,SUB.OPERATION_GROUP  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
      ,SUB.ELECTRODE_TYPE  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
      ,SUB.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID         AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
      ,SUB.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */

      ,SUB.FROM_OSP_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
      ,SUB.TO_OSP_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
      ,SUB.FROM_TCO_CELL_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
      ,SUB.TO_TCO_CELL_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */

  FROM
  (
     SELECT A.PLAN_ID
           ,A.MODELING_ID
           ,A.SEQ
           ,A.PLAN_NAME
           ,A.MASTER_ID
           ,A.OUT_VERSION_ID
           ,A.PLAN_TYPE
           ,A.DIVISION_ID
           ,A.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */

           ,MAX(A.DEMAND_PRIORITY)    AS DEMAND_PRIORITY
           ,MAX(A.DUE_DATE)           AS DUE_DATE
           ,NULL                      AS DELIVERY_ORDER_ID
           ,A.WORK_ORDER_ID
           ,MIN(A.START_TIME)         AS START_DTTM
           ,MAX(A.END_TIME)           AS END_DTTM
           ,A.SITE_ID
           ,A.ITEM_ID
           ,A.ORG_DEMAND_ID           AS DEMAND_ID
           ,A.DEMAND_ID               AS ENG_DEMAND_ID
           ,SUM(A.QTY)                AS SUPPLY_QTY
           ,MIN(A.LPST)               AS LPST

           ,MAX(A.OPERATION_GROUP)    AS OPERATION_GROUP  /* 전극 작업 추가 */
           ,MAX(A.ELECTRODE_TYPE)     AS ELECTRODE_TYPE  /* 전극 작업 추가 */
           ,A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */

           ,A.FROM_OSP_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
           ,A.TO_OSP_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
           ,A.FROM_TCO_CELL_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
           ,A.TO_TCO_CELL_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */

      FROM (
            /* SSP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN */
            SELECT PI.PLAN_ID
                  ,PI.MODELING_ID
                  ,PI.SEQ
                  ,PI.PLAN_NAME
                  ,PI.MASTER_ID
                  ,PI.OUT_VERSION_ID
                  ,PI.PLAN_TYPE
                  ,PI.DIVISION_ID
                  ,PI.DEMAND_PRIORITY
                  ,PI.DUE_DATE
                  ,PI.WORK_ORDER_ID
                  ,WO.START_TIME
                  ,WO.END_TIME
                  ,WO.SITE_ID
                  ,WO.ITEM_ID
                  ,PI.ORG_DEMAND_ID
                  ,PI.DEMAND_ID
                  ,PI.QTY
                  ,WO.LPST

                  ,WO.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */
                  ,WO.OPERATION_GROUP  /* 전극 작업 추가 */
                  ,WO.ELECTRODE_TYPE  /* 전극 작업 추가 */
                  ,PI.ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */
                  ,PI.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */

                  ,NVL(PI.ATTRIBUTE5,' ') AS FROM_OSP_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                  ,NVL(PI.ATTRIBUTE6,' ') AS TO_OSP_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                  ,NVL(PI.ATTRIBUTE7,' ') AS FROM_TCO_CELL_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                  ,NVL(PI.ATTRIBUTE8,' ') AS TO_TCO_CELL_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */

              /* FROM SCP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_SN     AS pi WITH(NOLOCK) */
              /* INNER JOIN SCP_ENG_WORK_ORDER_O_SN AS wo WITH(NOLOCK) */
              FROM SSP_ENG_PEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN     PI
              INNER JOIN SSP_ENG_WORK_ORDER_O_TEMP_SN WO
                ON 1=1
               AND PI.MODELING_ID    = WO.MODELING_ID  /* N'201'           -- */
               AND PI.MASTER_ID      = WO.MASTER_ID  /* N'81::DAILY'     -- */
               AND PI.PLAN_ID        = WO.PLAN_ID  /* N'103404'        -- */
               AND PI.PLAN_TYPE      = WO.PLAN_TYPE  /* N'SP'            -- */
               AND PI.PLAN_NAME      = WO.PLAN_NAME  /* N'20180712'      -- */
               AND PI.SEQ            = WO.SEQ  /* N'2'             -- */
               AND PI.OUT_VERSION_ID = WO.OUT_VERSION_ID  /* N'103404::SP::2' -- */
               AND PI.DIVISION_ID    = WO.DIVISION_ID  /* N'81'            -- */
               AND PI.WORK_ORDER_ID  = WO.WORK_ORDER_ID
               AND PI.FROM_ITEM_ID   = WO.ITEM_ID
             WHERE 1=1
               AND PI.WORK_ORDER_ID       IS NOT NULL
               AND PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID   IS NULL
               AND PI.STOCK_PLAN_LOT_ID   IS NULL
               AND CAST(WO.OPERATION_QTY AS NUMBER(20,10)) > 0.0
               AND ( SUBSTR(WO.OPERATION_ID,1,5) IN (  /* LOOKUP_TYPE 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION' 에 정의된 공정만 조회 */
                                                           SELECT SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID
                                                             FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                                            WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION' )
                     OR
                          WO.OPERATION_ID        IN (  /* 외주PACKER의 업체코드 */
                                                           SELECT PLANT_ID  AS OPERATION_ID
                                                            FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                                                           WHERE 1=1
                                                             AND DIVISION_ID = (CASE WHEN WO.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN WO.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
                                                                                     ELSE WO.DIVISION_ID
                                                                                END)
                                                             AND SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT'
                                                             AND OSP_YN      = 'Y'
                                                             AND VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                                         )
                   )

            UNION ALL
            /* SSP_ENG_UNPEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN */
            SELECT PI.PLAN_ID
                  ,PI.MODELING_ID
                  ,PI.SEQ
                  ,PI.PLAN_NAME
                  ,PI.MASTER_ID
                  ,PI.OUT_VERSION_ID
                  ,PI.PLAN_TYPE
                  ,PI.DIVISION_ID
                  ,NULL                    AS DEMAND_PRIORITY  /* demand_priority 없음 */
                  ,NULL                    AS DUE_DATE  /* due_date 없음 */
                  ,PI.WORK_ORDER_ID
                  ,WO.START_TIME
                  ,WO.END_TIME
                  ,WO.SITE_ID
                  ,WO.ITEM_ID
                  ,'UNPEGGING'             AS ORG_DEMAND_ID  /* org_demand_id 없음 */
                  ,'UNPEGGING'             AS DEMAND_ID  /* demand_id 없음 */
                  ,PI.COMPLETE_QTY         AS QTY
                  ,NULL                    AS LPST

                  ,WO.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */
                  ,WO.OPERATION_GROUP  /* 전극 작업 추가 */
                  ,WO.ELECTRODE_TYPE  /* 전극 작업 추가 */
                  ,WO.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID   AS ORIGIN_FROM_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */
                  ,WO.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID   AS ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극 작업 추가 */

                  ,NVL(WO.ATTRIBUTE5,' ') AS FROM_OSP_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                  ,NVL(PI.ATTRIBUTE6,' ') AS TO_OSP_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                  ,NVL(WO.ATTRIBUTE7,' ') AS FROM_TCO_CELL_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
                  ,NVL(PI.ATTRIBUTE8,' ') AS TO_TCO_CELL_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */

              /* FROM SCP_ENG_UNPEGGING_INFO_O_SN  AS pi WITH(NOLOCK) */
             /* INNER JOIN SCP_ENG_WORK_ORDER_O_SN AS wo WITH(NOLOCK) */
              FROM SSP_ENG_UNPEGGING_INFO_O_TEMP_SN  PI
             INNER JOIN SSP_ENG_WORK_ORDER_O_TEMP_SN WO
                ON 1=1
               AND PI.MODELING_ID    = WO.MODELING_ID  /* N'201'           -- */
               AND PI.MASTER_ID      = WO.MASTER_ID  /* N'81::DAILY'     -- */
               AND PI.PLAN_ID        = WO.PLAN_ID  /* N'103404'        -- */
               AND PI.PLAN_TYPE      = WO.PLAN_TYPE  /* N'SP'            -- */
               AND PI.PLAN_NAME      = WO.PLAN_NAME  /* N'20180712'      -- */
               AND PI.SEQ            = WO.SEQ  /* N'2'             -- */
               AND PI.OUT_VERSION_ID = WO.OUT_VERSION_ID  /* N'103404::SP::2' -- */
               AND PI.DIVISION_ID    = WO.DIVISION_ID  /* N'81'            -- */
               AND PI.WORK_ORDER_ID  = WO.WORK_ORDER_ID
               AND PI.ITEM_ID        = WO.ITEM_ID  /* UNPEGGING_INFO.from_item 없음 */
             WHERE 1=1
               AND PI.WORK_ORDER_ID       IS NOT NULL
               AND RTRIM(PI.WORK_ORDER_ID)     IS NOT NULL
               AND RTRIM(PI.DELIVERY_ORDER_ID) IS NULL
               /* AND pi.stock_plan_lot_id IS NULL --stock_plan_lot_id 없음 */
               AND CAST(WO.OPERATION_QTY AS NUMBER(20,10)) > 0.0
               AND ( SUBSTR(WO.OPERATION_ID,1,5) IN (  /* LOOKUP_TYPE 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION' 에 정의된 공정만 조회 */
                                                           SELECT SEGMENT1 AS OPERATION_ID
                                                             FROM SCM_ADM_LOOKUP_MASTER_DETAIL
                                                            WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE = 'SCP_PLAN_OPERATION' )
                     OR
                          WO.OPERATION_ID        IN (  /* 외주PACKER의 업체코드 */
                                                           SELECT PLANT_ID  AS OPERATION_ID
                                                            FROM SCM_MST_SITE
                                                           WHERE 1=1
                                                             AND DIVISION_ID = (CASE WHEN WO.DIVISION_ID = 'EE' THEN WO.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID
                                                                                     ELSE WO.DIVISION_ID
                                                                                END)
                                                             AND SITE_TYPE   = 'PLANT'
                                                             AND OSP_YN      = 'Y'
                                                             AND VALID_YN    = 'Y'
                                                         )
                   )

            ) A
     GROUP BY
           A.PLAN_ID
          ,A.MODELING_ID
          ,A.SEQ
          ,A.PLAN_NAME
          ,A.MASTER_ID
          ,A.OUT_VERSION_ID
          ,A.PLAN_TYPE
          ,A.DIVISION_ID
          ,A.ORIGIN_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */

          ,A.WORK_ORDER_ID
          ,A.SITE_ID
          ,A.ITEM_ID
          ,A.ORG_DEMAND_ID
          ,A.DEMAND_ID

          ,A.ORIGIN_TO_DIVISION_ID  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */

          ,A.FROM_OSP_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
          ,A.TO_OSP_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
          ,A.FROM_TCO_CELL_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */
          ,A.TO_TCO_CELL_YN  /* 전극/소형 작업 추가 */

  ) SUB

NAME: SSP_FORMATION_POST_CELL_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*

NAME: AGING_STOCK_V
TEXT:
SELECT A.COMPANY_ID
     , A.DIVISION_ID
     , A.SITE_ID
     , A.PLANT_ID
     , A.FACTORY_ID
     , A.ROUTE_ID
     , A.LINE_ID
     , A.CUTOFF_DATE
     , A.SEQ
     , A.ITEM_ID
     , A.PRODUCTION_TYPE
     , A.FCS_INPUT_DATE
     , CASE WHEN A.BEFORE_DEGAS = 'Y' THEN
                 A.AVAILABLE_DATE + NVL(CASE WHEN D.SHORTER_LT < 0 THEN FLOOR(D.SHORTER_LT)
                                             ELSE CEIL(D.SHORTER_LT) END, 0)
            ELSE A.AVAILABLE_DATE
       END                       AS AGING_AVAILABLE_DATE
     , A.REMAIN_LEAD_TIME
     , A.HOLDING_DATE
     , A.INPUT_QTY
     , A.QTY
     , A.QTY_UOM
     , A.STOCK_STATUS
     , A.OPERATION_ID
     , A.OPERATION_SEQ
     , A.OP_START_TIME
     , A.TRAY_OP_STATUS
     , A.STOCK_TYPE
     , A.WIPHOLD_YN
     , A.UNHOLD_EXP_DATE
     , A.SPECIAL_YN
     , A.LOT_ID
     , A.OCV2_END_TIME
     , A.SHIP_AVAILABLE_DATE
     , A.BEFORE_DEGAS
     , A.DEGAS_END_DATE
     , A.INSERT_ID
     , A.INSERT_TIME
     , A.UPDATE_ID
     , A.UPDATE_TIME
  FROM SCM_AGING_STOCK_H A
       LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT D.COMPANY_ID
                              , D.DIVISION_ID
                              , D.SITE_ID
                              , D.PLANT_ID
                              , D.FACTORY_ID
                              , D.LINE_ID
                              , D.ITEM_ID
                              , SUM(D.SHORTER_LT) AS SHORTER_LT
                           FROM FP_FORMATION_SHORTER_LT_M D
                          GROUP BY D.COMPANY_ID
                                 , D.DIVISION_ID
                                 , D.SITE_ID
                                 , D.PLANT_ID
                                 , D.FACTORY_ID
                                 , D.LINE_ID
                                 , D.ITEM_ID ) D
         ON  A.COMPANY_ID  = D.COMPANY_ID
         AND A.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
         AND A.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
         AND A.PLANT_ID    = D.PLANT_ID
         AND A.FACTORY_ID  = D.FACTORY_ID
         AND A.LINE_ID     = D.LINE_ID
         AND A.ITEM_ID     = D.ITEM_ID

NAME: FP_INSTANCE_INFO_V
TEXT:
(
/*******************************************************************************
 * 뷰 명       : FP_INSTANCE_INFO_V
 * 스키마      : FP_MGR
 * 설명        :
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 수정이력
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2026.03.06   jcnam        [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 설계 및 개발
 *******************************************************************************/
  SELECT /*+ USE_HASH(B C D E) */
       DISTINCT
       A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID,
       B.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_NAME,
       B.ATTRIBUTE1 AS CONFIRM_AREA,
       CASE WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE9 = 'E1' THEN 'E' ELSE B.ATTRIBUTE9 END AS INSTANCE_TYPE,
       A.SEGMENT2 AS COMPANY_ID,
       A.SEGMENT3 AS DIVISION_ID,
       A.SEGMENT4 AS SITE_ID,
       A.SEGMENT5 AS PLANT_ID,
--     ISNULL(C.SEGMENT2,'-') AS PLANNING_GROUP,
       CASE
         WHEN B.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'BUILDING' THEN E.FACTORY_ID
         ELSE NVL(C.SEGMENT2,'-')
       END AS RELEASE_GROUP,
       NVL(D.SEGMENT3,'-') AS SCP_LINE_ID
FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A
       JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE B
         ON A.SEGMENT1 = B.SEGMENT1
       LEFT JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE C
         ON C.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_PLANNING_GROUP'
        AND B.SEGMENT1 = C.SEGMENT1
        AND C.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
       LEFT JOIN (
         SELECT
           B.SITE_ID,
           B.DIVISION_ID,
           B.PLANT_ID,
           A.*
         FROM FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A
              JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M B
                ON A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
         WHERE B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
       ) E
         ON B.SEGMENT1 = E.INSTANCE_ID
        AND E.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
       LEFT JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE D
         ON D.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_SPLIT_LINE_DEFINITION'
        AND B.SEGMENT1 = D.SEGMENT1
        AND D.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
        AND E.FACTORY_ID = SUBSTR(D.SEGMENT3, 1, 2)
WHERE  A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_INFO'
  AND  B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
  AND  A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND  B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND  A.SEGMENT5 = E.PLANT_ID)

NAME: FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V
TEXT:
WITH INSTANCE_OPERATION_1 AS (SELECT
/* Program ID          : FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V */
  DISTINCT B.INSTANCE_ID
                                    , A.COMPANY_ID
                                    , A.DIVISION_ID
                                    , A.SITE_ID
                                    , A.FACTORY_ID
                                    , C.OPERATION_ID
                                    , C.INSTANCE_TYPE
                                    , C.INSTANCE_TYPE AS ORG_INSTANCE_TYPE
                                    , C.AMEND_FLAG
                                    , C.AMEND_MAIN_FLAG
                              FROM    FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M B
                                    LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M A
                                    ON  A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
                                    AND B.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y',
                                    SCM_OPERATION_M C
                              WHERE   1=1
                              AND     A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                              AND     A.COMPANY_ID = C.COMPANY_ID
                              AND     A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
                              AND     A.SITE_ID = C.SITE_ID
                              AND     B.INSTANCE_TYPE = C.INSTANCE_TYPE
                              AND     C.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                              AND     C.OPERATION_ID != 'F4500'
                              ),
     INSTANCE_OPERATION AS (SELECT  *
                            FROM    INSTANCE_OPERATION_1
                            UNION ALL
                            SELECT    A.SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID
                                    , B.COMPANY_ID
                                    , B.DIVISION_ID
                                    , B.SITE_ID
                                    , A.SEGMENT3 AS FACTORY_ID
                                    , A.SEGMENT4 AS OPERATION_ID
                                    , A.SEGMENT2 AS INSTANCE_TYPE
                                    , A.ATTRIBUTE3 AS ORG_INSTANCE_TYPE
                                    , A.ATTRIBUTE1 AS AMEND_FLAG
                                    , A.ATTRIBUTE2 AS AMEND_MAIN_FLAG
                            FROM    SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A,
                                    FP_INSTANCE_INFO_V B
                            WHERE   1=1
                            AND     A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ADD_OPERATION'
                            AND     A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                            AND     A.SEGMENT1 = B.INSTANCE_ID
                            AND     NOT EXISTS (
                                                SELECT  *
                                                FROM    INSTANCE_OPERATION_1 X
                                                WHERE   1=1
                                                AND     A.SEGMENT1 = X.INSTANCE_ID
                                                AND     A.SEGMENT3 = X.OPERATION_ID
                                                AND     A.SEGMENT2 = X.INSTANCE_TYPE
                                               )
                          ),
    OPERATION_INSTANCE AS (SELECT   A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.MODEL_TYPE, A.INSTANCE_TYPE, SUM(A.EQUIP_CNT) AS EQUIP_CNT,
                                    CASE
                                    -- NERP
                                         --WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A001' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'A' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'A010' THEN 'KR_CELL_M'

                                         --WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A009' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '81_ST' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'G821' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'P' THEN 'ST_PACK_A'
                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A009' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '81_ST' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'ST00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'A' THEN 'ST_CELL_A'
                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A009' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '81_ST' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'ST00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'E1' THEN 'ST_E_PRE_A'
                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A009' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '81_ST' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'ST00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'F' THEN 'ST_FORM_A'
                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A009' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '81_ST' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'ST00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'P' THEN 'ST_PACK_A'

                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A003' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'VP_GM01' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'A' THEN 'VP_GM_CELL_E'		--[E20260127-000749] virtual plant add
                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A003' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'VP_HD00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'A' THEN 'VP_HD_CELL_E'		--[E20260127-000749] virtual plant add
                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A003' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'VP_HD00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'P' THEN 'VP_HD_PACK_E'		--[E20260127-000749] virtual plant add
                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A003' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'VP_HD00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'E' THEN 'VP_HD_E_PRE_E'		--[E20260127-000749] virtual plant add
                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A003' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'VP_MI02' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'A' THEN 'VP_MI2_CELL_E'		--[E20260127-000749] virtual plant add
                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A009' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'VP_ST00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'P' THEN 'VP_ST_PACK_E'		--[E20260127-000749] virtual plant add
                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A009' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'VP_ST00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'A' THEN 'VP_ST_CELL_E'		--[E20260127-000749] virtual plant add

                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A003' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'AZ00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'A' THEN 'AZ_CELL_M'		--[E20260225-000965] AZ Instance 신규 세팅
                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A003' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '40' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'AZ00' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'E1' THEN 'AZ_E_PRE_M'		--[E20260225-000965] AZ Instance 신규 세팅

                                         WHEN A.SITE_ID = 'A003' AND A.DIVISION_ID = '82' AND A.PLANT_ID = 'MI04' AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'L' THEN 'US_LINK_E'	-- 2026-05-20 [PJ2026-50273] MI ESS LINK 공장 SCM(SCP/FP/PSCM ) 대응.

                                         ELSE '-' END AS INSTANCE_ID
                            FROM    (SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.LINE_ID, A.ELECTRODE_TYPE, A.OPERATION_ID, A.MODEL_TYPE, NVL(B.EQUIP_CNT, 0) AS EQUIP_CNT, C.INSTANCE_TYPE, D.INSTANCE_ID
                                     FROM   SCM_LINE_M A
                                            LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE, OPERATION_ID, COUNT(*) AS EQUIP_CNT
                                                             FROM   SCM_EQUIPMENT_M A
                                                             WHERE  1=1
                                                             AND        EQUIPMENT_TYPE = 'M'
                                                             AND        ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                             GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, LINE_ID, ELECTRODE_TYPE, OPERATION_ID) B
                                            ON  A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID
                                            AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
                                            AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID
                                            AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
                                            AND A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID
                                            AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                            AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
                                            LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT SEGMENT1 AS INSTANCE_ID, SEGMENT1 AS ORG_INSTANCE_ID, SEGMENT3 AS LINE_ID
                                                             FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE
                                                             WHERE  1=1
                                                             AND    LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_SPLIT_LINE_DEFINITION'
                                                             AND    ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                            ) D
                                            ON  1=1
                                            AND A.LINE_ID = D.LINE_ID,
                                            SCM_OPERATION_M C
                                     WHERE  1=1
                                     AND        A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                     AND        A.COMPANY_ID = C.COMPANY_ID
                                     AND        A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
                                     AND        A.SITE_ID = C.SITE_ID
                                     AND        A.OPERATION_ID = C.OPERATION_ID
                                     AND    C.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'		) A
                            WHERE   1=1
--							AND		A.EQUIP_CNT > 0
                            GROUP BY A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.PLANT_ID, A.OPERATION_ID, A.MODEL_TYPE, A.INSTANCE_TYPE, A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FACTORY_ID
                            )
SELECT  DISTINCT B.INSTANCE_ID,
        A.COMPANY_ID, A.DIVISION_ID, A.SITE_ID, A.OPERATION_ID
        , A.INSTANCE_TYPE
        , B.MODEL_TYPE
        , A.AMEND_FLAG, A.AMEND_MAIN_FLAG
FROM    INSTANCE_OPERATION A
        LEFT OUTER JOIN OPERATION_INSTANCE B
        ON  A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID
        AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
        AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID
        AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
        AND A.ORG_INSTANCE_TYPE = B.INSTANCE_TYPE
WHERE   1=1
AND     (B.INSTANCE_ID IS NOT NULL AND   B.INSTANCE_ID != '-')

NAME: FP_LAST_RELEASE_PLAN_ID_V
TEXT:
SELECT ZZ.COMPANY_ID
     , ZZ.DIVISION_ID
     , ZZ.SITE_ID
     , ZZ.PLANT_ID
     , ZZ.INSTANCE_ID
     , ZZ.INSTANCE_TYPE
     , ZZ.INSTANCE_DATE
     , ZZ.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
     , ZZ.FACTORY_ID
     , ZZ.PLAN_GROUP_ID
  FROM ( SELECT B.COMPANY_ID
              , B.DIVISION_ID
              , B.SITE_ID
              , B.PLANT_ID
              , A.INSTANCE_ID
              , B.INSTANCE_TYPE
              , A.INSTANCE_DATE
              , A.RELEASE_PLAN_ID
              , A.FACTORY_ID
              , A.PLAN_GROUP_ID
              , ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID, A.INSTANCE_ID, A.FACTORY_ID, A.PLAN_GROUP_ID
                                        ORDER BY A.INSERT_TIME DESC ) NUMS
           FROM FP_RELEASE_PLAN_INFO_H A
              , ( SELECT DISTINCT A.INSTANCE_ID
                       , A.INSTANCE_TYPE
                       , B.COMPANY_ID
                       , B.DIVISION_ID
                       , B.SITE_ID
                       , B.PLANT_ID
                       , CASE WHEN SLV.ATTRIBUTE1 = 'PLAN GROUP' THEN '-' ELSE B.FACTORY_ID END AS LINK_FACTORY_ID
                       , NVL(MP.SEGMENT2, '-') AS PLAN_GROUP_ID
                    FROM FP_INSTANCE_FACTORY_M A
                       , SCM_FACTORY_M         B
                       , SCM_OPERATION_M       O
                       , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE  SLV
                         LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE MP
                           ON  MP.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_PLANNING_GROUP'
                           AND MP.SEGMENT1         = SLV.SEGMENT1
                           AND MP.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
                           AND SLV.ATTRIBUTE1      = 'PLAN GROUP'
                   WHERE A.FACTORY_ID    = B.FACTORY_ID
                     AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG   = 'Y'
                     AND A.ACTIVE_FLAG   = B.ACTIVE_FLAG
                     AND A.INSTANCE_TYPE = O.INSTANCE_TYPE
                     AND B.COMPANY_ID    = O.COMPANY_ID
                     AND B.DIVISION_ID   = O.DIVISION_ID
                     AND B.SITE_ID       = O.SITE_ID
                     AND A.INSTANCE_ID  != 'KR_CELL_M_P'
                     AND SLV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'INSTANCE_ID'
                     AND SLV.SEGMENT1    = A.INSTANCE_ID
                     AND SLV.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                  ) B
          WHERE A.INSTANCE_ID   = B.INSTANCE_ID
            AND A.FACTORY_ID    = B.LINK_FACTORY_ID
            AND A.PLAN_GROUP_ID = B.PLAN_GROUP_ID
            AND A.INSTANCE_DATE > SYSDATE - 30
       ) ZZ
 WHERE ZZ.NUMS = 1

NAME: IF_FP_RELEASE_PLAN_V
TEXT:
WITH JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP AS (
	SELECT
/* ================================================================================================
 * Program ID          : IF_FP_RELEASE_PLAN_V
 *
 * Program Name        : IF_FP_RELEASE_PLAN_V
 * Param               :
 * Batch Period        :
 * Description         : SCP 제공용 확정 Plan
 *
 * Source System       : FP SDB
 * Destination System  : SCP SDB
 * Source Table        : FP_DAILY_PRODUCTIOIN_PLAN_H, SCM_DAILY_PRODUCT_RESULT_H, SCM_AGING_STOCK_H
 * Destination Table   :
 *
 * Create(Update) Date : 2021.12.27
 * Author              : kim choon dong
 * Version             : 2018-10-30 kimcd 소형 aging 재고, 조립 계획을 확정 계획으로 치환
 *                       2018-11-20 kimcd 소형 aging 재고, 조립 계획을 확정 계획에서 Grading : 1일 L/T
 *                                                                                   특성/포장 : 1일 L/T
 *                                         리드 타임 반영하여 계획 일자 변경
 *                       2018-11-29 kimcd 소형 조립 실적 기반으로 확정 계획 정보 형성
 *                       2019-01-29 PIYONG SCM_FORMATION_YIELD_M 테이블에 MONTH 컬럼 삭제
 *                       2019-05-20 kimcd 소형 ETW(F6200)은 WPP 기반으로 계획 반영
 *                       2019-06-03 kimcd 소형 특성은 WPP 기반으로 계획 반영
 *                                        F5300(원각특성), F5400(Pouch Grading), F5500(Pouch 특성), F5600(Pouch 특성 수작업), F6200(ETW) 공정 - WPP 전송
 *                       2019-08-29 kimcd FORMATION_MMD_ROUTE_CONVERT SEGMENT4에 COMPANY_ID 추가에 따른 수정
 *                       2019-10-02 kimcd 시업 시간별로 PLANT 조회하도록 수정
 *                       2019-12-19 kimcd E2000 공정 TEST는 S-TEST로 임시 전환
 *                       2020-01-29 kimcd E2000 공정 TEST는 S-TEST로 임시 전환 복원
 *                       2020-07-22 kimcd 소형 ETW(F6200)은 Release 기반으로 계획 반영
 *                       2021-12-27 kimcd 실적 주차 과거 1주에서 8주로 변경
 *                       2025-11-05 hrkim [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
 * 2026-07-04    ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 * 2026-10-07    AJS            FORMATION_MMD_ROUTE_CONVERT 갈래 조회 순서 지정(규칙→기준일→계획 이력 IX01) : 결과 동일, 사업부 이력 전체 읽기 제거
 * ================================================================================================ */
 VL_COMPANY_ID
		  ,VL_DIVISION_ID
		  ,VL_SITE_ID
		  ,VL_PLANT_ID
		  ,VL_FACTORY_ID
		  ,VL_LINE_ID
		  ,RL_COMPANY_ID
		  ,RL_DIVISION_ID
		  ,RL_SITE_ID
		  ,RL_PLANT_ID
		  ,RL_FACTORY_ID
		  ,RL_LINE_ID
	 FROM TABLE(SY_FN_GET_JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP())
)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- End  ### [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
SELECT NVL(MP.VL_COMPANY_ID,	DPP.COMPANY_ID		)	AS	COMPANY_ID		-- [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
      ,NVL(MP.VL_DIVISION_ID,	DPP.DIVISION_ID		)	AS	DIVISION_ID		-- [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
      ,NVL(MP.VL_SITE_ID,		DPP.SITE_ID			)	AS	SITE_ID			-- [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
      ,NVL(MP.VL_PLANT_ID,		DPP.PLANT_ID		)	AS	PLANT_ID		-- [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
      ,NVL(MP.VL_FACTORY_ID,	DPP.FACTORY_ID		)	AS	FACTORY_ID		-- [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
	  ,DPP.OPERATION_ID									AS	OPERATION_ID
      ,LOCATION
      ,TOP_ITEM_ID
      ,ITEM_ID
      ,DPP.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE  -- 2019-12-19 kimcd E2000 공정 TEST는 S-TEST로 임시 전환 2020-01-29 kimcd 복원
      ,MARKET
      ,NVL(MP.VL_LINE_ID,		DPP.LINE_ID			)	AS	LINE_ID			-- [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
      ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
      ,PLAN_DATE
      ,PLAN_QTY
      ,PLAN_IN_QTY
      ,EQUIPMENT_ID
 FROM FP_DAILY_PRODUCTIOIN_PLAN_H DPP
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Start ### [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	  LEFT JOIN JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP MP
			 ON MP.RL_COMPANY_ID	= DPP.COMPANY_ID
			AND MP.RL_DIVISION_ID	= DPP.DIVISION_ID
			AND MP.RL_SITE_ID		= DPP.SITE_ID
			AND MP.RL_PLANT_ID		= DPP.PLANT_ID
			AND MP.RL_FACTORY_ID	= DPP.FACTORY_ID
			AND MP.RL_LINE_ID		= DPP.LINE_ID
			AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X'
						  FROM SCM_ITEM_M EI
						 WHERE EI.ITEM_ID		= DPP.ITEM_ID
						   AND EI.COMPANY_ID	= MP.VL_COMPANY_ID
						   AND EI.DIVISION_ID	= MP.VL_DIVISION_ID
						   AND ROWNUM			= 1)
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- End ### [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	  CROSS JOIN (SELECT SLV.SEGMENT1
		           ,SLP.SEGMENT1  AS PLANT_ID
				   ,SLV.ATTRIBUTE1
				   ,SLV.MODIFY_DATE
		     FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE  SLV
			       ,SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE  SLP
				   ,SCM_PLANT_M           PM
			 WHERE  SLP.SEGMENT2         = SLV.SEGMENT2
			 AND    PM.SITE_ID           = SLV.SEGMENT1
			 AND    PM.PLANT_ID          = SLP.SEGMENT1
			 AND    SLV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'AUTO_PLAN_CALL_FLAG'
         AND    SLV.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
			 AND    SLP.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'BASIS_START_TIME_PLANT'
         AND    SLP.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'  )  SLV  -- 2019-10-02 kimcd 시업 시간별로 PLANT 조회하도록 수정
WHERE DPP.SITE_ID = SLV.SEGMENT1
  AND DPP.PLANT_ID  = SLV.PLANT_ID  -- 2019-10-02 kimcd 시업 시간별로 PLANT 조회하도록 수정
  AND ( ( DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'RELEASE' AND DPP.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ( 'F5300', 'F5400', 'F5500', 'F5600', 'F6200' ) )
        OR (DPP.OPERATION_ID IN ( 'F5300', 'F5400', 'F5500', 'F5600'/*, 'F6200' 2020-07-22 제외 */) AND DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'WPP')
--		OR (DPP.OPERATION_ID = 'F6200' AND ( ( DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'RELEASE' AND DPP.PLANT_ID != 'A010') OR ( DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'WPP' AND DPP.PLANT_ID = 'A010') ) ) ) -- 2019-06-03 kimcd 남경 특성 WPP 기준 전송. 2019-05-20 kimcd 소형 ETW(F6200)은 WPP 기반으로 계획 반영
		OR (DPP.OPERATION_ID = 'F6200' AND ( ( DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'RELEASE' AND DPP.PLANT_ID != 'HQ06') OR ( DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'WPP' AND DPP.PLANT_ID = 'HQ06') ) ) ) -- 2019-06-03 kimcd 남경 특성 WPP 기준 전송. 2019-05-20 kimcd 소형 ETW(F6200)은 WPP 기반으로 계획 반영
  AND ( ( DPP.PLAN_DATE >=  TO_DATE(ATTRIBUTE1 || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') AND DPP.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ( 'F5300', 'F5400', 'F5500', 'F5600', 'F6000') )
        OR (DPP.PLAN_DATE >=  CASE WHEN SLV.MODIFY_DATE + 3/24 < SYSDATE THEN TO_DATE(ATTRIBUTE1 || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') ELSE TO_DATE(ATTRIBUTE1 || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') - 1 END AND DPP.OPERATION_ID IN ( 'F5300', 'F5400', 'F5500', 'F5600', 'F6000') ) )
		-- 2019-06-03 kimcd 특성 실적 취합 조건 분리
UNION ALL
SELECT NVL(MP.VL_COMPANY_ID,	DPR.COMPANY_ID		)	AS	COMPANY_ID		-- [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
      ,NVL(MP.VL_DIVISION_ID,	DPR.DIVISION_ID		)	AS	DIVISION_ID		-- [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
      ,NVL(MP.VL_SITE_ID,		DPR.SITE_ID			)	AS	SITE_ID			-- [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
      ,NVL(MP.VL_PLANT_ID,		DPR.PLANT_ID		)	AS	PLANT_ID		-- [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
      ,NVL(MP.VL_FACTORY_ID,	DPR.FACTORY_ID		)	AS	FACTORY_ID		-- [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
	  ,DPR.OPERATION_ID									AS	OPERATION_ID
      ,LOCATION
      ,TOP_ITEM_ID
      ,ITEM_ID
	  ,DPR.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE  -- 2019-12-19 kimcd E2000 공정 TEST는 S-TEST로 임시 전환 2020-01-29 kimcd 복원
      ,MARKET
      ,NVL(MP.VL_LINE_ID,		DPR.LINE_ID			)	AS	LINE_ID			-- [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
      ,ELECTRODE_TYPE
      ,PLAN_DATE

	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- End ### [PJ2025F254][LGES] JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 : JV에 수립된 FP 계획, 실적을 MI 법인 계획으로 전환하여 정보 형성
	----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- PJ2025F254 변경전, SCM_ITEM_M            SI
	CROSS JOIN ( SELECT SLV.SEGMENT1
		           ,SLP.SEGMENT1  AS PLANT_ID
				   ,SLV.ATTRIBUTE1
		     FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE  SLV
			       ,SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE  SLP
				   ,SCM_PLANT_M           PM
			 WHERE  SLP.SEGMENT2         = SLV.SEGMENT2
			 AND    PM.SITE_ID           = SLV.SEGMENT1
			 AND    PM.PLANT_ID          = SLP.SEGMENT1
			 AND    SLV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'AUTO_PLAN_CALL_FLAG'
         AND    SLV.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
			 AND    SLP.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'BASIS_START_TIME_PLANT'
         AND    SLP.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'  )  SLV -- 2019-10-02 kimcd 시업 시간별로 PLANT 조회하도록 수정
	CROSS JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE  FLO
WHERE 1=1	-- PJ2025F254
-- PJ2025F254 변경전 WHERE DPP.SITE_ID     = SI.SITE_ID
-- PJ2025F254 변경전   AND DPP.COMPANY_ID  = SI.COMPANY_ID
-- PJ2025F254 변경전   AND DPP.DIVISION_ID = SI.DIVISION_ID
-- PJ2025F254 변경전   AND DPP.ITEM_ID     = SI.ITEM_ID
  AND DPP.SITE_ID     = SLV.SEGMENT1
  AND SLV.PLANT_ID    = DPP.PLANT_ID  -- 2019-10-02 kimcd 시업 시간별로 PLANT 조회하도록 수정
  AND DPP.SITE_ID     = FLO.SEGMENT1
  AND DPP.DIVISION_ID = FLO.SEGMENT2
  AND DPP.OPERATION_ID = FLO.SEGMENT3
  AND DPP.COMPANY_ID   = FLO.SEGMENT4 -- 2019-08-29 kimcd COMPANY_ID 추가
  AND FLO.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_MMD_ROUTE_CONVERT'
  AND FLO.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
  AND FLO.ATTRIBUTE2  = 'Y'
  AND DPP.PLAN_DATE  >=  TO_DATE(SLV.ATTRIBUTE1 || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYYMMDD HH24:MI:SS') - NVL(( SELECT ST_SUM
													 FROM   ( SELECT NVL(AIF.ROUTE_TOTAL_TIME/14400.0,0.0) + NVL(AIF.REMAIN_TIME/1440.0, 0.0)  AS ST_SUM
																   , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AIF.OPERATION_SEQ, OPERATION_STEP) AS ROW_NUM
															  FROM   SCM_AGING_ITEM_FLOW_M  AIF
															  WHERE  AIF.DEFAULT_ROUTE = 'Y'
															  AND   AIF.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'B' -- 기본 Route
															  AND   AIF.COMPANY_ID   = DPP.COMPANY_ID
															  AND   AIF.DIVISION_ID  = DPP.DIVISION_ID
															  AND   AIF.SITE_ID      = DPP.SITE_ID
															  AND   AIF.PLANT_ID     = DPP.PLANT_ID
															  AND   AIF.FACTORY_ID   = DPP.FACTORY_ID
															  AND   AIF.ITEM_ID      = DPP.ITEM_ID
															  AND   AIF.LINE_ID      = (SELECT FL.SEGMENT2
																						FROM   SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE  FL
																						WHERE  FL.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_LINE_MAPPING'
																						AND    FL.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
																						AND    FL.SEGMENT1 = DPP.SITE_ID
																						AND    FL.SEGMENT5 = DPP.LINE_ID
																						AND    ROWNUM = 1)) AIF
													 WHERE ROW_NUM = 1), TO_NUMBER(FLO.ATTRIBUTE3) ) - 2
-- 2018-11-29 kimcd 조립 실적 기반으로 특성 계획 형성 추가 종료

NAME: IF_FP_WEEK_RELEASE_PLAN_V
TEXT:
WITH TUESDAY AS (
    SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') + 1 AS TUESDAY FROM DUAL  -- MSSQL: DATEADD(D,1,DATEADD(WK,DATEDIFF(WK,0,GETDATE()),0)) = 당주 화요일
)
, JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP AS (
    SELECT VL_COMPANY_ID
          ,VL_DIVISION_ID
          ,VL_SITE_ID
          ,VL_PLANT_ID
          ,VL_FACTORY_ID
          ,VL_LINE_ID
          ,RL_COMPANY_ID
          ,RL_DIVISION_ID
          ,RL_SITE_ID
          ,RL_PLANT_ID
          ,RL_FACTORY_ID
          ,RL_LINE_ID
      FROM FP_MGR.SY_FN_GET_JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP()
)
SELECT NVL(MP.VL_COMPANY_ID,  DPP.COMPANY_ID )   AS COMPANY_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_DIVISION_ID, DPP.DIVISION_ID)   AS DIVISION_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_SITE_ID,     DPP.SITE_ID    )   AS SITE_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_PLANT_ID,    DPP.PLANT_ID   )   AS PLANT_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_FACTORY_ID,  DPP.FACTORY_ID )   AS FACTORY_ID
      ,DPP.OPERATION_ID                          AS OPERATION_ID
      ,DPP.LOCATION
      ,DPP.TOP_ITEM_ID
      ,DPP.ITEM_ID
      ,DPP.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
      ,DPP.MARKET
      ,NVL(MP.VL_LINE_ID,     DPP.LINE_ID    )   AS LINE_ID
      ,DPP.ELECTRODE_TYPE
      ,DPP.PLAN_DATE
      ,DPP.PLAN_QTY
      ,DPP.PLAN_IN_QTY
      ,DPP.EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM FP_MGR.FP_DAILY_PRODUCTIOIN_PLAN_H DPP
       LEFT JOIN JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP MP
              ON MP.RL_COMPANY_ID  = DPP.COMPANY_ID
             AND MP.RL_DIVISION_ID = DPP.DIVISION_ID
             AND MP.RL_SITE_ID     = DPP.SITE_ID
             AND MP.RL_PLANT_ID    = DPP.PLANT_ID
             AND MP.RL_FACTORY_ID  = DPP.FACTORY_ID
             AND MP.RL_LINE_ID     = DPP.LINE_ID
             AND EXISTS (SELECT /*+ NO_UNNEST */ 'X'
                           FROM FP_MGR.SCM_ITEM_M EI
                          WHERE EI.ITEM_ID     = DPP.ITEM_ID
                            AND EI.COMPANY_ID  = MP.VL_COMPANY_ID
                            AND EI.DIVISION_ID = MP.VL_DIVISION_ID)
 WHERE ( ( DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'RELEASE' AND DPP.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ('F5300','F5400','F5500','F5600','F6200') )
        OR ( DPP.OPERATION_ID IN ('F5300','F5400','F5500','F5600') AND DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'WPP' )
        OR ( DPP.OPERATION_ID = 'F6200'
             AND ( ( DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'RELEASE'
                     AND DPP.PLANT_ID NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM FP_MGR.SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE
                                               WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'IF_FP_WEEK_RELEASE_PLAN_V' AND SEGMENT1 = '3' AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') )
                OR ( DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'WPP'
                     AND DPP.PLANT_ID NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM FP_MGR.SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE
                                               WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'IF_FP_WEEK_RELEASE_PLAN_V' AND SEGMENT1 = '3' AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') ) ) ) )
   AND DPP.PLAN_DATE >= (SELECT M.TUESDAY FROM TUESDAY M)
UNION ALL
SELECT NVL(MP.VL_COMPANY_ID,  DPR.COMPANY_ID )   AS COMPANY_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_DIVISION_ID, DPR.DIVISION_ID)   AS DIVISION_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_SITE_ID,     DPR.SITE_ID    )   AS SITE_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_PLANT_ID,    DPR.PLANT_ID   )   AS PLANT_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_FACTORY_ID,  DPR.FACTORY_ID )   AS FACTORY_ID
      ,DPR.OPERATION_ID                          AS OPERATION_ID
      ,DPR.LOCATION
      ,DPR.TOP_ITEM_ID
      ,DPR.ITEM_ID
      ,DPR.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
      ,DPR.MARKET
      ,NVL(MP.VL_LINE_ID,     DPR.LINE_ID    )   AS LINE_ID
      ,DPR.ELECTRODE_TYPE
      ,DPR.PLAN_DATE
      ,DPR.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY                       -- OUT 수량
      ,DPR.ACTUAL_QTY                            -- IN 수량
      ,DPR.EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM FP_MGR.SCM_DAILY_PRODUCT_RESULT_H DPR
       LEFT JOIN JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP MP
              ON MP.RL_COMPANY_ID  = DPR.COMPANY_ID
             AND MP.RL_DIVISION_ID = DPR.DIVISION_ID
             AND MP.RL_SITE_ID     = DPR.SITE_ID
             AND MP.RL_PLANT_ID    = DPR.PLANT_ID
             AND MP.RL_FACTORY_ID  = DPR.FACTORY_ID
             AND MP.RL_LINE_ID     = DPR.LINE_ID
             AND EXISTS (SELECT /*+ NO_UNNEST */ 'X'
                           FROM FP_MGR.SCM_ITEM_M EI
                          WHERE EI.ITEM_ID     = DPR.ITEM_ID
                            AND EI.COMPANY_ID  = MP.VL_COMPANY_ID
                            AND EI.DIVISION_ID = MP.VL_DIVISION_ID)
 WHERE DPR.PLAN_DATE <  (SELECT M.TUESDAY FROM TUESDAY M)
   AND DPR.PLAN_DATE >= (SELECT M.TUESDAY FROM TUESDAY M) - 57   -- DATEADD(D,-1,DATEADD(wk,-8,TUESDAY)) = TUESDAY - 56 - 1
UNION ALL
SELECT NVL(MP.VL_COMPANY_ID,  DPP.COMPANY_ID )   AS COMPANY_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_DIVISION_ID, DPP.DIVISION_ID)   AS DIVISION_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_SITE_ID,     DPP.SITE_ID    )   AS SITE_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_PLANT_ID,    DPP.PLANT_ID   )   AS PLANT_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_FACTORY_ID,  DPP.FACTORY_ID )   AS FACTORY_ID
      ,SUBSTR(SI.FORMATION_FLOW_ID, -5)          AS OPERATION_ID  -- RIGHT(SI.FORMATION_FLOW_ID,5)
      ,DPP.LOCATION
      ,DPP.TOP_ITEM_ID
      ,DPP.ITEM_ID
      ,DPP.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
      ,DPP.MARKET
      ,NVL(MP.VL_LINE_ID,
           (SELECT FL.SEGMENT2
              FROM FP_MGR.SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FL
             WHERE FL.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_LINE_MAPPING'
               AND FL.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
               AND FL.SEGMENT1         = DPP.SITE_ID
               AND FL.SEGMENT5         = DPP.LINE_ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1) )       AS LINE_ID
      ,'-'                             AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
      ,DPP.PLAN_DATE + ( NVL( ( SELECT ST_SUM
                                  FROM ( SELECT NVL(AIF.ROUTE_TOTAL_TIME/14400.0, 0.0) + NVL(AIF.REMAIN_TIME/1440.0, 0.0) AS ST_SUM
                                              , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AIF.OPERATION_SEQ, AIF.OPERATION_STEP) AS ROW_NUM
                                           FROM FP_MGR.SCM_AGING_ITEM_FLOW_M AIF
                                          WHERE AIF.DEFAULT_ROUTE = 'Y'
                                            AND AIF.DEFAULT_FLAG   = 'B'   -- 기본 Route
                                            AND AIF.COMPANY_ID     = DPP.COMPANY_ID
                                            AND AIF.DIVISION_ID    = DPP.DIVISION_ID
                                            AND AIF.SITE_ID        = DPP.SITE_ID
                                            AND AIF.PLANT_ID       = DPP.PLANT_ID
                                            AND AIF.FACTORY_ID     = DPP.FACTORY_ID
                                            AND AIF.ITEM_ID        = DPP.ITEM_ID
                                            AND AIF.LINE_ID        = (SELECT FL.SEGMENT2
                                                                        FROM FP_MGR.SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FL
                                                                       WHERE FL.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_LINE_MAPPING'
                                                                         AND FL.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                                         AND FL.SEGMENT1 = DPP.SITE_ID
                                                                         AND FL.SEGMENT5 = DPP.LINE_ID
                                                                         AND ROWNUM = 1) ) AIF
                                         WHERE ROW_NUM = 1 )
                            , TO_NUMBER(FLO.ATTRIBUTE3) ) + 2 )   AS PLAN_DATE  -- grading, 특성 lead time 2일 추가
      ,FLOOR(DPP.PLAN_QTY * NVL( ( SELECT CASE WHEN D.FORMATION_TOTAL_YIELD = 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.FORMATION_TOTAL_YIELD END
                                        * CASE WHEN D.CHARACTERIZATION_YIELD = 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.CHARACTERIZATION_YIELD END
                                     FROM FP_MGR.SCM_FORMATION_YIELD_M D
                                    WHERE DPP.COMPANY_ID  = D.COMPANY_ID
                                      AND DPP.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                                      AND DPP.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
                                      AND DPP.PLANT_ID    = D.PLANT_ID
                                      AND DPP.FACTORY_ID  = D.FACTORY_ID
                                      AND DPP.ITEM_ID     = D.ITEM_ID
                                      AND DPP.LINE_ID     = D.LINE_ID ), 1)) AS PLAN_QTY
      ,DPP.PLAN_QTY                   AS PLAN_IN_QTY
      ,'-'                            AS EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM FP_MGR.FP_DAILY_PRODUCTIOIN_PLAN_H DPP
       INNER JOIN FP_MGR.SCM_ITEM_M SI
               ON SI.ITEM_ID     = DPP.ITEM_ID
              AND SI.COMPANY_ID  = DPP.COMPANY_ID
              AND SI.DIVISION_ID = DPP.DIVISION_ID
              AND SI.SITE_ID     = DPP.SITE_ID
       LEFT JOIN JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP MP
              ON MP.RL_COMPANY_ID  = DPP.COMPANY_ID
             AND MP.RL_DIVISION_ID = DPP.DIVISION_ID
             AND MP.RL_SITE_ID     = DPP.SITE_ID
             AND MP.RL_PLANT_ID    = DPP.PLANT_ID
             AND MP.RL_FACTORY_ID  = DPP.FACTORY_ID
             AND MP.RL_LINE_ID     = DPP.LINE_ID
             AND EXISTS (SELECT /*+ NO_UNNEST */ 'X'
                           FROM FP_MGR.SCM_ITEM_M EI
                          WHERE EI.ITEM_ID     = DPP.ITEM_ID
                            AND EI.COMPANY_ID  = MP.VL_COMPANY_ID
                            AND EI.DIVISION_ID = MP.VL_DIVISION_ID)
       CROSS JOIN FP_MGR.SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FLO
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND DPP.SITE_ID      = FLO.SEGMENT1
   AND DPP.DIVISION_ID  = FLO.SEGMENT2
   AND DPP.OPERATION_ID = FLO.SEGMENT3
   AND DPP.COMPANY_ID   = FLO.SEGMENT4
   AND FLO.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_MMD_ROUTE_CONVERT'
   AND FLO.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
   AND FLO.ATTRIBUTE2   = 'Y'
   AND DPP.PLAN_TYPE    = 'RELEASE'
   AND DPP.PLAN_DATE   >= (SELECT M.TUESDAY FROM TUESDAY M)
UNION ALL
-- 조립 실적 기반으로 특성 계획 형성
SELECT NVL(MP.VL_COMPANY_ID,  DPP.COMPANY_ID )   AS COMPANY_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_DIVISION_ID, DPP.DIVISION_ID)   AS DIVISION_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_SITE_ID,     DPP.SITE_ID    )   AS SITE_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_PLANT_ID,    DPP.PLANT_ID   )   AS PLANT_ID
      ,NVL(MP.VL_FACTORY_ID,  DPP.FACTORY_ID )   AS FACTORY_ID
      ,SUBSTR(SI.FORMATION_FLOW_ID, -5)          AS OPERATION_ID
      ,DPP.LOCATION
      ,DPP.TOP_ITEM_ID
      ,DPP.ITEM_ID
      ,DPP.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE
      ,DPP.MARKET
      ,NVL(MP.VL_LINE_ID,
           (SELECT FL.SEGMENT2
              FROM FP_MGR.SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FL
             WHERE FL.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_LINE_MAPPING'
               AND FL.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
               AND FL.SEGMENT1         = DPP.SITE_ID
               AND FL.SEGMENT5         = DPP.LINE_ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1) )       AS LINE_ID
      ,'-'                             AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
      ,DPP.PLAN_DATE + ( NVL( ( SELECT ST_SUM
                                  FROM ( SELECT NVL(AIF.ROUTE_TOTAL_TIME/14400.0, 0.0) + NVL(AIF.REMAIN_TIME/1440.0, 0.0) AS ST_SUM
                                              , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AIF.OPERATION_SEQ, AIF.OPERATION_STEP) AS ROW_NUM
                                           FROM FP_MGR.SCM_AGING_ITEM_FLOW_M AIF
                                          WHERE AIF.DEFAULT_ROUTE = 'Y'
                                            AND AIF.DEFAULT_FLAG   = 'B'   -- 기본 Route
                                            AND AIF.COMPANY_ID     = DPP.COMPANY_ID
                                            AND AIF.DIVISION_ID    = DPP.DIVISION_ID
                                            AND AIF.SITE_ID        = DPP.SITE_ID
                                            AND AIF.PLANT_ID       = DPP.PLANT_ID
                                            AND AIF.FACTORY_ID     = DPP.FACTORY_ID
                                            AND AIF.ITEM_ID        = DPP.ITEM_ID
                                            AND AIF.LINE_ID        = (SELECT FL.SEGMENT2
                                                                        FROM FP_MGR.SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FL
                                                                       WHERE FL.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_LINE_MAPPING'
                                                                         AND FL.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                                         AND FL.SEGMENT1 = DPP.SITE_ID
                                                                         AND FL.SEGMENT5 = DPP.LINE_ID
                                                                         AND ROWNUM = 1) ) AIF
                                         WHERE ROW_NUM = 1 )
                            , TO_NUMBER(FLO.ATTRIBUTE3) ) + 2 )   AS PLAN_DATE
      ,FLOOR(DPP.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY * NVL( ( SELECT CASE WHEN D.FORMATION_TOTAL_YIELD = 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.FORMATION_TOTAL_YIELD END
                                               * CASE WHEN D.CHARACTERIZATION_YIELD = 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.CHARACTERIZATION_YIELD END
                                            FROM FP_MGR.SCM_FORMATION_YIELD_M D
                                           WHERE DPP.COMPANY_ID  = D.COMPANY_ID
                                             AND DPP.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID
                                             AND DPP.SITE_ID     = D.SITE_ID
                                             AND DPP.PLANT_ID    = D.PLANT_ID
                                             AND DPP.FACTORY_ID  = D.FACTORY_ID
                                             AND DPP.ITEM_ID     = D.ITEM_ID
                                             AND DPP.LINE_ID     = D.LINE_ID ), 1)) AS PLAN_QTY
      ,DPP.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY            AS PLAN_IN_QTY
      ,'-'                            AS EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM FP_MGR.SCM_DAILY_PRODUCT_RESULT_H DPP
       INNER JOIN FP_MGR.SCM_ITEM_M SI
               ON SI.ITEM_ID     = DPP.ITEM_ID
              AND SI.COMPANY_ID  = DPP.COMPANY_ID
              AND SI.DIVISION_ID = DPP.DIVISION_ID
              AND SI.SITE_ID     = DPP.SITE_ID
       LEFT JOIN JV_REAL_ESS_VIRTUAL_LINE_MAP MP
              ON MP.RL_COMPANY_ID  = DPP.COMPANY_ID
             AND MP.RL_DIVISION_ID = DPP.DIVISION_ID
             AND MP.RL_SITE_ID     = DPP.SITE_ID
             AND MP.RL_PLANT_ID    = DPP.PLANT_ID
             AND MP.RL_FACTORY_ID  = DPP.FACTORY_ID
             AND MP.RL_LINE_ID     = DPP.LINE_ID
             AND EXISTS (SELECT /*+ NO_UNNEST */ 'X'
                           FROM FP_MGR.SCM_ITEM_M EI
                          WHERE EI.ITEM_ID     = DPP.ITEM_ID
                            AND EI.COMPANY_ID  = MP.VL_COMPANY_ID
                            AND EI.DIVISION_ID = MP.VL_DIVISION_ID)
       CROSS JOIN FP_MGR.SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FLO
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND DPP.SITE_ID      = FLO.SEGMENT1
   AND DPP.DIVISION_ID  = FLO.SEGMENT2
   AND DPP.OPERATION_ID = FLO.SEGMENT3
   AND DPP.COMPANY_ID   = FLO.SEGMENT4
   AND FLO.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_MMD_ROUTE_CONVERT'
   AND FLO.ACTIVE_FLAG  = 'Y'
   AND FLO.ATTRIBUTE2   = 'Y'
   AND DPP.PLAN_DATE   >= (SELECT M.TUESDAY FROM TUESDAY M)
                          - ( NVL( ( SELECT ST_SUM
                                       FROM ( SELECT NVL(AIF.ROUTE_TOTAL_TIME/14400.0, 0.0) + NVL(AIF.REMAIN_TIME/1440.0, 0.0) AS ST_SUM
                                                   , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AIF.OPERATION_SEQ, AIF.OPERATION_STEP) AS ROW_NUM
                                                FROM FP_MGR.SCM_AGING_ITEM_FLOW_M AIF
                                               WHERE AIF.DEFAULT_ROUTE = 'Y'
                                                 AND AIF.DEFAULT_FLAG   = 'B'
                                                 AND AIF.COMPANY_ID     = DPP.COMPANY_ID
                                                 AND AIF.DIVISION_ID    = DPP.DIVISION_ID
                                                 AND AIF.SITE_ID        = DPP.SITE_ID
                                                 AND AIF.PLANT_ID       = DPP.PLANT_ID
                                                 AND AIF.FACTORY_ID     = DPP.FACTORY_ID
                                                 AND AIF.ITEM_ID        = DPP.ITEM_ID
                                                 AND AIF.LINE_ID        = (SELECT FL.SEGMENT2
                                                                             FROM FP_MGR.SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FL
                                                                            WHERE FL.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_LINE_MAPPING'
                                                                              AND FL.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                                              AND FL.SEGMENT1 = DPP.SITE_ID
                                                                              AND FL.SEGMENT5 = DPP.LINE_ID
                                                                              AND ROWNUM = 1) ) AIF
                                              WHERE ROW_NUM = 1 )
                                 , TO_NUMBER(FLO.ATTRIBUTE3) ) + 2 )   -- DATEADD(DAY, -ISNULL(..)-2, TUESDAY)

NAME: IF_SSP_FP_RELEASE_PLAN_V
TEXT:
SELECT DPP.COMPANY_ID, DPP.DIVISION_ID, DPP.SITE_ID, DPP.PLANT_ID, DPP.FACTORY_ID, DPP.OPERATION_ID
     , DPP.LOCATION, DPP.TOP_ITEM_ID, DPP.ITEM_ID, DPP.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE, DPP.MARKET, DPP.LINE_ID, DPP.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , DPP.PLAN_DATE, DPP.PLAN_QTY, DPP.PLAN_IN_QTY, DPP.EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM FP_DAILY_PRODUCTIOIN_PLAN_H DPP
     , (SELECT SLV.SEGMENT1, SLP.SEGMENT1 AS PLANT_ID, SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, SLV.MODIFY_DATE
          FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SLV, SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SLP, SCM_PLANT_M PM
         WHERE SLP.SEGMENT2 = SLV.SEGMENT2
           AND PM.SITE_ID = SLV.SEGMENT1
           AND PM.PLANT_ID = SLP.SEGMENT1
           AND SLV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'AUTO_PLAN_CALL_FLAG' AND SLV.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND SLP.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'BASIS_START_TIME_PLANT' AND SLP.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') SLV
 WHERE DPP.SITE_ID = SLV.SEGMENT1
   AND DPP.PLANT_ID = SLV.PLANT_ID
   AND ((DPP.PLAN_TYPE = CASE WHEN DPP.PLANT_ID = (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'IF_SSP_FP_RELEASE_PLAN_V' AND SEGMENT1 = '0' AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) THEN 'SSP' ELSE 'RELEASE' END
         AND DPP.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ('F5300', 'F5400', 'F5500', 'F5600', 'F6200'))
     OR (DPP.OPERATION_ID IN ('F5300', 'F5400', 'F5500', 'F5600') AND DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'WPP')
     OR (DPP.OPERATION_ID = 'F6200' AND ((DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'RELEASE' AND DPP.PLANT_ID NOT IN (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'IF_SSP_FP_RELEASE_PLAN_V' AND SEGMENT1 = '0' AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'))
                                       OR (DPP.PLAN_TYPE = 'WPP' AND DPP.PLANT_ID IN (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'IF_SSP_FP_RELEASE_PLAN_V' AND SEGMENT1 = '0' AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y')))))
   AND ((DPP.PLAN_DATE >= TO_DATE(SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND DPP.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ('F5300', 'F5400', 'F5500', 'F5600', 'F6000'))
     OR (DPP.PLAN_DATE >= CASE WHEN SLV.MODIFY_DATE + 3 / 24 < SYSDATE THEN TO_DATE(SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE TO_DATE(SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1 END AND DPP.OPERATION_ID IN ('F5300', 'F5400', 'F5500', 'F5600', 'F6000')))
UNION ALL
SELECT DPR.COMPANY_ID, DPR.DIVISION_ID, DPR.SITE_ID, DPR.PLANT_ID, DPR.FACTORY_ID, DPR.OPERATION_ID
     , DPR.LOCATION, DPR.TOP_ITEM_ID, DPR.ITEM_ID, DPR.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE, DPR.MARKET, DPR.LINE_ID, DPR.ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , DPR.PLAN_DATE, DPR.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY, DPR.ACTUAL_QTY, DPR.EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM SCM_DAILY_PRODUCT_RESULT_H DPR
     , (SELECT SLV.SEGMENT1, SLP.SEGMENT1 AS PLANT_ID, SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, SLV.MODIFY_DATE
          FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SLV, SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SLP, SCM_PLANT_M PM
         WHERE SLP.SEGMENT2 = SLV.SEGMENT2
           AND PM.SITE_ID = SLV.SEGMENT1
           AND PM.PLANT_ID = SLP.SEGMENT1
           AND SLV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'AUTO_PLAN_CALL_FLAG' AND SLV.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND SLP.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'BASIS_START_TIME_PLANT' AND SLP.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') SLV
 WHERE DPR.SITE_ID = SLV.SEGMENT1
   AND SLV.PLANT_ID = DPR.PLANT_ID
   AND ((DPR.PLAN_DATE < TO_DATE(SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND DPR.OPERATION_ID NOT IN ('F5300', 'F5400', 'F5500', 'F5600', 'F6000'))
     OR (DPR.PLAN_DATE < CASE WHEN SLV.MODIFY_DATE + 3 / 24 < SYSDATE THEN TO_DATE(SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD') ELSE TO_DATE(SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD') - 1 END AND DPR.OPERATION_ID IN ('F5300', 'F5400', 'F5500', 'F5600', 'F6000')))
   AND DPR.PLAN_DATE >= TRUNC(TO_DATE(SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'IW') - 56
UNION ALL
SELECT DPP.COMPANY_ID, DPP.DIVISION_ID, DPP.SITE_ID, DPP.PLANT_ID, DPP.FACTORY_ID
     , SUBSTR(SI.FORMATION_FLOW_ID, GREATEST(LENGTH(SI.FORMATION_FLOW_ID) - 4, 1)) AS OPERATION_ID
     , DPP.LOCATION, DPP.TOP_ITEM_ID, DPP.ITEM_ID, DPP.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE, DPP.MARKET
     , (SELECT FL.SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FL
         WHERE FL.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_LINE_MAPPING' AND FL.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND FL.SEGMENT1 = DPP.SITE_ID AND FL.SEGMENT5 = DPP.LINE_ID FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS LINE_ID
     , '-' AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , DPP.PLAN_DATE + (NVL((SELECT ST_SUM
                               FROM (SELECT NVL(AIF.ROUTE_TOTAL_TIME / 14400.0, 0.0) + NVL(AIF.REMAIN_TIME / 1440.0, 0.0) AS ST_SUM
                                          , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AIF.OPERATION_SEQ, OPERATION_STEP) AS ROW_NUM
                                       FROM SCM_AGING_ITEM_FLOW_M AIF
                                      WHERE AIF.DEFAULT_ROUTE = 'Y' AND AIF.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'B'
                                        AND AIF.COMPANY_ID = DPP.COMPANY_ID AND AIF.DIVISION_ID = DPP.DIVISION_ID
                                        AND AIF.SITE_ID = DPP.SITE_ID AND AIF.PLANT_ID = DPP.PLANT_ID
                                        AND AIF.FACTORY_ID = DPP.FACTORY_ID AND AIF.ITEM_ID = DPP.ITEM_ID
                                        AND AIF.LINE_ID = (SELECT FL.SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FL
                                                            WHERE FL.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_LINE_MAPPING' AND FL.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                              AND FL.SEGMENT1 = DPP.SITE_ID AND FL.SEGMENT5 = DPP.LINE_ID FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY))
                              WHERE ROW_NUM = 1), TO_NUMBER(FLO.ATTRIBUTE3)) + 2) AS PLAN_DATE
     , FLOOR(DPP.PLAN_QTY * NVL((SELECT CASE WHEN D.FORMATION_TOTAL_YIELD = 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.FORMATION_TOTAL_YIELD END * CASE WHEN D.CHARACTERIZATION_YIELD = 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.CHARACTERIZATION_YIELD END
                                   FROM SCM_FORMATION_YIELD_M D
                                  WHERE DPP.COMPANY_ID = D.COMPANY_ID AND DPP.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID AND DPP.SITE_ID = D.SITE_ID
                                    AND DPP.PLANT_ID = D.PLANT_ID AND DPP.FACTORY_ID = D.FACTORY_ID AND DPP.ITEM_ID = D.ITEM_ID AND DPP.LINE_ID = D.LINE_ID), 1)) AS PLAN_QTY
     , DPP.PLAN_QTY AS PLAN_IN_QTY
     , '-' AS EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM FP_DAILY_PRODUCTIOIN_PLAN_H DPP
     , SCM_ITEM_M SI
     , (SELECT SLV.SEGMENT1, SLP.SEGMENT1 AS PLANT_ID, SLV.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SLV, SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SLP, SCM_PLANT_M PM
         WHERE SLP.SEGMENT2 = SLV.SEGMENT2
           AND PM.SITE_ID = SLV.SEGMENT1
           AND PM.PLANT_ID = SLP.SEGMENT1
           AND SLV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'AUTO_PLAN_CALL_FLAG' AND SLV.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND SLP.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'BASIS_START_TIME_PLANT' AND SLP.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') SLV
     , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FLO
 WHERE DPP.SITE_ID = SI.SITE_ID AND DPP.COMPANY_ID = SI.COMPANY_ID AND DPP.DIVISION_ID = SI.DIVISION_ID AND DPP.ITEM_ID = SI.ITEM_ID
   AND DPP.SITE_ID = SLV.SEGMENT1 AND DPP.PLANT_ID = SLV.PLANT_ID
   AND DPP.SITE_ID = FLO.SEGMENT1 AND DPP.DIVISION_ID = FLO.SEGMENT2 AND DPP.OPERATION_ID = FLO.SEGMENT3 AND DPP.COMPANY_ID = FLO.SEGMENT4
   AND FLO.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_MMD_ROUTE_CONVERT' AND FLO.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND FLO.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
   AND DPP.PLAN_TYPE = CASE WHEN DPP.PLANT_ID = (SELECT SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_CODE_LOOKUP_VALUE WHERE LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'IF_SSP_FP_RELEASE_PLAN_V' AND SEGMENT1 = '0' AND ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) THEN 'SSP' ELSE 'RELEASE' END
   AND DPP.PLAN_DATE >= TO_DATE(SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD')
UNION ALL
SELECT DPP.COMPANY_ID, DPP.DIVISION_ID, DPP.SITE_ID, DPP.PLANT_ID, DPP.FACTORY_ID
     , SUBSTR(SI.FORMATION_FLOW_ID, GREATEST(LENGTH(SI.FORMATION_FLOW_ID) - 4, 1)) AS OPERATION_ID
     , DPP.LOCATION, DPP.TOP_ITEM_ID, DPP.ITEM_ID, DPP.FP_PRODUCTION_TYPE, DPP.MARKET
     , (SELECT FL.SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FL
         WHERE FL.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_LINE_MAPPING' AND FL.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND FL.SEGMENT1 = DPP.SITE_ID AND FL.SEGMENT5 = DPP.LINE_ID FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) AS LINE_ID
     , '-' AS ELECTRODE_TYPE
     , DPP.PLAN_DATE + (NVL((SELECT ST_SUM
                               FROM (SELECT NVL(AIF.ROUTE_TOTAL_TIME / 14400.0, 0.0) + NVL(AIF.REMAIN_TIME / 1440.0, 0.0) AS ST_SUM
                                          , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AIF.OPERATION_SEQ, OPERATION_STEP) AS ROW_NUM
                                       FROM SCM_AGING_ITEM_FLOW_M AIF
                                      WHERE AIF.DEFAULT_ROUTE = 'Y' AND AIF.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'B'
                                        AND AIF.COMPANY_ID = DPP.COMPANY_ID AND AIF.DIVISION_ID = DPP.DIVISION_ID
                                        AND AIF.SITE_ID = DPP.SITE_ID AND AIF.PLANT_ID = DPP.PLANT_ID
                                        AND AIF.FACTORY_ID = DPP.FACTORY_ID AND AIF.ITEM_ID = DPP.ITEM_ID
                                        AND AIF.LINE_ID = (SELECT FL.SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FL
                                                            WHERE FL.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_LINE_MAPPING' AND FL.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                              AND FL.SEGMENT1 = DPP.SITE_ID AND FL.SEGMENT5 = DPP.LINE_ID FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY))
                              WHERE ROW_NUM = 1), TO_NUMBER(FLO.ATTRIBUTE3)) + 2) AS PLAN_DATE
     , FLOOR(DPP.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY * NVL((SELECT CASE WHEN D.FORMATION_TOTAL_YIELD = 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.FORMATION_TOTAL_YIELD END * CASE WHEN D.CHARACTERIZATION_YIELD = 0 THEN 1 ELSE D.CHARACTERIZATION_YIELD END
                                         FROM SCM_FORMATION_YIELD_M D
                                        WHERE DPP.COMPANY_ID = D.COMPANY_ID AND DPP.DIVISION_ID = D.DIVISION_ID AND DPP.SITE_ID = D.SITE_ID
                                          AND DPP.PLANT_ID = D.PLANT_ID AND DPP.FACTORY_ID = D.FACTORY_ID AND DPP.ITEM_ID = D.ITEM_ID AND DPP.LINE_ID = D.LINE_ID), 1)) AS PLAN_QTY
     , DPP.ACTUAL_GOOD_QTY AS PLAN_IN_QTY
     , '-' AS EQUIPMENT_ID
  FROM SCM_DAILY_PRODUCT_RESULT_H DPP
     , SCM_ITEM_M SI
     , (SELECT SLV.SEGMENT1, SLP.SEGMENT1 AS PLANT_ID, SLV.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SLV, SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SLP, SCM_PLANT_M PM
         WHERE SLP.SEGMENT2 = SLV.SEGMENT2
           AND PM.SITE_ID = SLV.SEGMENT1
           AND PM.PLANT_ID = SLP.SEGMENT1
           AND SLV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'AUTO_PLAN_CALL_FLAG' AND SLV.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
           AND SLP.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'BASIS_START_TIME_PLANT' AND SLP.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') SLV
     , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FLO
 WHERE DPP.SITE_ID = SI.SITE_ID AND DPP.COMPANY_ID = SI.COMPANY_ID AND DPP.DIVISION_ID = SI.DIVISION_ID AND DPP.ITEM_ID = SI.ITEM_ID
   AND DPP.SITE_ID = SLV.SEGMENT1 AND SLV.PLANT_ID = DPP.PLANT_ID
   AND DPP.SITE_ID = FLO.SEGMENT1 AND DPP.DIVISION_ID = FLO.SEGMENT2 AND DPP.OPERATION_ID = FLO.SEGMENT3 AND DPP.COMPANY_ID = FLO.SEGMENT4
   AND FLO.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_MMD_ROUTE_CONVERT' AND FLO.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y' AND FLO.ATTRIBUTE2 = 'Y'
   AND DPP.PLAN_DATE >= TO_DATE(SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD') - (NVL((SELECT ST_SUM
                               FROM (SELECT NVL(AIF.ROUTE_TOTAL_TIME / 14400.0, 0.0) + NVL(AIF.REMAIN_TIME / 1440.0, 0.0) AS ST_SUM
                                          , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AIF.OPERATION_SEQ, OPERATION_STEP) AS ROW_NUM
                                       FROM SCM_AGING_ITEM_FLOW_M AIF
                                      WHERE AIF.DEFAULT_ROUTE = 'Y' AND AIF.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'B'
                                        AND AIF.COMPANY_ID = DPP.COMPANY_ID AND AIF.DIVISION_ID = DPP.DIVISION_ID
                                        AND AIF.SITE_ID = DPP.SITE_ID AND AIF.PLANT_ID = DPP.PLANT_ID
                                        AND AIF.FACTORY_ID = DPP.FACTORY_ID AND AIF.ITEM_ID = DPP.ITEM_ID
                                        AND AIF.LINE_ID = (SELECT FL.SEGMENT2 FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE FL
                                                            WHERE FL.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'FORMATION_LINE_MAPPING' AND FL.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
                                                              AND FL.SEGMENT1 = DPP.SITE_ID AND FL.SEGMENT5 = DPP.LINE_ID FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY))
                              WHERE ROW_NUM = 1), TO_NUMBER(FLO.ATTRIBUTE3)) + 2)

NAME: SCM_FORMATION_POST_CELL_V
TEXT:
SELECT DPP.COMPANY_ID
     , DPP.DIVISION_ID
     , DPP.SITE_ID
     , DPP.PLANT_ID
     , DPP.FACTORY_ID
     , DPP.OPERATION_ID
     , DPP.ITEM_ID
     , DPP.LINE_ID
     , DPP.PLAN_DATE
     , DPP.PLAN_QTY
     , DPP.PLAN_IN_QTY
     , SBM.ITEM_ID                     AS CELL_ITEM_ID
     , SBM.REQ_QTY * DPP.PLAN_IN_QTY   AS CELL_REQ_QTY
  FROM FP_DAILY_PRODUCTIOIN_PLAN_H DPP
  LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT SBM.COMPANY_ID, SBM.DIVISION_ID, SBM.SITE_ID, SBM.PLANT_ID, SBM.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                        , SBM.ITEM_ID, SBM.REQ_QTY
                        , CASE WHEN SBM.ALT_ID IS NULL THEN 1
                               ELSE ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SBM.COMPANY_ID, SBM.DIVISION_ID, SBM.SITE_ID, SBM.PLANT_ID, SBM.PARENT_ITEM_ID, SBM.ALT_ID
                                                           ORDER BY SBM.ALT_PRIORITY, SBM.PRIT)
                          END                         AS PRIT
                     FROM (SELECT SBM.COMPANY_ID, SBM.DIVISION_ID, SBM.SITE_ID, SBM.PLANT_ID, SBM.PARENT_ITEM_ID
                                , CIM.ITEM_ID, SBM.ALT_ID, SBM.ALT_PRIORITY
                                , SBM.CHILD_QTY / SBM.PARENT_QTY AS REQ_QTY
                                , (SELECT ILA.PRIORITY
                                     FROM SCM_ITEM_LINE_ASSIGN_M ILA
                                        , SCM_LINE_M             SLM
                                    WHERE ILA.COMPANY_ID     = SLM.COMPANY_ID
                                      AND ILA.DIVISION_ID    = SLM.DIVISION_ID
                                      AND ILA.SITE_ID        = SLM.SITE_ID
                                      AND ILA.PLANT_ID       = SLM.PLANT_ID
                                      AND ILA.FACTORY_ID     = SLM.FACTORY_ID
                                      AND ILA.OPERATION_ID   = SLM.OPERATION_ID
                                      AND ILA.LINE_ID        = SLM.LINE_ID
                                      AND ILA.ELECTRODE_TYPE = SLM.ELECTRODE_TYPE
                                      AND ILA.MONTH         >= TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1), 'YYYYMM')
                                      AND ILA.COMPANY_ID     = CIM.COMPANY_ID
                                      AND ILA.DIVISION_ID    = CIM.DIVISION_ID
                                      AND ILA.SITE_ID        = CIM.SITE_ID
                                      AND ILA.ITEM_ID        = CIM.ITEM_ID
                                      AND ILA.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
                                      AND SLM.ACTIVE_FLAG    = 'Y'
                                    ORDER BY ILA.MONTH, ILA.PRIORITY
                                    FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY)  AS PRIT
                             FROM SCM_ITEM_M       CIM
                                , SCM_ITEM_CLASS_M ICM
                                , SCM_BOM_M        SBM
                            WHERE SBM.EFF_START_DATE <= SYSDATE
                              AND SBM.EFF_END_DATE    > SYSDATE
                              AND CIM.COMPANY_ID  = SBM.COMPANY_ID
                              AND CIM.DIVISION_ID = SBM.DIVISION_ID
                              AND CIM.SITE_ID     = SBM.SITE_ID
                              AND CIM.ITEM_ID     = SBM.CHILD_ITEM_ID
                              AND ICM.CLASS_ID    = CIM.ITEM_CLASS
                              AND ICM.CLASS_ID    IN ('ES1901', 'ES2001', 'ES2002', 'ES2003', 'ES2004')) SBM
                  ) SBM
    ON DPP.COMPANY_ID  = SBM.COMPANY_ID
   AND DPP.DIVISION_ID = SBM.DIVISION_ID
   AND DPP.SITE_ID     = SBM.SITE_ID
   AND DPP.PLANT_ID    = SBM.PLANT_ID
   AND DPP.ITEM_ID     = SBM.PARENT_ITEM_ID
   AND (SBM.PRIT IS NULL OR SBM.PRIT = 1)
     , (SELECT SLV.SEGMENT1
             , SLP.SEGMENT1  AS PLANT_ID
             , SLV.ATTRIBUTE1
          FROM SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SLV
             , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE SLP
             , SCM_PLANT_M          PM
         WHERE SLP.SEGMENT2         = SLV.SEGMENT2
           AND PM.SITE_ID           = SLV.SEGMENT1
           AND PM.PLANT_ID          = SLP.SEGMENT1
           AND SLV.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'AUTO_PLAN_CALL_FLAG'
           AND SLV.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y'
           AND SLP.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'BASIS_START_TIME_PLANT'
           AND SLP.ACTIVE_FLAG      = 'Y') SLV
     , SCM_OPERATION_M SOM
 WHERE DPP.COMPANY_ID   = SOM.COMPANY_ID
   AND DPP.DIVISION_ID  = SOM.DIVISION_ID
   AND DPP.SITE_ID      = SOM.SITE_ID
   AND DPP.OPERATION_ID = SOM.OPERATION_ID
   AND DPP.SITE_ID      = SLV.SEGMENT1
   AND DPP.PLANT_ID     = SLV.PLANT_ID
   AND DPP.PLAN_TYPE    = 'RELEASE'
   AND DPP.PLAN_DATE   >= TO_DATE(SLV.ATTRIBUTE1, 'YYYYMMDD')
   AND SOM.INSTANCE_TYPE = 'F0'
   AND DPP.PLAN_IN_QTY  > 0

NAME: SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_CPS_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * ================================================================================================
 * Program ID          : SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_CPS_V
 *
 * Program Name        : SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_CPS_V
 * Param               :
 * Batch Period        :
 * Description         : 기준 정보 Data 조회 Hierarchy 정보

 * Source System       : FP SDB
 * Destination System  : GSCM SDB
 * Source Table        : SCM_LINE_M, SCM_PLANT_M, SCM_FACTORY_M, SCM_OPERATION_M, SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE

 *                       2021.10.06 kimcd       속도 개선위해 Join 조건 추가
 * 2026-07-04    ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 * ================================================================================================
 */

		A.COMPANY_ID,
		H.COMPANY_NAME,
		A.DIVISION_ID,
		B.ATTRIBUTE1 AS DIVISION_NAME,
		A.SITE_ID,
		I.SITE_NAME,
		A.PLANT_ID,
		C.PLANT_NAME,
		CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID LIKE 'P%' THEN 'P' ELSE E.OPERATION_GROUP_ID END AS OPERATION_GROUP_ID,
		F.SEGMENT2 AS OPERATION_GROUP,
		A.FACTORY_ID,
		D.FACTORY_NAME,
--		E.SHOP_GROUP_ID,

		A.OPERATION_ID,
		E.OPERATION_NAME,
		A.LINE_ID,
		A.LINE_NAME,
		A.ELECTRODE_TYPE,
		A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE
FROM 	SCM_LINE_M A
		, SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE B
		, SCM_COMPANY_M H
		, SCM_SITE_M I
		, SCM_PLANT_M C
		, SCM_FACTORY_M D
		, SCM_OPERATION_M E
		, SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE F
		--, (SELECT 	COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID
		--	FROM 	FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V
		--	GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID) G
WHERE 	1=1
AND 	A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND 	B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_NAME'
AND 	A.DIVISION_ID = B.SEGMENT1
AND 	A.PLANT_ID = C.PLANT_ID
AND     A.SITE_ID = C.SITE_ID -- 2021-10-06 kimcd 조건 추가

AND     A.COMPANY_ID = C.COMPANY_ID -- 2021-10-06 kimcd 조건 추가
AND 	A.FACTORY_ID = D.FACTORY_ID
AND 	A.COMPANY_ID = D.COMPANY_ID -- 2021-10-06 kimcd 조건 추가
AND 	A.COMPANY_ID = E.COMPANY_ID
AND 	A.COMPANY_ID = H.COMPANY_ID
AND 	A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
AND 	A.SITE_ID = E.SITE_ID
AND 	A.SITE_ID = I.SITE_ID
AND     A.COMPANY_ID = I.COMPANY_ID  -- 2021-10-06 kimcd 조건 추가
AND 	A.OPERATION_ID = E.OPERATION_ID
AND 	E.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND 	F.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'SHOP_GROUP_ID'
AND 	E.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = F.SEGMENT1
