NAME: SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V
TEXT:
(
  /*******************************************************************************
 * 뷰 명       : SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V
 * 스키마      : FP_MGR
 * 설명        :
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 수정이력
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 *  DATE      IN CHARGE           DESCRIPTION
 *-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * 2026.03.06   jcnam        [PJ20264226] NextSCM Pilot 설계 및 개발
 *******************************************************************************/
  SELECT
/* Program ID          : SCM_LINE_HIERARCHY_V */
 /*+ USE_HASH(A B C D E F G H I) */
       A.COMPANY_ID,
       H.COMPANY_NAME,
       A.DIVISION_ID,
       B.ATTRIBUTE1 AS DIVISION_NAME,
       A.SITE_ID,
       I.SITE_NAME,
       A.PLANT_ID,
       C.PLANT_NAME,
       CASE
         WHEN A.OPERATION_ID LIKE 'P%' THEN 'P'
         ELSE E.OPERATION_GROUP_ID
       END AS OPERATION_GROUP_ID,
       F.SEGMENT2 AS OPERATION_GROUP,
       A.FACTORY_ID,
       D.FACTORY_NAME,
--     E.SHOP_GROUP_ID,
--     E.OPERATION_GROUP_NAME,
       A.OPERATION_ID,
       E.OPERATION_NAME,
       A.LINE_ID,
       A.LINE_NAME,
       A.ELECTRODE_TYPE,
       A.PROD_VERSION_TYPE,
       C.PLANT_TYPE                 -- 2025.11.14 kimcd       [PJ2025F254]  JV법인 ESS 혼용 생산 시스템 개선 가상 Plant 구분용 SCM_PLANT_M.PLANT_TYPE 컬럼 추가
FROM   SCM_LINE_M A
       JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE B
         ON B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_NAME'
        AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.SEGMENT1
       JOIN SCM_COMPANY_M H
         ON A.COMPANY_ID = H.COMPANY_ID
       JOIN SCM_SITE_M I
         ON A.SITE_ID = I.SITE_ID
        AND A.COMPANY_ID = I.COMPANY_ID  -- 2021-10-06 kimcd 조건 추가
       JOIN SCM_PLANT_M C
         ON A.PLANT_ID = C.PLANT_ID
        AND A.SITE_ID = C.SITE_ID -- 2021-10-06 kimcd 조건 추가
        AND A.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID -- 2021-10-06 kimcd 조건 추가
        AND A.COMPANY_ID = C.COMPANY_ID -- 2021-10-06 kimcd 조건 추가
       JOIN SCM_FACTORY_M D
         ON A.FACTORY_ID = D.FACTORY_ID
        AND A.COMPANY_ID = D.COMPANY_ID -- 2021-10-06 kimcd 조건 추가
       JOIN SCM_OPERATION_M E
         ON A.COMPANY_ID = E.COMPANY_ID
        AND A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
        AND A.SITE_ID = E.SITE_ID
        AND A.OPERATION_ID = E.OPERATION_ID
        AND E.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
       JOIN SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE F
         ON F.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'SHOP_GROUP_ID'
        AND E.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = F.SEGMENT1
       JOIN (
              SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID
              FROM   FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V
              GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID
            ) G
         ON A.DIVISION_ID = G.DIVISION_ID
        AND A.COMPANY_ID = G.COMPANY_ID
        AND A.SITE_ID = G.SITE_ID
        AND A.OPERATION_ID = G.OPERATION_ID

NAME: SCM_SITE_HIERARCHY_V
TEXT:
SELECT
/*
 * ================================================================================================
 * Program ID          : SCM_SITE_HIERARCHY_V
 *
 * Program Name        : SCM_SITE_HIERARCHY_V
 * Param               :
 * Batch Period        :
 * Description         : 기준 정보 Data 조회 Hierarchy 정보
 *
 * Source System       : FP SDB
 * Destination System  : GSCM SDB
 * Source Table        : SCM_LINE_M, SCM_PLANT_M, SCM_FACTORY_M, SCM_OPERATION_M, SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE
 * Destination Table   :
 *
 * Create(Update) Date : 2020.09.10
 * Author              : choikjthira
 * Version             : 2020.09.10	choikjthira 신규 생성
 * 2026-07-04    ZIONEX         [PJ202650304]  NextSCM Migration
 * ================================================================================================
 */
  DISTINCT
        A.COMPANY_ID,
        H.COMPANY_NAME,
        A.DIVISION_ID,
        B.ATTRIBUTE1 AS DIVISION_NAME,
        A.SITE_ID,
        I.SITE_NAME,
        CASE WHEN A.OPERATION_ID LIKE 'P%' THEN 'P' ELSE E.OPERATION_GROUP_ID END AS SHOP_GROUP_ID,
        F.SEGMENT2 AS OPERATION_GROUP,
        A.PLANT_ID,
        C.PLANT_NAME
FROM    SCM_LINE_M A
      , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE B
      , SCM_COMPANY_M H
      , SCM_SITE_M I
      , SCM_PLANT_M C
      , SCM_OPERATION_M E
      , SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE F
      , (SELECT COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID
           FROM FP_INSTANCE_OPERATION_V
          GROUP BY COMPANY_ID, DIVISION_ID, SITE_ID, OPERATION_ID) G
WHERE   1 = 1
AND     A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND     B.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'DIVISION_NAME'
AND     A.DIVISION_ID = B.SEGMENT1
AND     A.PLANT_ID = C.PLANT_ID
AND     A.COMPANY_ID = E.COMPANY_ID
AND     A.COMPANY_ID = H.COMPANY_ID
AND     A.DIVISION_ID = E.DIVISION_ID
AND     A.SITE_ID = E.SITE_ID
AND     A.SITE_ID = I.SITE_ID
AND     A.OPERATION_ID = E.OPERATION_ID
AND     E.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
AND     F.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'SHOP_GROUP_ID'
AND     E.OPERATION_GROUP_ID = F.SEGMENT1
AND     A.DIVISION_ID = G.DIVISION_ID
AND     A.COMPANY_ID = G.COMPANY_ID
AND     A.SITE_ID = G.SITE_ID
AND     A.OPERATION_ID = G.OPERATION_ID
